title: Physiotherapist
description:
Junior Physiotherapist 
 Position Overview We are looking for a motivated, responsible, and patient-focused Junior Physiotherapist to join our clinical team. The candidate will work under the guidance of senior physiotherapists and contribute to assessment, treatment, rehabilitation, patient education, documentation, and overall clinic operations. Key Responsibilities Conduct basic physiotherapy assessments under senior supervision. Assist in developing and implementing individualized treatment and rehabilitation plans. Provide treatment for orthopaedic, neurological, sports injury, post-operative, geriatric, and other rehabilitation patients as per clinical requirements. Perform therapeutic exercises, strengthening, stretching, mobility, balance, posture, and functional training. Assist with manual therapy and electrotherapy modalities as per the treatment plan. Monitor patient progress and modify exercises/treatment as instructed by the senior physiotherapist. Educate patients regarding home exercises, posture, ergonomics, precautions, and lifestyle modifications. Ensure patients perform exercises safely and with correct technique. Maintain accurate and timely patient records, treatment notes, progress reports, and follow-up documentation. Conduct regular patient follow-ups and encourage treatment and exercise compliance. Communicate professionally with patients, attendants, doctors, and other healthcare professionals. Maintain cleanliness, organization, and proper functioning of the treatment and exercise areas. Ensure physiotherapy equipment and treatment areas are used safely and responsibly. Assist in clinic camps, assessments, awareness programs, and patient education activities when required. Support senior physiotherapists in day-to-day clinical and administrative activities. Maintain patient confidentiality and follow professional and ethical standards. Represent the clinic professionally and contribute to a positive patient experience. Home Physiotherapy Visits The candidate should be willing and comfortable to undertake home physiotherapy visits when required. Home visits may include assessment, treatment, therapeutic exercise, rehabilitation, mobility training, and patient/caregiver education. The physiotherapist is expected to maintain the same level of professionalism, clinical standards, documentation, and patient care during home visits as in the clinic. Home visits may be scheduled based on patient requirements and clinic availability. Home visits will be compensated separately from the regular salary through a percentage-based incentive/revenue-sharing structure. The applicable percentage for each home visit will be discussed and mutually agreed upon at the time of joining. Home-visit incentives will be calculated based on completed/eligible visits as per the clinic's applicable policy. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 1. Patient Care & Treatment Quality Safe and effective patient handling. Correct execution of prescribed treatment protocols. Quality of exercise instruction and progression. Improvement in patient functional outcomes. 2. Patient Compliance & Retention Patient adherence to treatment plans and home exercise programs. Follow-up and appointment compliance. Patient communication and satisfaction. Ability to build professional and positive patient relationships. 3. Clinical Documentation Accurate assessment and treatment records. Timely updating of patient progress notes. Proper documentation of home visits and treatment outcomes. 4. Clinical Skill Development Continuous improvement in physiotherapy assessment and treatment skills. Ability to understand and implement appropriate rehabilitation protocols. Participation in internal training, case discussions, and learning activities. 5. Professionalism & Teamwork Punctuality and attendance. Professional behaviour and communication. Teamwork and cooperation with senior physiotherapists and clinic staff. Accountability and willingness to take responsibility for assigned duties. 6. Home Visit Performance Willingness and availability for assigned home visits. Quality and consistency of home-based treatment. Timely completion of home-visit documentation. Patient satisfaction and adherence during home rehabilitation. Contribution to home-visit revenue through quality patient care and follow-up. 7. Clinic Operations Proper handling and maintenance of equipment. Maintaining cleanliness and organization. Supporting clinic camps, assessments, awareness programs, and other clinic initiatives. Employment Terms Position: Junior Physiotherapist Employment Type: Full-time Contract Duration: 1 year Reporting To: Senior Physiotherapist / Clinical Head Performance Review: Regular performance reviews based on clinical performance, patient care, KPIs, professionalism, attendance, teamwork, and overall contribution to the clinic. Contract Renewal: Renewal after completion of the one-year contract will be subject to performance, conduct, and organizational requirements. Home Visit Incentive: Additional percentage-based incentive/revenue sharing for eligible home physiotherapy visits, separate from the fixed salary. Candidate Requirements Bachelor's degree in Physiotherapy ( BPT ) from a recognized institution. Valid registration as applicable. Freshers and candidates with relevant clinical experience may apply. Strong interest in clinical physiotherapy and rehabilitation. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to learn and work under clinical supervision. Willingness to undertake home physiotherapy visits when assigned. Responsible, punctual, disciplined, and patient-oriented. Ability to work effectively as part of a clinical team. Preferred Qualities Clinical knowledge • Good communication • Patient empathy • Willingness to learn • Professional attitude • Teamwork • Accountability • Attention to detail • Time management • Flexibility for home visits

Key Skills: Bpt,Physiotherapy,Physical Therapy,Physical,Therapy

title: NPD - Procurement [Leading D2C Skincare Brand] Professional
description:
Job Description

Role: NPD (New Product Development) -Procurement 
Department: NPD 
Experience: Fresher (0-1 year) 
Location: Kolkata (Work from Office) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Note: - Fresher or 1+ year experience candidates with a Bachelors degree in B.Com are applicable. 

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented NPD to join our team. The role will involve supporting the development and procurement of packaging materials, coordinating with vendors, and ensuring the right balance between cost, quality, timelines, and product requirements.
The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in procurement, packaging, vendor management, and cost optimization, along with good communication and negotiation skills.

Key Responsibilities:
1 . Packaging Procurement 
- Coordinate the procurement of packaging materials such as bottles, tubes, cartons, labels, pouches, jars, caps, pumps, and other components.
- Source and evaluate new vendors based on price, quality, MOQ, capacity, and lead time.
- Collect and compare quotations from multiple suppliers.
- Track purchase orders, production status, dispatches, and deliveries.
- Ensure materials are procured as per approved specifications and timelines.
2. Vendor Management 
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and new vendors.
- Coordinate with vendors for quotations, samples, production updates, quality issues, and deliveries.
- Follow up regularly to ensure timely execution of orders.
- Identify alternate vendors to improve competitiveness and reduce dependency.
- Maintain an updated vendor database with pricing, MOQ, lead time, and other commercial details.
3. Cost Optimization 
- Identify opportunities for cost reduction across packaging components.
- Benchmark vendor prices and negotiate for better commercial terms.
- Compare material specifications and alternate solutions to achieve cost efficiencies without compromising quality.
- Support the team in achieving procurement cost-saving targets.
- Track changes in packaging costs and maintain updated rate comparisons.
4. NPD / Packaging Development 
- Coordinate with internal teams for new packaging requirements.
- Communicate packaging specifications and requirements to vendors.
- Coordinate sampling, modifications, approvals, and finalization of packaging components.
- Follow up on tooling, moulds, samples, trials, and commercial production wherever applicable.
- Ensure packaging development timelines are aligned with product launch requirements.
5. Coordination Documentation 
- Coordinate with Design, RD, Quality, Operations, Finance, and other internal teams.
- Maintain proper records of quotations, samples, specifications, purchase orders, and vendor communications.
- Prepare cost comparison sheets and procurement reports.
- Track pending actions and ensure timely closure.

 What We Are Looking For 
 - Fresher with a Bachelors degree in B.Com 
- Strong interest in procurement, sourcing, packaging, and vendor management.
- Good communication and negotiation skills.
- Good command of MS Excel / Google Sheets. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to manage multiple vendors and follow up on several activities simultaneously.
- Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
- Willingness to learn about packaging materials, manufacturing processes, and commercial negotiations.

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): 
The candidate will be evaluated on:
- Vendor response and negotiation effectiveness
- Timely procurement and delivery
- New vendor development
- Reduction in procurement lead times
- Accuracy of cost comparisons and documentation
- Successful execution of new packaging development
- Vendor performance and issue resolution

Why Join Us
This role provides an opportunity to gain hands-on exposure to packaging procurement, vendor negotiations, cost optimization, and new product development in a fast-paced D2C environment. 
The candidate will work closely with multiple teams and vendors and will get end-to-end exposure to the packaging procurement and NPD process.

 Position Overview 
 We are looking for a professional, confident, and parent-friendly Admission Officer who will be responsible for managing the end-to-end admission enquiry process along with front office operations . The candidate will serve as the first point of contact for prospective parents, students, visitors, and other stakeholders , creating a warm and professional impression of the school. The role will involve handling admission enquiries, counselling parents, conducting follow-ups, coordinating school visits, maintaining admission records, and supporting the smooth functioning of the front office. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Admissions & Parent Counselling Handle admission enquiries received through walk-ins, telephone calls, emails, WhatsApp and online platforms . Understand parents' requirements and provide accurate information about the school's curriculum, academic programmes, facilities, fee structure, activities, and admission process . Counsel prospective parents and students and address their queries professionally. Conduct and coordinate school/campus tours for prospective parents. Explain the complete admission process, eligibility criteria, documentation requirements and timelines. Follow up with prospective parents regularly and support enquiry-to-admission conversion . Coordinate appointments and interactions with the Principal, Coordinators, or relevant academic team members. Assist parents with admission forms, document submission, assessments and other admission formalities. Ensure a smooth and positive parent experience throughout the admission journey. 
 2. Lead Management & Follow-up Maintain an updated database of all admission enquiries and leads. Record and track enquiries, follow-ups, visits, applications and admissions . Ensure timely follow-up with prospective parents and maintain proper communication records. Monitor pending enquiries and ensure that no prospective lead is missed. Prepare daily/weekly admission reports and share updates with the reporting manager. Work towards achieving assigned admission/enquiry conversion targets. 
 3. Front Office Operations Act as the first point of contact for parents, students, visitors and guests. Welcome and assist visitors in a warm, courteous and professional manner. Handle incoming and outgoing calls and direct them to the appropriate department/person. Handle general parent/visitor queries and ensure appropriate resolution or escalation. Maintain front office records, registers and other administrative documents. Coordinate with Administration, Academics, Transport, Accounts and other departments as required. 
 4. School Events & Admission Activities Support and coordinate Open Houses, Parent Orientation, Admission Events and School Tours . Assist in admission campaigns and other school promotional activities. Support the school during peak admission periods, events and parent interaction days. Represent the school professionally while interacting with prospective families. 
 5. Documentation & MIS Ensure accurate maintenance of admission forms and supporting documents. Update admission data in the school's ERP/CRM/Admission Management System . Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of student and parent information. Prepare admission-related MIS and reports as required by management. Maintain proper records of admission status, pending documents and follow-ups. 
 Candidate Profile

 Experience: 1-3 years of experience in School Admissions, Front Office, Counselling, Customer Service, Education Sales or a similar role. Prior experience in a school/educational institution will be preferred. 
 Required Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills , particularly in English. Strong interpersonal and parent-handling skills. Good counselling and convincing abilities. Pleasant, confident and professional personality. Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills. Good organizational and multitasking abilities. Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, Google Workspace and/or CRM/ERP systems . Ability to work under pressure, particularly during the admission season. Strong attention to detail and documentation skills. Presentable and professional in appearance and conduct. 
 Key Competencies

 Performance Indicators / KRAs Number of admission enquiries handled. Enquiry-to-visit conversion. Visit-to-admission conversion. Timely follow-up of leads. Accuracy of admission records and documentation. Parent satisfaction and service quality. Efficient management of front office operations. Timely submission of admission reports and MIS.

title: Business Development Manager | IT Services, AI Solutions
description:
About the Role 
 We are an AI-native software and consulting company that works with businesses to identify operational problems and build AI, automation, and custom software solutions around them. 
 We are looking for a **Business Development Manager** who can help us build our outbound sales engine from the ground up. 
 This is not a traditional lead-generation role where your job is to download thousands of contacts from Apollo and send generic emails. 
 You will be responsible for figuring out: 
 * Which industries and ICPs we should target * Which companies within those markets are worth approaching * Who the right decision-makers are * What messaging and offers resonate with them * Which outbound channels work best * How to consistently generate qualified sales conversations 
 You will work directly with the founder and will have significant ownership over the company's GTM strategy. 
 ## What You Will Do 
 ### Build Outbound Pipeline 
 Own outbound prospecting across channels including: 
 * Cold calling * Cold email * LinkedIn outreach * Account-based prospecting * Follow-ups and multi-channel sequences 
 Your objective is not simply to book meetings. 
 Your objective is to generate **qualified sales conversations and real business opportunities**. 
 Test Different ICPs and Markets 
 We will continuously test different industries and customer segments. 
 You will be responsible for: 
 * Researching industries and customer segments * Developing ICP hypotheses * Identifying relevant companies and decision-makers * Creating and launching outbound campaigns * Testing different messaging and offers * Measuring results * Killing campaigns that do not work * Doubling down on campaigns that show traction 
 You should be comfortable operating in an environment where the perfect sales playbook does not already exist. 
 Run Modern Outbound 
 We do not believe that simply scraping leads from Apollo and sending thousands of generic emails is an effective GTM strategy. 
 You should understand concepts such as: 
 * Account research * Segmentation * Buying signals * Trigger-based outreach * Personalized messaging * Multi-channel prospecting * AI-assisted research * CRM and pipeline management 
 You should constantly think: 
 **Why should this specific prospect care about what we are offering right now?** 
 Cold Calling 
 Cold calling is an important part of this role. 
 You should be comfortable: 
 * Calling prospects directly * Starting cold conversations * Getting through gatekeepers * Understanding the prospect's business problem * Handling objections * Identifying the right decision-maker * Converting relevant conversations into meetings 
 If you are uncomfortable picking up the phone and speaking to prospects, this role will not be a good fit. 
 Use AI in Your GTM Workflow 
 We are an AI-native company and expect our GTM team to operate similarly. 
 You should be comfortable using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI systems for: 
 * Account research * Prospect qualification * Company research * Personalization * Market analysis * Message iteration * Call preparation * Campaign analysis * Workflow automation 
 You do not need to know every AI tool available today. 
 However, you should understand how to use AI to become significantly more effective at sales and business development. 
 Generate Market Intelligence 
 Your job is not only to generate meetings. 
 Through outbound conversations and campaign data, you should also help us understand: 
 * Which industries have the strongest pain points * Which problems prospects care about * Which decision-makers respond * Common objections * Buying triggers * Why campaigns succeed or fail * How our positioning should evolve * Which ICPs we should pursue further 
 The insights you generate will directly influence the company's GTM strategy. 
 What We Are Looking For 
 You should have: 
 * 36 years of experience in Business Development, B2B Sales, Outbound Sales, or International Sales * Experience selling **IT services, software development services, AI/automation solutions, technology consulting, or similar B2B technology services** * Strong cold-calling experience * Experience generating outbound pipeline * Strong written and spoken English * Experience working with international prospects, preferably the US market * Good understanding of consultative / solution selling * Strong research and analytical skills * Experience working with CRM and prospecting tools * Ability to operate independently and take ownership * Comfort working directly with founders * High agency and bias toward action 
 Good to Have 
 Experience with: 
 * AI / Generative AI / Automation services * IT consulting or software development companies * US-market outbound * Apollo * LinkedIn Sales Navigator * Clay * HubSpot or similar CRMs * Cold email tools * Email deliverability * AI-assisted GTM workflows 
 This Role Is Not For You If 
 * Your outbound strategy is simply downloading lists and mass-emailing them * You only want inbound leads handed to you * You are unwilling to cold call * You measure success primarily by the number of emails sent * You need a mature sales playbook before you can operate * You have no experience selling technology or services * You are primarily looking for a people-management role 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Within the first few months, you should be able to: 
 * Build a structured outbound process * Test multiple ICPs and campaigns * Consistently generate qualified conversations * Identify which industries and messages are working * Build a repeatable prospecting process * Provide clear market insights based on real conversations * Create a predictable pipeline of qualified opportunities 
 The long-term objective is simple: 
 Build a repeatable outbound engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline for the company. 
 This is a high-ownership individual-contributor role. 
 If you enjoy experimenting with markets, talking to prospects, building outbound systems, and figuring out what actually makes customers buy, you will have significant ownership here.

title: JIRA Service Management Developer and Administrator
description:
Role Summary We are seeking an experienced Jira Service Management professional to administer, configure and enhance our Jira and JSM environment. The role combines platform administration with hands-on solution development - designing ITIL-aligned service management processes, automation, asset (CMDB) configuration, integrations and reporting that improve service delivery and operational visibility across the organisation. Key Responsibilities Jira Service Management Administration Administer, configure and maintain Jira and Jira Service Management (JSM) platforms including workflows, portals, request types, SLAs and project settings. Manage users, roles, permissions and access controls while enabling effective self-service experiences. Provide platform support, troubleshooting, upgrades, migrations and continuous improvement of the JSM environment. JSM Development Configuration Design and configure JSM solutions by translating business and ITSM requirements into workflows, approvals, request types, forms, queues, SLAs, notifications and escalations. Customize and optimize JSM through workflow configurations, automation, standards and reusable solutions aligned with organizational processes and Atlassian best practices. Develop dashboards, reports, filters and advanced JQL queries to support operational visibility and service performance monitoring. ITSM Process Implementation Implement, configure and support ITIL-aligned JSM processes including Incident, Major Incident, Service Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Asset and Configuration Management. Design and maintain workflows, approvals, SLAs, queues, automation and reporting to ensure efficient service delivery, governance and continuous process improvement. Automation Design, implement and maintain JSM automation solutions to streamline ticket management, approvals, notifications, escalations, status transitions and other operational processes. Develop automated workflows using Jira Automation rules, including cross-project orchestration, ticket creation/linking and process optimization to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. Assets Configuration Management Configure and administer JSM Assets (CMDB) including asset schemas, object types, relationships and configuration items (CIs) for services, applications and infrastructure. Manage asset integrations, imports, data synchronization and linkage with ITSM processes (Incidents, Requests, Problems, and Changes) to ensure accurate configuration and asset data management. Integrations API Develop, configure and support integrations between JSM and enterprise platforms using REST APIs, webhooks, Jira Automation and JSON. Integrate JSM with collaboration, identity, monitoring, DevOps and IT operations tools while troubleshooting integration, authentication and data synchronization issues to ensure seamless service delivery. DevOps Development Integration Integrate JSM with Jira Software and DevOps toolchains to support incident, change, deployment, and release management processes. Configure and automate development-service management workflows, enabling seamless collaboration between development, IT operations and support teams. Reporting Dashboards Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, filters and advanced JQL queries to monitor SLAs, service performance, incident and change trends and key ITSM metrics. Provide regular delivery updates and status reporting to project leads. Align data solutions with enterprise architecture and cloud strategy. Strong understanding of data engineering principles, architecture patterns, and best practices. Expertise in data modeling techniques (normalized, dimensional, star, snowflake schemas). Deep understanding of RDBMS operations and SQL Server performance optimization. Experience extracting and integrating data from structured (RDBMS) and unstructured sources (flat files, external feeds). Proficiency in query optimization, performance profiling, and monitoring tools. Experience creating and maintaining business requirements documentation and technical specifications. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

title: AI Enablement Lead
description:
ABOUT GLOBALSIGN Established in 1996, GlobalSign is the leading provider of trusted identity and security solutions enabling businesses, large enterprises, cloud service providers and IoT innovators around the world to secure online communications, manage millions of verified digital identities and automate digital signing, authentication, and encryption. Its high- scale PKI solutions support the billions of services, devices, people, and things comprising the Internet of Everything (IoE). The company has offices in the Americas, Europe, and Asia. 
 JOB SUMMARY: The AI Enablement Lead is responsible for accelerating the adoption and valorisation of artificial intelligence (AI) across GlobalSign. Working within the IT Department and reporting to the Chief Information and Security Officer, this role owns AI governance and policy, evaluates and rationalizes the AI tool portfolio, prepares the organization's knowledge and data for AI use, leads AI-driven business process transformation, measures the value delivered, and develops AI capability across the workforce. The AI Enablement Lead is the primary internal catalyst for AI-driven transformation, from strategy and tooling through to hands-on delivery support . 
 Role & responsibilities 1. Drive AI Governance and Policy Optimization Own and continuously optimize GlobalSign's AI usage policy, acceptable-use standards, and approval workflows, keeping them practical enough to encourage adoption while protecting the company's position as a publicly trusted certificate authority. Define and govern the AI operating model: platform selection, data usage, security-by-design, model lifecycle management, and integration with existing IT architecture. Set human-in-the-loop, review, and disclosure requirements for AI outputs used in regulated, audited, or customer-facing processes, and refresh policy as tool capabilities change. 2. Evaluate Emerging AI Technologies and Optimize the Tool Portfolio Scan the market for emerging AI models, agents, copilots, and platforms, and run structured evaluations against capability, total cost, security posture, data residency, and integration fit. Rationalize the tool portfolio by consolidating overlapping tools and retiring those underused or superseded and support procurement and legal review of AI vendors. Maintain reusable frameworks and reference architectures so departments build on a consistent foundation and advise leadership on build-versus-buy and investment priorities. 3. Establish AI-Ready Knowledge and Data Management Practices Define how enterprise knowledge is structured, labelled, owned, and maintained so that it can be reliably retrieved and used by AI systems. Lead the design of retrieval-augmented generation foundations: source-of-truth repositories, indexing strategy, access controls, and rules for content freshness and ownership. Set data classification and handling rules governing which data may reach which AI systems and improve data quality in the systems feeding AI use cases. 4. Manage AI Adoption Metrics and Subscription Inventory Maintain a complete inventory of AI tools, agents, models, and subscriptions, including business owner, cost, contract terms, renewal dates, and governance status. Track license utilization and adoption by department and users, identifying under-used seats, unmet demand, and unsanctioned shadow AI. Drive cost optimization through rightsizing, consolidation, and timely renewal or cancellation decisions. 5. Lead AI-Driven Business Process Transformation Map existing processes with department leads, identify automation and augmentation opportunities, and prioritize them by value, feasibility, and risk. Redesign workflows around AI capabilities rather than layering tools onto unchanged processes, translating business problems into scoped use cases with named owners. Move teams from proof-of-concept to production deployment, providing hands-on delivery support and coordinating across departments to avoid duplication. 6. Measure, Track, and Report Business Impact Define AI value KPIs covering adoption, efficiency gains, cost, quality, risk reduction, and customer impact, and establish baselines before deployment. Build and maintain a central AI value dashboard showing active initiatives, their status, and their measured outcomes. Report to leadership and the Board on realized versus projected value, and recommend whether initiatives are scaled, sustained, or stopped. 
 REQUIRED SKILLS: 5+ years of relevant professional experience Demonstrable experience in AI, data, technology consulting, or IT strategy role, with hands-on delivery of AI or automation projects at organizational level. Strong understanding of modern AI concepts including large language models, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, and copilot architectures. Proven ability to define, track, and communicate value metrics and KPIs related to technology adoption and business impact. Experience establishing knowledge management, documentation, or data governance standards, and managing a software or SaaS portfolio including licenses, cost, and renewals .

title: Bioinformatics Engineer
description:
About NonStop: NonStop is a software services company at the intersection of bioinformatics, genomics, and healthcare technology. We partner with biotech firms, pharma organizations, genomics labs, and clinical institutions to design and deliver production-grade bioinformatics software, AI-powered analytical platforms, and end-to-end genomic data pipelines. We work on problems that matter: from accelerating variant interpretation workflows and building HIPAA-compliant AI platforms, to orchestrating large-scale multi-omics pipelines for disease diagnostics and pharmacogenomics. Our team blends deep domain expertise with engineering rigor, and were growing to meet the increasing demand from the life sciences industry for smart, scalable, and compliant bioinformatics solutions. 
 We work this way: We dig deep into biological problems, not just the code. Domain knowledge is valued as much as engineering craft. Bioinformatics is a team sport. Youll work alongside software engineers, clinicians, and research scientists. You own your work end-to-end, from design to delivery. We trust you to make good decisions and learn fast. Life sciences move fast. We encourage continuous learning, conference participation, and staying ahead of the field. 
 Your role: As a Bioinformatics Engineer at NonStop, you will be a key contributor in designing, building, and maintaining bioinformatics software solutions and analytical pipelines for our clients across genomics, clinical diagnostics, and precision medicine. Youll bring both biological insight and engineering excellence to every project, collaborating with product, engineering, and scientific teams to deliver solutions that are scalable, reproducible, and compliant. 
 You ll be responsible for: Build scalable bioinformatics applications and pipelines for efficient processing of genomic, transcriptomic, and multi-omics data. Produce high-quality, detailed documentation for all projects, pipelines, tools, APIs, and analytical methods. Provide technical consultation and solutions across cross-functional bioinformatics projects. Coach and mentor team members through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and pairing on domain-specific challenges. Ensure compliance with our SDLC process throughout the product development lifecycle. Stay current with evolving bioinformatics technologies and evangelize technical excellence within the team. 
 We re looking for: Preferably 1 year of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining bioinformatics solutions. Masters degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a closely related technical discipline. Strong understanding of genomic data analysis, variant calling, targeted sequencing, whole-exome (WES), and whole-genome sequencing (WGS) workflows. Hands-on experience with RNA-seq analysis, including differential expression and transcriptomic workflows. Proficiency in variant interpretation and ACMG/AMP classification workflows is a plus. Knowledge of algorithms and computational model development applied to biological data. Strong foundation in statistics and data analysis as applied to genomics and bioinformatics. Experience developing and debugging bioinformatics pipelines using Nextflow, Snakemake, WDL, or CWL. Proficiency in shell scripting and Linux/Unix environments for NGS data analysis. Familiarity with workflow automation and best practices in reproducible pipeline design. Excellent programming skills in Python (primary); familiarity with R or Java is a plus. Proficiency with standard bioinformatics tools (GATK, DeepVariant, VEP, ANNOVAR, MultiQC, FastQC, etc.). Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB). Confident use of Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development. Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS or GCP, or Azure) for bioinformatics workloads. Familiarity with high-performance computing (HPC) environments is a plus. 
 Why join NonStop: Work on real-world genomics and clinical bioinformatics problems that directly impact patient care and scientific discovery. Collaborate with life sciences clients at the cutting edge, from rare disease diagnostics to AI-assisted bioinformatics platforms.

 The Servicing Transaction Management department is responsible for the loan boarding and deboarding process. This role relates to converting other servicers data to upload into Onitys loan servicing system and subsequently validating the data uploaded versus the data and/or documents received for all newly boarded loans. This position is responsible for developing projects in the loan boarding and related applications for bulk and flow transfers. The Data Mapping Analyst will analyze and program boarding files, as well as participate in data mapping, researching issues and testing the application and data loads. This position requires strong analytical skills and technical knowledge to support the Loansphere Loan Boarding System (LLB) as well as the Onity proprietary Loan Boarding Tool. The Data Analyst will work closely with various parties including their immediate team, business units, prior servicers and other technical teams to coordinate data transformation. This role will also be responsible for implementing tools to support transfer efficiency, as well as keeping documentation updated and communicating changes to processes, procedures and tools. 
 JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 Ensures that new loan programs or changes are incorporated into the boarding process. Analyzes boarding error messages to determine root cause and remediates issues. Creates edit checks within the Loan Baording System to recognize errors prior to boarding. Develop and configure the Loan Boarding System, as well as supporting toolsets such as SharePoint to support boarding data management. This includes mapping of seller/prior servicer data, create and update tables and define and implement solutions for converting the data. Perform testing to support trials and production. Review error reports and document/communicate issues found. Determine solutions for issues. Define requirements for and implement tools and processes to improve data quality and visibility. Work closely via meetings and conference calls with Business Unit Leads and prior servicers to ensure data transformation is accurate and clearly communicated. Update/create procedures and continue to enhance and optimize the boarding process, including tool enhancements as required. Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements (i.e. RESPA, USAP, Sarbox, etc.). Produce and review required control reporting. Meet all established milestones for deboarding/boarding project plans. Follow all established procedures regarding boarding/deboarding. Ensure all quality steps are completed and documented. Escalate any possible deadline misses. Communicate boarding/deboarding expectations with internal and external clients regularly. Organize meetings with internal and external clients with documented meeting minutes. Self-driven, should be able to handle high pressure. Must identify ways to automate processes and set up controls when required. Willing to work extra hours as per the process requirements/Flexibility to work in accordance with Business requirements. 
 KEY RESULTS AREA: 
 Reduce number of Servicing Transaction Management related customer complaints by a designated management percentage year over year. Maintain quality at 100%. Meet all milestones related to the loan boarding process. Timely responses to servicers and internal parties. 
 QUALIFICATIONS:

Proven strength in interpreting business requirements and implementing them in application or operational tools. Experience with Empower or Encompass origination system a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and attention to detail and accuracy.

title: RBI Data Analysis
description:
Job Summary Credit Risk in Indian Banking: RBI Data Analysis For most of the last decade, credit risk in Indian banking meant a crisis story. Ballooning bad loans. Undercapitalised public sector banks. A system searching for a floor. That story has changed. This analysis of Indian banking credit risk data draws straight from RBI s own numbers. It shows a sector operating at some of the lowest stressed-asset levels in its history. At the same time, new risks are quietly building underneath: unsecured retail credit, gold loans, and a fast-growing NBFC sector. So for anyone building credit risk models on Indian data, the headline ratio matters less than the underlying trend. What matters is understanding where the improvement came from, and where the residual risk now sits. This piece works through what RBI s own publications actually show. Specifically, we draw on RBI s Financial Stability Report (FSR) and its Report on Trend and Progress of Banking in India. We also use RBI s supervisory data releases directly. First, we break the picture down by bank category. Then we connect it to how analysts actually model default risk in practice. What Indian Banking Credit Risk Data Shows About Asset Quality How far asset quality has improved The single most-cited number here is the Gross Non-Performing Asset (GNPA) ratio of Scheduled Commercial Banks (SCBs). RBI s Financial Stability Report was released in June 2026. It put the GNPA ratio of SCBs at 1.8% as of March 2026 a multi-decadal low. RBI s own baseline projection expects only a slight edge-up, to around 1.9% by March 2028. The central bank called this a modest, manageable increase, not a reversal of the underlying trend. That figure looks even more striking against where the system stood less than a decade ago. In 2018, RBI s Financial Stability Report flagged a system-wide GNPA ratio of 11.46%. Banks under Prompt Corrective Action (PCA) RBI s restrictive framework for weak lenders ran even higher. The distance between 11.46% in 2018 and 1.8% in 2026 is the real story here. In fact, it represents one of the fastest deleveraging cycles any major banking system has gone through. And it wasn t accidental. It followed a specific, traceable sequence of interventions. Any credit risk analyst working with this data should be able to name them. Capital buffers moved in the same direction. RBI s June 2026 FSR put the system-wide Capital to Risk-Weighted Assets Ratio (CRAR) at 17.7%. The Common Equity Tier-1 (CET1) ratio stood at 15.3%. Both are multi-decade highs, per RBI. Similarly, RBI s Report on Trend and Progress of Banking in India 2024-25 shows the same trend over a longer horizon. System CRAR rose from 12.94% in March 2015 to roughly 17.4% by end-March 2025. Profitability tracked the same arc. Scheduled commercial banks aggregate net profit rose too from 2.63 lakh crore in FY2022-23 to 4.01 lakh crore in FY2024-25, per RBI s Trend and Progress data. What stress tests add to the Indian banking credit risk picture RBI s stress testing adds another layer here, separate from the point-in-time ratios above. Under RBI s macro stress test scenarios in the June 2026 FSR, the banking system absorbed hypothetical adverse shocks. Even so, aggregate capital ratios stayed comfortably above regulatory minimums. Compare that to RBI s own 2018 FSR. That report projected a comparable stress scenario could push GNPA at PCA banks as high as 22.3%. It also warned that at least six banks faced a capital shortfall. The gap between those two outcomes, eight years apart, is telling. It may say more about systemic resilience than either year s baseline GNPA ratio alone. None of this means credit risk has disappeared, however. RBI s June 2026 FSR was explicit on this point: new vulnerabilities are building even as legacy NPAs shrink. Specifically, RBI surveyed banks and NBFCs for the report. They flagged rising household debt, rapid growth in gold loans, and AI-enabled cyber threats as their top risks. In other words, the credit risk profile of Indian banking hasn t shrunk so much as shifted. It has moved from the corporate and industrial exposures that dominated the 2PHONE_NUMBER cycle, toward retail and unsecured lending instead. Indian Banking Credit Risk Data by Bank Category and Sector PSBs, private banks, and foreign banks compared Aggregate numbers hide where the improvement actually concentrated, though. RBI supervisory data as of breaks the 2.15% domestic GNPA ratio down by bank category. The Ministry of Finance cited this data in a Parliament reply. Public Sector Banks (PSBs) stood at 2.50%. Private Sector Banks (PVBs) stood at 1.73%. Foreign Banks stood at just 0.80%. Interestingly, the same data shows PSBs improving faster than private or foreign banks since March 2018. In other words, the segment that was historically the weakest link has also recovered the fastest. Even so, it still carries the highest absolute ratio of the three. That PSB recovery shows up in profitability too, per RBI s Trend and Progress report. PSBs aggregate net profit rose from 1.05 lakh crore in FY2022-23 to 1.78 lakh crore in FY2024-25. That s a faster proportional gain than the system as a whole. It s consistent with a segment recovering from a lower base. Where credit concentrates: NBFCs, MSMEs, and smaller lenders Beyond the bank-vs-bank split, this Indian banking credit risk data also shows where credit itself concentrates. NBFC credit is now systemically significant. It reached 14.6% of GDP in FY25, up from 13.5% a year earlier. Industry and retail exposures made up a combined 81.1% share of that NBFC credit as of end-March 2025. Services accounted for the remaining 15.4%. On the bank side, credit to MSMEs grew faster than credit to large enterprises over the same period. Meanwhile, Small Finance Banks (SFBs) posted strong balance-sheet growth. Even so, their asset quality worsened year-on-year, even as their credit-deposit ratio improved to 86.4%. That divergence is telling: large banks and PSBs improving, SFBs under pressure. It s exactly the kind of segment-level signal a system-wide GNPA number alone won t surface. Smaller institutions tell a related story, too. The number of Urban Co-operative Banks (UCBs) fell by 15 during FY25, to 1,457, as consolidation continued in that segment. Still, UCB credit growth accelerated to 6.7% the fastest pace in six years. Fraud data adds a further wrinkle here. Private sector banks accounted for 59.3% of reported fraud cases by number in FY25. Public sector banks, meanwhile, accounted for 70.7% of the total value involved. Clearly, operational risk and credit risk don t always concentrate in the same segments. How This Credit Risk Data Connects to PD Estimation A GNPA ratio is a lagging, backward-looking measure. It tells you what has already defaulted, not what s likely to default next. That s the gap probability of default (PD) modelling closes. It s also why this Indian banking credit risk data is a genuinely useful input for PD work. It s not just a macro backdrop to quote in an introduction. Two things from the data above feed directly into PD modelling in practice. First, the bank-category breakdown (PSB 2.50% vs PVB 1.73% vs Foreign 0.80%) is a natural segmentation variable. Pooling all SCBs into a single PD model would blur real structural differences in underwriting standards and portfolio.

Develop retrieval-augmented generation pipelines using structured and unstructured enterprise data. Integrate LLMs with internal applications, databases, APIs, knowledge repositories, and external systems. Implement intelligent workflows using AI agents, tools, memory, planning, and orchestration frameworks. Develop reusable components and accelerators for prompt management, document ingestion, retrieval, model integration, and response generation. LLM and Prompt Engineering Design, test, and optimize prompts for accuracy, consistency, relevance, and safety. Establish observability for model requests, token usage, latency, errors, retrieval performance, and user feedback. Optimize infrastructure and application design for scalability, reliability, performance, and cost. Troubleshoot production issues across models, prompts, retrieval pipelines, APIs, and cloud services. Translate business requirements into technical architecture and implementation plans. Collaborate with solution architects, data engineers, machine learning engineers, QA engineers, and cybersecurity teams. Conduct technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept implementations, and stakeholder presentations. Document solution architecture, model decisions, prompt strategies, evaluation results, risks, and operational procedures. Mentor junior engineers and support the adoption of Generative AI engineering best practices.

Target is an iconic brand, a Fortune 50 company, and one of America s leading retailers.
Target as a tech company Absolutely. We are the behind-the-scenes powerhouse that fuels Target s passion and commitment to cutting-edge innovation. Our teams build and operate the technology that powers every part of Target s digital and store experience. We combine modern engineering practices, cloud technologies, data, and innovative thinking to deliver reliable, scalable solutions that create meaningful value for our guests and team members.
Our high-performing teams balance independence with collaboration, and we pride ourselves on being versatile, agile, and creative. We are committed to building technology that operates smoothly, securely, and reliably while continuously exploring new ways to solve complex business problems. About the Role 
As a Senior Data Engineer , you will play a key role in designing, developing, and optimizing large-scale data platforms and pipelines that support critical business and analytical use cases. You will work across the full data lifecycle, from data ingestion and transformation to storage, processing, quality, and consumption.
You will apply strong expertise in Big Data, Apache Spark, Scala, and Google BigQuery to build high-performance, scalable, and reliable data solutions. You will work closely with engineers, architects, product teams, data scientists, and business partners to translate complex requirements into robust technical solutions.
The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with a passion for solving complex problems, optimizing large-scale workloads, and continuously learning emerging technologies. Experience with Java/Spring Boot and exposure to AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude will be an added advantage.
What You ll Do Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing frameworks using Spark, Scala, BigQuery, and other Big Data technologies. Build robust ETL/ELT pipelines for high-volume and complex datasets. Develop efficient data models and optimize BigQuery tables using appropriate partitioning, clustering, query design, and storage strategies. Design and implement scalable batch and distributed data processing solutions using Apache Spark . Develop reusable frameworks and components to improve engineering productivity, data processing efficiency, and operational reliability. Analyze and optimize large-scale data workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud cost efficiency . Implement data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability across data pipelines and datasets. Troubleshoot complex data, pipeline, infrastructure, and production issues and drive root-cause resolution. Participate in architecture and design discussions and contribute to technical decisions involving data platforms and cloud technologies. Collaborate with Product, Analytics, Data Science, Architecture, and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality data products. Participate in code reviews, design reviews, testing, debugging, and production support activities. Follow engineering best practices around CI/CD, automation, security, reliability, and operational excellence . Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies that improve data engineering productivity and platform capabilities. Contribute to technical documentation, engineering standards, and knowledge-sharing across the team. Explore and adopt AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and similar solutions to improve developer productivity and engineering efficiency. Identify practical opportunities to leverage Generative AI for code development, code reviews, debugging, documentation, data analysis, and automation. Stay current with emerging AI and data engineering technologies and evaluate their applicability to Targets technology ecosystem. About You Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in software or data engineering , with significant experience building and supporting large-scale data platforms. Strong hands-on experience with: Apache Spark Scala Google BigQuery Big Data / Distributed Processing Data Warehousing ETL/ELT Strong SQL skills and experience working with large and complex datasets. Experience designing and optimizing data pipelines for high-volume, high-performance processing . Strong understanding of distributed computing concepts, data partitioning, joins, aggregation, scalability, and performance optimization. Experience with cloud-based data platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP) . Good understanding of data modeling, including fact/dimension models and analytical data structures. Experience with data quality, monitoring, observability, and production support. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical issues. Ability to participate in architecture discussions and translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills Java and Spring Boot experience. Experience building REST APIs or microservices . Kafka or other event-streaming technologies. Experience with cloud-native architectures and GCP services. Experience with Python and Shell scripting. Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms. Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker. Experience with data quality platforms such as Monte Carlo or equivalent. Exposure to Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools , including GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar tools. Experience developing or contributing to reusable data engineering frameworks. Experience in Retail, AdTech, Media, Analytics, or other high-volume data domains is a plus.

title: Sr. Business Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Description**
 Come be a part of a rapidly expanding $50 billion\-dollar global business on its trajectory to $100B. At Amazon Business, a fast\-growing startup passionate about building solutions, we set out every day to innovate and disrupt the status quo. We stand at the intersection of tech, retail, and generative AI in the B2B space — developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations thrive. At Amazon Business, we strive to be the most recognized and preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. Bring your insight, imagination, and a healthy disregard for the impossible. Join us in building and celebrating the value of Amazon Business to buyers and sellers of all sizes and industries. Unlock your career potential.
   

  

 The Amazon Business Flywheel Inputs (ABFI) Analytics team is looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to build the measurement, reporting, and analytics foundations that power data\-driven decisions and emerging generative AI experiences. Amazon Business (AB) represents an incredible opportunity to address a vast new market segment and customer base for Amazon. We are focused on building solutions that enable B2B customers to find and buy products and services across multiple devices and marketplaces. Our team owns the measurement and analytics strategy for key AB problems including price optimization, selection expansion, operational excellence, and AI\-powered customer experiences. Amazon Business is one of Amazon's fastest\-growing business sectors. We need builders who can think big, dive deep, and translate complex data into actionable business insights. Come work with us if you are customer\-obsessed, analytical, and excited about making history.
   

  

 As a Sr. Business Intelligence Engineer, you will partner closely with Product Managers, Software Developers, Applied Scientists, and business leaders to define success metrics, build scalable reporting solutions, and drive strategic decision making. You will develop robust data models and visualization products that enable stakeholders to monitor business performance, identify opportunities, and understand the impact of product and operational investments. The ideal candidate possesses strong business judgment, advanced SQL and analytical skills, expertise in data visualization and storytelling, experience conducting deep\-dive investigations, and a passion for transforming complex datasets into clear and actionable insights. Experience leveraging generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, insight generation, and stakeholder self\-service is highly valued.
   

  

 In this role, you will serve as an analytics thought leader, establishing measurement frameworks and KPI definitions that guide product and business decisions. You will partner with engineering and product teams to ensure high\-quality telemetry is captured for existing and future product launches, enabling robust performance measurement and experimentation. You will design scalable reporting architectures, executive\-facing dashboards, and self\-service analytics solutions that integrate across Amazon Business Pricing, Selection, Managed Spend, and AI initiatives. You will drive root\-cause analyses on ambiguous business problems, uncover strategic opportunities through deep analytical investigations, and influence the organization's approach to measurement, attribution, and data\-driven decision making. You will also help shape the analytics foundations that power both traditional business intelligence and next\-generation AI agent experiences.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable reporting solutions, dashboards, and analytics frameworks that provide visibility into key business and product performance metrics.
* Partnering with Scientists, Product Managers, Software Engineers, and business stakeholders to define KPIs, establish measurement methodologies, and develop trusted source\-of\-truth datasets for decision\-making.
* Building and maintaining robust reporting pipelines, automated data validation processes, and monitoring mechanisms to ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of business insights.
* Developing scalable data models, semantic layers, and self\-service analytics solutions that enable stakeholders to explore data independently and integrate insights across multiple business domains — including datasets that support AI\-powered analytics and agent experiences.
* Driving deep\-dive analyses, root\-cause investigations, and opportunity sizing exercises to uncover actionable insights and influence strategic business decisions.
* Designing executive\-facing visualizations, business reviews, and performance reporting mechanisms that communicate complex findings through clear data storytelling.
* Establishing best practices for metric governance, experimentation measurement, attribution, and analytics engineering to improve trust and consistency across reporting ecosystems.
* Force\-multiplying analytical excellence across the organization by mentoring stakeholders on data\-driven decision making, promoting self\-service analytics, and fostering a culture of curiosity, innovation, and insight generation.


**About The Team**
 Today, AB serves millions of business customers worldwide — from Fortune 500 enterprises and hospital systems to local governments and small businesses — and is on a trajectory to become a $100B business.
   

  

 The Amazon Business Flywheel Inputs (ABFI) Data \& Analytics team is the engine behind the data\-driven decisions that power AB's growth flywheel. We own the metrics, insights, and data platforms that drive three of AB's most critical levers: Pricing Competitiveness, Selection Expansion, and Availability Optimization — across multiple marketplaces worldwide.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of professional or military experience
* 5\+ years of SQL experience
* Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi\-TB) data sets
* Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* 7\+ years of experience designing and developing scalable data models, semantic layers, and source\-of\-truth datasets that support self\-service analytics, executive reporting, and business decision\-making.


**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation
description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team s transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. What you ll be doing: Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done. Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model. Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes. What we need to see: Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks. Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track. 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience. Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering. High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team s traditional capacity. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes. Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland. Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL. Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software. NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you.

title: Sr. QA Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior QA Engineer with 4-5 years of hands-on experience in Manual and Automation Testing. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in software quality assurance, test planning, test execution, defect management, API and database testing, and automation framework development. The candidate should have a strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and modern QA practices. Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright is expected, with Playwright preferred. The role will involve working closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality, reliable, and scalable software releases. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Test Planning Strategy: Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documentation to define test strategies, scope, effort, timelines, and test coverage. Manual Testing: Design and execute comprehensive test cases and scenarios covering functional, regression, integration, system, smoke, sanity, exploratory, and UAT testing. Test Documentation: Create and maintain detailed test plans, test cases, test scenarios, test data, test execution reports, and other QA documentation. Automation Testing: Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard automation tools and frameworks. Automation Framework Development: Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable and reusable automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber, or Appium. Regression Smoke Automation: Automate regression and smoke test suites to improve test coverage, execution efficiency, and release cycles. Defect Management: Identify, document, track, prioritize, and verify defects throughout the defect lifecycle using tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or equivalent. API Testing: Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, SOAP UI, and Swagger/OpenAPI. Database Testing: Validate database records, data integrity, data flow, and backend processes using SQL and relational databases. End-to-End Testing: Validate complete business workflows across applications, APIs, databases, and integrated systems. CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing practices. Quality Risk Management: Perform risk-based testing, identify potential quality risks, and recommend appropriate testing strategies and mitigation approaches. Performance Optimization: Analyze test execution and automation results, troubleshoot failures, and continuously improve test coverage and execution efficiency. Agile Collaboration: Participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives. Release Validation: Support release and deployment validation activities and ensure software meets defined quality standards before production release. Quality Improvement: Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, standards, tools, frameworks, and best practices. Technical Contribution: Participate in code reviews, test strategy discussions, technical discussions, and automation roadmap planning. Mentoring: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior QA engineers and contribute to building overall team capabilities.

Experience working with CI/CD and DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Git, Maven, or Gradle . Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, TestRail, HP ALM/Quality Center, or Azure DevOps . Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments . Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and troubleshooting skills. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment. 
 
 Preferred Skills 
 Hands-on experience with Playwright and modern automation frameworks. Experience developing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP . Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner . Experience testing Microservices Architecture . Strong knowledge of API automation frameworks. Understanding of Security and Accessibility Testing . Experience with healthcare domain applications, including HIPAA, HL7, EHR/EMR, Claims, Eligibility, or Revenue Cycle . Experience with FHIR-based integrations . Exposure to MCP and AI-assisted workflow testing . Familiarity with modern CI/CD and continuous testing practices. title: Network Engineer
description:
We are hiring for a Network Engineer at the Bangalore location 
 Role purpose : We are looking for a hands-on network engineer to run and support enterprise wireless, perimeter security, and routing for our customers. This is a working engineering role rather than a coordination one: you will configure the devices yourself, own incidents through to resolution, and produce the documentation that goes back to the customer. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between a FortiGate policy, a Juniper SRX zone, a Cisco routing table and a wireless controller in the same day, and will be able to explain to a customer what changed and why. 
 Key responsibilities 
 Wireless Configure, operate and troubleshoot enterprise WLAN controllers, access points, SSID-to-VLAN mapping, and AP provisioning. Implement secure wireless authentication using WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise with 802.1X and RADIUS, and support certificate and guest access methods. Carry out RF planning and validation, site surveys, channel and power planning, coverage and interference checks. Diagnose client-side problems: association and authentication failures, roaming, sticky clients, band steering and throughput complaints. 
 Firewall and security Build and maintain firewall policies, NAT rules and object groups on Fortinet FortiGate, Juniper SRX and Cisco ASA or Firepower. Configure and support IPSec site-to-site and SSL/remote-access VPN, including troubleshooting phase 1 and phase 2 negotiation. Operate security profiles application control, web filtering, IPS and antivirus and tune them to reduce false positives. Support firewall high availability pairs, firmware upgrades and rule-base reviews and clean-ups. 
 Routing and switching Configure and troubleshoot routing on Cisco IOS/IOS-XE and Juniper Junos static routing, OSPF and basic BGP. Support the switched estate: VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, link aggregation and port channels. Work with WAN and internet links, including failover, routing policy and ISP coordination. 
 Operations and delivery : Respond to incidents within agreed service levels, perform root cause analysis and close the loop with the customer. Raise and execute changes through the change process, including rollback plans and post-change validation. Monitor the estate using SNMP, syslog and NMS tooling; investigate using packet captures where needed. Produce and maintain configuration documents, as-built records, network diagrams and standard operating procedures. Take part in the on-call rota and attend customer sites in and around Bangalore when hands-on work is required. 
 Essential skills and experience 
 Experience : 3 to 4 years in enterprise networking, with genuine hands-on configuration and troubleshooting rather than monitoring only. 
 Wireless : Working experience with at least one enterprise WLAN platform Cisco (WLC / Catalyst 9800), Aruba, Ruckus or equivalent covering controller and AP configuration, 802.1X and RF troubleshooting. 
 Firewalls : Hands-on with at least two of Fortinet FortiGate, Juniper SRX and Cisco ASA / Firepower. Comfortable working at CLI, not only through the GUI. 
 Routing: Practical routing and switching on Cisco IOS/IOS-XE or Juniper Junos: static routing, OSPF, VLANs, trunking, spanning tree and link aggregation. 
 VPN : Configuration and troubleshooting of IPSec and SSL VPN. 
 Troubleshooting: Structured fault isolation, log analysis and packet capture using Wireshark or an equivalent tool. 
 Documentation : Able to write clear configuration records, change plans and diagrams that a colleague can follow. 
 Communication: Able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical customer contact, in English and ideally in Hindi or Kannada. 
 Desirable : 
 Certification in one or more of: CCNA or CCNP Enterprise / Security, Fortinet NSE 4 or above, JNCIA or JNCIS. Exposure to SD-WAN, particularly FortiGate SD-WAN or Cisco Viptela. Experience with network access control, RADIUS or Cisco ISE. Familiarity with data centre switching, and with structured cabling and rack work. Scripting for routine tasks Python, Ansible or similar. Experience working to ITIL-style incident, change and problem processes. 
 Qualifications : 
 Bachelors degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline. Candidates with a diploma and strong demonstrable hands-on experience will also be considered.

Key Skills: Fortigate Firewall,configuration,Wireless Networking,CCNA,Troubleshooting,VPN,Routing and Switching,Juniper Firewall

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
Network Security Engineer — PQC Deployments 
 Experience: 4+ years (no upper cap — band set by capability, not years) Location: Hyderabad, with onsite client deployments across India 
 About the Role This is the person who takes our product from architecture diagram to running inside a client's locked-down network. Half the job is design and integration input alongside product and engineering; the other half is being onsite in a segmented, regulated, no-internet-egress environment, getting the deployment through firewalls, change control, and a client security team that hasn't approved anything yet. You'll be the first hire doing this, so there's no existing runbook — you'll write it as you go. Deep PQC research background isn't required, but you must have genuinely touched cryptographic work (certificate discovery, key/crypto inventory, migration) and be able to hold a credible conversation about why enterprises struggle to move to post-quantum crypto. 
 What You Will Do Design, configure, and deploy our security products inside client environments — on-prem, hybrid, and restricted networks. Give product and engineering teams real-world input on architecture, integration, and deployment feasibility. Work through segmented and access-restricted networks — firewalled zones, VLANs, regulated environments — to deploy and validate. Run network security assessments and troubleshoot integration failures against live client infrastructure. Drive access requests, approvals, and change-control sign-offs directly with client IT and security teams. Produce deployment documentation and technical findings for internal teams and client stakeholders. Build and improve the deployment playbook that doesn't exist yet. 
 What We're Looking For Must have 4+ years in network security engineering — hands-on with routing/switching, firewalls, VPNs, segmentation, and enterprise network architecture. Must have hands-on TLS/SSL, PKI, and certificate/key management experience. Must have actually worked on cryptographic material — certificate discovery, crypto/key inventory, or a migration effort. Not theoretical. Must be conversant with PQC concepts and the real obstacles to enterprise adoption (depth of research not required). Must hold CEH — hard filter, at the time of application. OSCP/GPEN in addition is a plus. Must have deployed independently onsite in restricted, regulated, or high-security environments — finance, government, defense, critical infrastructure. Must be able to troubleshoot under constrained conditions: proxy-only access, no internet egress, strict firewall rules, limited privileges. Must be able to run the client conversation — pushing for access and approvals with engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike. Must be an Indian citizen (client site requirement). Must be comfortable operating without a team or process ahead of them. Preferred: CCNP Security, Security+/CASP+, CCSP; scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for field work.
