**About Us**
 SSI Aeration is a global leader in the design and manufacture of advanced water and wastewater treatment equipment. SSI specializes in energy\-efficient diffused aeration systems, fine and coarse bubble diffusers, MBBR solutions, and wastewater process technologies. Founded in 1995, SSI serves customers in more than 85 countries and supports municipalities and industrial clients with innovative, durable, and cost\-effective water treatment solutions.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated
 **Sales Manager \- North India** 
 to drive business development and sales growth across the municipal wastewater sector in North India.With an approved project pipeline valued across key regions including Delhi Jal Board (DJB), Haryana, Punjab, and other Northern states, this role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to significant infrastructure development projects. The ideal candidate should possess extensive experience in managing sales and business development activities involving Municipal Authorities, Consultants, Project Management Consultants (PMCs), and EPC Contractors. A strong understanding of wastewater treatment technologies and processes is essential, along with the ability to influence project specifications and drive business opportunities from concept to order closure.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve annual revenue and growth targets across North India.
* Identify, track, and convert opportunities within municipal wastewater infrastructure projects.
* Develop a robust pipeline and maintain visibility of upcoming projects, tenders, approvals, and funding programs.
* Drive specification\-influencing activities with consultants, municipal bodies, and project stakeholders during the design stage.
* Generate demand for the company's solutions and technologies across municipal wastewater applications.
* Strong understanding of municipal project cycles, procurement processes, tendering procedures, and specification\-driven sales.
* Monitor project developments from DPR stage through tendering, bidding, award, and execution.
* Analyze competitive activities, market trends, regulatory changes, and government policies affecting the wastewater industry.
* Drive negotiations and support contract finalization to achieve successful order closures.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Civil, Environmental, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* MBA or equivalent business qualification will be an added advantage.
* Minimum 3\-10 years of experience in sales, business development, or project sales within the wastewater treatment industry.
* Strong understanding of municipal project cycles, procurement processes, tendering procedures, and specification\-driven sales.


 Travel \& Work Arrangements/Requirements
   

  

* Extensive travel across North India is required, including regular visits to Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, and Jammu \& Kashmir.
* Expected travel commitment of approximately 50\-70% of working time to support customer engagement, site visits, consultant meetings, project reviews, and business development activities.
* Willingness to travel at short notice based on project and customer requirements.
* Participation in industry conferences, technical seminars, exhibitions, and customer events as required.


 What We Offer
   

  

* Employee Ownership Program (Stock Options).
* Yearly performance\-based bonus.
* Leave Encashments.
* Medical, Group Term Life \& Accident Insurance.
* Employee Assistance Program.
* LinkedIn Learning access.
* Awardco recognition program.
* Collaborative multicultural work environment.

**Role \-** 




 Paid acquisition \- Google, Meta, Bing, and TikTok \- is a core growth lever.. **What You Need \-** 



* 3\+ years running paid performance marketing for the US market, with real hands\-on ownership \- not just vendor management.

* Fluency in attribution: GTM, GA4, UTM discipline, and CRM/CDP integration \- GoHighLevel experience a strong plus.

* Working knowledge of financial\-services advertising restrictions (Special Ad Category, TCPA, similar).



  





**Nice to have \-** 



* Experience scaling a channel from under $10M/month to $50\-100M/month in pipeline or revenue terms.
* Worked directly with sales/loan officer teams to improve lead quality, not just lead volume.
* Exposure to call\-tracking platforms (CallRail, Invoca) or live\-transfer lead\-gen models.
* Familiarity with SEO\-led D2C lending competitors (e.g., Griffin Funding) and the category more broadly.

**Human Resources Operations \& Compliance (35%)**

* Partner with hiring managers to understand workforce needs and support manpower planning.
* Manage candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management, and onboarding activities.
* Track recruitment metrics including time\-to\-fill, hiring costs, candidate pipeline, and onboarding effectiveness.
* Build and maintain talent pools for future organizational requirements.


**HR Systems, Payroll \& Benefits Administration (15%)**
* Serve as the focal point for HRIS data management and employee records administration.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs and validate employee data for payroll processing.
* Administer employee benefits programs including insurance, wellness initiatives, leave management, and statutory benefits.
* Ensure timely updates of employee data in local and global HR systems.
* Generate HR dashboards and reports related to headcount, attrition, recruitment, leave utilization, and workforce demographics.


**Employee Relations \& Engagement (15%)**
* Act as a trusted point of contact for employee inquiries regarding policies, benefits, and HR processes.
* Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, wellness programs, recognition activities, and organizational events.

**Performance Management \& Learning (10%)**
* Support implementation of performance management processes including goal setting, reviews, and development planning.

* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and experience with HRIS or payroll systems is a plus.
* Practical knowledge of the local country generally accepted accounting principles and fiscal statutes.
* Experience with accounting systems

 Sprinklr s Customer Success Manager align highly skilled expertise , thought leadership and program management, and unlock the deepest level of partnership with customers. The CSM s advanced mastery of Sprinklr s product and solutions is paired with domain and industry expertise , business acumen, and exceptional communication and program management skills, positioning the CSM to take a consultative approach in informing and actioning on partnership strategy plans

Increasing revenue from customers. Collaborate with the Sales, Solutions Consultant other cross-functional teams to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities. Develop a deep understanding of customer business objectives , industry trends, competitors and market dynamics to identify opportunities for value realization, expansion, and strategic growth. Preferred qualifications skills: Minimum of 6 -8 years experience in Customer Success, Technical Account management, Technology Consulting, or Technology Solutions Development. Experience delivering large-scale transformational programs across Fortune 100 enterprise clients customer experience functions, working across multiple lines of business to deliver organization-wide impact, often breaking through legacy silos. Ability to analyze customer s usage data, KPIs and health indicators to identify opportunities for improvement and translate into actionable recommendations, plan and path to solutions. Demonstrated experience and/or knowledge of marketing automation technologies, or contact center technologies digital transformation, AI solutions, market research and insights, business analytics, emerging technologies, and data management platforms and technology. Strong program management experience overseeing large, cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution of deliverables. Proven ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners, as well as mapping business requirements into technical features. Interest in continuously learning and advancing understanding of tech industry, customer experience technologies, technology platforms and solutions, AI advancement, and trends with top global brands We focus on our mission : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data - helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Supervisor, Operations


**Full Location:** Bengaluru \- IN


Are you positive, motivated and ready to learn in a fast\-paced environment? This is an opportunity to work in a friendly atmosphere, be recognized for your success, and make a difference. At ResultsCX, we are focused on providing exceptional customer service to our clients and making the communities we live and work in a better place to be.


The Supervisor, Operations role provides World\-class support to the Call Center Agents and our clients’ customers, as well as consistently driving to exceed performance targets. The supervisor supports and develops RAs by providing and delivering a Best\-In\-Class level of coaching in areas of call center performance, customer service, technology, and professional development.


Specifically, the Supervisor, Operations role will work across the matrix on a regional basis to interview and close candidates for all assigned regions. The role will be hands\-on and subjected to daily quotas that entail interviewing and offer ratios.

**In this role you will:**

* Directly manage team of 10 or more agents, including the provision of significant input on hiring, appropriate discipline, discharge, and insuring accuracy of inputs regarding payroll documentation
* Identify, Prioritize and Coach agent development areas
* Directly manage team of 10 or more agents
* Document account resolutions, issues, and general notes.
* Assist agents with functionality and basic troubleshooting of product or account issues for the customers
* Maintain target levels of performance required by the client
* Maintain up\-to\-date level of product and procedural knowledge by being attentive to and acting upon information advised in email updates, team meetings, trainings and other briefings.
* Provide appropriate motivational techniques to promote team building and to increase team and Call Center morale.
* Help maintain a good team and working environment
* Multitask, listen, input data, probes, and proves solutions to the agents.
* Ensure that all Agent reference materials are up to date.
* Undertake duties of a general nature or additional tasks as business requires from time to time
* Conduct mandatory phone call monitoring and desk\-side coaching to ensure that all agents are providing the levels of customer service that is required.
* Ensure that agents have working equipment and all items needed to do their job.

**To join our team, you need:**

* Consistent attendance and punctuality.
* Experience as a Mentor.
* Ability to exceed KPI’s.
* Proficient knowledge of inbound contact center environment.
* Excellent phone skills, customer service skills, analytical and troubleshooting expertise.
* Solid verbal and written communication skills.
* The Ability to multi\-task, handle escalated calls and upset customers in a professional and courteous manner.
* A flexible schedule.
* Analytical and troubleshooting expertise.
* Ability to develop and motivate a team.
* Superb listening, probing, negotiation and deescalation skills

 **Why join ResultCX:**

* Employee Performance Incentives and Prizes
* Frequent Employee events, games, parties, and all\-around fun in the workplace
* Healthcare Benefits
* Paid Training
* Opportunity to grow with ResultsCX if that’s “Your Greater”

 **About ResultsCX:**


ResultsCX is a premier customer experience partner to Fortune 100 and 500 companies. We design, build, and deliver digitally influenced customer journeys that achieve the satisfaction and loyalty brands need to thrive and grow, while improving efficiency and reducing costs. ResultsCX’s 30\+\-year track record for reimagining the customer experience to meet consumers’ evolving expectations has driven growth to more than 20 geographic hubs and approximately 20,000 colleagues worldwide. Our core expertise extends to actionable analytics, contact center as a service (CCaaS), and our own SupportPredict AI\-powered digital experience platform. Our strength lies in exceptional individuals working together in a high\-performing, fun culture to deliver next\-generation customer experiences on behalf of our clients.

 About DHL Blue Dart Express India:
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

 Position Overview:
   

  

 The PUD Manager is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end operations of one or more Pickup \& Delivery Units (PUDs), ensuring safe, timely and cost\-effective execution of first\-mile pickup, last\-mile delivery and customer service operations. The role is accountable for operational performance, fleet readiness, workforce productivity, customer satisfaction and service quality across the assigned locations.
   

  

 Reporting to the Regional PUD Manager, the incumbent leads frontline operational teams, coordinates with cross\-functional stakeholders and transport partners, and ensures seamless integration of pickup, delivery and hub operations. The role drives operational discipline, revenue assurance, people capability and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with organisational standards and customer commitments.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 To lead and manage the operations of assigned Pickup \& Delivery Units by delivering operational excellence, customer service, workforce productivity, fleet optimisation and revenue assurance while ensuring safe, compliant and profitable first\-mile and last\-mile operations aligned with Blue Dart's service standards.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 PUD Operations Leadership
   

  

  

* Lead the overall operations of the assigned PUD(s), ensuring consistent achievement of operational, service and business objectives.
* Drive operational planning and execution across pickup, delivery and customer service activities.
* Ensure adherence to operational workflows, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and service commitments.
* Monitor daily operational performance and implement timely corrective actions to address service gaps.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, fleet and infrastructure to support business requirements.


 Pickup \& Delivery Operations
   

  

  

* Manage first\-mile pickup and last\-mile delivery operations to achieve committed service levels and customer expectations.
* Monitor daily pickup schedules, delivery performance and route execution to maximise operational efficiency.
* Ensure timely processing, dispatch and movement of shipments through seamless coordination with hubs and service centres.
* Drive reduction in missed pickups, delivery exceptions, return\-to\-origin (RTO) cases and operational delays.
* Monitor shipment visibility and ensure timely closure of operational exceptions.


 Customer Service \& Service Quality
   

  

  

* Drive customer service excellence by ensuring adherence to pickup and delivery commitments.
* Partner with Customer Service teams to ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and service issues.
* Monitor customer feedback, operational performance and Net Promoter Score (NPS) trends to improve customer experience.
* Ensure timely communication and resolution of operational issues impacting customers.
* Support implementation of initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, service reliability and operational quality.


 Fleet, Route \& Resource Management
   

  

  

* Ensure optimum deployment and utilisation of fleet resources to support daily pickup and delivery operations.
* Coordinate with Fleet Operations teams and transport partners to ensure vehicle availability and route optimisation.
* Monitor route productivity, vehicle utilisation and operational efficiency across assigned PUDs.

* Perform highly complex activities related to creation, implementation, and documentation

**Desired Qualifications:**
* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering or related quantitative field
* 4\+ years of experience in AI/ML model development
* 1\+ year of experience building Foundation Models, Gen AI and Agentic AI applications
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to apply data analysis, modeling, visualization, statistics, research, and generative AI to generate insights, adapt quickly, and support innovative solutions.

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to foster an inclusive environment and actively seek, apply, and respond to feedback in collaborative analytical settings.
* Strong business acumen with a commitment to providing excellent service and supporting data\-informed business outcomes.

**Foundation Model Training**

**Agentic AI**

**AI Infrastructure \& Optimization**

 You will be hands\-on working and contributing to the high\-impact projects involving foundation models, large language models, multi\-agent workflows, retrieval\-augmented generation, human\-in\-the\-loop AI, model evaluation, automation, and responsible AI deployment at enterprise scale.
   

  

* Design, pre\-train, fine\-tune, and evaluate transformer\-based, foundation, and small language models (SLMs).
* Develop and deploy AI and machine learning solutions across generative AI, agentic systems, and traditional machine learning applications
* Design and build LLM\-powered agents and multi\-agent systems capable of planning, reasoning, task orchestration, and human\-in\-the\-loop collaboration
* Monitor production models and AI systems, evaluating performance, stability, and model drift through testing and analytics frameworks
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, technical experts, and business leaders across the organization
* Gain exposure to enterprise\-scale AI development, governance, and risk management practices
* Apply AI, machine learning, and generative AI techniques to solve complex business problems.
* Build and optimize scalable model training and deployment pipelines.
* Leverage distributed computing and advanced training techniques to improve model performance and efficiency.
* Enhance model performance through distillation, quantization, and pruning.
* Optimize inference speed, latency, throughout, and cost for production AI systems.

description:
As Senior Contracts Manager, you will provide strategic and commercially focused legal support across Bell’s operational, sales, pre\-sales, procurement, and senior management teams. You will ensure the business operates within a robust legal framework whilst supporting the achievement of its commercial objectives and driving revenue enablement, risk mitigation, and operational efficiency through best\-in\-class contracting practices.Working collaboratively across departments, you will deliver efficient, pragmatic, and commercially focused contract support, whilst also working closely with senior executives and coaching mentoring and developing junior members of the commercial contracts team.
   

  

* Lead the provision of clear, strategic, and commercially minded advice on complex contract terms, legal matters, and business risk across multiple areas of the business.
* Take ownership of reviewing, drafting, and negotiating a broad and complex range of agreements, including high\-value supplier and customer contracts, software licences, SaaS agreements, agency, reseller, subcontractor and service provision arrangements.
* Lead negotiations with customers and suppliers on complex or high\-value matters, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring outcomes align with business objectives, company policies, and risk appetite.
* Oversees and continuously improves Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), including contract registers, obligation tracking, renewals, amendments, and system optimisation, ensuring accuracy, accessibility, and compliance across the business.
* Act as a senior point of escalation for internal teams, providing guidance and support on complex on\-boarding, contractual disputes, claims, and legal risk matters.
* Monitor, interpret, and proactively communicate relevant legal and regulatory developments, assessing their impact on the business and recommending appropriate action (including data protection and other applicable regulatory frameworks).
* Engage, instruct, and strategically manage external legal counsel within agreed budgets, including oversight of matters involving Indian and other international jurisdictions, as well as specialist areas of law.
* Own and govern the business's suite of legal templates, driving regular reviews to ensure they remain current, commercially appropriate, and legally sound.
* Lead the identification and implementation of improvements to legal team processes, ways of working, and internal tools, including legal technology and automation solutions, to enhance efficiency and service quality.
* Provide regular data\-driven reporting and insights to senior leadership on legal risk, workload, contract lifecycle metrics (e.g. cycle time, deviation rates) and matters of strategic relevance to the business.
* Support the development of less experienced team members, sharing knowledge and providing guidance to build capability within the legal function through coaching and mentorship.
* Ensure full compliance with all processes and procedures adopted by the team and the wider business and contribute to their ongoing development whilst championing a culture of consistent, compliant, and risk\-aware contracting.
* Act as the dedicated Legal Business Partner to an assigned business practice, developing a deep understanding of its strategy, commercial objectives, operating model, and risk profile.
* Act as the primary legal point of contact for strategic initiatives, deals, and projects within the assigned practice, ensuring effective alignment between legal, commercial, and operational objectives.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders within the assigned practice, proactively identifying legal needs and providing tailored, commercially focused guidance.
* Anticipate and support the evolving legal requirements of the business practice, ensuring timely and pragmatic advice aligned with its growth plans and operational priorities.
* Develop, implement, and continuously improve standard form documentation, templates, playbooks, and guidance specific to the needs of the assigned business practice, ensuring consistency, scalability, and risk alignment.
* Legal qualification, legal training, or significant contract management experience demonstrating a strong understanding of fundamental legal and commercial principles, including contract law. Knowledge of Indian contract law and experience working with contracts governed by English law or other international legal frameworks is desirable.
* Minimum of seven (7\) years' experience in a contract management or commercial contracts role, with significant experience within the technology sector or a systems integration environment. Strong knowledge of data protection, privacy, and information security principles, including experience with applicable privacy laws and regulatory frameworks such as the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act), GDPR/UK GDPR, and other relevant international data protection requirements.
* Demonstrated expertise in independently leading and concluding complex, high\-value commercial negotiations across a range of agreement types.
* Substantial experience managing cross\-border agreements and navigating the legal and regulatory complexities of international contracting.
* A track record of working at a senior level alongside Sales, Procurement, Compliance, and operational teams to deliver commercially sound legal outcomes.
* Extensive experience negotiating key commercial risk provisions, including limitation of liability, indemnities, service levels, and data\-related risks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex legal matters clearly and confidently to senior stakeholders and non\-legal audiences.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office 365, with experience of contract management systems and tools.

Corporate Governance Specialist
description:
A global bank standing up its India technology and operations centre has reached a size where the centre needs its own governance rhythm rather than borrowing the parent entity's, and Flexiple, a managed marketplace placing specialist talent inside global companies' India teams, has been asked to help hire the person who will build it.
 



**Governance for a centre finding its own footing** 




 You would support the India centre's local board and governance committees end to end: preparing agendas and board packs, drafting minutes and resolutions, maintaining statutory registers, and coordinating the filings the centre owes to the Registrar of Companies and other authorities. You would also track compliance with the Companies Act and applicable Reserve Bank of India governance requirements for the centre's legal entity, and work with the global governance team to make sure local reporting lines up with what the parent entity expects.
 



**Where the gaps currently sit** 



* Board pack preparation is done ad hoc by whoever has time, with no fixed template or timeline
* Statutory registers have not been consistently updated as the centre has grown
* There is no single person accountable for the centre's Companies Act compliance calendar



**The profile we are hiring for** 



* 3 to 7 years in corporate governance or company secretarial work, ideally at a bank, financial\-services company, or large corporate
* A Company Secretary qualification, or an LLB with hands\-on governance and secretarial experience
* Working knowledge of Companies Act requirements and ROC filing processes
* Comfort setting up process where none currently exists, and working with both local and global stakeholders



 Location: Mumbai, Chennai, Hyderabad — hybrid, based alongside the centre's leadership and legal team
 



 Expect an HR screening, a working round on a governance\-calendar exercise, and a closing round with centre leadership.
 



 Flexiple keeps this application active for this role and future governance openings that fit your background.

title: Technical Services Engineer - Document Validator_11931
description:
Job Location: Bangalore, Chennai
   

  

 Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
   

  

 Req Id: 11931
   

  

 Posting Start Date: 9/3/26
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Technical Documentation Validator is responsible for validating customer\-facing procedural documentation for Optical, Software, and Wireless products before publication. This role ensures that documented procedures are technically accurate, executable, complete, and aligned with product functionality.
   

  

 The validator performs hands\-on verification of installation, configuration, provisioning, administration, maintenance, upgrade, troubleshooting, and operational procedures to confirm customers can successfully perform documented tasks as written.
   

  

 The role serves as a critical quality gate between content development and publication, working closely with Technical Writers, Engineering, DVT, PLM, Product Management, Support, and SMEs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Procedural Validation**
* Execute and validate documented procedures in lab, test, staging, or production\-like environments.
* Verify installation, provisioning, configuration, administration, upgrade, migration, and troubleshooting workflows.
* Confirm documented outcomes match actual product behavior.
* Validate command syntax, CLI examples, API calls, screenshots, system messages, and workflow diagrams.
* Ensure prerequisites, dependencies, warnings, and validation checkpoints are correctly documented.


**Technical Accuracy Review**
* Compare documentation against requirements, release notes, engineering specifications, feature definitions, and product designs.
* Identify and document inaccuracies, omissions, ambiguities, and procedural gaps.
* Partner with Engineering and SMEs to resolve technical discrepancies.


**Documentation Quality Assurance**
* Verify compliance with documentation standards, terminology, templates, and style guides.
* Ensure documentation supports customer task completion and usability objectives.
* Confirm procedures meet customer\-facing quality expectations.
* Validate consistency across related documentation sets.


**Defect Reporting and Resolution**
* Record validation findings and documentation defects.
* Provide actionable recommendations for issue resolution.
* Track validation issues through closure.
* Verify corrections before publication approval.


**Required**
 Any degree with 5\+ years of experience in technical documentation, product testing, DVT, systems engineering, technical support, or QA.
   

  

**Preferred**
* Experience in Optical Networking, Software Platforms, or Wireless Technologies.
* Experience validating customer\-facing procedures.
* Familiarity with structured authoring environments and content management systems.
* Experience with AI\-assisted documentation tools and automated quality validation systems.


**Key Competencies**
* Strong technical troubleshooting skills
* Attention to detail
* Analytical thinking
* Process discipline
* Customer\-focused mindset
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Written and verbal communication skills


 Relocation Supported: Yes

* Serve as a point of check for completion of forms/applications, verification of the KYC documents and other document proofs provided by the customer for purposes such as transactions, account opening etc.
* Take overall responsibility for housekeeping, physical infrastructure and IT infrastructure
* Responsible for coordination of functioning and replenishment of cash in the Branch ATMs (to be decided post finalization of ATM operating model)
* Coordinate activities with Regional\-Fund Transfer Unit and Branch Monitoring teams
* Coordinate with the internal and external audit team in carrying out the periodic Branch audits; formulate and review progress against action plans to address the deviations found in Branch operations and service quality
* To ensure strict adherence to regulatory compliances in running the branch and report deviations to CRM, perform the role of operations risk and compliance representative at the branch and report to regional OR \& compliance managers


**Learning \& Performance**
* Maintain up to date \& working knowledge of products/services offered in the branch.
* Ensure adherence to training man\-days/ mandatory training programs for self and reportees
* Train the Cashier \& CCR on process compliance, service quality and Branch operations

**There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!**
**About OutSystems**
 OutSystems enables enterprise teams to build AI\-powered applications and agents that reduce manual work, streamline internal operations, and accelerate impact. A proven low\-code foundation combined with agentic AI and AI app generation capabilities empowers teams to move up to 10x faster with the assurance of security, scalability, and governance built in.
   

  

 As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities—but inside the enterprise, things are moving fast and feeling chaotic. Some early adopters are making progress in production, but for many, AI tools are sprawling without governance, data isn't ready, and talent isn't there yet. Enterprises are still drowning in application backlogs and struggling with legacy systems. But with the right platform, AI doesn't have to add to the chaos. It can become the breakthrough that brings clarity—and drives real, enterprise\-wide impact. At OutSystems, we've built that platform, providing the tools necessary for enterprises to overcome these hurdles.
   

  

 We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us in helping our customers build, deploy, and scale apps and agents—fast, helping them accelerate innovation while enabling secure, governed human\-AI collaboration.
   

  

 OutSystems is a truly global company, with more than 850,000 developer community members, 1,700 employees, more than 500 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and of course has a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees.
   

  

**About Agentic Nexus Team**
 Agentic Nexus is building the next generation of AI\-aware data management solutions, empowering businesses to unlock the full potential of their data through intelligent retrieval, semantic understanding, and agentic automation. Our innovative platform integrates enterprise context graphs, semantic search, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and observability\-first design to deliver scalability, security, and ease of use. We're transforming how organizations store, process, analyze, and intelligently act on their information. Join a passionate team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and making a real impact in the AI revolution.
   

  

****The Role****
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our growing team. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Business Analyst – Data, Analytics and AI**
**The Opportunity**
 As a Business Analyst (Data, Analytics and AI) at EY, you will play a pivotal role in shaping, governing, and delivering data‑driven and AI‑enabled solutions for Clients \& Industries (C\&I) and select EY‑wide initiatives. You will be part of the Data Strategy team, operating at the intersection of business, analytics, and AI to ensure that Analytics and Copilot‑led agentic solutions are aligned to strategic objectives and deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 This role combines hands‑on delivery with ownership of analytics and AI governance, operating models, and value realization. You will act as the Business Analyst on Data Analytics and AI initiatives, while also contributing to data strategy, metric standardization, and trusted data foundations across C\&I.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Business Analysis \& Stakeholder Leadership**
* Lead discovery and requirements definition for data, analytics, and AI initiatives across Clients \& Industries.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to shape business problems into clear analytics and AI use cases with defined success measures.
* Translate business needs into structured requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria aligned to delivery backlogs.
* Act as a trusted advisor, balancing strategic objectives with execution‑focused delivery.


**Data Strategy, Governance \& Operating Model**
* Contribute to C\&I data strategy by identifying priority data domains, decision journeys, and analytics opportunities.
* Define and govern enterprise KPIs, metrics, and reporting standards to ensure consistency and trust.
* Maintain business glossaries, metric definitions, and analytics standards aligned with data governance practices.


**Data Collection, Data Quality \& Trusted Data**
* Define data collection requirements including sources, granularity, frequency, ownership, and quality expectations.
* Identify data gaps, quality issues, and remediation needs. Establish validation rules and “trusted data” criteria for analytics and AI use cases.
* Ensure compliance with EY data security, privacy, and regulatory standards, including GDPR.


**Analytics Delivery, Insights \& Value Realization**
* Partner with analytics teams to deliver actionable insights and executive‑ready narratives.
* Validate dashboards, reports, and AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, and business alignment.
* Drive adoption through enablement, walkthroughs, and targeted stakeholder communication.
* Identify optimization opportunities to enhance analytics and AI impact.
* Provide functional guidance to junior Data Engineers and ensure clarity of requirements and priorities.
* Collaborate across global, multi‑disciplinary C\&I teams to deliver outcomes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* AI‑first mindset with strong interest in Copilot‑led solutions and intelligent automation.
* Strong Business Analysis capability in data‑ and analytics‑heavy environments.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands‑on delivery and execution rigor.
* Executive presence and confidence engaging senior stakeholders as a trusted partner.
* Strong relationship‑building and influencing skills across business and technology teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complexity.
* Strong judgment, structured thinking, and operational discipline in a fast‑paced environment.
* Ability to operate effectively across geographies, cultures, and service lines.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong working knowledge of data and analytics concepts (KPIs, data models, data quality, data lineage).
* Proficiency in SQL for data validation and analysis; familiarity with Python is advantageous.
* Experience with Power BI (preferred) or similar visualization tools (Tableau, Spotfire).
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure analytics services (e.g., Data Factory, Synapse, Data Lake) from a requirements and design perspective.
* Experience with Copilot Studio for defining and validating AI agent solutions.
* Familiarity with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) integration patterns.
* Exposure to Alteryx preferred but not mandatory.


**What We Look For**
* We are looking for Manager‑level professionals who can combine data strategy, analytics delivery, and AI enablement to drive tangible business outcomes for Clients \& Industries. You should be a structured problem solver, a strong communicator, and a collaborative leader who can operate comfortably across strategy, governance, and execution.
* If you are excited about shaping data‑driven and Copilot‑enabled experiences at scale, we encourage you to apply and be part of our journey.

description:
**About Prodigal**
------------------



Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations.



We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time.



These institutions make millions of high\-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved?



Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them.



Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America.



Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next.



We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back\-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect.



We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100\+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder \- Sangram Raje


**About the role \-**



We are looking for a passionate and driven **Data Engineer** to join our team. You will be instrumental in building scalable data pipelines, generating powerful insights, and supporting our AI/ML initiatives. If you enjoy working across data engineering and analytics and want to help shape the future of Agentic AI, we'd love to hear from you!


### **Responsibilities**


* Design, build and manage robust data pipelines for collecting, transforming and modeling data within our Databricks data lake \- dbt is your primary tool, not an afterthought
* Own the dbt layer end to end \- models, sources, tests, macros, incremental strategies and documentation. If it touches transformation, it goes through dbt and you're accountable for it being clean, tested and re\-runnable
* Turn raw, messy data into reliable, well\-modeled assets that downstream teams can actually trust \- no untested models, no undocumented logic, no shortcuts
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver actionable insights that drive product, AI and business decisions \- translating business logic into dbt models that are built to last
* Support AI and ML initiatives by ensuring clean, validated and well\-structured data is always available when the models need it
* Identify and fix performance bottlenecks in dbt models, Databricks queries and downstream reporting pipelines

### **✅ Requirements**


* 2\-3 years of hands\-on experience in data engineering \- you've built things in production, not just in notebooks
* Strong SQL \- you can write and reason about complex joins, aggregations and window functions, and you know why a query is slow before you tune it
* Python for data engineering with production\-grade PySpark or Spark SQL experience. Databricks strongly preferred
* Dimensional modeling \- star schemas, fact vs dimension grain, SCD Type 2, and incremental loads you can confidently re\-run without breaking things
* dbt as your transformation framework of choice \- models, tests, sources and incremental strategies are second nature to you
* AWS hands\-on experience across Lambda, S3, CloudFront, SQS and beyond
* AI\-native workflow \- we ship with Claude Code and Cursor and we expect you to use them well, not just know they existSharp problem solving \- you find the right balance between getting it right and getting it done, and communicate clearly when tradeoffs are being made
* Self\-driven and curious \- you thrive in fast paced environments, pick things up quickly and keep an eye on what's emerging in the data ecosystem
* Bonus \- Foundational knowledge in ML/AI fundamentals

  


**Mode of Work** \- In\-Office (Koramangala,Bengaluru)


* **️ Our Tech Stack**


* Products built using Python, Cursor, Claude, dbt, Airflow
* Databases such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Databricks,
* Deployments on EKS, EC2, Lambda and other AWS services

### **What we offer**


### **Top Tier Benefits**



Health insurance for you and your family, meals at office on us, travel reimbursement, unlimited leaves, subsidized gym membership, unlimited learning \& development, flexible work schedule and a world\-class team to learn and grow with!


From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast\-paced, intellectually\-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US.

description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Stripe was built with simplicity in mind. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible. Today, Stripe handles over a million support cases per year and processes millions of internal transactions. We’re going to achieve excellence by thinking of support in a novel, solution\-oriented way, and viewing operations as an integral enabler of all of Stripe’s growth.
   

  

 Stripe has unique operational problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with as a result of “growing the GDP of the Internet.” Stripes leverage understanding of our products, the financial industry and money movement, and our processes to support both internal and external users. Doing so requires us to invest significant resources into building this experience ourselves.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 Stripe is launching Stripe Delivery Centers \- a brand new global team to design, implement and grow Stripe’s operations for the next decade. We are looking for dynamic and curious people that have a passion for solving global user issues, building operations, drive process improvement and want to play a front\-line role in building this new operational capability for Stripe and accelerating Stripe’s growth. If you like challenging, scaled problems and are an amazing teammate, we want to hear from you!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work with merchants, from successful venture\-backed startups to well established institutions
* Investigate and action/triage escalations across multiple channels, while providing accurate and timely responses
* Own various operational processes that the team performs such as risk user experience reviews and handling urgent risk\-related escalations from internals or Financial Partners, whilst upholding a strong commitment to process excellence and clear documentation
* Identify risk factors and trends and further report these identifiers to the wider risk team to ensure consistency in partnership
* Utilize analytics to optimize strategies which can be enforced across Stripes portfolio
* Maintain regular communication with our cross\-functional stakeholders, setting up recurring business meetings as necessary
* Identify gaps in current systems, policies and strategies, and recommend enhancements and process improvements
* Uplevel the internal understanding of Stripe’s real\-world impact on users, and improve internal processes and workflows to optimize outsourcing and reduce overall escalation rates
* Build scalable solutions across Stripe to ensure Risk support best practices and standards are successfully implemented throughout the user experience
* Utilize subject\-matter expertise to partner with cross\-functional teams in developing and improving processes and products related to Risk UX
* Participate in monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews for the Risk UX Operations team


 Who you are
   

  

 We are looking for someone passionate about improving the risk user experience, the payments ecosystem, educating other Stripes in a complex area of risk, naturally curious and has a strong desire to challenge the status quo. This person will work alongside a global team of risk analysts and strategists and build cross functional partnerships with operations, engineering, sales, treasury, vendor management teams and more!
   

  

 The right candidate for this role will have a minimum of two years experience in user experience related projects and who has successfully worked on establishing and improving operational processes and user facing workflows. You will be on the front lines, handling sensitive, complex user\-facing issues. You’ll leverage learnings from these user interactions to build at\-scale, proactive, users\-first support solutions. You’ll also help shape team strategy and execute on team objectives using complex project management, cross\-functional collaboration, and data\-driven decision making.

description:
****Position Description****
**Business Division:** 
 PIHS
   

  

**Department**
 PRD
   

  

**Location:**
 Hyderabad/ Jaipur
   

  

**Position Title**
 Research Scientist \-PRD
   

  

**Level**
 Executive (E1\-E4\)
   

  

**Reporting To (Title)**
 Team Lead\- PRD
   

  

****Position Purpose****
 The role involves conducting scientific experiments, developing and optimizing chemical processes through laboratory research, and supporting process development initiatives. Responsibilities include literature surveys, identifying synthetic procedures, analyzing experimental data, preparing technical documentation and review presentations, and contributing to SOP adherence and lab upkeep. The position also supports client\-related activities and day\-to\-day technical operations to drive impactful outcomes for the organization’s research goals.
   

  

****Strategic Responsibilities****
* Actively imbibing the values and philosophy of PI Health Sciences.
* Contributing effectively to the overall success of Process Chemistry by driving research and team performance in line with the objectives and targets set by the Director and Head of Chemistry.
* Fulfilling requirements as defined by the Group Leader and Team Leader, e.g., within specific research projects.
* Safeguarding intellectual property for PIHS
* Continuously updating oneself on chemistry knowledge through literature, lectures, seminars and conferences to strengthen research outcomes.
* Supporting the Team Leader, with a special focus on target setting, and consistently seeking functional feedback.


****Operational Responsibilities****
* Work collaboratively with the team to achieve and exceed targets within the framework set by the Group Leader and Team Leader – Process Research.
* Stay updated on the latest developments in synthetic chemistry and process innovation, with a specific focus on innovative process research.
* Maintain continuous documentation and reporting of all research results within the defined area of responsibility, as per SOPs and guidelines.
* Actively seek functional support from the Team Leader when needed.
* Conduct literature searches using available tools (Reaxys, SciFinder, etc.).
* Perform synthetic experiments safely and efficiently, ensuring accurate and complete recording of all procedures and data.
* Provide regular updates to the Team Leader regarding the functional progress and any issues related to the project.
* Participate constructively and actively in all technical and functional meetings of the team.
* Analyze and interpret experimental data effectively.
* Stay well\-versed in reaction mechanisms and their applications.
* Contribute to impurity profiling through evaluation, synthesis, characterization, and control.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of process development and the ability to design safe, robust, and scalable processes based on green chemistry principles.

title: Learning Engineer – Technical Training Content
description:
Company Description
   

  

 Adler \& Pfau India Private Limited is the Indian subsidiary of Germany\-based Adler \& Pfau GmbH. The company develops educational programmes, technologies and infrastructure for international skills development and responsible global workforce mobility.
   

  

 A key focus is the development of practical technical training and professional\-development programmes for skilled professionals and technical planners. These programmes cover areas such as photovoltaic and solar technology, heat pumps, air\-conditioning and building\-services engineering, as well as other technologies supporting the energy and heating transition.
   

  

 Through the Adler \& Pfau Academy, the company develops digital, blended and practice\-oriented training programmes for international target groups. These programmes take into account applicable technical standards, regulatory requirements and the needs of the relevant labour markets. The Wings49\.com platform complements these activities with solutions for skills development, workforce readiness and international workforce mobility.
   

  

 As an India\-based company belonging to a German corporate group, Adler \& Pfau India offers employees the opportunity to develop technical education programmes for the Indian and German markets and contribute to international projects at the intersection of engineering, vocational education and technology.
   

  

 Role Description
   

  

 Learning Engineer – Technical Training Content
   

  

 As a Learning Engineer for technical training content, you will be responsible for the technical design, development and maintenance of digital and blended\-learning programmes in the fields of energy technology, electrical engineering, building services and HVAC technology.
   

  

 You will primarily develop training programmes and learning materials in the following areas:
   

  

 \- Solar and photovoltaic technology for skilled professionals
   

 \- Planning and design of solar and photovoltaic systems
   

 \- Installation, commissioning and maintenance of photovoltaic systems
   

 \- Heat\-pump technology
   

 \- Heating, ventilation, air\-conditioning and refrigeration technology
   

 \- Energy\-efficient building\-services engineering
   

 \- Electrical energy\-storage systems and EV charging infrastructure
   

 \- Other technologies supporting the energy and heating transition
   

  

 You will research, structure and transform complex technical information into clear, practical and target\-group\-oriented learning content. This will include digital learning modules, technical presentations, work instructions, practical exercises, case studies, knowledge assessments and supporting training materials.
   

  

 You will work closely with technical subject\-matter experts, education partners, trade organisations, training institutes and instructional designers in Germany and India. Together, you will ensure that all learning content is technically accurate, pedagogically effective and aligned with the requirements of the respective target groups and labour markets.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

 \- Developing curricula, course structures and learning pathways
   

 \- Defining technical and practical learning objectives
   

 \- Creating and reviewing technical training content
   

 \- Translating technical standards, safety requirements and practical regulations into accessible learning materials
   

 \- Developing interactive e\-learning modules and microlearning units
   

 \- Creating technical drawings, diagrams, calculation examples and practical exercises
   

 \- Collaborating with external subject\-matter experts and training partners
   

 \- Implementing and maintaining content within a learning management system
   

 \- Testing, reviewing and continuously improving learning programmes
   

 \- Managing documentation, version control and quality assurance
   

 \- Supporting the development of classroom\-based, online and blended\-learning formats
   

  

 This is a full\-time position based in Mumbai under a hybrid working model, with the option to perform part of the work remotely.
   

  

 Qualifications
   

  

 Academic Background
   

  

 You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in one of the following or a comparable field:
   

  

 \- Electrical Engineering
   

 \- Mechanical Engineering
   

 \- Energy Engineering
   

 \- Renewable Energy Engineering
   

 \- Building Services Engineering
   

 \- HVAC or Refrigeration Engineering
   

 \- Mechatronics
   

  

 Technical Knowledge
   

  

 You possess solid technical knowledge and, ideally, initial practical or academic experience in one or more of the following areas:
   

  

 \- Photovoltaic and solar technology
   

 \- Electrical installations and systems
   

 \- Heat pumps and thermal systems
   

 \- Heating, ventilation, air\-conditioning and refrigeration systems
   

 \- Energy efficiency and building\-services engineering
   

 \- Technical planning, installation or commissioning
   

  

 Technical Content Development
   

  

 You are able to analyse and structure complex technical subjects and present them clearly to skilled professionals, technicians and aspiring technical planners. Experience in creating technical documentation, training materials, presentations or digital learning content would be an advantage.
   

  

 E\-Learning and Learning Platforms
   

  

 Ideally, you have some experience with e\-learning authoring tools, learning management systems or SCORM\-based learning modules. However, this is not mandatory, as the necessary skills can be developed as part of the role. Strong technical understanding and the ability to quickly learn new digital tools are more important.
   

  

 Additional Skills
   

  

 \- Strong analytical and conceptual abilities
   

 \- Genuine interest in technical education and vocational training
   

 \- Ability to explain technical subjects clearly and practically
   

 \- Structured, accurate and independent working style
   

 \- Good written and spoken English
   

 \- Willingness to work with international teams
   

 \- Intercultural competence and strong teamwork skills
   

 \- Interest in renewable energy and sustainable technologies
   

  

 Recent graduates and early\-career professionals with a suitable technical degree are explicitly encouraged to apply. Previous experience in e\-learning development is advantageous but not required.
   

  

 Adler \& Pfau India is committed to equal opportunities and an inclusive working environment. Women and persons with disabilities are expressly encouraged to apply. All applications will be considered based on qualifications, skills and suitability for the position.
   

  

 Application Information:
   

 Please include the following information with your application:
   

 Your current annual salary (CTC)
   

 Your expected annual salary (CTC)
   

 Your contractual notice period
   

 Your earliest possible starting date
   

 Your current location and willingness to work a hybrid model in Mumbai

description:
**Position:** 
 Software Development Engineer (SDE)
 



**Team:** 
 Solutioning \& Integration
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 0–2 years
 



**Working Model:** 
 In\-office
 



**Role Type:** 
 Software Engineering \| Integrations \| Automation \| Solutioning
 



  





 QuickReply.ai is a cutting\-edge WhatsApp Marketing Automation platform built for e\-commerce businesses. In just 18 months, we’ve onboarded 700\+ global customers and achieved 15x revenue growth. As businesses rapidly shift from email and SMS to WhatsApp, we are building a category\-defining product in this space.
 



 Founded by IIT Delhi alumni, we raised seed funding in April 2023 and are now scaling our team.
 



 We help brands automate customer journeys across the buyer lifecycle — lead capture, abandoned cart recovery, customer support, order updates, retention, upsell, feedback, and more.
 



 Our platform works closely with systems like Shopify, CRMs, ERPs, payment gateways, logistics tools, custom backends, and WhatsApp Business APIs. As customers grow, their workflows become more complex. This is where our
 **Solutioning \& Integration team** 
 comes in.
 



  





**Role overview** 




 We are looking for a
 **Software Development Engineer (SDE)** 
 to join our
 **Solutioning \& Integration team** 
 .
 



 This is a software engineering role focused on building technical solutions that connect QuickReply with customer systems and business workflows. You will work across APIs, webhooks, integrations, automation workflows, data transformation, technical debugging, and custom engineering solutions.
 



 You will work closely with customers, CSMs, Product, and Engineering teams to understand technical requirements, design solutions, build integrations, troubleshoot issues, and take solutions from requirement to production.
 



 It is an engineering role with significant exposure to real\-world customer problems.
 



 The right person should be comfortable reading API documentation, working with JSON and webhooks, writing scripts, debugging technical issues, understanding data flows, and building pragmatic solutions quickly.
 



 You will act as the engineering layer between
 **customer requirements and working technical solutions** 
 , while also contributing learnings back to the product team.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




**Understand Customer Workflows** 




 You will work with customers and internal CSMs to understand how their business works and translate business requirements into technical flows.
 



 Examples:
 


* How do they capture leads?
* Where does customer data live?
* How do orders, checkouts, payments, shipments, or appointments get created?
* Which events should trigger WhatsApp messages?
* What data is needed to personalize a message?
* When should a bot hand over to a human?
* What should happen after a customer replies?



 Your job is to convert these business flows into clear, scalable technical flows.
   





**Design WhatsApp Automation Solutions** 




 You will help design end\-to\-end automation journeys using QuickReply.
 



 Examples:
 


* Abandoned cart recovery flow
* Order confirmation and payment collection flow
* COD confirmation and RTO reduction flow
* Lead qualification bot
* Appointment reminder flow
* Feedback/NPS collection flow
* Support triage bot
* CRM lead handover flow
* Shopify or custom cart automation flow



 You should be able to think through edge cases, fallbacks, customer replies, data requirements, and handover logic.
 



  





**Work on Integrations and APIs** 




 A major part of this role will involve building and configuring integrations between QuickReply and customer systems.
 

 You may work with:
 


* Shopify
* Custom e\-commerce websites
* CRMs like HubSpot, Salesforce, LeadSquared, Zoho, etc.
* ERPs or internal systems
* Payment gateways
* Logistics platforms
* Webhooks
* REST APIs
* Google Sheets / Airtable / internal tools
* Customer databases or custom backends



 You should be able to read API documentation, understand request/response formats, test APIs, map payloads, and coordinate with customer technical teams.
 



  





**Debug Customer Issues** 




 You will investigate and resolve technical issues across integrations and automation workflows.
 



 Examples:
 


* Webhook not received
* Wrong customer data coming in
* WhatsApp template not triggering
* Bot flow breaking at a specific step
* CRM lead not getting created
* Shopify event missing data
* API authentication failing
* Duplicate contact being created
* Incorrect order status being passed
* Customer replies not mapping correctly



 You should be comfortable using logs, payloads, Postman, browser tools, and internal dashboards to identify root causes and implement fixes.
 



  





**Build Small Scripts, Tools, and Custom Solutions** 




 Sometimes a customer may need something small but important that is not yet available directly on the platform.
 



 You may build:
 


* Data transformation scripts
* Webhook middleware
* Small internal tools
* API connectors
* Google Apps Script automations
* One\-time migration scripts
* Custom payload mappers
* Utility scripts for testing or monitoring
* Creating mini web apps for customers



 This is not about building large products from scratch. It is about solving technical problems quickly, cleanly, and reliably.
 



  





**Own Technical Go\-Lives** 





 You will be responsible for making sure customers go live smoothly from a technical perspective.
 




 This includes:
 


* Understanding requirements
* Preparing technical solution notes
* Coordinating with CSMs, Product, Engineering, and customer teams
* Testing flows before launch
* Monitoring initial go\-live
* Debugging issues quickly
* Documenting what was implemented
* Creating reusable learnings for future customers



 Success in this role means customers go live faster, with fewer technical escalations and better automation outcomes.
 



  





**Share Product and Engineering Feedback** 





 Because you will work closely with real customer workflows, you will identify repeated technical gaps and opportunities.
 




 You should actively share:
 


* Which integrations are repeatedly needed
* Which product flows are confusing
* Where customers get stuck
* Which manual work should be automated
* Which features can reduce implementation effort
* Which use cases can become reusable templates
* Which technical capabilities can make future integrations faster



 You will bring these learnings back to the Product and Engineering teams to help improve the platform.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




**Must Have** 



* 0–2 years of experience in software engineering, integration engineering, solution engineering, or a similar technical role
* Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, JSON, HTTP methods, authentication, and basic system design
* Ability to write scripts or small applications using
 **JavaScript/Node.js or Python**
* Ability to debug technical issues logically and systematically
* Ability to understand business workflows and convert them into technical flows
* Comfortable working directly with customers and customer technical teams
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills
* High ownership and willingness to solve ambiguous problems
* Fast learner with a bias for action
* Excellent communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts clearly
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership startup environment
* Exposure to AI tools / LLM\-based workflows is preferred



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with Shopify or e\-commerce platforms
* Experience with CRM tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or LeadSquared
* Experience with Postman, API testing, logs, and webhook debugging
* Basic understanding of WhatsApp Business API, messaging templates, bots, or customer engagement platforms
* Experience with Google Apps Script, Airtable, Zapier, Make, or similar automation tools
* Familiarity with databases and SQL
* Exposure to AI tools for faster coding, debugging, documentation, or solutioning



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Strong Software Engineering Mindset** 




 Someone who enjoys building, debugging, testing, and shipping technical solutions rather than simply coordinating them.
 



  





**Builder Mindset** 





 Someone who can take a problem from
 
**understanding the requirement → designing the solution → writing code → testing → debugging → deploying** 

 .
 




  





**AI\-Native Approach** 





 A developer who actively leverages AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, documentation, research, and solutioning while maintaining engineering quality and ownership.
 




  





**High Ownership** 





 Someone who takes responsibility for solving problems end\-to\-end instead of waiting for detailed instructions.
 




  





**Comfort With Ambiguity** 





 Real customer problems rarely come with perfectly defined requirements. You should be comfortable figuring things out, asking the right questions, and creating practical solutions.
 




  





**Strong Curiosity** 





 You should enjoy learning new APIs, systems, technologies, tools, and business workflows quickly.
 




  





**Customer Empathy** 





 While this is an engineering role, you will work directly with customers. You should be able to understand their problems, communicate clearly, and translate their requirements into technical solutions.
 




  





**Why This Role Is Different** 





 As a Software Development Engineer in the
 
**Solutioning \& Integration team** 

 , you will work on problems that sit at the intersection of:
 




**Software Engineering \+ APIs \+ Integrations \+ Automation \+ Customer Problems** 




 You will not be limited to writing code against predefined requirements.
 



 You will have the opportunity to:
 


* Work with real\-world technical problems
* Build integrations with different systems
* Design automation workflows
* Debug APIs and data flows
* Write custom scripts and tools
* Work directly with customer technical teams
* Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering
* Use AI to accelerate development
* See the solutions you build go directly into production



 If you enjoy building things, solving ambiguous technical problems, and working close to the real\-world use of software, this role is for you.
 



  





**Working Model** 




**5\-day work week with alternate Saturdays mandatory** 




  





**Location** 





 Our office is located in Gurgaon, and we are building an in\-office team.
 




**Office Address:** 
 Plot 23, Sector 18, Maruti Industrial Development Area, Gurugram, Haryana 122015

description:
**Description**
 Job Description for Transportation Representative – NOC
   

  

 NOC Overview
   

  

 NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick\-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
   

  

 Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
   

  

**Purview Of a Trans Ops Representative**
 A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
   

  

 Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked\-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick\-up to delivery.
   

  

 Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.
   

  

 A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real\-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Trans Ops Representative should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
* Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
* Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.


 Providing real\-time customer experience by working in 24\*7 operating environment.

* \- 4\)Proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, vlookups) 5\)Demonstrated ability to work in a team in a very dynamic environment

 Our electric vehicles stream telemetry to the cloud, where it powers a dashboard, engineering analytics, and remote operations. We are looking for a Full Stack Developer who can build across the whole stack — front\-end dashboards, back\-end services, and the cloud architecture that connects our vehicles to the cloud — with a strong, security\-first mindset for a connected\-vehicle product.
   

  

 You will own significant parts of the telemetry and dashboard platform end to end, and help ensure the device\-to\-cloud pipeline is scalable, observable, and secure. We care about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to pick the right tool for the problem — specific languages, frameworks, and cloud providers are secondary to solid architecture and delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain the fleet/telemetry dashboard(modern front\-end framework) and back\-end services / APIs, including real\-time data streaming.

* Own the device\-to\-cloud data pipeline — telemetry ingestion (e.g. MQTT or equivalent), processing, and time\-series storage.
* Apply security across the stack: secure coding (OWASP Top 10\), device authentication with certificates and mutual TLS, PKI/certificate lifecycle, authentication/authorization, and secrets management.
* Define and provision infrastructure as code and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
* Own test automation — unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests — and build quality into the delivery pipeline.
* Set up monitoring, logging, and observability for the platform.
* Collaborate with the firmware team on device connectivity, provisioning, and secure OTA.


**Outcomes You Own**
* Deliver reliable, real\-time telemetry from device to dashboard at fleet scale.
* Harden the device\-to\-cloud path (certificates, authorization, secrets) with no critical security gaps.
* Codify infrastructure and CI/CD so the platform is reproducible and observable.


**Requirements**
**Required Qualifications**
* B.E./B.Tech/M.C.A. in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3–6 years building full\-stack web applications, with strong command of at least one modern front\-end framework and one back\-end language/runtime.

* Working knowledge of application \& cloud security: OWASP Top 10, TLS/PKI, authentication/authorization, and secrets handling.
* Version control, CI/CD, and automated\-testing discipline.


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have**
* IoT experience — device\-to\-cloud messaging, managed IoT services, and device certificate/fleet provisioning.
* Handling time\-series / high\-volume telemetry data at scale, and building operational dashboards.
* Containerization and orchestration.
* Familiarity with modern end\-to\-end and unit test frameworks.
* Security depth — threat modeling, pen\-test familiarity, or a recognized security certification.
* Exposure to connected\-vehicle / automotive cybersecurity concepts (e.g. ISO/SAE 21434\).

This opportunity is ideal for senior developers who excel in high\-impact environments, navigate ambiguity with confidence, and want to shape our customer experience standards—with clear career progression pathways into senior technical or customer\-centric roles, such as Senior Software Development Engineer, Solution Developer, Solution Architect and Delivery.
