**Our Culture**
**Who We Are**
 Led by two pioneering co\-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500\.
   

  

**How We Work**
* We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
* Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in\-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
* Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
* We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.
* We believe in being ‘everyday athletes’: taking care of ourselves so we can bring our best minds to work. We promote great sleep, movement, and restorative activities for optimal mental performance. It makes for a happier and more productive team.


**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Principal Engineer to take full, hands\-on ownership of Blitzy's most critical production\-grade systems and to deliver high\-leverage features that materially improve customer outcomes and engineering velocity.
   

  

 This is the most senior individual contributor role at the company today.
   

  

 This is not a Senior\-plus role, an architecture\-only role, or a promotion\-track role. We are looking for someone who has already operated at Principal / Staff\+ scope in a highly technical environment and expects to spend their time writing, reviewing, and shipping production code.
   

  

*This role is 100% hands\-on. Leverage comes from system ownership, execution quality, and durable technical decisions — not people management or process.*
**Responsibilities**
* Own mission\-critical production systems end\-to\-end, ensuring correctness, scalability, performance, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Design, build, and ship high\-impact backend systems and features that improve product reliability, performance, and customer value.
* Architect scalable services and cloud infrastructure using technologies such as Python, REST, gRPC, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
* Identify and resolve complex technical bottlenecks that limit engineering quality, system performance, or organizational velocity.
* Build and operate LLM\-powered systems and validation loops that evaluate correctness, consistency, durability, and production performance.
* Design and evolve data architectures incorporating relational, NoSQL, graph, and vector databases to support complex enterprise applications and semantic retrieval.
* Modernize and improve complex enterprise systems while balancing reliability, maintainability, scalability, and delivery speed.
* Set and uphold engineering quality standards through hands\-on technical leadership, sound technical judgment, and ownership of long\-term technical decisions.


**Qualifications**
* Direct experience with Python as a primary programming language, backend frameworks, and microservices architectures.
* Expertise in REST and gRPC, with proficiency in Node.js and JavaScript.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer Vice President
description:
**Job Specification:**
 We are seeking a Senior Java Engineer to fill the role of ‘Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst’ on the XiNG large scale distributed calculation platform (XiP).
   

  

 In this role you will design, build, and maintain the software that manages and controls the XiP platform. This engine is responsible for 1\.5 billion risk \& suitability calculations at Citi every day. The calculation engine at the core of XiP is both highly performant and rapidly changing to support new scenarios, technologies, and infrastructure.
   

  

 As an engineer working on XiP, you will work on a platform which daily; coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute cores, utilizes hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations.
   

  

 You will work closely with software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable operations of the platform.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
**Take part of the shared responsibility for the long\-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform:**
 Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in undesirable manner, small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines.
   

  

**Collaborate and innovate within the team:**
 Work as a key member of the development team responsible for the next generation of XiP. Participate actively in the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, contribute to technical discussions, and share your knowledge with peers to solve complex challenges and drive the project forward.
   

  

**Implement changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine, including analyzing and designing improvements to the distribution mechanisms of the engine which regularly parallelizes 250,000 hours of compute into a single 90\-minute execution:**
 Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput.
   

  

**Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone:**
 Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs.
   

  

**Qualifications:**
* 11\+ years of professional software development experience with Java.
* Solid experience with Java frameworks (e.g., Spring, Spring Boot, Quarkus).
* Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience designing, building, and maintaining large\-scale, distributed systems.
* Experience with RESTful API design and implementation.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming and design patterns.
* Exposure to NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) is a plus. Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test automation frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Mockito).
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices is a plus.


**Education:**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Position Summary:** 
 We are looking for a
 **Lead AI Engineer** 
 in
 **Bangalore** 
 to help build Messaging 3\.0, our next\-generation intelligent patient communication platform. You will design and build production\-grade AI agents end to end — from LLM orchestration, tool integration, and evaluation to guardrails, observability, reliability, and production operations. You will also be the technical lead for this initiative, setting the technical direction and mentoring engineers through influence rather than formal authority.
   

  

 In your first 90 days, you will help establish the foundation for the AI\-driven Intelligent Messaging platform, including core services, supporting services, Temporal workflows, and two initial agents: the Notification AI Agent and Cadence Outreach AI Agent.
   

  

 Over your first year, you will take these agents to production and build next\-best\-action intelligence so they can act autonomously and reliably toward the intended outcome of each message. You will also ensure the new architecture continues to support the important use cases handled by our existing legacy monolith and microservices.
   

  

**About the Team:** 
 The Messaging team is building Messaging 3\.0 — moving from static notifications and campaign\-based outreach to intelligent, agent\-orchestrated patient communication.
   

  

 Our AI agents will use patient context, preferences, workflow state, and tools to:
   

  

* Determine the next best action.
* Personalize patient communication.
* Select the right communication channel.
* Manage the interaction through to completion.


 This is a mix of greenfield and brownfield development. You will build new services while also replacing or wrapping existing systems that support live patient messaging in production today.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical design and development of the Messaging 3\.0 AI platform.
* Build production\-grade AI agents using LLM orchestration, tools, context, evaluation, guardrails, and observability.
* Design and build scalable services using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, Kubernetes, and AWS.
* Design and implement Temporal workflows for long\-running and failure\-prone processes, including retries and compensation.
* Build and take the Notification AI Agent and Cadence Outreach AI Agent to production.
* Build next\-best\-action intelligence that enables agents to act autonomously and predictably toward the intended message outcome.
* Identify and solve AI agent reliability and unpredictability issues in production.
* Ensure the new architecture continues to cover use cases supported by the existing legacy monolith and microservices.
* Drive high\-quality delivery and continuously improve engineering speed, quality, and reliability.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers through influence rather than formal authority.


**Additional Job Responsibilities**
* Work across both greenfield and brownfield systems.
* Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to establish technical direction and alignment.
* Own technical outcomes end to end, from design through production.
* Adapt as requirements and the architecture evolve.
* Evaluate and adopt new AI and agent technologies as the space changes.
* Build systems that are reliable and predictable in production, not just successful in demos.
* Understand existing messaging systems well enough to avoid gaps in functionality during modernization.


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2\+ years building AI agents.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java and Spring Boot in production.
* Strong system design and software architecture experience, including architectural trade\-offs and decision\-making.
* Production experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes.
* Experience with Temporal or an equivalent durable workflow orchestration framework.
* Hands\-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or an equivalent agent framework.
* Experience taking an AI/agentic system from prototype to reliable production.
* Strong understanding of AI/agent engineering, including reliability, evaluation, guardrails, and observability.
* Production experience with AWS and practical experience making AWS architecture decisions.
* Experience with Kafka, Postgres, Redis, Helm, Datadog, or equivalent observability tools is a plus.
* Data science experience is a plus.
* GenAI experience beyond agent frameworks, such as prompt/model evaluation or fine\-tuning, is a plus.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills.
* Comfortable working in ambiguous and evolving environments and leading through influence.


**About Athenahealth**
***Our vision:***
*In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*
***Our company culture:***
*Our talented* 
*employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do\-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.*

title: ASIC Digital Design, Sr Staff Engineer
description:
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years verifying IP that has to work in real silicon, not just pass regression. You know that closing coverage is not about hitting a number, it is about understanding what you have not tested yet and why that matters. Protocol specs do not intimidate you. You read them, translate them into test plans, and build environments that catch the corner cases three months before tapeout.


You are the person design teams come to when a regression fails at 3 a.m. and no one can figure out why. You open Verdi, trace the transactions, correlate protocol behavior with RTL state, and find the root cause while others are still guessing. UVM is a tool you use well, not a checkbox you tick. You write clean agents, extend sequences without breaking existing tests, and build scoreboards that actually catch bugs.


Mentoring matters to you. When a junior engineer gets stuck on a constrained\-random failure, you do not just fix it, you show them how to think through it. You communicate clearly across teams, whether you are explaining a coverage gap to an architect or walking a design lead through a protocol violation. At Synopsys, you will work on high\-speed interconnect IP that powers the next generation of AI and compute systems, and what you verify will ship.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Own end\-to\-end verification of UCIe, PCIe, or DDR IP blocks, from test planning and environment bring\-up through coverage closure and sign\-off
* Build and extend UVM testbenches in SystemVerilog, including agents, sequencers, scoreboards, coverage models, and protocol checkers
* Write directed and constrained\-random tests that stress protocol compliance, corner cases, and multi\-layer interactions
* Debug complex RTL and testbench failures using Synopsys Verdi, including waveform analysis, protocol trace, and transaction\-level debug
* Translate protocol specifications into executable test plans, assertions (SVA), and functional coverage models that map to real silicon risk
* Collaborate with design, architecture, and silicon validation teams on bug triage, ECO impact analysis, and bring\-up readiness
* Mentor verification engineers on UVM methodology, debug techniques, and protocol understanding, and contribute to design and verification reviews

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* You will close coverage gaps and catch protocol violations that prevent costly respins and silicon failures
* Your testbenches will become the foundation for future IP releases, reused and extended across product generations
* Design teams will ship with confidence because your verification caught the issues that matter before tapeout
* Junior engineers will level up faster because you showed them how to debug like a senior engineer, not just run regressions
* Cross\-functional teams will make better decisions because you explained the verification risk clearly and early
* Silicon validation will spend less time debugging because your pre\-silicon verification was thorough and well\-documented
* The IP you verify will enable high\-speed interconnects in AI accelerators, data center chips, and next\-generation compute platforms used by customers worldwide

### **What You'll Need**

* 7\+ years of hands\-on ASIC or SoC design verification experience, with at least 3 years on protocol\-heavy IP
* Deep working knowledge of at least one high\-speed protocol: PCIe, UCIe, or DDR, with the ability to read specs and build compliant testbenches
* Strong UVM methodology experience, including building agents, writing constrained\-random sequences, implementing scoreboards, and closing functional coverage
* Solid SystemVerilog skills, including object\-oriented programming, constrained\-random stimulus generation, and SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA)
* Proven ability to debug complex failures using Synopsys Verdi or equivalent tools (FSDB, protocol analyzers, transaction\-level debug)
* Experience with industry simulators such as VCS, Xcelium, or Questa, and familiarity with regression and coverage tools like URG
* B.Tech or M.Tech in Electronics, VLSI, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline; working knowledge of a second protocol (PCIe, UCIe, DDR, CXL) is a strong plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can open a 500\-page protocol spec, find the state machine that matters, and turn it into a test plan and coverage model within a week
* When a regression fails intermittently, you do not rerun it and hope, you reproduce it, trace it in Verdi, and document the root cause for the design team
* You write UVM code that other engineers can read and extend six months later without asking you what it does
* You push back when a test plan is too shallow or a coverage model misses a critical scenario, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward
* You can explain a protocol violation to a design engineer in two sentences, then walk an architect through the same issue at the transaction level without losing the thread
* You treat verification like a product: your environments are maintainable, your tests are reusable, and your documentation helps the next person who touches your code

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

**Job Title:** 
 Head of Product Operations
 



**Reports To:** 
 Chief Product Officer
 



**Team:** 
 Product
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India
 



**Experience:** 
 8\+ years
 



  





**About Digital Green** 




  





 Digital Green is a pioneer global not for profit organization, utilizing digital platforms and community\-driven approaches to amplify the voices of smallholder farmers and improve their livelihoods. Our mission is to create a world where farmers use technology and data to build prosperous communities. By harnessing the power of technology, we facilitate knowledge sharing, capacity building, and market linkages, enabling farmers to adopt sustainable agricultural practices and increase their productivity and income.
 



 We are dedicated to transforming the lives of under\-served smallholder farmers worldwide through innovative technology solutions. Backed by leading philanthropic organizations such as the Bill \& Melinda Gates Foundation (BMGF), Walmart Foundation, USAID, and UK Foreign, Commonwealth \& Development Office (UKFCDO), we are committed to leveraging data and technology to empower smallholder farmers and strengthen agricultural extension systems.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




  





 We are looking for a senior Product Operations leader to build and run the operating system that keeps FarmerChat product work moving from early ideas through development, beta, production, and learning.
 



 This role sits at the center of a fast\-moving Product organization. You will create clarity across priorities, decisions, stakeholders, dependencies, and timelines; make sure the right people are involved at the right moments; and help Product and Engineering leaders turn decisions into coordinated execution.
 



 You will not own the product vision or make product decisions on behalf of Product leaders — you will own the process that helps those decisions happen with the right information, clear accountability, and strong follow\-through. You will work particularly closely with Product and Engineering leadership, helping establish clear handoffs and shared ways of working as initiatives move from product definition into technical delivery, while also serving as a key stakeholder partner for the Product organization more broadly.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Run Product Operations** 



* Build and maintain clear, lightweight ways of working across Product, Engineering, Tech/AI, Design, Research, Growth, and other teams.
* Run the core operating cadence, including planning, stage reviews, decision forums, and cross\-functional meetings.
* Maintain a reliable source of truth for priorities, roadmap status, key decisions, risks, dependencies, and open questions.
* Track progress proactively, surface blockers early, and ensure decisions and follow\-ups move to closure.
* Improve ways of working over time, introducing enough structure to create clarity and predictability without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.



**Bring the Right Inputs into Product Decisions** 



* Coordinate the process for bringing together signals from Product, Research, Growth and Data, Design, Country Teams, Strategy, Legal, and other relevant functions.
* Ensure the right stakeholder perspectives are brought into the process at the appropriate points.
* Prepare clear, decision\-ready materials that synthesize inputs, trade\-offs, evidence, and open questions for Product leadership.
* Make priorities, assumptions, and decision rationale visible and understandable across the organization.



**Coordinate the Product Lifecycle** 



* Help move work from early signals and prototypes through product definition, engineering, beta, and production.
* Coordinate required stakeholder input and review at the appropriate stages, ensuring decisions, risks, dependencies, and open questions are clear before work advances.
* Ensure product requirements, design, success measures, dependencies, and risks are sufficiently clear before work enters Engineering.
* Establish clear handoffs and ways of working with Engineering as initiatives move from product definition into build, testing, beta, and release.
* Work closely with the Engineering delivery counterpart to maintain a shared view of scope, readiness, dependencies, timelines, and unresolved issues.
* Track feedback and decisions so teams understand what was included, deferred, or changed and why.
* Coordinate beta and production\-readiness processes and ensure learning feeds back into future product work.



**Strengthen Stakeholder Alignment and Communication** 



* Build trusted relationships with leaders and key stakeholder groups across the organization so Product can work effectively across functions and surface issues early.
* Create a predictable rhythm of clear product updates for leadership and the broader organization.
* Translate complex Product and Engineering work into language that different teams can understand and act on.
* Ensure key decisions, changes, and trade\-offs are communicated clearly, and close the loop with stakeholders after important decisions.
* Reduce the amount of time teams spend reconstructing past decisions, chasing information, or working from different versions of the truth.



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 



* 8\+ years of experience in Product Operations, product/program management, product delivery, Chief of Staff, or a comparable operating role in a technology environment.
* Strong experience working with senior Product and Engineering leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to build practical processes and improve ways of working in fast\-changing organizations.
* Strong judgment about when structure is useful and when it becomes an unnecessary process.
* Excellent stakeholder\-management and facilitation skills, with the ability to move work forward through influence rather than formal authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and the ability to synthesize complex information clearly.
* Strong ownership, organization, and follow\-through.
* Familiarity with product roadmaps, OKRs, user research, experimentation, and modern Product/Engineering workflows.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in AI/ML, data\-intensive, or rapidly scaling digital products.
* Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, or operating environments.
* Exposure to agriculture, global development, or products designed for underserved users.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Product work moves through a clear and predictable process without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Decision ownership is clear and decisions are documented and followed through.
* Stakeholders are engaged at the right points rather than late in the process.
* Product and Engineering have clear handoffs, shared visibility into readiness, and a consistent understanding of dependencies and risks.
* The wider organization has a clear view of what Product is working on, what has changed, and why.
* Product requirements, design, and key decisions are sufficiently resolved before major Engineering work begins.
* The CPO and Product leaders spend less time coordinating, chasing follow\-ups, and reconstructing decisions — and more time on product and strategy.



  





**Why Digital Green (optional)** 



* Join a mission\-driven team using AI to directly improve the livelihoods of over 10 million smallholder farmers worldwide.
* Work on FarmerChat, a multilingual AI advisory platform live across India, Kenya, Ethiopia, Nigeria, and Brazil, answering millions of farmer questions in 15\+ local languages.
* Help shape how a fast\-growing Product organization operates, with real influence over ways of working from the ground up.
* Backed by leading global philanthropic partners, with nearly two decades of on\-the\-ground agricultural extension experience behind the technology.

 Digital Green is a great place to work and prides itself on a competitive and comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Digital Green Trust is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in Client Data Product Management. You have found the right team.


As a Data Product Manager within our dynamic team, you will be responsible for scaling the CDM (client data management) data product, strengthening operating models, and driving operational excellence through data\-driven execution.


Job Responsibilities


* **Drive** product development for the CDM data product with cross\-functional, cross\-domain partners.
* **Collaborate** with stakeholders to deliver impactful, scalable data product solutions.
* **Design** cross\-product operating models to strengthen execution, governance, and scalability.
* **Implement** operating model changes in partnership with operational teams to improve delivery rigor.
* **Optimize** processes and controls to enable consistent product execution and operational excellence.
* **Analyze** large datasets to extract actionable insights and surface business opportunities.
* **Communicate** insights clearly to align teams, accelerate decisions, and drive outcomes.
* **Engage** diverse user groups to understand needs and deliver measurable user value.
* **Manage** professional relationships with a client\-service mindset and product excellence focus.
* **Support** the full SDLC using agile/scrum practices while adapting to shifting priorities.
* **Shape** product strategy through structured problem\-solving, clarity of execution, and strong organization.


Required qualifications, capabilities and skills


* **Demonstrate** strong ownership, initiative, attention to detail, and structured execution.
* **Bring at least** 5\+ years of financial services experience, including 2\+ years in asset \& wealth management.
* **Proven** product development experience and success delivering outcomes across functions/domains.
* **Apply** experience partnering with operational teams to build and implement operating models.
* **Operate** effectively within SDLC environments, with hands\-on agile/scrum delivery experience.
* **Exhibit** high data literacy with the ability to process and analyze large datasets.
* **Leverage** data analysis/visualization tools (e.g., Alteryx, Python, Tableau) as applicable.
* **Uphold** strong data governance orientation (e.g., MDM) when working with critical client data.
* **Communicate** clearly in writing and verbally across varied stakeholder groups.
* **Build** trusted relationships and manage professional touchpoints across diverse users.


Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills


* **Hold** an advanced degree in Business, Finance, or a related field.
* **Bring** experience with cloud\-based data platforms and modern data architectures.
* **Demonstrate** experience scaling data products within large organizations.
* **Apply** UI/UX research or design exposure to shape intuitive, high\-impact product experiences.
* **Show** familiarity with workflow/digital ecosystem concepts and/or distribution/CRM platforms.
* **Developing experience using AI\-powered analytics**, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

J.P. Morgan Asset \& Wealth Management delivers industry\-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

**About the Company** 




 We are seeking an experienced BI Developer with 5\+ years of hands\-on experience to design, build, and optimize end\-to\-end data pipelines, modern analytical models, and interactive visual applications. In this role, you will leverage Snowflake as the core cloud backend alongside Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Sigma Computing, and Power Apps to transform complex raw datasets into actionable insights and enterprise\-ready business applications.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced BI Developer with 5\+ years of hands\-on experience to design, build, and optimize end\-to\-end data pipelines, modern analytical models, and interactive visual applications.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* **Data Modeling:** 
 Design, optimize, and maintain scalable data warehouses and data marts in Snowflake using modern dimensional modeling techniques.
* **Analytics \& Business Intelligence:** 
 Build, deploy, and support enterprise reports and interactive dashboards in both Power BI (complex DAX, data modeling, semantic model optimization) and Sigma Computing (direct Snowflake querying, spreadsheet\-style analytics).
* **Modern Data Stack (Fabric):** 
 Architect and maintain enterprise analytics solutions utilizing Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouses, Data Factory, Direct Lake mode).
* **Low\-Code Application Development:** 
 Build custom business applications and workflow interfaces using Power Apps integrated with backend data sources.
* **Data Transformation \& SQL:** 
 Write highly optimized, complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and transformations across Snowflake and lakehouse environments.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** 
 Translate complex business requirements into technical solutions while communicating effectively with both technical teams and non\-technical business leaders.



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Experience:** 
 5\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or enterprise BI solutions.
* **Data Backend:** 
 Advanced expertise in Snowflake (architecture, performance tuning, data modeling, role\-based access control).
* **Advanced SQL:** 
 Expert\-level capability in writing clean, scalable, and performance\-optimized SQL.
* **Reporting \& BI:** 
 Deep hands\-on experience with both Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Dataflows) and Sigma Computing for self\-service and cloud analytics.
* **Unified Analytics Platform:** 
 Solid working experience with Microsoft Fabric environment and its unified suite.
* **Low\-Code Apps:** 
 Proven track record of building user\-friendly business applications in Power Apps.
* **Communication:** 
 Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex analytical concepts clearly to executive stakeholders.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Experience automating business workflows and approvals using Power Automate.
* Hands\-on experience building and orchestrating data integration pipelines via Azure Data Factory (ADF).
* Familiarity with DevOps processes, version control (Git), and CI/CD pipelines for analytics projects.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience automating business workflows and approvals using Power Automate.
* Hands\-on experience building and orchestrating data integration pipelines via Azure Data Factory (ADF).
* Familiarity with DevOps processes, version control (Git), and CI/CD pipelines for analytics projects.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an **Embedded Software Engineer** who has hands\-on experience in embedded systems and microcontroller\-based product development. The candidate will be responsible for developing, testing, debugging, and maintaining embedded software for our devices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain **embedded firmware/software** for microcontroller\-based systems.
* Work with **ESP32** and other microcontrollers for embedded product development.
* Develop and integrate communication protocols such as **MQTT** for device\-to\-server/cloud communication.
* Work with **RTOS** and implement multitasking, task scheduling, synchronization, and resource management.
* Develop firmware for **IoT\-connected devices** and ensure reliable communication between hardware and software.
* Interface and work with various **sensors, modules, displays, and peripheral devices**.
* Debug hardware\-software integration issues and troubleshoot firmware\-related problems.
* Perform firmware testing, debugging, validation, and optimization.
* Work closely with the **hardware and electronics team** during product development and testing.
* Participate in product integration, field testing, and troubleshooting when required.
* Maintain technical documentation, firmware versions, test reports, and development records.
* Identify and resolve performance, connectivity, and reliability issues in embedded systems.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **Embedded C/C\+\+**.
* Hands\-on experience with **ESP32** or similar microcontrollers.
* Working knowledge of **RTOS** such as FreeRTOS or similar.
* Experience with **MQTT** and other communication protocols.
* Understanding of **UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, ADC, PWM**, and other common embedded interfaces.
* Knowledge of debugging tools and techniques for embedded systems.
* Understanding of basic electronics and **hardware\-software integration**.
* Experience with Git or other version\-control systems is preferred.
* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in **IoT or connected\-device development**.
* Experience working with sensors and real\-time data acquisition.
* Experience with Wi\-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity.
* Experience in developing firmware for commercial/industrial products.
* Exposure to device testing, firmware updates, and field troubleshooting.

**Title And Summary**
 Senior Platform Architect
   

  

**Overview**
 Infrastructure Design Services is a team of Technology Architects and Engineers responsible for the analysis and design of the infrastructure framework to fit the application, platform or system needs in\-line with MasterCard's operational standards and principles.
   

  

 Infrastructure Design Services is engaged from the beginning of the analysis and design phase to work with the application team(s) and other critical teams within Mastercard to ensure that the completed infrastructure and application architecture aligns with MasterCard’s security, design and availability standards.
   

  

 Infrastructure Design Services' primary deliverable is the TAD (Technical Architecture Document) which details the infrastructure design for the application, platform or system.
   

  

 This job requires experience in internet fundamentals related to web servers, application servers, internet security and other internet technologies.
   

  

 This job actively performs designing and delivering internet infrastructure solutions that satisfy member, product, service and backbone requirements.
   

  

 Have you ever worked with Microsoft Visio to design middleware infrastructure from the ground up?
   

  

 Can you interface with the user(s), application team(s), etc., and all other stakeholders in order to determine their (evolving) needs and requirements?
   

  

 Can you generate the highest level of system requirements, based on the given requirements and other constraints?
   

  

 Can you ensure that this set of high level requirements is consistent, complete, correct, and operationally defined?
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Generating requirements, together with other architects, engineers, development team(s) and user(s), to determine that all the high\-level requirements have been met.
* Resolve internet architectural and operational problems impacting infrastructure and product availability and performance globally.
* Generating products such technical architecture documents, logical flows, and models to keep the user(s), architects and the engineers constantly up to date and in agreement on the application, system or platform to be provided as it is evolving.
* Ensuring that all architectural products maintained in the most current state and never allowed to become obsolete.
* Research and evaluate new technology for possible deployment in MasterCard’s infrastructure.
* May assume lead and total accountability for ongoing regional projects as assigned; including responsibility for planning; time and cost control; resource utilization and implementation.
* Implement, manage and support internet infrastructure components while leveraging current standards and best practices.


 Perform problem diagnosis; performance tuning; capacity planning and configuration management for MasterCard internet components
   

  

* Assure system stability and future compatibility by monitoring production execution of all relevant systems.


**All About You**
* Thorough knowledge and understanding of network, operating system principles and web architecture
* Thorough knowledge in core functions related to internet infrastructure design and web administration.
* Deep understanding on Load Balancer, firewall policies and configurations.
* Well verse with Failover strategy and current design and security best practices
* Deep understanding on Disaster failover techniques and routing strategy
* Awareness on Cloud design and architecture
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written and strong relationship and collaborative skills and organizational skills with the ability to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team
* Must be high\-energy, proactive, detail\-oriented and able to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must have a high degree of initiative and self\-motivation and demonstrate the ability to drive results.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities is critical.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1739776
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Security Technology Services – Network Security Technology**


**Assistant Director – Network Security Operations \| India**


**EY Technology**



Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently and securely. We have more than 400,000 people in over 150 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to perform their jobs every day.



Everything we use as a firm depends on our security\-first mindset. Our users, applications, cloud platforms, data centers, AI services, and business\-critical systems all rely on modern security technologies to enable secure access, protect sensitive information, and reduce cyber risk.



Within Security Technology Services, our mission is to deliver world\-class security capabilities that enable Zero Trust, cloud transformation, attack surface reduction, and secure digital experiences. If you are passionate about building and operating security solutions at global scale, we want to hear from you.

  


**The Opportunity**



We are looking for an **Assistant Director – Network Security Operations** to own Zscaler operations and automation within Security Technology Services. This is a senior, hands\-on operations leadership role responsible for keeping Zscaler services stable, measurable, automated, supportable and continuously improved across production environments.



The role will provide operational leadership across Zscaler Internet Access, Zscaler Private Access, Client Connector, App Connectors, Private Service Edges, cloud connectors and related zero trust services used in complex global enterprise environments.



The successful candidate will combine deep Zscaler operational expertise, strong automation capability, disciplined service ownership and the ability to lead engineers through high\-priority incidents, recurring problem patterns and platform improvement initiatives.

  


**This role is focused on:**


* Leading reliable operations for ZIA, ZPA, Client Connector, App Connectors, Private Service Edges and related Zscaler services.
* Driving Zscaler product automation for API\-based administration, Terraform\-managed configuration, policy lifecycle activities, configuration validation, reporting and service health checks.
	+ Managing major incidents, root cause analysis, recurring problems, change governance and service restoration for Zscaler platforms.
	+ Improving service maturity through dashboards, metrics, runbooks, controls and automation\-led service improvement.
	+ The role will work closely with Network Security Technology, Cloud Engineering, Identity, Endpoint, Infrastructure, Application, SOC, Monitoring and Architecture teams to ensure Zscaler services are operated consistently, governed effectively and improved through automation.
  


**Your Key Responsibilities**



The Assistant Director – Network Security Operations will own Zscaler operational delivery, Zscaler product automation roadmap execution, platform reliability, incident response, governance and continual service improvement across ZIA, ZPA and related Zscaler capabilities.

  


**Zscaler Operations Leadership**


* Own operational delivery for ZIA, ZPA, Client Connector, App Connectors, Private Service Edges, cloud connectors and related services.
* Ensure services have clear ownership, monitoring, runbooks, escalation paths, change controls and operational readiness standards.
* Drive service availability, operational KPIs, incident trend reviews and targeted improvement actions.
* Provide hands\-on escalation support for complex production issues across policy, identity, endpoint, DNS, routing, cloud and data center layers.

  


**Zscaler Product Automation and Operational Engineering**


* Define and execute the Zscaler product automation roadmap using Zscaler APIs, OneAPI, API clients, Terraform providers and supported product automation frameworks.
* Automate ZIA and ZPA configuration activities such as locations, IPSec or GRE tunnels, URL filtering policies, cloud firewall policies, application segments, segment groups, server groups and zero trust access policies.
* Use Zscaler Terraform providers and reusable modules to standardize deployments, reduce configuration errors and support repeatable product operations across environments.
* Use Zscaler Terraformer or equivalent supported tooling to import existing ZIA and ZPA configurations into Terraform\-managed workflows where appropriate.
* Establish product automation controls for versioning, peer review, credential handling, rollback, drift detection and change validation for Zscaler\-managed configurations.

  


**Incident, Problem and Change Management**


* Lead high\-priority incident response with structured triage, clear communication, evidencebased escalation and disciplined service restoration.
	+ Drive root cause analysis across endpoint, identity, policy, service edge, connector, DNS, routing, firewall, proxy and target application layers.
	+ Own problem management for recurring issues and ensure corrective actions are tracked through closure.
	+ Ensure production changes follow risk assessment, test evidence, implementation, validation, rollback and communication standards.
	+ Platform Governance, Monitoring and Reporting
* Define and maintain service health dashboards, availability metrics, change metrics, incident trends and automation performance indicators.
* Govern configuration standards, policy ownership, exception handling, access reviews and audit evidence.
* Oversee controls for policy changes, administrative access, API credentials, service accounts, connector lifecycle and configuration drift.
* Prepare concise leadership updates covering service health, risks, incidents, dependencies, automation progress and improvement actions.

  


**Team Leadership and Operational Delivery**


* Lead, mentor and coordinate engineers responsible for Zscaler operations, automation, troubleshooting and service improvement.
* Prioritize the operational backlog across incidents, Zscaler product automation, technical debt, monitoring gaps and platform enhancements.
* Establish clear ways of working across engineering, operations, architecture, cloud, identity, endpoint and application teams.
* Promote operational excellence, automation\-first thinking, accountability, continual learning and measurable service improvement.

  


**Technical Depth and Cross\-Platform Operations**


* Maintain strong hands\-on knowledge across ZIA, ZPA, Client Connector, App Connectors, Private Service Edges, cloud connectors and related identity and endpoint integrations.
* Understand dependencies across Azure networking, VMware, data center networks, internet egress, DNS, TLS, routing, proxies, firewalls and identity federation.
* Guide engineers through advanced troubleshooting using evidence\-based analysis rather than trial\-and\-error changes.
* Translate operational findings into Zscaler product improvements, API automation requirements, Terraform backlog items, policy refinements and engineering actions.

  


**Focus Areas**


* Candidates should be prepared to discuss practical examples of Zscaler operations, Zscaler product automation and production incident leadership, including:
* Operating ZIA and ZPA at enterprise scale with service health metrics, monitoring, runbooks and escalation processes.
* Building Zscaler product automation using OneAPI, Zscaler APIs, Terraform providers, Terraform modules or API clients for ZIA and ZPA configuration, validation, reporting or health checks. Leading a major Zscaler production incident from triage through service restoration, root cause analysis and prevention of recurrence.
* Managing configuration drift, policy exceptions, administrative access risks and operational audit evidence.
* Troubleshooting across Client Connector, identity, ZPA policy, Service Edge, App Connector, DNS, routing, TLS and target application layers.
* Defining a 90\-day improvement plan for Zscaler operations and product automation in a large global enterprise.

  


**Skills and Attributes for Success**



We are interested in candidates who bring hands\-on Zscaler operations experience, Zscaler product automation capability, disciplined service ownership and the ability to lead operational delivery in complex enterprise environments.

  


**As a successful candidate, you will demonstrate:**


* Strong operational leadership across ZIA, ZPA, Client Connector, App Connectors, Private Service Edges and related Zscaler services.
* Ability to lead incident response, root cause analysis, problem management and service restoration for complex network security platforms.
* Hands\-on Zscaler product automation experience using OneAPI, Zscaler APIs, Terraform providers, Terraform modules, Zscaler Terraformer or supported API clients.
* Strong understanding of governance, change control, configuration standards, access reviews, audit evidence and service reliability practices.
* Deep troubleshooting capability across DNS, routing, TLS, proxy, firewall, identity, endpoint and cloud networking layers.
* Clear communication style for service health, operational risk, incident status and improvement plans.

  


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent experience.
* 10\-14 years of experience in network security, cloud security, security operations, infrastructure security or security engineering.
	+ 5\+ years of hands\-on Zscaler experience, with strong operational exposure across ZIA, ZPA and related platform capabilities.
	+ Experience leading incident response, root cause analysis, problem management, change control and operational governance for business\-critical security services.
	+ Hands\-on experience automating Zscaler product configuration and operations using OneAPI, Zscaler APIs, Terraform providers, Terraform modules, Zscaler Terraformer or equivalent supported product tooling.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID or equivalent identity providers using SAML, SCIM, groups, device posture and conditional access signals.
* Strong understanding of Azure networking, VMware\-based data centers, hybrid connectivity, internet egress, routing, DNS, TLS, PKI, proxies and enterprise firewall concepts.
* Experience leading engineers or technical operations teams in a global enterprise environment.

  


**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**


* Experience with Zscaler Terraform providers for ZIA and ZPA, Zscaler Terraform modules, Zscaler OneAPI, API clients and automated reporting workflows.
* Experience using Zscaler Terraformer or equivalent supported tooling to import existing ZIA and ZPA configurations into Terraform\-managed workflows.
* Experience operating and automating Zscaler services across Azure cloud, VMware\-based data centers and large\-scale hybrid enterprise networks.
* Experience using ZDX or equivalent Zscaler telemetry and digital experience data for troubleshooting and service improvement.
* Strong understanding of SASE, SSE, Zero Trust, ZTNA, secure internet access, private application access and operational security controls.
* Zscaler, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Security Engineer, CCNP Security, CISSP, CCSP or equivalent certifications.

  


**What We Look For**



We are looking for a senior, hands\-on operations leader who can keep Zscaler services reliable, lead engineers through complex incidents, drive Zscaler product automation and improve operational maturity across global enterprise environments.



The ideal candidate has successfully operated and automated ZIA, ZPA, Client Connector, App Connectors, Private Service Edges and related Zscaler services using supported Zscaler APIs, OneAPI, Terraform providers, Terraform modules and product\-native automation approaches.

  


**What We Offer**



At EY, we offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working, career development and benefits that support your personal and professional priorities.



Plus, **we offer:**


* Support, coaching and feedback from engaging colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
* Exposure to large\-scale global technology and cybersecurity transformation programs.
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.


EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service while supporting your career and personal priorities.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Role Overview** 




  





 We are seeking a Bench Digital \& Mixed\-Signal Validation Engineer to support silicon validation, characterization, and board\-level verification for semiconductor products. The role involves first silicon bring\-up, bench validation, hardware debugging, interface validation, and laboratory automation using industry\-standard test equipment. The engineer will work closely with Design, Product Engineering, Embedded Software, PCB Design, and Manufacturing teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

**Job Summary**
 Baxter’s Front Line Care business unit products expand therapies to better help patients and physicians to monitor \& manage chronic or acute respiratory and cardiac diseases (COPD, CHF, etc.). The earlier the treatment for these patients – the better the quality of life. The $1\.1B business portfolio includes products for airway clearance, cardiology \& patient monitors.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the overall technical direction and deliverables for Front Line Care products. Based on your significant technical expertise and leadership skills, you will also drive the full product development cycle from feasibility through lifecycle management. Assures that quality is built into the design during new product development. Proactively monitors the program and develops strategies to mitigate technical risks. Report on the progress on a routine cadence to senior management.
   

  

 The role of
 **Principal Engineer** 
 includes responsibility for developing creative solutions to challenging issues associated with the design, development, and sustaining engineering for our new and existing Front line care product portfolio. Possess solid “hands\-on” technical abilities, an excitement and energy for product development, and a passion for the work and the impact it has on meeting the needs of patients. In addition, you will also be responsible for application of human factors engineering principles to the design, development, and testing of medical products while working with cross\-functional program teams. This position is based out of Bangalore and reporting to the Manager, Systems Front\-Line Care.

* As a Principal Engineer Systems, responsible for end\-to\-end development \& sustenance of the product, from capturing the user/marketing needs to final product release. Interact with customers and marketing to develop and refine user requirements.
* System engineering plays a critical role in product development, making sure the product meets all the functional and performance requirements. He/ She is responsible for making sure the manufacturing and service requirements are translated into product design.
* Lead the development and documentation of the product systems architecture and systems level design, including the decomposition of the system architecture and requirements into subsystem and interface specifications.
* Hands on Experience and knowledge in requirements of IEC62366, 60601\-1, IEC62304 and associated guidance’s from FDA, EU MDR.
* Resolve competing constraints between interrelated functions (engineering, manufacturing, regulatory, marketing, etc.) required to deliver the product to market.
* Plan and execute system integration activities to minimize issues in systems verification and validation.
* Document traceability from requirements to verification activities, and from requirements to design entities.
* Resolve system\-related technical issues by applying problem solving tools such as cause\-and\-effect diagrams and Pareto charts
* Adheres to Baxter Quality Management system \& supports the quality audits.
* Plan, coordinate, perform, analyze and document study activities with focus on identifying user needs, intended user profiles, use environment and usability aspects.
* Analyze and define goals and requirements related to usability for the products.
* Plan, coordinate, perform, visualize and document concept of handling design
* Plan, perform and document evaluations of handling related product risks.
* Plan, perform, analyze and document usability evaluation activities according to scientifically accepted tools
* Identify and implement improvements to the internal processes within the competence area to secure that state of art is maintained
* Support in audits and assessments made by authorities and third parties
* Time and budget estimations for Human Factors activities where one or several resources are assigned.
* Identify and define internal and external customer needs, functions, performance, usability and safety requirement for product or solution with thorough knowledge and understanding constraints \- Business and Regulatory, Design trade\-offs and Risk assessment early in the development cycle working independently or under the guidance of senior staff.
* Excels in the development of Use Case for product or solution based on intimate knowledge of customers and their environments.
* Use tools such as DOORS and excels in the management of requirements and decomposition of system level requirements to modules.
* Carry out risk management process in accordance with the EN ISO 14971 throughout product life cycle to ensure compliance and product safety.
* Completes detailed, high\-quality technical documentation to capture and communicate designs.
* As Lead integrator for the product proactively look out for integration issues during development tests and ensure module / system development is successful.
* Actively engage with verification and validation engineers to aid in the development of verification scripts with good test coverage


**What You’ll Bring**
* Graduate or Post\-Graduate in Electrical, Mechanical, Biomedical, or related Engineering.
* An advanced technical degree is desired. Experience should include at least 8\-12 years of relevant technical experience, including some technical leadership.
* Must possess a strong knowledge of engineering disciplines like Risk Management and Usability / Human Factors Engineering and solid knowledge of related disciplines, Electro/Mechanical, Systems, Fluid Mechanics, Materials Science, blowers, pumps, and control systems
* Experience in Medical Device Development, FDA Regulations and MDR.
* Demonstrated excellent skills in Human Factors Engineering techniques.
* Demonstrated understanding and capabilities within user centered design.
* Comprehensive knowledge of applicable usability related to standards and regulations
* Ability to coach less experienced Human Factors Engineers. Expertise to Usability Engineering Process
* Ability to decompose complex problems into actionable tasks, Structured, systematic, result and quality\-oriented working.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with others in a team environment
* Understanding of and adherence to FDA, ISO and IEC design control procedures, regulations and standards.
* Demonstrated experience in accomplishing objectives.
* Able to deliver on multiple projects simultaneously
* Self\-motivated with good interpersonal skills
* A demonstrated track record in system development in Medical Devices or highly regulated products such as military hardware.
* Have a proven track record of management/leadership effectiveness in a fast\-paced environment. Proven ability to create results within budget, timeline, and product/project deliverables.
* Understanding manufacturing and design of electromechanical medical devices and systems.

* Champion and drive an AI\-first engineering mindset across all teams, ensuring AI\-assisted coding, testing, documentation, and operations practices are adopted consistently across every solution delivered
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to accelerate delivery, improve quality, or reduce operational cost, and drive adoption plans together with engineering and architecture leads
* Manage cross\-team dependencies across software engineering, data/BI/integration, and DevOps/cloud engineering roles, proactively resolving blockers
* Own stakeholder communication: executive status updates, steering committee reporting, and risk/issue escalation
* Partner with architects on technical roadmap alignment with business priorities
* Ensure delivery quality, compliance, and security requirements, including HIPAA\-aware practices, are embedded into program execution
* Mentor and guide engineering leads on program management fundamentals and on driving AI\-first delivery within their teams



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; PMP, PMI\-ACP, CSM, or SAFe certification is a plus
* 12–15 years of experience in technical program or project management, including delivery of complex, multi\-team software engineering programs
* Strong working knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture concepts, sufficient to engage credibly with engineering and architecture teams on technical trade\-offs
* Proven experience managing programs spanning distributed systems/backend engineering, data engineering/BI, and DevOps/cloud engineering disciplines
* Strong command of program/project management tools and methodologies (Agile/Scrum/Kanban, JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, or similar), including building and tracking project plans, RAID logs, and status reports
* Demonstrated ability to understand customer and business context and translate business requirements into actionable technical direction for engineering teams
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to track progress, surface risks early, and drive resolution across multiple concurrent workstreams
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including experience presenting to senior stakeholders and clients
* Experience managing and coordinating distributed onshore/offshore delivery teams
* Strong stakeholder management skills across business, engineering, and executive audiences



**AI\-First Leadership (Required)** 



* A genuine AI\-first mindset: able to identify, champion, and drive adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices (AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, AI\-assisted testing and documentation) across every team and every solution under their management
* Practical, hands\-on familiarity with AI coding/assistant tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar), sufficient to credibly set expectations and coach teams on effective, responsible usage
* Able to define and track AI\-adoption goals and metrics across engineering teams (e.g., proportion of AI\-assisted work, cycle\-time improvement, quality impact) as part of program governance
* Understanding of responsible and compliant AI usage in a health\-insurance context, including data\-privacy safeguards such as never exposing PHI or sensitive member/client data to external AI tools, and the ability to enforce these standards across teams
* Able to evaluate where AI can be applied across the full solution lifecycle, requirements analysis, design, coding, testing, documentation, and operations, and build these expectations into program plans
* Comfortable partnering with architects and engineering leads to embed AI\-first practices into technical roadmaps and solution designs



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience in the US health insurance or payer domain: claims, eligibility, enrollment, provider/member data, and HIPAA\-aware program delivery
* Experience managing programs supporting health plan clients in a consulting or professional services environment
* Familiarity with the specific technologies used by the teams under management: Go, Python, Node.js, AWS EKS/OpenShift, AWS Glue, Power BI, IBM Message Broker/ACE, and cloud DevOps toolchains (Terraform, CI/CD)
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate)
* Experience establishing AI governance frameworks or an AI center\-of\-excellence function within an engineering organization

* Experience building battlecards or teardown decks that a sales team has actually used

This role requires curiosity, attention to detail, excellent verbal and written communication skills, and eagerness to be hands\-on in a fast\-paced environment.

 As a Web Accessibility Engineer, you will need a foundational understanding of technical accessibility standards to support remediation efforts using established testing methodologies. You will perform accessibility evaluations of web applications, document findings clearly, and contribute actionable recommendations under the guidance of senior team members.
   

  

 You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product, design, and engineering throughout the project lifecycle, supporting accessibility reviews and helping ensure inclusive experiences are built into the product from the ground up. You will also contribute to the team's accessibility training materials, tooling, and standards as you grow in the role.

* Foundational knowledge and experience with web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

* Experience with testing with assistive technologies such as VoiceOver, JAWS, or NVDA

description:
**About Amgen**
 If you feel like you are part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever\-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of. Join us.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Role:** 
 Senior Associate, Center of Excellence – Technology Adoption (L4\)
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. The
 **Senior Associate, Technology Adoption** 
 supports the planning, successful deployment, adoption and measurement of Global Procurement technology adoption initiatives. This role helps stakeholders adopt digital capabilities across procurement processes by coordinating readiness activities, developing enablement resources, tracking adoption metrics, and partnering with business and technology teams to improve user experience and value realization.
   

  

 This role plays a key part in ensuring employees have the tools, knowledge, and support needed to successfully adopt new digital capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technology Adoption Support**
* Support execution of adoption plans, readiness and implementation activities for Global Procurement digital initiatives.
* Coordinate launch preparation for new capabilities, including stakeholder readiness, communications, training logistics, and support materials.
* Contribute to change management activities that help procurement users understand, adopt, and sustain new ways of working.


**Training \& Enablement**
* Develop training materials, job aids, FAQs, knowledge articles, and quick\-reference guides tailored to procurement users and process needs.
* Support end\-user training sessions, office hours, and adoption forums in partnership with business and technology stakeholders.
* Maintain learning content and adoption documentation so users have accurate, current, and easy\-to\-use resources.
* Monitor training completion, learner feedback, and effectiveness indicators to identify opportunities for improvement.


**Communications**
* Prepare clear launch, readiness, and adoption communications for procurement technology initiatives.
* Support stakeholder engagement and change communication activities to reinforce key messages and expected ways of working.
* Coordinate adoption campaigns and awareness activities that encourage consistent tool usage.
* Maintain adoption resources on SharePoint and other collaboration platforms.


**User Support**
* Collect user feedback, identify adoption barriers, and summarize recurring themes for action.
* Coordinate issue resolution and user support follow\-ups with technology, process, and business teams.
* Monitor support trends and recommend practical improvements to adoption, usability, and stakeholder experience.


**Analytics \& Reporting**
* Track adoption indicators such as usage rates, training completion, stakeholder readiness, user feedback, support trends, and adoption barriers.
* Develop reports and status updates that communicate adoption progress, risks, and opportunities.
* Analyze adoption data and stakeholder insights to recommend targeted actions that improve engagement and sustained usage.
* Support value realization reporting by connecting adoption outcomes to process improvements and user experience benefits.


**Project Coordination**
* Support project planning, implementation tracking, and workstream coordination for technology adoption initiatives.
* Coordinate meetings, action items, risks, dependencies, and deliverables across business and technology teams.
* Maintain project documentation, decision logs, stakeholder trackers, and adoption\-related materials.


**Required Skills And Capabilities**
* Supports technology adoption and change management activities that enable successful implementation, stakeholder readiness, and sustained usage.
* Develops training, learning resources, and enablement materials that improve user proficiency and adoption of digital procurement solutions.
* Collaborates effectively with business and technology stakeholders to understand needs, address challenges, and support adoption outcomes.
* Applies data analysis and reporting skills to monitor usage, readiness, training effectiveness, support trends, and value realization indicators.
* Uses project coordination skills to manage workstream activities, timelines, action items, documentation, and stakeholder follow\-ups.
* Demonstrates proficiency in Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, analytics tools, and digital ways of working.
* Applies continuous improvement principles to enhance user experience, increase adoption, and simplify procurement processes.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with procurement technology platforms or Source\-to\-Pay processes, including supplier enablement, purchasing, contracting, or analytics use cases.
* Exposure to tools such as Power BI, SharePoint, Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, learning platforms, or digital adoption platforms.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools, automation, process improvement, or enterprise digital transformation programs.
* Basic understanding of change management, stakeholder engagement, communications planning, and adoption measurement methods.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Communicates clearly with diverse audiences through written, verbal, and presentation\-based interactions.
* Builds effective working relationships with cross\-functional and global teams to support shared objectives.
* Applies analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills to identify issues, evaluate options, and recommend practical solutions.
* Adapts quickly in a dynamic environment with evolving business priorities and technologies.
* Engages stakeholders with a customer\-focused mindset and a collaborative approach.
* Demonstrates strong organization, attention to detail, and accountability while managing multiple priorities.
* Takes initiative to deliver high\-quality outcomes and improve processes, tools, and ways of working.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Technology, Engineering, Analytics, Communications, or related field.
* 5–9 years of experience in Project Management, Change Management, Technology Enablement, Business Analysis, Training, or Consulting.
* Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting digital transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of Procurement or Source\-to\-Pay processes.
* Experience working with Power BI, SharePoint, Forms, Power Automate or learning platforms.
* Exposure to AI, automation, or enterprise technology programs.


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**
 Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

 Role Title: Apprentice - Assistant Project Manager Tier: IC10 - Department/Division: Higher Education - Location: Hybrid - Employment Type: Full-time - Duration: 12 months - Target Start The Print/Digital Assistant Project Manager for the Higher Education International Division will help to ensure the assembly, execution, and maintenance of major products according to specified objectives - budget, schedule, and adherence to quality standards. You will also manage production schedules for print and digital assets. This role is ideal for a fresher or early-career professional who is eager to learn project management, risk assessment and mitigation, and digital product creation in the higher education space. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Content production of selected print, digital, and supplemental content. Production of digital courseware content that will be used in both print and digital delivery. Maintain legacy data on a vast number of series-specific titles, including print books and editorial supplements, while at the same time helping to guide the list through the transition to a nextGen digital format. Coordinating and keeping track of budgets in all the projects. Learn to drive creation of project schedules; enforce adherence; provide accountability charter for delays. Serve as liaison with Rights and Permission team; ensure quality of coverage; escalate any schedule delays or budget concerns. Identify and manage vendors to schedule, budget, and quality compliance; provide feedback on performance. Enforce system maintenance and data integrity of records; oversee invoice processing and reconciliation. Support in contributing to cover and internal design process.

 Ability to think and act independently to seek out resolutions and problem-solve on a daily basis. Ability to influence and negotiate where necessary with peers, project team, sponsors/stakeholders, and other internal teams as needed. Ability to respond confidently to conflicts and manage situations positively, proactively escalating ongoing issues and showing solid judgment. Demonstrates highly active ownership of projects, possesses ability to proactively assess and mitigate risk, and actively poses solutions to problems.  Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Recent graduates or candidates with less than one to three years of experience are encouraged to apply. Must meet requirements under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 and be registered on the NATS portal. Must be legally eligible to work in India.
