 Practical exposure to Project Management operations, scheduling and budgeting. Hands-on experience in risk assessment and mitigation, and professional communication. Experience in creating and sharing schedules using Smartsheets. Understanding of how digital learning products are built and created. Opportunity to work with Product, Content Solutions, QA, and R&P teams in a professional business environment.

description:
**Position Summary**
 The Manufacturing Engineer is responsible for transforming high\-precision fixture designs into physical assets with a focus on technical excellence and financial efficiency. This role requires a blend of advanced CNC/CAM expertise and rigorous project management to ensure parts are machined "Right First Time" within the estimated budget and hours.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* CNC / CAM \& Process Strategy
* High\-Precision Programming: Develop 3\-axis and 5\-axis CNC programs using advanced CAM software, optimizing tool paths for surface finish and accuracy.
* Manufacturing Methods: Identify the most efficient manufacturing sequence to ensure dimensions meet customer specifications (±5 to ±10 microns).
* Surface Treatment Planning: Calculate and apply precise machining allowances to account for post\-processing requirements like Hard Anodizing, ENP, or Heat Treatment.
* Material Expertise \& Development
* Metallic Machining: Implement specialized cutting strategies for Stainless Steel (work\-hardening prevention) and Aluminium (high\-speed machining with superior surface finish).
* Non\-Metallic \& Polymer Development: Lead the machining and development of TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane) and other engineering plastics. This includes managing material compression during clamping and selecting razor\-sharp tooling to prevent "burring" or melting.
* Distortion\-Free Machining: Develop specialized workholding and stress\-relieving machining sequences to prevent warping in thin\-walled components.
* Production Control \& Cost Management
* Machining Hour Control: Monitor and control actual machining hours against the pre\-defined Estimated Man\-Hours. Identify variances and implement corrective actions to prevent cost overruns.
* Efficiency Audits: Continuously review CNC cycle times and setup procedures to align shop\-floor performance with the commercial estimate.
* Assembly Engineering: Lead the physical integration of mechanical, pneumatic, and electrical subsystems, ensuring zero interference during the final build.


**Technical Requirements**
* Education \& Experience
* Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Manufacturing, Mechanical, or Production Engineering.
* Experience: 4–7 years in high\-precision CNC machining and toolroom operations.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in managing "Estimate vs. Actual" machining costs for custom tooling projects.
* Software \& Technical Proficiency
* CAM Mastery: Expert proficiency in Mastercam, NX CAM, or PowerMill.
* Project Tracking: Familiarity with ERP systems or Excel\-based tracking for monitoring machining hours and production milestones.
* Metrology: Hands\-on experience with CMM, 3D scanning, and high\-precision manual gauging.
* Specialized Knowledge
* Material Science: Understanding of the thermal and mechanical properties of Stainless Steel, Aluminium alloys, and the elastic behaviour of TPU during machining.
* Tooling Economics: Ability to select cutting tools that balance high\-speed removal with long\-term cost\-efficiency.


**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**
 Labor Efficiency: Percentage variance between Estimated vs. Actual machining hours (Target: \<5% variance).
 - Quality Rate: Success rate of First Article Inspection (FAI) with zero rework due to machining errors or material distortion.

- Material Integrity: Zero part rejections due to improper handling of specialized materials (e.g., melting of TPU or work\-hardening of SS).

- On\-Time Delivery: Adherence to the production schedule for final fixture assembly.

**Job Description \-Senior Accountant**

**Position:** Senior Accountant  
**Department:** Finance \& Accounts  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years  
**Location:** Gurgaon, Sector 66  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reports To:** Finance Manager / Accounts Head

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Accountant / Senior Accounts Executive** who can independently handle **complete accounting operations**, including day\-to\-day accounting, cash handling, bank entries, POS transactions, reconciliations, MIS reporting, and statutory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of accounting processes, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage accounting activities independently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle **complete day\-to\-day accounting operations**, including sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses, and journal entries.
* Record and verify all financial transactions accurately in the accounting system.
* Handle **cash transactions and daily cash management**, including cash receipts, payments, cash reconciliation, and maintenance of cash records.
* Handle **bank entries**, including deposits, withdrawals, receipts, payments, bank charges, and other banking transactions.
* Perform **bank reconciliation** and resolve discrepancies on a timely basis.
* Manage and reconcile **customer, vendor, and general ledger accounts**.
* Handle **POS transactions**, including recording, reconciliation, and verification of POS collections against accounting records and bank deposits.
* Prepare and maintain **daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports** as required by management.
* Monitor and reconcile **cash, bank, POS, and other collection\-related transactions**.
* Manage **Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable**, including tracking outstanding balances and follow\-ups.
* Prepare invoices, debit/credit notes, payment requests, and other accounting documentation.
* Assist in **month\-end and year\-end closing** activities.
* Handle **GST, TDS, and other statutory accounting/compliance requirements**.
* Verify supporting documents, bills, expenses, and accounting entries for accuracy.
* Maintain proper books of accounts and ensure all records are updated on time.
* Coordinate with banks, vendors, customers, auditors, and internal teams regarding accounting\-related matters.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in **Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field**.
* **5–10 years of relevant experience** in accounting and finance.
* Strong knowledge of **complete accounting processes**.
* Practical experience in **cash handling, bank entries, bank reconciliation, and POS reconciliation**.
* Good knowledge of **MIS reporting and financial data analysis**.
* Strong working knowledge of **Tally / ERP / accounting software**.
* Proficiency in **MS Excel**, including formulas, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, etc.
* Good understanding of **GST, TDS, and Income Tax**.
* Strong knowledge of ledger reconciliation, AP/AR, and general accounting.
* Excellent numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounting activities.
* Good communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in handling **end\-to\-end accounting operations**.
* Experience in **retail, hospitality, restaurant or POS\-based businesses** will be an advantage.
* Hands\-on experience in **cash, bank and POS reconciliation**.
* Experience in preparing **MIS reports for management**.
* Experience in audit coordination and statutory compliance.

**Key Competencies**

* Complete Accounting Operations
* Cash Handling \& Reconciliation
* Bank Entries \& Bank Reconciliation
* POS \& Collection Reconciliation
* MIS Reporting
* Accounts Payable \& Receivable
* GST \& TDS Compliance
* Tally / ERP \& MS Excel
* Audit \& Documentation
* Attention to Detail
* Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills
* Time Management

description:
**About the Role** 




 As Business Development \& Market Research Associate, you will be the engine behind EmpoweringCPO's sales pipeline. You will identify target companies, research procurement signals (new CPO appointments, procurement job postings, open government tenders, company restructurings), and reach out to decision\-makers via LinkedIn and email. You will work closely with the founder to qualify opportunities, prepare proposals, and support digital marketing activities.
 



  





 This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact role in a small, ambitious team. Your work will directly influence which clients EmpoweringCPO wins. You will learn the procurement outsourcing industry deeply and develop hands\-on skills in B2B sales, market intelligence, and international business development.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Lead Generation \& Prospecting** 




  




* Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify and qualify target accounts across the Gulf, UK, USA, Canada, Australia, and Singapore filtering by company size, sector, geography, and procurement hiring signals.
* Monitor procurement\-specific buying signals: new CPO appointments, open procurement job postings, company restructurings, RFP notices on government tender portals, and PE\-backed company activity.
* Build and maintain a structured, ranked prospect database with contact details, signal notes, company context, and outreach status using CRM tools or structured spreadsheets.
* Identify and track open RFPs and government tenders for procurement advisory and outsourcing services on portals including find\-tender.service.gov.uk (UK), canadabuys.canada.ca (Canada), tenders.gov.au (Australia), and ted.europa.eu (Europe).
* Research and flag newly appointed CPOs, Heads of Procurement, and CFOs at target accounts these are the highest\-priority outreach opportunities and must be actioned within days of appointment.



  





**Market Research \& Database Building** 




  




* Research target industries and geographies to build sector\-specific prospect lists including manufacturing, facilities management, healthcare, mining, financial services, energy, and retail.
* Track competitor activity which procurement outsourcing and advisory firms are winning, what their propositions are, and how EmpoweringCPO can differentiate.
* Monitor procurement industry news, CPO moves, and market trends through Procurement Magazine, Spend Matters, CPO Rising, CIPS, and ISM summarise weekly for the business head.
* Research specific prospect companies in depth before outreach revenue, ownership structure, procurement maturity, recent news, and the specific business pain EmpoweringCPO can solve.



  





**Client Outreach via LinkedIn and Email** 




  




* Draft and send personalised LinkedIn connection requests and InMail messages to CPOs, CFOs, COOs, and Heads of Procurement tailored to each individual's background, role, and company context. No generic templates.
* Execute structured email outreach sequences to qualified prospects personalised, signal\-led messages that reference a specific reason for reaching out (new CPO appointment, open procurement roles, live tender notice).
* Follow up systematically track responses, log all outcomes in the CRM, and re\-engage cold leads when new signals emerge.
* Prepare detailed briefing notes on each prospect before every discovery call involving the business head.
* Manage LinkedIn Sales Navigator alerts, connection requests, and engagement activity — warming relationships before direct outreach.



  





**What You Will Learn** 




 Within 12 months in this role, you will have:
 



  




* Deep knowledge of the global procurement outsourcing market — who the buyers are, what drives their decisions, and who the competitors are.
* Hands\-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CRM tools, outreach sequencing, and B2B digital marketing.
* A working understanding of the procure\-to\-pay process, spend analysis, and strategic sourcing — giving you a foundation to grow into a senior sales or consulting role.
* Direct exposure to international business development across the Gulf, UK, USA, and APAC — rare experience for a junior professional based in India.
* Mentorship from a procurement industry expert with global client experience.



  





**Required Skills and Experience** 




  




* 1 to 3 years of experience in business development, sales support, market research, lead generation, or a related role — preferably in a B2B services environment.
* Excellent written communication skills in English — you will write LinkedIn messages and emails to senior executives (CFOs, CPOs, COOs) in the UK, UAE, and USA. Your writing must be professional, concise, and persuasive.
* Proficiency with LinkedIn — or strong willingness to learn LinkedIn Sales Navigator quickly. This is the primary tool for this role.
* Structured, organised approach to managing large lists of prospects, tracking outreach status, and prioritising follow\-ups. Strong attention to detail is essential.
* Genuine curiosity and research instinct — you enjoy digging into companies, understanding industries, and identifying the specific signal that makes a prospect worth contacting today.
* Comfort with ambiguity and self\-direction — this is a small team. You will need to take ownership of your pipeline and proactively identify opportunities.

title: Founding Partner — Revenue & GTM
description:
MarCat \| Ahmedabad
   




 We are looking for someone to build revenue with us from zero.
 
  





 MarCat is building the technology infrastructure for India's independent retail.
 



  





 We’re starting with supermarkets and independent retailers, helping them run their stores better across sales, inventory, customers and growth.
 



  





 We are very early.
 



 There is no sales team.
 



 There is no proven GTM playbook.
 



 There is no guaranteed salary for this role.
 



 What we do have is a market we believe is underserved, a product we are building, and the opportunity to build something meaningful from the ground up.
 



 We are looking for a founding partner to own Revenue \& GTM.
   




 What you would own
 
  





 Initially, almost everything related to getting MarCat into the hands of retailers.
 



 You will:
 


* Find the right retailers to target
* Build the prospect pipeline from scratch
* Talk directly to owners and decision\-makers
* Visit stores and understand how they operate
* Run demos and sell the product
* Close the first customers
* Experiment with outbound, referrals, partnerships, field sales and other channels
* Understand why customers buy — and why they don't
* Help shape pricing, positioning and packaging
* Turn customer conversations into product and GTM decisions



 Once we find what works, your job changes.
 



 You will build the revenue engine:
 



 process → metrics → playbook → team → scale.
 



 Eventually, you would own the broader revenue organization and help take MarCat beyond Ahmedabad.
   




 This is not a sales job
 
  





 We're not looking for someone to execute a lead list.
 



 We're not looking for someone who needs an established sales process.
 



 We're not looking for someone whose definition of GTM is LinkedIn posts and marketing campaigns.
 



 At this stage, you are the GTM function.
 



 You need to be comfortable figuring things out, hearing "no", changing the approach, getting back on the phone and trying again.
 



 Some days you'll be selling.
 



 Some days you'll be in a supermarket.
 



 Some days you'll be analysing the funnel.
 



 Some days you'll be figuring out why our pitch isn't working.
 



 And some days you'll be sitting with the founder deciding what we should change.
   




 Who we want
 
  





 We care much less about your degree or title than your track record.
 



  





 You might be:
 


* A strong B2B salesperson who wants to build something
* An early\-stage startup operator who has owned revenue
* An entrepreneurial sales professional
* Someone who has built a territory or business from scratch
* A retailer/SMB\-focused sales professional who understands how owners actually buy



  





 You should be comfortable with:
 


* Cold calling
* Field sales
* Rejection
* Ambiguity
* Direct conversations with business owners
* Working without a playbook
* Taking responsibility for outcomes
* Gujarati, Hindi and English
* Being on the ground across Ahmedabad



  





 Experience in SaaS, POS, ERP, FMCG, merchant\-tech, distribution or B2B sales is useful, but not a requirement.
 



  





 We care about evidence of ownership more than years of experience.
   




 The person we're looking for
 
  





 You probably won't enjoy this if you want:
 


* A defined job description
* A fixed sales process
* A large inbound pipeline
* Predictable working days
* Someone else to tell you what to do



 You may love it if you think:
 


 "Give me a market, a product and a phone. I'll figure out how to get the first customers."
   

 What you get
 
  





 You join MarCat as a founding partner, not as an employee.
 


* Meaningful founder\-level equity
* Direct partnership with the founder
* Ownership of Revenue \& GTM
* A seat at the table on major company decisions
* The opportunity to shape product through direct customer exposure
* The opportunity to build and eventually lead the revenue organization
* No artificial ceiling on what you can build or own



 This is an equity\-first opportunity and does not come with a conventional salary package.
 



 The value of the opportunity comes from what we build together.
   




 Location
 
 Ahmedabad — On\-site
 



  




 How we'll evaluate you
 
  





 Don't worry about having the perfect resume.
 



  





 Show us evidence that you can create something from nothing.
 



 Tell us about:
 


* The hardest thing you've sold
* A time you created an opportunity without being handed a lead
* A target you were responsible for and how you achieved it
* A rejection that taught you something
* Something you built or owned without being asked



 We care about what you actually did, not just what your job description said.
 



 If this sounds more exciting than a conventional job, we'd like to talk.

description:
**About the Role** 




 Scale.jobs is a hybrid AI \+ human job application platform. Real humans, backed by automation, apply to jobs on behalf of job seekers so they can spend their time interviewing instead of filling out forms. We're a Techstars '24 company, profitable, serving job seekers across the US, Canada, UK, Germany, and Australia. Millions of applications processed so far.
 



  





 You'd be our SEO person. Not one of several \- the one. You own organic growth end to end: strategy, execution, and the number we look at every month.
 



  





 Here's why the timing is interesting. A growing share of our customers now find us through ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews instead of ten blue links. The classic playbook still matters, but the ground underneath it is moving. We want someone who's paying attention to that.
 



 You'll get direct CMS access. You're expected to ship on\-page changes yourself, not queue everything behind a developer. Code\-level work goes to engineering with a clear spec you wrote.
 



  





**What you'll actually be doing** 



1. **On\-page.** 
 Keyword research, mapping, and intent analysis across blogs, landing pages, and programmatic pages. Primary and secondary keywords assigned per URL so two pages never fight each other. Titles and metas written for clicks, not just relevance. Heading structure, internal linking, topic clusters, killing orphan pages. Schema (Article, FAQ, JobPosting, Breadcrumb, Organization) plus OG and Twitter cards.
2. **AI search (GEO/AEO).** 
 Structure content so AI engines can extract and cite it \- clean Q\&A blocks, tight definitions, claims backed by schema. Track our citation share across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews. Watch where competitors are getting surfaced and close the gap.
3. **Technical.** 
 Semrush audits triaged by revenue impact, not error count. Robots.txt, sitemaps, canonicals, crawl budget, index coverage. Core Web Vitals. Site architecture, breadcrumbs, pagination, mobile rendering, redirects, duplicate content. When you can't ship it yourself, you write the spec \- repro steps, affected URLs, expected outcome.
4. **Content.** 
 Blogs and newsletters that actually bring traffic and leads. Revamping old underperforming posts, which is often better ROI than net\-new. Editing and formatting pages in basic HTML.
5. **Off\-page.** 
 Outreach, guest posts, resource\-page placements. Converting unlinked brand mentions into links. Competitor backlink gap analysis. Reddit and niche job\-seeker communities \- real participation, not spam. Backlink health monitoring. And digital PR around launches, which is completely greenfield here, so you'd be building it from zero.
6. **Reporting.** 
 Own the dashboard across GSC, GA4, and Semrush. Monthly report that ties organic performance to signups and revenue. Recommendations, not a metrics dump.



  





**We'll vibe if you…** 



* Have 4 years of hands\-on SEO. Actual execution, not agency oversight.
* Can plan and run on\-page and off\-page strategy without someone handing you a brief
* Do keyword research, mapping, and intent analysis in your sleep
* Are comfortable editing and formatting pages in basic HTML
* Write titles and metas that earn the click
* Write genuinely good long\-form content \- blogs, newsletters \- without needing a second editor
* Know your way around Semrush audits
* Can look at Semrush \+ GSC \+ GA4, find the real problem, and either fix it or spec it clearly
* Actually get GEO/AEO \- how content gets written, structured, and surfaced in AI answers
* Optimize blogs and pages as per the competitor analysis and market trends.
* Report performance with recommendations attached, not just charts
* Are opinionated about prioritization and can defend why one fix beats twenty others
* Find the AI search shift interesting rather than annoying



  





**Bonus points:** 
 SaaS or marketplace SEO. Multi\-region work (hreflang, geo\-targeting \- we serve five markets). Programmatic SEO at scale. Basic SQL or spreadsheet modeling. Familiarity with Next.js and how rendering affects crawlability. Digital PR or founder\-led distribution.
 



**Tools:** 
 GSC, GA4, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Sheets, and whichever AI visibility tracker we land on.
 



  





**What's in it for you** 



* **Full ownership.** 
 You're not executing someone else's SEO strategy. It's yours.
* **You ship.** 
 Direct CMS access, no waiting three sprints for a title tag change.
* **Profitable company.** 
 We're not burning the runway. That means a real budget for tools and links, and no pressure to chase vanity numbers for a deck.
* **A genuinely new problem.** 
 AI search optimization has not settled the playbook yet. Whatever you figure out here is yours to take anywhere.



  





 To fast\-track your application, email
 **hr@scale.jobs** 
 with the subject line
 **"SEO Specialist Application"** 
 . Include your portfolio and your current and expected compensation.

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1739734
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**EY GDS – Commercial Architect – Associate Director**

  



As an Associate Director in the Strategic Pricing \& Insights team under Commercial Excellence, you will provide strategic financial and commercial leadership for EY’s most complex and high\-value opportunities. This role combines pursuit leadership with commercial transformation responsibilities, requiring you to architect innovative pricing strategies, influence senior stakeholders, and lead a high\-performing team to optimize winnability and profitability. You will also contribute to EY’s broader commercial transformation agenda by driving adoption of best practices, tools, and thought leadership initiatives.



You will act as a trusted liaison for onshore engagement leaders and business leaders, building trust\-based relationships to ensure seamless collaboration and alignment on pursuit priorities.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


**Strategic Pursuit Leadership**


* Own the end\-to\-end pricing and commercial strategy from qualification to closure for large, complex deals. Develop business cases, design commercial constructs, optimize deal price positioning, and ensure alignment with EY’s profitability and risk frameworks.
* Lead and govern development of client\-facing proposals and commercial narratives, ensuring strategic alignment and executive\-level positioning; actively support high\-stakes negotiations and articulate EY’s differentiated value proposition.
* Integrate solution intelligence and competitive insights to refine price positioning using price\-to\-win analysis, market benchmarks, and behavioral economics principles (e.g., prospect theory, loss aversion, anchoring and adjustment, choice architecture).
* Proactively identify, communicate, and manage competitive and commercial risks by collaborating with the Deal Leader/Manager, Lead Negotiator, Solution Architect, Legal, Risk Management, QRM, and Independence.
* Function as a trusted bridge between pursuit leaders and delivery teams—establishing trust\-based influence and ensuring consistent deal shaping, monetization approaches, and commercial terms and conditions.


**Commercial Transformation \& Governance**


* Drive activation and adoption of best practice pricing methods, tools, dashboards, and analytics platforms \- spanning MS Excel models, SaaS/web tools, and EY digital assets \- bringing together external observations, solution design, modeled pursuit economics, and historical peer performance to accelerate value based pricing; flex engagement approach to meet pursuit or project team needs.
* Establish KPIs and accountability metrics for the team, ensure compliance with internal policies, risk management requirements, and pursuit hygiene standards.
* Contribute to thought leadership through development of pricing frameworks, training programs, and knowledge capital \- e.g., immersive sites, newsletters, white papers, articles, presentations, and learning assets.


**Team Leadership \& Development**


* Lead assigned team; mentor and coach team members to enhance technical and commercial capabilities. Function as a regional or sector pod lead when needed, driving consistent pricing strategies across multiple pursuits and geographies.
* Cultivate a culture of growth and design transformative career journeys for team members by delivering structured feedback and orchestrating capability\-building programs. Support the firm’s performance management process with open, constructive developmental feedback and capability building plans.
* Mentor teams in authoring client facing materials \- value estimation and articulation, pricing proposal narratives, commercial assumptions, MS Excel based price/solution templates, and applicable sections of the Statement of Work (SOW)
* Serve as a technical subject matter resource (SMR), providing constructive peer review and risk mitigation across financial modeling, analysis, and documentation for select pursuits.
* Ensure compliance with pursuit hygiene and operational requirements, including time recording, capacity tracking, and deal intake documentation.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Proven expertise in value\-based pricing, commercial strategy, and competitive intelligence for professional services.
* Strong leadership and coaching skills—able to influence without authority, manage conflicts, and inspire high\-performing teams.
* Ability to direct advanced financial modeling and analytics, ensuring insights drive strategic decisions; Adept at synthesizing large volumes of internal and external data (primary, secondary, third‑party) into actionable intelligence for diverse stakeholders.
* Demonstrated empathy and collaborative agility across diverse social styles; influences without authority to achieve target outcomes.
* Executive presence with effective communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Innovative mindset with a track record of transformative impact on commercial outcomes.

  


**Leadership attributes**


* Demonstrate a growth mindset and the following leadership behaviors:
* “Gold Standard Champion \- execute with discipline and rigor, improving consistency and leading practices to win.”
* “Innovation Driver \- differentiate EY through innovative strategies, experiences, and deliverables at scale.”
* “Trusted Strategic Advisor \- guide stakeholders toward outcomes that deliver compelling, sustainable results.”
* “Inspirational Change Agent \- invest in developing world class talent, methods, tools, and capabilities.”

  


**Others**


* Contribute to internal initiatives (e.g., townhalls, CSR projects, mandatory learnings) and advance knowledge capital through newsletters, white papers, and articles.

  


**Qualifications for the role:**


* Graduate in finance, accounting, economics, engineering, or related fields; MBA or financial certifications (CFA, CMA, CPA) preferred.
* Minimum 12 years of relevant experience in pricing, commercial strategy, or financial planning within professional services or SaaS/cloud environments.
* Project management certifications (e.g., PMP, Agile, Scrum) preferred.
* Advanced MS Excel and commercial modeling skills.
* Familiarity with solution architecture and advanced analytics platforms is an advantage.
* Fluency in English (oral and written); flexibility to work across global time zones and occasional travel.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Brief Description**
 Head of Partner Performance Management
   

  

**Pune, India**
**Reporting to: Chief Operating Officer**
**Salary: 38,00,000 – 45,00,000 per annum \+ benefits**
 Lead a Global Partner Engineering Workforce
   

  

 ESP Global Services is a leading provider of End User Computing, Field Engineering and Infrastructure Support services to enterprise customers across the globe.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Head of Partner Performance Management to lead the operational performance of our global partner engineering network, ensuring that hundreds of third\-party engineers consistently deliver exceptional service to our customers.
   

  

**This is not a traditional procurement or vendor management role.**
 You will be responsible for ensuring that partner\-employed engineers perform as an extension of ESP's own workforce, meeting customer expectations, contractual service levels and commercial objectives across multiple international regions.
   

  

 Working closely with Operations, Customer Success, Service Delivery, Procurement and Executive Leadership, you will drive accountability, operational excellence and continuous improvement across our global partner ecosystem.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 You will lead the governance and operational performance of approximately 200 third\-party engineers delivering:
   

  

* End User Computing (EUC)
* Field Engineering
* Deskside Support
* Infrastructure Support
* Engineer Augmentation Services
* Smart Hands and Technical Onsite Services


 Your focus is ensuring the right engineers are deployed, performing effectively, meeting service commitments and representing ESP professionally within customer environments.
   

  

 Success will be measured by operational performance, customer satisfaction, partner accountability and commercial performance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own the operational performance of ESP's global partner\-delivered engineering workforce.
* Lead the governance framework across multiple engineering partners and suppliers.
* Ensure partner engineers consistently achieve agreed SLAs, KPIs and customer service standards.
* Drive engineer utilisation, workforce planning, attendance, availability and capacity management.
* Manage operational escalations relating to engineer performance, service delivery and customer experience.
* Hold partners accountable through structured governance, service reviews, corrective action plans and Quarterly Business Reviews.
* Drive continuous improvement across partner performance, engineer quality and operational consistency.
* Work closely with Service Delivery, Customer Success and Operations teams to ensure customer commitments are consistently achieved.
* Own the commercial performance of partner\-delivered services, including budgets, forecasting, billing accuracy and cost optimisation.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, tooling and process standardisation.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 This role will suit someone who has managed large operational teams of third\-party engineers delivering IT support services.
   

  

**You Will Bring** 
  

  

* 10\+ years' experience leading partner\-delivered IT service operations, supplier performance or field engineering organisations.
* Demonstrable experience managing third\-party engineers delivering End User Computing, Infrastructure Support, Field Services or Engineer Augmentation.
* Experience managing multiple global partner organisations simultaneously.
* Proven success improving partner operational performance through structured governance and performance management.
* Strong experience managing:
+ SLA and KPI performance
+ Workforce planning and engineer utilisation
+ Operational reporting and analytics
+ Service governance
+ Customer escalations
+ Supplier accountability

* Commercial experience managing budgets, forecasting, supplier costs and financial performance.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams across Operations, Service Delivery, Customer Success and Procurement.
* Strong analytical capability with the confidence to challenge poor performance using operational data.


**Essential Experience**
**We are particularly interested in candidates who have operational responsibility for partner\-employed engineers delivering services such as:**
* End User Computing (EUC)
* Field Engineering
* Desktop Support
* Infrastructure Support
* Smart Hands
* IMAC Services
* Break/Fix Services
* Data Centre Support
* Managed Services


 Candidates whose experience is primarily within procurement, sourcing, contract administration or general vendor management, without operational accountability for technical service delivery, are unlikely to be suitable for this role.
   

  

 Why Join ESP?
   

  

 This is a highly visible leadership role reporting directly to the COO.
   

  

 You will shape how ESP manages and develops a global network of engineering partners supporting enterprise customers across multiple continents. Your work will directly influence customer satisfaction, operational excellence, service quality and commercial performance.
   

  

 If you enjoy leading through influence, improving operational performance, holding partners accountable and building world\-class engineering services, we'd like to hear from you.
   

  

 Before You Apply
   

  

**To help us identify the right experience, please ensure your CV clearly demonstrates:**
* The number of third\-party engineers you have managed.
* The types of IT support services those engineers delivered.
* The countries or regions you were responsible for.
* Examples of how you improved partner performance or service delivery.
* The operational KPIs, SLAs or commercial outcomes you were accountable for.

**What would you do?**

Record to Report (RTR) is the end\-to\-end finance and accounting process that covers the collection, processing, and reporting of financial data to provide a complete and accurate picture of business performance. It includes general ledger accounting, journal entry processing, account reconciliations, intercompany accounting, fixed assets management, financial close management, and statutory and management reporting. The goal is to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards. Effective RTR operations underpin strong financial controls and support informed business decision\-making. **Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**  

At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast\-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.  

  

As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future\-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting\-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.  

  

**About The Role**  

The Information Security Officer is responsible for supporting the implementation and operation of the organisation's Information Security Management System (ISMS) within their region. This role will support security risk management, policy compliance, audits (internal, external and client), training and awareness, supply chain risk, and support security operations in incident management.
As a Managed Service Provider (MSP) and data processor for clients, the analysts will enable security controls aligning with client contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. The analyst will work closely with global security leadership, regional stakeholders and clients to address both internal and client\-specific security challenges. **What You’ll Do** **The position is within the Assurance function of GRC team.** **Main activities will include but are not limited to:** **Internal Audit \& Assurance:*** Support the implementation and operations of the ISMS within the region.
* Support alignment with global security policies and regulatory requirements including ISO27001, SOC2 type II and PCI\-DSS.
* Support continuous assessment and improvement of security controls and processes.
 **Information Security Risk Management*** Support, identify, assess, and mitigate security risks.
* Maintain the risk register and track remediation activities.
* Provide risk\-based guidance to business units, IT teams, and client\-facing operations.
 **Information Security Policy \& Standards*** Support compliance with corporate security policies, frameworks, and client\-specific security mandates.
* Support develop and enforce security standards and client requirements.
* Input into periodic reviews and updates to security policies to align with evolving requirements.
 **Information Security Audit \& Compliance*** Support internal and external security audits, ensuring timely remediation of findings.
* Provide security assurance to clients by responding to security questionnaires and participating in client audits.
* Coordinate with service delivery teams to meet client\-specific obligations.
* Monitor and report on security posture, client security commitments, and compliance status.

  

**Information Security Training \& Awareness**  

* Support the delivery of security awareness programs
* Support phishing exercises and other training initiatives to enhance security culture.
* Collaborate with HR and other departments to ensure security education is embedded in employee onboarding and ongoing training.
 **Supply Chain Risk Management*** Support the assessment and management of security risks associated with third\-party vendors and suppliers.
* Support security requirements are included in vendor contracts and SLAs.
* Enable regular security assessments of critical suppliers, considering the impact on client services.
 **Security Operations \& Incident Management Support*** Assist in managing and responding to security incidents within the region, to ensure rapid containment and remediation.
* Work with the Security Operations team to protect both internal and client environments.
* Support post\-incident reviews and contribute to continuous improvement in incident handling, including lessons learned for client operations.
  

In addition to the above position\-specific responsibilities, all employees are required to undertake any other reasonable duties and responsibilities within your capability and skills, when requested to do so. **Unleash your potential**  

To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3\+ years of experience in an information security role, preferably with regional oversight in an MSP or data processing environment.
* Good understanding of ISO27001, NIST, GDPR, and other security and data protection frameworks.
* Experience in security risk management, audits, compliance, and client security assurance.
* Knowledge of security operations, incident response, and managed security services.
* Familiarity with supply chain security and third\-party risk management.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working with clients on security matters.
* Ideally security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CRISC are preferred
 **Working at Bravura**  

Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.  

  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme
* Medical /Insurance benefits
* Parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Transport/Meal Facilities
  

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.  

  

Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.  

  

All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
   

  

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Lead Architect \- Azure \& Agentic AI Solutions**
*Architecture leadership for Azure deployment, agent design, orchestration and end\-to\-end solution flow*
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Lead Architect to define the target architecture for an enterprise\-grade procurement agentic AI solution. The role will determine the appropriate Azure deployment stack, establish architecture principles and guardrails, and advise on agent architecture, orchestration patterns, integration design, and end\-to\-end solution flows. The Lead Architect will work closely with client technology stakeholders, the Solution Lead, AI/ML teams, data engineers, security teams and delivery leadership to ensure the solution is scalable, secure, operable and fit for enterprise deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end target architecture across data, AI/ML, GenAI, agent orchestration, APIs, integration, observability, security and user\-facing application layers.
* Assess client constraints and determine the appropriate Azure deployment stack, including services for compute, storage, data processing, model serving, GenAI, integration, secrets, networking, monitoring and CI/CD.
* Define cloud deployment patterns across Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks or equivalent data platforms, AKS, Container Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus or Event Grid, Key Vault, Monitor and related services as appropriate.
* Advise on when to use agents, conventional services, rules engines, workflow orchestration, ML models, optimization services and event\-driven automation rather than forcing all use cases into an agent pattern.
* Translate business workflows into executable solution flows spanning sensing, signal processing, forecasting, recommendation, approval, action and traceability layers.
* Define API and integration architecture for interaction with enterprise source systems, planning tools, data platforms, UI applications, model endpoints and external services.
* Establish non\-functional requirements and architecture guardrails for scalability, latency, resilience, disaster recovery, cost efficiency, explainability, auditability and supportability.
* Define identity and access patterns, network segmentation, secrets management, data protection controls, content safety, prompt security and responsible AI controls in collaboration with client security teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, technical decision records and trade\-off discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Provide hands\-on guidance to engineering teams on implementation patterns, reusable components, deployment standards and technical issue resolution.
* Own architecture alignment across environments including development, test, UAT, and production, with clear promotion, rollback and release patterns.
* Guide observability design across application traces, agent traces, prompt and tool execution, model performance, API metrics, data pipeline health, cost usage and business process outcomes.
* Support capacity planning and cloud cost optimization, including workload sizing, token consumption controls, autoscaling, caching, batching and appropriate service selection.
* Collaborate with the Lead Manager and Solution Lead to balance delivery timelines with architecture quality and enterprise readiness.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise solution architecture, cloud architecture, platform engineering or related technology leadership roles.
* Strong hands\-on architecture experience with Microsoft Azure and enterprise deployment patterns.
* Proven experience designing distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, containerized workloads and cloud\-native integrations.
* Strong understanding of GenAI and agentic AI architecture, including LLM orchestration, tool calling, RAG, state and memory patterns, evaluation, guardrails and human approval mechanisms.
* Ability to design architectures that combine conventional software services, AI/ML models, optimization engines, data pipelines and agentic workflows.
* Strong knowledge of security, identity, networking, observability, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code and production operations in enterprise environments.
* Experience engaging with client architects, CIO/CTO organizations, cloud platform teams, security stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Strong ability to communicate architecture trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders and drive decisions under real\-world constraints.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, AKS, Container Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Key Vault, Entra ID and Azure Monitor.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent patterns and frameworks.
* Exposure to supply chain, demand forecasting, planning, semiconductor or high\-tech industry solutions.
* Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, prompt and agent evaluation and production AI governance.
* Relevant Azure architecture certifications or equivalent demonstrable experience.


**Key Deliverables**
* Target\-state solution architecture and Azure service deployment blueprint.
* Agent architecture and orchestration design, including tool boundaries and control flows.
* End\-to\-end sequence flows for key business scenarios and exception paths.
* Integration, API, identity, networking, security, observability and environment architecture.
* Architecture decision records, non\-functional requirements, deployment standards and engineering guardrails.
* Production\-readiness and scalability recommendations, including cost and operational considerations.


**Key Success Metrics**
* Architecture is accepted by client technology and security stakeholders with minimal late\-stage redesign.
* Solution is deployable, scalable, secure, observable and supportable across enterprise environments.
* Agent and orchestration patterns remain controlled, explainable and appropriate to the business workflow.
* Reduction in integration rework, deployment friction, technical debt and avoidable cloud cost.
* Engineering teams can implement consistently using clear architecture standards and reusable patterns.

**Title And Summary**

**About Mastercard**
 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Cloud Infrastructure Engineers at Mastercard design, build, and operate the foundational platforms that enable our product and service teams to deliver securely, reliably, and at scale. This role focuses on Azure\-based infrastructure, cloud\-native services, and automation that power transaction processing, analytics, developer productivity, and self\-service delivery across the enterprise.
   

  

 As a Lead Cloud Infra Engineer, you will operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical ownership and influence that extends beyond a single team. You will drive the design and evolution of complex platform capabilities, set technical direction for key areas of cloud infrastructure, and partner closely with engineering, security, and operations leaders to ensure platforms are scalable, resilient, and aligned with business goals. While still hands\-on, your impact is measured by the systems, standards, and teams you enable.
   

  

 As a Lead Cloud Infra Engineer, you are expected to perform the following general responsibilities:
   

  

* Provide technical leadership for complex cloud infrastructure and platform initiatives spanning multiple teams or services
* Own the architecture, design, and implementation of critical Azure infrastructure components and platform capabilities
* Define and evolve standards, patterns, and guardrails for secure, scalable, and operable cloud solutions
* Lead cross\-team technical discussions, driving alignment on design decisions and tradeoffs
* Enable and improve self\-service provisioning and developer platforms that reduce friction and increase team autonomy
* Anticipate and mitigate systemic risks related to reliability, security, scalability, and cost
* Guide and mentor Senior and Software Engineer II team members through design reviews, feedback, and technical coaching
* Partner closely with product, security, operations, and architecture stakeholders to translate business needs into platform solutions


**All About You**
* Overall 8\-12 years of career experience in a similar field
* Extensive hands\-on experience designing, building, and operating Azure\-based cloud infrastructure at scale, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and platform services
* Deep expertise with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and automation, using tools such as ARM, Bicep, Terraform, or equivalent, with a strong emphasis on modularity, reuse, and policy enforcement
* Strong command of cloud security and networking concepts, including identity and access management, private networking, secure service boundaries, and defense\-in\-depth architectures
* Proven experience designing resilient, highly available, and fault\-tolerant platforms, with a strong understanding of failure modes and disaster recovery strategies
* Demonstrated ability to lead large or complex initiatives end\-to\-end, including authoring and reviewing technical designs, decomposing work, sequencing delivery, and managing safe production rollouts
* Treats operability and cost efficiency as core design principles, ensuring observability, auditing, and financial transparency are built into platform solutions
* Advanced troubleshooting skills, capable of diagnosing and resolving broad, cross\-system production issues with minimal guidance
* Strong experience with enterprise CI/CD and SDLC practices, including quality gates, change management, and automation at scale
* Clear, influential communicator able to document architectures, establish technical direction, and drive consensus across distributed teams
* Consistent track record of mentoring and elevating other engineers, raising technical quality and ownership across the team
* Pragmatic and collaborative leader who balances technical excellence with delivery needs and organizational realities
* Actively evaluates industry trends in cloud, DevOps, and platform engineering and applies them thoughtfully to Mastercard’s ecosystem


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
 



  





 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
 



  





 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 At Rippling, the Accounting Integrations team sits at the critical intersection of product innovation and financial infrastructure. Our mission is to empower finance teams to move from traditional month\-end closes to real\-time accounting by seamlessly connecting Rippling’s platform with the world’s most widely\-used ERP systems—including NetSuite, QuickBooks, and soon Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle, and more.
 



  





 We build robust, bi\-directional integrations that serve both Rippling’s internal products (like Payroll, Spend Management, Procurement, and Travel) and external ERPs used by our customers. These integrations power complex accounting workflows such as journal syncing, reconciliation, audit readiness, and more, enabling our customers to automate the most repetitive and error\-prone financial operations.
 



  





 As Rippling expands globally and moves upmarket to serve large enterprises, the Accounting Integrations team is at the forefront of unlocking key use cases and supporting new geographies, integrations, and accounting standards. This team also operates in a high\-velocity, continuous delivery environment, tackling a wide surface area of capabilities, systems, and support scenarios.
 



  





 If you’re excited by systems design, love working across product boundaries, and want to build foundational infrastructure that finance teams depend on, the Accounting Integrations team is the place to be.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Grow Payroll products by expanding accounting coverage across all spend use cases. Empower finance teams to move from traditional month\-end closes to real\-time accounting.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable, two\-way integrations between Rippling and ERP systems , powering features like journal syncing, bank reconciliations, audit data, and real\-time transaction flows.
* Ship medium\-to\-large features end\-to\-end with minimal oversight, owning requirements gathering, architectural design, coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, UX, internal platform teams (Payroll, Spend, Procurement, Travel), and external partners to translate high\-level business needs into robust technical solutions.
* Drive technical excellence by defining and enforcing best practices in code quality, testing (unit/integration), observability, and performance for a high\-throughput, continuous\-delivery environment.
* Tackle production support and incident response: dive into complex debugging, triage integration failures, resolve customer issues, and implement fixes that strengthen reliability and reduce future support load.
* Continuously improve integration frameworks and abstractions to accelerate delivery across multiple ERP platforms, ensuring consistency, extensibility, and maintainability.
* Drive key initiatives in partnership with technical leadership,own critical roadmap projects, propose architectural enhancements, and influence the team’s vision for expanding global accounting capabilities.
* Mentor and coach peers and more junior engineers,conduct design/code reviews, share feedback on architecture, and help unblock teammates to raise the team’s overall bar.



  





**Who you are** 



* You care about product ownership and solving problems for our customers.
* You’re passionate about being in a product\-focused environment where everyone cares deeply about customer impact.
* Adapt and learn beyond your core expertise: pick up new frameworks, front\-end or back\-end technologies, infrastructure tools, and domain concepts to get work done autonomously.
* Embrace a sense of urgency to onboard quickly: shadow support rotations, tackle real tickets early, and proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, documentation, and tooling.



  





**What you will need** 



* BS/MS in Computer Science (or equivalent practical experience).
* 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping backend or full\-stack systems end\-to\-end.
* Strong CS fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and reliability at scale.
* Proficiency in one or more backend languages (Python, Go, Java, or Node.js) and hands\-on experience with RESTful or gRPC APIs.
* Deep experience building integrations or middleware, ideally connecting to ERPs (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Dynamics 365, Oracle) or other financial systems.
* Solid database skills, including designing schemas and writing efficient queries in relational (Postgres, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) stores.
* Proven troubleshooting and support skills, with experience debugging production incidents, analyzing logs/metrics, and driving root\-cause fixes.
* Product mindset and communication excellence, able to collaborate with PMs, UX, internal teams, and external partners to turn ambiguous requirements into robust solutions.
* Self\-starter attitude, comfortable learning new frameworks, digging into unfamiliar codebases, and proactively taking on non\-core tasks (e.g., light front\-end work, custom tooling, support).
* Bonus: Prior hands\-on with ERP\-specific APIs or SDKs (NetSuite SuiteTalk, QuickBooks API, Dynamics OData, Oracle integrations).
* Bonus: Direct experience or deep interest in accounting workflows (journal entries, reconciliations, book closure).

 aiqon is hiring for the Jr. AI Engineer Role. This is an AI \+ Engineering role, not a teaching or research\-only position. You will build AI systems and ship full\-stack product work for industry clients in the USA and Australia.
 



  





 The work is broader than LLM integrations. Depending on the client, you may develop or fine\-tune models for document processing, truck tracking and logistics, computer vision, or similar applied problems, then take those models into production.
 



  





 On a typical week, you might train or adapt a document\-extraction model, work on a tracking pipeline, integrate an LLM into a workflow, then jump to a React or API change or a production bug. We need people who can work across applied AI and software engineering, not just one or the other.
 



 This role is based in Hyderabad (hybrid). You will support USA and Australia clients, so overlapping hours with those time zones are required.

* Develop, adapt, and ship models for applied problems such as document processing, truck tracking and logistics, and similar client use cases, not only LLM integrations.

* Contribute to full\-stack engineering: product UI, APIs, data, and the glue that holds client systems together.

* Minimum eligibility: freshers coming out of college, through to candidates with up to 2 years of professional experience.

* This is an AI \+ Engineering role: you should be ready to develop applied models (document processing, tracking, and similar problems), work with LLMs when needed, and ship full\-stack software.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript; you can write working software without being walked through every step.

* Clear written and spoken communication in English; you can explain trade\-offs and ask for help early.
* Willing to work overlapping hours with USA and Australia time zones to support those clients.

description:
**Hello there! We're Infrrd.** 




 Infrrd (pronounced In\-fur\-d) is an Enterprise AI company that uses AI and Machine Learning to automate human tasks in document\-heavy workflows across mortgage, insurance, and finance. We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to help build and own the backend services that power our mortgage document processing platform.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 You will own backend services that process large, complex mortgage documents at scale — designing the pipelines, integrating LLMs, and keeping the whole thing fast, accurate, and cost effective in production. This is a hands\-on senior role with real ownership: you will make architecture calls, drive them to a decision, and set the quality bar for engineers working alongside you.
 



  





**What You'll Actually Work On:** 




 High\-throughput extraction pipelines that process big\-size documents and large volumes of data in parallel, LLM failover and resilience logic across multiple model providers, and continuous work on accuracy, latency, and cost.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 
 :
 


* **Build high\-throughput document pipelines.** 
 Asynchronous, parallel processing with batching, retries, backpressure, and idempotent reprocessing for big\-size documents and large data volumes.
* **Work with the latest LLMs.** 
 Build against current LLM APIs — timeouts, token and cost controls, response validation, and automatic failover between providers.
* **Engineer for resilience.** 
 Circuit breakers, fallback chains, and graceful degradation so a single upstream failure never takes the pipeline down.
* **Debug production.** 
 Investigate extraction failures, latency spikes, and cost regressions using dashboards and metrics, and fix the root cause.
* **Raise the bar on the team.** 
 Review PRs, break features into clear tasks, unblock junior engineers, and write design docs that hold up to scrutiny across time zones.



  





  





**Who You Are** 
 :
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on Java development, including at least 2 years owning a production service.
* Excellent command of Core Java, with real depth in multithreading and concurrent architecture design.
* Strong with Spring Boot and Spring Data; comfortable in microservices and REST architecture.
* Strong working knowledge of No\-SQL DB (preferred MongoDB ); familiar with relational databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
* Comfortable with Docker and Kubernetes, and at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills with a solid command of data structures.
* Reasons about tradeoffs — cost, latency, and accuracy — not just correctness.
* Has informally mentored or guided junior engineers; the person others come to when they're stuck.
* Operates independently with minimal supervision, and proactively flags risks instead of waiting to be asked.
* Excellent written communication — much of the collaboration is asynchronous and across time zones.



  





**Good to Have** 
 :
 


* Exposure to LLM or GenAI application development — prompt iteration, evaluation, or accuracy measurement.
* Working knowledge of Python.
* Experience with streaming queues like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Background in Document AI, OCR, or the mortgage / fintech domain.
* Familiarity with observability tooling (Grafana, Metabase, ELK).



  





**Work Mode:** 




 5\-days work in office with flexible working hours (Google Maps Location).
 



  





**Curious about the kind of engineering challenges we solve? Check out a few of our tech talks:** 




**Automated Data Extraction from Engineering \& Construction Drawings** 




**Ally \| Agentic AI for Mortgage** 




**NLP\-powered Table Extraction for Insurance Policy Data**

description:
We are building a centralised marketing and sales analytics platform for a large multi\-market consumer brand: a governed BigQuery data layer feeding a single, certified Power BI reporting product used by head\-office marketing and sales teams and by every national market. It replaces a fragmented estate of hand\-built, per\-market dashboards and manual spreadsheet exports with one version of the truth.
   

  

 You will own the Power BI half of that platform end to end — the semantic model, the KPI logic, every report page, and the executive PDF report generated from it. This is not a dashboard\-assembly role. One model and one report template must serve every market through filtering, hold up under executive scrutiny, and reconcile to source platforms on demand.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 6\+ Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kolkata (Onsite)
   

  

**‍Key Responsibilities**
 ‍
   

  

**Strategic Marketing \& Brand Building**
* Design, build and own the certified Power BI semantic model over a governed star schema in the cloud warehouse — relationships, cardinality, role\-playing dates, hierarchies and field\-level documentation.
* Choose and justify the connectivity approach (Import, DirectQuery or composite), and implement incremental refresh, aggregations and partitioning to keep refresh windows and query response inside agreed service levels.
* Author the KPI layer in DAX: a frozen, documented catalogue of measures covering traffic, engagement, conversion and funnel performance, with consistent year\-on\-year, year\-to\-date, quarter\-on\-quarter and custom period\-comparison logic.
* Implement weighted and normalised benchmark measures so small and large markets can be compared fairly against a group average.
* Keep the model performant and maintainable — calculation groups, variables, disciplined measure structure, and regular tuning with Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio and Tabular Editor.


 ‍
   

  

**Report And Experience Design**
* Build the report pages the business actually asked for: a real\-time KPI tracker with progress\-to\-target visuals, market\-versus\-group benchmarking, product\-level performance, an end\-to\-end lead\-to\-order funnel with banded performance thresholds, channel and traffic\-source analysis, and social performance.
* Design for flexible self\-service: independent metric selection per visual, multi\-market comparison, switchable chart types, and free choice of reporting and comparison periods — without users needing to export anything.
* Apply a consistent, accessible visual language across every page: clear labelling, sensible visual hierarchy, and charts rather than dense tables.
* Configure workspaces, apps, audiences and deployment pipelines across development, test and production, and implement row\-level security where required.


 ‍
   

  

**Executive reporting layer**
* Build and automate the recurring executive PDF report generated directly from the platform, using paginated reports and export automation, so a market or period can be selected and a complete, correctly formatted pack produced in one action.
* Ensure exported visuals remain visuals — presentation\-ready output, not screenshots of tables.


 ‍
   

  

**Quality, reconciliation and trust**
* Build data quality and anomaly surfacing into the reporting layer: freshness indicators, missing\-period detection, and outlier alerting on unexpected drops or spikes.
* Reconcile platform figures against the underlying source platforms, document the variances that are structurally expected, and explain them clearly to non\-technical stakeholders before they are discovered in a meeting.
* Write and maintain the model and report documentation, KPI definitions and handover material.


 ‍
   

  

**Delivery**
* Work to a gated, fixed\-scope delivery plan with hard go\-live dates, translating business requirements into agreed KPI definitions and report specifications.
* Run user acceptance testing on a reference market, manage a controlled review\-and\-revision cycle per report page, and support training and handover.


 ‍
   

  

**‍Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 6\+ years in business intelligence or analytics engineering, with at least 4 years hands\-on in Power BI on production, business\-critical reporting.
* Advanced DAX — time intelligence, calculation groups, context transition, performance\-conscious measure design. You can explain why a measure is slow, not just that it is.
* Proven semantic model design over a dimensional warehouse: star schema, incremental refresh, composite models, aggregations, gateways and capacity considerations.
* Strong SQL, and practical experience querying a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred; Snowflake, Redshift or Synapse considered) with an understanding of partitioning, clustering and query cost.
* Direct experience modelling digital analytics data — particularly GA4 event\-level exports in a warehouse, including nested and repeated structures, sessionisation and conversion definitions. This is the single most important differentiator for this role.
* Paginated reports (Power BI Report Builder / RDL) and export automation for pixel\-accurate PDF output.
* Report and dashboard design judgement — you can take a vague executive requirement and produce something that answers it in seconds, and you can defend your layout decisions.
* Power Query / M for shaping and troubleshooting, and comfort with source\-control and deployment discipline.
* Confident written and spoken English, and the composure to present work directly to senior stakeholders and take feedback in the room.


 ‍
   

  

**Desirable**

**About the Company** 




 Skillinabox is one of India's fastest\-growing SkillTech startups, transforming vocational education through hands\-on learning in Fashion Designing, Make\-up Artistry, and future\-ready skills. With a young team of 110\+, we're on a mission to empower learners and expand our presence by launching new experiential centers across India.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Business Development Executive (Inside Sales), you’ll play a key role in driving student admissions, customer acquisition, lead conversion, and revenue growth. You’ll contribute to our Go\-To\-Market (GTM) strategy, help expand our learner community, and support the launch and growth of new experiential centers while delivering an exceptional counselling experience. This is an entrepreneurial role where you’ll work directly with experienced founders while accelerating your career in the SkillTech ecosystem.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Counsel prospective learners through phone calls, video consultations, WhatsApp, and walk\-in interactions.
* Understand learner requirements and recommend suitable Fashion Designing and Make\-up Artistry programs.
* Convert qualified leads into enrollments while consistently achieving monthly sales targets.
* Conduct consultative sales conversations and deliver an outstanding learner experience.
* Manage the complete sales pipeline from lead generation to enrollment using CRM.
* Build strong relationships with prospective learners and ensure timely follow\-ups.
* Collaborate with the Marketing and Product teams to improve customer experience and lead conversion.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, sales reports, and daily activity updates.
* Contribute towards business expansion and revenue growth.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 1\-3 year of experience in Business Development, Inside Sales, Education Sales, Academic Counselling, Customer Success, Telecalling, Lead Generation, or B2C Sales.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Excellent verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong interpersonal, negotiation, persuasion, and relationship\-building skills.
* Target\-oriented with the ability to work in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment.
* Passionate about Education, Skill Development, Career Counselling, and helping learners achieve their goals.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn and grow.
* Basic knowledge of CRM software, Microsoft Excel, or Google Sheets is an added advantage.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 



* 3 \- 4\.5LPA (Fixed) \+ 1\-2LPA (Variable).
* Your next Appraisal will be in a really short period considering this is a core team position we are hiring for. (4\-10 Months).
* An opportunity to own a part of the firm, having a skin in the game (ESOPS).
* Benefit \- Become a part of the core team and work directly with founders \& the board.
* Start building a team around you helping you move forward in your role.



  





**Last Words** 




 If you’re ambitious, passionate about helping learners succeed, and excited to build your career in a high\-growth startup, you can email us at careers@skillinabox.in. We’d love to hear more about you from you.
