title: Senior Director - Organic Growth & Brand
description:
**About Codingal** 




  





 Codingal (www.codingal.com) is a global leader in online AI and coding education for kids and teens (Grades 1\-12\). Our mission is to help students fall in love with AI \& coding and become creators of the future \- entrepreneurs, engineers, and scientists by providing high\-quality, accessible, and personalized computer science education.
 



  





 Students across 135\+ countries learn Coding, AI, and other subjects through Codingal's structured curriculum and expert teachers.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a
 **Senior Director \- Organic Growth \& Brand** 
 to build and lead Codingal's organic growth and brand engine.
 



  





 The \#1 priority for this role is
 **SEO and organic search growth** 
 . We want to significantly scale Codingal's organic discovery, traffic, qualified leads, enrolments, and revenue, and establish SEO as one of the company's most important and predictable acquisition channels.
 



  





**This role owns essentially everything under the broader marketing and growth umbrella except performance marketing / paid acquisition** 
 .
 



  





 We are looking for someone who understands that modern SEO is much more than keywords and blog traffic. It sits at the intersection of content, technology, product, authority, brand, distribution, backlinks, conversion, and increasingly AI\-driven discovery.
 



  





 The ideal candidate combines deep SEO expertise with strong content and brand judgment, analytical thinking, leadership ability, and a strong bias toward execution.
 



  





**1\. SEO \& Organic Growth \- Primary Mandate** 




  





 You will:
 


* Own Codingal's end\-to\-end global SEO strategy and organic growth roadmap.
* Grow organic traffic, qualified leads, enrolments, and revenue from search.
* Build strategies across technical SEO, content SEO, programmatic SEO, on\-page optimization, internal linking, site architecture, link building, and digital PR.
* Identify high\-intent search opportunities and systematically build category leadership around them.
* Build scalable landing page and content ecosystems across subjects, courses, age groups, geographies, learning needs, and customer intents.
* Develop topical authority around Coding, AI, Math, English, technology, education, parenting, and future\-ready skills.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering on technical SEO, crawlability, indexing, page speed, structured data, site architecture, and product\-led SEO opportunities.
* Build a strong backlink and domain authority strategy.
* Continuously analyse competitors, SERPs, keywords, emerging categories, and search trends.
* Improve conversion rates from organic traffic rather than optimizing purely for traffic volume.
* Build clear measurement and attribution between SEO initiatives and business outcomes.
* Develop scalable systems and processes for SEO experimentation and execution.



  





**SEO in the AI Era** 




  





 Search and discovery are changing rapidly, and this role will also be responsible for building Codingal's strategy for visibility across Google Search, AI Overviews, LLM\-based discovery like ChatGPT, answer engines, and emerging AI\-native platforms.
 



  





 We expect this leader to actively develop Codingal's approach to Generative Engine Optimization, AI search visibility, and the changing search ecosystem.
 



  





**2\. Brand \& Content** 




  





 The second major mandate is to make Codingal a recognizable, trusted, and authoritative global education brand.
 



  





**Brand** 




  





 You will:
 


* Define and continuously sharpen Codingal's positioning, messaging, narrative, and brand voice.
* Build awareness, consideration, trust, and preference among parents and students.
* Develop a coherent brand architecture across Coding, AI, Math, English, and future learning categories.
* Own how Codingal presents itself across its website, campaigns, content, partnerships, customer communication, and other touchpoints.
* Develop brand initiatives that increase awareness, branded search, direct traffic, and customer trust.
* Build a deep understanding of parents and students across our major markets and translate those insights into strong communication.
* Ensure consistency of the Codingal brand while adapting communication appropriately across markets.



  





**Content** 




  





 You will:
 


* Own Codingal's overall content strategy and editorial direction.
* Build Codingal into an authoritative source of information around coding, AI, technology, education, parenting, Math, English, and future skills.
* Develop high\-quality content across blogs, guides, landing pages, research, videos, case studies, student stories, and other formats.
* Build content for different stages of the customer journey \- awareness, discovery, consideration, conversion, and advocacy.
* Create compelling stories around Codingal students, teachers, projects, competitions, learning outcomes, and customer success.
* Build scalable editorial and content production systems without compromising quality.
* Use AI intelligently within content workflows while maintaining originality, accuracy, and strong editorial standards.
* Ensure content investments contribute meaningfully to organic growth, brand authority, or customer conversion.



  





**3\. PR \& Communications** 




  





 You will build Codingal's earned media presence and establish the company and its leadership as credible voices in education, technology, and AI.
 



  





 You will:
 


* Own Codingal's PR and external communications strategy.
* Build relationships with journalists, publications, educators, influencers, and relevant industry stakeholders.
* Generate meaningful media coverage across education, technology, AI, parenting, startups, and business.
* Identify and create genuinely newsworthy stories rather than depending only on company announcements.
* Develop research, reports, data stories, and insights that can generate both media coverage and SEO authority.
* Build thought leadership for Codingal and its leadership team.
* Identify awards, speaking opportunities, conferences, industry forums, and other high\-leverage platforms.
* Own press releases, media outreach, interviews, and reputation management.
* Use digital PR as an important mechanism for building high\-quality backlinks and domain authority.



  





**4\. Social Media** 




  





 You will own Codingal's organic presence across relevant social platforms.
 



  





 You will:
 


* Develop differentiated strategies across platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, and emerging channels.
* Build content formats that parents, students, teachers, and educators genuinely want to consume and share.
* Move the company beyond maintaining a social calendar toward creating memorable and distinctive content.
* Build repeatable formats and intellectual property around Codingal's social presence.
* Use social distribution to amplify Codingal's strongest content, student stories, research, PR, and brand initiatives.
* Develop founder, employee, teacher, parent, and student advocacy opportunities.
* Focus on meaningful outcomes such as reach, engagement, branded discovery, website traffic, and assisted conversions rather than vanity metrics alone.



  





**Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Ownership** 




  





 You will:
 


* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team across SEO, content, brand, PR, social, and related functions.
* Establish clear goals, dashboards, operating rhythms, and accountability.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering, particularly on technical and product\-led SEO opportunities.
* Partner closely with Performance Marketing while maintaining distinct ownership of organic acquisition.
* Collaborate with Sales, Customer Relations, Curriculum, Teacher Operations, Product, Engineering, and company leadership.
* Manage agencies and external specialists where they provide leverage while maintaining strong internal ownership.



  





 We expect this person to stay close to execution: reviewing keyword opportunities, landing pages, content briefs, homepage copy, and growth dashboards personally.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  





 Over time, we expect this leader to:
 


* Make SEO a major and predictable customer acquisition channel.
* Significantly increase non\-branded organic search visibility.
* Reduce dependence on paid acquisition over time.
* Establish strong visibility across traditional search and AI\-driven discovery.
* Establish Codingal as a trusted global brand in Coding, AI, and future\-ready education.



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




  





 You will likely have:
 


* 10\-15\+ years of experience across marketing, SEO, organic growth, content, or related functions.
* Significant leadership experience.
* Deep expertise in SEO and organic growth.
* A demonstrated track record of materially scaling organic traffic, leads, customers, or revenue.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, content SEO, programmatic SEO, authority building, and link acquisition.
* Experience working closely with Product and Engineering on SEO.
* Strong understanding of analytics, attribution, experimentation, and conversion.
* Experience owning or working closely with content, brand, PR, and social functions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical and business judgment.
* Experience building and managing high\-performing teams.
* The ability to operate effectively in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment.
* A strong bias toward execution and ownership.



  





**What Will Differentiate You** 




  





 We would especially value candidates who:
 


* Have personally built or dramatically scaled an SEO\-driven acquisition channel.
* Can demonstrate measurable traffic, lead, customer, or revenue growth they directly influenced.
* Have managed organic acquisition across multiple countries.
* Have experience marketing to parents, families, students, educators, or other high\-trust consumer categories.



  





 If you have built a powerful organic growth engine before and want to build one at global scale, we would love to hear from you.
 



  





**What we offer:** 



* Market standard annual salary \+ incentives \+ stock options
* A collaborative, mission\-driven team culture
* Career growth opportunities
* Exposure to a fast\-paced AI\-native Edtech startup
* Free Lunch \& Dinner
* Health Insurance
* PF Contribution



  





**You get to work with a young \& smart team, including directly with the founders, who are on a mission to inspire school kids to fall in love with AI \& coding. Join us on the journey to provide high\-impact education to every K\-12 student and prepare them for the future.**

 Our mission is simple:
 **End Cyber Risk.** 




  





 We are looking for a
 **Senior Product Manager – Exposure Management** 
 to help achieve this mission.
 



  





 The Senior Product Manager – Exposure Management will contribute to our Product Management organization by leading the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Arctic Wolf’s Aurora Exposure Management platform. This role requires deep familiarity with Exposure Management technologies, specifically vulnerability detection and content generation methods. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience working with engineering and user experience teams to decompose business needs into detailed technical requirements and ensure consistent value delivery.
 



  





**IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:**

**YOU WILL BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE IF:**

description:
5–7 years' experience · HSR Layout, Bengaluru (in\-office) · People Team
 



  





**About Codingal** 




  





 Codingal (www.codingal.com) is the global leader in online AI \& coding education for kids and teens. We run live, interactive classes led by expert instructors, helping students build apps, games, websites, and AI\-powered projects.
 



  





 Trusted by over 1 million students worldwide and backed by Y Combinator, Rebright Partners, and top angel investors, Codingal is rated 4\.9/5 by students with an NPS of 86 — the most loved platform for coding and AI education. We are a \~200\-person team headquartered in HSR Layout, Bengaluru, running a global, always\-on business across sales, renewals, customer service, student operations, teacher operations, content, and growth.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 Codingal is in the middle of a deliberate scale\-up. We are scaling toward 10,000 sales\-qualified leads a month by October, and that volume needs a significantly larger team of academic counselors, renewal specialists, and customer service associates. Concretely: 20–30 hires this quarter across sales, renewals, and customer\-facing teams, alongside a ground\-up rebuild of our growth function that includes senior leadership hires for performance marketing and organic growth.
 



  





 Recruiting is now a core business function for us, not a support function. We have tried agencies; they gave us speed on paper but pulled from shared candidate pools and could not hold the quality bar we need for roles where communication and empathy with parents and kids decide outcomes. So we are building the in\-house team instead.
 



  





 We are hiring a
 **Talent Acquisition Manager** 
 to own that hiring engine end to end: build and run the TA team, own the plan with our hiring managers and CEO, and be personally accountable for whether the hires land. This is a player\-coach seat, not an oversight seat. You will split your time between managing the team and running the company's hardest searches yourself.
 



  





 You will report to the Associate Director, People, and work directly with the CEO and with hiring managers across Sales, Customer Relations, Operations, and Growth.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* **The hiring plan, end to end.** 
 Gather requirements from hiring managers and the CEO, translate them into a staffed execution plan with named owners and dates, and be accountable for the targets set with leadership. If the number is missed, it is yours.
* **The company's hardest searches, personally.** 
 Senior and leadership roles — including Director\-level growth hires and specialist content and design roles — stay on your desk. These are won on market mapping, judgment, and stakeholder management, not throughput.
* **High\-volume non\-tech hiring across functions.** 
 Sales (academic counselors and BDAs), renewals, customer service, student operations, pre\-sales, and internships. Multi\-req, at pace, all month.
* **Coach the team, including the difficult cases.** 
 Set the quality bar, review pipelines, sit in on screens. When a recruiter underdelivers, diagnose whether it is an understanding gap or a motivation gap, co\-train with the hiring manager, and act on it quickly rather than letting a quarter drift.
* **The funnel and the systems behind it.** 
 Own our ATS (Dover) and the screening rubrics, trackers, scorecards, and sourcing playbooks the team runs on. Keep them clean enough that anyone can read the pipeline without asking you.
* **Sourcing channels and vendors.** 
 Job boards, referrals, campus and intern pipelines, and the external agency panel — including holding agencies to their SLAs rather than absorbing their misses.
* **Numbers leadership can see weekly.** 
 Time\-to\-fill, cost\-per\-hire, offer acceptance rate, offer\-to\-join ratio, and a live pipeline dashboard. We measure on hires who join and stay, not interviews scheduled.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





**Non\-negotiables** 



* **5–7 years in talent acquisition,** 
 with at least 3 in high\-growth startup environments where the plan changed mid\-quarter and you delivered anyway.
* **You have managed a team of 2 or more recruiters** 
 — allocated reqs, set targets, run reviews, and handled at least one underperformer. Managing a single direct report is not the bar here.
* **A strong personal closing record as an individual contributor.** 
 You will be coaching juniors on craft you can still demonstrate, so we will go deep on roles you closed yourself: how you sourced, what you screened for, and why the candidate said yes.
* **High\-volume non\-tech hiring at scale** 
 — sales, customer service, operations, support, or similar customer\-facing roles, at 10\+ hires a month.
* **Based in Bengaluru,** 
 and able to be in our HSR Layout office. This is not a relocation or remote seat.
* **Steady tenure.** 
 We value recruiters who commit and grow. A pattern of short stints is a hard conversation.



  





**Strongly preferred** 



* **An automation\-first, AI\-native way of working.** 
 We score hundreds of applications against weighted rubrics using Claude\-based agents before a human picks up the phone, and we use AI for structured outreach, communication assessment, and pipeline analytics. We will teach you our stack; we want to see that you have already been reaching for these tools rather than waiting to be handed them.
* Ed\-tech, or high\-volume B2C / inside\-sales hiring exposure.
* Experience hiring senior or leadership roles alongside volume hiring.
* Comfort building a function from a thin base rather than inheriting a running machine.



  





**How We Work** 




 We are direct about this because it is a real commitment: we are an in\-office team at HSR Layout, Bengaluru, working 6 days a week, 11 AM to 8 PM, with 24 work\-from\-home days a year. The pace is intense in the way early growth\-stage companies are.
 



  





 In exchange, the work is unusually consequential. The people you hire this quarter will visibly move the company’s trajectory, and you will have short decision loops and real budget authority to get it done. Don’t just take our word for it: read what current and former employees say on Glassdoor and bring your questions to the interview.
 



  





**Compensation \& Location** 



* **Compensation:** 
 competitive, based on experience. Fixed CTC plus a performance\-linked incentive tied to hiring delivery. We will share the specific band with you on our first call.
* **Location:** 
 HSR Layout, Bengaluru — in\-office, no remote option.
* **Perks:** 
 free lunch and dinner, and direct exposure to the CEO and leadership from week one.



  





**Your First 90 Days** 



* **Days 1–30:** 
 Team strengths scoped (2\-3 recruiters, 2 interns), reqs allocated, per\-recruiter targets set.
* **Days 30–60:** 
 Funnel running on your systems. Rubrics, trackers, and the weekly dashboard live; agency panel under SLA; senior searches opened.
* **Days 60–90:** 
 Delivering against the quarterly plan with the team, and owning at least one leadership search to offer stage.



  





**Where This Role Goes** 




 The honest version: this is a build seat, and the first months are in the trenches. As the function matures, its scope widens beyond filling roles into the broader people agenda — employer branding, career ladders, rewards and recognition, and people programs that today sit with leadership. The person who builds a team that reliably delivers is the first conversation for that scope. It is performance\-gated, not time\-gated, and we would rather tell you that plainly than promise a title.
 



  





**Our Process** 




 Fast and mutual: a short screening conversation, a deeper discussion on hiring craft (planning, funnel thinking, stakeholder management), a 60\-minute structured assessment, a conversation with our CEO, and an office visit so you can see the team and the pace for yourself. We move in days, not weeks, and we expect you to interview us just as hard.
 



  





 Ready to build the hiring engine behind Codingal's next stage?
 **Apply now.**

Key Responsibilities 1. Paid Advertising Assist in planning, launching, and managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns. Monitor campaign performance including CPL, CTR, CPM, CPC, conversion rate, and ROAS. Identify underperforming campaigns, creatives, audiences, and landing pages. Coordinate with the creative and marketing team to test new ad angles, copies, and creatives. Maintain daily/weekly campaign performance reports. 2. Lead Generation & Funnels Manage and monitor lead-generation campaigns and marketing funnels. Track leads from ad landing page WhatsApp/call conversion. Identify drop-offs and suggest improvements. Coordinate with the sales team to ensure leads are properly tracked and followed up. Maintain accurate lead and campaign data. 3. Content & Social Media Assist in planning and publishing content across social media platforms. Research content ideas, trends, hooks, competitors, and industry developments. Coordinate with designers/video editors for creatives, reels, posts, ads, and promotional content. Help repurpose existing content into multiple formats. 4. Marketing Analytics Track and analyze campaign and funnel performance. Prepare daily/weekly/monthly marketing reports. Identify patterns and provide actionable insights. Maintain dashboards and spreadsheets for marketing KPIs. Use data to recommend where budget, effort, and resources should be increased or reduced. 5. Marketing Execution Execute marketing campaigns for book launches, author programs, publishing offers, events, webinars, and other initiatives. Coordinate with internal teams for campaign launches and deadlines. Assist in email, WhatsApp, remarketing, and other digital campaigns. Ensure campaigns and marketing assets are launched accurately and on time. 6. Research & Optimization Research competitors and successful campaigns in the publishing, personal branding, education, and creator economy space. Study successful advertisements, landing pages, offers, and messaging. Continuously test new marketing ideas and growth opportunities. Stay updated with changes in Meta Ads, Google Ads, AI tools, and digital marketing trends. KPIs for the Role Your performance will primarily be measured by: Qualified leads generated Cost per lead Lead-to-sale conversion rate Campaign ROI / ROAS Landing page conversion rate CTR and CPC Speed and accuracy of campaign execution Number of successful marketing experiments Quality and accuracy of reporting Who We Are Looking For You should be: Data-driven — comfortable looking at numbers and making decisions from them. Execution-oriented — able to take a task and get it completed without constant supervision. Curious — constantly looking for better ads, hooks, offers, and marketing strategies. Detail-oriented — small tracking or campaign errors should not slip through. Fast learner — digital marketing changes rapidly, and you should enjoy learning new tools. Good communicator — able to coordinate effectively with creative, sales, and marketing teams. Problem solver — when a campaign doesn’t work, you should think about why and what to test next. Preferred Skills Knowledge of any of the following is a plus: Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Analytics Google Sheets / Excel Canva WordPress / Landing Pages WhatsApp Marketing CRM tools Basic copywriting Marketing automation AI tools such as ChatGPT / Claude Experience & Education Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory. Freshers with strong digital marketing knowledge and practical experience are welcome. Internship, freelance, or personal experience running digital campaigns is a plus. Ideal Candidate We are not looking for someone who only knows how to post on Instagram. We are looking for someone who wants to understand: Traffic Leads Sales Revenue If you enjoy analyzing numbers, testing ideas, improving campaigns, and seeing your work directly impact business growth, this role is for you.

**Description**
 Do you want to define the future of Internet commerce?

Come talk with us about joining our team to help our team serve customers better.
   

  

 Is your next project defining a world class Internet service?
   

  

 With us, you will be building cutting\-edge applications and services in an environment of highly distributed systems used by Amazon transportation . Your innovation will provide new functionality for Amazon Transportation enabling millions of packages to move smoothly across amazon transportation network across the globe.
   

  

 Can you work at the scale of the biggest Internet companies?
   

  

 The solutions that you will deploy must scale to serve missions of customers worldwide, process thousands of transactions per minute and have an uptime greater than 99\.99%.
   

  

 Do you believe systems can always be made faster?
   

  

 If so, come be a member of Amazon’s Core Transportation Technology team. We build software systems that ensure millions of packages reach our customers in the fastest possible time. The systems you build will be at the forefront of our goal to ensure we are able to deliver packages same day or even within hours.
   

  

 Are you pedantic about code quality ?
   

  

 If so, we are looking for an individual like you to join a team of world class developers and help us write highest quality code which is readable, maintainable and can give our customers a bug free experience.
   

  

 Amazon is a premier place to build and deploy world class software
   

  

 Amazon has come a long way since opening on the World Wide Web in July 1995\. Today, we operate retail websites in multiple countries across geographies, offering products in many categories (books, media, digital, electronics etc.) worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history! The Amazon.com brand has become synonymous with a superior level of convenience, selection, low prices, and customer service.
   

  

 Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. There are a variety of ways in which we acquire items from vendors to our warehouses, ship items from one location to another, and several intermediate locations through which the package travels before reaching the customer. There are millions of such packages, each with different attributes, and different delivery requirements. What results is a highly dense graph of source, intermediate and destination nodes, with arcs between them representing possible paths for packages, with different costs and times along each arc. Accounting for all these constraints, and maximizing the number of shipments shipped, while minimizing cost, providing a variety of delivery options and maximizing delivery performance is Transportation Engineering's primary focus.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are a highly agile and self driven team of talented and motivated engineers based out of Delhi. We are at the heart of Amazon transportation and are responsible for managing entire package lifecycle. Team owns the orchestration of transportation requests, state management, proactive deviation management at network level, progress tracker operations like delivery to locker, cancel and notification of transportation events to downstream clients. Come join the team that sets a high bar for software development and operational excellence practices. We use Amazon wide tools and processes to a large extent, and we also contribute to the Amazon wide arsenal of tools that all businesses use to be more effective. We are early adopters of new tools and technologies, before they become mandatory.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* 1\+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

In the job you would be required to exercise superior analytical and problem solving skills as well as people management skills. You will be expected to work with the senior leadership of multiple Fulfillment Centers and set expectation on the support that central flow would provide and need from them. You would be responsible to work with cross functional teams in developing tools, standards and best practices and will co\-ordinate the efforts with multiple Fulfillment centers across IN. You are expected to have a steep learning curve in learning pick flow settings, collate settings and other flow related tools and become a subject matter expert in flow management. You will need to be very knowledgeable in Excel as this team will depend on multiple tools based on the software.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and develop a team of Amazon Central Flow Leads.
* Understand and teach detailed flow concepts related to outbound flow operations in Amazon’s fulfillment centers.
* Continuously improve processes and procedures related to OB Flow Operations
* Continuously monitor performance of FCs that are attributable to Central Flow and take corrective steps whenever required to optimize outbound productivity performance and Customer Experience.
* Remove barriers for Central Flow Leads by developing tools and automate manual business processes.
* Monitor and audit if standard processes are followed for every FC and take corrective action to change or modify standards if needed due to change in external or internal processes related to FC.

 A day in the life

The team's mission is to optimize FC workflows by centralizing and standardizing shift planning and execution while automating critical decision points. The culture is built on deep partnership with tech, ACES, PE, and analytics teams to drive proactive operational improvements. The team monitors ExSD risk, TRB, and productivity, providing real\-time recommendations to maintain benchmark standards. The team embodies a fast\-paced, data\-driven, and collaborative environment focused on preventing bottlenecks and ensuring packages flow smoothly to meet customer promises.

description:
**Description**
 Do you want to build machine learning and agentic\-AI systems that analyze billions of dollars in transactions every day, and measure your impact in millions of dollars saved?
   

  

 In Amazon's Finance Technology group, we build the detection systems (machine learning, and increasingly agentic AI) that defend Amazon against theft, fraud, abuse, and waste across the supply chain, retail catalog, and corporate procurement. We turn terabytes of transaction, vendor, and operational data into real\-time risk decisions: scoring payments as they happen, surfacing anomalous behavior, and uncovering collusion networks that span thousands of entities.
   

  

 We're now building the next generation of that platform around generative and agentic AI: multi\-agent systems that discover fraud patterns directly from the raw data flowing through Amazon's businesses, working alongside domain experts to turn what they find into production detection logic. The result is a platform where new detection coverage comes not only from engineers, but from agents and the experts who know the fraud best, shipping in days instead of sprints.
   

  

 You'll build the agent tools, ML pipelines, services, and data infrastructure behind all of this, working with generative AI, large language models, and agent frameworks alongside the anomaly\-detection, classification, and graph\-modeling techniques they build on. You'll partner directly with applied scientists, fellow engineers, and finance operations teams, and you'll see your ideas reach production in weeks, not years.
   

  

 If you want to apply advanced ML and agentic AI at Amazon scale, on systems with a direct, measurable financial impact, we'd love to talk.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You Will Participate In The Full Software Development Lifecycle, From Collaborating With Customers And Scientists On Design, To Building Scalable, Extensible Systems That Run In Production. You Will
   

  

 Design and build ML pipelines that process terabytes of data and score billions of dollars in transactions.
   

  

 Build agentic AI applications: LLM\-powered agents that discover risk patterns and generate detection logic, operating through well\-defined tool interfaces with human\-in\-the\-loop review.
   

  

 Build the knowledge and memory systems agents depend on: vector stores, knowledge graphs, the entity\-risk layer for cross\-entity collusion detection, and in\-session and shared memory.
   

  

 Develop how we evaluate agent effectiveness in fraud detection, and turn analysts' ad\-hoc investigation patterns into repeatable, templated workflows.
   

  

 Build the platform and tooling (governed data access, model deployment, and self\-service rule authoring) that lets agents and non\-engineers ship detection logic safely and fast.
   

  

 Take models and agents from prototype to reliable, real\-time production systems, and work directly with internal customers to turn feedback into shipped improvements.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You'll partner with applied scientists, software engineers, and finance operations teams across Amazon. You'll harden an agent pipeline for production, extend the entity graph that powers a new detector, or design a tool interface that lets an agent query data safely, then review it with the customer who'll use it. Because our team and our customers are comfortable trying new ideas, you'll get your work in front of real data quickly and iterate on what you learn.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We own the machine learning and agentic\-AI systems that prevent, recover, and avoid internal and external theft, fraud, abuse, and waste across Amazon Finance Operations. Our platform makes real\-time risk decisions on transactions from many of Amazon's largest businesses. We're actively building toward entity\-level risk profiles updated in real time, and agentic systems that compress fraud discovery and investigation from weeks to days, with engineers building the leverage layer that multiplies what every analyst and agent can do.

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience in processing data with a massively parallel technology (such as Redshift, Teradata, Netezza, Spark or Hadoop based big data solution)

The role comes with significant investment backing and outsized influence in shaping what the next\-generation experience looks like.

 We are seeking a PM with expertise and high judgment to determine the right goals, design long\-term solutions, and take the lead on initiatives independently while seeking direction when needed. description:
**Description**
 Do you want to define and drive the learning strategy for an organization that impacts thousands of associates globally?
   

  

 As a Site Trainer, you will own the end\-to\-end training lifecycle — from identifying strategic learning needs to designing scalable programs, mentoring trainers, and measuring business\-level impact. You will bring deep expertise in communication training and instructional design to shape how teams develop, perform, and grow. This role goes beyond delivery — you will set the direction, influence stakeholders, and build training frameworks that scale across sites and geographies.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Training Strategy \& Program Ownership
   

  

* Own and drive the training strategy for assigned programs or business lines, defining learning roadmaps aligned with organizational goals and operational priorities
* Design and implement scalable training frameworks that can be replicated across sites, teams, and geographies
* Identify emerging skill gaps through proactive analysis of business trends, performance data, and stakeholder input; develop strategic interventions without waiting for escalation
* Lead the design and rollout of organization\-wide communication excellence programs (business writing, verbal fluency, presentation skills, stakeholder communication)


 Advanced Training Delivery \& Communication Coaching
   

  

* Facilitate high\-complexity training sessions including leadership communication workshops, advanced soft skills programs, and cross\-functional capability\-building initiatives
* Serve as the subject matter expert for communication training — design and deliver modules on accent modification, business communication, customer interaction strategies, and executive communication
* Lead Train\-the\-Trainer (TTT) programs to build trainer capability across sites; certify and calibrate trainers on delivery standards
* Design and facilitate simulations, role\-plays, and scenario\-based learning for complex, ambiguous situations


 Curriculum Design \& Innovation
   

  

* Architect comprehensive curricula using advanced instructional design methodologies (ADDIE, SAM, Agile Learning Design) with emphasis on scalability and learner experience
* Pioneer innovative learning formats (microlearning, gamification, AI\-assisted content, peer learning communities) to drive engagement and retention
* Establish content governance standards — version control, review cadence, and retirement criteria for training materials
* Design multi\-level assessment frameworks including competency\-based evaluations, capstone projects, and certification pathways


 Data\-Driven Training Effectiveness \& Impact
   

  

* Define and own training effectiveness metrics across the full Kirkpatrick model (Levels 1\-4\); establish causal links between training programs and business outcomes
* Build and maintain executive\-level dashboards that communicate training ROI, learner progression, and capability development trends
* Conduct deep\-dive analyses on underperforming programs; develop and execute improvement action plans with measurable targets
* Benchmark training programs against industry standards and internal best practices; drive continuous improvement through data


 Stakeholder Influence \& Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Partner with senior leaders across Operations, Quality, WFM, and HR to align training investments with business strategy
* Represent training in business reviews (WBRs, MBRs, QBRs) — present insights, advocate for learning initiatives, and influence resource allocation decisions
* Mentor and develop Training Specialists; provide structured coaching, feedback, and career development guidance
* Drive cross\-site standardization of training practices while adapting for local context and needs


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning may begin with a strategy session with operations leadership, aligning training priorities with upcoming business goals and identifying capability gaps across multiple programs. You then review training effectiveness data across sites, spotting trends and crafting recommendations for program redesign. Mid\-day, you mentor a team of trainers on advanced facilitation techniques and provide feedback on their curriculum designs. In the afternoon, you lead a cross\-functional working group to launch a new communication excellence program, defining the rollout plan, success metrics, and stakeholder communication strategy. You close the day by presenting quarterly training impact analysis to senior leadership, demonstrating how your programs drove measurable improvements in quality scores and operational KPIs.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Training team is dedicated to accelerating specialist readiness and continuous development at scale. We partner closely with Operations, Quality, and Workforce Management across multiple sites and geographies to deliver learning solutions that drive performance outcomes. Our vision is to build a culture of continuous learning where every specialist has the skills and confidence to deliver world\-class service. As a Site Trainer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping team strategy, mentoring junior trainers, and raising the bar for learning programs across the organization.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of learning design, learning science, instructional design, educational psychology, or similar field experience
* Experience with Learning \& Development and course facilitation or an equivalent professional qualification, or experience in a training role, including technical training, or a mix of training, performance management and coaching/mentoring
* Experience designing and delivering training programs at scale across multiple teams or sites
* Experience mentoring or leading other trainers (formally or informally)
* Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) strategy, governance, and reporting


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Organizational Development, Communication, Instructional Design, or a related field
* Experience as a Communication or Soft Skills Trainer with program\-level ownership in a contact center, BPO, or customer service environment
* Professional certification in Learning \& Development (e.g., CPTM, ATD\-CPTD, CIPD, or equivalent)
* Experience with e\-learning authoring tools (Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, or similar) at an advanced level
* Experience in designing and delivering accent modification or language proficiency coaching programs
* Process improvement certification (Six Sigma Green Belt, Lean, or Kaizen)

Amatech Innovation is looking for a driven, technically curious and coachable Technical Sales Executive to join our growing team. This is not a conventional sales job. If you are ambitious, comfortable with field work and want to develop expertise in specialty adhesives, thermal management materials and protective coatings, this is an opportunity to build a strong technical-sales career from the ground up. About Amatech Innovation Amatech Innovation Pvt. Ltd. is an Ahmedabad-based advanced materials technology company developing and manufacturing high-performance specialty materials for demanding industrial applications. Our key technology platforms include: Linkobond® – Specialty Adhesives Amasil® – Thermal Management Materials Amacoat® – Protective & Functional Coatings Custom-engineered material solutions Our products are used for applications across: EV & Batteries | Electronics | Electrical | Automotive | Pumps | LED | Industrial OEMs We are a lean, founder-driven company with strong technical and R&D capabilities, now expanding our technical sales and business development team. What You Will Do Your job is to understand the customer's problem, identify the right technical solution and turn the opportunity into business. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new OEM and industrial customers across Gujarat and Maharashtra. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline. Maintain systematic records of customer visits, samples, trials, quotations and opportunities. Work with existing channel partners and support expansion of the distribution network. Achieve agreed activity, customer acquisition and revenue targets. Preferred Profile Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.Sc. in Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Chemistry or related disciplines. 1–2 years of experience in technical sales, application engineering, application support or industrial sales. description:
**Description**
 Payroll Tech's Sheriff team develops and maintains ML and Generative AI applications that support Payroll Operations and Amazon employees at scale. Our portfolio includes Pay\-Input Anomaly Detection, which improves the pay experience by identifying pay input irregularities such as leaves and insurance discrepancies; Percept, which improves ticket resolution by providing intelligent ticket prioritization via sentiment scoring, ticket summarization, defect classification, and categorization; Penny, a Virtual Assistant that enables payroll operations teams to efficiently retrieve information from multiple sources including policies, Percept data, vendor data, and HR data via Xylem through a single browser interface; Pay Ticket Genie, in process of being integrated with Amazon AZA(A to Z Assistant); Niyam, our rule engine; and Policy as Code Extraction (PoCo), a critical component of SPACE (Single Payroll Autonomous and Computation Engine) Amazon's in\-house payroll system built to eliminate third\-party vendor dependency for payroll processing. PoCo ensures data accuracy by validating that pay instructions are correct and performing calculations when required. It consists of two components: policy\-based rule creation, where business owners select a pay code and provide policy links to generate rules for specific business processes, and rule evaluation, where upstream services send real\-time validation or calculation requests and receive results along with rationale for any failures. Sheriff team owns policy\-based rule creation and powering the rule evaluation system with rules generated.
   

  

 As an Applied Scientist on the Sheriff team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that power these systems: driving model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across the payroll ecosystem.
   

  

 Key Job Responsibilities
   

  

 As an Applied Scientist on the Sheriff team, you will operate across three core dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence.
   

  

 Invent
   

  

 You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state\-of\-the\-art scientific approaches as well as emerging technologies from the research community. You practice customer\-obsessed science : working backwards from the needs of Amazon employees and payroll operations teams to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM\-based methodologies for anomaly detection, sentiment analysis, ticket classification, prescriptive analysis, intelligent virtual assistance, and automated policy extraction. You identify and define the research agenda for expanding Percept's capabilities including prescriptive analysis feature; lead the scientific strategy for the Penny\-AZA integration enabling accurate and low\-latency responses to Amazon employee payroll queries, and drive the ML strategy for Policy as Code extraction(PoCo), developing models that extract, interpret, and codify payroll policies into structured, executable rules that power real\-time pay instruction validation and calculation within SPACE. You author or co\-author articles for internal or external peer\-reviewed venues that validate the novelty of your work, when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations.
   

  

 Implement
   

  

 The ML components you develop are directly integrated into production systems or directly support large\-scale applications serving Amazon's global payroll operations. You make appropriate tradeoffs between model accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and immediate versus long\-term solutions; favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi\-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the correct level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs) and GenAI frameworks largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with data sources including USC (Unified Central Service), Xylem, SIM\-Ticketing, Pay Code Governance system, and PoCo's rule evaluation engine.
   

  

 Influence
   

  

 You contribute to tactical and strategic planning for the Sheriff team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for the global expansion of Percept, driving both feature growth and country\-level launches own the complex AI track for Penny\-AZA integration collaborating across partner teams including Reflect and GREF to ensure seamless data integration and robust ML pipeline workflows, and drive the scientific roadmap for PoCo's expansion to 100K US employees, ensuring the ML models powering policy extraction, rule generation and testing scale reliably to meet this growth. You mentor scientists and engineers on the team and across teams, championing best practices for the AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) to rapidly increase developer productivity and delivery velocity. You provide peer feedback on research procedures and results within and across teams, help recruit and develop bar\-raising talent through interview drives, and grow the team's organizational knowledge of Sheriff team ML solutions. You are visible in the broader internal and external scientific communities as a subject matter expert and regularly serve as a Program Committee (PC) member at peer\-reviewed conferences or review articles for journal publications.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4\+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top\-tier peer\-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C\+\+, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high\-performance computing


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development
* Experience communicating research findings and analysis in both written and spoken channels
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience leading and influencing your team or organization
* Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
* Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large\-scale optimizations, or experience with data infrastructures: relational analytic DBMS, Elastic\-Search, and Big Data EMR/EC2/Glue/Lambda

title: Business Intelligence Engineer II, AOP
description:
**Description**
 Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. The AOP team is an integral part of this and strives to provide Data and Science Capabilities to fulfill all customer processes in the APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Ops businesses.
   

  

 This BIE role sits at a rare intersection and has high growth prospects. On one side, you have cutting\-edge ML/OR models making split\-second cost saving decisions across Ops network. On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside — you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time — that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re\-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. In some instances you will also directly own these models.
   

  

 The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large\-scale, low\-latency data flowing through real\-time pipelines. You'll design automated reporting frameworks that need to be as robust as the system they monitor. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well\-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you.
   

  

 What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting\-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet — they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. You'll need strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL and Python and AWS Services, and experience building scalable BI solutions. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication — and to own outcomes end\-to\-end rather than just deliver reports — is what will make you exceptional in this role.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AOP Science Team is the central science team of Amazon APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Operations. We are responsible for creating core science capabilities to scale decision making across domains such as Truck Capacity Optimization, Short\-term capacity planning, Network Abuse Detection, Impact analyses, Productivity improvement Models and so on. As a team our goal is to support our customers to make better decisions by leveraging applied statistics, machine learning, OR, deep learning architecture and algorithms. Team owns end\-to\-end life cycle for science model development which includes data exploration, experimentation, automating near real\-time data pipelines, data visualization and model productionization.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets

 We are looking for a dynamic and technically strong Business Head (Metal) to lead the Precious metal business. 
 Must be strong 
 The role involves full business ownership into operations, and sales , with accountability for profitability and growth. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of chemical processing, Metal Sales along with proven experience in managing large-scale process plants. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Business Head Metals & Chemical Processing The role involves end-to-end business ownership , with accountability for plant operations, feed sourcing, sales, profitability, and business growth . The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of chemical processing, metal extraction and sales , along with proven experience in managing large-scale process plants and commercial operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business & P&L Ownership Lead the overall business for metals including Copper, Zinc, Lithium, Cobalt, and Nickel , with end-to-end accountability for business performance and profitability. Formulate and execute business strategies aligned with organizational growth objectives. Drive profitability through cost optimization, process efficiency, capacity utilization, yield improvement, and product realization . Own annual operating budgets, financial performance, working capital, and overall commercial outcomes. Identify opportunities for capacity expansion, new products, process improvements, and value-added downstream businesses. 
 2. Plant Operations & Manufacturing Provide overall leadership to plant operations , ensuring safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective functioning of the manufacturing facility. Drive plant performance across production, yield, recovery, quality, throughput, energy consumption, and operating costs . Ensure optimal utilization of installed capacity and continuously improve operational efficiency. Work closely with plant, process, maintenance, quality, EHS, and technical teams to achieve production and business targets. Establish and monitor operational KPIs and drive a culture of continuous improvement, productivity, and operational excellence . Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS, statutory, environmental, quality, and operational standards . 
 3. Feed Sourcing & Raw Material Strategy Own the end-to-end sourcing strategy for feed/raw materials required for the plant, ensuring adequate availability, quality, and competitive landed cost. Develop and maintain a strong network of feed suppliers, recyclers, aggregators, traders, and strategic sourcing partners . Identify new feed sources and geographies to ensure security and diversification of raw material supply. Lead commercial negotiations, supplier development, contract structuring, and long-term sourcing arrangements. Optimize the feed mix based on plant capabilities, metal recovery, processing economics, quality parameters, and market conditions. Work closely with technical and plant teams to evaluate the metallurgical/chemical suitability and economics of different feed materials . Ensure uninterrupted feed availability while optimizing inventory, working capital, logistics, and overall sourcing costs. 
 4. Sales & Business Development Develop and execute the sales strategy for extracted metals and value-added chemical intermediates . Build and manage relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, traders, and downstream consumers. Formulate commercial strategies covering pricing, customer engagement, contract negotiation, product positioning, and market development . Identify new markets and business opportunities to maximize product realization and margins. Develop long-term customer relationships and strategic partnerships to strengthen market positioning. Monitor metal and chemical market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and demand-supply dynamics to inform business decisions. 
 5. Integrated Commercial & Operational Management Balance feed economics, plant performance, metal recovery, product realization, and market pricing to maximize overall business profitability. Develop an integrated view of the business from feed sourcing plant processing metal recovery product sales cash realization . Ensure close coordination between sourcing, operations, sales, finance, and supply chain teams. Take data-driven decisions on feed procurement, production planning, inventory, product mix, and sales allocation. 
 6. Leadership & Team Management Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams across operations, sourcing, sales, commercial, and support functions . Establish clear performance metrics and accountability across the organization. Work closely with senior management/promoters on strategic decisions, investments, expansion plans, and overall business growth. Drive a strong culture of ownership, operational discipline, commercial excellence, and profitability .

description:

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
Area Sales Manager (Microsurgery) Job Summary Area Sales Manager (Microsurgery) is a key territory for the medical division and direct sales role handling both government and private institutions. The sales strategies and activities required to drive the sales target within the division. The ultimate objective is to grow sales and margin in the territory and to increase market share through effective promotion and selling efforts and by aggressively defending achieved market share against competition within the microsurgery business vertical. Focused on the 4P s of Marketing (Product, Price, Promotion and Place) is responsible for providing marketing leadership and for developing and executing market attack plans, identifying growth opportunities and launching marketing promotions with the scope of creating market demand and accelerating new products growth for your Region. Responsible for product sales activities of divisional products, including new product lunches, competitive data gathering, VOC, creation of sales tools and monitoring of business results ( Product mix, volumes, prices, customer profitability). Key Responsibilities Drive Sales Performance- Achieve sales targets and grow the medical product portfolio (Neuro, ENT, Plastic and Reconstruction, Spine, and Ophthalmology) within the assigned territory. Expand Business Profitability- Increase direct sales, market penetration, and profit margins across assigned accounts, territories, and customer segments. Build Strong Customer Relationships- Establish and maintain professional relationships with key decisionmakers, clinicians, and stakeholders in customer accounts. Should be able to build rapport with leading Neuro, ENT, PR, Spine, and Ophthalmology surgeons to drive business growth and drive KOL Engagement Ensure Compliance Effective Decision-Making- Conduct business with the highest standards of integrity and compliance while handling critical discussions, negotiations, and business decisions effectively. Leverage Clinical Network Market Knowledge- Utilize strong knowledge of the territory and maintain excellent rapport with leading Neuro, ENT, PR, Spine, and Ophthalmology surgeons to drive business growth. Focused on the 4P's of Marketing (Product, Price, Promotion and Place) - Focused on providing marketing leadership and for developing and executing market attack plans, identifying growth opportunities and launching marketing promotions with the scope of creating market demand and accelerating new product growth for your Region. Required Skills and Experience Educational Background Industry Experience- Degree in Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, MBA, or equivalent; strong sales experience in the medical device/healthcare industry is equally valued. Proven Sales Performance- Minimum 8+ years of experience in selling medical devices, preferably surgical operating microscopes, with a demonstrated track record of achieving consistent sales growth. Strong Commercial Skills- Excellent communication, business acumen, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with experience in channel partner management. Technical Demonstration Expertise- Ability to effectively demonstrate microscopy equipment and conduct product presentations, including operating theater demonstrations. Business Management Mobility- Proficiency in Salesforce or similar CRM systems, with willingness to undertake extensive field travel within the assigned territory to drive business growth. Personal Attributes Positive, proactive, able to multi-task, well organized with an eye for details. Strong interpersonal and communication skills Proficient in MS Office and good working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint Well organized team player with sense of urgency to manage to deadlines.

description:
Supply Chain Product Manager - Orchestration Automation Job Description You were made to create Better Care for a Better World. As a person, you re a problem-solver - a connector - someone who thrives on creating order from complexity and driving continuous improvement. You see the big picture while mastering the details, ensuring that every product, process, and partnership flows with precision and purpose. You live your life in alignment with the highest values of integrity, efficiency, and collaboration, always working to turn today s challenges into tomorrow s success stories. In this role, you ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU. About You In one of our Supply Chain roles, you ll focus on winning with consumers and the market, while putting safety, mutual respect, and human dignity at the center. Job responsibilities include: Responsibilities Owning the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the overall Supply Chain Digital Orchestration and Automation digital capabilities and technical domains. Defines what success looks like, drives toward it, and tracks it using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Providing cross-functional leadership, most notably between engineering teams, logistics, and support. A key aspect of this is communicating the product roadmap and keeping the product team and the stakeholders informed of updates. Collaborating with the Product Owner to leverage stakeholder insights to develop a living and breathing roadmap for the future while advocating for and driving alignment between stakeholders in the development of requirements, acceptance criteria, and solutions. Understanding how NA Supply Chain objectives intersect with the needs, pain points, and priorities of the user base of their Supply Chain Orchestration and Automation domains. Understanding what success looks like for different groups in terms of use cases and user experience, as documented with User Personas, Use Cases, and Case Studies. Accountability for stakeholder management at each point of the product lifecycle including requests, adoption, requirements gathering, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Representing the needs of Enterprise Supply Chain and Global Product Teams who own tools with overlapping use cases. Driving adoption of enhancements through user feedback sessions, training support, and an adoption roadmap. Developing and manages defined communication channel(s) and/or stakeholder groups, proactively seeking to identify potential demand, and drives the creation of the business case. Anticipating changes in customer/user needs, adapts product (with enhancements), and create product retirement and transitioning plans. Required Qualifications 3+ years of Product Management experience, or 5+ years of experience in a related field Experience integrating enterprise systems (SAP, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, MES, etc.). Experience with Automation systems integration (Dematic, E80 and/or Wapiti). Experience with product life cycle management, especially with product vision, strategy, roadmap, and prioritization. Experience managing stakeholders, including senior executives. Strong cross-functional leadership, influence, collaboration, relationship-building, and communication skills. Desire and ability to crystallize and diagnose problems through cross-functional collaboration and troubleshooting. Detail-oriented, process-driven, and highly organized. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience working for a global, highly matrixed, Consumer Packaged Goods company. Experience with API architecture, middleware, or integration platforms. Experience working with teams organized around Agile ways of working. Experience conducting stakeholder interviews, market analysis, and other forms of research. Experiencing identifying goals, metrics, and analytics to measure value at a large scale (e.g., a product, a program). Familiarity with uncovering and championing high value use cases for data Familiarity with database structure (systems and data). Experience solving business problems with technology solutions. title: Finance Executive
description:
Job Description: Finance Executive AP & AR Role Overview We are looking for a Finance Executive to manage day-to-day Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) activities, ensure timely accounting and collections, and maintain accurate financial records. The role requires strong attention to detail, good coordination with customers and vendors, and the ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines. Key Responsibilities Accounts Payable (AP) Process and verify vendor invoices, purchase orders, and supporting documents. Ensure invoices are accurately recorded and approved before payment processing. Maintain vendor accounts and reconcile vendor statements. Track outstanding payables and prepare payment schedules. Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to resolve invoice discrepancies. Ensure timely processing of vendor payments. Maintain proper documentation for all AP transactions. Accounts Receivable (AR) Raise and issue customer invoices based on agreed contracts, milestones, and billing schedules. Track customer outstanding balances and maintain accurate AR records. Follow up with customers for overdue payments and payment confirmations. Prepare and share customer statements and ageing reports. Reconcile customer accounts and resolve billing/payment discrepancies. Coordinate with sales, project, and customer support teams on billing-related matters. Maintain regular collection follow-ups and provide updates on overdue accounts. Reconciliation & Reporting Perform regular bank, customer, and vendor reconciliations. Prepare AP/AR ageing reports and outstanding reports. Monitor overdue receivables and escalate long-pending balances. Support month-end and year-end closing activities. Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation. Assist in audit requirements and provide necessary financial data. Additional Responsibilities Ensure compliance with internal finance processes and controls. Maintain confidentiality of financial and customer information. Support management with finance-related reports and analysis. Identify process gaps and suggest improvements to improve billing, collections, and payment processes. Maintain clear communication with internal stakeholders, customers, and vendors. Required Skills Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes. Good understanding of basic accounting principles. Experience with invoice processing, billing, collections, reconciliations, and ageing. Good knowledge of MS Excel, including basic formulas and reporting. Experience working with accounting/ERP software. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. High attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities. Experience 2–5 years of experience in Finance, Accounts, AP/AR, or a similar role. Key Performance Indicators Timely and accurate invoice processing. Reduction in overdue receivables. Timely customer collections and payment follow-ups. Accurate vendor and customer reconciliations. Timely AP payment processing. Accuracy of financial records and reports. Compliance with internal finance processes.

title: SME-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting.
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This Position reports to: Accounting & Reporting Manager - General Accounting
  SME-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting. Take your next career step at ABB with a global team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences. You will be working as SME-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting and will be reporting to Accounting & Reporting Manager – GA and will be a part of Bangalore, India. In this role you will be primarily responsible for End-to-End Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting and Internal Audit and Process Improvements and automation Process as SME or team focused on the complete, accurate, and timely completion of Fixed Assets & Reporting and related activities within the General Accounting (GA) team. Ensure compliance with internal guidelines and procedures as well as external regulatory requirements with strong understanding of USGAP and FA Module. Fixed Asset Accounting Operations Manage end-to-end fixed asset accounting processes. Ensure accurate capitalization, transfers, retirements, disposals, and depreciation of assets. Review and approve asset creation requests in compliance with accounting policies. Maintain the fixed asset register and ensure completeness and accuracy. Monitor Construction-in-Progress (CIP) accounting and capitalization activities. Financial Reporting & Month-End Close Execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end fixed asset close activities. Review depreciation runs and accounting entries. Prepare and validate fixed asset reconciliations between subledger and general ledger. Support financial statement disclosures related to Property, Plant & Equipment (PP&E). Analyze asset balances and investigate significant movements. Compliance & Internal Controls Ensure compliance with IFRS, US GAAP, local statutory requirements, and company accounting policies. Maintain SOX/internal control documentation and evidence. Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions. Support internal and external audits through timely preparation of schedules and explanations. Asset Lifecycle Management Govern the complete asset lifecycle from acquisition to disposal. Ensure appropriate asset classification and useful life assignment. Review impairment assessments and asset write-offs. Monitor leased assets and right-of-use assets where applicable. Reconciliation & Data Quality Perform periodic asset register reviews and reconciliations. Resolve discrepancies between procurement, project accounting, and fixed assets records. Ensure asset master data accuracy and integrity. Develop and track key performance metrics related to fixed asset processes. Reporting & Analytics Prepare management reports on capital expenditures, depreciation, asset additions, and disposals. Support budgeting and forecasting activities related to fixed assets. Provide insights into capital investment trends and asset utilization. Develop dashboards and report solutions for stakeholders. Stakeholder Management Act as the primary point of contact for fixed asset-related queries. Partner with Finance, Procurement, Tax, Controllership, and Business Operations teams. Coordinate with external auditors, statutory auditors, and tax advisors. Provide guidance on fixed asset accounting treatments and policy interpretations. Process Improvement & Automation Identify and drive process improvement initiatives. Lead standardization and harmonization of fixed asset processes across entities. Support system implementations, upgrades, and testing activities (e.g., SAP, Oracle, S4-HANA,Trintech) Promote automation opportunities to improve efficiency and control. SME Governance Responsibilities Serve as the functional expert for fixed asset accounting. Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions to team members. Provide guidance during transitions, migrations, and transformation projects. Review complex accounting transactions and determine appropriate treatment. Key Skills & Competencies: Strong knowledge of Fixed Assets Accounting, PP&E, Depreciation, Capitalization, and Asset Retirement. Experience with IFRS, US GAAP, and internal controls. ERP knowledge (SAP, Oracle,). Advanced Excel and reporting skills. Analytical problem-solving and stakeholder management. Audit support and compliance expertise. A master’s degree in accounting, Finance or Commerce (MBA/Mcom) is must. Minimum 10to 12 years of experience in Fixed Assets Accounting and Record to Report GA. Experience leading teams in a shared service, GBS, or multinational environment. Strong knowledge of working in SAP & FA Module. Use MEDDPICC and Salesforce to qualify renewals, call risk early, and maintain accurate pipeline, value, stage and close-date data. Build senior stakeholder access. Experience negotiating with institutional buying committees, procurement teams, public-sector authorities or channel partners. Strong command of structured sales methodology, preferably MEDDPICC, and disciplined Salesforce usage. Executive-level written and spoken English for senior correspondence and formal bid documentation. Experience in healthcare, health sciences education, medical publishing or clinical technology. Experience with distributors, public tenders, consortium purchasing or grant-funded institutional buying in South Asia or Southeast Asia.

Providing a high quality search experience is a unique challenge as Amazon expands to new customers, countries, categories, and product lines. This team’s charter is to increase the pace at which Amazon expands and improve the search experience at launch.
