description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Wellness Consultant to own and convert inbound enquiries for our recovery equipment portfolio.
 



 Leads come to you — your job is to qualify them with precision, understand the buyer's facility or training context deeply, and guide them to a confident purchase decision.
 



 This is not a cold\-calling role. It is a consultative, high\-touch sales seat where your familiarity with the wellness world is what earns the buyer's trust.
 



 Our buyers are gym owners, coaches, physiotherapists, hotel and spa wellness heads, and serious individual athletes. They speak the language of training, recovery and performance, and they buy from people who speak it back.
 



 If you have worked in this industry and care about where it is going, you start this role with an advantage no generalist salesperson can match.
 



 We will teach you the product and the protocols — what we cannot teach is genuine interest in wellness.
 



 This is a high\-ownership seat. You will own your numbers, your pipeline and your mistakes, with no one chasing you.
 



 It is demanding, and not everyone lasts. If that is the environment where you do your best work — and you want the recognition and the chance to make your name in the wellness and longevity industry — we want to talk to you.
 



  





**What you'll do \-** 



* Receive, qualify, and prioritise inbound enquiries across our product range — ice baths, infrared saunas, and red light therapy panels.
* Run discovery calls and video consultations to understand the buyer's space, member or client profile, use case, and decision timeline.
* Advise buyers on the right configuration for their facility or home setup, and explain the outcomes and protocols behind it credibly.
* Own the sales cycle end to end — qualification, proposal, follow\-up, negotiation, and order closure.
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records of every interaction, lead stage, and deal status in Zoho CRM.
* Coordinate with the installation and customer success team for a seamless post\-sale handover.
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities within inbound enquiries and existing accounts.
* Share structured feedback on lead quality, common objections, and buyer patterns with the marketing and product team.
* Represent Biotastic at gyms, industry events, trade shows, and wellness summits to build visibility and generate leads.
* Track competitor activity, pricing movements, and client feedback; share structured market intelligence with the team.



  





**What we are looking for \-** 



* **Industry background** 
 — you come from wellness, fitness or recovery in Chennai: a gym or fitness studio, a fitness or wellness equipment dealer, a physiotherapy or sports rehab centre, or a sports nutrition brand — Fitness One, Skale, O2 Health Studio, Anytime Fitness, Gold's Gym, ReLiva or similar. We are looking for the health and performance side of wellness, not beauty, salon or aesthetic services.
* **Genuine interest in health, fitness and recovery** 
 — you follow where this industry is going and can talk about it without being briefed first.
* **Sales, consultative, or client\-facing experience** 
 — years matter less than your track record of persuading people and closing. Be ready to substantiate with numbers or specifics.
* **Comfortable learning technical product detail** 
 — cold and heat exposure, recovery protocols, and what the evidence supports. We will train you on this.
* **Excellent communication and presentation skills** 
 in both English and Hindi.
* **Consultative selling instinct** 
 — you listen first, ask the right questions, and advise rather than push.
* **Comfortable with a CRM tool** 
 and willing to maintain rigorous daily data hygiene in Zoho CRM.



  





**Good to have \-** 



* Prior experience selling gym or fitness equipment, wellness services, memberships, or premium hospitality.
* Experience with high\-consideration purchases where the buyer needs education, trust, and time before committing.
* Experience selling capital equipment, turnkey installations, or premium experiential products.



  





**What we offer \-** 



* A front\-row seat in India's recovery and longevity category while it is still being built — and the recognition that comes with helping build it.
* A product portfolio that genuinely sells itself to the right buyers — premium, differentiated, and backed by science.
* Employee wellness benefits including gym subsidy, annual health checkup, and an AI upskilling budget.
* A fast\-moving, founder\-led environment with clear scope to grow into a regional or vertical leadership role

title: Account Manager
description:
**About Plum** 




  





 Welcome to Plum, where we take a step towards building the most trusted \& loved insurance \& healthcare provider for people \& companies, one step at a time, one person at a time. We got into this space when the founders, Saurabh \& Abhishek, felt that this industry was a unique combination of a large industry (100k Cr\+ Premiums), growing fast (20%\+ CAGR over past 20 years), where the customer experience was not close to what we could deliver using technology.
 



  





 Over the past 5 years, we have done what no one could expect to \- innovate, raise the customer experience bar while onboarding more than 4000 companies, 700,000 lives, 20 of India’s unicorns while delivering great value to our customers (our NPS is more than double the industry average).
 



  





 We are on a mission to provide the highest quality insurance and healthcare to 10 million lives by FY2030 through companies that care and are backed in our mission by Tiger Global and Peak XV Partners.
 



  





**About the team** 




  





 Plum’s Account Managers operate with 4 core principles:\-
 


1. **We exist to disrupt the insurance industry by raising the bar on customer experience.**


* The insurance world has a lot of ‘hairy problems’ \- over\-complicated systems, too much paperwork, low trust, too much fine print, too many hiding features
* We want to be the company that is a friendly insurance \& health partner not just a service provider, who just takes over, who are super easy to use and super smooth to work with


1. **We will learn from our customers \- We handle more diverse customers than you can imagine and from them our AMs learn and become rock\-stars.** 
 Our customers range from Large Global Capability Centres, Fast Growing Start Ups, niche enterprises like Aerospace\-focused companies, etc.
2. **We are a team which keeps trying to raise the bar in everything \- from quality of work, people growth to a culture of promoting from within**


* All our current team leaders started off as ICs in the past 2\-3 years and are now leading businesses of \> 20 Cr of Premiums’
* We aim to be the first insurance broker in India to manage 10,000 customers and want folks who build systems//processes to achieve this.



  





**About the role** 




  





 Having found product/market fit, we’re in the midst of transitioning from 'start\-up' to ‘scale\-up’. We are looking for builders, hackers and straight\-up hustlers to help us build something memorable. We’re looking for outstanding account managers who have consistently delivered high customer satisfaction, thrive in taking full ownership of delivering delight to customers and folks who are hungry to smash targets. We want people who want a run a mini business of your own
 



  





***Note: This role will be based in Bangalore for the first 6 months for training, after which it will transition to Mumbai as the full\-time base location.***




  





**Responsibilities** 



* You will manage a set of diverse accounts in an end\-to\-end manner, having 100% accountability of all the outcomes of that account \- from escalations to relationship building to retention and revenue.
* To get started, you would develop a good understanding of the product and work with different teams to make internal processes more efficient
* Once you build some credibility, you will also be responsible for cross\-selling and getting customer referrals to build your own book.



**Role Requirements** 



* Ideally 3\-5 years of experience in B2B sales and a customer\-facing role
* Very strong written and verbal communication and high numeric ability
* High customer empathy and extreme ownership
* Strong problem solver, can hustle to unblock customers
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams to resolve issues
* Strong adherence to SLAs and processes

 Verex Engineering LLC is a multi\-cloud solutions, engineering, and healthcare\-focused organization that helps businesses grow, increase efficiency, and prepare for the future through advanced technology services. The company specializes in managing applications and infrastructure across leading cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform in a cohesive, integrated manner. By solving more than workload problems, Verex Engineering LLC creates strategic business advantages that enable clients to work faster and smarter. Its multi\-cloud engineering services cover the full lifecycle of cloud projects, from consultation and assessment to deployment, migration, and ongoing management. The team follows industry best practices and uses advanced tools to ensure seamless integration, strong security, and compliance.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Sales Executive (Night Shift – US Process) based in Rajarhat. The Sales Executive will handle outbound and inbound sales calls, engage with prospective and existing clients in the US market, and promote the company’s multi\-cloud and engineering services. Daily responsibilities include lead generation, qualifying prospects, presenting service offerings, preparing basic proposals or quotations, and maintaining accurate records in CRM or sales tracking tools. The role also involves meeting individual and team sales targets, following up on inquiries, coordinating with internal technical and operations teams, and providing timely feedback from customers. The Sales Executive will work during night hours aligned with US business timings and is expected to join immediately.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, including clear spoken and written English and active listening abilities.
* Candidates should possess sales and customer engagement skills, such as lead generation, negotiation, relationship building, and closing techniques.
* Candidates should possess basic knowledge or interest in IT, cloud, or technology services, with the ability to understand and explain service offerings to clients.
* Candidates should possess organizational and time\-management skills, including accurate documentation, CRM usage, and the ability to handle multiple leads and tasks during night shifts.
* Candidates should possess adaptability and problem\-solving skills, including resilience in a target\-driven environment and the ability to respond to customer queries effectively.
* Prior experience in international voice process or US sales (B2B or B2C) is beneficial.
* Comfort with night shift work and on\-site presence in Rajarhat is required.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory if relevant experience is demonstrated.

About the Role

Atom Wellness is looking for **dynamic, target\-oriented and customer\-focused Sales Executives** to strengthen our presence in the **Ernakulam region**.

The selected candidate will be responsible for developing business across **hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, medical shops, retailers, distributors and healthcare institutions**.

Candidates with experience in **hospital sales, medical devices, surgical products, orthopaedic products, pharmaceutical sales or healthcare retail sales** will be preferred.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Hospital Sales

* Visit hospitals, clinics, nursing homes and healthcare institutions regularly.
* Develop relationships with **doctors, purchase managers, hospital administrators, biomedical teams, nurses and other key decision\-makers**.
* Promote Atom Wellness products and generate institutional business.
* Identify new hospital accounts and business opportunities.
* Conduct product presentations and demonstrations whenever required.
* Follow up on enquiries, quotations, purchase orders and pending requirements.
* Coordinate with the internal team and distributors for timely product supply.
* Develop long\-term relationships with hospital customers.
* Identify opportunities for surgical, orthopaedic, healthcare and wellness products.

2\. Retail Sales

* Generate regular orders and improve product availability.
* Introduce new products and schemes to retailers.
* Ensure proper product visibility and availability at retail outlets.
* Develop new retail customers and increase market coverage.
* Follow up on pending orders and stock requirements.
* Build strong relationships with retailers and distributors.
* Improve product penetration across the Ernakulam market.

* Focus on product\-wise and segment\-wise sales growth.
* Generate leads and convert them into regular business.
* Identify new market opportunities within the assigned territory.
* Follow up consistently until order conversion.
* Support new product launches and promotional activities.

* Monitor product availability and stock levels.
* Follow up on pending orders and supplies.

* Support distributor\-to\-retailer business expansion.

title: Senior Admissions Counselor
description:
**Sr. Academics Counselor \|\| Altera Institute \- Digiaccel Learning** 




  





 At Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute, we are on a mission to build the next generation of business leaders equipped for a digital and AI\-first world. Today, we are known in the industry for our deep education expertise in domains such as eCommerce, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Product \& AI. As a Program Expert in the Learner Success team, you will play a pivotal role in helping aspiring professionals make informed career decisions and unlock transformative learning opportunities.
 



  





 This is a learner\-centric role that goes beyond admissions and enrolments. You will serve as a trusted advisor and the first point of contact for prospective learners, understanding their career aspirations, professional challenges, and growth objectives. By guiding them towards the most suitable programs, you will help shape their educational journey and contribute directly to their long term career success.
 



  





 You will work closely with cross\-functional teams including Marketing, Product, Admissions, Career Services, and Academic Operations to ensure a seamless learner experience \- from the first interaction through onboarding and beyond. The ideal candidate is passionate about education, possesses strong interpersonal skills, and is motivated by creating meaningful impact in learners' lives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Learner Counselling \& Career Guidance** 



* Engage with prospective learners through calls, virtual meetings, emails, and other communication channels to understand their professional aspirations, learning needs, and career goals.
* Provide personalized guidance on Digiaccel and Altera programs, helping learners identify the most relevant learning pathways based on their background and objectives.
* Act as a trusted advisor throughout the decision\-making process, addressing queries and enabling learners to make informed educational investments.
* Build strong relationships with prospective learners by delivering a consultative and empathetic counselling experience.



**Admissions \& Onboarding Support** 



* Guide applicants through the admissions and enrolment journey, ensuring a smooth and positive onboarding experience.
* Support learners with application processes, documentation requirements, program information, and enrolment formalities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely communication and efficient resolution of learner concerns.
* Ensure every learner interaction reflects the organization’s commitment to quality, transparency, and learner success.



**Build vertical industry depth** 



* Build expertise of the Business education landscape, both at a postgraduate as well as executive level
* Identify advantages and disadvantages of different business education models and build conversational depth in how each model compares against the others.



**Learner Engagement \& Relationship Management** 



* Serve as a brand ambassador for Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute by effectively communicating the value proposition, program outcomes, and career impact of our offerings.
* Maintain consistent engagement with prospective learners through follow\-ups and personalized communication.
* Foster long\-term relationships that enhance learner trust, satisfaction, and advocacy.
* Capture learner feedback and insights to continuously improve the learner experience.



**Collaboration \& Process Excellence** 



* Work closely with Marketing, Product, Communications, and Academic teams to improve learner outreach, engagement, and conversion strategies.
* Maintain accurate learner records, pipeline updates, and interaction history through CRM systems and internal tools.
* Analyze learner feedback, market trends, and admission insights to contribute towards process improvements and operational excellence.
* Support organizational initiatives focused on enhancing learner outcomes and overall program experience.



**Performance \& Outcome Ownership** 



* Contribute towards enrolment and learner acquisition goals while maintaining a strong focus on ethics, learner satisfaction, and long\-term outcomes.
* Take ownership of individual performance metrics and continuously seek opportunities to improve effectiveness and impact.
* Demonstrate a learner\-first mindset in all interactions and decisions.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 1\-3\+ years of experience in learner counselling, admissions, sales, customer success, education, consulting, or other customer\-facing roles.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage and influence diverse audiences.
* A consultative and empathetic approach to understanding learner needs and guiding career decisions.
* Excellent relationship\-building and stakeholder management abilities.
* Strong ownership mindset with a results\-oriented approach.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, and dynamic environment.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, Microsoft Office, and digital communication platforms.
* Passion for education, career transformation, and learner success.
* A collaborative team player with a growth mindset and strong problem\-solving skills.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* **Make a Meaningful Impact:** 
 Be part of an organization that is redefining business education and helping professionals build future\-ready careers in the digital economy.
* **High\-Growth Learning Environment:** 
 Work with a fast\-scaling education company where ownership, innovation and excellence are valued and rewarded.
* **Learner\-Centric Culture:** 
 Join a team that places learner outcomes at the center of every decision and takes pride in delivering world\-class educational experiences.
* **Accelerated Career Growth** 
 Benefit from continuous learning opportunities, mentorship, structured development, and the ability to take on increasing responsibility as the organization grows.
* **Build the Future of Education:** 
 Contribute to a mission\-driven organization that is transforming how business education is delivered and creating measurable impact for thousands of learners across the country.



  





**About the Company** 




 Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.
 



  





 Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher\-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.
 



  





 This is exactly what we solve for at Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute.
 



  





 The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%\+ NPS across all programs since inception.
 



  





 Digiaccel Learning is VC backed and has CXOs and Founders of some of India’s top digital commerce companies as it’s investors.
 



  





 We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment.
 



  





 We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

**Panda Pedals \| EV Scooters \| Bangalore**

Panda Pedals is looking for a confident and responsible **Showroom Store Manager** who can take complete ownership of the day\-to\-day operations and sales performance of our electric scooter showroom.

This is not just a store supervision role.

We’re looking for someone who can manage customers, drive sales, follow up with leads, coordinate test rides and ensure every person walking into the showroom gets a great buying experience.

Your goal is simple:

**Run the showroom well and sell more scooters.**

What You’ll Do

* Manage the complete day\-to\-day operations of the showroom
* Attend to walk\-in customers and understand their requirements
* Explain Panda Pedals scooters, features, pricing and benefits clearly
* Conduct and coordinate test rides
* Convert showroom enquiries into sales
* Follow up with customers who have visited, enquired or taken a test ride
* Manage incoming leads from phone calls, WhatsApp, Google, website and marketing campaigns
* Maintain proper records of leads, follow\-ups and sales
* Coordinate scooter bookings, payments and deliveries
* Ensure scooters are displayed properly and the showroom is always presentable
* Maintain basic stock and inventory records
* Coordinate with the service and operations team when required
* Handle basic customer queries before and after purchase
* Ensure customers receive a smooth experience from enquiry to delivery
* Track daily and monthly sales performance
* Share regular updates with management

Sales Is a Major Part of This Role

We are looking for someone who is comfortable speaking with customers and closing sales.

You should be able to understand what the customer actually needs, explain the right scooter confidently and guide them towards making a purchase decision.

You should also be comfortable following up.

Many customers will not buy on their first visit.

Your ability to stay in touch, answer their questions and bring them back to the showroom will be an important part of the role.

What We’re Looking For

You should be:

* Confident and well\-spoken
* Comfortable dealing with customers face\-to\-face
* Good at sales and negotiation
* Comfortable following up on phone and WhatsApp
* Organised with leads and customer records
* Responsible and able to manage the showroom independently
* Presentable and professional
* Target\-oriented
* Comfortable working with daily and monthly sales goals
* Able to handle customer objections calmly
* Good at building trust with customers

You’ll Be a Strong Fit If

You enjoy talking to customers.

You can explain products without sounding scripted.

You know when to push for a sale and when to give the customer space.

You follow up consistently instead of waiting for customers to call back.

You take ownership of the showroom instead of waiting for someone to tell you what to do.

And when showroom sales are slow, your first thought is:

**“What can I do today to bring more customers back and close more deals?”**

Key ResponsibilitiesCustomer Experience

Ensure every customer entering the showroom is attended to properly and receives clear information about the scooters.

Lead Management

Track every enquiry and ensure there is a proper follow\-up until the customer buys or clearly declines.

Test Rides

Encourage interested customers to take test rides and ensure the experience is smooth and professional.

Sales

Work towards individual and showroom\-level monthly sales targets.

Showroom Management

Maintain cleanliness, scooter display, marketing material and overall presentation of the showroom.

Inventory

Keep track of available scooters, colours, variants and delivery\-ready vehicles.

Delivery Coordination

Ensure customers receive the correct vehicle and have a smooth handover experience.

What Your Performance Will Be Measured On

* Number of showroom walk\-ins handled
* Test rides conducted
* Lead follow\-up rate
* Walk\-in to test ride conversion
* Test ride to sale conversion
* Monthly scooter sales
* Lead response time
* Customer experience
* Showroom discipline and presentation

The objective is not simply to keep the showroom running.

The objective is to **make the showroom perform.**

Experience

**2 to 5 years preferred**

Previous experience in any of the following is an advantage:

* Automobile showroom sales
* Two\-wheeler sales
* EV sales
* Retail store management
* Automotive dealership
* Consumer electronics sales
* High\-value retail sales

Experience in the automobile industry is preferred, but strong sales ability and customer\-handling skills are more important.

Languages

Comfortable speaking in:

* English
* Kannada
* Hindi

Additional languages are an advantage.

Apply

Interested candidates can share their CV with Panda Pedals for consideration.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Bengaluru, Karnataka (Bengaluru, Bengaluru Urban District): Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Are you currently in Bangalore?

Work Location: In person

We are looking for an experienced **GeM Manager** to manage and grow our business through the **Government e\-Marketplace (GeM)**. * Follow up on pending payments and documentation with concerned departments.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of the **GeM Portal and government tendering process**.
* Experience in GeM bidding, reverse auctions, product listing, and order management.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel and reporting/MIS.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Good understanding of government procurement procedures.
* Ability to analyse tender eligibility, BOQ, specifications, and commercial terms.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.

Qualification

**General Information** 




**Role Title:** 
 Senior Recruiter / Senior Talent Partner

 Full\-Time, permanent
 



**Hiring Timeline:** 
 Immediate

 Talent Acquisition Lead

 Yes

 Open until Filled

 2:00 PM \- 11:00 PM IST
 



**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):** 




 Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high\-performance logistics operations.
 



 We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real\-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end\-to\-end supply chain execution.
 



 Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time\-to\-value and reduce delivery risk.
   





**Role Overview:** 



* The Senior Recruiter / Senior Talent Partner is responsible for delivering complex, high\-impact hiring while elevating the overall effectiveness of Fulfillment IQ's recruiting function.
* This role goes beyond filling roles. Senior Recruiters are expected to own hard\-to\-fill, specialist, or senior hires, improve hiring quality, speed, and decision discipline, and surface data\-backed insights that help the Talent Acquisition Lead optimize strategy, process, and capacity.
* This is a senior individual contributor role with significant influence, broad stakeholder exposure, and a clear path toward talent acquisition leadership.



**Mandate:** 



* Deliver successful outcomes on complex and high\-priority roles
* Improve recruiting quality, consistency, and decision\-making
* Act as a trusted hiring partner to senior stakeholders
* Use data and market insight to strengthen hiring strategy and execution



**Must Have:** 



* 7\-10 years of full\-cycle recruiting experience in consulting, technology, or services\-led environments
* Demonstrated success hiring for complex, niche, or senior roles
* Strong sourcing, assessment, and closing capability
* Proven ability to influence hiring managers and guide decisions
* Comfort working across regions, time zones, and seniority levels



**Market \& Domain Expertise:** 



* We are looking for an experienced recruiter with strong exposure to both the US and Canada markets.



**The ideal candidate should have:** 



* Hands\-on experience hiring across North America
* Strong understanding of US employment structures and tax terms (W2, C2C, 1099\)
* Working knowledge of work visa processes and compliance
* Familiarity with cross\-border hiring dynamics and talent availability



**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience hiring in supply chain, logistics, or enterprise technology domains
* Exposure to workforce planning or recruiting analytics
* Experience coaching or mentoring recruiters



**Key Responsibilities:**




**Complex \& High\-Impact Hiring** 



* Own full\-cycle recruiting for senior, niche, or hard\-to\-fill roles
* Lead intake sessions to define success profiles, competencies, and evaluation criteria
* Influence role scoping, leveling, and success metrics during intake based on market realities
* Open and post new job requisitions assigned to you across various hiring platforms and job boards
* Design sourcing strategies that balance speed, quality, and long\-term pipeline health



**Assessment \& Decision Quality** 



* Conduct structured interviews and guide hiring teams on consistent evaluation
* Facilitate debriefs and drive clear, timely hiring decisions
* Identify and resolve misalignment, bias, or indecision in the interview process



**Stakeholder Partnership** 



* Act as a trusted partner to senior hiring managers and functional leaders
* Advise on market realities, trade\-offs, and hiring feasibility
* Escalate risks, delays, or systemic issues to the TA Lead with proposed solutions
* Format Resumes for client‑specific requirements and coordinate with hiring managers to schedule client interview rounds (for client staff augmentation only)



**Process \& Performance Improvement**



* Analyze funnel performance, stage conversion, and candidate drop\-off
* Identify patterns impacting quality, speed, or candidate experience
* Partner with the TA Lead to test and implement process improvements



**Team Enablement** 



* Coach and support Recruiters through informal mentorship and calibration
* Share best practices in sourcing, interviewing, and closing
* Contribute to hiring playbooks, interview guides, and role templates



**Vendor Partnership \& Vendor Management:** 



* Act as the primary SPOC for external vendors, ensuring alignment on role requirements, hiring timelines, and evaluation criteria
* Share job specifications and coordinate resume submissions, interview scheduling, and candidate progress across stages
* Partner with hiring managers, the Talent Intelligence team, and external recruiters to secure offers from successful candidates



**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:** 




**30 Days In**



* Build a deep understanding of Fulfillment IQ's business, roles, and hiring priorities
* Take ownership of assigned complex or priority roles
* Establish trust with hiring managers and the TA team



**60 Days In**



* Demonstrate consistent progress and momentum on complex hires
* Improve interview quality and decision speed on assigned roles
* Begin surfacing funnel insights and improvement opportunities



**90 Days In**



* Successfully close multiple high\-impact or difficult roles
* Contribute measurable improvements to hiring efficiency or quality
* Be recognized as a trusted advisor by hiring leaders and TA leadership



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):** 



* Closure rate on complex or priority roles
* Time\-to\-hire and stage aging on assigned requisitions
* Time\-to\-fill on assigned requisitions
* Interview\-to\-offer and offer acceptance rates
* Hiring manager satisfaction
* Contribution to funnel and process improvements
* Probation Pass Rate
* Preboarding Candidate Satisfaction survey scores



**Why You'll Love Working Here:** 




 At Fulfillment IQ, we don't just build supply chain solutions; we build long\-term careers.
   

 We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you're leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.
 



 We operate with a high\-trust, high\-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.
 



 Here's what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:
 



**Work That Matters**
 You'll help solve real operational challenges that directly impact global commerce, customer experience, and supply chain performance.
 



**Career Growth That Matters**
 We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning — supporting both vertical growth and long\-term career progression.
 



**Flexibility to Thrive**
 We support remote and hybrid work models, flexible schedules, and trust our teams to manage their time responsibly.
 



**We Celebrate Impact**
 From project wins to personal milestones, we recognize contribution, celebrate progress, and value consistency over heroics.
 



**A Collaborative Culture**
 You'll work alongside experienced consultants, engineers, product leaders, and commercial professionals who value ownership, transparency, and high standards.
   





**Perks you'll appreciate:**

AI supports human reviewers and does not make hiring decisions on its own. Final hiring decisions are made by FIQ personnel. If you have questions about how AI is used in this process, contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

Consistent with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, accommodations are available on request at any stage of recruitment and assessment. Contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com and we will work with you to meet your needs.

This includes the use of AI\-assisted screening described above and cross\-border storage or processing that may occur in the United States. By applying, you acknowledge this notice. We provide equal opportunity in line with the Constitution of India and consider all qualified applicants without regard to religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth, disability, or any other characteristic protected under applicable Indian law.

 FIQ maintains a safe and respectful workplace and complies with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH). title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**HR Generalist** 




  





 At BlueMatrix, our people are at the core of everything we do. As we continue to grow our presence across the Asia\-Pacific region, we’re looking for a people\-focused HR professional who is eager to make a real impact. In this role, you will support the full employee lifecycle across multiple APAC locations, working closely with managers and employees to foster a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing workplace. You’ll collaborate with a global HR team, gain exposure to diverse labor markets, and play a hands\-on role in shaping the employee experience across the region. If you thrive in a dynamic environment and enjoy balancing operational HR work with strategic thinking, this is the role for you.
 



  





**OBJECTIVES OF THE ROLE** 



* Act as a trusted HR point of contact for employees and managers across APAC, providing guidance on HR policies, processes, and best practices
* Support the full employee lifecycle, from onboarding and development to performance management and offboarding
* Ensure HR operations are compliant with local labor laws and regulations across APAC jurisdictions
* Contribute to building a consistent and engaging employee experience aligned with BlueMatrix’s global culture
* Partner with the global HR team to roll out company\-wide initiatives and adapt them to regional needs
* Use HR data and insights to identify trends and support informed decision\-making



  





**DAILY AND MONTHLY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Manage end\-to\-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth and welcoming experience for new hires across APAC
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records in the HRIS system, ensuring data integrity and confidentiality
* Support recruitment efforts by coordinating interviews, liaising with hiring managers, and managing candidate communications
* Assist in the administration of performance review cycles, including tracking timelines, preparing materials, and supporting managers through the process
* Respond to employee queries regarding contracts, benefits, leave entitlements, and HR policies in a timely and professional manner
* Coordinate with local payroll providers and finance teams to ensure accurate and on\-time payroll processing
* Track and report on key HR metrics such as headcount, attrition, and time\-to\-hire on a regular basis
* Support the planning and execution of employee engagement initiatives, surveys, and regional team events
* Assist in drafting and updating HR policies and documentation to reflect local legal requirements and company standards
* Liaise with external partners, including recruitment agencies, benefits providers, and legal advisors, as needed



  





**WHAT YOU BRING** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
* Solid understanding of HR fundamentals, including recruitment, employee relations, performance management, and HR compliance
* Familiarity with labor laws and employment regulations in at least one APAC jurisdiction (e.g., Philippines, India, Japan, Australia, New Zealand)
* Experience working with HRIS platforms and applicant tracking systems
* Proficiency in MS Office / Microsoft 365, including Excel for HR reporting and data analysis
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in an additional APAC language is a plus
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion
* Comfortable working across time zones and collaborating with remote and distributed teams



  





**EXTRA SKILLS THAT MAKE YOU STAND OUT** 



* Genuine curiosity about people and a proactive approach to understanding employee needs
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Adaptability and comfort navigating ambiguity in a fast\-growing, international environment
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to build trusted relationships across all levels of the organization
* Continuous learning orientation and openness to developing expertise in new HR domains



  





**WHO WE ARE \& WHAT WE DO** 




 At BlueMatrix, we build cutting\-edge web applications that power the authoring, distribution, and analysis of investment research. Our solutions also support internal knowledge management and digital communications, streamlining the publishing process on a global scale. We’re not just developing software, we’re redefining the way financial insights are created and shared.
 



  





**WHY JOIN BLUEMATRIX?** 




 We’re a team of ambitious, passionate innovators who have transformed technology development and client service into an art. Many of us have spent years growing the BlueMatrix brand and shaping the investment research landscape.
 



 With offices in North America, Canada, Europe, and the APAC region, we collaborate across continents, bringing together diverse perspectives to drive innovation and impact in the financial technology space.
 



 This position supports our APAC region. The role is open to fully remote candidates within the region.
 



 If you’re ready to be part of something game\-changing, we’d love to have you on board!

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**Position : Head of HR – VALUELINE Group** 




**Location : Hyderabad** 




**Language : Telugu (Mandatory) \+ English \+ Hindi** 




**Industry Type : Manufacturing \& Trading** 




**Working Days : 6 days a week** 




**Salary budget : Upto 24LPA** 




  





  





**Role Objective** 




 The Head of HR will lead the complete Human Resources function of Valueline Group across all business verticals and locations. The role will have end\-to\-end ownership of
 **HR strategy, manpower planning, recruitment, employee lifecycle, performance management, policies, compliance, employee engagement, organizational development and HR systems** 
 .
 



 The role will work closely with Management and Business Heads to ensure the organization has the right people, structure, culture, systems and capabilities to support sustainable growth.}
 



  





**1\. HR Strategy \& Organizational Development** 



* Develop and implement the Group HR strategy aligned with business objectives and growth plans.
* Establish scalable HR systems, processes and governance across locations and entities.
* Partner with Management and Business Heads on organizational structure, manpower planning and people strategy.
* Review organizational effectiveness, reporting structures and manpower deployment.
* Build a culture of performance, ownership, accountability and professionalism.
* Develop succession, retention and leadership development strategies.
* Act as a strategic HR advisor to Management and senior leadership.



  





**2\. Manpower Planning \& Recruitment** 



* Own Group\-wide manpower planning and approved manpower budgets.
* Identify current and future manpower requirements in coordination with Business and Department Heads.
* Standardize Job Descriptions, KRAs and competency requirements.
* Lead recruitment for critical, managerial and leadership positions.
* Establish effective sourcing channels and talent pipelines.
* Ensure quality of hire, recruitment turnaround time and cost\-effective hiring.
* Strengthen employer branding and talent attraction.
* Ensure timely onboarding against approved requirements.



  





**3\. Employee Lifecycle \& HR Operations** 



* Establish standardized processes covering the complete employee lifecycle.
* Oversee joining, documentation, verification, induction, confirmation, transfers, promotions and employee records.
* Ensure timely issuance of appointment letters, contracts and HR documentation.
* Maintain accurate, confidential and up\-to\-date personnel records.
* Ensure consistency of HR practices across all Group locations.



  





**4\. Payroll, Attendance \& HRMS** 



* Oversee monthly payroll to ensure accuracy and timely processing.
* Establish controls for attendance, leave, overtime, incentives and payroll inputs.
* Coordinate with Finance for salary processing and statutory deductions.
* Ensure effective implementation and utilization of HRMS for attendance, leave, payroll, records and reimbursements.
* Resolve recurring payroll and attendance issues through process improvements.
* Ensure HR data accuracy, security and confidentiality.



  





**5\. Statutory \& Labour Law Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Oversee PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, Bonus, Gratuity and other applicable compliances.
* Ensure timely filings, payments, registers and statutory documentation.
* Coordinate with consultants, auditors, legal advisors and authorities when required.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and periodic audit mechanism.
* Keep Management informed of material changes in labour laws and associated risks.
* Ensure appropriate labour and HR documentation across offices, warehouses, fabrication units and project locations.



  





**6\. Performance Management** 



* Own and drive the Group Performance Management System (PMS).
* Establish KRAs, KPIs and performance evaluation frameworks.
* Ensure timely goal setting, reviews and appraisals.
* Partner with managers to ensure objective and measurable performance assessment.
* Support Performance Improvement Plans for underperforming employees.
* Ensure increments, promotions and career progression are linked to performance and organizational requirements.
* Establish mechanisms to identify and reward high performers.



  





**7\. Talent, Training \& Leadership Development** 



* Identify capability gaps and future talent requirements.
* Develop annual training and development plans.
* Coordinate internal and external training and evaluate effectiveness.
* Develop leadership programs for managers and high\-potential employees.
* Establish career progression and competency frameworks.
* Develop succession plans for critical positions and internal talent pipelines.



  





**8\. Employee Relations, Discipline \& Culture** 



* Act as the senior escalation point for employee relations matters.
* Establish a professional, transparent and accountable workplace culture.
* Oversee grievance resolution and disciplinary processes in accordance with Company policy and applicable law.
* Ensure consistency and fairness in disciplinary action across locations.
* Address behavioural, attendance, performance and policy violations proactively.
* Partner with Business Heads to reinforce discipline, accountability and professional conduct.
* Maintain appropriate documentation of employee relations and disciplinary matters.



  





**9\. HR Policies, SOPs \& Governance** 



* Develop, implement and periodically review Group HR policies, SOPs and guidelines.
* Standardize HR practices across Group entities and locations.
* Maintain the Employee Handbook and HR Guidelines.
* Establish clear frameworks for attendance, leave, WFH, travel, reimbursements, promotions, transfers, performance and employee conduct.
* Ensure employees and managers understand and follow policies.
* Continuously identify process gaps and improve HR systems and controls.



  





**10\. Compensation, Benefits \& Employee Welfare** 



* Develop appropriate compensation structures in consultation with Management.
* Conduct salary benchmarking and internal parity reviews.
* Support annual increment, promotion and compensation planning.
* Ensure compensation decisions consider performance, role responsibility, market benchmarks and business affordability.
* Monitor manpower and HR costs against approved budgets.
* Oversee employee benefits, insurance and welfare initiatives.
* Develop employee recognition and engagement programs.



  





**11\. Separation, Exit \& Full \& Final Settlement** 



* Oversee resignations, notice periods, handovers, clearances and exits.
* Conduct structured exit interviews and analyze attrition trends.
* Coordinate timely Full \& Final Settlement.
* Ensure timely issuance of relieving letters, experience certificates and other exit documentation.
* Develop corrective measures to improve retention.



  





**12\. HR MIS, Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Establish a robust Group HR MIS and reporting framework.
* Provide Management with regular reports covering headcount, manpower cost, recruitment, attrition, attendance, leave, payroll, performance, training, grievances, disciplinary matters and open positions.
* Use HR analytics to identify trends, risks and areas requiring intervention.
* Provide data\-backed recommendations to Management.
* Maintain complete confidentiality of employee information.



  





**13\. Multi\-Location \& Project HR** 



* Oversee HR requirements across offices, showrooms, warehouses, fabrication units and project/site locations.
* Ensure appropriate manpower deployment, attendance and documentation.
* Coordinate site\-related accommodation, travel, welfare and employee requirements where applicable.
* Ensure labour\-law and safety\-related HR documentation at operational locations.
* Maintain consistent HR standards while addressing local requirements.



  





**14\. HR Team Leadership** 



* Lead, mentor and develop the Group HR team.
* Define clear roles, KRAs and accountability for HR team members.
* Establish HR service standards, review mechanisms and escalation processes.
* Build a proactive HR function capable of independently managing routine operations.
* Review HR team performance and continuously strengthen HR capabilities.



  





**15\. Management Partnership \& Confidentiality** 



* Serve as a trusted HR partner to Management and senior leadership.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of employee, compensation, disciplinary and business\-sensitive information.
* Escalate critical employee, legal, compliance and organizational risks promptly.
* Provide objective, fact\-based recommendations on people decisions.
* Support Management during expansion, restructuring, change management and other strategic initiatives.

description:
Location: Mumbai (Work from office)
 



  





**About Emeritus:** 




  





 Emeritus is committed to teaching the skills of the future by making high\-quality education accessible and affordable to individuals, companies, and governments around the world. It does this by collaborating with more than 90 top\-tier universities across the United States, Europe, Latin America, Southeast Asia, India and China. Emeritus’ short courses, degree programs, professional certificates, and senior executive programs help individuals learn new skills and transform their lives, companies, and organizations. Its unique model of state\-of\-the\-art technology, curriculum innovation, and hands\-on instruction from senior faculty, mentors and coaches has educated more than 250,000 individuals across 80\+ countries. Founded in 2015, Emeritus, part of Eruditus Group, has more than 2,000 employees globally and offices in Mumbai, New Delhi, Singapore, Palo Alto, Mexico City, New York, Boston, London, and Dubai. Following multiple funding rounds, including a $650 million Series E round in 2021 and a $150 million Series F round in 2024 led by TPG, the company is valued at approximately \~$3 billion and is backed by Accel, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, CPP Investments, and other leading global investors.

Key Responsibilities

**Experience**

 ● 2\+ years of experience at Management Consulting firms or in a CHRO's Office role driving strategic initiatives and cross\-functional execution.
 



 ● Demonstrated experience managing high\-impact, cross\-functional strategic initiatives in fast\-paced environments.

Head of Human Resources
description:
Head of Human Resources
 
**Company:** 
 10x Global
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Gurgaon
 



**Reporting to:** 
 CEO
 



**Experience:** 
 8–12 years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 


 About 10x Global
 
 10x Global is a global business advisory platform helping companies
 **enter, operate and scale across markets** 
 . With teams and operations across India, UAE, Singapore and the US, we work with ambitious founders, startups, multinational businesses and investors on market entry, tax, finance, compliance, transactions and strategic growth.
 



 As we scale, we are looking for a
 **Head of Human Resources** 
 to build the people function into a genuine strategic advantage for the organisation.
 


 The Role
 
 This is not a traditional HR administration role.
 



 You will own the entire employee lifecycle — from
 **hiring and onboarding to performance, culture, development, compensation and exits** 
 — while building the systems and processes required for a high\-performance, entrepreneurial organisation.
 



 The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable:
 


* Building HR strategy
* Hiring exceptional people
* Fixing broken processes
* Managing employee issues
* Driving performance
* Building culture
* Working directly with partners and the CEO
* Using data to identify and solve people problems



 You will be the
 **custodian of the 10x Global culture and employee experience** 
 .
 


 Key Responsibilities1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
 * Own the end\-to\-end recruitment function across India and international offices.
* Build hiring plans aligned with business growth and revenue targets.
* Develop strong talent pipelines for critical roles across consulting, tax, finance, legal, technology, sales, marketing and operations.
* Improve quality and speed of hiring while maintaining high hiring standards.
* Build structured interview frameworks and assessment processes.
* Establish relationships with executive search firms, recruitment partners, campuses and talent networks.
* Develop a strong employer brand for 10x Global.
* Ensure every new hire has clear role expectations, KPIs and a defined onboarding plan.



**Success metric:** 
 Right people, hired quickly, into the right roles.
 


 2\. Performance Management
 
 Build a
 **high\-performance culture** 
 where people know what is expected of them.
 


* Design and implement a company\-wide performance management framework.
* Establish KRAs/KPIs for every function and role.
* Run quarterly performance reviews and annual appraisal cycles.
* Build mechanisms for continuous feedback rather than annual\-only reviews.
* Work with managers to identify underperformance early.
* Create structured Performance Improvement Plans where required.
* Identify high performers and build accelerated growth plans for them.
* Ensure compensation, promotions and career progression are linked to performance.



**Core principle:** 
 No ambiguity around performance.
 


 3\. Employee Engagement \& Culture
 
 Take ownership of making 10x Global a place where ambitious people
 **want to work and grow** 
 .
 


* Build initiatives to improve employee engagement and morale.
* Regularly measure employee sentiment through surveys, 1:1s and structured feedback.
* Identify cultural issues before they become attrition problems.
* Build a strong internal communication cadence.
* Design employee recognition programmes.
* Drive team\-building, town halls, offsites and cultural initiatives.
* Create an environment that is ambitious, energetic, entrepreneurial and collaborative.
* Ensure employees feel heard while maintaining high organisational standards.



 You will be expected to answer one fundamental question:
 



**"Why should a great person want to spend the next five years at 10x Global?"** 



 4\. Compensation \& Benefits
 * Build and maintain a competitive compensation philosophy.
* Conduct periodic market benchmarking.
* Develop salary bands by role and level.
* Establish clear promotion and compensation frameworks.
* Manage annual increments, bonuses and incentive programmes.
* Design performance\-linked compensation structures.
* Review benefits and employee welfare programmes.
* Ensure internal equity across teams and geographies.


 5\. Learning \& Career Development
 
 Build a culture of continuous learning.
 


* Create career paths for major functions.
* Establish competency frameworks by level.
* Identify skill gaps across teams.
* Build internal and external training programmes.
* Develop leadership programmes for managers and future leaders.
* Create structured onboarding and 30/60/90\-day programmes.
* Encourage internal mobility and cross\-functional exposure.
* Build succession plans for critical positions.


 6\. HR Operations \& Systems
 
 Professionalise the HR infrastructure of the company.
 


* Establish clear HR policies, SOPs and processes.
* Implement/optimise HRMS and employee records.
* Digitise leave, attendance, payroll coordination, performance and documentation.
* Ensure accurate employee data and HR reporting.
* Establish clear SLAs for HR queries and employee requests.
* Build a central HR dashboard for management.
* Ensure statutory and employment compliance across relevant jurisdictions.
* Work closely with finance and external advisors on payroll and employment matters.



**Objective:** 
 HR should become predictable, process\-driven and data\-led.
 


 7\. Employee Relations
 
 Act as a trusted but objective point of contact for employees and leadership.
 


* Handle employee grievances and workplace conflicts.
* Investigate sensitive employee matters objectively.
* Support managers in difficult people decisions.
* Manage disciplinary processes where required.
* Conduct exit interviews and identify recurring organisational issues.
* Ensure consistent application of company policies.
* Maintain confidentiality and professional judgement in sensitive matters.


 8\. HR Analytics \& Management Reporting
 
 Move HR from
 **administration to intelligence** 
 .
 



 Build a monthly HR dashboard covering:
 


* Headcount
* Hiring pipeline
* Time\-to\-hire
* Cost\-to\-hire
* Attrition
* Voluntary vs involuntary exits
* Employee tenure
* Performance distribution
* Compensation
* Absenteeism
* Engagement scores
* Open positions
* Hiring plan vs actual
* Revenue/headcount and productivity metrics



 Provide the CEO and leadership team with
 **actionable insights** 
 , not just reports.
 


 Strategic Responsibilities
 
 As a member of the leadership team, you will also contribute to:
 


* Organisation design
* Workforce planning
* New geography expansion
* Leadership hiring
* Succession planning
* Culture design
* M\&A / integration\-related people matters
* Building international HR infrastructure
* Employer branding
* Organisation\-wide transformation initiatives


 What We Are Looking ForMust Have
 * 8–12 years of progressive HR experience.
* Experience managing HR for a high\-growth organisation.
* Strong understanding of talent acquisition, performance management and employee relations.
* Demonstrated ability to build HR systems from the ground up.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong business understanding — you should understand how the company makes money, not just how HR works.
* High ownership and execution orientation.
* Ability to operate independently in an entrepreneurial environment.


 Strongly Preferred
 * Experience in consulting, professional services, financial services, technology or a high\-growth startup.
* Experience managing multi\-location or international teams.
* Experience working directly with founders/CEOs.
* Experience implementing an HRMS.
* Experience designing performance and compensation frameworks.


 The Ideal Personality
 
 We are looking for someone who is:
 



**High ownership** 
 — doesn't wait to be told what to do.
 



**High empathy, high standards** 
 — cares deeply about people without compromising performance.
 



**Commercially minded** 
 — understands that people decisions ultimately affect growth and profitability.
 



**Hands\-on** 
 — willing to personally solve problems rather than delegate everything.
 



**Data\-driven** 
 — uses evidence rather than anecdotes to make HR decisions.
 



**Discreet and trustworthy** 
 — comfortable handling highly sensitive information.
 



**Energetic** 
 — capable of bringing life and momentum into the organisation.
 



**Firm when required** 
 — capable of having difficult conversations with employees and senior leadership.
 


 First 90 DaysFirst 30 Days — Diagnose
 * Meet every functional leader.
* Understand organisation structure and reporting lines.
* Review current employees, open positions and hiring pipeline.
* Audit existing HR policies and processes.
* Analyse attrition and employee feedback.
* Identify immediate people risks.
* Establish baseline HR metrics.


 Days 31–60 — Build
 * Introduce HR operating calendar.
* Establish hiring process and recruitment SLAs.
* Define performance\-management framework.
* Create HR dashboard.
* Fix critical HR process gaps.
* Establish employee communication cadence.
* Begin compensation benchmarking.


 Days 61–90 — Transform
 * Launch performance framework.
* Implement career levels and role expectations.
* Launch engagement programme.
* Build annual workforce plan.
* Establish talent\-review process.
* Present a
 **12\-month People Strategy** 
 to the CEO.


 KPIs for the Role
 
 The Head of HR will ultimately be measured on:
 


1. **Quality of hiring**
2. **Time\-to\-hire**
3. **Employee retention**
4. **Employee engagement**
5. **Performance\-management effectiveness**
6. **Manager effectiveness**
7. **HR process efficiency**
8. **Employee satisfaction with HR**
9. **Leadership/talent pipeline**
10. **People productivity**


 The ultimate objective:
 
**Build a high\-performance organisation where great people join, perform, grow and stay — while making HR scalable enough to support 10x Global's next phase of growth.**

title: City Director, Kolkata
description:
**Position Summary** 




 The City Director (CD) plays a critical role in unleashing the potential and power of a local movement for educational equity in this metropolis. This individual creates and shapes a vision for the city that is rooted in the local context and develops a long\-term strategy that will fully realise the regional vision. The City Director, therefore, has a five\-fold charge:
 


1. Ensuring that Teach For India Fellows are not only driving transformational outcomes for children in classrooms, but that they’re growing as leaders.
2. Fostering a local, growing Alumni movement that is committed to providing all children an excellent education.
3. Building a local, enduring institution that promotes sustainable funding, talent, and operations – including assembling effective teams and resources, coaching talent to outcomes and leading the site rooted in strong culture
4. Serving as a critical organisational leader for operations that span Teach For India’s vision and mission.
5. Co\-creating the strategy \& roadmap to serve 1 in 10 children from low income communities in the city.



 To achieve that five\-fold charge, the CD works closely with the local program team to create an ecosystem of support for Fellows that enables them to be successful in their roles as teachers and future leaders of the movement. The CD also works to foster a sense of community among Alumni in the city and mobilises them towards shared goals, while also building partnerships with a range of government, corporate, and civil society players to catalyse systemic impact and ensure the long\-term sustainability of our efforts. Last but not least, the CD plays an integral role in building the capability and commitment of members of the City Operations team to contribute to our mission in the long\-term.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\. Envision, develop and update a contextualized vision for Teach For India’s operations in the city:** 



* Articulate a vision for the city that is rooted in the local context, yet directly aligned to Teach For India's larger national movement
* Phase out the city vision into a short\-mid\-and long term roadmap, with clearly defined goals and measures for success
* Build investment and ownership among Staff, Fellows, Alumni, \& Partners in the vision and goals.



**2\. Develop a strategic and operational plan that is designed to realise the vision:** 



* Design a strategic plan that effectively sets priorities, searches for innovative paths and best practices, and accounts for regional uncertainties and externalities.
* Design short\-term tactical plans to mobilise resources and guide a team to outcomes in the short\-and\-mid term



**3\. Manage the Executive Team in the city:** 



* Establish and/or strengthen infrastructure needed to maximize performance and operations of both talent and resources (processes, structure, systems, communication)
* Select, mentor and develop a group of your direct reports (managees) that is composed of the right skills, knowledge, and mindsets needed to advance transformational progress for children through the City roadmap.
* Build a systematic approach to people development to ensure that team members across the site are growing, performing and flourishing
* Establish clear accountability, decision making responsibilities, and performance expectations that are aligned to the strategic plan



**4\. Build relationships with key partners and stakeholders to foster collective impact and ensure long\-term sustainability:** 



* Build the site into a sustainable organisation rooted in local funding and talent
* Develop the operational infrastructure to enable scale and efficiency
* Engage with local networks, Alumni, education sector stakeholders to make Teach For India a strong voice in regional communities of practice
* Build, engage and strengthen a strong advisory board
* Play a front\-facing role in local fundraising efforts and capacities



**5\. Manage a growing team towards short\-term outcomes and long\-term success:** 



* Manage city vertical leads that span Program, Partnerships (Alumni \& Government) and People (Recruitment, HR, Job Placements, etc.)
* Design systems and processes to manage progress and people across layers
* Build and execute a strong performance management plan to ensure progress



**6\. Establish and uphold a strong culture of inspiration, honesty, support, and accountability among team members:** 



* Foster an internal team culture that is rooted in our organisational values.
* Model culture both internally and externally.
* Build on\-going relationships with our internal community



**7\. Collaborate with teams across clusters at Teach For India (People, Impact \& Operations, Movement Building, Regions, Office of the Senior Leadership team).** 




  





**Additional Responsibilities** 




**As a member of the Leadership team:** 



* Providing feedback on organisational decision\-making and long\-term strategy as a member of the Leadership Team.
* Driving internal alignment and support for Teach For India’s core Programs.
* Serving as an ambassador of the Teach For India brand and an advocate for our work and for educational equity in our country through both internal and external communication.
* Supporting key organisational areas such as Recruitment, Selection, Fundraising, Movement Building, and Alumni Engagement.
* Over time, supporting Teach For India’s Alumni and other external organisations in their journey to our vision with organisational insights.



  





**Minimum Qualifications, Experiences and Expectations** 



* A Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in any field with 8\+ years of relevant work experience
* Previous experience managing large projects and teams to successful outcomes
* Previous teaching/education experience would be an added advantage
* Strategic and critical thinking skills so as to conceptualise multiple approaches to solving a problem and draw out a clear roadmap with roles and responsibilities
* Relationship\-building and networking skills so as to connect individuals, groups, and partners with shared goals
* Influencing and persuasion skills so as to leverage people and relationships to outcomes
* Communication skills so as to deliver a compelling message through oral and written mediums to diverse stakeholders
* People management skills so as to manage diverse teams to outcomes
* Ability to be resourceful and entrepreneurial in the face of uncertainty
* Proficiency in analysing data and making inferences to drive strategies and decisions
* Understanding of Teach For India’s short\-term and long\-term theory of change
* Understanding of Teach For India’s leadership development philosophy and framework

description:
**About Target Plus**
 Target is an iconic Fortune 50 retailer and one of America’s leading retail brands. Target Plus is Target’s curated, invite\-only marketplace, connecting guests with trusted brands and partners.
   

  

 The Partner Onboarding team plays a critical role in enabling partners to successfully launch on Target Plus through a seamless, scalable, and high\-quality onboarding experience.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Manager, Partner Onboarding, you will lead and develop a team responsible for delivering consistent and high\-quality onboarding support for Target Plus partners.
   

  

 This is primarily a people and operations leadership role, focused on building team capability and running a scalable, high\-performing onboarding operation. You will own day\-to\-day team execution, operational performance, partner support, quality, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will bring strong onboarding practitioner expertise to coach the team, develop talent, improve quality, and strengthen operational performance. You will work closely with U.S.\-based functional leaders and cross\-functional teams to execute against established priorities and within the global onboarding operating model.
   

  

 U.S.\-based functional leaders own the broader onboarding strategy, priorities, and operating model. This role will influence through deep onboarding expertise, operational insights, and strong execution, while translating those priorities into consistent, high\-quality team performance.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a strong people leader and onboarding practitioner who is energized by building teams, developing talent, and driving operational excellence at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of onboarding professionals, with clear expectations around performance, quality, and partner experience.
* Own day\-to\-day operations including workload management, capacity planning, SLA adherence, backlog, and partner follow\-ups.
* Ensure consistent execution of onboarding playbooks, processes, quality standards, and escalation paths.
* Use onboarding expertise to coach the team on the work, identify capability gaps, and drive learning and training to strengthen team performance.
* Monitor onboarding performance, including SLAs, quality, NPS/PSAT, and operational metrics, and proactively identify risks, delays, and opportunities to improve partner experience and speed to launch.
* Serve as the first escalation point for complex partner and operational issues, ensuring timely and appropriate escalation to U.S. onboarding and cross\-functional teams.
* Partner closely with U.S.\-based functional leaders, Product, Technology, Category, Acquisition, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless execution.
* Use data and operational insights to identify trends, improve processes, and drive continuous improvement.
* Build strong operating rhythms around performance reviews, quality calibration, issue resolution, and team development.
* Provide practitioner insights and feedback to U.S.\-based functional leaders to help continuously improve and scale the onboarding operation.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 8\+ years of experience in digital/e\-commerce or marketplace onboarding, operations, partner/customer experience, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams.
* Strong hands\-on onboarding expertise, including experience with partner onboarding, learning and training, quality, SLAs, NPS/PSAT, and scaled operations.
* Ability to coach teams on functional work, develop talent, and raise overall team capability.
* Strong operational and analytical skills with experience managing workflows, performance, quality, and SLAs.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly in a global environment.
* Strong problem\-solving, judgment, and escalation management capabilities.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset with a focus on outcomes and accountability.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, evolving environment and work effectively within a global operating model.
* Experience in e\-commerce, retail, marketplaces, or partner onboarding is required.

title: SharePoint Support Specialist [T500-29192]
description:
**About Stolt\-Nielsen:** 




 Stolt\-Nielsen is a family\-founded global leader in bulk\-liquid and chemical logistics, transportation, and storage, known for its commitment to safety, service excellence, and innovation. At the Stolt\-Nielsen Digital Innovation Centre, we bring this legacy into the future — building smarter systems, driving digital transformation, and shaping what's next for the world of logistics. Here, you’re encouraged to think boldly, challenge convention, and help move today’s products toward tomorrow’s possibilities.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As a SharePoint Support Specialist at Stolt\-Nielsen, you will be the first point of contact for SharePoint Online issues across the organisation, providing responsive P1 and P2 support and ensuring the platform runs smoothly day to day. You will manage site provisioning, permissions, lifecycle management, and the integration touchpoints between SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 applications.
 



 This role combines operational support with hands\-on administration, and requires strong problem\-solving ability and clear communication, since you will frequently be the one translating technical permission structures into plain language for end users and stakeholders. You will handle site creation and decommissioning, manage permissions and access reviews across multiple levels of the SharePoint and OneDrive environment, execute lifecycle management tasks (inactive site detection, owner attestation follow\-ups, archival), and support minor customization requests.
 



 You will work within a small, focused SharePoint team alongside a Team Lead and Senior Developer, with real opportunity to improve your technical skills over time.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Provide P1 and P2 support for all SharePoint Online issues across the organisation, acting as the first point of contact for end users.
* Manage day\-to\-day site provisioning, configuration, and decommissioning in line with governance policies.
* Administer permissions across all levels of the environment, including:
* Site\-level and sub\-site permissions
* Ownership assignment and transfer
* Guest\-level (external user) permissions and access reviews
* Folder\- and item\-level (unique) permissions
* OneDrive\-level sharing and access permissions
* Security group membership and Microsoft 365 group permissions
* Diagnose and resolve permission\-related issues logically and systematically, tracing access problems back to their root cause (e.g. broken inheritance, conflicting group membership, expired guest access) rather than applying quick fixes.
* Execute lifecycle management tasks including inactive site detection, owner attestation follow\-ups, and archival processes.
* Support integration touchpoints between SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 applications such as Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, and Viva Engage.
* Log, track, and report on support tickets; maintain SLA compliance and provide regular reporting on ticket volumes and resolution times.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with end users and stakeholders — explaining permission issues, timelines, and resolutions in an accessible, non\-technical way.
* Handle minor customisation requests such as page layouts, list configurations, and basic workflow adjustments.
* Assist with permission audits and access reviews in support of governance and compliance requirements.
* Maintain clear, well\-structured documentation for support procedures, known issues, permission models, and environment configurations.
* Perform additional duties and projects as assigned.



  





**What You'll Bring:** 



* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in SharePoint Online administration within a Microsoft 365 enterprise environment.
* Strong, demonstrable understanding of SharePoint's permission model, including site, sub\-site, folder/item\-level, guest, and OneDrive permissions, and how inheritance and breaking inheritance affects access.
* Solid understanding of security groups and access management.
* Experience with site provisioning, lifecycle management, and governance processes.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 ecosystem integration (Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, Viva Engage).
* Basic PowerShell scripting skills for administrative tasks and bulk operations.
* Strong problem\-solving and logical thinking skills, with the ability to methodically diagnose and resolve complex access and permission issues.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong service orientation with excellent communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple support requests, prioritise effectively, and work under SLA pressure.
* Attention to detail and commitment to thorough documentation.



  





**Must\-Have Skills:** 



* SharePoint Online administration and site management
* In\-depth knowledge of SharePoint permissions: site, sub\-site, folder/item\-level, guest access, and ownership management
* OneDrive permissions and sharing management
* Microsoft 365 permissions management and security groups
* Site provisioning, lifecycle management, and governance
* Incident management and SLA\-driven support
* Basic PowerShell scripting
* Strong problem\-solving and logical/analytical thinking
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:** 



* Experience with Power Automate for basic workflow automation
* Familiarity with SharePoint migration processes
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview or other compliance and governance tools
* Experience with ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar)
* Exposure to Power Apps or SharePoint Framework (SPFx) development

description:
