 Stolt\-Nielsen is a family\-founded global leader in bulk\-liquid and chemical logistics, transportation, and storage, known for its commitment to safety, service excellence, and innovation. At the Stolt\-Nielsen Digital Innovation Centre, we bring this legacy into the future — building smarter systems, driving digital transformation, and shaping what's next for the world of logistics. Here, you’re encouraged to think boldly, challenge convention, and help move today’s products toward tomorrow’s possibilities.
 



  





 We are recruiting a Senior Platform Engineer to own the health, performance and evolution of the global OutSystems platform at Stolt\-Nielsen (SN).
 



 This is deliberately an operations\-first role. Around 80% of your week will be spent keeping our environments running well – monitoring, incident response, deployments, upgrades, access management and performance tuning. The remaining 20% is hands\-on development: the automation, tooling and platform components that make the operational work faster and less manual, plus occasional support to delivery teams on technical problems.
 



 If you enjoy owning a platform end to end and would rather automate a problem than repeat a workaround, this role is built for you.
 



 We take digital seriously. We invest in our teams through training and mentoring, and we give them the tools to work in a modern way. As we build up our engineering practice further, there is ample room for you to contribute, take initiative and shape our ways of working and technology landscape.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




**Platform support and operations (80%)** 




**Environment administration:** 



* Administer and maintain our OutSystems environments across Development, Test, Acceptance and Production.
* Manage configuration, environment setup and system resources across cloud and on\-premises installations.
* Manage user roles, permissions and access controls in line with our security policies.



  





**Application lifecycle management:** 



* Run deployments, tagging, versioning and rollbacks through OutSystems Lifetime.
* Guard our ALM standards and manage dependencies so that releases stay predictable.
* Support new teams onboarding onto the platform so they can deliver reliably from the start.



  





**Monitoring and performance:** 



* Establish and maintain monitoring and alerting for availability, performance and errors.
* Monitor and optimise platform performance, database usage and environment capacity.
* Identify capacity constraints before they become incidents, and plan accordingly.



  





**Incident and problem management:** 



* Act as the escalation point for platform\-related issues, coordinating with OutSystems Support where needed.
* Lead root cause analysis and drive preventive maintenance so the same incident does not recur.
* Maintain runbooks and operational documentation to a standard others can actually follow.



  





**Upgrades and maintenance:** 



* Plan, perform and document platform upgrades, patches and scheduled maintenance, working with our development and infrastructure teams.
* Oversee database management on SQL Server, including backups, schema evolution and performance tuning.



  





**Development and automation (20%):** 



* Build automation that removes manual operational steps, deployment scripts, health checks, environment provisioning, routine reporting.
* Integrate OutSystems into our CI/CD pipelines alongside the DevOps team.
* Develop and maintain reusable platform components, integrations and shared services used across applications.
* Provide hands\-on technical support to OutSystems developers on integration, performance and architecture questions.
* Contribute to architecture discussions and help define our operational standards for low\-code environments.



  





**What you'll bring:** 



* Proven experience managing OutSystems platforms in an enterprise, multi\-environment setup.
* Strong understanding of OutSystems architecture across front\-end, service and integration layers.
* Working knowledge of OutSystems Lifetime, Service Center, Integration Studio and the Infrastructure Management Console.
* Practical database administration experience\-Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle or similar.
* Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure, PaaS components and network and security fundamentals.
* Familiarity with DevOps principles, CI/CD tooling and automation scripting in PowerShell, Python or Bash.
* Excellent documentation skills and a genuine eye for operational detail.
* The ability to work with developers, infrastructure teams and security specialists to keep the platform healthy and aligned with our wider goals.



  





**Must\-have skills:** 



* 5\+ years in IT operations, platform administration or DevOps roles.
* 3\+ years of OutSystems platform administration experience.
* Strong knowledge of OutSystems Lifetime and environment management.
* Database management on SQL Server or Oracle.
* Platform monitoring, maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of OutSystems ALM, deployment flows and dependency management.
* Familiarity with networking, firewalls and identity management using Azure AD or Entra ID.



  





**Nice to have:** 



* Scripting for operational automation at scale, rather than one\-off fixes.

Job Description:
 



 We seek an experienced and motivated construction project manager to join our dynamic team at Nestcon. As a construction project manager, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating and managing construction projects for our firm.
 



  





 Your responsibilities will include developing and managing project budgets, creating detailed schedules and overseeing resource allocation to ensure optimal execution. You will conduct regular site inspections, review construction plans and specifications, identify potential risks, implement proactive measures to mitigate them and verify that all the work is performed to the highest quality standards.
 



  





 If you’re passionate about this field, we invite you to apply. You will have the opportunity to work with a talented team, leverage advanced construction technologies and contribute to the successful execution of diverse and challenging construction projects in India. We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package as well.
 



  





 Objectives of this role
 


* Planning, coordinating and managing all phases of construction projects, including project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and closeout.
* Establishing project objectives, scope and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders and ensuring alignment with client requirements.
* Developing and managing project schedules, budgets and resource allocations to ensure cost efficiency and timely delivery.
* Liaising with architects, engineers, contractors and subcontractors to monitor construction progress, resolve issues and ensure compliance with specifications and quality standards.
* Managing procurement processes, including bid evaluations, contract negotiations and vendor selection.
* Oversee project budgeting and cost control and manage change orders to ensure adherence to budgetary constraints.
* Conducting regular site inspections to assess project progress, identify risks, and ensure compliance with safety protocols and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain effective communication with project team members and stakeholders to provide project updates, address concerns and foster strong working relationships.



 Your tasks
 


* Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, resource allocations and procurement strategies.
* Coordinate and oversee construction activities, ensuring adherence to project schedules and specifications.
* Evaluate and select contractors and subcontractors based on qualifications, experience and cost\-effectiveness.
* Monitor project progress, track key performance indicators (KPIs) and report on project status to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and legal requirements, prioritising a safe working environment for all involved.
* Manage construction project documentation, including contracts, permits, drawings and change orders.
* Conduct regular meetings to facilitate communication, address challenges and to meet project objectives.
* Provide regular updates and reports on project status, including milestones, budget updates, and any significant developments or risks.
* Implement and enforce safety protocols and ensure compliance with local building codes and regulations.
* Carry out thorough project evaluations and assessments to identify areas for improvement and implement necessary corrective measures.
* Provide leadership and guidance to the project team, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance work environment.



 Required skills and qualifications
 


* A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, (MS Project etc.) or a related field.
* 3\+ years of relevant experience in construction project management, with a track record of successfully delivering projects on time and within budget.
* Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, building codes and safety regulations in the Indian context.
* Excellent project management skills, including effective planning, organising and prioritising tasks.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting technical documents, including project blueprints and construction schematics.
* Strong leadership and communication skills to manage project teams and stakeholders.
* Proficiency in construction management software, project scheduling tools and cost estimation software.
* Familiarity with sustainable construction practices and green building certifications.



 Preferred skills and qualifications
 


* Relevant professional certification in project management or construction management, like Project Management Professional (PMP) or LEED certification.
* Knowledge of risk management and budget management principles.
* Experience in managing large\-scale construction projects in India.
* Knowledge of local construction regulations, permits and approval processes.
* Proficiency in using Building Information Modelling (BIM) software.
* Experience with construction contract negotiations and claims management.
* Familiarity with lean construction principles and methodologies.
* Strong financial understanding and experience in project budgeting and cost control.

title: Financial Reporting Assistant Manager
description:
**About the company:** 




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart.
 



  





 BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Financial Reporting Manager to take ownership of the financial reporting and month\-end close process across group entities. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role requiring strong technical accounting expertise, audit management capabilities, and a strong focus on internal controls and financial governance.
 



  





 The role will work closely with Service Lines, FP\&A, Tax, Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Compliance, and senior leadership to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  





**Financial Reporting \& Month\-End Close** 



* Own and drive the monthly financial reporting and close process across group entities.
* Ensure timely and accurate closure of monthly books within defined timelines.
* Review trial balances, general ledger accounts, and supporting schedules.
* Review and ensure accurate accounting of provisions, accruals, prepayments, depreciation, amortization, and other month\-end entries.
* Perform detailed variance analysis of actuals versus budget, forecast, and prior periods, and highlight key business drivers to management.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data across entities.



  





**Financial Statements \& Accounting Compliance** 



* Prepare and review annual financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS / Local GAAP.
* Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for complex transactions and financial reporting matters.
* Provide accurate financial information, schedules, and supporting documentation for regulatory and statutory filings.
* Partner with the Compliance and Secretarial teams to ensure timely and accurate regulatory reporting.



  





**Statutory \& Internal Audit Management** 



* Lead and manage statutory audits across group entities.
* Coordinate and support internal audits, including preparation of audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents, and deliverables.
* Act as the key point of contact between auditors and internal stakeholders.
* Manage audit timelines and ensure timely closure of audit observations and queries.
* Proactively identify and resolve audit issues with minimal escalation.



  





**Internal Financial Controls \& Governance** 



* Execute and monitor Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (IFCR/IFC) within the reporting function.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and testing of key financial controls.
* Identify control gaps and drive timely remediation.
* Strengthen financial governance and control frameworks across entities.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.



  





**Lease Accounting \& Fixed Assets** 



* Manage lease accounting, including maintenance of lease trackers and periodic accounting entries.
* Ensure appropriate accounting and reporting under Ind AS 116, where applicable.
* Oversee fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, disposals, and reconciliation.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of fixed asset registers and related schedules.



  





**Balance Sheet \& Month\-End Governance** 



* Ensure all balance sheet schedules are prepared, reviewed, and reconciled on a monthly basis.
* Maintain strong controls over provisions and expense recognition.
* Ensure appropriate cut\-off procedures and completeness of expense recognition.
* Investigate and resolve long\-outstanding reconciling items and unusual balances.
* Drive high standards of accuracy and financial discipline across the reporting process.



  





**Stakeholder Management** 



* Collaborate closely with Service Lines, FP\&A, AP, AR, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Provide management with relevant financial information, analysis, and insights.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve accounting, reporting, and close\-related issues.
* Build strong working relationships with senior stakeholders and external auditors.



  





**Process Improvement \& Systems** 



* Identify opportunities to improve and standardize financial reporting and close processes.
* Drive standardization of reconciliations, reporting schedules, and management reporting formats.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen controls and improve process efficiency.
* Support enhanced utilization and optimization of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.
* Drive process improvements, automation, and reporting efficiencies wherever relevant.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory.
* 2\-5 years of post\-qualification experience in financial reporting, accounting, controllership, or related finance functions.
* Strong hands\-on experience in:
* Financial reporting and financial statements
* Month\-end and year\-end close
* Statutory and internal audits
* Balance sheet reconciliations
* Internal financial controls
* Technical accounting
* Experience managing reporting across multiple entities will be preferred.
* Experience in professional services, consulting, Big 4, or similar environments will be an advantage.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.

* Familiarity with ERP systems and retail analytics platforms.

title: Deputy Manager- Operations (Central Operations)
description:
**About Moove**


Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best\-in\-class technologies that power mobility platforms. Its flagship Drive\-to\-Own (DTO) product democratizes access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive.


Our global growth has been fueled by our partnership with Uber and backed by leading investors and lenders, including Uber, Mubadala, BlackRock, and many others. Today, Moove operates the world's largest manned \& autonomous ride\-hail fleet, with 38k\+ vehicles across 29 cities, 13 countries and 6 continents enabled by 2\.1k\+ employees – Moove continues to expand through strategic partnerships with industry leaders like Uber. We’re transforming mobility to be safer, more efficient and accessible to all, while creating economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector.

**About the Role**


A Deputy Manager\- Operations (Central Operations) role at Moove is a pivotal position responsible for developing and building dashboards, analyzing operational data, and supporting the central operations team in optimizing processes and reporting. You will act as a core strategic partner to leadership, transforming complex operational and financial datasets into scalable business intelligence, executive insights, identify revenue leakages, and drive fleet productivity across multiple regions. The role requires a strong understanding of data analysis, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.

**What You’ll be Doing**

* Data Analysis: Collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for operational improvement.
* Operational Support: Support the central operations team with data\-driven insights to optimize workflows, improve efficiency, and ensure compliance. KPI dashboard design, yield optimization, and cross\-functional process automation.
* Establish single\-source\-of\-truth semantic models and KPI frameworks to track fleet utilization, trip yield, driver retention, maintenance costs, and asset performance.
* Reporting: Prepare regular and ad\-hoc reports for management, highlighting key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.
* Conduct rigorous root\-cause analyses (RCA) and deep dives into regional fleet bottlenecks, vehicle downtime, churn drivers, and revenue leakage points.
* Oversee data integrity and governance across CRM, fleet tracking, and telemetry systems to ensure accurate billing, incentive distribution, and compliance.
* Process Improvement: Collaborate with various departments to identify and implement process improvements based on data analysis.
* Data Integrity: Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data across all systems.
* Ad\-hoc Requests: Respond to ad\-hoc data requests and provide analytical support as needed.

**What You will need for this position**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in business analytics, operational reporting, or data science. Experience in mobility marketplaces, ride\-hailing fleets, asset finance, logistics, or quick\-commerce is highly preferred.
* Proven experience in data analysis, or a similar analytical role.
* Strong proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
* Expert\-level knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and experience with database management.
* Ability to communicate complex data insights clearly and concisely to non\- technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Exceptional structured thinking, numerical aptitude, and ability to break down ambiguous operational challenges into clear quantitative frameworks.
* Experience in the financial services, Internet/ E\- commerce Industry or mobility sector is a plus

**Key Metrics**

* Own processes for centrally driven exercise for existing drivers
* Churn mitigation
* Improve collections
* Own daily reconciliation of driver payment

  

**Who You'll Be Working with:**
Directly reporting to our Associate Director\- Marketplace \& Customer Acquisition, and closely working with our Operations Team.

**About the team**


Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.


Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.

Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.

**EEO Statement:** Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

**Moove:** Moove is a mobility asset finance company and Uber's preferred fleet partner across Sub\-Saharan Africa. Our Vision is to democratize financial services to make our customers more productive and successful. Our Core values are Compassion, Excellence, Innovation, Teamwork, Trust and Ownership.

 As a Growth Analyst, you will play a key role in driving data\-led growth across our Marketing and Sales functions.  This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys working with data, solving business problems and translating insights into measurable business impact.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Marketing \& Growth Analytics** 




 • Partner with the Marketing team to analyse performance across digital channels such as Meta, Google, YouTube and LinkedIn, identifying gaps and opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness.
 



 • Analyse campaign, audience and conversion data to generate actionable insights around targeting, messaging, channel mix and marketing efficiency.
 



 • Work with the Marketing team on CRM and lifecycle initiatives, including WhatsApp and Email, to improve lead engagement, nurturing and conversion.

**What We’re looking for?**

 • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel is a must, including working with large datasets, building analyses and deriving actionable insights.

 •

And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. The candidate will contribute to solutions involving consolidated order/trade data stores, multiple asset classes, system integrations, workflow design, and data-flow analysis. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Gather, interpret, and document business, functional, technical, and data requirements from written inputs and stakeholder discussions. Analyze order, trade, portfolio, client, reference, market, and reporting data across multiple systems and business lines. Create BRDs, FRDs, FSD inputs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, data mappings, and data dictionaries. Perform source-to-target data mapping, field-level analysis, data profiling, SQL investigation, data validation, and reconciliation checks. Work with technology teams to clarify database requirements, API expectations, JSON/XML payloads, integration points, and downstream data needs. Support development and QA teams by explaining requirements, resolving clarifications, reviewing test scenarios, and validating test coverage. Facilitate SIT/UAT support, defect analysis, issue tracking, remediation follow-up, and business sign-off coordination. Use Agile practices to support backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and workstream status updates. Use GenAI tools responsibly to accelerate requirements drafting, analysis summaries, test preparation, data investigation, and documentation quality. Translate technical concepts into business language and business requirements into technology-ready specifications. Qualifications 5-8 years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or Technology Consultant. Experience in Financial Services, with preference for Wealth Management, Asset Management, Capital Markets, trading systems, investment platforms, or reporting platforms. Good understanding of order/trade lifecycle and one or more asset classes such as equities, options, fixed income, mutual funds, ETFs, structured products, derivatives, or alternatives. Hands-on experience with data mapping, data analysis, data validation, reconciliation, data migration, and data-quality issue investigation. Strong SQL skills for querying, data checks, root-cause analysis, and reconciliation support. Understanding of REST APIs, web services, JSON/XML payloads, Postman, and system integration concepts. Experience creating BRDs, FRDs, user stories, functional requirements, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria. Working knowledge of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, Jira or similar ALM tools, and documentation tools such as Confluence. Practical AI-native mindset with ability to use tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Azure AI, or similar platforms to improve productivity and quality. Knowledge and Skills WAM and Capital Markets domain knowledge across front, middle, and back-office processes. Data mapping, data lineage, source-to-target analysis, data profiling, and data reconciliation. Advanced SQL querying and ability to investigate data issues independently. API and web-service understanding, including request/response structures and testing support through Postman or similar tools. Requirements documentation including BRD, FRD, FSD inputs, user stories, acceptance criteria, data dictionaries, mapping specifications, and process flows. Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and stakeholder coordination skills. Ability to work on multiple project tasks or workstreams with guidance from project leads or managers. Experience and Education Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Finance, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 5-8 years of relevant experience in business analysis, data analysis, technology consulting, financial services transformation, or related roles. Certifications such as CBAP, Agile/Scrum, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, or AI-related certifications are advantageous but not mandatory. EY | Building a better working world

To detail the hiring requirements for a position focused on the technical and functional aspects of BlackLine , specifically around data flow, template handling, and issue resolution  related to SAP-to-BlackLine integrations. 2. Key Role Requirements A. Experience Expectations Candidates with 4+ years  of experience preferred. Even junior candidates  can be considered if they have hands-on BlackLine experience . Experience should be technical , not purely operational. 3. Mandatory BlackLine Experience A. Technical Skills The candidate must: Work on data extraction from SAP  and uploading into BlackLine . Understand FBW  and how data moves from SAP into BlackLine. Run and troubleshoot In-Transit Runs  for all templates. Identify and resolve issues in data flow from SAP to BlackLine. Have experience with BlackLine admin activities . B. BlackLine Templates Knowledge Candidate must understand frequently used templates, including: Generalist Match Template Matching Account Analysis (MAA) Template Internal Bank Templates External Bank Templates Intercompany Templates Generalist AP/AR Match Templates Other BlackLine templates (BlackLine has ~1215 templates) C. BlackLine Modules Candidate should be aware of: General Ledger Module Reconciliation Module Matching Module  (used for: Intercompany reconciliations Internal bank External bank Automatching & autocertification) 4. SAP Functional Knowledge (FICO) A certification is not  required, but handson experience is necessary. Candidate should know: SAP FICO basics FC Local FBL*N  reports FS10N Creation/use of: Cost Centers Profit Centers WBS Elements Chart of Accounts 5. Accounting Knowledge Required Accounting understanding is essential. Candidate must know: What general ledger accounts represent What bank accounts represent Trade payables/receivables Classification of receivables/payables (within 1 year, within 5 years) How to interpret data before uploading to BlackLine (not a copy-paste task) 6. Role Structure Individual Contributor (IC) role , not a team lead position. Candidate will not manage people , but will: Guide the team Provide solutions Analyze issues and suggest fixes 7. Work Location Requirements First 2 months: Work from office  (for training & system understanding) After 2 months: Hybrid model  (2–3 days office / 2–3 days WFH) 8. Role Breakdown 60% Technical Data extraction from SAP Data uploads into BlackLine Understanding field mappings & template parameters 40% Functional (Accounting) Understanding the meaning behind the numbers Validating correctness of SAP data before upload 9. Main Responsibilities Carry out and troubleshoot in-transit runs . Validate SAP-to-BlackLine data flows. Identify issues in: Template configurations Matching rules Field validations Ensure correctness of reconciliations and matching results. Support teams with technical expertise on BlackLine templates and modules.

title: Finance Executive
description:
Financial Services Executive - Operations & Client Servicing Job Type: Full-time
 Experience: 1-4 years preferred
 Location: Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi
 Industry: Financial Services / Mutual Funds / Insurance 
 About the Role We are looking for a smart, organised and proactive Financial Services Executive to join our growing financial services business. The role will involve a combination of mutual fund and insurance operations, client servicing, financial transactions, documentation, communication and general business support . The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of financial products, excellent communication skills and be comfortable using technology and AI tools to work efficiently. This is a hands-on, non-routine role where the candidate will be expected to take ownership of tasks, coordinate with clients and service providers, and manage multiple responsibilities independently. 
 Key Responsibilities Mutual Fund & Investment Operations Initiate and process mutual fund transactions through NSE and other relevant platforms Handle purchase, redemption, switch, SIP and other investment transactions Assist with KYC, account opening, FATCA, documentation and related processes Coordinate with AMCs, RTAs, NSE and other platforms for transaction and service-related requirements Track pending transactions and ensure timely completion Maintain accurate client and transaction records Insurance Operations Assist with new insurance business, policy servicing and renewals Coordinate documentation and service requests with insurance companies Track policy renewals, pending requirements and client requests Maintain organised records of policies and related documentation Client Servicing Communicate with clients through phone, WhatsApp and email regarding transactions, documentation and service requirements Respond to routine client queries professionally and efficiently Coordinate client meetings and follow-ups Occasionally accompany or visit clients for documentation, servicing or other requirements Build and maintain strong professional relationships with clients Technology & Business Support Maintain Excel/Google Sheets, digital records and databases Use online financial platforms, CRM tools and other business applications Effectively use AI tools such as ChatGPT for research, drafting, analysis, communication and improving day-to-day productivity Conduct online research and gather financial/product-related information when required Assist with occasional flight, hotel and other travel bookings Handle other operational and administrative responsibilities as required Entrepreneurial Mindset & Growth We are specifically looking for someone with an entrepreneurial spirit and an ownership mindset. You should be someone who: Treats the business and its clients with the same care and responsibility as you would your own business Looks for ways to improve processes, solve problems and make the business more efficient Is willing to take initiative rather than waiting for instructions for every task Is interested in learning and gradually taking on greater responsibility 
 Performance will be recognised and rewarded. Salary growth, bonuses and increased responsibilities will be linked to performance, initiative, contribution and the growth of the business. 
 What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate should be: Highly organised and detail-oriented Comfortable working with numbers, financial information and documentation Knowledgeable about mutual funds, investments, insurance and personal finance Excellent in spoken and written Hindi and English Confident and professional while communicating with clients Comfortable with computers, Excel/Google Sheets and online platforms Tech-savvy and interested in using AI tools to improve productivity A quick learner who can adapt to new software and processes Proactive and capable of taking ownership without constant supervision Good at following up and ensuring tasks are completed on time Presentable and comfortable with occasional client visits Reliable, responsible and discreet when handling client information Ambitious, self-motivated and entrepreneurial Preferred Qualifications & Experience Graduate in B.Com, BBA, Finance, Economics or a related field 1-4 years of experience in mutual funds, insurance, banking, wealth management, financial services or a similar role preferred Familiarity with NSE mutual fund transactions, AMC/RTA portals, KYC processes and insurance platforms will be an advantage Candidates with strong financial knowledge and excellent communication skills may also be considered even without direct industry experience Important This is primarily an operations and client servicing role, not a pure sales role. The position is ideal for someone who enjoys working across finance, technology, people and business operations and wants to develop a broad understanding of the financial services industry. We are looking for someone who wants to build something, take ownership and grow alongside the business.

title: Manager Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
description:
We are hiring for Manager Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) with Solar EPC Firm!! 

 Location : Karnal,Haryana 

 Role Summary: 
 We are looking for a Manager Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to lead budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and business performance analysis. The role will act as a strategic finance partner to Plant, Sales, and Supply Chain leadership , providing actionable insights to support decisions around pricing, product mix, CAPEX, working capital, and overall business growth. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and rolling quarterly forecasts across business segments, including solar pumps, agricultural & industrial pumps, motors, and exports . Prepare and present monthly MIS and business review reports for the CFO, MD, and Board, covering revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, cash flow, and budget vs. actual and prior-year variance analysis. Conduct product-wise, segment-wise, and customer-wise profitability analysis to support pricing, discounting, and commercial decisions. Analyse raw material cost movements including copper, steel, and polymers, along with plant conversion costs, overhead absorption, productivity, and operational efficiency. Evaluate CAPEX proposals by developing business cases and financial models covering IRR, NPV, payback period, and return on investment ; monitor post-implementation performance. Drive working capital analysis and cash-flow forecasting , including monitoring receivables, inventory days, vendor payment terms, and government/PM-KUSUM scheme receivables. Develop scenario and sensitivity models to assess the impact of commodity prices, government scheme/tender volumes, export demand, and other key business variables. Support Investor Relations (IR) activities by preparing financial data, quarterly earnings information, analyst responses, and investor presentations. Work closely with the IT/ERP team to enhance financial reporting capabilities and develop dashboards using Power BI and advanced Excel . Provide financial insights and analysis for strategic initiatives, M&A evaluations, long-range business planning, and other ad-hoc management requirements . Partner closely with plant and business teams to identify cost optimization opportunities and improve overall financial performance. 
 Candidate Profile: 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) with 36 years of post-qualification experience . Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in FP&A / Business Finance , preferably within a manufacturing environment . Strong expertise in financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and advanced Excel . Exposure to Power BI or similar business intelligence/reporting tools will be preferred. Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics , particularly for financial reporting and analysis. Strong commercial acumen with the ability to challenge business assumptions and translate financial data into actionable business insights. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively interact with senior management and non-finance stakeholders . Experience with a listed company or an organization that has recently undergone an IPO will be an added advantage. Strong understanding of manufacturing finance, cost structures, profitability, working capital, and CAPEX evaluation . Willingness to travel to manufacturing/plant locations as required.

title: Title Insurance
description:
POSITION SUMMARY Assistant Manager Operations will manage day-to-day US Title Insurance operations, ensuring achievement of quality, productivity, turnaround time, and SLA requirements. The role is responsible for leading high-performing teams, managing operational performance, supporting client requirements and escalations, and driving continuous improvement, process compliance, and operational efficiency. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES – OPERATIONS Manage day-to-day operations, including Title Search and related title products. Ensure achievement of defined quality, productivity, turnaround time, and SLA targets, with proactive action on potential SLA risks. Monitor queues, workloads, volumes, and staffing to ensure timely completion of orders and effective resource utilization. Review daily operational performance and implement corrective actions for identified gaps. Ensure accurate and timely operational reporting and maintain effective process controls. Support implementation and stabilization of new processes, products, clients, and projects. Plan resources based on transaction volumes, business requirements, and forecasted demand. QUALITY & PROCESS MANAGEMENT Ensure adherence to client-specific requirements, SOPs, process guidelines, and applicable compliance standards. Analyze quality trends, recurring errors, audit findings, and rework; implement corrective and preventive actions. Identify process gaps and opportunities for standardization, automation, cost optimization, and productivity improvement. Ensure audit observations are addressed within defined timelines and process documentation is kept current. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, efficiency, and client experience. PEOPLE MANAGEMENT Lead, coach, and mentor team members to achieve individual and operational performance objectives. Manage attendance, staffing, roster/shift planning, and resource utilization. Conduct performance reviews, provide timely feedback, and address performance gaps through structured coaching. Identify training needs and coordinate with Training/Quality teams to close skill gaps. Build a culture of accountability, quality, collaboration, employee engagement, and continuous improvement. Support effective onboarding, nesting, and transition of new hires into production. CLIENT & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT Act as a key point of contact for day-to-day client communication and operational requirements. Manage client queries and escalations proactively and ensure timely resolution. Participate in client calls and business reviews and provide updates on performance, risks, and action plans. Build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders. Coordinate with Quality, Training, Workforce Management, Technology, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth service delivery. REPORTING, COMPLIANCE & RISK MANAGEMENT Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering productivity, quality, SLA/TAT, volume, capacity, utilization, attendance, backlog, and error trends. Analyze operational data, identify trends and risks, and present actionable improvement plans to management. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, client requirements, process guidelines, and applicable compliance standards. Escalate significant operational, quality, compliance, or client-impacting risks to the appropriate leadership team. JOB REQUIREMENTS Bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution. 6+ years of experience in BPO/ITES operations, preferably with significant experience in US Mortgage/Title Insurance operations. Strong knowledge of US Residential Mortgage Title Search and related Title Insurance products/processes. Experience managing teams in a production environment with defined quality, productivity, and SLA metrics. Experience in client communication, operational reviews, escalation management, process improvement, and root-cause analysis. Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, verbal, and written communication skills. Working knowledge of MS Excel, reporting tools, and operational systems. Willingness to work flexible shifts, including weekends/holidays, based on business requirements; travel may be required.

title: Sr Manager, Software Development Engineering
description:
Job Summary At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, youll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Introduction to team: Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travellers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences. The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source. We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence. In this role, you will: Lead, coach, and develop one software engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating robust, scalable, and secure Data Quality Platform services. Set technical direction for your team across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, incident management, and data health experiences. Lead and collaborate on complex, cross-organizational initiatives, making thoughtful resource, delivery, product, and architectural trade-offs to maximize strategic value. Partner closely with product managers, architects, program managers, data platform teams, and data domain owners to prioritize roadmaps, clarify requirements, and deliver measurable outcomes. Define and raise engineering standards for coding, testing, architecture, observability, security, continuous delivery, performance, and cost management. Ensure reliable operation of production systems through effective on-call strategies, incident management, root-cause analysis, capacity planning, and continuous improvement of service-level indicators and objectives. Safely integrate and operate machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts to practical data platform workflows. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor s Degree or Equivalent Level; Technical Degree Preferred. 8+ years of relevant professional experience and 3+ years of people management experience. Proven track record of end-to-end ownership for complex software or data platform systems, including system design, application programming interface design, data modelling, implementation, and ongoing operations within a defined product or domain scope. Strong proficiency in core software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and building secure, reliable, and observable services. Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, analytics systems, or a closely related domain. Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, make data-driven trade-offs, and align cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality software at scale. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading a software engineering team within a large-scale, distributed technology environment, with accountability for team-level architecture, technical strategy, and delivery outcomes. Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including service decomposition, data modelling at scale, backward-compatible application programming interfaces, and integration with batch or streaming pipelines. Deep experience with production operations at scale, including site reliability engineering practices, capacity planning, performance optimization, and building systems for high availability and resilience. Demonstrated ability to drive architectural modernization, platform migration, or legacy system deprecation while maintaining strong delivery and operational outcomes. Experience with cloud-native data processing, workflow orchestration, data contracts, anomaly detection, machine-assisted software or data quality workflows, and observability platforms. Proven ability to build an inclusive, high-performance engineering culture and develop engineers through feedback, coaching, career planning, and meaningful technical opportunities. Accommodation requests Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request.

title: Engagement Manager - Supply Chain Analytics
description:
Role Summary: We are looking for a senior leader to help anchor our CPG Supply Chain Analytics practice in Bengaluru. You will sit inside the practice, reporting into practice leadership. Expect to lead client engagements end to end, own a set of capability areas, and drive the strategic initiatives that the practice is betting on. It carries real ownership, but you will be doing it alongside a practice leader rather than in place of one. Roughly speaking, your time goes to clients, to the team you lead and to the solutions we are building. 
 What you will be doing: 
 Inside the practice Lead significant parts of how the practice is built out, working to the direction that practice leadership sets. Take ownership of specific capability areas and offerings, from the first idea through to something we can put in front of a client. Help shape how we take the practice to market, and back the sales and business development teams in pursuits. 
 Clients Lead engagements and own the relationships on the accounts you carry. Get close enough to a client's business to see what is actually holding them back, then turn that into solutions that can be built and used. Become a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on supply chain topics. 
 Solutions and innovation Drive the development of advanced analytics and data models, including AI, machine learning, optimisation and Gen AI, to improve how decisions get made across the supply chain. Stay close enough to the work to review the approach, challenge the modelling and keep the quality bar where it should be. Keep consulting and engineering close together so that models make it past the pilot stage and into production. 
 Team and knowledge Lead, coach and grow the consultants and analysts working with you. Write. Articles, points of view, internal intellectual capital, anything that lifts the quality of client work across the practice. Contribute to knowledge management at a practice level, and make sure people actually use what we build. Represent Sigmoid at industry events, conferences and forums. 
 What we are looking for: 8 to 12 years spent consulting on and delivering data and analytics work for large CPG customers. Direct front office consulting experience, with strategic customer leadership. That part is not negotiable. A track record of leading teams and engagements, and getting excellent work out of the people around you. Strong communication skills, and the senior client relationships to show for it. The ability to take a messy problem apart and work out which piece actually matters. BE or BTech in Computer Science from a Tier I or Tier II university such as an IIT or NIT. An MBA from a top business school such as an IIM is a plus. 
 Nice to have: Real depth in supply chain planning and operations, whether that is CPG, life sciences, pharma or industrial, and a sense of where analytics fits. Familiarity with the full process: demand planning, forecasting, inventory optimisation, procurement analytics. Experience building models yourself, across machine learning, deep learning and Gen AI, and comfort with the whole range from descriptive through to prescriptive. Published writing on supply chain topics, internally or externally. A working understanding of the technology stack, both on premise and cloud (GCP, Azure, AWS).

description:
Job Description Senior Manager – Quality | IPQC Company: Oben Electric
 Location: Bengaluru – Electronic City
 Function: Quality – Manufacturing / Vehicle Quality
 Experience: 10–15 years
 Industry: Automotive / Two-Wheeler / EV About Oben Electric Oben Electric is a Bengaluru-based electric motorcycle OEM with in-house design, development, engineering, testing and manufacturing capabilities. The company manufactures electric motorcycles and critical EV components including batteries, motors, VCUs and chargers. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Manager – Quality with strong hands-on experience in IPQC / In-Process Quality Control within the automotive two-wheeler or EV industry . The role will be responsible for driving process quality, vehicle assembly quality, defect prevention, process audits, quality systems and continuous improvement across manufacturing operations. Key Responsibilities Lead IPQC / In-Process Quality Control activities for two-wheeler/EV vehicle assembly. Establish and monitor process quality standards, inspection criteria and control plans across manufacturing lines. Drive First Time Right (FTR), FPY, PPM, rejection, rework and defect reduction initiatives. Conduct regular process, product and layered process audits to identify quality gaps. Ensure adherence to SOPs, work instructions, control plans, inspection standards and process parameters . Monitor critical-to-quality characteristics and ensure effective poka-yoke / mistake-proofing implementation. Lead RCA and CAPA for internal, customer and field quality issues using 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto and other quality tools . Drive containment and corrective actions for repeat defects and line-quality issues . Work closely with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, R&D, Supplier Quality and Service teams to resolve quality issues. Establish and monitor EOL testing and functional inspection for vehicle assembly. Ensure traceability of critical components and process parameters. Drive SPC, MSA, process capability (Cp/Cpk) and statistical quality improvement initiatives wherever applicable. Support new product development, pilot builds and process validation from a quality perspective. Review and improve PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flow, Inspection Standards and SOPs . Drive supplier-related quality issues in coordination with SQE/Supplier Quality teams. Lead quality improvement projects, Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives . Prepare and review daily/weekly/monthly quality MIS and management dashboards. Develop and mentor the IPQC/Quality engineering team . Must-Have Experience 10–15 years of experience in Quality within the automotive / two-wheeler / EV manufacturing industry . Strong and demonstrated experience in IPQC / In-Process Quality Control . Experience in vehicle assembly quality is highly preferred. Strong exposure to process audits, product audits and line quality . Experience with RCA, 8D, CAPA, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto and problem-solving methodologies . Good knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA and APQP . Experience in monitoring FTR/FPY, rejection, rework, PPM and customer/field complaints . Exposure to EOL testing / functional testing of vehicles. Experience working closely with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, R&D and Supplier Quality teams. Should have experience managing and developing a Quality/IPQC team . Preferred Experience in electric two-wheelers / EV manufacturing . Exposure to battery, motor, VCU, charger and electrical/electronic component quality would be an advantage, given Oben's vertically integrated EV manufacturing setup. Experience in a fast-paced OEM/start-up manufacturing environment . Engineering degree in Mechanical / Automobile / Production / Electrical / Electronics . Six Sigma / Quality certification will be an added advantage. Ideal Candidate Profile Two-wheeler OEM + 10–15 years Quality experience + strong IPQC ownership + Vehicle Assembly Quality + Process Audit + RCA/CAPA + PFMEA/Control Plan + EOL + team management.

Negotiate rates considering quality, quantity, wastage, transportation, processing,polishing, installation, and other associated costs. Develop alternate sources to ensure continuity of supply and reduce dependency on individual vendors. 
 3. Interior Works Club Houses & Marketing Offices:

Handle procurement and execution of: False Ceiling Flooring Partitions Doors Lighting Fixtures Glass Railings Faade Works Dcor Items Carpets Stainless Steel Railings POP Works Internal Painting Other Interior Finishing Works Coordinate with Design, Architecture, Projects, Marketing, and other stakeholders for finalization of specifications, drawings, BOQs, and scope of work. Obtain competitive quotations and finalize vendors/contractors within approved budgets and timelines. Ensure proper coordination between design requirements, procurement, and site execution. 
 4. Capex Equipment Procurement : 
 Manage end-to-end procurement of Capital Equipment, Machinery, and other Capex requirements for projects and operations. Evaluate technical and commercial proposals from multiple OEMs suppliers. Conduct techno-commercial evaluation and detailed negotiations. Ensure optimum lifecycle cost considering purchase price, operating cost,maintenance, warranty, and after-sales support. Coordinate with Finance, Projects, P&M, Technical, and other concerned teams for budget approvals and procurement. Ensure timely delivery, installation, commissioning, testing, and handover of equipment. Monitor warranty, AMC/CMC, after-sales service, and supplier performance. 
 5. Contract Management: 
 Manage end-to-end contracts for landscaping, interior works, marble installation,specialized works, and other assigned contracts. Prepare, review, and finalize BOQs, Scope of Work, commercial terms, rate contracts, Work Orders, and agreements. Ensure clear definition of scope, specifications, quantities, timelines, payment terms, retention, LD, warranty, performance obligations, and other contractual conditions. Monitor contractor performance against agreed scope, cost, quality, and timelines. Review contractor bills, measurements, variations, deviations, and additional claims. Control and negotiate variations to minimize cost impact. Ensure timely closure of contracts, including final measurements, final bills,recoveries, warranties, and other contractual obligations. Resolve commercial and contractual issues in coordination with concerned departments and management. 
 6. Vendor Development & Management: 
 Develop a strong, reliable, and competitive vendor/contractor base. Identify new vendors and alternate sources for critical and high-value requirements. Conduct vendor evaluation, qualification, negotiations, rate benchmarking, and performance reviews. Ensure multiple sources are developed for critical materials and specialized works. Monitor vendor performance against Quality, Cost, Delivery, Service, and Compliance parameters. Maintain professional vendor relationships while ensuring strict adherence to company commercial policies. 
 7. Cost Control & Commercial Management: 
 Drive cost savings through competitive bidding, negotiations, market benchmarking, alternate sourcing, value engineering, and long-term rate contracts. Ensure procurement and contracts remain within approved budgets and management guidelines. Analyse market trends, price movements, and supply conditions and provide recommendations to management. Identify opportunities for cost reduction without compromising quality or project requirements. Control variations, additional costs, and commercial deviations during contract execution. Maintain proper documentation and commercial records for all procurement and contracts. 
 8. Coordination, Reporting & MIS: 
 Coordinate closely with Projects, Planning, Design, Architecture, Marketing, Finance, P&M, Stores, and Management. Monitor procurement and contract status against project requirements and committed timelines. Track pending PRs, enquiries, quotations, negotiations, approvals, purchase orders, work orders, deliveries, and contract closures. Prepare periodic MIS covering: Procurement Status Cost Savings Pending Requirements Vendor/Contractor Status Contract Progress Variations and Claims Capex Procurement Status Ensure compliance with company procurement policies, approval procedures, SAP processes, and internal controls.

Develop talent and succession capability for the hospital business.

 6. Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Management
 
Partner closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Marketing, Medical, Sales and Digital teams to deliver business objectives.

Drive effective coordination between commercial strategy and operational execution.

Represent the organisation at relevant hospital forums, industry platforms, conferences and strategic customer engagements.

Ensure adherence to company policies, compliance standards and established SOPs.

Use business intelligence and performance dashboards to identify opportunities, track execution and improve productivity.

description:
Job Title: Hardware Design Engineer Experience 1015 Years Location Pune Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Hardware Design Engineer with 1015 years of experience in telecom product development. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in analog and digital hardware design, power supply design, high-speed PCB design, and hardware debugging. The role involves developing new telecom products, enhancing existing products, managing component obsolescence, and driving cost optimization initiatives. Key Responsibilities Design and develop hardware for telecom products from concept through production. Re-engineer and enhance existing products to improve performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Perform hardware bring-up, debugging, validation, and root cause analysis. Design and optimize analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuits. Develop and validate power supply circuits for telecom applications. Knowledge of EMI/EMC design practices and compliance requirements. Strong hardware debugging and troubleshooting skills using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other laboratory instruments. Familiarity with component selection, derating, reliability, and lifecycle/obsolescence management. Understanding of DFM, DFT, and product qualification processes. Preferred Skills Experience in telecom networking equipment or communication products. Knowledge of TEC (Telecommunication Engineering Centre) requirements and certification processes. description:

JOB PURPOSE To manage and control Quantity Surveying, project billing, cost estimation, contract administration and commercial activities for real estate projects, ensuring accurate measurement, timely certification of bills, effective cost control and compliance with contractual terms. 2. Prepare and verify detailed quantity take-offs and BOQs for civil, structural and finishing works. Conduct quantity reconciliation against approved drawings, BOQ and actual site execution. Billing & Certification Review and certify contractor/sub-contractor RA bills based on actual site measurements and contractual terms. Monitor contractor compliance with contractual obligations, milestones and payment terms. Handle variation orders, extra items, substituted items and deviations . Evaluate contractors' claims and recommend appropriate commercial settlements. Review and assess EOT, escalation, rate analysis and other contractual claims . Maintain proper records of contract amendments, correspondence, approvals and commercial commitments. Support resolution of contractual disputes and commercial issues with contractors. D. Cost Control & Commercial Management Monitor project expenditure against approved budgets and identify cost overruns. Prepare cost-to-complete and forecast reports for ongoing projects. Analyze project cost trends and highlight potential financial risks to management. Conduct rate analysis for new, extra and substituted items. Support value engineering initiatives to optimize project cost without compromising quality. Maintain project-wise commitment, expenditure and balance cost statements. E. Coordination & MIS Coordinate with Project, Engineering, Planning, Procurement, Finance and Accounts teams. Provide regular commercial and billing MIS to senior management. Prepare reports on project billing, contractor payments, variations, commitments and cost status. Ensure proper documentation and audit readiness of all commercial records. Ability to read and interpret civil/architectural drawings. Strong negotiation, coordination and communication skills. Ability to independently manage commercial activities for multiple projects. Strong attention to detail and documentation skills. 4. EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENT 1012 years of relevant experience in Quantity Surveying, Billing and Contracts. Candidates should have substantial experience in real estate / residential / commercial construction projects . Experience in handling contractor/sub-contractor billing, contracts, variations and project cost control is essential. Experience of working with reputed real estate developers or construction companies will be preferred. 5. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION Essential: B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering from a recognized university/institute. Preferred: Additional qualification/certification in Quantity Surveying, Contracts Management, Construction Management or Commercial Management. 6. KEY DELIVERABLES Accurate and timely contractor/sub-contractor bill certification. Effective quantity and cost control. Timely closure of variations and commercial claims. Accurate project cost forecasting and MIS. Effective contract administration and documentation. Reduction/control of project commercial risks and cost overruns. title: Sr Logistics Coordinator
description:
Senior Logistics Coordinator - Job Description Role: Senior Logistics Coordinator
Department: Logistics
Location: Mumbai Role Overview Responsible for managing end-to-end logistics operations for clinical samples and materials, ensuring timely, compliant and cost-effective execution. The role will also manage the Logistics Coordinator team, coordinate with vendors and internal stakeholders, and drive operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities 1. Logistics Operations Oversee sample collection, movement, handover and delivery across locations. Ensure timely execution as per defined TATs, SLAs and SOPs. Monitor delays, exceptions and escalations and ensure timely closure. 2. Team Management Manage and supervise the Logistics Coordinator team. Allocate shifts, responsibilities and workloads. Monitor team performance, productivity and adherence to SOPs. Train and support team members and handle operational escalations. 3. Vendor Partner Management Coordinate with logistics and collection partners for daily operations. Monitor vendor performance, service quality and SLA adherence. Support vendor and route optimization to improve efficiency and cost. 4. Inventory Material Management Monitor availability and movement of logistics materials and consumables. Coordinate replenishment and maintain accurate inventory records. Ensure proper handling of temperature-sensitive materials where applicable. 5. MIS, Cost Performance Tracking Maintain logistics trackers, dashboards and operational MIS. Monitor TAT, pending cases, exceptions, vendor performance and logistics costs. Support cost tracking, reconciliation and identification of cost-saving opportunities. 6. Cross-functional Coordination Coordinate with Sales, Command Center, Laboratory, Finance and Operations teams. Ensure smooth communication and handovers across teams and shifts. Manage urgent and high-priority logistics requirements. 7. Process Improvement Ensure adherence to logistics SOPs and documentation requirements. Identify operational gaps and implement corrective actions. Improve processes, workflows and tracking mechanisms as the business scales. Candidate Profile 2-3 years of experience in logistics, healthcare logistics, sample logistics, supply chain or operations. Experience in team coordination or people management preferred. Strong coordination, communication and problem-solving skills. Good knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets and MIS. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and time-sensitive operations. Experience in diagnostics, pathology, healthcare or clinical sample logistics is an advantage.

title: International Customer Support Specialist
description:
International Customer Support Specialist
 Chennai, India 
 At Vendasta, we re leading the AI revolution from Saskatoon to Chennai-and beyond. We work together to empower our partners and customers through our AI-powered customer acquisition and engagement platform to help them get more customers and keep them. We re proud to share that Vendasta has officially been named one of Canada s Most Admired Corporate Cultures! 
 We re looking for an International Customer Support Specialist who is energized by delivering outstanding omnichannel customer service and technical support with speed, accuracy, and delight. In this role, you will act as a trusted expert of Vendasta s platform, fostering a customer-first environment, adopting advanced AI support tools, and ensuring that every single customer interaction adds value and strengthens trust. 
 Your Impact As an International Customer Support Specialist, youll work with customer support teams, product managers, and customers to: Deliver Omnichannel Support: Serve as the primary touchpoint for customer inquiries, providing timely, empathetic, and accurate resolution across phone, email, chat, and video calls. Drive Efficiency via AI Fluency: Consistently integrate approved AI tools (e.g., suggestion bots, summarizers, and response tools) into your daily workflows to reduce resolution times, maximize accuracy, and maintain a one-touch solve rate of 68% or higher . Own Knowledge Process Updates: Maintain, update, and verify internal and customer-facing documentation-including validating AI-generated draft updates-to ensure resource accuracy reflects the latest platform changes. Advocate for the Customer: Gather real-time customer feedback, input trends into internal AI systems, conduct product walkthroughs, and participate in sprint reviews to proactively champion the customer experience and support platform evolution. Deliver Strategic Metrics: Track and improve Key Performance Indicators-such as Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), first response time, AI tool usage compliance, and the accuracy of AI tagging-to meet organizational performance benchmarks.

 What You Bring to the Table You bring 1-2 years of experience in customer service, support, or a related field, ideally within a SaaS or fast-paced technology environment. You possess dtrong Technical Ability. You possess strong written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical platform issues into warm, clear, and actionable solutions for customers. You have a basic understanding of AI-driven workflows and feel confident navigating AI-powered assistance tools (prior exposure to automation tools or AI chat interfaces is a strong asset). You are highly proficient with customer support platforms (such as Zendesk or Intercom) and have an analytical aptitude for triaging tickets based on severity and time sensitivity. You have a proven track record of multitasking and prioritizing in a dynamic, high-volume environment while maintaining a solution-oriented mindset. You have a strong technical aptitude for identifying software bugs, gathering context, conducting troubleshooting screen-shares, and escalating issues appropriately. 
 About Vendasta We help businesses get more customers. And keep them. Vendasta is an AI-powered customer acquisition and engagement platform for SMBs and the partners who support them, streamlining marketing, sales, and operations through intelligent AI employees, automation, and real-time actions and insights. From creating awareness to nurturing lasting customer relationships, Vendasta offers a suite of solutions with AI assistants that streamline every stage of the customer journey. By combining a businesss unique data with AI and automation, Vendasta simplifies marketing, sales, and operations, eliminating the need for multiple disjointed systems. 
 Perks At Vendasta, you ll work alongside driven, curious teammates in a culture rooted in Drive, Innovation, Respect, and Agility, solving meaningful problems that shape the future of local business. We invest deeply in your development through continuous learning opportunities, hands-on exposure to emerging technologies, in-house training, education reimbursement, and leadership development programs designed to help you grow as the world evolves. We support this growth with flexibility, wellness benefits, and an environment that trusts you to do your best work - whether that s learning something new, taking on bigger challenges, or building the next chapter of your career. At Vendasta, you re not just keeping up with change. You re growing with it. Health insurance benefits Paid Time Off (PTO) Night Shift Premium Provident Fund Cab Facilities Free snacks, hot beverages, and catered lunches on Fridays

 Discover your potential. Build something that matters. Join the AI revolution from right here in Chennai.

title: Sales Officer LAP
description:
Group Company: AU Small Finance Bank Limited Designation: Sales Officer MBL 
 
 Job Summary 
 Position description: Generate fresh Business and service existing clients 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Achieve assigned targets for sales regular collection Conduct Marketing activities, leafleting , Canopy etc to identify new sources of business Handle customer queries, build up customer relationship and develop brand value in the market Attend customer queries and provide resolution Co-ordinate with Operations Collection department for customer onboarding and servicing Conduct physical verification of customer's residence, business and any other asset crucial from credit point of view and taking photographs. Follow instructions frm seniors, coordinate with internal teams for getting visit reports done. Visit customers for first FI and meeting, and also accompany seniors to customer's place for visit and verification. Conduct physical verification of credit related documents like ITR, Bank statement, receipts, ledger and property documents - doing OSV ( Original Seen and verified) of documents. Prepare basic CAM ( Credit Appraisal Memo) Take reference check of customers from local market and existing customers. Follow policies procedure as laid down by the bank. Portfolio Management - visit delinquent cases, collect EMIs of delinquent cases in collaboration with collections team. Maintain and stop early delinquency , Non-starter cases in portfolio, decide the treatment of such cases wisely. Maintain least OTC / PDD pendency and ensure timely clearance of the same. Maintain non-RPDC portfolio - ensure all cases of portfolio are ACH. Maintain and collect fresh bouncing cases EMI with charges as mentioned in policy, Correct the operational errors and get 100% cases repayment in Non-PDC mode. Collect fresh data from open marketing activities for tele calling and self sourcing. Follow leads so generated from data received from telemarketing team Complete documentation, file agreements, formats and other formalities for disbursement of cases Clear queries from credit, Ops, Legal, Valuation etc. Timely submit daily MIS and sourcing data to reporting authority 
 
 Additional Responsibilities 
 Provide true and fair opinion based on customer's interaction. Clear queries of customers - clarify final ROI, Fees, Charges, and all other terms of the case Do not get involved in any financial/non-financial transaction with the customer Maintain decency and good behaviour while dealing with the customer, visiting property, especially while taking photos of the house and surroundings with permission of the customer. Conduct customer reference checks with utmost sincerity and maturity - goodwill of the client should not be hampered - not disclose any financial or personal information of existing / new clients with any ( existing / prospective clients ) or any 3rd party 
 
 Required work experience 
 Industry: BFSI Role: Sales Executive, Sales Officer, Customer Service Executive/Officer, Relationship Executive/Officer Years of experience: 0 to 3 
 
 Key Performance Indicators 
 Business Volume Average Ticket size Boarding rate 
 
 Required Competencies 
 Ownership and accountability for results Customer-centric mindset and actions Adept at handling digital business apps and software Hard work and detail-orientation Eager to learn and grow as a banking professional Positive mindset, ethical and high integrity Bias for Action and Urgency 
 
 Required Knowledge 
 Aptitude for lead generation Target Market Knowledge - Local Area geography familiarity Familiarity with Digital applications Detailed data collection/recording 
 
 Required Skills 
 Professional Communication - Regional language proficiency, verbal and written fluency, soft-spoken Relationship Management - Client-Centric Approach, respectful Sales Forecasting Reporting 
 
 Required abilities 
 Physical: Physical fitness Physical: Mental agility Physical: Ability to do extensive field travel/work Physical: Ability to handle work pressure and demanding clients Other: Valid Two-Wheeler Driving License Other: Personal 2-wheeler Other: Own Smartphone Other: track record of past employment Other: Positive reference check and clear civil report 
 
 Work Environment Details 
 90% - Field, 10% - Office 
 
 Specific requirements 
 Travel: High Vehicle: 2-wheeler Work Permit: 
 
 Other details

ID Card, SIM, Marketing material, digital devices, Receipt book etc.
