title: Full Time Permanent Work From Home - Customer Support and Sales
description:
Permanent Work From Home | Domestic Process | Healthcare Diagnostics 
 We are an authorised all-India sales partner for Thyrocare, India's largest diagnostic lab. This is a permanent work-from-home role no office visits, no relocation, open to candidates in any city in India. 
 Please read the schedule carefully before applying. 
 This role is 6 days a week, 10 hours a day, on rotational shifts. If that doesn't suit you, this is not the right role and we'd rather you know now. 
 Shift timings (rotational, assigned as per business requirement): 7:00 AM 5:00 PM 9:00 AM 7:00 PM 12:00 PM 10:00 PM One weekly off, on a rotational day, communicated in advance. Weekends are working days. 
 Role & responsibilities Handle customer queries on call and WhatsApp and convert them into confirmed bookings this is a sales-led support role, not a query-closing desk. Understand each customer's requirements in detail and recommend the right health checkup package as per the pre-defined SOPs only. Own every customer end to end — from first enquiry to order booking to sample collection to final report delivery. No handoffs, no dropped threads. Follow the process exactly as documented. Ask when information is missing rather than assuming. Maintain accurate order and customer records. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Minimum 1 year of voice-based customer support or tele sales experience. Freshers please do not apply. Fluent verbal and written communication in English and Hindi . Ability to understand what a customer actually needs, not just what they ask for. Comfortable with Excel, Word, WhatsApp and email. Good negotiation skills. Own laptop in excellent working condition, wired broadband connection, and power backup covering laptop and router for the full shift. A dedicated workspace at home with zero background noise and zero interruptions. Candidates with a career gap, and women returning to work after a break, are welcome to apply. 
 Salary & benefits Fixed: 18,000 – 23,000 per month in hand , based on English fluency and relevant experience. Monthly performance incentive: up to 10,000 . Loyalty bonus: 6,000 on completion of every 6 months. Realistic earning potential: 25,000 – 30,000 per month. Salary credited to your bank account every month. Detailed hands-on training provided. This is a permanent role and we are looking for people who want to stay and grow with us. 
 How to apply 
 Apply through Naukri, or email your CV to thyrocare@live.com or thyromail@gmail.com . 
 In your email or Naukri message, mention: (1) your Laptop RAM, (2) your power backup arrangement. Applications without these details will not be shortlisted.

title: Customer support travel specialist
description:
Customer support travel specialist 
Our philosophy for customer service is simple: Listen to the customer. Understand their needs. Take ownership. Solve the problem. When a customer contacts Miraee, you take the responsibility till the need is addressed or the issue is solved. You will own urgent disruptions, complex multi-leg trips, VIP requests, and edge cases the AI agents couldn't resolve. Our customers include CEOs, CFOs, senior executives, executive assistants, and frequent business travelers with urgent and complex travel needs. 
 You will own four KPIs: First-Response Time (FRT) Resolution Time Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) Ownership Rate End-to-End Issue Resolution 
 What you will do Handle flight changes, cancellations, rebooking, delays, missed connections, and other travel disruptions especially last-minute and complex requests. Book domestic and international flights, hotels, car rentals, rail, airport transfers, and ground transportation when the frequent travelers are in need. Flag recurring pain points and agent failure patterns to Product and Engineering so the AI improves - you are a key input to our product feedback loop. Support travelers with check-in, seat and upgrade requests, and hotel needs such as early check-in and late checkout. Assist with restaurant bookings, private dinners, meetings, conferences, and other business travel needs. Understand the traveler's schedule and recommend the best available option. Work directly with airlines, hotels, and travel partners to resolve customer issues. Support customers across phone, chat, email, and messaging; keep them updated until the issue is fully resolved. Escalate account-level or program-level issues to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager; you own the traveler, they own the account. 
 Experience needed 3 - 5 years in corporate travel, business travel, airline ticketing, travel agency, or travel customer support. Hands-on experience with at least one GDS: Sabre, Amadeus, Apollo, Galileo, or Travelport. Experience handling US domestic and international travel. Experience supporting business travelers, senior executives, VIPs, or frequent travelers. Strong understanding of flight bookings, changes, cancellations, exchanges, refunds, and fare rules. Experience handling travel disruptions and last-minute changes. Prior experience at a corporate travel desk or travel management company preferred. 
 Skills we value Excellent spoken and written English. Strong attention to detail. Sound problem-solving and decision-making. Comfortable with demanding travelers with complex needs. Able to manage multiple customer requests simultaneously. Takes ownership instead of passing problems along. Comfortable with travel technology and quick to learn new systems including working alongside AI agents.

description:

 DIGITAL MARKETING EXECUTIVE PERFORMANCE MARKETING & SEO 
 Company: Fintellect Associates
 Location: Bangalore
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Experience: 13 Years
 Department: Digital Marketing & Lead Generation
 About Fintellect Associates 
Fintellect Associates is a growing professional training and career services organization specializing in Practical Accounting & Taxation Training, Accounting Services, Placement Services and employability-focused programs.
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to take complete ownership of our digital marketing activities and lead-generation campaigns.
 Role Overview 
Our social media platforms, basic optimization, advertising setup and lead funnel have already been established with the support of a digital marketing agency. The selected candidate will take over the existing setup and be responsible for SEO, Google Ads, paid campaigns, lead generation, campaign optimization and digital performance tracking.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Google Ads & Paid Campaigns 
 Plan, create and manage Google Search, Display and other relevant Google Ads campaigns. Conduct keyword research and identify high-intent keywords. Create and optimize campaigns for course admissions and business lead generation. Manage campaign budgets and improve CPL, conversion rate and ROI. Monitor search terms, negative keywords, CTR, CPC and conversions. Continuously A/B test ad copies, keywords, landing pages and campaigns. Identify opportunities to scale successful campaigns. 2. SEO 
 Develop and execute an SEO strategy for the company's website and landing pages. Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis. Implement on-page SEO, including titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking and content optimization. Work on technical SEO and identify website issues affecting rankings. Develop and execute off-page SEO and quality backlink strategies. Improve organic traffic, keyword rankings and lead generation. Coordinate with content writers/web developers wherever required. 3. Lead Generation & Funnel Management 
 Manage and optimize existing lead-generation funnels. Monitor leads generated through Google Ads, social media and website. Track lead quality and conversion performance. Work closely with the admission/sales team to improve lead-to-admission conversion. Identify drop-offs in the funnel and recommend improvements. Create campaign-wise performance reports. 4. Social Media Management 
 Take ownership of the existing social media setup. Coordinate with graphic designers/content creators for regular posts, reels and promotional creatives. Plan content calendars based on business objectives. Monitor engagement and identify opportunities for organic growth. Support paid social media campaigns when required. 5. Analytics & Reporting 
 Set up and manage Google Analytics and Google Search Console. Monitor website traffic, user behaviour and conversions. Track campaign performance using appropriate analytics and reporting tools. Prepare weekly/monthly digital marketing performance reports. Provide actionable recommendations based on campaign data. Required Skills 
 Google Ads Google Analytics / GA4 Google Search Console SEO & Keyword Research Google Tag Manager Landing Page & Conversion Optimization Lead Generation Meta Ads / Facebook & Instagram Ads Basic knowledge of WordPress/CMS Google Sheets/Excel Competitor Research & Digital Marketing Analytics Preferred Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, Commerce or a related field. 13 years of hands-on digital marketing experience. Candidates with experience in education, training, coaching, recruitment or lead-generation businesses will be preferred. What We Are Looking For 
We are looking for someone who is hands-on and performance-oriented, not someone who only coordinates with agencies. The candidate should be able to:
 Take ownership of digital marketing activities. Independently manage Google Ads campaigns. Build and execute an SEO strategy. Generate quality leads within the allocated budget. Analyse campaign data and make decisions based on performance. Continuously test and improve campaigns. Work closely with the sales/admission team to improve conversions. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Qualified leads generated Cost per lead (CPL) Google Ads conversion rate Lead-to-admission conversion Advertising ROI/ROAS Website organic traffic SEO keyword rankings Organic leads generated Landing-page conversion rate Overall digital marketing performance

title: Head Digital Marketing
description:
Role & responsibilities The Head of Digital Marketing owns the growth and profitability of Ahujasons digital business. That means the e-commerce store, the corporate gifting demand engine, and the brand presence that feeds both. The person is accountable for revenue and return on ad spend, and equally for building a team and a system that keeps producing results without depending on any one individual. This is not a hands-off strategy role. The person will still get into ad accounts, still read the numbers themselves, and still write creative briefs. The difference from the current setup is leadership: the ability to direct a content team toward creative that actually converts, to develop people, and to run the function with discipline through a highly seasonal business cycle. Annual media budget under management 
 Approximately Rs. 65 lakh to Rs. 90 lakh. Current run rate is Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 20,000 per day on e-commerce and Rs. 3,000 to Rs. 5,000 per day on corporate gifting, with seasonal swings. Budget is not the constraint; return on it is. Revenue lines owned 
 E-commerce (own Shopify store, no marketplaces) and corporate gifting lead generation. Combined digital-led revenue to be confirmed by Finance before the role is offered. Channels 
 Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, email marketing, WhatsApp marketing, LinkedIn and Lusha outbound, organic social. Direct reports 
 Social Media Manager. Content team of photographer, video editor and graphic designer. Functional coordination with the web developer and the e-commerce operations team. Indirect scope 
 Shopify storefront experience, product listing quality, order status visibility, inbound enquiry handling. Reports to 
 Director, Digital Divisions. 
 Preferred candidate profile Essential 8 to 12 years in digital marketing, with at least 3 years leading a team of five or more. Direct, hands-on ownership of Meta Ads and Google Ads accounts at a monthly spend of Rs. 5 lakh or above. Agency oversight alone is not sufficient; we need someone who has been accountable for the number, not for the client relationship. Proven experience running a Shopify or comparable D2C store as a revenue line, including conversion rate work, not only traffic acquisition. Demonstrated ability to brief and direct creative teams. The candidate should be able to explain, with examples, how they turned a creative idea into a measurable performance result. B2B or corporate lead generation experience, ideally including LinkedIn and outbound tooling. Practical AI fluency: routine use of AI tools for creative production, copy, campaign analysis, reporting and automation, with specific examples of workflows they have built and what those workflows saved or earned. Comfort with a seasonal, inventory-led business where demand concentrates into a few months. Preferred Background in fashion, apparel, accessories, gifting, jewellery or a comparable visual-led category. Exposure to a family-run or promoter-led business, where influence matters more than formal authority. Experience with email and WhatsApp retention marketing, not just acquisition. SEO depth, including technical SEO on Shopify. Remuneration shall not be a limiting factor for the right candidate

description:
OpenLM India Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a Cyber Security Specialist to lead and manage information security, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and related governance activities across the organization. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Information Security Management Systems (ISMS), IT security and compliance standards, risk management, vulnerability management, incident response, IT Asset Management (ITAM), Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and security documentation . The role will also involve supporting and maintaining security certifications and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR , while working closely with internal teams, customers, prospects, and global stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities ISMS Management Design, implement, maintain, and continuously improve an effective Information Security Management System (ISMS) aligned with organizational requirements. Develop and manage information security policies, procedures, processes, controls, and supporting documentation. Ensure effective implementation and monitoring of security controls across relevant business and technology functions. IT Asset & Risk Management Manage and maintain IT Asset Management (ITAM) processes and associated security controls. Identify, assess, document, and manage information security risks. Support risk mitigation activities and track remediation of identified security gaps. Contribute to effective Change Management processes from an information security perspective. Cyber Security Assessment Conduct regular cybersecurity and security control assessments to identify potential threats, risks, and control weaknesses. Recommend and implement appropriate corrective and preventive measures. Monitor the effectiveness of security controls and drive continuous security improvement. Threat & Vulnerability Management Proactively identify, assess, prioritize, and manage security threats and vulnerabilities. Coordinate remediation activities and follow up on identified vulnerabilities. Help minimize the potential business and technical impact of cybersecurity threats. Privacy Assessment & Management Support privacy assessments and ongoing privacy management activities. Ensure information security and privacy practices align with applicable regulations, contractual requirements, and industry best practices. Assist in identifying and addressing privacy-related risks and compliance gaps. Incident Response Document, manage, and track information security incidents. Support investigation, response, root-cause analysis, and remediation of security incidents. Implement and monitor corrective actions to address identified security gaps and prevent recurrence. Documentation & Compliance Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for IT security policies, procedures, standards, processes, and controls. Ensure security documentation remains accurate, current, and audit-ready. Support internal and external audits and compliance activities. Customer & Prospect Security Questionnaires Complete customer and prospect security questionnaires accurately and within required timelines. Coordinate with relevant internal teams to gather technical, security, compliance, and operational information. Analyze customer security requirements and identify potential compliance or security improvement opportunities. Security Compliance & Continuous Improvement Review customer, prospect, and regulatory security requirements. Identify opportunities to improve OpenLM's security posture and compliance with applicable standards. Support the implementation and continuous improvement of security controls, policies, and processes. Security Certifications & Compliance Frameworks Prepare, coordinate, and guide the organization through maintaining relevant security certifications and compliance frameworks. Support activities related to ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR , and other applicable security and privacy standards. Maintain evidence, documentation, control records, and other requirements necessary for certification and compliance activities. Required Qualifications & Experience Experience in cybersecurity, information security, IT security, security compliance, or a similar role . Strong understanding of key IT security and compliance standards/frameworks . Experience developing and maintaining process and security documentation . Strong understanding of networking, firewalls, and antivirus/security solutions . Experience with IT Asset Management (ITAM) . Experience with Business Continuity Planning (BCP) . Understanding of risk management, security assessments, and compliance processes. Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and coordination skills. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and global teams. Good to Have Knowledge of industry-standard security frameworks and best practices. Experience with ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR , or similar compliance frameworks. Experience in a similar cybersecurity/information security role within the technology or software industry . Exposure to vulnerability management, incident response, privacy management, and security audits. What We Offer Competitive salary commensurate with experience. title: TL-Enrollment & Billing
description:
**Job Summary**
 This role focuses on managing complex enrollment and billing activities within a commercial insurance environment using Facets membership capabilities ensuring accurate member data timely billing cycles and high operational reliability. The professional will work from office in a night shift model driving quality outcomes process improvements and consistent service for clients and members while collaborating closely with cross functional partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage end to end enrollment and billing operations in a commercial insurance environment ensuring accurate member creation maintenance and termination activities aligned with client policies and regulatory standards.
* Coordinate daily Facets membership processing tasks including new enrollments updates reinstatements and coverage changes to maintain reliable eligibility records and downstream billing accuracy.
* Monitor billing cycles premium calculations and invoice generation activities to identify discrepancies early and drive timely resolution thereby supporting predictable revenue recognition for the organization.
* Analyze complex enrollment and billing issues in Facets membership and commercial insurance enrollments diagnose root causes and recommend practical remediation steps that prevent recurrence and support operational stability.
* Collaborate with operations finance and configuration teams to clarify benefit structures group setups and product rules so that enrollment data and billing outputs remain aligned with contractual commitments and client expectations.
* Develop and update standard operating procedures for enrollment and billing processes ensuring documentation reflects current commercial insurance practices Facets membership configurations and control checkpoints.
* Perform regular quality checks and reconciliation of member records billing files and payment postings to detect gaps between source data and system outputs driving corrective actions that protect data integrity and customer trust.
* Provide detailed status reporting on nightly batch runs production issues and backlog items in enrollment and billing enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions about priorities and resource allocation.
* Support incident and defect management by validating reported problems in Facets membership and enrollment workflows preparing clear analysis notes and partnering with technical teams for timely fixes.
* Guide process optimization efforts that streamline enrollment intake mapping and validation steps reducing manual touch points and improving turnaround time for commercial groups and individual members.
* Coordinate user acceptance validation for changes impacting enrollment and billing rules crafting realistic test scenarios based on commercial insurance use cases to confirm that system updates work as intended.
* Engage with internal clients and business partners to understand upcoming plan changes group additions and billing requirements translating those needs into precise enrollment processing tasks and timelines.
* Uphold compliance with relevant commercial insurance regulations and internal audit controls across all enrollment and billing operations ensuring documentation and system evidence are maintained for review.


**Qualifications**
* Possess strong applied experience in Facets membership functions including configuration awareness enrollment transactions and eligibility data management in a commercial insurance setting.
* Demonstrate deep practical knowledge of commercial insurance enrollment processes such as group and member setup coverage tier changes qualifying events and related billing dependencies.
* Apply solid understanding of medical insurance billing concepts including premium calculation logic invoice cycles grace periods and reconciliation practices to support accurate financial outcomes.
* Use analytical abilities and attention to detail to interpret enrollment source files identify data issues and design validation checks that improve overall data quality for downstream systems.
* Bring experience working in structured operations environments with night shift schedules maintaining productivity adherence to timelines and consistent coordination with cross site partners.
* Exhibit capability to document procedures create clear operational notes and communicate complexities in enrollment and billing processes to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.


**Certifications Required**
 Preferred certifications include health insurance specialist certification or professional training in Facets administration or payer operations.

title: What being a Care Buddy means at Prayojana?
description:
The Care Buddy will be the first point of contact and the face of the Prayojana. More importantly, they will participate in supporting their assigned members with the same level of empathy and warmth that the member's own children would have
   

  

**The Care Buddy’s Primary Role Will Be To**
* Check on the members assigned to her/him on their day to day well being
* Help out with errands – like bank\-related work, basic groceries or vegetable procurement
* Schedule appointments for doctor visits \& accompany them for such
* Schedule periodic lab visits as required
* Help members handle any technology\-related issues, like setting up Whatsapp, fixing internet issues, using social media (Facebook, Instagram), etc.
* Visit the member at least once in a week or as frequently as required, to check their needs \& help them accordingly
* Educate them on the process of emergency management, how to call, what to do etc.
* In case of an emergency
* report to the hospital \& co\-ordinate or facilitate the treatment
* keep all stakeholders informed on the status
* Update medical records in Prayojana Health App from time to time
* Monitor medicine inventory \& help in ordering refills
* Be a friend to the member, accompany them for walks once in a week
* Accompany them to social events, concerts as per requests
* Organize tickets for events like music concerts, movie, drama if needed
* Arrange \& co\-ordinate transportation needs for the members for them to go to such events/family functions


 A Care Buddy will be assigned a maximum of 10 members to assist at most simultaneously
   

  

**Who can be a Care Buddy?**
 Our Requirements
   

  

* Should be a person with a high level of integrity \& trustworthiness
* Should be independent \& willing to be available to take emergency calls 24x7
* Should demonstrate a high level of empathy \& patience, willing to listen, be polite, softspoken, punctual \& stick to commitments
* Be willing to go the extra mile to keep seniors happy, comfortable and without worry about how to manage their day\-to\-day life
* Should have experience using web and mobile\-based applications with basic computer and internet knowledge
* Should have a personal two\-wheeler (bike/scooter)


**Nice to have**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Social Work would be a big plus

 TDO need to own any issues related to site availability and drive through the resolution and have the accountability to make necessary changes to fix issues and bring the sites backup online and make sure customer experience is seamless, execute recovery levers during outages, configuration mishaps, and DR situations. leverage technical experience to keep critical systems running through any event.
   

  

 The Technical Duty Officer (TDO) is responsible for the availability and performance of our global sites. The TDO will take command and control of Major Incidents focusing on restoration by identifying and coordinating with appropriate resources through all the phases of triage, restoration and validation. Technically you will understand the full end to end stack and use this knowledge to detect and lead a team through incident response. Excellent judgement is crucial as you will provide final approval on site changes and hold critical switches for functionality of the site. You will ensure all documentation surrounding the Major Incidents are accurate and communication with the leadership team is clear and complete. Your ability to continuously challenge yourself and develop a strong network with peers and stakeholders cross functionally will see you exceed in this role. Our goal is to protect the customer experience and deliver outstanding levels of availability.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

 Architecture Acumen: Requires knowledge of: Architectural principles; Systems and environment behavior; Architectural Styles, Patterns and plans; Architectural standards; Non\-functional System performance parameters; Technology Strategy.
   

  

 Defect Management and Troubleshooting: Requires knowledge of: Defect life\-cycle process, defect tracking tools and methodologies; Defect reporting; Regression testing; Root cause analysis; Root cause corrective action. To conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and root cause corrective action (RCCA) to identify the origin of defects/ performance gaps and prevent them from recurring. Track registered issues for the product/solution and prioritize them for resolution. Measure usability of the product/solution as per customer/business requirement after defect fixing and plugging test gaps. Analyze the issues and plan a series of steps which potentially includes reconfiguration, integration, removal or addition of application components to enhance the application's functionality, usability and security.
   

  

 DevOps Orientation: Requires knowledge of: Different operating systems; Software maintenance tools and techniques; Application monitoring tools and techniques; Debugging tools; Mock screen; Pseudocodes; Reverse Engineering; Traceability matrix; System performance, security, integration; Data migration and accessibility; Design Methodologies.
   

  

 Agentic AI framework—requires a shift from passive monitoring to active, autonomous oversight of digitalisation.
   

  

 The core requirement is managing "human\-in\-the\-loop" systems where AI agents plan and execute tasks, while the TDO ensures alignment with business goals, security, and safety.
   

  

 Prompt Engineering and Evaluation: Proficiency in designing prompts that enable agents to act reliably and setting up evaluation frameworks for monitoring performance.
   

  

 Requirement And Scoping Analysis: Requires knowledge of: Traceability matrix; Risk analysis methodologies; Cost Analysis; Business objectives; Classification of requirements; User stories To explore relevant products/solutions from an existing repertoire, that can address business/technical needs.
   

  

 Strong and demonstrable incident management skills with relevant experience in an enterprise organization.
   

  

 Methodical and systematic problem solving approach, combined with a solid awareness of ownership, initiative and drive.
   

  

 Experience investigating, analysing and troubleshooting large scale enterprise systems.
   

  

 Understanding of Unix/Linux systems from kernel to shell and beyond, taking in system libraries, file systems, and client\-server protocols along the way.
   

  

 Experience working with and developing enterprise monitoring/tooling solutions like Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana, Splunk, Graphite, Dynatrace, catchpoint.
   

  

 Working knowledge of one or more cloud technologies such as AZURE, GCP and OpenStack.
   

  

 Expert verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Demonstrate excellent judgement in decision making.
   

  

 Strong focus on collecting and inferring metrics.
   

  

 Excellent communication skills
   

  

 What You’ll bring
   

  

 10\-14 years in an infrastructure, systems, engineering or development environment delivering operational excellence to highly complex distributed systems.
   

  

 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or relevant work experience of 10\+ years.
   

  

 Experience and exposure working in a 24/7 operations support environment.
   

  

 Working and technical expertise in K8 and microservice architectures.
   

  

 Experience administering Unix/Linux in a production environment.
   

  

 Ability to supervise the Site Reliability Operations team, mentor and provide guidance.
   

  

 Working knowledge of BASH, Python, AI or other scripting languages
   

  

 Utilize AI\-powered monitoring and anomaly detection tools to predict potential failures and resource bottlenecks before they impact users.
   

  

 Ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of infrastructure specifically designed for AI/ML workloads,
   

  

 Networking knowledge and understanding of network concepts, such as different protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, etc.), MAC addresses, IP packets, DNS, OSI layers, and load balancing).

**About Us:**

**Job Description:**
**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**
 At Barry\-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.
   

  

 What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well\-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.

The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry\-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.

* Ownership – Drive features end\-to\-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results\-oriented environment that respects your time.

 At Barry\-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world\-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts.  If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high\-impact, future\-focused environment—where long\-term stability meets start\-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 The Senior Controls Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and lifecycle management of software for industrial automation and control systems. This role involves developing PLC, HMI/SCADA, motion control, and industrial communication solutions while collaborating with cross\-functional teams throughout the complete project lifecycle—from concept and design through commissioning and customer support.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in PLC programming, HMI/SCADA development, industrial networking, and machine automation
 **using Siemens, Beckhoff, Bosch Rexroth, B\&R automation platforms or a combination of these automation platforms.**
**Essential duties and responsibilities:**
* Design and develop machine control software for custom automation systems from concept through commissioning.
* Develop PLC, HMI/SCADA, motion control, safety, and industrial communication software.
* Configure and integrate servo drives, VFDs, robotics, vision systems, and field devices.
* Prepare Functional Design Specifications (FDS), I/O lists, software architecture, and technical documentation.
* Perform software testing, debugging, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and customer support.
* Collaborate with Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, and Project Engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* Participate in the review of electrical designs, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ensure compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards.
* Troubleshoot control systems and optimize machine performance.
* Participate in software code reviews and maintain software quality standards.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives, software standardization, and engineering best practices.
* Maintain project schedules and communicate technical progress to project stakeholders.


**Requirements \& Experience**
* Minimum 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in industrial automation, controls development, and machine commissioning.
* Experience designing and implementing control systems for custom automation projects.
* Strong knowledge of PLC programming, HMI/SCADA development, and motion control.
* Experience integrating servo systems, drives, motors, robotics, sensors, and vision systems.
* Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols including:
* Profinet
* EtherCAT
* Ethernet/IP
* Modbus TCP
* OPC UA
* Experience with Safety PLCs and machine safety devices.
* Strong troubleshooting and commissioning skills.
* Experience with software version control and software lifecycle management.
* Ability to prepare technical documentation including:
* Functional Design Specifications
* Software Architecture
* I/O Lists
* User Manuals
* Electrical Documentation
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and customer communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams).


**Education**
* Bachelor's Degree in one of the following disciplines:
* Electronics \& Communication Engineering
* Instrumentation \& Control Engineering
* Mechatronics Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Minimum 8\+ years of relevant experience in industrial automation, controls development, and machine commissioning.


**Key Result Areas:**
* Configure automation hardware and software according to project specifications.
* Develop PLC and HMI applications for custom machine automation.
* Deliver reliable, maintainable, and scalable control software.
* Follow software change management procedures and maintain version control.
* Support FAT, SAT, machine commissioning, and production startup.
* Provide technical support during installation and post\-deployment activities.
* Ensure compliance with engineering standards and customer requirements.
* Deliver assigned projects on time while maintaining quality and customer satisfaction.


**Travel:**
* Domestic and international travel may be required, up to 20%, depending on project requirements.

title: Solution Architect
description:
**Role** 
 : Solution Architect (Python · Cloud\-Native Platforms)
 



**Experience** 
 level required: 10\-16 years
 



**Location** 
 : Chennai, Tamil Nadu/Hybrid
 



**Joining** 
 : Immediate to max 15 days
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Architecture ownership — produce and maintain solution blueprints, HLD documents, and Architecture Decision Records for every significant choice.
* Microservices \& event\-driven design — define service boundaries, inter\-service communication, idempotency, retries, dead\-letter handling, and backpressure using Kafka, Pub/Sub, and EventArc.
* API architecture — design and govern REST APIs, including OpenAPI contracts, versioning strategy, rate limiting, and gateway policy via Apigee.
* Frontend architecture — define the React.js application architecture — component and folder structure, state management, routing, API integration and error handling patterns, authentication flows, build tooling, and performance budgets.
* Security architecture — design OAuth2 and JWT\-based authentication and authorisation, IAM least\-privilege models, Secret Manager usage, and edge protection with Cloud Armor and global load balancing.
* Data architecture — model and optimise PostgreSQL and SQL Server schemas; design BigQuery warehousing, partitioning, clustering, and cost\-efficient analytical pipelines; define caching strategy with Redis and Memorystore.
* Cloud platform design — architect workloads across GKE, Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Cloud Storage, Cloud Logging, and Vertex AI, balancing performance, reliability, and cloud spend.
* AI \& GenAI enablement — define reference architectures for Vertex AI and GenAI workloads, including model serving, RAG patterns, Agentic AI, and Agentic AI SDKs.
* Infrastructure as code — own the Terraform module design, environment promotion strategy, state management, and guardrails.



  





**Technical Skills — Must Have** 




**Languages \& paradigms:** 
 Expert\-level Python 3\.x including AsyncIO, concurrency, and parallel processing; strong command of object\-oriented and functional programming.
 



  





**Frameworks \& APIs:** 
 FastAPI REST framework; REST API design; OAuth2 and JWT authentication; GraphQL and gRPC exposure an advantage.
 



  





**Frontend:** 
 Strong hands\-on React.js — modern hooks, component composition, state management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or React Query), routing, form handling, and REST API integration; solid JavaScript and TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3, responsive design, and frontend build tooling (Vite or Webpack). Able to define frontend architecture standards and review frontend code.
 



  





**Architecture:** 
 Microservices architecture, event\-driven and streaming systems, Kafka, and Google Cloud Pub/Sub and EventArc.
 



  





**Databases \& caching:** 
 PostgreSQL and SQL Server — schema design, query optimisation, indexing, and performance tuning; Redis and Memorystore for caching, sessions, and rate limiting; MySQL exposure.
 



  





**Data \& analytics:** 
 BigQuery for large\-scale warehousing, analytics, and reporting, including partitioning, clustering, and query cost optimisation.
 



  





**Google Cloud Platform:** 
 GKE, Cloud Run, Vertex AI and Gen AI services, Artifact Registry, Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL), Memorystore, Cloud Armor, Global and External Load Balancing, Apigee, Cloud Logging, Cloud Storage buckets, Secret Manager, EventArc, Pub/Sub, and IAM.
 



  





**Containers \& orchestration:** 
 Docker and Kubernetes — image optimisation, autoscaling, resource limits, and health probes.
 



  





**Infrastructure as code:** 
 Terraform.
 



  





**CI/CD:** 
 Tekton and GitHub Actions, with Git\-based branching strategy and cloud deployment best practices.
 



  





**Testing:** 
 Pytest, test\-driven development, and automated quality gates in the pipeline.
 



  





**Observability:** 
 Dynatrace.
 



  





**Ways of working:** 
 Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and the full SDLC.

title: University Guidance and Career Counselling
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



  





 University Guidance \& Career Counsellor – IBDP \& Cambridge A Level
 



 Designation: University Guidance \& Career Counsellor
 



 Reporting To: Head of School / Director
 



 Location: Chennai
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are seeking an experienced University Guidance \& Career Counsellor to lead undergraduate university counselling for students pursuing IBDP and Cambridge A Level. The role will manage the complete student journey from career exploration and profile building to university selection, application, admission and enrolment, across India and international destinations.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Provide individualised university and career counselling from Grade 6 onwards.
* Develop student profiles, career pathways and strategic university application plans.
* Guide students on university selection, including reach, match and safety choices.
* Manage end\-to\-end applications through UCAS, Common App, BridgeU and other international/Indian portals.
* Review and guide students on personal statements, essays, resumes, portfolios, interviews and entrance assessments.
* Advise on SAT, ACT, IELTS, TOEFL, scholarships, financial aid and university\-specific requirements.
* Maintain application timelines, documentation, predicted grades and recommendation requirements.
* Conduct student/parent counselling sessions, university admission workshops and career guidance programmes.
* Build relationships with universities and coordinate university visits, fairs and admission interactions.
* Maintain accurate application records and report on offers, admissions, scholarships and placement outcomes.



  





 Education \& Experience
 


* Master's degree in Education, Counselling, Psychology, Career Guidance or a related field.
* 5–6 years of experience in university counselling, college admissions or student placement.
* Mandatory experience with IBDP and/or Cambridge A Level, preferably in an international school.
* Proven success in undergraduate placements to top global universities, including Ivy League, Oxbridge, Russell Group and other highly selective institutions.
* Strong knowledge of Indian and international university admissions and application processes.
* Experience with UCAS, Common App and BridgeU is essential.
* Strong university network and demonstrated ability to manage multiple applications and deadlines.



  





 Preferred Institutional Background
 



 Preference will be given to candidates with relevant experience in reputed university counselling/college admissions organisations such as:
 



 Crimson Education India \| Athena Education \| Univariety \| Mindways \| Bon Avenir
 



 Candidates from comparable organisations with strong experience in student profile building, university strategy, application management and international admissions may also be considered.
 



  





 Key Competencies
 


* Excellent counselling, mentoring and communication skills.
* Strong knowledge of global higher education and admissions trends.
* Strategic thinking with strong attention to detail.
* Excellent stakeholder management and parent engagement skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple students, applications and deadlines.
* High professional integrity and confidentiality.



  





 Key Performance Indicators
 


* Successful university placements and quality of offers.
* Admissions to highly selective/top\-ranked universities.
* Student and parent satisfaction.
* Timely and accurate application completion.
* Scholarships/financial aid secured.
* Effective university engagement and career guidance programmes.



  





 The ideal candidate will combine strong counselling expertise with proven international admissions experience and a demonstrated track record of achieving exceptional university outcomes for students.

We are looking for a dynamic and result\-oriented Talent Acquisition Executive to manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, salary negotiation, and candidate closure. The role requires strong knowledge of job portals, recruitment strategies, ATS/ERP systems, and high\-volume hiring. The ideal candidate should be able to hire 80–100 candidates per month, maintain a strong talent pipeline, manage recruitment TAT and hiring cost data, and be willing to travel across India for recruitment requirements.

**What we Offer?**

* Absolute clarity on work expectations and number\-based appraisal system
* Company is growing 10X in next 4 years, so a superb growth opportunity for people contributing towards growth of company.
* Stable company with clear laid down procedures, and a great track record of growth.
* Pan India operations so scope of moving across India to gain multiple experience in various geographies.
* Job Security with cash rich, well\-funded company listed on NSE with market cap of 600 Crores.
* Professional work culture and learning environment, where the only pressure is of upgrading your skillset and growing along with organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment from sourcing to candidate onboarding.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, social media, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes, conduct HR interviews, and coordinate interviews with hiring managers.
* Achieve monthly hiring targets of 80–100 positions while maintaining recruitment quality.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring requirements.
* Negotiate salary, influence candidates, and ensure successful offer acceptance and joining.
* Ensure adherence to recruitment SOPs, hiring policies, and company guidelines.
* Maintain recruitment MIS, ATS/ERP records, and recruitment reports.
* Track and improve Recruitment TAT, Time\-to\-Hire, Cost\-to\-Hire, and Joining Ratio.
* Draft professional emails for candidate communication, interview scheduling, offers, and follow\-ups.
* Coordinate with hiring managers and stakeholders to ensure timely position closures.
* Travel across India for recruitment drives, campus hiring, walk\-in interviews, and business hiring requirements.

**✅ Desired Candidate Profile:**

* Strong knowledge of job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Workindia, etc.) and sourcing strategies.
* Proven ability to close positions within defined TAT.
* Experience in high\-volume hiring (80–100 hires per month preferred).
* Excellent salary negotiation, candidate influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good knowledge of ATS/Recruitment Software/ERP systems.
* Strong email drafting, MS Excel, and reporting skills.
* Ability to build and maintain a quality candidate database and talent pipeline.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and time management skills.
* Willingness to travel across India for recruitment activities.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

* Drive automation strategyacross CI/CD, infrastructure provisioning, testing, and operations
* Lead technical design reviews and set coding and architecture standards
* Mentor mid\-level and juniorengineers and guide their technical growth

title: Lead Applied AI SRE Engineer I
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Lead Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer I**
**Role Overview:** 
 As a Lead Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer II , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands\-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high\-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost\-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte’s engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering—together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio—consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in operating high\-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a role\-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to set production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service\-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability—ensuring high\-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient.
* Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Set production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production—gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow.
* Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre\-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability—codified, version\-controlled dashboards and SLO\-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient\-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands\-on, self\-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks—operating as an infrastructure\-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high\-quality, supportable automation; and review the work of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co\-defining service\-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning\-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements—progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement—rather than big\-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross\-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Set production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co\-define service\-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production—holding the segregation\-of\-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Possess deep expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering—cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering—together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate—and, where they are AI\-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service\-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well\-structured arguments and trade\-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co\-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.


**The team:** 
 US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost\-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom\-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge internal and go\-to\-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
   

  

**The successful candidate will possess:**
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.


**Required Qualifications:**
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
* 12\+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large\-scale, distributed, cloud\-native systems in production, with experience in most of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C\#/.NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks.
* 3\+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large\-scale systems—defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on\-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging—e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre\-production and production; and segregation\-of\-duties controls (least\-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk.
* 3\+ years of experience with cloud\-native engineering and cloud platform ownership on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—plus container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), infrastructure\-as\-code, networking, and multi\-environment management.
* 1\+ years of experience establishing reliability and operational standards—SLO discipline, runbooks, and performance and resilience budgets—including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards.
* Prior experience operating AI/ML and agentic workloads in production—their reliability failure modes (drift, train/serve skew, output variance), MLOps/LLMOps, and the AI control plane (model/LLM gateway, guardrails) from the operability and performance side.
* Prior experience with load and performance testing under simulated production traffic (e.g., LoadRunner, k6, or JMeter), chaos engineering (e.g., Azure Chaos Studio, AWS Fault Injector), capacity planning, autoscaling, and cloud/AI cost engineering (FinOps tooling/dashboards, including GPU/inference and token cost attribution).
* Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI\-augmented spec\-driven development.
* Prior experience using methodologies \& tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi\-agent orchestration tools) etc. to operate high\-quality, resilient platforms and products at scale.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
Technical Recruiter
 



  





 Location: Hyderabad, India
 



 Work Model: On\-site
 



 Company: Linx
 



 Experience: 3–6 years
 



  





 About Linx
 



  





 Linx helps companies build and manage teams globally through Employer of Record (EOR), Global Payroll, Talent Acquisition, and Global Capability Center (GCC) solutions.
 



  





 As we continue to scale our global recruiting operations, we are looking for a Technical Recruiter who knows how to find exceptional talent — not simply process applications.
 



  





 The Role
 



  





 We are looking for a hands\-on Technical Recruiter who can own technical searches from requirement intake through offer acceptance.
 



  





 You should be comfortable recruiting across:
 



  





 \* Software Engineering
 



 \* Data \& Analytics
 



 \* AI / Machine Learning
 



 \* Cloud \& DevOps
 



 \* Cybersecurity
 



 \* Product \& Technical Program Management
 



 \* QA / Automation
 



 \* Enterprise Applications
 



  





 This is a delivery\-focused role. You’ll work closely with hiring managers and recruiting leadership to understand requirements, develop sourcing strategies, engage passive candidates, and close positions quickly without compromising quality.
 



  





 What You’ll Do
 



  





 Own the search. Understand the role beyond the job description — technology stack, seniority, compensation, team structure and what actually makes someone successful.
 



  





 Source proactively. Build pipelines through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, databases and creative sourcing techniques rather than relying on inbound applications.
 



  





 Evaluate technical talent. Conduct strong recruiter screens and understand technology well enough to distinguish genuine hands\-on experience from keywords on a résumé.
 



  





 Manage the entire recruiting lifecycle. Sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate engagement, feedback, offer negotiation and closure.
 



  





 Partner with hiring managers. Challenge requirements when necessary, recalibrate searches quickly and provide real market intelligence.
 



  





 Recruit globally. Support technical hiring across India, the US and other international markets based on client requirements.
 



  





 Maintain recruiting discipline. Keep ATS data accurate and provide clear visibility into submissions, interviews, offers, closures and bottlenecks.
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  





 \* 3–6 years of hands\-on technical recruiting experience
 



 \* Strong experience sourcing passive technical candidates
 



 \* Good understanding of modern technology roles and terminology
 



 \* Strong LinkedIn Recruiter and Boolean search skills
 



 \* Ability to manage multiple open requirements simultaneously
 



 \* Excellent written and verbal communication
 



 \* Strong candidate assessment and negotiation skills
 



 \* Experience supporting US or international technical hiring strongly preferred
 



 \* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven environment
 



  





 How We Measure Success
 



  





 We care about outcomes, not résumé volume.
 



  





 Quality of submission → Interview conversion → Offer conversion → Time to fill → Joining ratio → Hiring\-manager/client satisfaction
 



  





 Sending 50 average profiles isn’t more successful than sending 10 excellent ones.
 



  





 A Note About Our Interview Process
 



  





 At Linx, we’re building the future of recruiting — and we believe our own candidates should experience the technology we’re creating.
 



  





 The first step in the interview process for this role is a Lexy AI interview.
 



  





 It’s an opportunity for us to learn more about your experience, approach to recruiting and how you think, while also giving you firsthand experience with the AI recruiting technology that is becoming part of how we work.
 



  





 We’re looking for recruiters who are curious about technology and comfortable working in an environment where AI and human judgment work together.
 



  





 If participating in an AI interview isn’t something you’re comfortable with or interested in, we completely respect that. This particular opportunity, however, may not be the right fit, and we’d encourage you to consider that before applying.
 



  





 Who Will Do Well Here
 



  





 Someone who is curious, persistent and commercially minded.
 



  





 You enjoy difficult searches. You know how to find candidates other recruiters can’t. You follow up relentlessly, communicate well and understand that candidate experience matters.
 



  





 When someone says:
 



  





 “We’ve been trying to fill this position for three months.”
 



  





 Your instinct is:
 



  





 “Give me the requirement.”
 



  





 If that’s how you recruit — and you’re excited about how AI is changing our industry — we’d like to meet you.

description:
**About Truveta**
 Truveta is on a mission to save lives with data. We are building the world's largest and most comprehensive health data platform to accelerate scientific discovery, improve patient care, and enable the next generation of AI\-driven healthcare. Our India Development Center (IDC) plays a critical role in scaling our engineering, product, and business operations globally.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, we are looking for an HR Generalist who is passionate about creating exceptional employee experiences and helping build a high\-performing organization.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 As an HR Generalist, you will support the day\-to\-day People operations for our growing India Development Center and help manage the employee lifecycle from onboarding through offboarding. You will work closely with employees, managers, and cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth HR operations and a positive employee experience. As the IDC continues to scale, you will also provide support for Talent Acquisition activities, including sourcing, interview coordination, candidate engagement, and hiring operations.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to gain broad exposure across HR operations, employee engagement, Talent Acquisition, and other People initiatives while helping build and scale our People function in India.

 HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle
   

  

* Provide day\-to\-day HR support and guidance to employees and managers.
* Manage employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, confirmations, promotions, internal transfers, documentation, and offboarding.
* Deliver a smooth and engaging onboarding experience for new hires.
* Maintain accurate employee records and ensure HR systems are updated in a timely manner.
* Coordinate with Payroll, Finance, IT, and other teams to ensure seamless HR operations.
* Support employee queries related to HR policies, processes, benefits, payroll, and other People matters.
* Support compliance with company policies, Indian labor laws, and statutory requirements.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve HR processes.


 Talent Acquisition Support
   

  

* Support the Talent Acquisition function as hiring continues to scale in India.
* Assist with sourcing and identifying candidates for open positions.
* Coordinate interviews across candidates, hiring managers, and interview panels.
* Manage candidate communication, scheduling, and interview follow\-ups.

* Help maintain hiring trackers, reports, and recruitment dashboards.

 Employee Engagement \& People Initiatives
   

  

* Support employee engagement, recognition, wellness, and culture\-building programs.
* Assist with employee communications and People\-related events and initiatives.
* Support HR projects and organizational initiatives as the India Development Center continues to grow.

title: Community Outreach Associate
description:
**Company Description** 
 Roligt Foods is a Hyderabad\-based company focused on building clean food systems that prioritize people over shelf life. Its first brand, CocoWorks is its consumer\-facing brand. The company is building clean\-label, minimally processed nutrihydration around tender coconut, with a deliberately evidence\-led standard: claims must be defensible, product choices must be honest, and execution must be rigorous. The business is at an early stage, so the people who join need to be comfortable creating structure while the company is still moving fast. Roligt promotes a fun and engaging culture, reflected in its name, which means “fun” in Swedish and is pronounced “Ro\-Lit.”
 



**Role Description:** 
 The Community Outreach Associate is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Hyderabad.
 


* Build and maintain relationships with startup communities, coworking spaces, founders, HR/People teams, fitness and wellness communities, colleges, resident communities and event organisers.
* Identify and secure opportunities for CocoWorks community activations, sampling, pop\-ups, hydration partnerships and Nurture Station pilots.
* Research local ecosystems and maintain a structured database of prospects, partners, events and introductions.
* Represent CocoWorks at conferences, community events, founder gatherings, wellness events and relevant brand activations.
* Coordinate the full event cycle: outreach, confirmations, logistics, product movement, on\-ground execution and post\-event follow\-up.
* Work closely with Sales and Marketing to qualify leads generated through community channels and move high\-potential opportunities into the commercial pipeline.
* Create simple, repeatable community playbooks for outreach, event selection, partner onboarding and followup
* Capture learnings from communities: what people ask, what resonates, objections, product feedback and partnership opportunities.
* Support community\-led content by identifying stories, people, places and moments that can be turned into useful brand narratives.
* Maintain disciplined CRM / tracking hygiene so that every meaningful conversation has a next step



**What we are looking for:** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in community management, partnerships, events, field marketing, sales development, public relations or customer\-facing roles.
* Strong interpersonal skills and genuine curiosity about people and communities.
* Comfort with cold outreach, introductions, follow\-ups and asking for meetings or pilots.
* Excellent organisation and on\-ground execution skills; you can manage multiple moving parts without losing the thread.
* Strong writing and communication skills in English; Telugu/Hindi is a plus for Hyderabad\-facing work.
* Basic comfort with spreadsheets, CRM tools and reporting.
* A bias toward action and an ability to operate independently in an early\-stage environment.
* Interest in food, wellness, sustainability, startups or community ecosystems is a plus.



**The kind of person we want** 



* You remember names, follow up when you said you would, and build relationships before you need something.
* You would rather have ten strong conversations than collect 100 cold contacts.
* You can represent a brand confidently without turning every interaction into a hard sell.
* You are comfortable being on the ground and doing the unglamorous bits that make an activation work.



  





**Applications:** 
 Please share your CV and one example of a community, event, partnership or relationship you built from scratch. You can send an email to hr@roligtfoods.com or apply here \- https://forms.zohopublic.in/roligtfoodspvtltd346/form/JobApplicationForm1/formperma/OE\_qZkD9KwnYiobI9kJiXtARsRGEZA74ewzxnapbUkE

title: Digital-Twin & Robotics Simulation Lead
description:
**Job Requirements**
 At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
   

  

 We are looking for a Digital\-Twin and Robotics Simulation Engineer to build and maintain the simulation\-first pipeline for a humanoid robotics program. The role centers on building high\-fidelity digital twins in NVIDIA Omniverse / Isaac Sim, generating synthetic data, and supporting policy training and validation for a humanoid robot before it is deployed on physical hardware. Candidates with a strong real\-time 3D / simulation background (Unity, Unreal Engine, or similar, using C\+\+/C\#) who have since transitioned into the NVIDIA Omniverse / Isaac ecosystem are strongly preferred.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain physically accurate digital twins of robot platforms on OpenUSD using NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim.
* Set up scenes, sensors, physics properties, and environment randomization for synthetic data generation using Isaac Lab / Cosmos world models.
* Support training and post\-training of foundation\-model robot policies (e.g., Isaac GR00T\-class VLA models) by preparing simulation\-ready datasets and trajectories.
* Develop Python\-based tooling and pipelines to automate scene generation, domain randomization, data export, and simulation\-to\-training hand\-off.
* Integrate Omniverse / Isaac Sim outputs with ROS 2 nodes, middleware bridges, and downstream AI training workflows.
* Work with the embedded / MCU team to align simulation timing, sensor models, and control interfaces with hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) requirements.
* Validate simulation fidelity against real robot behaviour and iterate on physics tuning, sensor noise models, and scene accuracy.
* Collaborate with 3D content, AI/ML, and embedded engineers to keep digital assets, physics rigs, and policies in sync across the pipeline.
* Document simulation architecture, pipelines, and configuration for reuse across future robot programs.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and technical design reviews.


 We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
   

  

 We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.
   

  

**Work Experience**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 4\-9 years of software / simulation engineering experience, including current hands\-on work with NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim.
* Working experience with Isaac Lab, Isaac GR00T, and/or NVIDIA Cosmos world models (or clear ability to ramp up quickly on these).
* Strong Python scripting skills for simulation automation, data pipelines, and tooling.
* Solid foundation in 3D graphics, physics\-based simulation, and real\-time rendering concepts.
* Prior professional experience with Unity3D or Unreal Engine using C\+\+ and/or C\# — this real\-time engine background, later transitioned into NVIDIA Omniverse/Isaac, is a strong plus.
* Understanding of USD (Universal Scene Description) based workflows and asset/scene pipelines.
* Familiarity with robot description formats (URDF/USD physics articulation) and basic robotics concepts (kinematics, sensors, actuators).
* Experience with version control (Git), Agile development, and collaborative engineering practices.
* Good communication and documentation skills; comfortable working with cross\-functional AI, embedded, and simulation teams.


**Desired / Good\-to\-have Skills**
* Exposure to synthetic data generation, domain randomization, and dataset annotation for AI/ML model training.
