title: Zonal Head — Capital Formation and Investor Relations (East)
description:
***Zonal Head — Capital Formation and Investor Relations (East) \| Vantrock Investment Managers LLP \| Kolkata***




  





 Vantrock is India’s independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth. This seat builds its distribution network in Kolkata and the East and owns the zone.
 



  





**Note:**
 team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change as the platform builds out. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.
 



  





**THE SEAT**




**Employer:**
 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP — the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures (the Vantrock Group)
 



**Reports to:**
 Head — Capital Formation and Investor Relations; until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder \& CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands\-on
 



**Direct reports:**
 None at launch — a senior single\-contributor seat with a very large number attached
 



**Location:**
 Kolkata, in office; twelve to fifteen travel days a month across Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi, Raipur
 



**Experience:**
 10–16 years
 



  





**ABOUT VANTROCK**




 Vantrock is an independent real assets platform. Real assets only. We start where we know the ground: logistics, warehousing and industrial parks, across the full chain — first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use developments with distribution below and office above. From there, in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space — vertical industries, where our expertise transfers; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living.
 



  





 Three parts, kept separate. The founder’s balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de\-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited — own board, team and governance — is the development manager and operator. Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, part of Vantrock Ventures, is the investment manager; its team underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee — the operator and the manager kept at arm’s length by design.
 



  





 Alignment is structural: assets enter at cost, with no founder premium; the development team takes no fee and no profit on development management; the platform earns only after its investors have, through its share of additional returns.
 



  





 Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO — three institutional platforms built from zero, the fourth now on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, all litigation\-free, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close — ₹2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the distribution channel — India’s first domestic warehousing AIF, and India’s largest industrial real estate exit. Delivered across the founder’s three prior platforms. We hire number twos who want to become number one.
 



  





**THE FIRST STRATEGY**




 Six product lines — industrial parks, warehousing, suburban office, starter office, first\-mile and last\-mile logistics — through a seeded AIF alongside deal\-by\-deal co\-investment via CIV and co\-investment PMS routes. Seeded means the operator puts assets in place before the fund launches, so 50–60% of the pipeline is typically identified and de\-risked on day one. No blind\-pool vehicle is ever raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment, and larger co\-investment tickets.
 



  





**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**




 Own the zone. Build the distribution and IFA network in East and North\-East India — Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi and Raipur, activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert it into committed capital for the first strategy — and a channel ready for the next.
 



  





 Not a cold start. The platform brings an existing investor base, sponsor and anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the AIF and product channel from two prior funds; you will be welcomed. What does not yet exist is the franchise — the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls — and there is no team to delegate it to in Year 1\. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**




 – The network: national distributors’ regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs/MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi\-family offices and wealth\-platform regional desks — 5–7 firms empanelled and live.
 



 – The full empanelment cycle, locally — first meeting to product committee to go\-live — for both the fund and the co\-investment routes.
 



 – Activation: branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 35–50 RMs and IFAs in the zone have each placed at least one ticket.
 



 – Conversion: joint client meetings as the core of the job; the pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.
 



 – The map: every relevant RM, IFA and product head in the zone, in the CRM, weekly.
 



 – Investor relations in the zone after the close, with Fund Operations: drawdowns, reporting queries, site visits, and the hard conversation when something goes wrong.
 



 – The face of Vantrock in Kolkata and the East, and the first call a partner makes when a client asks a hard question.
 



  





**THIS IS A FRONT\-FACING SEAT**




 You do not sell to the distributors and stop; you sell with them. Accompany partners and their RMs to clients and pitch the fund yourself. Tell the story — operator\-led, seeded pipeline, the asset class — so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits in Kolkata and the East, and speak at them — and at trade shows, expos and industry forums. Be present on LinkedIn as a named voice of the platform. Approved material only; no return promises, ever.
 



  





**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**




**Essential**




 – 10–16 years in financial services, at least five in B2B or B2B2C distribution of PMS, AIF or mutual\-fund products from the manufacturer’s side — an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. You have carried a distribution number and been paid against it.
 



 – Verifiable relationships with distributor product heads, national and regional distributors and the top IFA/MFD firms in East and North\-East India — you can name them, and they take your call.
 



 – You have launched a product into the channel from scratch at least once — not only carried an established brand.
 



 – Third\-party capital raised through the channel, stated as capital drawn, not “assets influenced”.
 



 – Graduate; MBA, PGDM, CA or CFA or equivalent; NISM as applicable.
 



 – Appetite for the road: twelve to fifteen travel days a month is the job, not an exception to it.
 



 Advantageous
 



 – Real\-assets fund background (not mandatory — a strong alternatives channel salesperson from equity, credit or PMS is often the superior hire); an AMC alternates or PMS desk; co\-investment tickets sold alongside a fund. Standing in the Marwari, Bengali and North\-East business communities, where alternatives penetration is low relative to wealth.
 



 What this role is not
 



 A B2B distribution seat, not a private\-wealth seat. If your career has been advising your own HNI clients, or selling directly to institutions, this is the wrong role. The job is to persuade another firm’s RMs and IFAs to sell Vantrock — and make them successful when they do.
 



  





**COMPENSATION AND WEALTH CREATION**




 Upper\-quartile benchmark, deliberately weighted from take\-home to wealth creation. Four parts, a mix of all four: fixed; a capital\-formation incentive on the capital you personally bring in, plus a team component on the platform’s total raise; a share in the platform’s additional returns on strategies you help close; and ESOPs. We want the next generation of capital\-formation talent — people who would rather build long\-term wealth with a platform they helped create than optimise a salary. Numbers in the first conversation.
 



  





**VANTROCK CULTURAL FIT**




 We’re building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We’re looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying “I don’t know” and “I was wrong.” If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn’t the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



  





 AI\-native by construction: the group’s first company was Vantrock Intelligence, and everyone here works with AI daily, with the judgment to check it — fluent AI use is tested at interview for every hire. A place to belong: a small team of co\-builders with real ownership; nobody is a seat on an org chart.
 



  





**HOW WE WILL ASSESS**




 1\. A fixed set of questions, on video (preferred) or in writing — an automated email with an AI\-interview link follows your application; about forty minutes, reviewed before the CV.
 



 2\. The Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, sent in the same email.
 



 3\. A network conversation — who in Kolkata and the East you would call in your first ninety days — then the Founder \& CEO.
 



 4\. References: two contacted directly, at least one a distributor product head.
 



 Once we have your application, interview and test, we reach out with next steps. Your application is confidential — seen only by the Founder’s Office and the hiring lead.
 



  





**TO APPLY**




***Email careers@vantrock.com, subject: Zonal Head — Capital Formation and Investor Relations (East) — \[your name]. Include your CV or profile link, the products you have launched into the channel in this zone, your notice period and expectation, and one short paragraph: the first three distributors in Kolkata and the East you would take a new real\-assets strategy to, and why. That paragraph matters more than the CV.***




  





***We don’t hire roles. We build the platform. Ownership, not employment. Builders hire builders.
 
 ﻿***

**Managing Execution** 



* **Building and Contributing to Teams** 
 \- Leads and participates as a member of a team to move the team toward the completion of common goals while fostering cohesion and collaboration among team members.
* **Driving for Results** 
 \- Sets high standards of performance for self and/or others; assumes responsibility for work objectives; initiates, focuses, and monitors the efforts of self and/or others toward the accomplishment goals; proactively takes action and goes beyond what is required.

 \- Gathers information and resources required to set a plan of action for self and/or others; prioritizes and arranges work requirements for self and/or others to accomplish goals and ensure work is completed.



**Building Relationships** 



* **Coworker Relationships** 
 \- Interacts with others in a way that builds openness, trust, and confidence in the pursuit of organizational goals and lasting relationships.
* **Customer Relationships** 
 \- Develops and sustains relationships based on an understanding of customer needs and actions consistent with the company’s service standards.
* **Global Mindset** 
 \- Supports employees and business partners with diverse styles, abilities, motivations, and/or cultural perspectives; utilizes differences to drive innovation, engagement and enhance business results; and ensures employees are given the opportunity to contribute to their full potential.



**Generating Talent and Organizational Capability** 



* **Organizational Capability** 
 \- Evaluates and adapts the structure of team assignments and work processes to best fit the needs and/or support the goals of an organizational unit.
* **Talent Management** 
 \- Provides guidance and feedback to help individuals develop and strengthen skills and abilities needed to accomplish work objectives.



**Learning and Applying Professional Expertise** 



* **Applied Learning** 
 \- Seeks and makes the most of learning opportunities to improve performance of self and/or others.
* **Business Acumen** 
 \- Understands and utilizes business information to manage everyday operations and generate innovative solutions to approach team, business, and administrative challenges.
* **Technical Acumen** 
 \- Understands and utilizes professional skills and knowledge in a specific functional area to conduct and manage everyday business operations and generate innovative solutions to approach function\-specific work challenges
* **Food and Beverage Sanitation** 
 \- Knowledge of procedures and techniques for kitchen maintenance, cleaning, and use of sanitation systems; use of grease trap; trash (compactor(s), Baler operation, dish machines, and other equipment. Knowledge of techniques for care and cleaning of silver, stainless steel, and dish machines.

This includes knowing the right equipment to use for each job.

title: Associate Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
The Associate \- Accounts Receivable is responsible for the Order\-to\-Cash activities of its Business Lines covering billing, collections, cash application, and revenue recognition and reporting — ensuring accuracy, timely recovery of receivables, and clear visibility of customer outstanding balances for the business.
   

  

 The role brings standardisation to customer\-level visibility of revenue, invoicing and outstanding balances, and holds ownership of collections performance for an assigned customer portfolio, including ageing, DSO and overdue exposure. It requires a sound understanding of the business and its revenue drivers, the ability to manage large data sets and present up\-to\-date insights, control over pricing in the revenue systems, and effective partnering with Sales and Account Management on outstanding invoices, billing queries and customer escalations.
   

  

**Requirements**
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
   

  

* Maintain up\-to\-date, detailed pricing data to support invoicing and revenue management
* Apply control checks on invoicing data across all revenue streams
* Participate in the end\-to\-end Accounts Receivable process, from invoice generation through to collection and cash application
* Prepare, review and issue customer invoices accurately and on schedule, ensuring supporting data, tariffs and contractual terms are correctly applied before dispatch, and resolving discrepancies prior to release
* Manage collections for an assigned customer portfolio: monitor ageing reports, follow up on overdue invoices through structured dunning, and escalate long\-outstanding or high\-risk accounts in line with the agreed escalation matrix
* Issue statements of account and payment reminders, and record committed payment dates and collection notes to maintain a reliable receivables and cash\-inflow forecast
* Perform cash application on a daily basis, allocating incoming receipts to the correct customer invoices and matching remittance advices accurately
* Interact with Sales and Account Management on outstanding invoices — sharing overdue positions, obtaining customer feedback, resolving billing queries and disputes, and jointly agreeing recovery actions on ageing accounts
* Coordinate and assist in year\-end finalisation and audits, providing AR schedules and supporting documentation


**Requirements**
 Minimum Education/Qualification: Bachelor of Commerce (CMA, CA, B. Com or BBA); accounting certifications an advantage.
   

  

 Min. Experience :
   

  

* 4\+ years' experience in accounts receivable, billing or order\-to\-cash
* Direct communication with customers on billing and collections matters


 Industry
   

  

* 
* Order\-to\-cash, billing, collections or revenue accounting environment
* 
* Maritime technology, shipping services or a transaction\-based business preferred


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Hands\-on experience across the end\-to\-end order\-to\-cash cycle: billing, collections and cash application
* ERP experience (NetSuite or equivalent), including the AR and billing modules
* Maintenance of pricing and tariff data in revenue systems, including approval controls
* Control over credit notes and amendments to issued invoices
* Cash application, remittance matching and clearing of unapplied, unidentified or short\-paid receipts
* Statements of account, structured dunning and escalation processes
* Revenue reconciliation between invoicing and operational data
* Monthly revenue reporting, budget deviation analysis and forecasting models
* Analytics and data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI) for AR, billing and revenue reporting
* Advanced Excel, with the ability to manage and interpret large data sets


 Languages : English (fluent)

title: AML Administrator
description:
**About Suntera** 




  





 Suntera Global is a leading international provider of fund, corporate and private wealth services, with over 45 years of experience and 550\+ specialists supporting a diverse range of industries worldwide, empowering responsible ambition through professional delivery of governance, administration and accounting services, all while focusing on strong relationships and continually evolving to provide the best possible service to clients.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and highly organised Digital Anti\-Money Laundering Data Administrator to support our regulatory consultancy by managing data entry, document uploads and screening requirement on third\-party digital compliance platforms. This role is ideal for a professional with strong data handling skills, a keen eye for accuracy, and an understanding of AML\-related documentation.
 



  





 Key responsibilities include:
 



  




* Document Validation: Review documentation received via email or SharePoint to ensure completeness and validity, request any missing information, upload approved documents to the system, and accurately extract key data (e.g. passport numbers, dates, addresses) into online platforms
* System Screening: Use the online system to input certain names for the purposes of screening
* Risk Assessment: Complete an online questionnaire which allows a risk assessment to be performed
* Ongoing Monitoring: Identify when documents need to be refreshed. Ensure that all records are updated in line with regulatory requirements and internal policies. i.e. when passports expire
* Project Management: Work closely with the UK\-based team, providing regular updates on document status and flagging issues. This will be via email and telephone calls
* Identification and Escalation of Material Matters: As you develop your knowledge and experience, you may be asked to identify and flag any material items in the documents that the team should be aware of
* Client Interaction: Potentially aid in the acquisition of documentation and/or information from the AML Targets
* Administration: Other ongoing or ad\-hoc administrative tasks as and when required
* Confidentiality: Maintain strict confidentiality and follow data protection best practices when handling sensitive compliance documents



  





**About You** 




  





 Skills and Requirements
 



  





 Essential:
 



  




* Understanding of different corporate structures
* Ability to handle large volumes of documents efficiently while meeting deadlines
* Strong attention to detail
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English



  





 Preferable:
 



  




* Prior experience in regulatory compliance, preferably Anti\-Money Laundering
* Comfortable using digital platforms, cloud\-based tools, and Excel/Google Sheets for data management
* Strong ability to review, verify, and organise AML documentation accurately
* Familiarity with handling confidential regulatory information securely
* Experience with compliance, KYC (Know Your Customer), AML (Anti\-Money Laundering), or risk management frameworks
* Prior exposure to UK regulatory environments (FCA, HMRC, etc.)
* Understanding of GDPR and data protection best practices

title: Transfer Pricing Manager, Mumbai
description:
**Transfer Pricing Manager – Siemens Ltd.**
 We’re looking for dedicated team player with the skills and vision to build a better tomorrow. Join our Tax team as a Tax Manager and ensure compliance with TP regulations. Also help us build the technology that will transform entire industries, cities and even countries.
   

  

 The position exists as a support function to the Tax department to fulfil statutory obligations applicable to the company.
   

  

**Change the future with us!**
* Assistance in preparation and filing of Return of Income, tax audit and transfer pricing (Form 3CEB) requirements as per statutory deadlines.
* Undertaking all TP compliances (including BEPS related Master file, CBC, etc.) and filing of tax and TP returns of foreign affiliates.
* Preparing TP documentation to support intra\-group transactions in compliance with local regulations.
* Supporting audits, respond to the assessment notices, prepare appeals and submissions, attending hearings before the tax authorities.
* Advice on TP implications of new business initiatives. Advise on TP queries received from business, interpret various tax treaties, MLI, etc.
* Conducting regular review of TP policies in accordance with the latest tax regulations and developments. To ensure that all actions for preparation and filing of TP returns, assessment notices, etc. are handled in time so that exposure of TP adjustment and litigations can be minimized if not eliminated completely.
* Oversight on the company's transfer pricing matters and partnering with multiple stakeholders to provide support on transfer pricing related issues, including industry standards mandated by SEBI LODR.
* You will be involved in Tax Assessments: Review notices, prepare submissions and attend/ organize representation at assessment hearings, provide information as required during the course of assessment proceedings. This may involve coordination with various corporate functions, business steams, external consultants etc.
* Appeals: Draft appeals, attend/organize representation at proceedings conducted by DRP / Commissioner of Income\-tax and Income Tax Appellate Tribunal as required. Briefing the counsel / lawyer, attending hearings before the ITAT, taking adjournments, etc.
* You will be responsible for post assessment activities like getting OGEs, stay of demand, follow up for obtaining refunds, obtaining rectification orders, etc. so that company gets the orders/ refunds as fast as possible.
* Knowledge Management: Keeping abreast of change of laws/ any tribunal/high court decisions so that relevant information is passed on within the team and to the business divisions, so that timely and accurate decisions are taken, and compliance of tax is ensured.
* Assist in various Automation / Digitalization projects.


**You Will Be Working With**
**External \-** 
 Tax authorities, Senior counsels and advocates, External Auditors, Consultants
   

  

**Internal:** 
 Commercials / BA, Technical team, Marketing/ Sales group commercials, Works, CF, Accounts, Personnel, HR, Internal Audit and other Divisions Group companies both domestic and international.
   

  

**We don’t need superheroes, just super minds**
* You are a Qualified CA and you bring 5 to 7 years of experience in transfer pricing area with knowledge of Income Tax Act, DTAA, FEMA and recent case laws etc. Knowledge of Accounting and Finance and Indian GAAP, USGAAP/IFRS, Commercial concepts, Business understanding.
* Conversant with MS office is must. Knowledge of search database, ERP tool such as SAP, ESPIRIT will be an added advantage.
* You should have strong analytical skills and a high attention to detail.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with different partners.


**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens!**
 This role is based in Mumbai (Worli). You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries \- and the craft of things to come.
   

  

 We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
   

  

**Find out more about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers** 
 \#SL

 As a Business Development Executive (Inside Sales), you’ll play a key role in driving student admissions, customer acquisition, lead conversion, and revenue growth. * Conduct consultative sales conversations and deliver an outstanding learner experience.

* Build strong relationships with prospective learners and ensure timely follow\-ups.
* Collaborate with the Marketing and Product teams to improve customer experience and lead conversion.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, sales reports, and daily activity updates.
* Contribute towards business expansion and revenue growth.

* 1\-3 year of experience in Business Development, Inside Sales, Education Sales, Academic Counselling, Customer Success, Telecalling, Lead Generation, or B2C Sales.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Excellent verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong interpersonal, negotiation, persuasion, and relationship\-building skills.
* Target\-oriented with the ability to work in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment.
* Passionate about Education, Skill Development, Career Counselling, and helping learners achieve their goals.

* 3 \- 5LPA (Fixed) \+ 1\-2LPA (Variable).

description:
**\[Apply through the Excel sheet]**

 \~\~\~
   

  

 BDTC is a private limited company established in 2013 in Pune. It was founded by Avinash Anand Singh who is an international acclaimed peak performance coach. The company runs series of workshops and have participants from 9\+ countries. The company is standing at a verge of explosive growth and scale. Hence, we are looking for bright and skilled people to join the team.
   

  

 BDTC helps people move through a structured personal transformation journey — from an introductory program through to a deeper, immersive residential experience.
   

  

 A Program Counsellor is the human bridge in that journey: the person who speaks with someone who's shown interest, understands where they actually are in their life and what's holding them back, and helps them see clearly whether this program is the right next step for them — and if so, guides them to commit.
   

  

 This is a conversation\-first, relationship\-first role. A strong, structured sense of how to guide someone from interest to decision matters more than any specific industry background.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Personally own a pipeline of prospective participants from first conversation through to enrollment, staying accountable for outcomes at every stage.
   

  

 Have genuine, structured conversations that understand a person's situation, motivations, and hesitations before recommending anything.
   

  

 Address doubts and concerns (cost, timing, family buy\-in, uncertainty) honestly and with patience, helping people make a decision they feel good about, not one they're pushed into
   

  

 Maintain complete, accurate records of every conversation and interaction in the CRM your own visibility into your pipeline depends on this
   

 Consistently guide your pipeline toward monthly enrollment targets as an individual contributor
   

  

 Work closely with the wider counselling and marketing team, sharing insight on what's actually resonating (or not) with the people you're speaking to
   

 Progressively take on deeper, higher\-value conversations as you build a track record of trust and results
   

  

 What We're Looking For
   

  

 3–4 years of experience in a role centered on guiding people to a decision — counselling, admissions, advisory, or a consultative client\-facing role
   

  

 A genuine, structured approach to conversations — real listening and understanding, not a fixed pitch
   

 Comfortable with a full journey involving multiple touchpoints (call, WhatsApp, video) over time, not a single interaction
   

  

 Good spoken English and Hindi
   

  

 Consistent, disciplined record\-keeping habits
   

 Nice to have, not required: prior experience guiding people toward higher\-value program upgrades or premium offerings
   

  

 Available for the full 6\-day, 9:30–6:30 WFO schedule

 Fixed base \+ performance\-linked incentive, tied to individual enrollment outcomes. Exact base discussed based on experience.

title: Life Coach
description:
**Company Description** 
 Atmantan Wellness Centre is a luxury wellness destination nestled in the crystal hills and overlooking the pristine Mulshi Lake, offering a tranquil environment for holistic healing. The centre focuses on integrated wellness for mind, body, and soul, combining modern science with traditional practices. Guests come for personalized wellness programs, including lifestyle transformation, stress management, and overall health optimization. Team members work in a serene, nature\-rich setting that supports both guest well\-being and professional growth for wellness practitioners.

 The Life Coach at Atmantan Wellness Centre is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Pune District. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**

We focus on our customers’ post go\-live journey, assuring long\-term success. We deliver a variety of programs and services ranging from feature assessments to full feature deployments to support their growing and changing business needs within Workday. But we like to have fun, too! We put people first, celebrate diversity, drive innovation, and prioritise giving back to our communities, demonstrating a commitment to corporate social responsibility. Our dedication to customer success, coupled with a vibrant and inclusive company culture, sets a strong foundation for continued growth and success at Workday.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Would you enjoy learning new things in a fast paced environment? Do you have an appetite for variety and challenging business problems to solve? Are you a great communicator who can clearly articulate and demonstrate the value of Workday solutions to our customers?
   

  

 The Workday Success Plans team works directly with customers through targeted micro\-consulting engagements to help solve their business needs using the Workday application. Responsible for acting as a trusted Workday advisor, you will have the opportunity to assist customers with how\-to questions, troubleshoot and guide customers through configuration, and provide feature demonstrations. As a Workday expert, customers will benefit from your knowledge as you share your experience, identify key considerations, and highlight standard methodologies.
   

  

 Our team of professionals have a broad and deep understanding of Workday Financials \& Adaptive Planning. In this position we are looking for expertise in the following:
   

  

 Workforce Planning Expertise

* Implementation experience with Workday Adaptive Planning

* Ability to develop complex reports and dashboards using Adaptive Planning


 Data Management and Integration
   

  

* Experience with data integration between Workday Adaptive Planning and Workday HCM and/or other HCM systems.
* Proficiency in managing data imports, exports, and data validation.


 If you are passionate about the value technology can bring to an organization, love learning and want to work directly with some of the greatest companies on the planet, bring your energy and teamwork to the Workday Success Plans team!
   

  

 Primary responsibilities of this role include delivering various services to Workday Success Plans customers. To be successful, this requires:
   

  

 Conducting research to ensure understanding of customer questions and related Workday concepts.
   

  

 Delivering small scope consulting in response to customer requests; providing configuration guidance, demonstrations, considerations, tips \& tricks.
   

  

 Troubleshooting product configuration to resolve or provide optimal product configuration to meet customer business requirements.
   

  

 Clearly and effectively communicating responses and value to customers.
   

  

 Creating and delivering customer presentations on how to use Workday features to achieve business goals (Accelerator Webinars).
   

  

 Providing one\-on\-one consulting guidance to accelerate customer feature adoption (Feature Accelerator).
   

  

 Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities (Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews).
   

  

 Completing and maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) along with familiarity with Workday roadmap.
   

  

 Keeping up to date with industry practices and the ability to engage with our customers on those topics.
   

  

 Helping drive the creation of new programs to drive customer feature adoption
   

  

 In addition to delivering Workday Success Plans services, our Workday professionals will also deliver other services such as:
   

  

 Perform configuration and business requirements reviews with a detailed deliverable calling out opportunities for optimization
   

  

 Provide one\-on\-one customer configuration designs
   

  

 Deployments including full deployment of Workday features
   

  

**About You**
 2\+ years of experience with Workday Adaptive Planning implementations
   

  

 5 years of IT implementation experience
   

  

 3\+ years of software consulting experience
   

  

**Additional Qualifications:**
 1\+ years experience in Adaptive Integrations with external systems
   

  

 Workday Adaptive Planning Certification is a huge plus
   

  

 Ability to troubleshoot Adaptive Integrations to external systems
   

  

 Ability to gain a thorough understanding of Workday concepts as new features are released
   

  

 Ability to distill complex concepts into understandable presentations for our customers
   

  

 Ability to multitask and work on multiple engagements and deliverables simultaneously
   

  

 Strong critical thinking skills so as to understand complex, technical process issues and facilitate/influence decision making
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience required. Advanced degree preferred.
   

  

 Travel may be up to 10%
   

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Our Vision is a Connected Community of Health. With the largest community of clients in healthcare, Altera is able to deliver an integrated platform of clinical, financial, connectivity, and information solutions to facilitate enhanced collaboration and exchange of critical patient information.
   

  

 In this role, the ideal candidate will assist with day\-to\-day operations on technical issues and problems, as well as participate in the initiation and planning phases of organizational projects. The primary purpose of this role is to install, implement, configure, upgrade, and optimize the performance of application systems and databases required to operate Altera Software Development and QA environments.
   

  

**Experience \& Knowledge**
* Knowledge of Application/Infrastructure Monitoring tools/solutions.
* Candidate must have0\-1 years of experience in supporting and monitoring

* Server Performance metrics \- CPU, Memory, Queue length, MSMQ, I/O, Page writes, Perfmon, etc.

title: L2 Production Support
description:
**Job Summary**
 Synechron is seeking an experienced Production Support Engineer to ensure the stability, security, and performance of key capital markets, banking, and trading systems. This role involves providing advanced support for enterprise trading platforms, market data feeds, and settlement systems, with a focus on incident resolution, troubleshooting, and system optimization. The incumbent will support a 24/7 operational environment, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and implement automation initiatives to enhance system reliability and efficiency.
   

  

**Software Requirements**
* Required:
+ Strong hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux administration, scripting (Shell, Python), and log analysis
+ Expertise in SQL (complex joins, query optimization) using databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or similar
+ Experience managing batch processing tools such as Control\-M
+ Familiarity with monitoring tools like Geneos, AppDynamics, or Splunk
+ Knowledge of microservices architecture supporting financial platforms
+ Understanding of ITIL framework and processes for incident, change, and problem management


* Preferred:
+ Support experience with trading platforms such as Calypso, Murex, Apex, or similar systems
+ Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) supporting enterprise systems
+ Experience with automation tools and scripting for support processes (Ansible, Terraform)


**Overall Responsibilities**
* Act as Level 3 escalation point for mission\-critical trading, risk, payments, and settlement incidents, ensuring rapid resolution and minimal downtime
* Perform deep troubleshooting across application, middleware, database, and infrastructure layers to identify root causes
* Support trade lifecycle processes, including trade capture, validation, settlement, and reporting
* Maintain detailed incident logs, RCA documentation, and support dashboards
* Support deployments, patches, and system upgrades, validating post\-deployment stability
* Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to resolve complex system issues and implement support automation
* Optimize system configurations, batch processes, and performance tuning to meet SLAs
* Support audit, compliance, and regulatory requirements relevant to financial systems
* Lead proactive monitoring and automation initiatives to reduce manual support efforts and increase operational resilience


**Technical Skills (By Category)**
* Languages \& Scripting: Required: Shell scripting, Python for automation and support tasks Preferred: Java, PowerShell
* Databases \& Data Management: Oracle, SQL Server, support for complex SQL queries, data validation, and reconciliation
* Middleware \& Scheduling: Control\-M or similar batch processing tools, middleware supporting trade/settlement systems
* Monitoring \& Logging: Geneos, AppDynamics, Splunk, or similar, for system health and incident management
* Security \& Compliance: Knowledge of financial security standards, encryption, audit logging, and compliance standards (e.g., PCI DSS, GDPR)
* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Basic support for cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP with experience supporting hybrid deployments


**Experience Requirements**
* 6\+ years in financial or enterprise systems support, with a focus on trading, settlement, or large\-scale banking systems
* Proven incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis in mission\-critical environments
* Support experience with trade lifecycle management, market data feeds, and reconciliation systems
* Familiarity with batch processing tools like Control\-M and enterprise support frameworks such as ITIL
* Experience supporting compliance and security requirements relevant to banking or financial sectors


**Day\-to\-Day Activities**
* Monitor production systems, review system alerts, and analyze logs to proactively identify issues
* Troubleshoot and resolve incidents related to trade processing, settlement, or market data errors
* Support deployment activities, configuration changes, and system upgrades with minimal impact
* Conduct root cause analysis, document findings, and implement preventive measures
* Automate routine tasks such as health checks, log analysis, and incident handling workflows
* Coordinate with development and infrastructure teams to troubleshoot complex issues
* Support emergency responses and participate in escalation calls as needed
* Maintain detailed documentation, support procedures, and operational reports


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* 6\+ years supporting enterprise financial or trading systems, with experience in trade lifecycle or settlement systems preferred
* Practical experience with Unix/Linux systems, scripting, and batch processing tools
* Certification in ITIL, cloud support, or enterprise support is a plus
* Proven track record supporting high\-availability, mission\-critical systems in large enterprise environments


**Professional Competencies**
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for complex, high\-impact incidents
* Effective communication skills for stakeholder updates, incident reporting, and cross\-team collaboration
* Leadership qualities to manage support activities and mentor junior engineers
* Ability to adapt quickly to new systems, tools, and operational standards
* Process\-oriented mindset to implement automation, support frameworks, and operational efficiencies
* Time management skills to prioritize support activities and meet SLAs

title: Quality Inspector –Equipment’s
description:
**Title**
 Quality Inspector –Equipment’s
   

  

**Job Title**
 Quality Inspector –Equipment’s
   

  

**Division**
 KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) provides holistic and value\-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world\-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high\-end design capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets.
   

  

**Summary Section**
 The Quality Inspector – Equipment role is a senior quality assurance position responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications throughout the manufacturing and inspection lifecycle of static process equipment, including pressure vessels, heat exchangers, rotating equipment, and associated systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical guidance on quality, welding, and NDE requirements for process equipment.
* Review vendor technical proposals to ensure compliance with project and quality requirements.
* Lead supplier qualification assessments, audits, and evaluations.
* Conduct pre\-inspection meetings with suppliers and stakeholders.
* Review and approve quality documents, including ITPs, welding procedures, weld records, PWHT procedures, NDE procedures, and testing documentation.
* Perform and oversee shop inspections in accordance with approved Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs).
* Coordinate Third\-Party Inspection (TPI) activities and review inspection reports prior to release.
* Develop Critical\-to\-Quality (CTQ) checklists based on project specifications and lessons learned.
* Interface effectively with suppliers, clients, engineering, procurement, and project teams on quality\-related matters.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives through the development of quality processes, tools, and best practices.


**Qualifications Including Required Education, Experience, \& Skills**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution.
* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years in a reputable organization.
* Strong experience in pressure vessel fabrication and inspection in accordance with ASME, EN, and other international codes and standards.
* Proven experience with ASME Code\-stamped equipment and fabrication quality control.
* In\-depth knowledge of welding, NDE, heat treatment, pressure testing, final inspection, and quality documentation.
* Experience in inspection and quality control of raw materials, fabrication processes, final product acceptance, and manufacturing records.
* Familiarity with materials such as low\-alloy steels, stainless steels, and nickel\-based alloys including Inconel.
* Experience in witnessing and validating Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) for rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, turbines, and associated auxiliary systems.
* Experience in witnessing and validating Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) for control valves, instrumentation systems, and related automation equipment to ensure compliance with project specifications and applicable standards.
* Sound understanding of ISO 9001 Quality Management System requirements.
* Proficiency in Refractory and Painting Inspection Requirements will be preferred.
* Exposure to KBR technology static equipment’s is preferred.


**Mandatory**
**Preferred Qualifications Education, Experience, \& Skills:**
* ASNT Level II certifications in:
+ PT (Liquid Penetrant Testing)
+ MT (Magnetic Particle Testing)
+ RT (Radiographic Testing)
+ UT (Ultrasonic Testing)


**Preferred**
* CSWIP or equivalent welding certification.
* Experience in refractory and painting/coating inspections.
* Exposure to KBR technology static equipment.

title: Educational Consultant
description:
**About Application Ally** 




 Application Ally is a boutique education consulting firm that provides highly personalized guidance to students navigating the global admissions process. We combine thoughtful mentorship, strategic advice, and meticulous application support to help students present their strongest and most authentic candidacy.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an Education Consultant to support students applying primarily to Master’s programs around the world, with a particular focus on universities in the US and UK.
 



 This is a multifaceted role combining graduate admissions consulting, writing and editing, student mentorship, and project and program management. You will guide students through the entire application journey: from early\-stage planning and university selection to developing application materials and managing final submissions.
 



  





 You will also contribute to broader initiatives such as student workshops, school and institutional partnerships, and internal programs and projects. We welcome candidates with direct admissions experience, as well as accomplished writers, communicators, and project managers from other professional backgrounds who are excited about working in education."
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




*Graduate Admissions Consulting* 



* Guide students through the end\-to\-end graduate application process, primarily for Master’s programs.
* Help students identify suitable universities and programs based on their academic background, professional goals, interests, and preferences.
* Develop individualized application strategies, timelines, and action plans.
* Support students in shaping compelling personal narratives across their applications.
* Provide detailed guidance and editorial feedback on statements of purpose, personal statements, essays, résumés, and other application materials.
* Prepare students for admissions interviews where required.
* Track multiple application requirements and deadlines, ensuring that each application is complete, accurate, and submitted on time.
* Communicate regularly with students.



*Project and Program Management* 



* Plan and conduct workshops, information sessions, and other student\-facing programs.
* Support projects involving colleges, counsellors, and institutional partners.
* Coordinate timelines, stakeholders, communications, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.
* Collaborate closely with the Application Ally team to ensure a consistently high standard of service.
* Contribute ideas for improving student resources, programs, workflows, and internal processes.
* Take ownership of assigned projects and follow them through from planning to delivery.



  





**Who We’re Looking For** 



* An exceptional writer and editor with a strong command of English.
* A polished, thoughtful, and highly effective communicator.
* Strong project\-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple students, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* An attentive listener who can understand a student’s experiences and help them communicate their story authentically.
* Detail\-oriented, dependable, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership.
* Able to provide candid, constructive, and empathetic feedback.
* Comfortable working collaboratively as part of a close\-knit team.
* Interested in higher education and motivated by helping students achieve meaningful academic and professional goals.



  





**Experience** 




 We are flexible about years of experience and will evaluate candidates based on the strength and relevance of their overall profile.
 



 Previous experience in graduate admissions, education consulting, counselling, writing, editing, communications, project management, program management, or a related field is valuable but not essential. Strong writers and project managers seeking to transition into education consulting are encouraged to apply.
 



  





**Why Join Application Ally?** 



* Do meaningful, high\-impact work with students at an important stage in their academic and professional journeys.
* Work in a boutique environment where every student receives personalized attention.
* Take on a varied role spanning consulting, mentorship, writing, workshops, partnerships, and program delivery.
* Join a collaborative team that values excellent work, thoughtful communication, and continuous learning.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Please apply through LinkedIn with your résumé or email it to anushkadesai@applicationally.net.

title: Stewarding Executive

 A passion for spreading the light and warmth of

title: OT Security Engineer L3
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced OT Security Engineer L3 to lead the design, deployment, integration, support, and optimization of OT security monitoring solutions across ICS, SCADA, DCS, and IIoT environments. The ideal candidate will bring 6–10 years of experience in OT cybersecurity and industrial network defense, act as the highest technical escalation point within the OT SOC, and drive implementation, threat hunting, incident response, detection engineering, customer engagement, and continuous improvement for complex industrial environments.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
* OT Security Architecture, Deployment, and Implementation


 Lead the deployment and configuration of OT monitoring solutions including Nozomi Guardian and related collectors, sensors, packet brokers, TAPs, SPAN ports, and syslog infrastructure.
   

  

 Design OT monitoring architecture for industrial environments covering asset visibility, protocol decoding, segmentation\-aware telemetry collection, and secure integration patterns.
   

  

 Install and configure SIEM platforms such as Splunk, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, FortiSIEM, and Elastic Security for OT use cases.
   

  

* Integration and Automation


 Integrate OT monitoring technologies with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence platforms, CMDBs, ticketing systems, and reporting solutions.
   

  

 Configure Syslog, REST APIs, STIX/TAXII feeds, automation workflows, and custom integrations for OT firewalls, switches, historians, HMIs, PLCs, and engineering workstations.
   

  

* Incident Response and Technical Escalation


 Lead the investigation of high\-severity OT security incidents and act as the final escalation point for complex issues raised by L1 and L2 analysts.
   

  

 Coordinate containment, eradication, recovery, root\-cause analysis, and technical communication with customer incident response teams and internal stakeholders.
   

  

* Threat Hunting and Detection Engineering


 Perform proactive threat hunting across OT and converged OT/IT environments to identify abnormal asset behavior, unsafe protocol usage, lateral movement, persistence mechanisms, and industrial attack techniques.
   

  

 Develop and optimize detection rules, dashboards, correlation logic, and OT\-specific use cases to improve fidelity and reduce false positives.
   

  

* Security Monitoring, Packet Analysis, and Forensics


 Review OT alerts and correlate them with enterprise SIEM telemetry, asset context, and industrial communication patterns.
   

  

 Perform advanced packet analysis using Wireshark, support forensic triage, validate malware indicators, and guide evidence collection for OT investigations.
   

  

* Customer Engagement and Technical Leadership


 Lead onsite and remote implementation activities, conduct customer workshops, deliver technical presentations, and provide expert troubleshooting during upgrades, migrations, and health checks.
   

  

 Serve as the senior technical SME for OT SOC operations and provide strategic guidance during architecture reviews, escalations, and service improvement planning.
   

  

* Engineering, Optimization, and Playbooks


 Create custom parsers, integrations, playbooks, SOPs, and knowledge artifacts that improve OT visibility, response consistency, and service quality.
   

  

 Optimize detection logic, data onboarding, alert tuning, and reporting workflows to improve MTTR, response quality, and customer outcomes.
   

  

* OT Domain, Protocol, and Asset Expertise


 Apply deep working knowledge of OT/ICS components including ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, historians, engineering workstations, industrial Ethernet, and IIoT\-connected assets.
   

  

 Demonstrate strong command of industrial protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870\-5\-104, IEC 61850, OPC UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, BACnet, and MQTT.
   

  

* Reporting and Documentation


 Produce executive dashboards, weekly and monthly SOC reports, compliance reporting, threat intelligence summaries, deployment status updates, and detailed root\-cause analyses.
   

  

 Maintain high\-quality technical documentation for deployments, incidents, integrations, customer environments, and engineering changes.
   

  

* Compliance, Risk, and Assessments


 Support OT cybersecurity assessments, vulnerability management activities, and control validation aligned to standards such as ISA/IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and customer\-specific governance requirements.
   

  

 Ensure delivery quality, SLA adherence, audit readiness, and operational alignment with plant safety and production constraints.
   

  

* Mentoring and Knowledge Transfer


 Mentor L1 and L2 analysts, guide implementation engineers, review technical deliverables, and conduct knowledge transfer sessions for customers and internal teams.
   

  

 Drive continuous learning around OT attack techniques, threat intelligence, use\-case maturity, and industrial cybersecurity best practices.
   

  

* Report deviations and concerns to the SOC Manager


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Electronics, Instrumentation, Industrial Automation, or a related field.
* 6–10 years of experience in OT cybersecurity, ICS/SCADA security monitoring, industrial network engineering, SOC operations, or related security engineering roles.
* Hands\-on expertise with OT monitoring and SIEM platforms such as Nozomi Guardian, Splunk, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, FortiSIEM, and Elastic Security.
* Strong understanding of ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, historians, engineering workstations, industrial switches, and asset visibility concepts.
* Deep knowledge of industrial protocols including Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870\-5\-104, IEC 61850, OPC UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, BACnet, and MQTT.
* Strong OT/industrial networking fundamentals covering TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, firewall policies, VPNs, IDS/IPS, packet capture, and secure remote access.
* Experience with Wireshark, Nmap, PowerShell, Linux, Windows Server, REST APIs, troubleshooting, deployment documentation, and RCA preparation.
* Excellent customer communication, presentation, technical leadership, problem\-solving, and mentoring skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert, CISSP, CEH, CompTIA Security\+, Nozomi Certified Engineer, Microsoft SC\-200, Splunk Certified Consultant, or equivalent.
* Experience designing OT visibility architectures, deploying collectors/sensors, validating TAP/SPAN strategies, and integrating packet, log, and asset telemetry.
* Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, SOAR orchestration, CMDB/ticketing integrations, custom parser development, and OT\-specific detection engineering.
* Working knowledge of Purdue Model, zones and conduits, industrial segmentation, change management in plant environments, and maintenance\-window\-aware deployment practices.
* Experience supporting industrial sectors such as manufacturing, energy, utilities, pharma, chemicals, transportation, or other critical infrastructure domains.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

**readylease.com**

 : $2,000 USD/month during 90\-day review period ➔ $2,500 USD/month upon confirmation (\~₹23L to ₹28\.7 LPA equivalent)
 




**Education Criteria** 

 : Tier 1 or Tier 2 Colleges (IIM, IIT, NIT's only)
 




  




**About Us** 

  




**About Shrestha Edutech** 

  






 Shrestha Edutech Private Limited is a technology and product engineering company building high\-impact platforms across global domains. Our engineering team works directly on production\-grade, international applications, giving engineers true technical ownership rather than isolated outsource assignments.
 




  




**About Ready Lease (Client)** 

  






 At Ready Lease (
 
**https://** 
**readylease.com** 

 ), we believe a single credit score or past rental bump shouldn't stand between someone and a place to call home. We are rebuilding the residential leasing landscape through second chance leasing \- a modern, data\-driven approach that looks
 
*beyond traditional credit scores* 

 .
 




  






 Operating in a recession\-resilient and counter\-cyclical market, our platform serves a massive, underserved demographic by combining real\-time bank verification, soft credit checks, and automated underwriting to pre\-approve renters across our property network.
 




  




**About the Role** 

  






 We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Full Stack Developer / Technical Lead with 8\+ years of software engineering experience. In this role, you will lead the technical design, development, and scaling of production applications across our product suite, with primary focus on our US\-facing Ready Lease platform.
 




  






 This is an architecture\-aware, hands\-on position. You will contribute to core backend systems, dynamic user interfaces, database design, and cloud deployments while establishing high engineering standards and mentoring mid\-level developers.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities** 

  




* **Full\-Stack Architecture \& Development:** 

 Design, build, and maintain scalable web applications and mobile\-ready services across frontend, backend, database, and cloud layers.
* **API \& System Integrations:** 

 Design robust REST/GraphQL APIs and integrate third\-party FinTech services (credit bureaus, bank verification, payment processing).
* **Database Management:** 

 Architect and optimize PostgreSQL schemas, queries, indexes, and data models for high performance and security.
* **Code Quality \& Technical Standards:** 

 Write clean, modular, and thoroughly tested production code; conduct thorough code reviews and establish CI/CD best practices.
* **Security \& Compliance:** 

 Ensure secure handling of customer PII, applying OWASP principles, data encryption, and zero\-trust access controls.
* **Technical Leadership \& Ownership:** 

 Act as a technical owner for key features—taking problems from initial requirements to architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
* **Mentorship:** 

 Support and guide junior/mid\-level developers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and documentation.



  




**Technical Stack \& Environment** 

  






 You do not need to be an expert in every tool listed below, but you should possess strong full\-stack fundamentals and senior\-level problem\-solving capabilities:
 




  




* **Frontend:** 

 React.js, React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5/CSS3
* **Backend:** 

 Python (FastAPI), Node.js (Express/NestJS), Java (Spring Boot)
* **Databases:** 

 PostgreSQL, Relational Schema Design, Query Optimization, ORM Tools
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** 

 AWS Services, Docker, CI/CD Pipelines, Terraform
* **Engineering Tools:** 

 Git, RESTful APIs, Automated Testing, Agile/Scrum
* **AI \& Productivity Tools:** 

 Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLM\-driven workflows, CI/CD automation



  




**What We Are Looking For** 

  




**Required Qualifications** 

  




* **8\+ years** 

 of professional full\-stack software development experience.
* **Exceptional English Communication:** 

 Fluent written and spoken English skills are strictly required. You must be able to confidently articulate complex technical concepts, lead architectural discussions, and collaborate directly with US\-based product managers and executive leadership without friction.
* **Frontend Expertise:** 

 Strong experience building modern interfaces using React.js
 
**and/or React Native** 

 .
* **Backend Expertise:** 

 Proven track record building production services using Python
 
**, Node.js, or Java** 

 .
* **Database Proficiency:** 

 Hands\-on experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases.
* **Cloud \& Infrastructure:** 

 Working experience with AWS and modern deployment/CI/CD pipelines.
* **Communication \& Ownership:** 

 Ability to independently manage features and communicate complex technical concepts effectively with stakeholders.
* **Location \& Commute:** 

 Ability to work from our Delhi office according to our structured hybrid schedule.



  




**Preferred Qualifications** 

  




* Experience with
 
**Python/FastAPI** 

 paired with
 
**React/React Native** 

 .
* Experience in FinTech, PropTech, SaaS, or data\-sensitive consumer platforms.

**:** 

 Hands\-on experience using modern AI developer tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate code generation, test writing, refactoring, and rapid prototyping.

 Ready Lease operates in a counter\-cyclical sector where demand for second\-chance leasing and alternative credit underwriting remains consistently high across all economic environments, providing long\-term business stability.

 Work directly on an active US\-focused FinTech and PropertyTech platform, solving real\-world consumer credit and housing problems at scale.

 Work alongside founding leadership and key business stakeholders without corporate layers or administrative bureaucracy.

 Direct technical involvement in a fast\-growing US FinTech product.

**ABOUT AIR INDIA SATS AIRPORT SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED** 




 AISATS, a leading gateway services provider in India, is a 50\-50 joint venture between Air India Limited (a part of the TATA Group) and SATS Ltd., one of the world’s largest providers of air cargo handling services and Asia’s leading airline caterer. ‘AISATS’ is defined by its people – they are our greatest strength. With deep domain knowledge of the aviation ecosystem, we offer end\-to\-end ground handling services such as passenger and baggage handling, ramp handling, aircraft interior cleaning, load control and flight operations, and cargo handling services for general, perishable, transshipment, express courier and special cargo.
 



  





**JOB PURPOSE** 




 The Safety Executive (E1\) supports the Safety Manager in ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant day\-to\-day operations. The role is responsible for monitoring ramp and terminal activities, identifying hazards, reporting unsafe conditions, coordinating incident investigations, and reinforcing the organization’s Safety Management System (SMS). The position acts as a key link between operational teams and the Safety Department, promoting proactive safety behavior and continuous improvement.
 



  





**SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 \- Monitor operational areas to identify unsafe acts, unsafe conditions, and SOP violations.
 



 \- Collect factual data related to safety violations, hazards, accidents, and near misses.
 



 \- Serve as communication link between operations and the Safety Department.
 



 \- Participate in or conduct incident investigations, including root cause analysis.
 



 \- Submit investigation reports with CAPA recommendations.
 



 \- Ensure consistent accident, incident, and near\-miss reporting by operational teams.
 



 \- Assist in operational incident investigations as required.
 



 \- Report any unsafe or abnormal events immediately to the Safety Officer/Manager.
 



 \- Monitor staff activities and escalate unsafe behaviors for corrective action.
 



 \- Support audits, inspections, toolbox talks, and safety campaigns.
 



 \- Assist in SMS documentation, record\-keeping, and compliance reporting.
 



 \- Support delivery of safety trainings and awareness communication.
 



 \- Take on assignments delegated by Safety Manager and assume additional responsibilities as needed.
 



 \- Facilitate active participation and coordination for Emergency Response Exercise, drills, table top, etc.
 



 \- Responsible and accountable for safety, quality, and security of operations in assigned areas.
 



 \- Report occurrences violating safety, security, or operational standards to supervisors.
 



  





**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS** 




 \- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a recognized university.
 



 \- Additional safety certifications (SMS, QMS, NEBOSH, IOSH, Industrial Safety, Aviation Safety) preferred.
 



  





**RELEVANT EXPERIENCE** 




 \- Minimum 12 months of experience in civil aviation.
 



 \- Experience in Ramp Supervision preferred.
 



 \- Computer proficiency is compulsory.
 



  





**PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS \& BEHAVIOURS** 




 \- Physically fit with stamina suitable for airside operations.
 



 \- Fluency in spoken and written English.
 



 \- Strong people management and supervisory skills.
 



 \- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
 



 \- Team player capable of leading cross\-functional groups.
 



 \- Adaptable to computerized reporting and tracking systems.
 



 \- Capable of conducting incident investigations and tracking CAPA closure.
 



 \- Demonstrated professionalism, discipline, and positive attitude.

title: GTM & Business Development Manager
description:
About the Role
 
 This is more than a lead\-generation or cold\-calling position.
 



 You will work closely with the founder to sharpen Looply’s go\-to\-market strategy, identify the right markets and accounts, create new business opportunities, manage the sales pipeline and convert qualified prospects into long\-term clients.
 



 You should be comfortable moving from research and outreach to discovery, solution\-building, proposal creation, negotiation and closure.

 * Help define Looply’s ideal customer profiles, priority industries and target accounts
* Identify opportunities across branding, websites, technology, marketing, automation and integrated retainers
* Research markets, competitors, buying behaviour and emerging client needs
* Develop industry\-specific outreach angles, offers and entry strategies
* Turn Looply’s capabilities into clear, commercially relevant solutions
* Help build a repeatable and measurable GTM motion


 Business Development
 * Build and manage a qualified pipeline through outbound outreach, referrals, partnerships, networking and inbound opportunities
* Identify and connect with founders, marketing heads, business heads and other decision\-makers
* Run personalised outreach through LinkedIn, email, calls and relevant channels

* Coordinate with strategy, creative and technology teams to shape the right solution
* Prepare proposals, pitch decks, scopes and commercial recommendations
* Handle follow\-ups, objections, negotiations and closures

 Revenue Growth
 * Build a healthy mix of projects and recurring retainers
* Improve lead\-to\-meeting, meeting\-to\-proposal and proposal\-to\-close conversion rates
* Identify cross\-selling and upselling opportunities within existing accounts
* Build relationships that can lead to repeat business and referrals
* Track pipeline value, sales cycle, win rate and revenue forecast
* Contribute directly to the revenue growth required to scale Looply from 10 to 50 team members


 Sales Operations
 * Establish a structured process from prospecting to closure and handover
* Create outreach sequences, qualification frameworks and follow\-up systems
* Maintain sales documentation, account intelligence and next actions
* Coordinate smooth handovers to account management and delivery teams
* Share market feedback that can improve Looply’s services, positioning and pricing


 What We Are Looking For
 * Minimum 3 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, agency sales or GTM roles

* Strong understanding of consultative and solution\-based selling

 This Role Is for You If

title: Solutions Development Architect
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
