We are dedicated to creating meaningful opportunities and supporting the growth and well\-being of our team. Join us in building a world where everyone can unite, take action, and create lasting change.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 This position supports the RI Programs and Service team, which includes RI Programs, volunteer\-led service, alumni engagement, service and project partnerships, and special projects related to member engagement and impact. You will work with colleagues and volunteer members, and your contributions will span across the operations of the portfolio and the team’s commitments to deliver on Rotary’s Strategic Plan.
   

  

**You Will Have**
* Minimum Bachelor’s degree required
* A minimum of three years’ experience providing administrative support to departments or programs or a related field (i.e. volunteer engagement, non\-profit management)
* Mastery of Microsoft products, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Teams, and SharePoint
* Experience analyzing data, synthesizing information, and identifying trends
* Ability to develop materials and correspondence based upon broad guidance
* Strong time management and organizational skills
* International experience either through work, study, or volunteering
* Excellent writing and communication skills in English
* Professional communication skills in a second language is preferred


**You Are Good At**
* Accomplishing tasks with a minimum of supervision
* Setting priorities and working collegially yet independently
* Written and oral communication
* Showing attention to detail and accuracy
* Maintaining discretion with sensitive information
* Working with volunteers and staff across all levels of seniority


**You Are Open To**
* Building relationships with other areas of Rotary
* Learning new skills that enhance the work quality of the team
* Periodic early morning, evening, or weekend assignments


**You Will Be Responsible For**
**Supporting RI Programs**
* Processing programmatic chartering, replacement, and termination requests for the regional and RI World Headquarters
* Supporting members, participant, and alumni with chartering and program\-related inquiries
* Maintaining data quality around RI programs and program participants
* Supporting program participant data reporting and assisting with related inquiries
* Collaborating on and supporting future processes for revenue\-generating opportunities related to RI Programs
* Identifying process gaps and improvement opportunities, and collaborating with the appropriate colleagues on improvements.

**Data Analysis and Reporting**
* Working with the RI Programs Manager to coordinate data collection efforts.
* Analyzing collected data, identifying insights and trends and collaborating on reports with findings.
* Assisting with other special projects as assigned.


**Events Support**
* As requested, representing the RI Programs and Service portfolio at virtual and in\-person regional events
* Assisting with webinar logistics and related e\-learning opportunities
* Recording notes for Committee meetings, constituent group meetings, staff meetings;
* Serving as a base of information and coordination of activities for RI Programs \& Service;
* Performing other duties as assigned.


**Distribution of Work**
 60% of the work for this position will be dedicated to global RI Programs and Service support, and 40% will be dedicated to regional programs and service support, including relationship\-building.
   

  

**Leadership Attributes**
* Communication: Be open to receiving ideas from diverse viewpoints and able to communicate messages so that they are universally understood.
* Collaboration: Builds partnerships and works jointly with others to meet shared objectives.
* Productivity: Able to generate results that moves Rotary toward achieving its goals.
* Accountability: Have a clear sense of ownership and take personal responsibility for actions.
* Adaptability: Respond to changes willingly and recognize when to adjust based on the situation.

The CCM must demonstrate the knowledge to work independently, make timely claim decisions, and must possess the knowledge and experience which allows performance of the daily activities of the job with minimal supervision.

**Major Opportunities and Decisions:** 




 This position utilizes problem solving, analytical, written and verbal communication skills to ensure timely and appropriate disability claim decisions while providing superior customer service to all internal and external customers. This position will review claims for Short Term Disability and requires consistent and effective claim management skills to succeed in a collaborative, team\-oriented culture with a goal to drive positive claim outcomes.

Proactively work with claimants to recover overpayments in full or negotiate monthly instalments according to established protocol

* Regulatory and Compliance experience a plus
* Ability to multi\-task and meet turnaround times
* Ability to clearly communicate claim decisions and contract language verbally and in written correspondence
* Understanding of medical terminology and medical conditions helpful

title: Quality Assurance Test Engineer
description:
**Typesider \| Noida \| Hybrid \| Full\-time \| 0–3 Years** 




 Compensation:
 **₹3–5 LPA** 




  




**About Typesider** 

 Typesider is a reward based Windows desktop application that turns everyday computer activity into tangible rewards.
 



 Users earn Typoints based on keyboard keystrokes and mouse clicks while using their computers normally. Typoints can be redeemed for coupons, discounts, exclusive brand offers, and soon, cashback.
 



 Typesider is designed to work seamlessly in the background and follows a privacy first approach. It counts activity volume but does not read, record, or store what users type or the content of their computer activity.
 



 We’re building a consumer product where reliability, usability, privacy, and trust are critical.
   




**About the Role** 

 We’re looking for a Quality Assurance Test Engineer to help us test and improve Typesider as we continue developing and releasing the product.
 



 You’ll work closely with the product and development teams to test the Windows application, identify bugs, explore edge cases, and ensure new features work reliably for real users.
 



 This is a hands on role where you’ll have a direct impact on product quality.
   




**What You’ll Do** 

 • Test the Typesider Windows desktop application across different user scenarios
 



 • Create, document, and execute manual test cases and test scenarios
 



 • Perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing
 



 • Test the complete user journey, including installation, onboarding, streaks, reward days, reward claims, and redemption
 



 • Test new features and product updates before release
 



 • Identify bugs, edge cases, and usability issues
 



 • Document bugs clearly with steps to reproduce, expected behavior, actual behavior, severity, and supporting information
 



 • Verify fixes and perform regression testing
 



 • Test different Windows environments and user scenarios
 



 • Work closely with developers and the product team to understand and resolve issues
 



 • Think like a real user and identify issues that could impact trust, engagement, retention, and overall experience
 



 • Help improve testing processes and documentation as the product grows
   




**What We’re Looking For** 

 • 0–3 years of experience in QA, software testing, or a related field
 



 • Freshers and candidates with 1–3 years of experience are welcome to apply
 



 • Good understanding of manual testing and software testing principles
 



 • Ability to create and execute clear test cases and test scenarios
 



 • Understanding of functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing
 



 • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify bugs and edge cases
 



 • Ability to write clear and reproducible bug reports
 



 • Good analytical and problem solving skills
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication skills
 



 • Comfortable working closely with developers and product teams
 



 • Willingness to explore a product deeply and question how things work
   




**Good to Have** 

 • Experience testing Windows desktop applications
 



 • Familiarity with Jira or similar bug tracking tools
 



 • Basic understanding of API testing
 



 • Exposure to automation testing or QA automation tools
 



 • Experience testing consumer software or applications involving rewards, subscriptions, payments, or user accounts
   




**What We Value** 

 We’re looking for someone who doesn't just follow a checklist.
 



 A good QA engineer should be able to ask:
 



 What happens if the user does this?
 



 What happens if the system fails here?
 



 Can this feature be misunderstood or misused?
 



 Does this actually work the way a real user would expect?
 



 Your ability to think through these scenarios and uncover problems will be a major part of the role.
   




**Why Join Typesider** 

 Typesider is an early stage consumer product, so you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with the team building the product and see your work directly influence releases.
 



 You’ll be testing a product used by real users and helping build the quality standards and QA processes as the product grows.
   




**Work Details** 

 Experience: 0–3 Years
 



 Compensation: ₹3–5 LPA
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 



 Work Mode: Hybrid
 



 Working Days: Monday to Friday
 



 Working Hours: 10AM \- 6PM

description:
Job description
 



 Job Title: Senior AI/ML Engineer/Team Lead
 



 Location:Gurugram
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Experience: 5\+ Years
 



  





 About Aaizel Tech
 



 Aaizel Tech is a pioneering tech startup at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, geospatial solutions, and more. We drive innovation by delivering transformative technology solutions across industries. As a growing startup, we are looking for passionate and versatile professionals eager to work on cutting\-edge projects in a dynamic environment.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 As a Senior AI/ML Engineer at Aaizel Tech, you will lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models and AI solutions. You will work on projects ranging from predictive analytics and NLP to computer vision and anomaly detection. You will also mentor a team of AI/ML professionals, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and drive innovation by integrating state\-of\-the\-art research with scalable production systems.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Model Development \& Optimization
 



 Design \& Implementation:
 


* Architect and develop end\-to\-end ML solutions for applications such as predictive analytics, anomaly detection, computer vision, and NLP.
* Utilize advanced techniques including deep learning (CNNs, RNNs), reinforcement learning, and generative models (GANs) to address complex challenges.



 Optimization:
 


* Fine\-tune model parameters using techniques such as hyperparameter tuning (Grid Search, Bayesian Optimization, Neural Architecture Search).
* Optimize models for both accuracy and inference speed to meet real\-time processing requirements.



 2\. Advanced Data Engineering \& Integration
 



 Data Pipeline Development:
 


* Build robust ETL pipelines using libraries like Pandas, NumPy, and PySpark to process large\-scale datasets from satellite imagery, IoT sensors, and real\-time streams.
* Integrate data from diverse sources (APIs, databases, big data platforms like Hadoop and Apache Kafka) to support real\-time analytics.



 Data Quality \& Preprocessing:
 


* Implement data cleansing, feature engineering, and transformation pipelines to ensure high\-quality inputs for ML models.



 3\. Research \& Innovation
 



 Algorithm Research:
 


* Conduct research on state\-of\-the\-art ML techniques including Transfer Learning, Transformer models, and AutoML to enhance model performance.
* Innovate new algorithms for specialized tasks such as geospatial analysis, environmental modeling, or cybersecurity threat detection.



 Prototyping \& Experimentation:
 


* Develop proof\-of\-concept models and prototypes to validate new approaches before production deployment.



 4\. Deployment, MLOps \& Performance Monitoring
 



 Model Deployment:
 


* Deploy models using containerization (Docker) and orchestration tools (Kubernetes) to ensure scalable and efficient production environments.
* Work with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and model serving solutions (TensorFlow Serving, ONNX, TorchServe) for high\-throughput inference.



 MLOps \& Lifecycle Management:
 


* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models, ensuring seamless updates and versioning.
* Develop monitoring dashboards (using Prometheus, Grafana) to track model performance and trigger retraining based on real\-time feedback.



 5\. Collaboration \& Leadership
 



 Cross\-Functional Teamwork:
 


* Collaborate closely with data engineers, software developers, domain experts, and product managers to integrate AI solutions into end\-to\-end products.



 Mentorship \& Code Quality:
 


* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior AI/ML engineers, ensuring adherence to coding standards and best practices.
* Participate in code reviews, maintain detailed documentation, and foster a culture of continuous learning.



  





 Recommended Technology Stack
 



 Backend Framework:
 


* Python (Django/FastAPI): Ideal for API integration, leveraging Python’s rich AI/ML ecosystem.



 AI/ML Frameworks:
 


* PyTorch \+ Hugging Face Transformers \+ scikit\-learn: For flexibility in research, multilingual NLP tasks, and classical ML pipelines.



 Data Engineering:
 


* Apache Kafka \+ Apache Spark \+ Apache NiFi: To handle both real\-time data streaming and batch processing.



 Database \& Storage:
 


* PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB extension: For structured and time\-series data storage.



 DevOps \& Monitoring:
 


* Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Prometheus/Grafana: For containerized deployments, continuous integration, and comprehensive monitoring.



 Media Processing:
 


* OpenCV, FFmpeg, Tesseract OCR, Wav2Vec2: To support image, video, and speech\-to\-text processing where needed.



  





 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



 Technical Expertise:
 


* Experience:
* 5 years in Machine Learning, AI research, or a related field with a proven track record of delivering production\-level AI solutions.
* Programming \& Frameworks:
* Expertise in Python and hands\-on experience with frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit\-learn.
* Experience with Hugging Face Transformers for NLP applications.
* Data Engineering:
* Proficiency in building data pipelines using Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, and integrating data from diverse sources.
* Familiarity with big data platforms and real\-time data processing frameworks.
* Model Deployment \& MLOps:
* Hands\-on experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines for ML models.
* Experience with cloud deployment and model serving solutions.
* Research \& Innovation:
* Demonstrated ability to apply advanced ML techniques (deep learning, transfer learning, reinforcement learning) to solve real\-world problems.
* Testing \& Optimization:
* Strong background in model evaluation, hyperparameter tuning, and performance optimization.



 Soft Skills:
 


* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical abilities.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* Leadership and mentoring experience, with a collaborative approach to working in cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and drive continuous innovation.



 Educational Background:
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field from a reputed institution.



  





 What We Offer
 


* Innovative Projects: Engage in cutting\-edge AI/ML projects that influence product strategy and technological innovation.
* Professional Growth: Opportunities for continuous learning, mentorship, and career advancement.
* Collaborative Culture: Work within a diverse team of experts passionate about pushing the boundaries of technology.
* Impactful Work: Play a key role in shaping AI\-driven solutions and driving real\-world impact.



  





 How to Apply
 



 Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and how you can contribute to Aaizel Tech's success. Send your application to hr@aaizeltech.com, anju@aaizeltech.com.
 



  





 Join Aaizel Tech as a Senior AI/ML Engineer and lead the development of innovative, scalable AI solutions that transform industries and drive digital excellence!

title: Senior Administrative Executive
description:
**About Protsahan**
 Protsahan India Foundation works with 96,000\+ girls annually across Delhi’s slum communities, building pathways out of poverty through education, mental health support, and livelihoods training. As the organisation scales into a pan\-India field\-building model in 2026, the Executive Director’s office requires dedicated, high\-calibre support to manage a wide and demanding portfolio of administrative, regulatory, and coordination responsibilities.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Senior Administrative Executive will directly support the Executive Director in managing time\-sensitive administrative, regulatory, and coordination tasks that fall within the ED’s direct responsibility but do not require the ED’s personal judgement or presence to execute. This is a role for someone who takes ownership of tasks end\-to\-end, tracks details precisely, and follows through without repeated reminders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage and track all statutory, regulatory, and administrative filings, licenses, registrations, and renewals that fall under the ED’s direct responsibility, maintaining a live compliance and renewals calendar with no missed deadlines.
* Coordinate with government departments, vendors, consultants, and external agencies on behalf of the ED, following up, collecting documentation, and driving pending applications to closure.
* Manage the ED’s calendar, correspondence, and meeting preparation, including compiling briefing notes and background material ahead of key meetings.
* Draft, proofread, and format correspondence, documents, and presentations on behalf of the ED.
* Maintain organised, accessible records of all documentation handled, physical and digital, so that nothing is dependent on institutional memory alone.
* Support the ED in tracking action items arising from meetings, board interactions, and donor conversations, and follow up proactively until closure.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information relating to governance, compliance, and personnel matters.
* Take on other administrative work sitting under the ED’s purview as required.


**Candidate Requirements**
**Non\-negotiables**
* Impeccable attention to detail. This is the single most important requirement for this role. The ideal candidate double\-checks their own work as a habit, catches errors before anyone else does, and treats documentation accuracy as professional pride, not obligation.
* Process discipline. Follows documented processes precisely, without shortcutting steps or improvising on filings, checklists, or approval flows. Deviations are flagged and discussed, not decided unilaterally.
* 24\-hour turnaround on assigned tasks. Every task gets a status update within one working day, even if the update is that the task is blocked.
* Absolute discretion. Handles confidential documents and conversations without exception.


**Essential**
* Graduate degree in any discipline. Additional certification in office administration or business support is welcome but not required.
* At least 5 years of experience in an executive assistant, administrative coordination, or similar support role, ideally involving statutory or regulatory filings.
* Prior direct experience supporting a Founder, CEO, or ED.
* Demonstrated experience navigating government departments or regulatory processes (fire department, municipal bodies, FCRA, or statutory filings).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Office and Google Workspace.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment.


**Preferred**
* Prior experience working with or for a non\-profit, foundation, or mission\-driven organisation.
* Familiarity with FCRA compliance requirements, or willingness to learn quickly.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Regulatory and statutory filings under the ED’s purview are tracked, followed up, and closed on time, with no last\-minute surprises.
* Correspondence and documents prepared for the ED are accurate and ready to use without correction.
* Routine administrative and procedural work is handled end\-to\-end, freeing the ED to focus on judgement\-heavy work only ED can do.

title: Manager – Financial Accounting
description:
**About Protsahan**
 Protsahan India Foundation works with 96,000\+ girls annually across Delhi’s slum communities, building pathways out of poverty through education, mental health support, and livelihoods training. As we scale into a pan\-India field\-building model in 2026, we are hiring a Manager – Financial Accounting to run the everyday execution of our finance function end\-to\-end and take full accountability for our accounting integrity, compliance, and reporting.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role is for someone who has moved from executing finance tasks to owning finance outcomes. You are accountable for accuracy, timeliness, and audit\-readiness across the function, not just for your own work. You run the function so the leadership can focus on strategy.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Full accountability for the accounting function. The accuracy of ledgers, monthly close discipline, and the integrity of every statutory and donor filing that leaves the office.
* Direct leadership of the finance team. Team leadership responsibility formalises after successful completion of probation. Once formalised, direct reports include the Assistant Manager and Senior Executive in the function, with room for the team to grow as the organisation scales.
* FCRA compliance end\-to\-end. FC\-4 filings, utilization certificates, designated bank account discipline, and adherence to non\-mixing rules across FC and non\-FC funds.
* Statutory compliance. Income Tax, TDS, GST (where applicable), PF, ESIC, and Section 12A/80G renewal filings, working with the Statutory Auditor to ensure zero compliance gaps.
* Audit management. Statutory audit, internal audit, and donor audits. You are the primary interface with auditors and keep documentation audit\-ready year\-round.
* Payroll oversight on Keka. Coordinating with HR on inputs, ensuring accurate monthly payroll disbursement, statutory deductions, and reconciliation with accounting entries in Tally.
* Financial reporting. Monthly MIS to the ED, quarterly reports to the Board, and donor\-specific reports on grant utilization, restricted fund balances, and budget variances.
* Internal controls and process design. Chart of accounts review, segregation of duties, approval workflows, and continuous strengthening of the control environment.
* Board and governance support. Preparation of finance sections of board packs, presentation of financials to the Board Finance Committee where required, and independent escalation of any material concerns to the Board Treasurer where warranted.


**Non\-negotiables**
* Ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. You are accountable for the numbers being right, whether you did the entry or your team did. You do not hide behind your team when errors surface.
* FCRA fluency. You can walk through FC\-4 preparation, UC mechanics, the designated bank account architecture, and non\-mixing rules from memory. You have personally owned FCRA compliance for at least 3\-4 years.
* Audit calm. Auditor visits are routine, not fire drills. You keep documentation audit\-ready year\-round, not only in the week\-of the audit.
* Judgment plus process. You follow documented processes and know when to escalate a deviation. You do not shortcut compliance, and you do not escalate every decision back up the chain.
* Absolute discretion. On payroll data, board conversations, related\-party disclosures, and compensation matters.


**Must\-haves**
* CA, CMA, MBA (Finance), or M.Com with a strong accounting foundation.
* Minimum 8\-10 years of accounting and finance experience, with at least 4\-5 years directly handling FCRA compliance and donor grant accounting.
* Demonstrated experience running monthly closures, managing statutory audits, and preparing board\-level financial reports.
* Expertise in knowledge of Tally (essential) and Keka payroll (or willingness to learn quickly), plus advanced Excel and Google Sheets.
* Experience leading and developing a small finance team (2\-5 people).
* Comfort presenting to senior stakeholders including the ED, Board, statutory auditors, and donor representatives.


**Advantage if You Bring**
* Prior experience in an NGO of comparable scale (50\+ staff, multiple field locations, multiple funding streams).
* Familiarity with Trust structures, and FCRA changes over the last five years.
* Exposure to donor audits from institutional funders (US, UK, EU, Indian CSR).
* Experience implementing or upgrading a finance system (chart of accounts overhaul, Tally migration, MIS build).


**Governance and Independence**
 This role carries specific independence obligations that protect you, protect the organisation, and give the Board comfort:
   

  

* You will interface directly with the Statutory Auditor on all audit findings.
* You will have a dotted line to the Board for any related\-party transactions, compensation disclosures for founding members, and any material concerns you cannot resolve with the ED.
* You are expected to escalate concerns independently where warranted. This is a feature of the role, not a failure of it.


**Growth Path**
 Manager, Grade C1 as per Protsahan’s band structure. Promotion to Senior Manager or Head of Finance is available based on sustained ownership of the function, expansion of scope, and Board endorsement. There is no minimum tenure lock. The path opens when the readiness is there.
   

  

**Employee Value Proposition**
* EPF (as applicable)

* Gratuity (as per applicable law)
* Group Accident Insurance
* Group Medical Insurance
* 24 annual leaves apart from gazetted and national holidays
* Learning and growth opportunities

 **Software Developer** 




  





 Location: Delhi

 Company: ISC IT Services Pvt. Ltd.

 ISC is a fast\-growing IT and BPO company based in Delhi. We provide software development, business intelligence, data visualisation, reporting, data analytics and other IT\-enabled services to reputed European airlines.
 



  





 As we expand our capabilities in AI\-enabled software and automation, we are looking for developers who combine strong programming fundamentals with an AI\-ready mindset.

 We are seeking a Software Developer with professional experience in React.js, Python and MySQL.
 



 The selected candidate will contribute across the software development lifecycle—from solution design and prototyping to development, testing, deployment and documentation.
 



  





**Required Technical Skills** 




 • React.js
 



 • Python
 



 • MySQL
 



 • Front\-end and back\-end application development
 



 • REST API development and third\-party integrations
 



 • Responsive web application development
 



 • Database design and management
 



 • Understanding of client\-server architecture

 The ideal candidate should:
 



 • Be familiar with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms
 



 • Understand how AI tools can support coding, debugging, testing, documentation and prototyping
 



 • Be interested in developing AI\-enabled applications and automation solutions
 



 • Be willing to continuously learn about AI, Large Language Models and emerging technologies
 



 • Be able to critically evaluate and validate AI\-generated outputs before using them
 



 Knowledge or experience in .NET and MS SQL will be an added advantage.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Develop front\-end architecture and responsive user interfaces

title: Sales Manager
description:
As a Sales Development Manager at 9 CORK, you will drive business growth across India by managing incoming leads, generating new B2B sales opportunities, and delivering an exceptional in\-person experience for clients visiting our Noida display centre. Operating from our Noida headquarters, you will take full ownership of the sales pipeline for our sustainable cork solutions—Premium wall coverings, and eco\-friendly gifting solutions. You will also represent 9 CORK on\-site at major pan\-India B2B trade exhibitions, converting qualified interactions into long\-term accounts.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Display Centre \& Client Hosting:** 
 Warmly welcome and assist B2B clients, designers, and corporate visitors visiting our Noida display centre; walk them through product samples, demonstrate eco\-friendly cork applications, and convert walk\-ins into qualified opportunities.
* **Lead Generation \& Pipeline Management:** 
 Proactively identify, prospect, and qualify new B2B clients across India through cold outreach, market research, and targeted industry networking.
* **Inbound Lead Conversion:** 
 Promptly respond to, qualify, and nurture incoming digital, phone, and referral leads to close sales opportunities.
* **Exhibition \& Event Presence:** 
 Travel with leadership to represent 9 CORK at major pan\-India B2B trade exhibitions; manage booth traffic, conduct live product demonstrations, and capture high\-value leads.
* **Client Consultation \& Commercials:** 
 Understand customized cork product requirements, prepare tailored commercial quotes, negotiate pricing, and close deals.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 
 Collaborate closely with internal manufacturing, logistics, and design teams to ensure accurate custom order fulfillment and reliable on\-time delivery.



  





**Candidate Requirements \& Qualifications** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 3–6 years of hands\-on experience in B2B sales development or field sales, preferably within eco\-friendly products, interior materials, or manufacturing sectors.



  





**Core Competencies:** 




  




* **Lead Generation \& Prospecting:** 
 Proven track record in outbound prospecting, cold outreach, and managing an end\-to\-end sales pipeline.
* **In\-Person Client Handling:** 
 Demonstrated experience in hosting corporate clients, architects, designers, or walk\-in visitors in a showroom or display centre environment.
* **Exhibition Sales:** 
 Experience representing brands at industrial B2B trade shows and converting event leads into revenue.
* **Mobility \& Location:** 
 Based in or willing to commute daily to Noida, with flexibility to travel pan\-India for client visits and trade exhibitions.
* **Skills:** 
 Strong negotiation, presentation, and communication skills (English and Hindi); familiarity with CRM software and pipeline tracking tools.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field (MBA is a plus).

title: Insurance AI Architect
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Insurance AI Architect
 



**Skills:** 
 Generative AI, RAG, LLM, Insurance Domain, AWS/Azure/GCP
 



**Experience:** 
 12\-18 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Greater Noida
 



  





 We at Coforge are hiring for Insurance AI Architect
 



  





**Insurance Industry \& Platform Expertise** 



* **Duck Creek Technologies:** 
 Working knowledge of Duck Creek OnDemand, Duck Creek Policy, Claims, Billing, and Rating modules; understanding of Duck Creek's Author/Manuscript configuration model, Duck Creek Data Insights, and Duck Creek's low\-code/no\-code extensibility framework
* **Optional \- Guidewire InsuranceSuite:** 
 Basic knowledge of PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, and BillingCenter architecture, including Gosu scripting, PC/CC/BC data model, Integration Gateway, Cloud API, and Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP); familiarity with UI framework and Guidewire Marketplace apps
* **Platform integration patterns:** 
 Experience with how AI services plug into both platforms via REST/SOAP APIs, event\-driven architectures (Guidewire Cloud Events, Duck Creek's integration points), webhooks, and middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services)
* Understanding of
 **P\&C Commercial \& Specialty product structures:** 
 Rating algorithms, forms/endorsements, exposure bases, and how these map into platform data models



  





**AI/ML Technical Stack** 



* **LLM \& GenAI frameworks:** 
 LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel; prompt engineering, RAG architecture design, and agentic frameworks ( CrewAI, or similar) for multi\-step underwriting/claims workflows
* **Foundation model platforms:** 
 Practical experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Anthropic Claude/API; model selection criteria (cost, latency, accuracy) for insurance\-specific tasks
* **Traditional ML/predictive modeling:** 
 Regression, gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM) for risk scoring and pricing models; familiarity with actuarial modeling concepts as they intersect with ML
* **Document AI/IDP:** 
 OCR and intelligent document processing (Azure Form Recognizer, AWS Textract) for submission intake, ACORD forms, loss runs, and SOV (statement of values) processing a common Commercial/Specialty use case
* **MLOps \& deployment:** 
 Model versioning, monitoring, and governance tooling (MLflow, Azure ML, SageMaker); CI/CD for AI pipelines integrated with platform release cycles
* **Microsoft AI Platform Expertise: Copilot Studio, Foundry and Microsoft ecosystem integration**
* **Platform decision\-making:** 
 Judgment on when to use Copilot Studio (low\-code, business\-user\-facing agents) vs. AI Foundry (custom, code\-first, higher\-control agentic solutions) vs. open\-source/other cloud AI stacks, based on client maturity, governance needs, and use case complexity



  





**Data \& Cloud Architecture** 



* **Cloud platforms:** 
 Azure, AWS, or GCP; landing zone design, data lake/lakehouse architecture for insurance data
* **Data engineering:** 
 ETL/ELT pipelines pulling from Duck Creek/Guidewire data models into analytics or AI\-ready stores; understanding of insurance data standards (ACORD, ISO)
* **API \& microservices design:** 
 RESTful API design, event streaming (Kafka), and how to expose AI capabilities as composable services consumable by both platforms



  





**Governance \& Compliance** 



* Working knowledge of
 **model risk management** 
 , explainability techniques
* Familiarity with
 **SOC 2, data privacy (state insurance data regulations), and responsible AI frameworks** 
 as applied to carrier environments



  





**Executive \& Stakeholder Communication** 



* CXO\-level engagement
* Executive storytelling \& influence
* Trusted advisor positioning
* Change management fluency

title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:

 Onsite \- Noida, India

 Full\-time
 




  





**Reporting To** 





 Founder
 




  





**Experience Required** 





 2\-4 years 
 




  





**Qualifications** 





 Graduate (B.Tech in IT or Computer Science preferred)
 




  





**About the role** 





 We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer (Playwright or Selenium) who will be responsible for ensuring that all our digital products\- Mobile applications (Android, Flutter), websites (NEXT.js, React), and backend systems, meet the highest standards of quality and performance.
 





 The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, logical, and organized, with a strong technical understanding of both automation and manual testing processes. You will work closely with developers to write, maintain, and optimize test cases, ensuring every deployment is smooth, bug\-free, and reliable.

* Write, execute, and maintain test cases for all applications and ensure they are updated as systems evolve.
* Ensure proper documentation and organization of all test cases and testing processes.
* Collaborate with developers to identify and fix bugs quickly, ensuring high\-quality releases.
* Use Playwright, Selenium, and Postman for automation and API testing.
* Analyze bugs, log issues, and track them through resolution using project management tools.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, test automation frameworks, and standards.
* Proficiency with testing frameworks, automation tools (e.g., Playwright, Selenium, Cypress), and API testing.
* Solid understanding of Agile methodologies and the software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Proficiency in Python/Node.js for writing test scripts.
* Strong understanding of programming languages: Node, Java, Dart, JavaScript.
* Database familiarity: Firebase, PostgreSQL, MySQL.
* Experience with Postman, Playwright, and Selenium.
* Working knowledge of REST API testing (Postman/Newman, curl, or pytest requests).
* Excellent test case organization and documentation abilities.
* Strong logical thinking, analytical mindset, and problem\-solving orientation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with developers and stakeholders.



  





**Success Metrics / KPIs** 



* Bug\-Free Deployments: Measured reduction in critical post\-deployment issues.
* Number of Deployments: Increased volume of stable and verified releases.
* Speed of Testing: Reduced turnaround time between builds and QA sign\-off.
* Test Coverage: Comprehensive test case coverage across all modules and products.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Highly logical and analytical thinker with a structured approach to problem\-solving.
* Meticulous and organized in handling documentation and multiple test scenarios.
* Collaborative mindset, working effectively with developers and product teams.
* Passionate about quality assurance, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Self\-driven and reliable, with a strong sense of accountability and ownership for product quality.



  





**About the Company** 





 SayaCare is a fast\-growing e\-health company dedicated to making healthcare and wellness simple, accessible, and personalized. Founded in 2021, we combine technology, care, and innovation to deliver reliable health solutions to our community. At Sayacare, we value collaboration, learning, and human\-focused solutions, and we are building a team that’s passionate, creative, and committed to improving lives.

title: Data Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
 WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
   

  

 The opportunity
   

  

 The Data Lead is responsible for building and governing the data foundation that enables executive visibility across strategic initiatives. This role transforms fragmented business information into trusted portfolio intelligence, ensuring leaders have accurate, timely, and actionable insights to make strategic decisions.
   

  

 What you’ll be doing
   

  

**Develop Enterprise Data Strategy**
* Define and execute the enterprise data strategy supporting portfolio governance, business intelligence and executive decision\-making.
* Build a scalable data architecture that integrates information from multiple sources into a trusted reporting ecosystem.
* Standardize business definitions, KPI methodologies, and data governance across functions.


**Build Portfolio Intelligence**
* Develop portfolio intelligence frameworks, executive dashboards, and scorecards providing visibility into strategic initiatives, financial performance, resource utilization, risks, dependencies, and business outcomes.
* Establish leading indicators that proactively identify execution risks and opportunities.


**Lead Data Governance**
* Define enterprise data governance standards covering ownership, quality, integrity, stewardship, lifecycle management, and reporting controls.
* Continuously improve data quality and governance practices to ensure trusted executive reporting.


**Enable Workforce and Resource Intelligence**
* Build analytical models for workforce planning, capacity forecasting, demand management, resource allocation, utilization, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with PMO, and program manager to optimize workforce investments and support strategic planning.


**Drive Executive Decision Support**
* Translate complex business data into actionable executive insights that support portfolio prioritization, investment decisions, and operational planning.
* Identify trends, risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities, providing recommendations that enable proactive decision\-making.


**Partner Across the Enterprise**
* Collaborate with Strategy, Finance, Operations, Technology, Product, Resource Management, and Program teams to align enterprise reporting, analytics, and business metrics.
* Serve as the strategic data partner supporting executive governance and cross\-functional decision making.


**Advance Analytics and AI**
* Partner with data science and engineering teams to develop predictive analytics, forecasting models, scenario planning, and AI enabled insights.
* Evaluate emerging analytics technologies and promote modern data practices that strengthen business intelligence.


**Modernize Reporting and Analytics**
* Design scalable reporting architectures that automate reporting, enable self\-service analytics, and improve executive visibility.
* Standardize dashboards, reporting methodologies, and visualization practices to ensure consistency, accuracy, and timeliness.


**Build Organizational Data Capability**
* Establish repeatable governance frameworks, metadata standards, reporting templates, and documentation that improve organizational data maturity.
* Mentor analysts and promote a culture of data\-driven decision making across the organization.


 What we want from you
   

  

* 10\+ years of progressive experience in Data Strategy, Business Intelligence, Analytics, Business Operations, Portfolio Management, Data Governance, or Management Consulting within a global technology or SaaS organization.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related discipline; Master's degree or MBA preferred.
* Proven experience designing enterprise reporting architectures, executive dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
* Strong expertise in enterprise data governance, master data management, and data quality frameworks.
* Experience supporting executive decision\-making through advanced analytics and strategic reporting.
* Demonstrated success working with Director, VP, and Executive\-level stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of portfolio management, workforce planning, resource management, financial reporting, and business operations.
* Experience with Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or modern cloud analytics platforms.
* Advanced expertise in Power BI, SQL, Excel, and enterprise visualization tools.
* Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Workday, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow, Anaplan, or similar business systems.
* Experience collaborating with Data Engineering and Data Science teams to deliver scalable analytics solutions.
* Working knowledge of AI\-powered analytics, predictive modeling, and modern business intelligence platforms.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic business recommendations.
* Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to simplify complex analytical concepts for senior business leaders.
* Experience leading cross\-functional analytical initiatives within highly matrixed organizations.


 Beyond the Resume
   

  

* Business\-First Mindset: Solves business problems through data, not just reporting.
* Strategic Thinker: Connects data across operations, finance, workforce, and business performance.
* Trusted Advisor: Delivers objective, insight\-driven recommendations that influence executive decisions.
* Builder Mindset: Creates scalable data, governance, and reporting capabilities that endure.
* Analytical Curiosity: Challenges assumptions and uncovers meaningful insights from complex data.
* Executive Storyteller: Translates complex analysis into clear, decision\-ready narratives.
* Collaborative Influencer: Aligns business and technical teams around common goals and standards.
* Innovation\-Driven: Leverages AI and modern analytics to continuously improve business intelligence and decision\-making.


 What we can offer you

description:
**NEOLYTIX**
**Credentialing Associate / Sr Associate**
 Provider Credentialing \& Enrollment
   

  

* US Healthcare LEVEL


**Associate / Sr AssociateEXPERIENCE**
**1\+ Yr / 3–4 Yrs**

**Night (US Hours)** 
**Two openings, one team —** 
 Associate requires a minimum of 1 year in US provider credentialing/enrollment; Senior Associate requires 3–4 years including payer\-enrollment ownership.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Neolytix runs credentialing and enrollment for US provider organizations — getting physicians and facilities enrolled with payers accurately and fast, because every stalled application is delayed revenue for the client.
   

  

 Associates manage application preparation, submissions, and follow\-up. Senior Associates own end\-to\-end enrollment files, payer escalations, and re\-credentialing calendars.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Core (Associate \& Sr Associate)**
* Prepare, submit, and track provider enrollment applications with commercial and government payers (Medicare/Medicaid, commercial plans)
* Maintain and attest CAQH profiles; manage PECOS, NPPES, and payer portals
* Follow up with payers on application status and resolve deficiencies quickly and accurately
* Maintain accurate trackers — effective dates, expirables (licenses, DEA, malpractice), and re\-credentialing timelines
* Handle provider and client data with strict confidentiality and HIPAA compliance


**Additional (Sr Associate)**
* Own complete enrollment files end\-to\-end for assigned clients, including complex group/facility enrollments and payer escalations
* Run the re\-credentialing and expirables calendar so nothing lapses
* Review associates’ submissions for accuracy and coach on payer\-specific requirements


**Skills \& Experience**
**Must\-Have**
* Associate: minimum 1 year in US provider credentialing/enrollment. Sr Associate: 3–4 years with end\-to\-end enrollment ownership
* Hands\-on experience with CAQH, PECOS/NPPES, and payer portals; strong understanding of enrollment workflows and timelines
* High attention to detail — credentialing errors are expensive and slow to unwind


**Preferred**
* Experience on practice\-management / EHR platforms — Epic, AdvancedMD, or athenahealth preferred; similar platforms considered
* Experience with credentialing software (Modio, MD\-Staff, Verity, or similar)


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree (any discipline) is mandatory and must be completed — candidates currently pursuing a degree, or with an incomplete/dropped graduation, are not eligible
* Communication: Moderate\-to\-strong — good spoken and written English for payer follow\-ups and professional, client\-facing emails and notes. Accuracy in writing matters as much as speed
* Work mode \& shift: Onsite at Gurugram, 5 days a week, on a fixed night (US\-hours) shift — reliable attendance, punctuality, and roster adherence are essential
* Systems: Comfortable with payer portals, CAQH / PECOS / NPPES, tracker maintenance, and MS Office (Excel/Word)
* Notice period: Immediate joiners or candidates on short notice strongly preferred


**Performance Expectations**
 You will be measured on clear, role\-specific metrics:
   

  

* Applications prepared/submitted and processed per period
* First\-pass approval rate and enrollment turnaround time (TAT)
* Zero lapses on expirables and re\-credentialing dates
* Accuracy / rework rate on submissions


**Hiring Process**
* HR Screening
* 2 Technical Interviews
* Assessment Round
* HR discussion (fitment, shift, notice)


**Why Join Neolytix**
**US Healthcare Depth**
 Live US provider accounts across 270\+ client organizations — real RCM, not a training bench.
 **Clear Growth Path**
 Associate → Sr Associate → QA / TL → AM: progression tied to performance.
 **Multi\-Platform Exposure**
 Hands\-on across Epic, AdvancedMD, athenahealth, and more — skills that travel.
 **Stable, Growing MSO**
 A fast\-growing US\-headquartered organization with centres in Chicago, Gurugram, and Manila.

 Skills and experience

description:
**Key Responsibilities**
* Work with business stakeholders to understand business processes, scheme rules, and operational workflows for employee benefits administration.
* Analyze and interpret scheme documentation and business rules, translating them into clear system behavior and data requirements.
* Lead and facilitate requirements\-gathering activities (workshops, interviews, documentation review) to capture functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Produce high\-quality documentation including business requirements documents (BRDs), functional requirements documents (FRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Design logical and physical data models (ERDs) to support new and existing features, ensuring data integrity, normalization, and consistency across systems.
* Collaborate with developers and architects to ensure solutions align with business needs, technical architecture, and SDLC standards.
* Write and execute SQL queries to analyze data, validate requirements, support impact analysis, and assist with defect investigation.
* Perform root\-cause analysis of incidents and defects using logs, monitoring tools, and database analysis; define and document fixes and preventative improvements.
* Map and document current and target\-state business processes, identifying opportunities to streamline workflows and improve data quality.
* Support Agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban) by contributing to backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demonstration of completed changes to stakeholders.
* Maintain configuration and requirements documentation in tools such as Jira and Confluence, ensuring traceability from requirements through to implementation and testing.
* Work closely with application support, testing, and development teams to ensure smooth deployment and transition of changes into BAU operations.


**Must Have**
* Strong business analysis capability including business process understanding and the ability to read scheme documentation and translate it into system behaviour.
* Solid understanding of SDLC and Agile/Scrum delivery practices.
* Hands\-on experience with relational databases, data modelling (ERD), normalisation, and SQL (preferably PostgreSQL).
* Demonstrable experience in requirements gathering and documentation (BRDs/FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria).
* Strong problem\-solving, root\-cause analysis, and incident analysis skills using SQL, logs, and monitoring tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience of stakeholder management and incident/update communication.
* Practical experience with Jira and Confluence or equivalent tools.


**Nice To Have**
* Exposure to web applications and cloud\-hosted solutions.
* Experience with monitoring/logging tools and application performance analysis.
* Experience with Azure DevOps or similar tools for task and workflow tracking.
* Prior experience in insurance, pensions, or employee benefits domains.
* Experience contributing to basic project planning, estimation, and time management within an Agile context.

**Qualifications**

* Hands\-on experience designing and working with relational data models and writing complex SQL queries.
* Demonstrable experience in incident and problem analysis, including root\-cause identification using logs and monitoring tools.
* Experience within insurance, pensions, employee benefits, or wider financial services.
* Experience working with /web applications and cloud\-based platforms.
* Experience working in multi\-team, multi\-vendor environments.


**Knowledge**

* Solid knowledge of relational database concepts, ER modelling, normalization, and data integrity controls.
* Understanding of application architecture concepts (e.g. APIs, services, integrations, web applications, monitoring).

title: GMS-Senior-CyberArk
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Global Managed Service – Privileged Identity and access Management – Senior**
 The Senior CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is a key member of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, responsible for the advanced support and management of the CyberArk infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of PAM principles, CyberArk architecture, and cybersecurity best practices. The Senior Analyst will lead initiatives to enhance security, streamline processes, and ensure the stability and integrity of privileged account management systems
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Lead the administration and advanced support of the CyberArk PAM solution, including complex troubleshooting, policy management, and platform optimization.
* Design and implement enhancements to the CyberArk infrastructure to improve security, efficiency, and compliance with industry standards.
* Oversee the onboarding of new accounts, platforms, and integrations into the CyberArk environment, ensuring adherence to strict security guidelines.
* Conduct regular system audits to identify potential vulnerabilities and recommend remediation strategies.
* Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on best practices and technical challenges.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to support enterprise\-wide cybersecurity initiatives and projects.
* Manage the response to critical incidents involving privileged accounts, including root cause analysis and preventive measures.
* Stay abreast of emerging threats and technologies in the PAM space and evaluate their impact on the organization.
* Lead the planning and execution of system upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities, minimizing disruption to business operations.
* Support compliance and regulatory activities by providing expertise and documentation as needed.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive disaster recovery and business continuity plan for the CyberArk infrastructure, ensuring minimal downtime and quick restoration of services in the event of an outage.
* Collaborate with the cybersecurity architecture team to design and implement a robust privileged access management strategy that aligns with the organization's overall security posture.
* Lead security incident investigations related to privileged accounts, including forensic analysis, and collaborate with the incident response team to develop a coordinated response plan.
* Proactively monitor the CyberArk environment for unusual activities and potential threats using advanced security tools and techniques.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for CyberArk within the organization, providing insights and recommendations to senior management on PAM\-related matters.
* Participate in vendor management, including evaluating potential software solutions, negotiating contracts, and managing relationships with CyberArk and other security vendors.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by regularly reviewing and updating CyberArk policies and procedures to reflect the evolving threat landscape and business needs.
* Facilitate cross\-training and knowledge sharing sessions within the team to ensure redundancy in critical skill sets and promote a culture of continuous learning.
* Engage with the broader cybersecurity community to stay informed about new vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and defense mechanisms related to privileged access management.
* Influence and enforce security policies and procedures across the organization, ensuring that privileged access is managed in accordance with best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in budget planning and management for the CyberArk operations team, including forecasting future needs for resources, tools, and training.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Advanced knowledge of CyberArk PAM solutions, with relevant certifications such as CyberArk Certified Delivery Engineer (CDE), Defender, or Sentry.
* Proven experience in managing complex CyberArk environments, including components such as EPV, CPM, PSM, and AIM.
* Strong understanding of network security, identity and access management (IAM), and related technologies (e.g., SIEM, firewalls, multi\-factor authentication).
* Expertise in scripting and automation to streamline operations and incident response.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Leadership qualities and experience in mentoring or managing junior staff.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non\-technical stakeholders


**Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
   

  

**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required

 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

* Communicate with IT stakeholders during incident response activities, ensuring effective containment, remediation, and accurate identification of compromise indicators
* Report on incident metrics, analyse findings, and develop reports to ensure comprehensive resolution and understanding of security events

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About Travezy** 




 Travezy is an AI\-powered travel planning product. We run a consumer app and are building a B2B intelligence layer for travel agents. We're small, we ship continuously, and we work with an external engineering partner on core build. We're hiring our first dedicated AI engineer to own how AI actually gets built, evaluated and deployed here.
   





**The Role** 




 Most companies are still at the demo stage with AI. We're past that and hitting the harder problem: getting agentic systems from pilot into production and keeping them reliable there.
 



 You'll own that path. Concretely:
 



  





**Agentic development and infrastructure** 



* Build production systems using agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin) as a primary workflow, not an experiment
* Design and run the CI/CD pipeline for AI\-generated code — how it gets reviewed, tested, merged and deployed safely
* Build the agentic infrastructure our features run on: orchestration, tool access, failure handling, observability



  





**Evaluation and governance** 



* Build the evaluation framework that tells us whether an AI change made things better or worse, for both generated code and product output
* Own the governance layer for our multi\-model setup (we route across several LLM providers) — cost, latency, quality, fallback, and which model is trusted with what



  





**Data and knowledge layer** 



* Build the semantic layer over our product data. We currently pull from 15\+ sources including Mixpanel, GA4, RevenueCat and AppsFlyer, and they don't speak to each other
* Design the ontology that makes that data queryable in natural language
* Stand up MCP servers so our internal tools and agents can reach this data safely



  





  





**What we are looking for** 



* You have taken an AI system from pilot to production and kept it running. Not a demo, not a hackathon — something real users depended on.
* You write code with agentic tools daily and have opinions about where they fail
* You've built or meaningfully worked on evaluation for an AI system
* You can reason about data modelling and semantics, not just pipelines



  





**Strongly preferred:** 



* Experience with MCP, agent orchestration frameworks, or equivalent
* Multi\-model routing or LLM gateway experience
* Ontology or knowledge\-graph work
* Infrastructure and deployment ownership (we're on \[AWS — confirm])



 We're not screening on degree, institution, or years.
 



  





**Process** 



1. Send us your application (below)
2. 45\-minute portfolio call — you walk us through something you built
3. Paid evaluation task on a real problem of ours
4. Conversation with the founding team, offer

title: Front-end Engineer for a funded startup
description:
**Job Description**
 "About the job Who We Are Endor Labs is building the Application Security platform for the software development revolution. Modern software is complex and dependency\-rich, making it increasingly difficult to pinpoint the risks that truly matter. Endor Labs solves this challenge by building a call graph of your entire software estate—enabling teams to clearly identify, prioritize, and fix critical risks faster. Trusted by companies that are one or one hundred years old, Endor Labs secures code whether it was written by humans or AI, and whether it's 40\-year\-old C\+\+ code or cutting\-edge Bazel Monorepos. Endor Labs was founded by serial entrepreneurs Varun Badhwar and Dimitri Stiliadis, and is backed by leading VC firms such as Dell Technology Capital, Lightspeed, and Sierra Ventures. Sound interesting? Let’s talk if you want to be part of the next big leap in security innovation! How You'll Make an Impact As an IT Support Engineer at Endor Labs, you’ll help build and maintain a secure, reliable, and seamless technology experience for our employees. You’ll own day\-to\-day IT operations across endpoints, identity and access, business applications, networking, and office technology while helping us scale our IT environment as the company grows. Own employee IT onboarding and offboarding, including laptop setup, configuration, deployment, and access provisioning. Provide hands\-on support for macOS and Windows environments and troubleshoot hardware, software, and operating system issues. Manage and secure corporate endpoints using MDM and security platforms such as Jamf and CrowdStrike. Manage software deployment, security updates, patching, device compliance, and endpoint configuration. Manage user accounts, SSO, and access to corporate applications and SaaS platforms. Troubleshoot networking and connectivity issues across LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, and related infrastructure. Support business applications and office technology, including Zoom and conference room A/V systems. Manage IT assets, inventory, procurement, and device lifecycle. Build and improve IT processes, documentation, and automation to make IT operations more scalable and efficient. Partner with security and other teams to maintain a strong IT security and compliance posture. What You Bring to the Table If you enjoy solving technical problems, working directly with users, and building reliable IT systems in a fast\-moving technology environment, we would love to talk to you! 5\+ years of experience in IT support, IT operations, or a similar role, preferably in a fast\-growing technology company. 4\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting macOS and Windows environments, including MDM and device management tools such as Jamf. Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoints, hardware, software, LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, and common networking issues. Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, and Wi\-Fi. Experience with identity and access management, SSO, and SaaS administration using platforms such as Google Workspace or Okta. Experience managing business applications and tools such as Google Workspace, Rippling, Jira, and Confluence. Hands\-on experience with endpoint security tools such as CrowdStrike and a good understanding of security best practices. Experience supporting video conferencing and office A/V technologies such as Zoom. Experience with IT security and compliance requirements, including SOC 2, is preferred. Familiarity with scripting using Bash, Python, or similar technologies for automating routine IT tasks is a plus. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer\-focused approach to IT support. Strong ownership, troubleshooting, prioritization, and follow\-through skills. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline is preferred. Why Endor Labs We’re building at the intersection of developer productivity and security — one of the fastest\-growing spaces in software. Our dev\-loved platform has real ROI, strong momentum, and customers who care about doing things right. At Endor Labs, we think big, start small, and learn fast. We take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with the customer’s success. We debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. We celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way — because when our customers win, we all win. Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment, and we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one\-size\-fits\-all here."

* Experiment with generative AI tools under HRBP guidance, applying sound judgment and data privacy standards

* Analytical mindset with strong problem‑solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach
* Ability to learn quickly, manage multiple tasks, and follow through in a fast‑paced, global environment
* High level of professionalism, integrity, and respect for confidentiality and data privacy
* Positive attitude with a growth mindset and enthusiasm for building a long‑term career in Human Resources



**Be Successful — Your Path**

* Build and maintain HR dashboards and standard reports for headcount, movement, and people metrics

* Demonstrate ability to use Oracle HCM, collaboration tools, and at least one AI‑enabled or analytics tool
* Establish trusted working relationships with HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, and People \& Places colleagues



**One Year:**

* Provide clear, data‑backed insights on attrition, hiring, engagement, and organization health
* Recommend at least one process improvement or automation using AI or analytics tools
* Be recognized as a reliable, detail‑oriented partner with strong stakeholder management skills
* Be considered for future opportunities within the HR function based on performance and business needs



**Belong — Your Community**

 **Teamwork** 
 drives the best outcomes. A sense of
 **Ownership** 
 and accountability. And a focus on the
 **Now**

title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Remote (India\-based) — Bengaluru preferred; with meaningful daily overlap with our UK and US teams
   

  

**Engagement Type:** 
 Full\-time — permanent, ongoing
   

  

**About MarcoPolo Learning**
 MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy\-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion \& Coach — a guided AI assistant that helps early\-learning educators plan lessons, discover the right materials, and improve classroom outcomes. We’re looking for a Full\-Stack AI Engineer to help bring Audrey to life and shape where she goes next.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This is a role for an engineer who loves working where AI meets product. You’ll own the intelligence behind Audrey — the retrieval, generation, and logic that make her genuinely useful to teachers — while being just as comfortable moving across the backend and frontend to bring the whole experience together. You’ll work alongside our backend, infrastructure, and frontend engineers, with real ownership of the AI and real influence over what we build.
   

  

 Audrey is approaching an exciting launch, and you’ll play a central part in shaping her — refining how she works today and helping define where she goes as we grow into more classrooms.
   

  

 Just as much as the engineering, we care about instinct for the product. We’re looking for someone genuinely curious about the teachers we serve — an engineer who asks the right questions, understands how educators actually use what we build, and lets that understanding shape the experience. You’ll bring deep AI expertise, a natural instinct for collaboration, and a calm, considered approach to solving hard problems.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the AI at the heart of Audrey — retrieval, generation, and the models and logic that make her intelligent and dependable.
* Craft an experience where teachers instantly find exactly the right video, printable, or activity, with retrieval that’s fast, accurate, and reliable.
* Build and refine the content and data pipelines that power Audrey — ingesting and structuring videos, printables, guides, and multilingual content for precise retrieval.
* Work across the full stack, connecting the AI seamlessly into the wider product alongside our backend and frontend engineers.
* Shape how Audrey thinks, responds, and guides teachers — designing her behavior, personality, and overall experience with the end user always in mind.
* Help bring Audrey to launch and shape her evolution as we scale.
* Continuously raise the quality, speed, and reliability of Audrey’s responses and recommendations.
* Build fluently with modern AI\-assisted development tools to design, build, and iterate quickly.
* Partner with our infrastructure lead to keep Audrey running smoothly and efficiently in the cloud.
* Put in place the evaluation, testing, and monitoring that keep quality high, and keep technical documentation clear.
* Collaborate closely and openly with engineering and product, sharing your thinking and progress early and often.
* Help shape the product roadmap — from deeper personalization to multilingual support and classroom insights.
* Build with privacy and safety in mind, including FERPA/COPPA alignment.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience across the full stack, comfortable working fluidly between backend and frontend.
* Proven, hands\-on depth with modern AI: you’ve personally built and shipped at least one production LLM/AI application. We know the LLM tooling is only a few years old — what you’ve actually built matters far more to us than years on a résumé.
* Strong experience building retrieval\-augmented (RAG) systems — embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and re\-ranking — with a real feel for what makes retrieval accurate and dependable.
* An AI\-native engineer who builds fluently with modern AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. Cursor) and weaves AI through their workflow.
* Strong Python and solid backend fundamentals (APIs, databases, data pipelines), with enough frontend ability to work end\-to\-end across the stack.
* Practical LLM orchestration and prompt engineering (LangChain or comparable), including agent/tool design, system\-prompt and persona design, and guardrails.
* Solid AWS experience (compute, storage, databases, containers, monitoring); familiarity with managed model services (e.g. Amazon Bedrock) and/or self\-hosted model inference is a plus.
* A genuine product sensibility — you’re curious about the people who use what you build, and you let that shape your work.
* A natural collaborator who communicates openly, builds trust across teams, and brings a calm, considered approach to a fast\-moving environment.
* Comfortable owning your work and driving it forward with minimal oversight.
* Able to work remotely with meaningful overlap across UK and US time zones, with strong written communication.
* Bonus: edtech or early\-childhood education experience; multilingual retrieval; video/audio ML; familiarity with FERPA/COPPA or similar.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive, market\-aligned salary for an experienced engineer in India.
* Fully remote, full\-time role with flexibility over how you structure your day.
* End\-to\-end ownership of the AI behind a flagship product, from launch through scale, with real influence over its architecture and roadmap.
* A collaborative, family\-friendly, mission\-driven environment at the intersection of education, media, and technology.


**Why Join Us**
 This is a rare chance to own the AI capabilities of a growing global education company at a defining moment. You’ll be the engineer who brings Audrey to life, shapes how she’s built, and helps take her from launch to a product used in thousands of classrooms. If you want work that’s visible, technically meaningful, and genuinely impactful for young learners and their teachers, this is it.
   

  

*Note: This is an India\-based engagement. Applicants must have the right to work in India; visa sponsorship is not available at this time.*
 MarcoPolo Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. We pride ourselves on a supportive and mission\-driven working environment.

* In this key role, you’ll support a set of environments used by a platform’s applications and assist as a point of contact for environment related activities
* We’ll look to you to assist Environment Managers in preparing a rolling environmental strategy which considers risks in relation to stability and resilience
