title: Senior Software Engineer – DevOps & Automation
description:
At CREADIS, we combine deep engineering expertise with a collaborative and people\-focused culture. We help some of the world's leading technology companies solve complex engineering challenges, and we are passionate about creating innovative solutions that make a real impact.
 



  





 We are currently looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong DevOps and automation expertise to join our growing team in Chennai, India. In this role, you will work on a large\-scale software framework within the wind energy sector, helping to build and maintain the automation, build, test, validation and release processes that support critical engineering solutions used globally.
 



  





 Working closely with software engineers, technical specialists and stakeholders, you will contribute throughout the entire development lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment, adoption and handover.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities** 




 As our new Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in establishing robust and scalable development processes. Your responsibilities will include:
 


* Designing and implementing Azure DevOps and GitHub CI/CD pipelines
* Creating reusable pipeline templates and automation solutions using PowerShell and Python
* Provisioning and maintaining self\-hosted Windows build environments using Terraform and Ansible
* Integrating automated testing and validation processes into release workflows
* Supporting Git repository migrations, branching strategies and pull request governance
* Developing reliable integrations with a strong focus on quality, observability and maintainability
* Producing technical documentation, operational runbooks and architectural designs
* Collaborating with customer engineering teams and mentoring colleagues when relevant



  





**Your Technical Environment** 




 You will be joining a highly technical environment where modern DevOps practices and automation are at the centre of software delivery. Together with a team of experienced engineers, you will work with technologies such as Azure DevOps, GitHub, Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell and Python to build scalable automation solutions and support the full software lifecycle.
 



  





 Depending on the project, you may also work with technologies including .NET, C\+\+, CMake, automated testing frameworks and engineering software platforms used within the renewable energy sector.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys automating complex processes and enabling efficient software delivery. You combine strong technical skills with a structured and collaborative approach, and you thrive when working closely with colleagues and customers to solve complex challenges.
 



  





 We imagine that you have:
 


* 7\+ years of software engineering experience
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, DevOps, automation or developer tooling
* Strong experience with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub pipelines
* Solid PowerShell scripting skills
* Experience working with Terraform and Ansible
* Strong understanding of Git and repository migration practices
* Experience with software testing, integrations and automation
* Excellent communication and documentation skills
* Experience collaborating directly with engineering stakeholders and customers
* Professional proficiency in English



  





**It Is an Advantage If You Also Have Experience With** 




 Experience with C\#/.NET, C\+\+, CMake or Python development will be considered an advantage. Likewise, familiarity with MATLAB, PSCAD or other engineering software environments is highly relevant. Previous experience working in a consulting environment or customer\-facing engineering roles is also valued.
 



  





**Why Join CREADIS?** 




 At CREADIS, people are at the centre of everything we do. We believe that the best engineering solutions are created by empowered teams working in an environment built on trust, knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
 



  





 When you join us in Chennai, you become part of an international engineering community where collaboration, professional development and technical excellence are highly valued. You will work with colleagues across multiple countries and contribute to projects for global customers, giving you the opportunity to broaden both your technical expertise and industry knowledge.
 



  





 We offer a culture where ideas are welcomed, knowledge is shared openly and personal growth is encouraged. Our teams work closely together across locations, combining local presence with international collaboration to create innovative engineering solutions for leading companies around the world.
 



  





 If you are passionate about DevOps, automation and software engineering, and you want to contribute to technologies that support the global transition towards sustainable energy, we would love to hear from you.

title: Sr BSO Coordinator
description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***








**Who We Are…**

**General Summary:**









 The purpose of this role is to plan and prepare the daily presentation schedule for assigned networks in conjunction, and coordinating, with the Programming, On Air Promotion, Sales, Media Planning and Transmission departments, ensuring accuracy, completeness, compliance, and delivery according to the prescribed deadlines.  The schedulers form part of a team working directly under the Broadcast Schedule Operations Supervisor.

* Liaising with the Media Planner to ensure smooth hand over of prepped schedules ready for promo placement.

* To fully understand break patterns and templates and ensure they are checked and loaded into the system and that all final commercial loads or amendments are actioned.
* Organization and regular revision of presentation templates.
* Liaise with the Media Asset Management team and Regional Sales teams checking all media items are present or accounted for prior to download of schedules to transmission.

* Liaise with Transmission teams, confirming correct playlist versions have been received and necessary changes to ‘on\-air’ have taken place.


* Perform daily presentation schedule reconciliation in both Scheduling and Sales systems and provide any reports, including discrepancy reports as required by the Supervisor/Manager.


* Attending meetings and building strong relationships with key contacts in the WBD internal and regional offices.
* Cross training to develop knowledge across feeds and regions within the department.
* Any other presentation scheduling tasks required and assigned by the Supervisor that are appropriate and in line with the position.







  


**Requirements:**

* Ability to work with others and to follow instructions.

* Delivery of the daily transmission schedules within deadlines and high levels of accuracy.

* Working with other departments to ensure all matters relating to the creation of the daily presentation schedule and associated work processes are followed and any issues fed back as required.
* To become proficient in the presentation scheduling functions across numerous channels where required.

 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at

 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

* Extensive experience in enterprise risk, operational risk, regulatory risk and/or technology risk management.
* Proven track record of successfully leading and project managing risk management initiatives with strong business engagement.

title: Operations Associate (E-Commerce)
description:
**About Joify** 




  





 Joify is a new\-age ice cream brand built on our family's four decades of expertise in ice cream manufacturing. We make real ice cream (not frozen dessert), formulated with 11% milk fat to deliver superior richness and creaminess. We're on a mission to build a strong regional FMCG brand across South India, starting with Andhra Pradesh \& Telangana.
 



  





***Instagram***
 : @joifyicecreams
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 Joify is an FMCG brand at its core, and we've also launched a direct\-to\-consumer online store for Hyderabad. We're hiring someone to run Joify's D2C e\-commerce operations end\-to\-end. You'll be the single point of accountability for everything that happens after a customer clicks "buy" on our website \- inventory, packing, dispatch, delivery coordination, customer communication, managing helpers and the numbers behind all of it. This is a hands\-on operational role, not a desk job \- expect to be on your feet in a cold storage area, packing boxes, and on the phone with delivery riders and customers throughout the day.
 



  





***Compensation***
*: Rs.30,000 per month* 




  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***Shopify \& Inventory Management***




  




* Manage the Shopify backend: update stock levels, process and fulfill orders, mark shipments, handle cancellations and refunds
* Track SKU\-level inventory across individual ice cream units and curated packs; flag low stock and place replenishment requests with the factory
* Conduct daily physical inventory counts of e\-commerce stock in cold storage, reconciling counts against Shopify records
* Manage inventory of packaging materials (boxes, tapes, labels, etc.) — track stock and place restock orders with vendors before running low



  





***Order Fulfillment \& Pre\-Packing***




  




* Assemble curated boxes from individual ice cream units ahead of demand, keeping them neatly organized and dispatch\-ready in cold storage
* Pack individual customer orders with support from a packing helper
* Perform quality control on every pre\-packed box before dispatch \- checking for melt, damage, and seal issues
* Supervise and manage the packing helper's day\-to\-day work, including task allocation and scheduling



  





***Logistics \& Delivery Coordination***




  




* Book and coordinate orders with delivery partners (Rapido, Uber, Porter, etc.) for each dispatch, choosing the best option on cost and speed
* Track deliveries in real time and troubleshoot issues as they arise \- wrong turns, delays, failed drop\-offs



  





***Customer Communication***




  




* Contact customers post\-order to verify delivery address and confirm someone will be available to receive the ice cream
* Own WhatsApp Business as a customer channel \- understand requirements, resolve queries, and log requests



  





***Reporting \& Analytics***




  




* Track sales analytics \- order volume, SKU performance, delivery success rate, refund/complaint rate
* Send a daily report to the director covering order volume, stock levels, customer queries, and any open issues



  





**Requirements** 



* Prior experience in e\-commerce operations, D2C fulfillment, or logistics coordination (food/FMCG experience is a strong plus)
* Comfortable working in a cold storage/freezer environment and doing physical packing work
* Strong communication skills in Telugu, English and Hindi for customer\-facing calls
* Basic proficiency with Shopify (or willingness to learn quickly), spreadsheets, and WhatsApp Business
* Familiarity with Hyderabad\-area geography for delivery ETA estimation is a plus
* Location: Jubilee Hills, Road No 36\. Timings: 11AM \- 8PM
* 6 days a week. Holiday is on Monday. Saturday and Sunday are working days.
* Comfortable working weekends/evenings, since ice cream order volume peaks then.

* Ability to script or automate repetitive tasks using CCL or other tools.
* Experience with various documentation requirements for specialties.
* Proficiency with MS Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.

**Key Competencies**

title: Chartered Accountant – Accounting & Loan Servicing
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 MYFINSER is looking for a qualified
 **Chartered Accountant** 
 to join a growing U.S.\-based private lending and financial services team in a hybrid
 **Chartered Accountant – Accounting \& Loan Servicing**

 **60% accounting and 40% loan servicing**

**Accounting \& Month\-End Close**

* Manage AP and AR activities and support weekly payment processes.
* Maintain fixed asset and loan asset schedules.
* Reconcile loan servicing records to the general ledger and investigate variances through resolution.

* Support construction and interest reserve draw administration and reconcile reserve balances.
* Track escrow and impound accounts for taxes and insurance where applicable.
* Maintain delinquency and aging reports and escalate exceptions promptly.

 **U.S. GAAP**

* Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Direct experience in
 **loan servicing or loan operations** 
 .

 **The Mortgage Office, FCI Lender Services, Mortgage Automator** 
 , or similar systems.

 **Zoho Books, QuickBooks** 
 , or comparable cloud accounting platforms.
* Exposure to fund accounting, waterfall/preferred return calculations, or investor reporting.

**What We’re Looking For**

 Able to take responsibility for assigned accounting and servicing activities with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.

 Understands that financial and servicing accuracy is critical when dealing with borrowers, investors, and lending transactions.

 Comfortable learning new systems and processes and contributing to process improvements.

 Willing to raise questions, discrepancies, and potential issues early.

 This is an opportunity to work closely with a

title: Quality Analyst – Manual Testing
description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Analyst to lead manual testing efforts for the Customer Portal, a React/AEM\-based web application integrated with SAP, Salesforce, and supporting middleware. The QA will validate end\-to\-end business scenarios spanning the web/AEM front end and SAP\-driven backend processes (orders, deliveries, invoices, documents), ensuring the portal meets functional, data\-accuracy, and customer\-experience requirements before release.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Test Planning \& Strategy: Define the manual test strategy and test plans for each Phase 1 module (Profile, Documents, Contact Us, Dashboard, Deliveries, Order Status), covering functional, regression, integration, and UAT\-support testing.
* Test Case Design: Author detailed test cases and test scripts derived from business requirement documents, including field\-level validations, business rules, and source\-system mappings (e.g., SAP, SFDC).
* SAP\-Integrated Scenario Testing: Validate portal behavior against SAP\-driven data and logic, including order status transitions, delivery commitment / delay logic, credit/pricing/compliance blocks, invoice and document availability, and output management triggers.
* Web/UI Testing: Perform functional, cross\-browser, responsive, and accessibility testing of the React/AEM front end, including forms, search/filter behavior, modals, file uploads/downloads, and navigation flows.
* Data Validation: Verify data accuracy and consistency across SAP, Salesforce (SFDC), and the portal UI, including account details, contact information, order/delivery data, and document metadata.
* Defect Management: Log, triage, and track defects to closure using the team's defect management tool, working closely with React developers, AEM SMEs, and SAP consultants on root cause and resolution.
* Requirement Traceability: Maintain requirements\-to\-test\-case traceability matrices to ensure full coverage of documented requirements and sign\-off criteria.
* Regression \& Release Testing: Execute regression test cycles ahead of each release, validate bug fixes, and provide go/no\-go quality input to the Project Lead.
* UAT Support: Support business stakeholders during User Acceptance Testing, including test data preparation, issue triage, and coordination of retesting.
* Documentation: Maintain clear test documentation, execution logs, and status reporting (pass/fail metrics, defect trends, coverage) for project stakeholders.


**Must\-Have Skills**
* Experience: 5\+ years of manual QA experience with at least 2\+ years testing applications integrated with SAP and modern web front ends.
* SAP Exposure: Working knowledge of SAP Sales \& Distribution (Order\-to\-Cash) processes – Sales Orders, Deliveries, Billing/Invoicing, Customer Master – sufficient to validate business rules and data displayed on the portal.
* Web Application Testing: Hands\-on experience testing React\-based or other modern JavaScript web applications, including responsive/cross\-browser testing; exposure to CMS/DXP platforms such as AEM is a plus.
* Test Management Tools: Proficiency with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA/Xray, Azure DevOps, qTest, or similar).
* API/Integration Awareness: Ability to validate data flowing through REST/GraphQL APIs and integration layers (e.g., Apigee) at a functional level, using tools such as Postman.
* CRM Exposure: Familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) data structures (Accounts, Contacts, Cases) as they relate to customer and case data shown on the portal.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to design test scenarios covering complex business/status logic (e.g., order and delivery lifecycle states).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for defect reporting and stakeholder coordination.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams, including participation in sprint ceremonies and Definition of Done reviews.


**Added Advantage (Highly Preferred)**
* Experience testing AEM (Sites/SPA Editor) authored pages and AEM Dispatcher\-cached content.
* Exposure to SAP transaction codes relevant to customer master and order data (e.g., XD03\) for cross\-verification during testing.
* Experience testing Salesforce Case creation/workflow integrations.
* Basic SQL knowledge for backend data verification.
* ISTQB Foundation Level certification.


**Qualifications**
* B.E / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent.
* ISTQB or equivalent QA certification is a plus.

 Our Digital team at Azurity is building new capabilities utilizing cutting\-edge Salesforce technologies. We are seeking a dynamic, self\-driven, hands\-on team member who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
   

  

 The Senior Salesforce Tester is responsible for testing and validating Salesforce applications to ensure quality, performance, security, and regulatory compliance across Azurity's commercial and medical business processes. This role focuses on Salesforce platforms supporting HCP/HCO engagement, sales operations, patient support programs, regulatory requirements, and commercial excellence initiatives.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA teams to identify defects, improve functionality, and maintain compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, Sunshine Act, and FDA regulations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Test Planning \& Strategy**
* Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Salesforce applications.
* Ensure comprehensive coverage for functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing.
* Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and define testing strategies.
* Participate in test estimation, release planning, and risk assessment activities.


**Functional \& Regression Testing**
* Conduct manual and automated testing of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud functionalities.
* Validate HCP/HCO engagement processes, KOL management, consent management, patient support workflows, and compliance\-related business processes.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation of business workflows, data integrity, and system configurations.
* Verify territory alignment, call planning, sample management, omnichannel engagement, and commercial operations processes.
* Execute regression testing to ensure system stability across Salesforce releases and deployments.


**Integration \& Data Testing**
* Test integrations with third\-party pharmaceutical platforms including IQVIA, Veeva, MedPro, SAP, Snowflake, and MDM solutions.
* Validate Salesforce APIs (REST and SOAP) and perform API testing using Postman.
* Verify Data Cloud integrations, data ingestion, transformation, and synchronization processes.
* Ensure data accuracy, completeness, reconciliation, and security across integrated systems.
* Support testing of end\-to\-end data flows between Salesforce and enterprise applications.


**Compliance \& Security Testing**
* Ensure HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements are met across Salesforce solutions.
* Perform role\-based security testing, user access validation, permission testing, and audit trail verification.
* Validate electronic records controls, consent management processes, and sensitive data protection requirements.
* Support compliance documentation and validation activities as required for regulated systems.


**Performance \& Automation Testing**
* Use Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or similar automation tools to automate Salesforce test cases.
* Design, develop, and maintain reusable automated test suites.
* Perform performance and scalability testing to assess system stability under peak workloads.
* Identify bottlenecks, optimize test execution, and validate Lightning Web Component (LWC) performance.
* Utilize basic Python scripting where applicable to support automation and data validation activities.


**Defect Tracking \& Collaboration**
* Document, manage, and track defects using JIRA, X\-Ray, or similar test management tools.
* Work closely with developers and business analysts to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and release readiness activities.


**Continuous Improvement \& Best Practices**
* Stay current with Salesforce releases, platform enhancements, testing tools, and industry best practices.
* Implement CI/CD testing methodologies leveraging Copado and Salesforce DevOps processes.
* Recommend improvements to test automation frameworks, testing methodologies, and quality processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, quality, and compliance.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in Salesforce testing, preferably within Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or Healthcare industries.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of manual and automated testing frameworks for Salesforce applications.
* Experience testing Salesforce integrations with pharmaceutical platforms such as IQVIA, Veeva, SAP, Sales Enablement tools, Snowflake, and MDM solutions.
* Proficiency in Salesforce Administration, Flows, Apex test classes, and Lightning Web Component (LWC) testing.
* Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP), Postman, and Data Cloud validation.
* Hands\-on experience with Copado Robotic Testing and Salesforce DevOps release management practices.
* Understanding of HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements.
* Experience using JIRA, X\-Ray, or similar test management and defect\-tracking tools.
* Basic Python knowledge to support test automation and data validation activities.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills within a global offshore\-onshore delivery model.


**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Software Asset Analyst II
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Software Asset \& License Analyst II handles the work that is too complex or too consequential for the Level I queue: unlisted software triage and due diligence, renewals and true\-ups tracked as events against contract records, M\&A software integration, and the configuration and auditing of automated licence reclamation. Where Level I is measured on speed and accuracy against high\-volume queues, Level II is measured on judgment — deciding whether a request should proceed at all, what evidence it needs, and what it commits the client to.
   

  

 The analyst works one of the three IST\-anchored shifts, reporting to that shift's Level III lead, and mentors the Level I associates on the same window. Eight of these roles exist across the team — two on APAC and three each on EMEA and NAMER — with the heavier weighting on the shifts that carry the larger request volumes. Because the client is the licensee on every agreement, the analyst's discipline in gating, evidencing and recording is what keeps commercial and compliance exposure off the client's books.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Complex Requests \& Unlisted Software Triage
* Triage unlisted software requests in the enterprise ticketing queue, logging eligible items in the unified tracker and advancing due\-diligence\-complete requests to weekly triage review.
* Enforce intake gating rules: identify and reject high\-risk use cases (e.g., customer\-facing code, personal device use, reverse engineering) using standard responses and appropriate routing.
* Secure sensitive data by immediately moving tickets containing license keys, audit notifications, or accessibility info to the private queue.
* Manage security and legal gates by collecting VSA project IDs, verifying EULA/clickwrap reviews, and flagging cases requiring director\-level signatures.
* Escalate signed agreements to the formal contract intake path; do not accept or process these locally within the unlisted queue.
* Resolve complex entitlement and edition decisions, prioritizing reusable existing assets before initiating new purchases.
* Renewals, True\-Ups \& Contract Event Management
* Create and track contract events against the correct Deal Radar ID using the standard event types — new contract, contracted renewal, true\-up and predict\-and\-purchase — with correct recurrence numbering.
* Work the milestone schedule on assigned events: compile the Initial Licence Position from usage scans and consumption snapshots, gather domain Invest/Maintain/Divest sentiment, and produce the Final Licence Position with harvested licences already pruned from the baseline.
* Apply the correct commercial workflow for true\-ups — an amendment where a signature alters contracted baseline quantities, a purchase\-order addition where no signature is required.
* Maintain contract metadata accurately: products, pricing, start and end dates, evergreen clauses and committed spend, extracted from executed agreements.
* Process business\-as\-usual change management — licence changes, publisher name changes and product version updates — through the change log.
* Prepare purchase requisitions and support downstream three\-way matching, cross\-verifying invoices, unit prices and payment terms against the purchase order and the analyst's own records.
* M\&A Software Integration
* Maintain M\&A software inventory trackers, utilizing population scripts to map raw vendor data into unified deal tracking formats.
* Normalize publisher and title names against the master catalog, flagging net\-new vendors for portfolio review and insertion.
* Filter out\-of\-scope embedded technology; exclude software embedded in acquired public\-facing products from the termination queue.
* Automate ticket creation from tracker rows, bundling records under hotlists for executive visibility while maintaining master sync integrity.
* Process pre\-close terminations by collecting cancellation evidence and updating trackers without recording cost avoidance.
* Execute post\-close terminations under privacy controls: audit privacy sheets and pull details directly to avoid unauthorized vendor contact.
* Apply correct termination timelines: resolve short\-usage via cancellation proof and route long\-usage for security/legal exception approvals.
* Automated Reclamation, Audits \& Mentoring
* Configure automated harvesting: map product IDs, set inactivity thresholds, and classify software correctly as high\-risk (potential data loss on unassignment, requiring repeated use\-it\-or\-lose\-it warnings) or low\-risk (no data loss, reclaimed automatically after the 14\-day inactive notice).
* Run the daily former\-user sweep to reclaim licences from leavers, and execute manual reclamation surveys where automation does not yet cover a publisher.
* Record realised savings accurately in the licence\-reclaim audit table — deprovisioning date, software, user, initiative and reason — since the cost\-avoidance dashboards are built directly from these entries.
* Run the weekly and monthly licence audits for the assigned portfolio and act on the exceptions they surface.
* Mentor Level I associates on the shift: review their work, coach on gating judgment, and take the cases they should not decide alone.
* Flag automation candidates where a publisher's transaction volume approaches the 1,000\-per\-year threshold.


 PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS
   

  

 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per shift.
   

  

* Intake Gating Accuracy: 100% of high\-risk and out\-of\-scope use cases correctly identified and routed; zero signed agreements actioned through the unlisted queue.
* Due Diligence Completeness: every request pushed to triage review carries complete security, privacy and legal evidence.
* Contract Event Integrity: correct Deal Radar ID, event type and recurrence on 100% of events created, with milestone deliverables on their due dates.
* Licence Position Quality: Initial and Final Licence Positions reconcilable to usage evidence, with harvested licences pruned before the renewal baseline is set.
* Reclamation \& Savings: reclamation rules configured to the correct risk class, and 100% of realised savings recorded completely enough to stand as the audit record.
* M\&A Tracker Discipline: tracker and ticket records kept synchronised, and privacy controls observed on 100% of post\-close terminations.
* Audit Cadence: weekly and monthly audits completed on time with exceptions actioned.
* Mentoring: agreed coaching and review commitments met for the Level I associates on the shift.


 TOOLS \& SYSTEMS
   

  

* Intake \& Queue: the enterprise ticketing queue with strict category coding for tracking tickets and bugs, the unified intake tracker, and the private queue for sensitive tickets.
* Contract \& Entitlement: Deal Radar for contract and event records, and Flexera / ServiceNow SAM for entitlement and consumption tracking.
* Legal \& Security Gating: vendor security assessment tooling, and Pactfinder / Accord for legal review and signature cases.
* Automation \& Reclamation: gHive automated harvesting and UiPath, plus Apps Script automation on the M\&A trackers.
* Financial: SAP Materials Management for purchase orders, amendments and three\-way matching.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Mandatory
   

  

* 3–7\+ years in software asset management, software licensing operations or software procurement.
* Practical command of licensing models and their governance differences across SaaS user\-based, installed device\-based, cloud\-hosted, floating and consumable\-credit software.
* Hands\-on renewal and true\-up experience, including building licence positions from usage data.
* Demonstrated gating judgment — able to recognise a request that must be stopped, escalated or re\-routed rather than fulfilled.
* Strong ticket and data discipline, with attention to category coding, evidence retention and audit\-ready records.
* Comfortable working one of three IST\-anchored shifts, including the NAMER window (22:00–06:00 IST).
* Clear English communication with requesters, approvers, publishers and resellers.


**Preferred**
* Software asset management certification (IAITAM CSAM, ITIL, Flexera or ServiceNow SAM credential).
* M\&A software integration experience, including terminations under privacy constraints.
* Experience configuring automated licence harvesting and setting risk\-based reclamation rules.
* SAP Materials Management experience and exposure to three\-way matching.
* Spreadsheet automation or scripting (Apps Script, Python) applied to tracker and reporting work.

 The Programme Director is the single point of accountability for Truworth Wellness's EAP engagement with SBI. Deployed at the Bank's Corporate Centre, this role serves as the senior escalation point for the account, the primary interface with SBI's HR Department, and the owner of programme governance, stakeholder alignment, and strategic oversight across the full lifecycle of the engagement — from implementation through steady\-state delivery, contract renewal, and eventual transition\-out. The Programme Director is directly accountable to the Bank for SLA adherence, governance discipline, and the quarterly performance outcomes on which contract payments are conditioned.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Client Governance \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the Bank's senior escalation point and primary accountability owner for all aspects of the EAP engagement.
* Serve as the primary interface between Truworth Wellness and SBI's HR Department on programme governance, stakeholder alignment, and strategic direction.
* Chair/lead the Programme Steering Committee and monthly Operational Review Meetings with the Bank's designated Programme Manager and other stakeholders.
* Ensure Minutes of Meeting are circulated within 5 working days of each governance forum, and own the consolidated action tracker through to closure.
* Represent the programme in leadership\-level reviews, audits, and any ad hoc governance requirements raised by the Bank.



**Service Delivery \& SLA Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the scope of work: 24×7 counselling and crisis intervention, wellbeing programmes, the Holistic Health Champion Programme, webinars, and awareness campaigns.
* Monitor SLA and KPI performance continuously; drive corrective action on any shortfall to avoid penalties or liquidated damages, and to secure release of quarterly performance\-linked payments.
* Oversee the implementation and onboarding plan in Year 1 (platform configuration, HRMS/SSO integration, counsellor mobilisation, launch sessions) and, at contract end, the transition\-out plan, knowledge transfer, and data wipe\-out certification.
* Ensure continuity of care for employees under active counselling in the event of any transition to a successor provider.



**Reporting, Analytics \& Compliance** 



* Ensure timely submission of monthly, quarterly, and annual programme reports, and the quarterly performance certificate required for payment release.
* Own the accuracy and governance of the centralised analytics dashboard, including weekly data refresh and segmentation across Bank\-defined dimensions.
* Ensure the programme's data privacy and confidentiality practices comply with the DPDP Act 2023, the Bank's information\-security requirements, and Truworth's ISO 27001 obligations.
* Oversee the annual wellbeing survey and impact assessment, and present aggregated, de\-identified findings and improvement roadmaps at Circle, AO, and organisational levels.



**Team \& Account Leadership** 



* Lead and performance\-manage the dedicated Account Management team, technical/platform manager, and coordination with the clinical/counselling panel supporting SBI.
* Own resourcing and continuity for the account, including managing any key\-personnel changes through the Bank's prior\-notification and approval process.
* Build internal readiness for scale — pan\-India service delivery, multilingual counselling, and nationwide referral network coordination.



**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Minimum 10 years of experience in EAP/ employee wellbeing,/behavioural health, or related domains.
* Proven experience managing large, enterprise\-scale accounts, ideally with PSU, banking, or BFSI\-sector clients, including exposure to formal vendor governance frameworks.
* Postgraduate qualification in Psychology, Human Resources, Business/Public Health Management, or a related field is preferred.
* Working knowledge of SLA\-based managed\-services contracts, data privacy regulation (DPDP Act 2023\), and information\-security frameworks such as ISO 27001\.
* Demonstrated ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders (DGM level and above) and to run structured governance forums.
* Strong command of programme reporting, dashboards, and outcome\-based/KPI\-linked performance management.



**Key Competencies** 



* Executive stakeholder management and senior\-level relationship building.
* Programme and vendor governance discipline — meeting cadence, documentation, action tracking.
* Commercial acumen — understanding of SLA/KPI\-linked, performance\-based payment structures.
* Crisis\-management orientation and sound judgement on escalations.
* Data\-driven decision\-making, with comfort reading and presenting utilisation and outcome analytics.
* High personal discretion and commitment to confidentiality and data privacy.



**Key Performance Indicators** 



* SLA and KPI compliance across all quarterly delivery cycles.
* Successful, on\-schedule conduct of Programme Steering Committee and Operational Review Meetings.
* Timeliness and quality of monthly, quarterly, and annual reports and dashboards.
* Employee utilisation, engagement, and satisfaction trends against annual targets.
* Zero material findings on data privacy, confidentiality, or ISO 27001 compliance.
* Achievement of quarterly performance certification required for release of contract payment.

title: Facilities Executive
description:
Facility Executive\- IFM operations
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The Executive is responsible for coordinating and managing integrated facility services operations encompassing both soft services (housekeeping,technical security, reception, catering) and technical services coordination (basic maintenance, vendor liaison, work order management). This role maintains robust governance frameworks to ensure service quality, compliance, and performance excellence across all facility operations. The position requires strong coordination skills, technical awareness, attention to detail, governance capabilities, and a customer service orientation to maintain high service standards, operational efficiency, and occupant satisfaction.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Soft Services Coordination**
 Coordinate daily operations of housekeeping, janitorial, and cleaning services across the facility. Oversee reception, front\-of\-house services, and visitor management operations. Manage mail room operations including courier services, package handling, and distribution. Coordinate catering services, pantry management, and kitchen/breakroom upkeep. Monitor landscaping, pest control, and waste management services. Ensure proper functioning of employee amenities including meeting rooms, breakout areas, and common spaces. Conduct regular walkthroughs and inspections to ensure service quality and cleanliness standards are met.
   

  

**Technical Services Coordination**
 Coordinate routine maintenance activities for building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and lighting. Manage work order systems for technical service requests and maintenance issues. Liaise with technical vendors and contractors for repairs, preventive maintenance, and servicing. Monitor completion of scheduled preventive maintenance tasks and inspections. Track maintenance schedules for critical building equipment and systems. Coordinate access for technical contractors and ensure proper site induction procedures. Log and track technical issues, service calls, and resolution timelines. Escalate urgent technical matters to Facility Manager or engineering team. Support energy management initiatives by reporting anomalies in consumption or system performance. Assist with coordination of minor building projects and equipment installations.
   

  

**Governance Framework \& Standards**
 Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all soft and technical services activities. Create and implement service delivery standards, quality benchmarks, and performance criteria. Establish inspection protocols, checklists, and quality assurance processes for both service categories. Document workflows, service schedules, and operational guidelines. Maintain governance documentation including policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure alignment with organizational standards and industry best practices. Review and update governance documents regularly to reflect operational changes and improvements. Create technical service protocols including emergency response procedures and escalation matrices.
   

  

**Performance Monitoring \& Reporting**
 Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for all facility services operations. Implement service level monitoring systems and maintain performance dashboards. Conduct regular audits and inspections using standardized assessment criteria. Generate daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports for management review. Analyze service delivery trends, identify patterns, and highlight areas requiring attention. Maintain performance scorecards for vendors and internal service teams. Track technical service metrics including response times, first\-time fix rates, and equipment uptime. Monitor compliance with preventive maintenance schedules and service intervals. Present findings and recommendations to facility management and stakeholders. Generate equipment performance reports and maintenance history logs.
   

  

**Vendor \& Contractor Management**
 Serve as primary point of contact for soft services and technical services vendors and contractors. Monitor vendor performance against defined SLAs and contractual obligations. Coordinate service requests and communicate requirements to service providers. Track vendor attendance, timesheets, and service delivery documentation. Conduct regular vendor performance reviews and feedback sessions. Report vendor performance issues and coordinate corrective actions. Assist with vendor onboarding and orientation to facility requirements. Maintain vendor compliance records including insurance certificates, licenses, certifications, and trade qualifications. Manage vendor escalations and dispute resolution processes. Coordinate technical certifications and equipment\-specific training requirements for contractors.
   

  

**Service Quality \& Compliance Management**
 Implement and monitor service level standards for all facility services. Conduct quality inspections and maintain inspection checklists and reports. Address service deficiencies promptly and follow up on corrective actions. Respond to occupant requests, complaints, and feedback regarding facility services. Maintain high standards of cleanliness, presentation, and service delivery. Verify technical work completion and quality before sign\-off. Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on feedback and observations. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, procedures, and governance requirements. Monitor compliance with service contracts and specifications. Verify compliance with technical standards, building codes, and manufacturer specifications.
   

  

**Documentation \& Records Management**
 Maintain comprehensive facility services records, logs, and documentation systems. Process work orders and service requests through facility management systems (CMMS/CAFM). Document service incidents, non\-conformances, and corrective actions taken. Track consumables inventory including cleaning supplies, pantry items, and amenities. Maintain equipment registers, asset lists, and technical specifications. Document maintenance history, service records, and warranty information. Maintain audit trails for inspections, quality checks, and service delivery. Coordinate supplies ordering and ensure adequate stock levels. Prepare regular reports on service delivery, incidents, and performance metrics. Maintain vendor contracts, insurance certificates, and compliance documentation. Archive historical records and ensure data integrity and accessibility. Maintain technical drawings, equipment manuals, and as\-built documentation.
   

  

**Budget \& Financial Governance**
 Support budget tracking and invoice processing for facility services. Monitor expenditure against approved budgets and highlight variances. Review vendor invoices for accuracy and compliance with contracted rates. Track cost trends and identify opportunities for efficiency improvements. Maintain financial records and support audit processes. Assist in budget preparation and forecasting for facility services. Monitor technical service costs including emergency call\-outs and breakdown repairs. Ensure proper financial controls and approval processes are followed. Identify cost\-saving opportunities through preventive maintenance and service optimization.
   

  

**Health, Safety \& Regulatory Compliance**
 Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations for all facility services activities. Monitor proper use of cleaning chemicals, equipment, and safety procedures. Oversee contractor safety compliance including permits to work and risk assessments. Conduct safety briefings with service providers and maintain safety records. Report safety incidents, near misses, and hazards promptly. Maintain incident logs and investigation documentation. Support emergency preparedness including evacuation procedures and crisis response. Ensure proper waste segregation, recycling programs, and environmental compliance. Monitor regulatory requirements for technical systems including fire safety, lifts, and pressure systems. Conduct risk assessments for facility services operations. Verify contractor licensing and certification compliance for technical trades. Maintain records of statutory inspections and compliance certifications.
   

  

**Work Order \& Request Management**
 Manage facility management system (CMMS) for tracking all service requests and work orders. Prioritize incoming requests based on urgency and impact. Assign work orders to appropriate vendors or internal teams. Monitor work order status and follow up on pending items. Communicate progress updates to requestors and stakeholders. Close completed work orders with proper documentation and verification. Generate work order reports and analyze trends in service requests. Identify recurring issues requiring permanent solutions. Maintain response time metrics and service level compliance. Coordinate planned versus reactive maintenance activities.
   

  

**Occupant Services \& Experience**
 Act as first point of contact for occupant inquiries related to facility services. Coordinate special requests for events, meetings, and workplace activities. Manage meeting room bookings, setup requirements, and catering arrangements. Support workplace hospitality and visitor experience initiatives. Conduct occupant satisfaction surveys and implement feedback. Build positive relationships with building occupants and department representatives. Develop service improvement plans based on user feedback and emerging needs. Communicate planned maintenance activities and potential service disruptions proactively.
   

  

**Project Support \& Continuous Improvement**
 Assist with facility services transitions, vendor changes, and service improvements. Support office moves, workspace reconfigurations, and setup activities. Coordinate deep cleaning projects, carpet cleaning, and specialized services. Assist with facility events, corporate functions, and special programs. Support small capital projects and equipment upgrades. Participate in facility improvement initiatives and workplace enhancement projects. Identify inefficiencies and recommend process improvements. Benchmark services against industry standards and best practices. Lead or support service optimization initiatives. Implement lessons learned and best practices from completed projects.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
**Education:** 
 Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Facility Management, Engineering Technology, Building Services, Business Administration, or related field. High school diploma with relevant technical and facility services experience may be considered.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5\-7 years of experience in integrated facility services, combining soft services coordination with technical services support. Experience in commercial office buildings, corporate facilities, industrial sites, or multi\-tenant environments. Background in vendor coordination, service delivery operations, and performance monitoring. Demonstrated experience with governance, compliance monitoring, or quality assurance. Exposure to building systems maintenance and work order management. Customer service experience in a corporate or professional environment. Experience managing service level agreements and performance metrics.
   

  

**Technical Knowledge:** 
 Understanding of housekeeping operations, cleaning standards, and industry best practices. Familiarity with workplace services including reception, mail services, and amenity management. Basic technical knowledge of building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and lighting. Understanding of preventive maintenance principles and equipment servicing requirements. Ability to interpret basic technical documentation, service reports, and maintenance logs. Knowledge of governance frameworks, SOP development, and quality management systems. Understanding of KPI development, performance monitoring, and reporting methodologies. Knowledge of health and safety requirements for facility and technical services. Proficiency with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) or CAFM platforms. Knowledge of inventory management and supplies coordination. Understanding of building automation systems and energy management concepts preferred.
   

  

**Governance \& Compliance Skills:** 
 Ability to develop and implement standard operating procedures and service standards. Experience conducting audits, inspections, and quality assessments. Strong documentation and record\-keeping capabilities. Understanding of compliance requirements and regulatory frameworks. Knowledge of vendor management best practices and contract administration. Familiarity with performance measurement and continuous improvement methodologies. Experience with reporting tools and dashboard creation. Understanding of statutory compliance requirements for building systems.
   

  

**Skills:** 
 Strong organizational and multitasking abilities with exceptional attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills across all organizational levels. Customer service orientation with analytical and problem\-solving mindset. Ability to coordinate multiple vendors and service providers simultaneously. Technical aptitude with ability to understand basic building systems and maintenance requirements. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint), particularly Excel for data analysis and reporting. Report writing and documentation skills with ability to present findings clearly. Data analysis capabilities to identify trends and insights from performance metrics. Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively. Professional demeanor and presentation skills. Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and urgent requests. Process\-oriented thinking with focus on standardization and efficiency. Basic troubleshooting and problem diagnosis abilities.
   

  

 Personal Attributes
   

  

 Strong attention to detail and quality consciousness. Proactive approach with ability to anticipate needs and identify issues before escalation. Governance compliance rates and audit findings. Non\-conformance identification and resolution rates. Work order completion rates and backlog management. Energy consumption trends and efficiency improvements.

**About Maker Bhavan Foundation (MBF)** 




 Maker Bhavan Foundation (MBF) is a non\-profit organization transforming engineering education across India by shifting learning from theoretical instruction to hands\-on, active problem\-solving. Founded by visionary tech alumni, entrepreneurs, and academicians, MBF equips academic institutions with the tools, funding, and expertise needed to cultivate future\-ready innovators and engineers. Through its flagship Tinkerers' Labs (24/7 student\-led makerspaces), MBF gives students direct access to rapid prototyping technology. Its high\-impact initiatives, such as the InventX summer invention internship, the Vishwakarma Awards, and the Center for Essential Skills, foster both technical ingenuity and professional readiness. Collaborating directly with governing bodies like AICTE on Project PRACTICE, MBF works to integrate project\-based learning into Tier\-II and Tier\-III colleges. Driven by a vision to embed a vibrant maker culture into higher education, Maker Bhavan Foundation aims to expand to 100s of engineering colleges by 2030, directly empowering 10% of India's graduating engineers each year to translate bold ideas into real\-world technological solutions.
 



  





**1\. Role Overview** 




 STEM Shiksha Foundation is seeking a highly organized and proactive
 **HR \& Admin Manager** 
 to manage our day\-to\-day office operations and internal people processes.
 



 This is an execution\-heavy role for someone who enjoys building order out of chaos. You will be the backbone of the office—ensuring our physical and digital workspaces run like clockwork while managing the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for our growing team. We need a "doer" who is comfortable switching between vendor negotiations and recruitment screenings with ease.

 Oversee the day\-to\-day functioning of our office at Vikhroli; manage housekeeping, supplies, and general upkeep.

 Act as the primary administrator for
 **Google Workspace** 
 . This includes managing user access, structuring shared drives, and ensuring a clean, intuitive file\-naming hierarchy.

 Source, negotiate with, and manage vendors for office utilities, stationery, and equipment.

 Coordinate travel, local transport, and scheduling for the leadership team and visiting stakeholders.

 Maintain rigorous digital and physical filing systems to ensure "audit\-ready" documentation at all times.



  





**B. HR Operations(30%)**

 Manage the full recruitment funnel—posting jobs, initial resume screening, scheduling interviews, and maintaining a candidate database.

 Ensure every new hire has a seamless Day 1 (IT setup, documentation, orientation) and manage professional offboarding for exiting employees.

 Roll out HR policies and ensure consistent adherence across the team.
* **Performance Support:** 
 Assist the Head of Operations in tracking KRAs and ensuring timely completion of performance review cycles.
* **Compliance:** 
 Maintain employee records, attendance, and basic HR compliance requirements.



  





**3\. Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 5–6 years of relevant HR \& Admin experience.
* Experience independently handling recruitment and HR operations.
* Prior experience in a startup, NGO, or small\-to\-mid\-sized education firm is highly preferred.

 Expert\-level command over Google Workspace (Drive, Sheets, Docs, Calendar). You should be the person others ask for help with digital tools.

 A natural knack for organizing files, schedules, and physical spaces.

 High integrity and emotional intelligence when handling sensitive employee information.

 Compensation will be competitive and based on experience and capability.

 As a Quality Professional, you will play a crucial role in driving quality excellence across Siemens Energy's High Voltage, Digital Grid, FACTS, HVDC, and Project businesses. You will act as a trusted quality advisor to management and cross\-functional teams, ensuring that quality management systems, processes, and compliance frameworks are effectively implemented and continuously improved.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead strategic quality initiatives, support supplier quality management, oversee audits and regulatory compliance, and promote a culture of continuous improvement across the organization. You will collaborate closely with project teams, suppliers, manufacturing units, and business stakeholders to enhance customer satisfaction, product quality, operational performance, and sustainable business growth. We are looking for an experienced quality professional with strong expertise in High Voltage electrical systems, quality management systems, supplier quality, audits, and process excellence who can drive quality transformation and support Siemens Energy's commitment to operational excellence.
   

  

 How You'll Make an Impact
   

  

* Develop and drive the quality strategy for the assigned business scope, aligning quality objectives with organizational goals and customer expectations.
* Ensure the effective implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), including process management and compliance with internal and external requirements.
* Lead strategic quality programs and monitor their effectiveness, enabling continuous improvement across projects, factories, suppliers, and business operations.
* Act as a quality advisor to management and stakeholders, promoting quality culture, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
* Develop and implement professional non\-conformity (NC) management processes, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, and lessons learned programs.
* Drive quality methods, risk management practices, and quality gates across projects, products, and organizational processes.
* Lead product safety\-related quality activities and ensure compliance with applicable standards, regulations, and customer requirements.
* Manage supplier quality initiatives, including supplier development, vendor assessments, factory acceptance tests (FAT), material inspections, and franchise audits.
* Conduct internal audits and coordinate external audits, ensuring timely closure of findings and continuous compliance with ISO and regulatory requirements.
* Develop quality reporting frameworks, management reviews, dashboards, and performance metrics to support informed business decisions.
* Promote awareness of Quality Management Systems through training programs, workshops, lessons learned sessions, and stakeholder engagement activities.
* Support process improvement initiatives across the Business Unit by identifying opportunities to enhance quality, customer satisfaction, EHS performance, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure alignment between quality, project excellence, supplier management, and EHS objectives to support sustainable business growth.
* Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on products, services, and business operations.
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration with engineering, procurement, project management, manufacturing, and service teams to achieve quality excellence.


 What You Bring
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering with 7\+ years of relevant professional experience in Quality Management, High Voltage products, projects, or services.
* Certification in ISO 9001 and ISO 45001 standards, with strong understanding of quality management principles and compliance requirements.
* Audit experience exceeding 200 hours, including planning, execution, reporting, and closure of internal and external audits.
* Strong understanding of High Voltage electrical systems with hands\-on experience in engineering, design, execution, testing, commissioning, or project coordination.
* Domain expertise in High Voltage equipment, substations, FACTS, HVDC systems, transmission projects, or related energy infrastructure businesses.
* Experience in supplier quality management, vendor development, supplier audits, and factory acceptance testing activities.
* In\-depth knowledge of quality management tools, continuous improvement methodologies, Lean management principles, and risk management techniques.
* Strong knowledge of ISO standards, regulatory requirements, and quality compliance frameworks applicable to the energy industry.
* Sound understanding of project management principles and the integration of quality practices within project execution environments.
* Proficiency in High Voltage product testing, engineering processes, design practices, and instrumentation \& control applications.
* Experience in developing quality documentation, quality assurance plans, process manuals, management review systems, and quality reporting mechanisms.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, and decision\-making capabilities with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively across organizational levels.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives, inspire teams, share best practices, and drive sustainable business improvements.
* Professional proficiency in English with strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.
* Willingness to travel for site evaluations, supplier audits, vendor inspections, customer engagements, and project quality assessments.

description:
**Why UKG**
 At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
   

  

 We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
   

  

 The Product Support Representative II (S2\) is a customer\-facing role responsible for delivering outstanding voice\-based and digital support to our US customers. You’ll play a key role in resolving technical issues, guiding users on the UKG Ready application (Time, Labor, HR, and Payroll modules), and ensuring an exceptional customer experience through every interaction.
   

  

 This role requires strong communication skills, technical curiosity, and a results\-driven mindset — balancing productivity goals with continuous learning and collaboration.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Customer Support Excellence


 Serve as the first point of contact for customer inquiries, primarily through voice\-based channels.
   

  

 Demonstrate clear, confident, and empathetic communication while maintaining professionalism and customer trust.
   

  

 Take ownership of customer issues by investigating, troubleshooting, and identifying root causes through a methodical process of elimination before considering escalation.
   

  

 Manage interactions efficiently and provide timely, accurate resolutions to drive customer satisfaction and retention.
   

  

* Domain \& Technical Proficiency


 Apply analytical and problem\-solving skills to investigate and reproduce customer\-reported issues.
   

  

 Troubleshoot and resolve customer\-reported issues across applications and systems, using a structured and analytical approach; familiarity with HCM domains such as US Payroll, Time \& Labor, and HR is a strong plus.
   

  

 Collaborate with the Tier 2 team to escalate and resolve complex product or technical concerns.
   

  

 0–2 years of hands\-on experience with US Payroll or HR systems. (Preferred but not required)
   

  

* Performance \& Productivity Focus


 Achieve and maintain high productive hours over the phone with customers.
   

  

 Consistently meet or exceed team KPIs for quality, response time, and resolution rate.
   

  

 Use remaining time effectively for research, learning, and skill enhancement.
   

  

 Demonstrate ownership and accountability for individual and team goals.
   

  

* Process Adherence


 Follow all UKG policies, support protocols, and documentation standards.
   

  

 Complete assigned tasks, training, and certifications within required timelines.
   

  

 Participate actively in meetings, huddles, and process\-improvement discussions.
   

  

* Team Collaboration


 Contribute to a positive team culture by supporting peers and sharing knowledge.
   

  

 Collaborate across functions and geographies to enhance overall customer experience.
   

  

 Uphold the “Partners for Life” model through teamwork and customer advocacy.
   

  

* Adaptability \& Learning Mindset


 Thrive in a fast\-paced, evolving environment with frequent product updates.
   

  

 Take initiative in learning new modules, technologies, and troubleshooting techniques.
   

  

 Embrace feedback and coaching to continuously improve.
   

  

* Work Flexibility


 Willing to work Eastern Time Zone hours and follow a hybrid work model (minimum 3 days in office per week).
   

  

 During probation you are required to work from the office for all 5 days.
   

  

 Open to working from the office 5 days a week as per business and operational needs.
   

  

 Adapt to changing priorities and operational demands.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 2–3 years of experience in voice\-based Technical support for US clients (mandatory).
   

  

 Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to multitask and meet performance goals in a metrics\-driven environment.
   

  

 Strong analytical and technical troubleshooting abilities.
   

  

 Experience working in a tiered support environment, with hands\-on responsibility in a Level 2 (L2\) support role.
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree (BCom, BA, BSc Computers).
   

  

 Proficient in Microsoft Suite (Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word).
   

  

 Certification in Payroll or HR systems is a plus.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 You build trust quickly with customers through clarity and ownership.
   

  

 You consistently meet or exceed KPIs while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
   

  

 You actively learn, adapt, and grow within the team.
   

  

 You contribute positively to the culture and success of the broader support organization.
   

  

**Company Overview**
 UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people\-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. **What We're Looking For** 

 ●     Strong proficiency in Shopify Liquid, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap

description:

**Role: Prompt Engineer – Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio**
**Position Summary**
 EY’s GDS Assurance Digital team designs and deploys AI‑enabled solutions that transform audit and assurance workflows at scale. As a
 **Prompt Engineer – Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio** 
 , you will be responsible for designing, engineering, testing, and governing high‑quality prompts, agents, and conversational workflows that power Microsoft Copilot–based solutions for Assurance professionals.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of
 **Assurance domain knowledge, Generative AI behaviour, and Microsoft Copilot platform engineering** 
 . You will ensure Copilot solutions are
 **accurate, explainable, safe, compliant, and engagement‑ready** 
 , while delivering measurable productivity and quality outcomes for audit teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Prompt Engineering \& AI Behaviour Design**
* Design, refine, and optimize prompts for Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio to support audit, controls, risk, and reporting use cases.
* Engineer multi‑turn conversational flows, system prompts, grounding instructions, and response constraints aligned to Assurance methodology.
* Apply prompt patterns such as role‑based prompting, chain‑of‑thought structuring, guardrails, and retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG).
* Continuously test and improve prompt performance for accuracy, consistency, explainability, and hallucination reduction.


**Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio Engineering**
* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents including topics, triggers, entities, actions, plugins, and orchestration logic.
* Integrate Copilot Studio with enterprise data sources, workflows, APIs, and assurance tools in line with security and governance standards.
* Design agent routing and orchestration logic to support multi‑agent or domain‑specific Copilot experiences.
* Collaborate with platform and engineering teams to align Copilot implementations with Microsoft and EY architectural standards.


**AI Quality, Risk \& Governance**
* Define and execute AI testing strategies including prompt validation, negative testing, edge‑case handling, and output evaluation.
* Ensure Copilot solutions meet AI governance, risk management, and compliance expectations (e.g., explainability, traceability, human‑in‑the‑loop).
* Support AI certification, QRM reviews, and engagement‑readiness assessments for Copilot‑based solutions.
* Document prompt logic, assumptions, limitations, and usage guidance for audit and risk review purposes.


**Adoption, Change \& Enablement**
* Support rollout of Copilot solutions through user guidance, prompt playbooks, and best‑practice documentation.
* Train Assurance users on effective Copilot interaction and responsible usage.
* Gather user feedback and usage insights to iteratively improve prompt effectiveness and agent design.


**Research \& Continuous Improvement**
* Stay current on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, and emerging prompt engineering techniques.
* Evaluate new Copilot features and GenAI capabilities for applicability to Assurance use cases.
* Contribute to reusable prompt libraries, agent templates, and design standards across the Assurance Digital portfolio.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 4–7 years of experience in AI‑enabled product, automation, or digital roles.
* Hands‑on experience with prompt engineering for LLM‑based systems.
* Practical experience building solutions using Microsoft Copilot and/or Copilot Studio, Python, LangGraph.
* Strong understanding of LLM behaviour, limitations, risks, and evaluation techniques.
* Ability to translate complex business or regulatory requirements into structured AI interactions.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models with cross‑functional global teams.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to explain AI behaviour to non‑technical stakeholders.


**Preferred / Additional Capabilities**
* Familiarity with Assurance, Audit, Risk, or Regulatory workflows.
* Experience with RAG patterns, vector search, and enterprise data grounding.
* Exposure to AI governance, risk management, or model validation frameworks.
* Knowledge of Azure services and API‑based integrations.
* Ability to create conversation flows, prompt maps, and AI interaction diagrams.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Copilot solutions that deliver trusted, high‑quality, audit‑ready outputs.
* Prompts and agents that are reusable, scalable, and compliant by design.
* Strong adoption and positive feedback from Assurance practitioners.
* Reduced rework, improved efficiency, and enhanced audit quality through AI assistance.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Quality analyst and Trainer
description:
The QA \& Training Analyst is a senior individual contributor who owns two connected charters for DentalKart's CX function: quality assurance and agent capability building. This role audits chat and email interactions against SLA/CX standards, runs structured root\-cause analysis (ACPT — Agent / Customer / Process / Technology) on service failures, and closes the loop by designing and delivering the training interventions — onboarding, refreshers, and targeted coaching — needed to fix what the audits surface. The ideal candidate has enough tenure to independently run both QA and training charters, and to represent both in reviews with the CX Head.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 4–5 years of experience spanning QA, training, or both, ideally within e\-commerce/D2C customer support or a comparable high\-volume support environment.
* Demonstrated ability to independently run a QA charter — scorecard design, audit execution, calibration — without close supervision.
* Hands\-on training/facilitation experience — designing content and delivering it to agents, not just consuming training material.
* Strong command of CX metrics and terminology — FRT, ART, AHT, TAT, SLA, CSAT, NPS, deflection.
* Working proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for tracking, scorecards, and reporting.
* Familiarity with helpdesk/chat platforms such as Zoho Desk, Zoho SalesIQ, or equivalent (Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom).
* Comfortable working with root\-cause frameworks (ACPT or equivalent) and translating audit findings into training content and process recommendations.
* Strong written and verbal communication — able to deliver constructive feedback to agents and summarize findings for CX leadership.


**Benefits**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Own end\-to\-end QA audits of chat (Zoho SalesIQ) and email (Zoho Desk) interactions against defined scorecards, covering both accuracy and tone/handling.
* Track and report CX metrics — FRT, ART, AHT, TAT, SLA compliance, CSAT, NPS, bot containment/deflection — and publish audit reporting on a defined cadence.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on negative feedback and repeat contacts using the ACPT framework, separating agent\-level, process\-level, and technology\-level failures.
* Run calibration sessions across auditors/TLs to keep QA scoring consistent; own the QA scorecard and update it as processes evolve.
* Convert recurring QA findings into SOP updates and process/technical fix recommendations, in partnership with the CX Head and Ops.
* Design and deliver onboarding/induction training for new CX hires, covering product, process, tools, and communication standards.
* Build refresher and upskilling modules based on recurring QA gaps — e.g., scripted/no\-resolution responses, misjudged escalations, tool usage errors. Design SOP of the processes and do weekly training with the team.
* Run targeted, evidence\-based coaching for individual agents or teams flagged through QA audits or performance scorecards (KRA/KPI).
* Maintain a training calendar, content library (SOPs, playbooks, scenario guides), and track training effectiveness against post\-training QA scores and CSAT movement.
* Certify agents on new processes, tools, or product launches before they go live on the floor.

title: Marketplace Growth Consultant
description:
About Filli and Me
 
 Filli and Me is an early years brand with a vision to make parenting easier and childhood more fun. Launched in April 2026, the brand has been built with a clear ambition: to become India's best\-in\-class early years brand. Starting with the kids' accessory space, we have launched a range of differentiated, ergonomic backpacks and will be launching several exciting new ranges over the next few quarters. 7. **Protect premium positioning** 
 Grow the channel in a way that strengthens Filli and Me's premium positioning, balancing growth with long\-term brand equity.

 Preference is for candidates based in Delhi NCR, with a hybrid working arrangement — including weekly or fortnightly in\-person touchpoints. Candidates based outside Delhi NCR can also be considered, provided frequent, structured touchpoints are put in place to ensure constant coordination and alignment with the team.
