title: Senior / Staff Data Engineer (BI) – CEG Team
description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Get To Know Our Team:**
 The Data department oversees all of Agoda’s data\-related requirements. Our ultimate goal is to enable and increase the use of data in the company through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, queue systems, BI tools, and data science technology. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company’s culture of diversity and experimentation. The role the Data team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, engineers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty. This is what drives up the challenge as part of the Data department, but also the reward.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 As a
 **Senior/Staff Data Engineer in CEG (Customer Experience Group)** 
 , you will help design, build, and maintain the data and software foundations that power how CEG Business users serves customers and agents across all contact channels. You will work closely with Product, Operations, Analytics, Operations Efficiency, WFM, DevOps and engineering teams to deliver reliable data pipelines, scalable models, internal tools, and clear insights that improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
   

  

 You are comfortable switching between
 **engineering work** 
 (pipelines, data models, internal services, tooling, optimization) and
 **analytics work** 
 (business questions, dashboards, deep‑dive analysis). You can talk to both engineers and business stakeholders in simple, clear language. At the
 **Staff level** 
 , you will also shape CEG’s data and tooling strategy, influence cross‑team architecture, and raise the overall engineering and data bar for the team.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
**Data Engineering**
* Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and serve data from CEG systems (case management, telephony, chat, bots, QA tools, WFM, CRM) and third‑party tools and logs.
* Develop and optimize data models (e.g., warehouse tables, marts, views) that power CEG reporting, monitoring, forecasting, QA, and experimentation.
* Ensure data quality, reliability, and observability:
* Implement validation checks, anomaly detection, and monitoring for key CEG datasets and metrics.
* Work with stakeholders to define and enforce data definitions, SLAs, and ownership for critical tables and metrics.
* Improve performance and cost efficiency of data jobs and queries (e.g., partitioning, indexing, query tuning, storage format optimization) for high‑volume CEG data (calls, chats, emails, cases, events).
* Collaborate with data platform and engineering teams to standardize tooling and best practices (e.g., version control, CI/CD for data and services, code review, documentation, runbooks).


**Data Tools \& Product Development**
* Design and build data tools and internal products for CEG (e.g., self‑service analytics, case monitoring dashboards, alerting systems, investigator tools, QA/review tools, agent performance views).
* Use languages such as Python, Java, Golang, or JavaScript/TypeScript to implement APIs, data services, and lightweight UIs that expose data in a usable way to agents, managers, and operations teams.
* Work closely with CEG product managers and operations to translate operational pain points into concrete data tools, from problem framing to delivery and iteration.
* Apply solid software engineering practices—testing, code reviews, CI/CD, observability—to data products so they are reliable, maintainable, and easy to extend.
* At Staff level, define and drive the roadmap for key CEG data tools and platforms, ensuring reuse across regions, lines of business, and channels.


**Data Analytics \& Business Impact**
* Partner with CEG product and business teams to translate questions into data problems and design clear analytic approaches.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports (e.g., contact volumes, handling time, quality, customer outcomes, agent performance, spot alerts) that provide reliable metrics and self‑service access to data.
* Perform deep‑dive analysis to understand trends in contact patterns, customer issues, agent performance, and operational efficiency; identify root causes and propose practical, data‑driven recommendations.
* Define and maintain metrics and KPIs (e.g., CSAT, NPS, SLA, AHT, FCR, quality scores), ensuring consistent definitions across CEG teams and tools.
* Communicate findings in simple, business‑friendly language, including clear implications and recommended next steps.


**Stakeholder \& Team Collaboration** 
  

  

* 
+ Act as a trusted data partner for CEG stakeholders (operations leaders, product managers, WFM, QA, training, policy, and regional leadership).
+ Work with other data engineers, analysts, and scientists to align on data standards, reusable components, and shared datasets for CEG.
+ Mentor junior and mid‑level team members on data engineering, analytics, and software engineering best practices.
+ Contribute to continuous improvement of team workflows (code reviews, testing, documentation, runbooks, knowledge sharing, incident reviews).
+ At Staff level, influence cross‑team architecture and ways of working, making sure CEG’s data ecosystem scales with business growth.


**Required Qualifications:**
* 8\+ years working as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Data Analyst in a data‑driven environment (Staff level typically 10\+ or equivalent scope/impact).
* Strong SQL skills (complex joins, window functions, aggregation, query optimization).
* Experience with at least one major data warehouse / big data technology (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Hive, Spark, Vertica, StarRocks, or similar).
* Solid experience with ETL/ELT tools or orchestration frameworks (e.g., Airflow, dbt, internal frameworks).
* Proficiency in at least one programming language for data and services (e.g., Python, Java, Golang, Kotlin, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
* Experience building production‑grade data pipelines and/or data services with attention to quality, monitoring, and maintainability.
* Experience with BI / visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Superset, Metabase, Looker).
* Strong analytical thinking: comfortable framing business questions, exploring data, and turning results into clear insights.
* Ability to communicate complex topics in simple, concise language to non‑technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience with event‑driven data (logs, clickstream, customer journey, contact flows, tracking data).
* Knowledge of data modeling techniques (e.g., dimensional modeling, Kimball, data vault, star/snowflake schema).
* Experience with A/B testing, experimentation platforms, or causal analysis.
* Familiarity with ML pipelines or working with data science teams (e.g., routing models, QA scoring, forecasting, recommendations).
* Experience in online consumer products, travel, e‑commerce, or marketplaces.
* Hands‑on frontend or backend development experience (e.g., building internal tools in React/Next.js, Node.js, or similar frameworks) used by operations or support teams.
* Prior experience in a Staff or Tech‑Lead role, driving technical direction and mentoring multiple engineers/analysts.

title: Formal Verification Engineer
description:
We are currently seeking an experienced Formal Verification Engineer with strong CPU/GPU and verification fundamentals to work in NVIDIA's Central Formal team based in Bangalore. NVIDIA builds CPUs and GPUs that powering up the next generation AI and HPC workloads. This position will have you crafting and optimizing formal verification flows across CPU/GPU projects and resolving tool issues for design teams with tool vendors. Additionally, you'll verify the micro\-architecture using formal verification tools to employ the latest model checking and equivalence checking techniques. You will be expected to understand the design \& implementation, define the verification scope, and ensure design correctness. You will use advanced formal techniques to obtain full proofs, or sufficient bounded proofs, of the design while working with architects, designers, pre\- and post\-silicon verification teams to accomplish your tasks.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* The specification, implementation, and maintenance of an integrated end\-to\-end formal verification flow for the formal verification team.
* Developing scripts to automate the verification process.
* Review formal setups and proofs with design and verification teams.
* Maintain and extend assertion libraries, including support for both simulation and FV.
* Identifying key behaviours for verification of DUT and creating a verification plan.
* Developing verification environment including environment assumptions, assertions and cover properties in context of the verification plan.
* Applying various FV techniques to prove correctness of digital designs.

title: People & Talent Head
description:
**This role is for one of Weekday's clients
   

  

 Salary range: Rs 1800000 \- Rs 3000000 (ie INR 18 \- 30 LPA)**
 Min Experience: 5\+ years
   

  

 Location: Gurgaon
   

  

 JobType: full\-time
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **People \& Talent Head** 
 to build and lead the organization's talent and people function from the ground up.
   

  

 This is not a traditional HR leadership role focused primarily on managing established processes. This is a
 **foundational builder role** 
 for someone who can create the talent engine, people systems, hiring standards, and culture required to scale a high\-growth organization.
   

  

 As the company enters its next phase of growth, talent quality will become one of its most important competitive advantages. The People \& Talent Head will play a critical role in determining
 **who joins, who grows, who stays, and how the organization's culture evolves at scale** 
 .
   

  

 You will work closely with the founders and leadership team to build high\-quality, scalable, and practical people systems while remaining deeply hands\-on during the early stages.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
 **2\. Founder\-Aligned Hiring \& Culture Building** 
**3\. Performance, Growth \& Retention** 
**4\. People Operations \& HR Infrastructure** 
**5\. Leadership \& Manager Enablement**
* Talent Acquisition \& Hiring Excellence
* Own end\-to\-end hiring across leadership, mid\-level, and high\-impact entry\-level roles
* Build and implement scalable hiring strategies and playbooks
* Develop sourcing strategies across referrals, top campuses, lateral hiring, and other relevant talent channels
* Personally source, screen, interview, and close high\-quality candidates
* Continuously raise the hiring bar as the organization scales
* Build structured and effective interview processes that evaluate ownership, problem\-solving ability, judgment, and cultural alignment
* Work closely with founders to translate organizational values and expectations into clear hiring signals and evaluation frameworks
* Build systems that ensure strong alignment between candidates and the organization's culture
* Protect the quality of talent and culture by making thoughtful hiring decisions, even under aggressive growth timelines
* Establish clear standards around ownership, accountability, execution, and performance
* Build performance management frameworks focused on outcomes and impact rather than activity alone
* Design career and growth frameworks that reward ownership, capability, and performance
* Identify high\-potential employees and create opportunities to accelerate their development
* Develop effective feedback and performance review mechanisms
* Improve employee retention by creating clarity, fairness, growth opportunities, and strong manager relationships
* Monitor attrition and identify opportunities to reduce regrettable employee turnover
* Establish scalable and efficient people operations processes
* Oversee payroll, employment documentation, contracts, compliance, EPF, ESIC, and other HR processes
* Build simple, effective systems that support growth without creating unnecessary bureaucracy
* Ensure strong HR hygiene, documentation, and operational discipline
* Identify when additional HR operations or administrative support is required and build the function accordingly
* Partner with managers and leaders on hiring, performance management, feedback, and people decisions
* Act as a trusted advisor for complex employee and organizational matters
* Coach managers to become stronger people leaders
* Support leadership in making thoughtful and effective talent decisions
* Help the organization scale while preserving its speed, ownership culture, and entrepreneurial mindset


 A Hands\-On Builder Role
   

  

 This role begins as a
 **deeply hands\-on individual contributor position** 
 .
   

  

 Initially, you will personally drive key activities, including:
   

  

* Candidate sourcing
* Job description creation
* Resume screening
* Initial candidate conversations
* Interview coordination
* Candidate assessment
* Talent closing
* Hiring process design
* People operations setup


 There may not be a large HR team in the early stages. Success in this role will come from
 **strong judgment, execution, ownership, and the ability to build systems from scratch** 
 .
   

  

 As the organization grows, you will have the opportunity to design scalable processes and build a high\-performing People \& Talent team.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable
 **building first and delegating later** 
 .
   

  

 What We're Looking For
   

  

* Proven experience in Talent Acquisition, People Operations, HR Leadership, or building people functions within high\-growth organizations
* Experience owning end\-to\-end recruitment across multiple functions and seniority levels
* Strong ability to identify and assess high\-quality talent
* Experience working directly with founders and senior leadership
* Demonstrated ability to build HR and talent processes from scratch
* Strong understanding of performance management, employee development, and retention
* Working knowledge of HR operations, payroll, employment documentation, and statutory compliance
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills
* Strong judgment and the confidence to make difficult people decisions
* A highly hands\-on and execution\-oriented mindset


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Talent Acquisition
* People Strategy
* HR Operations
* Performance Management
* Employee Engagement \& Retention
* Leadership Hiring
* Stakeholder Management
* Culture Building
* Strategic Thinking
* Execution \& Ownership
* Problem Solving
* Team Building
* Entrepreneurial Mindset


 Why This Role Is Unique
   

  

 This is a rare opportunity to become a
 **foundational People \& Talent leader** 
 and build the organization's talent engine from the ground up.
   

  

 You will have significant ownership over the systems, standards, and decisions that shape the future workforce. Your work will directly influence the quality of hiring, organizational culture, leadership capability, employee growth, and the company's ability to scale successfully.
   

  

 You will not simply support growth.
   

  

**You will help determine the people who make that growth possible.**
 Ideal Candidate
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **talent builder and people leader** 
 who combines strategic thinking with a strong willingness to execute.
   

  

 The ideal candidate understands that great organizations are built through exceptional people. They have strong judgment, high standards, and the ability to build practical systems without introducing unnecessary complexity.
   

  

 Most importantly, they are comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment where
 **ownership matters, ambiguity is common, and building from zero is part of the opportunity** 
 .

title: Tele-caller
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 CashKaro is India's largest cashback app, helping users earn real cashback on purchases
 



 across 1,500\+ e\-commerce brands like Amazon, Flipkart, and Myntra. Cashback is paid on
 



 top of all existing discounts and can be transferred directly to a bank account, making
 



 CashKaro the smartest way to shop online.
 



  





 We are the \#1 performance marketing partner for e\-commerce in India, driving ₹10,000 Cr in
 



 annual GMV for our brand partners. Founded in 2013 by Rohan and Swati Bhargava,
 



 CashKaro has raised over ₹250 Cr in funding from marquee investors including the late Mr.
 



 Ratan Tata, and has scaled to ₹600 Cr in revenues — growing over 70% in FY26\.
 



  





 Our sister platform, EarnKaro, is India's \#1 affiliate marketing platform. It empowers content
 



 creators, homemakers, students, and micro\-influencers to monetise their reach by sharing
 



 affiliate links from Amazon, Flipkart, and 250\+ brands. Top creators on EarnKaro earn up to
 



 ₹40 lakhs a month. With 80% market share on Telegram, EarnKaro is one of the largest
 



 affiliate traffic drivers for e\-commerce in the country.
 



  





 The group also operates BankKaro, enabling users to compare and apply for credit cards,
 



 loans, and other financial products — making smarter financial decisions accessible to all.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a Tele Caller you will be responsible for reaching out to customers and leads to promote
 



 BankKaro’s partnered credit card offerings, including SBI, Axis, HSBC, and other leading card providers. You will educate customers about card benefits, eligibility, offers, and application processes while managing follow\-ups and ensuring a smooth customer journey from initial outreach to application submission.
 



 The role requires strong communication, persuasion, follow\-up discipline, and atarget\-oriented approach in a fast\-paced sales environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Customer Outreach \& Product Promotion
 


* Make outbound calls to prospective customers and leads for credit card offerings.
* Pitch credit cards clearly by explaining benefits, eligibility criteria, rewards, and applicable offers.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend relevant card options.
* Handle customer queries and objections professionally.



 2\. Lead Follow\-up \& Conversion
 


* Follow up consistently with warm and cold leads to drive application submissions.
* Maintain regular communication with interested customers throughout the application journey.
* Identify customer intent and maximise lead\-to\-application conversion.
* Ensure timely follow\-ups and closure of assigned leads.



 3\. Application \& Documentation Support
 


* Guide customers through the credit card application process.
* Explain required documentation and assist customers with the submission process.
* Ensure customer and application details are captured accurately.
* Coordinate with internal teams wherever required to resolve application\-related issues.



 4\. Application Tracking \& Customer Updates
 


* Track application progress and keep customers informed about the status and next steps.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, customer interactions, and application stages.
* Follow up on pending applications and required documentation.
* Ensure a smooth onboarding experience for customers.



 5\. Target \& Performance Management
 


* Achieve assigned daily, weekly, and monthly calling and conversion targets.
* Maintain strong call quality and closure rates.
* Monitor individual performance metrics and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Adhere to defined sales, quality, and compliance processes.



  





**Must Have Qualifications** 



* 0–3 years of experience in telesales, telecalling, credit card sales, BFSI sales, or customer\-facing calling roles.
* Excellent verbal communication skills with fluency in English and Hindi.
* Strong persuasion, negotiation, and objection\-handling skills.
* Comfortable working in a target\-driven and fast\-paced environment.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and customer\-handling skills.
* Basic knowledge of Excel, CRM, or lead\-tracking systems.
* Good attention to detail while handling customer information and application details.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Previous experience selling or handling credit cards, particularly SBI, Axis, HDFC, or HSBC products.
* Understanding of basic credit card eligibility criteria such as salary, age, and CIBIL score.
* Familiarity with cashback, rewards, and credit card comparison products.
* Experience working in a BFSI, fintech, or financial services environment.



  





**Why Join CashKaro?** 



* Real Ownership, Real Impact — You're not a cog in a machine. You work directly on products and decisions that move the needle for a platform used by millions of Indians every day.
* Innovative Culture — No unnecessary layers, no committee lags. We move fast, back good ideas, and give people the space to build, experiment, and grow.
* Learning \& Development — Structured L\&D programs, cross\-functional exposure, and a team that believes your growth is the company's growth.
* Wealth Creation — ESOPs awarded to many team members, because when CashKaro wins, the people who built it should win too.
* Food, Sorted — Daily lunch and snacks in office. One less thing to worry about.
* Benefits That Actually Matter — Comprehensive medical insurance, Flexible Benefits Plan with tax benefits, wellness initiatives, and a workplace designed tosupport you.
* We Celebrate Everything — Festivals, birthdays, work anniversaries, life milestones. If it matters to you, it matters to us.
* Community, Not Just Colleagues — Team events, outings, dinner meetups, and the kind of in\-office culture where people actually like showing up.
* Diverse by Design — We believe the best ideas come from the most varied rooms.
* Different backgrounds, different perspectives — that's not a policy, it's how we operate.

title: Growth Associate - Dental
description:
**Looking for a Growth Associate to join Orvica Labs to help scale the Dental vertical.
 



  





 Orvica Labs develops Health One, an AI platform for clinics to run their day to day work on\- covering appointments, WhatsApp\-based patient communication, billing and clinical charting and much more. Our first clinical specialty is Dental, before we add other specialties in healthcare.
 



  





 The platform is currently deployed with a multi\-branch dental group in Delhi NCR.
 



  





 Why this might suit you
 



  





 If your future is in the business side of dentistry rather than at the clinical chair, this is a direct route in. You’ll build a working relationship with practice owners across Delhi NCR, learn what makes a clinic function in real life, and understand how dental businesses are actually run — knowledge that stays with you whatever you do next.
 



  





 How we work
 



  





 Field\-based, no fixed office; we do regular team meets, but you set your own days around meetings. You’ll learn something new most days, and the work is genuinely enjoyable. We work hard, but we also have lives — we don’t expect you to work weekends.
 



  





 What the job actually involves
 



  





 This is early\-stage work, and the brief is simple: put your best foot forward to bring good clinics onto the platform. Some days that’s a scheduled demo with a practice owner. Others it’s representing Orvica at an IDA branch meeting or a dental conference, sharing our work on the channels dentists actually read, following up on an enquiry, speaking to your own batchmates and seniors, or trying an approach nobody has tried before. Building relationships with dental supply reps and lab technicians is part of it too — they visit every clinic in NCR each week and know which practices are growing before anyone else does. If it brings in the right clinics, it’s in scope. And it goes without saying, we’re here to support you through it.
 



  





 You should also know that selling to clinics takes time. A doctor who likes the product on day one might still sign much later, after follow\-ups and demos for their partners and staff — that’s normal, and it isn’t a bad sign. Trust is what closes these conversations, and trust takes time to build; you can’t fake it. Not every conversation converts, and the ones that do often land long after you’d stopped expecting them to. The people who do well at this treat a “not right now” as a task for next month rather than a rejection, and they enjoy the long game: every conversation teaches you something about how these practices run, and that knowledge compounds whether or not that particular clinic gets onboarded.
 



  





 Compensation: Competitive Salary \+ Performance Incentive. All work travel fully reimbursed. Laptop provided.
 



  





 Requirements: BDS, 0–2 years’ experience. Based in Gurugram or Delhi NCR. Willing to travel across NCR.
 



  





 No clinical duties, no chairside hours. You’ll report directly to the founder.
 



  





 Send applications to divij@orvica.in \- and if you want to stand out, write briefly about your greatest wins and accomplishments, and why you will be a good fit for this role.**

title: EHS Executive
description:
**About us** 




  





 Umendra Life Sciences manufactures OTC topical pharmaceuticals and personal care products — creams, gels, lotions and ointments — primarily for the US and other international markets.
 



  





 We are looking to add an EHS Executive to our team.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will own day\-to\-day Environment, Health and Safety at the site — the shop floor version, not the head\-office version. That means being visibly present in operational areas, knowing the high\-risk jobs before they start, and having the standing to intervene when something isn't right. You'll work alongside production, maintenance, projects, HR and contractors.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Run the daily inspection rhythm — identify unsafe acts and conditions, drive corrective action to closure, and stay on it until it's closed.
* Own the permit\-to\-work system end\-to\-end: hot work, work at height, confined\-space entry, electrical isolation and other high\-risk activities.
* Lead risk assessments, Job Safety Analyses and toolbox talks so that hazard thinking sits with the line, not only with you.
* Investigate incidents, near misses and environmental events — root cause, CAPA, and verification that the fix held.
* Own emergency preparedness: response plans plus fire, evacuation, spill\-response and first\-aid drills that people actually take seriously.
* Deliver induction, refresher and contractor safety training, and hold contractors to the same standard as employees — from prequalification through on\-site supervision.
* Keep statutory compliance clean: registers, inspection records, testing and certification schedules, and direct interaction with regulators and external auditors.
* Manage environmental controls — waste segregation, hazardous\-waste handling, emissions, effluent, and energy and resource use.
* Drive implementation and continual improvement of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 at the site.
* Report what matters — weekly and monthly EHS dashboards, trend analysis and honest escalation to management.
* Build participation: safety observations, campaigns, suggestions and committee meetings that generate real input from the floor.



**Who fits** 




 Requirements, not preferences:
 


* Based at or willing to relocate to Ahmedabad, and able to work on\-site at our Bavla plant daily. This is a plant role — there is no remote or hybrid arrangement.
* 3–5 years of hands\-on EHS experience in manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, engineering or construction. Plant floor exposure is essential; corporate or consulting\-only backgrounds won't translate.
* Recognized Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety, meeting applicable statutory requirements, alongside a Bachelor's degree or diploma in Engineering, Science, Environmental Studies or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of Indian occupational safety, fire, environmental and waste\-management regulations.
* Direct experience running incident investigations, risk assessments, permit\-to\-work systems and emergency response.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, Hindi and Gujarati — you'll be explaining the same standard to a plant head and to a contract worker on the same day.



 Preferred: ISO 45001 / ISO 14001 internal auditor certification. First\-aid and fire\-safety certification. Pharmaceutical, cosmetic or chemical manufacturing background.
 



  





 What we're really looking for is judgment and persistence — the confidence to interrupt work that's unsafe, the credibility to be listened to when you do, and the patience to chase a corrective action until it's genuinely closed rather than merely logged.
 



**What this role is not** 



* Not a corporate or head\-office EHS position — you will spend most of your day in operational areas, not at a desk.
* Not remote or hybrid.
* Not a documentation\-only role. Records matter, but a candidate whose experience is limited to maintaining files and preparing audit paperwork will struggle here.
* Not a role where safety gets overruled by schedule pressure.



**How you'll be measured** 




 Recordable incidents and lost\-time injuries. Near\-miss reporting rates — we want these going up, not down. Closure rate and ageing of corrective actions. Completion of inspections, audits, training and drills. Contractor and permit compliance. Zero overdue statutory renewals. Reduction in repeat findings.

 We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.

**Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Administrator** 




**Position Summary** 




 The Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Administrator is responsible for supporting identity governance, access administration, privileged access management, cloud identity management, mobile device management, and IT asset management functions. This role assists in maintaining secure access controls, supporting compliance initiatives, managing user identities and entitlements, administering privileged accounts, and ensuring the integrity of access management processes across enterprise and cloud environments. The position works closely with Information Security, Infrastructure, Application Support, and Business teams to support secure and efficient access to organizational resources.
 



  





**Essential Job Functions** 




**Identity \& Access Management (IAM)** 



* Assist in managing AWS IAM users, groups, roles, and policies.
* Support role\-based access control (RBAC) implementation and maintenance for AWS services, including EC2, Lambda, and other cloud resources.
* Provision, modify, and deprovision user access across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and infrastructure systems.
* Troubleshoot and resolve access\-related issues, including permission errors, authentication failures, and role assumption problems.
* Participate in periodic user access reviews, certification campaigns, and entitlement audits.
* Identify, document, and escalate inappropriate access, policy violations, and segregation of duties concerns.
* Maintain accurate identity data, including user attributes, roles, group memberships, and entitlements across supported systems.
* Audit and maintain access controls to ensure compliance with organizational security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.



**Privileged Access Management (CyberArk)** 



* Assist in the administration and maintenance of CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions.
* Support onboarding and management of privileged accounts, service accounts, and application accounts within CyberArk.
* Assist with account discovery, password vaulting, credential rotation, and privileged session management activities.
* Monitor CyberArk platform health, password management processes, and scheduled jobs to ensure operational effectiveness.
* Troubleshoot and resolve CyberArk\-related issues, including account onboarding failures, password reconciliation issues, and access request problems.
* Support privileged access request workflows, approvals, and access certifications in accordance with security policies.
* Assist in implementing and maintaining least\-privilege and privileged access security controls.
* Perform periodic reviews of privileged accounts and privileged access assignments to ensure compliance with organizational standards.
* Generate and maintain CyberArk reports related to privileged account activity, password management, and compliance requirements.
* Maintain CyberArk operational documentation, procedures, and onboarding standards.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, security, and application teams to onboard systems and accounts into CyberArk.



**Security \& Compliance** 



* Assist in implementing and maintaining security controls related to identity and access management.
* Support vulnerability remediation efforts by deploying updates, patches, and corrective actions in response to identified security risks.
* Assist with audit requests and provide supporting documentation related to access management, privileged access management, and asset inventories.
* Ensure adherence to established security policies, procedures, standards, and best practices.
* Support compliance initiatives related to access governance, privileged access management, and information security controls.



**Service Management \& Documentation** 



* Support ServiceNow workflows related to access requests, incident management, change management, and service fulfillment.

* Maintain accurate records of system changes, troubleshooting activities, and access management actions.

 We're seeking a results\-driven Performance Marketing Manager to own and scale marketplace and quick commerce advertising for a leading CPG brand. This is a client\-facing role where you'll be the go\-to expert for campaign strategy, execution, optimization, and reporting.

**Strategy \& Planning**

**Client Communication \& Reporting**

 Participate in business reviews and strategic planning discussions
 




**Listing Management Support**

 Ensure advertising strategies are aligned with product page content and availability
 





 Provide inputs on listing optimization based on campaign performance data
 




**Analytics \& Insights** 





 Build and maintain campaign performance dashboards and trackers
 





 Analyze data across platforms to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
 





 Track key metrics: ROAS, ACoS/ACOS, CTR, conversion rate, share of voice, and sales attribution
 





 Use Excel and analytics tools to derive insights and present recommendations

 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience managing marketplace and quick commerce advertising

 Strong experience with at least one quick commerce platform: Blinkit, Zepto, or Swiggy Instamart
 





 Experience managing CPG/FMCG brand campaigns (preferred) or D2C brands with strong marketplace presence
 





 Track record of managing significant advertising budgets and delivering measurable ROAS improvements
 




**Technical Skills** 





 Expert\-level proficiency in Amazon Seller Central and Amazon Advertising Console
 





 Working knowledge of Flipkart Ads Manager
 





 Hands\-on experience with Blinkit, Zepto, or Swiggy Instamart advertising platforms
 





 Advanced Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data analysis, and dashboard creation
 





 Comfortable working with campaign APIs and third\-party analytics tools
 




**Core Competencies** 





 Data\-driven decision making: You live in the data and use it to drive every optimization
 





 Client management: Professional communication skills and ability to build trust with brand stakeholders
 





 Ownership mindset: You take full accountability for campaign performance and results

 Attention to detail: Campaign setups, budget tracking, and reporting accuracy matter to you

**Nice to Have** 





 Certification in Amazon Advertising or other marketplace platforms
 





 Experience with campaign automation tools or scripts
 





 Knowledge of SEO and listing optimization best practices
 





 Familiarity with attribution modeling and incrementality testing
 





 Experience working in an agency or platform environment serving multiple brands

 Goodera is the world’s leading employee volunteering platform, powering companies to scale employee volunteering experiences globally through our innovative technology platform and unique operating model. With a presence in over 100 countries and support for 30\+ languages, we connect over 500 clients, including 60\+ Fortune 500 companies, with meaningful volunteer opportunities tailored to their communities.  We're looking for a Talent Partner to help build and scale Goodera's global host community.
 



  





 In this role, you'll own the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle for our host network—from sourcing and interviewing to onboarding and ensuring hosts are event\-ready. You'll work closely with the Host Community team to understand regional hiring needs, build talent pipelines, and ensure we always have the right hosts available to support our growing global operations.

**Timings: 6 PM \- 3 AM** 




  





 What You'll Do
 



  





 End\-to\-End Recruitment
 


* Own the complete recruitment lifecycle for assigned geographies.
* Source candidates through multiple channels, including LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, and community outreach.
* Screen candidates to assess communication skills, professionalism, and role fit.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and ensure a seamless candidate experience.
* Drive hiring against monthly and quarterly hiring targets.



  





 Host Onboarding
 


* Coordinate onboarding activities for newly hired hosts.
* Ensure documentation, contracts, and profile creation are completed accurately.
* Partner with the Host Community team to ensure every new hire is event\-ready within defined SLAs.
* Track onboarding progress and proactively resolve bottlenecks.



  





 Talent Pipeline Management
 


* Build and maintain talent pools across multiple geographies.
* Forecast hiring needs with business stakeholders.
* Maintain an active pipeline for priority markets.
* Re\-engage strong candidates for future hiring needs.



  





 Hiring Operations
 


* Maintain accurate recruitment data and reporting.
* Track hiring funnel metrics, conversion rates, and time\-to\-hire.
* Continuously improve recruitment processes and candidate experience.
* Partner with stakeholders to improve hiring efficiency and quality.



  





 Employer Branding
 


* Represent Goodera professionally throughout the hiring process.
* Deliver an outstanding candidate experience from first interaction through onboarding.
* Help strengthen Goodera's employer brand across global talent markets.



  





 What We're Looking For
 


* 2–5 years of experience in Talent Management/ Account Management/ Expert Network

* Strong sourcing skills using LinkedIn and other recruitment platforms.
* Ability to manage multiple hiring pipelines simultaneously.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.

* Build strong talent pipelines for priority regions.
* Improve onboarding readiness and reduce delays between hiring and deployment.

title: Admission Counsellor JEE - NEET (Bangalore)
description:
**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILTIES**

1\. Student \& Parent Counselling

* Conduct one\-to\-one counselling sessions with students and parents interested in JEE and NEET programs.
* Understand the student's academic performance, strengths, weaknesses, career aspirations and target examination.
* Identify the student's requirements and recommend the most suitable academic program, batch and learning pathway.
* Explain the importance of systematic JEE/NEET preparation and the role of the institution in achieving the student's goals.
* Build trust and establish strong relationships with students and parents throughout the admission journey.
* Provide clear and accurate information regarding courses, curriculum, faculty, batch structure, academic methodology, tests, study material and support systems.

2\. JEE \& NEET Program Knowledge

* Develop strong knowledge of JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET and K\-CET preparation.
* Understand the differences between various programs, batches and preparation pathways.
* Stay updated with changes in entrance examinations, eligibility criteria, examination patterns, important dates and competitive landscape.
* Clearly communicate the academic and career advantages of different programs to students and parents.
* Explain the institution's academic methodology, faculty expertise, results, student achievements and unique differentiators.

3\. Lead Management \& Conversion

* Handle leads generated through digital marketing, website enquiries, phone calls, WhatsApp, walk\-ins, seminars, school outreach, scholarship/entrance tests and other campaigns.
* Respond to new enquiries promptly and professionally.
* Qualify leads based on student profile, academic requirements, course interest and admission readiness.
* Maintain a systematic follow\-up process for all prospective students and parents.
* Convert qualified leads into confirmed admissions.
* Maintain a healthy admission pipeline and ensure that no prospective student is left unattended.

4\. Telephonic Counselling

* Make inbound and outbound calls to prospective students and parents.
* Conduct effective telephonic counselling and generate interest in relevant JEE/NEET programs.
* Explain course benefits, program structure, fee details, scholarships, batch timings and admission procedures.
* Schedule campus visits and face\-to\-face counselling appointments.
* Follow up with prospects at appropriate intervals until the admission decision is made.

5\. Walk\-in \& Face\-to\-Face Counselling

* Handle students and parents visiting the centre.
* Conduct professional and structured counselling sessions.
* Present the institution, academic programs, faculty, results and student success stories effectively.
* Conduct centre/facility tours whenever required.
* Understand parent concerns and provide appropriate solutions.
* Work towards converting walk\-ins into admissions.

6\. Objection Handling

* Professionally handle objections related to:
* Fees
* Discounts and scholarships
* Competitor institutes
* Faculty
* Results
* Batch size
* Location
* Timings
* Hostel/transport
* Course duration
* Academic methodology
* Parent/student hesitation
* Communicate value rather than competing purely on price.
* Understand the underlying concern behind an objection and provide a relevant solution.
* Escalate academic or operational concerns to the appropriate team whenever required.

7\. Admission Target Achievement

* Achieve assigned monthly and quarterly admission targets.
* Maintain a strong focus on lead\-to\-admission conversion.
* Track individual performance against admission and revenue targets.
* Take ownership of the complete sales cycle from enquiry to enrolment.
* Consistently work towards improving conversion ratios and revenue contribution.

8\. CRM \& Data Management

* Maintain accurate records of all enquiries, counselling interactions, follow\-ups and admission status in the CRM.
* Update lead status on a daily basis.
* Maintain proper follow\-up schedules and ensure timely callbacks.
* Track hot, warm and cold prospects.
* Maintain accurate student and parent information.
* Prepare regular reports on lead status, conversions, pending follow\-ups and admission pipeline.

title: Trainer - Transcription Review
description:
Role: Trainer — Transcription Review
   

 Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu · Full\-time
   

 Reports to: Operations Manager
   

  

 About the role:
   

 We run an English\-language transcription\-review operation: reviewers listen to audio and correct machine\-generated text into clean, accurate, client ready transcripts — working on platforms and to quality standards similar to TranscribeMe.
   

 As Trainer, you own how quickly and how well new joiners reach production standard, and you build our team of Reviewers who correct and finalize transcripts to a client\-ready bar. You will design and run onboarding, coach on clean\-verbatim style and English grammar, calibrate the team to a single standard, and grow reviewer capability as we scale from a small pilot team to \~90 seats
   

  

 What you'll do:
   

 • Onboard new reviewers — deliver structured training on platform/tool navigation, clean\-verbatim style, speech tags (inaudible, crosstalk, etc.), speaker labelling, timestamps, and researching names and terms.
   

 • Own the curriculum — build and maintain the training material, house style guide, and a certification/assessment path; keep them current as client style guides change (US vs. Commonwealth English, file\-specific rules).
   

 • Coach English fundamentals — grammar, punctuation, spelling, and formatting to one consistent standard; run targeted refreshers on recurring error patterns.
   

 • Develop Senior / Lead Reviewers — identify strong performers and grow them into senior reviewer roles who can guide others and hold the quality bar as the team expands.
   

 • Run calibration — hold regular sessions so all reviewers correct the same file the same way; track and close inconsistencies between reviewers.
   

 • Own ramp\-quality metrics — time\-to\-productivity, accuracy / rejection rate, critical\-error rate, and rework rate; report progress against the hiring ramp.
   

 • Pick up new domains fast — absorb new subject areas and client accounts and turn them into training material quickly (e.g., US legal transcription conventions where required).
   

  

 Must have:
   

 • Excellent command of English — near\-native grammar, punctuation, and spelling (US and Commonwealth), with strong reading comprehension and an ear for meaning.
   

 • Transcription, proofreading, or review background, ideally including clean\-verbatim work.
   

 • Fast domain learner — able to absorb a new subject or style guide and teach it clearly within days, not weeks.
   

 • A coaching instinct — patient, structured, and able to give feedback that actually changes behaviour.
   

 • Detail\-obsessed — comfortable holding a quality standard and working to measurable accuracy targets.
   

  

 Nice to have:
   

 • Exposure to US legal / court transcription conventions — verbatim vs. non\-verbatim, speaker labels, bracketed notation (\[phonetic], \[indiscernible]), and numeral/formatting rules.
   

 • Hands\-on experience with TranscribeMe (or Rev, GoTranscript, Verbit, etc.) as a transcriber or reviewer.
   

 • Experience handling varied English accents (US, UK, Australian, Indian) and difficult audio.
   

 • Prior experience standing up training for a new or scaling team.
   

  

 Success in the first 90 days:
   

 • New reviewers reliably reach production accuracy within the defined ramp window.
   

 • A documented house style guide, training deck, and certification test are live.
   

 • At least one internal Senior Reviewer cohort is trained and holding the standard independently.

title: AI Operations Incident Commander
description:
**Role Summary** 




 As the AI Operations Incident Commander (Offshore), you will lead live incident coordination during offshore hours and provide structured command for production issues impacting the clients AI support environment. We need someone who can rapidly size the situation, confirm severity, engage the right teams, keep the bridge disciplined, and maintain an accurate view of what is happening technically. This role sits close to the work: you should be comfortable coordinating engineers, reviewing evidence, challenging weak updates, and preparing clean handoffs to the onshore lead and client stakeholders when needed.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Live incident command and technical coordination
 


* Lead Severity 1, Severity 2, and priority production incidents during offshore coverage, including bridge setup, severity confirmation, responder coordination, action tracking, and restoration cadence.
* Drive structured technical triage across SRE, platform, integration, application, service desk, security, and vendor teams so incidents continue moving and do not stall in ambiguity.
* Maintain a current command view of symptoms, likely causes, actions in progress, risks, dependencies, and next decisions required.



 2\. Handoffs, escalation, and operational discipline
 


* Prepare concise, high\-quality handoffs to the onshore lead with clear incident status, unresolved risks, owners, timestamps, and recommended next actions.
* Escalate early when severity, business impact, stakeholder sensitivity, or technical uncertainty requires broader engagement or onshore leadership attention.
* Ensure ticket hygiene, bridge notes, timelines, and action logs are complete enough to support RCA, reporting, and clean follow\-through.



 3\. Change risk, problem management, and improvement support
 


* Support operational readiness for risky changes, releases, and maintenance activities by asking the right questions about rollback, validation, monitoring, and support readiness.
* Contribute incident evidence and technical observations into post\-incident reviews and corrective\-action planning.
* Identify repeat failure patterns, weak runbooks, and support\-process gaps, then push improvements back into the service.



 4\. Stakeholder engagement and team ways of working
 


* Work closely with the onshore incident lead, offshore engineers, resolver groups, vendors, and service leadership to keep decision\-making and recovery aligned.
* Engage stakeholders proactively to unblock work rather than waiting for direction when an incident is already live.
* Create structure in fast\-moving situations and help less experienced responders operate with clarity and confidence.



**Preferred Skills and Experience** 




  





**Major incident leadership** 




 Experience coordinating high\-severity production incidents, including bridge management, severity assessment, action tracking, and restoration management.
 



**Technical support depth** 




 Enough technical depth to follow cloud, application, integration, and observability signals and challenge incomplete or weak technical updates.
 



**Service operations and ITIL** 




 Experience working within ITIL\-aligned incident, problem, change, and service\-request processes with strong ticket hygiene.
 



**Communication and handoffs** 




 Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to provide concise bridge updates and high\-quality handoffs across shifts.
 



**Problem solving under ambiguity** 




 Ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information, prioritize quickly, and keep progress moving.
 



**Ownership and teamwork** 




 Strong sense of ownership, comfort operating in ambiguity, and willingness to engage stakeholders proactively to unblock work.
 



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in cloud platform support, AI platform support, complex enterprise application support, or NOC / command\-center style operations.
* Experience coordinating high\-priority incidents in an ITIL\-aligned environment with strong documentation discipline.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, bridge tooling, service reporting, shift handoffs, and working in a managed\-services model.
* Comfort working across offshore and onshore support teams with shared ownership and tight communication loops.



**Working Style \& Core Behaviors** 



* Stays calm and methodical when incidents are noisy, urgent, or under\-defined.
* Knows how to separate signal from noise and keep the bridge focused on the next best action.
* Works well with engineers, service desk teams, vendors, and leadership without waiting for perfect direction.
* Pushes for clarity, evidence, and ownership while still being collaborative and pragmatic.
* Treats clean handoffs and documentation as part of the job, not admin work.



**What Good Looks Like** 



* Can take control of a live incident quickly and make it obvious what the team is doing and why.
* Keeps technical responders focused, escalates at the right time, and does not let issues drift.
* Hands off incidents cleanly to onshore leadership without losing context or forcing rework.
* Turns repeated failure patterns into better runbooks, monitoring, and support discipline.



**Team Context** 




 You will join PwCs AI Operations \& Platform Support team supporting clients run\-state AI environment. The operating model is centered on Level 2 and Level 3 support, monitoring, incident response, service requests, minor enhancements, and continuous improvement across AWS/Bedrock, OpenAI, and related platform components.
 



 This role will work in a managed\-services model focused on incident management, service requests, monitoring, minor enhancements, knowledge management, and continuous improvement. Success depends not only on technical skill, but also on ownership, collaboration, and the ability to engage stakeholders to progress work.

 The Cyber Defense team is responsible for monitoring Security alerts, investigating potential data loss events, and helping protect sensitive information across the enterprise. This role is part of the operational team that provides insights, tuning recommendations, and policy\-level suggestions to the DLP Committee while Engineering continues to own implementation of platform and policy changes.

**Full\-Time \| Work From Office: 5days Working \| Banjara Hills, Hyderabad** 
 \| Reports to: Pod Manager
 



  





**Company Description** 




  





**Digital Mojo** 
 is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





**We are looking for a Google Ads Expert with 4\-6 years of hands\-on agency experience managing Google Ads campaigns across multiple industries and budget scales.** 
 This is not a role for someone who sets up campaigns and waits for results. Senior Performance Marketer/Google Ads Specialist is expected to own campaign outcomes, drive lead quality, manage budgets strategically, and bring proactive optimization thinking to every account they handle. You will work closely with the Pod Manager and Account Managers and will be the performance authority within the pod.
 



 At this level, you are expected to mentor junior performance marketers, contribute to campaign strategy, and have direct conversations with clients on performance when needed.
 



  





**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not someone who only executes what is briefed without questioning the strategy
* Not someone who reports numbers without explaining what they mean and what to do next
* Not a junior marketer with more years of experience
* Not someone who needs to be told when to optimize



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Campaign Strategy and Execution** 



* Plan, build, and manage Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns end\-to\-end across multiple client accounts
* Run campaigns across Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, Demand Gen, Meta Feed, Reels, and Stories
* Own campaign architecture including structure, targeting, bidding strategy, ad copy, and budget allocation
* Develop campaign strategies aligned with client business goals and not just platform defaults
* Conduct deep keyword research, audience building, competitor analysis, and market sizing before going live
* Recommend campaign types and budget splits based on funnel stage and client objective



**2\. Performance Ownership and Optimization** 



* Own CPL, CTR, ROAS, conversion rate, and lead quality metrics for all assigned accounts
* Proactively identify underperforming elements and optimize without waiting to be asked
* Run structured A/B tests on creatives, audiences, landing pages, and ad formats
* Monitor campaigns daily and make real\-time adjustments to protect budget and performance
* Know when a campaign needs a tweak and when it needs a complete strategic overhaul
* Deliver consistent performance improvement quarter on quarter across accounts



**3\. Budget and Spend Management** 



* Manage monthly ad spends ranging from small accounts to large multi\-lakh budgets
* Allocate budgets across campaigns, platforms, and ad sets based on performance data
* Pace spending efficiently throughout the month without over\-spend or under\-delivery
* Flag budget risks, anomalies, and opportunities to the Pod Manager proactively
* Maintain a clear spend vs performance log for each account at all times



**4\. Reporting and Client Communication** 



* Prepare accurate, insightful, and well\-presented performance reports for each account
* Go beyond numbers in reports. Explain what happened, why it happened, and what comes next
* Present performance updates to clients independently or alongside the Account Manager
* Translate complex campaign data into clear business language that clients understand
* Respond to client performance queries with confidence and data



**5\. Lead Generation and Funnel Strategy** 



* Understand the full lead generation funnel from ad click to qualified lead to conversion
* Work with Account Managers and the Pod Manager on landing page recommendations, form optimization, and funnel improvements
* Track and improve lead quality, not just lead volume
* Coordinate with creative teams on ad creatives that are built to convert, not just look good
* Set up and maintain conversion tracking, pixel integrations, and tag management accurately



**6\. Tools, Tracking, and Tech** 



* Set up and manage Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking across accounts
* Use platform tools including Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Search Ads 360, and third\-party reporting tools
* Identify tracking gaps and fix them before they impact reporting or optimization decisions
* Stay current on platform updates, algorithm changes, and new ad formats and implement them where relevant
* Leverage AI tools for campaign ideation, copy generation, audience research, and performance analysis



**7\. Mentorship and Team Contribution** 



* Guide and review the work of junior performance marketers within the pod
* Share best practices, optimization frameworks, and campaign learnings with the team
* Contribute to agency\-level performance marketing SOPs and processes
* Participate in new business pitches and proposal building when required



  





**Key KPIs** 



* CPL and ROAS across assigned accounts
* Lead Quality Score
* Month\-on\-Month Campaign Performance Improvement
* Budget Utilization Efficiency
* Report Accuracy and Submission Timeliness
* Client Satisfaction on Performance
* Conversion Tracking Accuracy
* Optimization Frequency and Impact



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* 4\-6 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience in a digital marketing agency
* Expert\-level knowledge of Google Ads including Search, Display, Performance Max, and YouTube

title: Product Designer
description:
**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

**The Role** 
  

  

 As a Product Designer, you'll own the design of complex, data‑rich experiences that support decision‑making for administrators and improve clarity and usability across our platform.
   

  

 You'll work as a senior individual contributor within a cross‑functional product team: Design, Product, Engineering, bringing product design expertise to your product area. While Product Management owns roadmap direction and prioritisation, you will play a critical role in informing decisions through research, design exploration, and user‑centred evidence, translating complexity into intuitive, accessible solutions.
   

  

 This role sits within a newly established team focused on analytics, dashboards, and reporting, where you'll elevate usability, interaction design, and data visualisation quality across StarRez products.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Lead complex design initiatives from discovery through delivery, translating multi‑role, data‑heavy workflows into intuitive, scalable, and accessible experiences.
* Conduct and contribute to continuous discovery activities, including customer interviews, usability testing, and concept validation, surfacing insights that inform product decisions and reduce delivery risk.
* Partner with Product to support clear problem framing, hypotheses, and measures of success, using research, experimentation, and customer feedback to validate design decisions and iterate solutions.
* Work iteratively, shipping improvements in stages and refining designs based on real‑world usage, feedback, and observed outcomes.
* Elevate data visualisation quality across dashboards and reporting experiences, ensuring information is clear, meaningful, and usable for diverse audiences.
* Strengthen the broader product experience by contributing to our design system and embedding accessibility best practices (WCAG 2\.2 AA) in collaboration with Engineering.
* Support stakeholder alignment through clear communication of UX decisions, improving usability and consistency through hands‑on critique, shared UI/UX patterns, and informal mentorship.
* Actively leverage AI‑powered tools and workflows within the design practice to accelerate exploration, iteration, and problem‑solving.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience designing complex SaaS or B2B digital products.
* Strong experience designing data‑rich interfaces, including dashboards, reporting tools, or complex operational systems.
* Demonstrated experience contributing to measurable product or business impact through improved usability, efficiency, or user satisfaction.
* Strong systems thinking and experience working across interconnected workflows or multi\-role platforms.
* Proficiency in interaction design, information architecture, and high\-fidelity execution.
* Experience leading discovery efforts and synthesizing insights into actionable product decisions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate design rationale clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ensure high\-quality implementation.
* A strong sense of shared ownership, you care about outcomes, not just deliverables.
* Ability to balance speed with rigor, making thoughtful decisions grounded in research, data, and sound judgment.


  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in scale\-ups or growth\-stage product environments.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards, testing tools, and assistive technologies.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled workflows, automation, or design\-to\-development optimisation practices.


*Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!*
  

  

**Reasons to join our Team:** 
  

  

 StarRez is not just a workplace—it's a place to belong, build, and grow.
   

  

* A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20\+ years—a testament to our people\-first philosophy.
* Global Impact, Local Ownership: Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry\-leading solutions, while building the centre up from ground up.
* Long\-Term Vision: We're not here for short\-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive.
* Innovation with Stability: Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long\-term industry leadership.
* Z\-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z\-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives.


 If you are excited about building game\-changing products in a high\-impact, collaborative environment—StarRez India is the place for you.
   

  

*We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.* 
  

  

  

  

***Notice to external Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies:***
  

  

*StarRez will not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, headhunters, or any other third parties for this role through this website or directly to any employee. StarRez and any of our subsidiaries will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company. In addition, we ask that you do not reach out to any employee with regards to this position, or any other positions, now, or in the future.* 
  

  

 StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Associate, Private Markets and Alternative Operations
description:
**About This Role**
**Team Overview**
 BlackRock’s
 **Outsourced Platform Services (OPS)** 
 provides global middle\- and back\-office support for BlackRock Solutions’ outsourcing business, encompassing trade support, transaction servicing, collateral management, data governance, payments, corporate actions, reconciliations, alternative operations, and investment accounting—delivering operational excellence worldwide.
   

  

**Global Client Alternative Services (GCAS),** 
 a specialized team within Tech \& Ops under OPS, ensures the integrity of cash and position data for middle\-office clients and delivers comprehensive outsourcing solutions for Aladdin clients investing in Alternatives and Private Markets. The team drives global collaboration on strategic initiatives and oversees all aspects of Private and Alternative assets, including client engagement and daily IBOR reconciliation to manage risk and client exposure.
   

  

 This role demands expertise in reconciliation, exception management, and client service, complemented by strong problem\-solving, data analysis, and process improvement skills. Additional responsibilities include maintaining documentation, supporting management initiatives, and driving operational efficiency.
   

  

**Role Responsibility**
* Apply deep expertise in loan and private markets—including project finance, structured credit, real assets, and syndicated loans—to engage effectively with stakeholders, agents, borrowers, counterparties, and high\-profile clients.
* Interpret and analyze complex legal documentation, translating key provisions into actionable insights to ensure operational clarity.
* Facilitate settlement processes across a broad spectrum of instruments, including syndications, secondary trades, CLOs, restructurings, private markets, infrastructure debt, renewable power, real estate debt, and trade claims.
* Collaborate with internal and external teams to maintain the accuracy and integrity of the Investment Book of Record (IBOR).
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of portfolios and deal documentation to uphold control standards and ensure regulatory compliance.
* Lead initiatives focused on process automation and control enhancements to improve efficiency and mitigate operational risk.
* Investigate and resolve cash, position, and transaction discrepancies promptly and accurately.
* Demonstrate proficiency in loan systems as an added advantage.
* Manage multiple projects concurrently in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and adherence to deadlines.
* This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of private markets and operational innovation, contributing to BlackRock’s mission of delivering scalable, risk\-aware solutions for global clients.


**Experience**
 The ideal candidate will have 3–6 years in loan operations or similar expertise in settlements, reconciliations, and documentation\-driven transactions. Strong understanding of private credit, real assets, and project finance.
   

  

**In Addition, We Are Looking For The Following Qualifications**
* Exceptional communication and client service skills, with the ability to foster strong relationships.
* Comprehensive understanding of banking and investment management, including experience in alternatives such as Private Credit, bank loans, credit strategies, registered funds, financial institutions, and a diverse range of investor types.
* Proven ability to perform effectively under pressure in high\-volume, high\-risk environments with minimal margin for error.
* Highly self\-motivated and collaborative, demonstrating a proactive approach to taking on additional responsibilities.
* Strong capability to prioritize and manage multiple requests while maintaining focus on overarching objectives and deadlines.
* Sound decision\-making skills, with the ability to make well\-informed judgments based on available information and seek clarification or assistance when necessary.
* Comfortable working within dynamic teams that embrace varied perspectives and problem\-solving approaches.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and related applications; familiarity with loan\-centric systems is advantageous.
* Solid knowledge of trading instruments and settlement processes.
* Excellent analytical and organizational skills, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in execution.
* Demonstrates initiative and a commitment to contributing beyond defined responsibilities to support team and firm\-wide goals.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
