**Job Description**
 At EY, you’ll have the opportunity to build a career as unique as you are—supported by our global scale, inclusive culture, and advanced technology. We value diverse perspectives and empower our people to deliver meaningful impact for our clients while shaping a better working world.
   

  

**EY – Technology Assurance Senior Consultant (Japanese Speaker)**
 Technology Assurance provides independent assurance and risk advisory services focused on evaluating information technology, systems, processes, and controls that support business operations and financial reporting. Our services help organizations build trust, manage risk, and meet regulatory and contractual expectations. Engagements span assurance and risk advisory work and vary in scope and complexity.
   

  

 As a Japanese speaking Technology Senior Consultant, you will play a critical role in delivering end to end Technology Assurance engagements, interacting directly with Japanese clients, leading key workstreams, and collaborating with different engagement teams. You will apply strong technical expertise, professional judgment, and cultural awareness to deliver high quality outcomes.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY’s Technology Assurance services aim to strengthen governance, enhance internal controls, and improve IT and business performance. The work includes financial audit IT support, SOC/SSAE engagements, IT governance and risk management, ERP and system controls, cybersecurity, and data and analytics.
   

  

 As a Senior Consultant (Japanese Speaker), you will assume increased responsibility for planning, execution, and review, while serving as a trusted point of contact for clients and engagement leadership.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Execute Technology Assurance and IT risk engagements, working closely with Assistant Managers, and Managers.
* Own assigned engagement workstreams, including planning, execution, documentation, and issue resolution.
* Serve as a key contact for Japanese clients and stakeholders, facilitating discussions and meetings in Japanese and English.
* Review audit working papers, risk assessments, and deliverables prepared by Associates
* Apply EY methodologies related to IT controls, risk assessment, control testing, remediation, and reporting.
* Identify control gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities, and clearly articulate recommendations to clients.
* Provide coaching and performance feedback to junior team members.
* Support engagement management activities such as timelines, deliverable tracking, and quality assurance.
* Collaborate effectively with offshore and onshore EY teams across regions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of Japanese business practices and cultural norms to enhance client relationships.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Fluent in Japanese (reading, writing, speaking, and comprehension); JLPT N2/ N1 certification is required.
* With appreciation of IT controls, IT audit concepts, and assurance methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead tasks independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and critical thinking skills.
* Effective stakeholder communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work with team members and contribute to a collaborative team environment.
* Proactive, detail oriented, and quality focused mindset.


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Information Technology/ Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Typically with relevant experience in Technology Assurance, IT Audit, IT Risk, or related consulting roles.
* Prior experience as IT Auditor, Technology Risk Consultant, IT Compliance Analyst, Information Security Consultant, Financial Auditor or in similar roles.
* Willingness to work onsite, as required.
* Flexibility to work extended hours during peak periods or critical engagement phases.


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment.
* Opportunities to work with EY technology risk practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Full stack AI Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job Location: Anywhere India. Remote. Mumbai/Ahmedabad preferred Type: Full\-time Experience: 2\+ years (recent graduates with strong internship/project experience welcome) Build What Comes After Generative AI The first wave of AI learned to generate. The next will learn to perceive, reason, coordinate, and act in the physical world. We are building an intelligence platform at the intersection of frontier AI, autonomous systems, robotics, edge computing, sensing, and real\-world operations. Our ambition is to create a new category: Mission Superintelligence—technology that helps humans and intelligent machines understand complex environments, make better decisions, and coordinate action across the physical world. About the Role We're looking for a Full Stack AI Engineer to help us build and scale our web application. You'll own new feature development end\-to\-end — from database and API design through to polished, responsive UI — while keeping our existing product stable, fast, and maintainable. This is a hands\-on role for someone who is comfortable across the whole stack and genuinely excited about building with modern AI tooling. You'll work directly with LLMs, use AI\-assisted development workflows day to day, and ship features that put AI to work for our users. What You'll Do Design, build, and ship new features for our web app across the full stack (frontend, backend, database). Maintain, debug, and improve the existing application — fixing issues, improving performance, and paying down technical debt. Build and integrate LLM\-powered features into the product. Design clean REST/JSON APIs and efficient PostgreSQL schemas and queries. Own deployments and keep environments healthy (Railway, Docker). Write readable, tested, well\-documented code and participate in code reviews. Collaborate closely with product and design to turn ideas into working features quickly. Use AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) to move faster without sacrificing quality. Required Skills \& Experience 2\+ years of professional full stack development experience, or a strong portfolio of projects/internships for recent graduates. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. Frontend: Strong proficiency with React.js and Next.js, including modern hooks, component architecture, and responsive UI. Backend: Solid Python experience building backend services and APIs (e.g., FastAPI, Django, or Flask). Database: Hands\-on experience with PostgreSQL — schema design, writing and optimizing queries, migrations. Deployment: Experience deploying and managing apps on Railway (or similar PaaS) and containerizing services with Docker. AI/LLM: Practical experience working with LLMs and AI models — calling model APIs, prompt engineering, and integrating AI into real features. Comfort using AI\-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code in your day\-to\-day workflow. Strong fundamentals: Git/version control, debugging, writing clean and maintainable code. Good communication skills and the ability to work independently and own features end\-to\-end. Nice to Have Experience with TypeScript. Familiarity with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone), or agent frameworks. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing. Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience with authentication/authorization, API security, and rate limiting. Familiarity with observability/monitoring tools (logging, error tracking, performance monitoring). An eye for UI/UX and design systems (e.g., Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui). What We Offer Competitive Salary Equity/bonus based on performance after the first year. Health, PTO, and other benefits The chance to build real AI products and grow quickly in a small, high\-ownership team. This Is Your Role If You do not want your best work to be another incremental feature. You want to build at the boundary between intelligence and action. You want to help answer how AI will interact with machines, infrastructure, and the physical world. You want to look back years from now and know that you helped create a category before the rest of the market knew it existed. How to Apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Tell us: What is the hardest product you have helped build? What did you personally own? What did you initially misunderstand? What evidence changed your product direction? Why do you believe the next era of AI will move into the physical world? Why should you be one of the people who helps build it?

 Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd. (MOFSL) is a diversified financial services firm offering solutions across Private Wealth, Retail and Institutional Broking, Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Commodities, Currencies, and Home Finance. title: Structure Designer- BIM
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 ROLE
   

  

 BIM Structural Modeler, as a part of multi\-disciplinary projects teams, is responsible to provide drafting support to technically challenging projects. Technician would create 2D drawings and 3D models and shall be responsible for the technical quality of his own work and would focus on compliance with project objectives and quality standards.
   

  

**Experience**
 Experience in preparing minimum LOD 300 REVIT Documentation (3D and 2D), general arrangement drawings, Composite steel drawings, Structural Steel Drawings, Reinforcement Drawings, and Reinforcement Detailing. Experience in Precast will be an advantage must have experience on international projects self\-motivated, team player and able to work independently with minimum supervision. Experience in BIM management as an additional skill will be preferred.
   

  

 Here's what you'll need
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work on detailed drawings for a range of projects to create 2D drawing and 3D models and support, mentor and train other members of the drafting team in accomplishing complex tasks.
* Need to coordinate with project managers and/or engineers for BIM documentation and drafting work in a given project.
* Responsible for technical correctness, project standard compliance and timely delivery of the drawings and documents.
* Exercises self\-discipline and work ethics
* Respect and follow company policies and procedures
* Liaise with Architecture, MEP and other disciplines
* Familiar with Programs REVIT Archi and REVIT MEP for coordination of models, Navisworks for checking of models
* Has in depth knowledge of building structural elements.
* BIM Knowledge as per best\-industry practice, hands\-on experience in 3D modelling and scheduling, multi\-D coordination and documentation, BIM setup for a project and execution and monitoring.


 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

 **SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) Techno\-Functional Consultant**

 **Finance Master Data and Business Partner Governance** 
 . The ideal candidate should possess a solid understanding of SAP MDG functional processes along with hands\-on technical development and integration experience.
   

  

 The consultant will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting SAP MDG solutions, with a focus on
 **Finance Master Data, Business Partner governance, OData services, BRF/BRF\+, DRF, SOA\-based replication, S/4HANA integration, and Central Finance (CFIN) integration** 
 .

+ Customer/Vendor and Business Partner master data
+ G/L Account
+ Cost Center
+ Profit Center
+ Other relevant Finance master data objects

* Configure and support Business Partner Governance processes, including customer and supplier integration.
* Design MDG governance processes covering:
+ Change Request types
+ Workflow and approvals
+ Validations and derivations
+ Data replication
+ Data quality and enrichment

* Work closely with Finance, Procurement, Sales, and other business stakeholders to understand master\-data requirements.
* Translate business requirements into scalable MDG functional and technical solutions.

* Strong hands\-on experience in SAP MDG development and enhancement.

+ Data models
+ UI configurations
+ Change Request processes
+ Validations and derivations
+ Workflow

* Hands\-on experience in BRF/BRF\+ for implementing business rules, validations, derivations, and decision logic.
* Hands\-on experience in designing, consuming, enhancing, and troubleshooting OData services for MDG applications and integrations.
* Strong understanding of SAP MDG framework, APIs, BADIs, enhancement points, and custom developments.
* Develop and troubleshoot integrations using SOA services and web services.


 Data Replication \& Integration
   

  

* Strong experience with Data Replication Framework (DRF) and replication models.
* Configure and troubleshoot SOA\-based master data replication.
* Experience integrating SAP MDG with SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience with Business Partner, Customer, Supplier, and Finance master data integration between MDG and S/4HANA.
* Hands\-on experience with Central Finance (CFIN) integration, particularly master data integration/governance scenarios.
* Analyze and resolve integration, replication, mapping, and data synchronization issues.
* Work with middleware/integration teams to design and troubleshoot end\-to\-end interfaces.


**Required Technical Skills**
* SAP MDG – strong hands\-on experience
* SAP MDG Finance Master Data
* SAP MDG Business Partner Governance
* OData Services – development and consumption
* BRF/BRF\+
* DRF – Data Replication Framework
* SOA/Web Services
* SAP S/4HANA integration
* SAP Central Finance (CFIN) integration
* SAP Business Partner / Customer / Supplier integration
* SAP Workflow and Change Request Management
* ABAP development/debugging and MDG enhancements
* SAP MDG data models, UI configuration, validations and derivations
* Integration troubleshooting and error handling


 Functional Skills
   

  

* Strong understanding of Finance master data processes.
* Good understanding of SAP Finance and S/4HANA master data concepts.
* Strong understanding of Business Partner master data and governance.
* Ability to conduct requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Ability to work across functional and technical teams and communicate effectively with business stakeholders.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA implementation or transformation programs.
* Experience with Central Finance (CFIN) projects.
* Experience with SAP MDG upgrades, migrations, or rollouts.
* Knowledge of SAP Fiori/UI5 and REST\-based integrations.
* Experience with SAP integration technologies and middleware.
* Strong debugging and root\-cause analysis skills.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 6\+ years of SAP experience, with significant hands\-on experience in SAP MDG.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
**Summary**
 The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high\-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long\-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the company’s position as a leader in the solar industry.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
* Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision\-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
* Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
* Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
* Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision\-making.
* Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data\-driven planning.
* Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.


 Requirements
   

  

**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* Proven experience (5\+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
* In\-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi\-stakeholder decision\-making and long\-term contracts.
* Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
* Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
* Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* Competitive base salary: ${salary}
* Performance\-based commission and bonus structure
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
* Company\-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

title: Security Control Assessment Specialist
description:
**Department:** 
 Engineering
   

  

**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad/GiftCity
   

  

**Description**
 We are seeking an experienced Security Control Assessment Specialist to independently test the design and operating effectiveness of Trading Technologies’ enterprise cybersecurity controls. This role plans and executes control assessments end to end, documents findings with clear supporting evidence, and partners with control owners and the TT Security team to design practical remediations. The role also contributes to the continuous improvement of the control environment itself, strengthening how controls are defined, evidenced and monitored, and automating control testing where possible.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Plan and execute independent tests of enterprise cybersecurity controls across TT’s technology estate, with a high degree of autonomy over scoping, methodology, sampling and scheduling.
* Assess both the design and the operating effectiveness of controls, combining evidence review and control owner walkthroughs with hands\-on technical validation of configurations, logs, identity and access data, and cloud environments.
* Document findings clearly and defensibly, setting out the condition, criteria, cause, risk and impact, and rating them consistently against TT’s risk criteria.
* Partner with control owners and TT Security to design workable remediations, then validate closure through retesting rather than accepting assertion alone.
* Track findings and remediation plans through to closure, escalating overdue or inadequately addressed items where necessary.
* Build and maintain automated and continuous control monitoring so that control health is visible between formal assessment cycles.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the control framework itself, refining control definitions, testing procedures, evidence requirements and the annual assessment plan.
* Map the control environment to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks, identifying gaps, duplication and opportunities to test once and satisfy multiple obligations.
* Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and control owners, setting expectations, communicating requirements clearly, and holding a firm, evidence\-based position when findings are challenged.
* Support external audits and customer assessments by providing tested, reliable control evidence.


**Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**
 Essential Skills \& Experience
   

  

* 8 to 10 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years focused on information security.
* Professional certification required: CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC or equivalent.
* Demonstrable experience designing and executing security control tests and producing findings and workpapers that withstand audit scrutiny.
* Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity controls and frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST SP 800\-53\.
* Technical depth across identity and access management, cloud infrastructure (AWS certification is a plus), endpoint and network security, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management and secure development practices.
* Experience automating control testing or building continuous control monitoring, using scripting, queries, APIs or GRC platform automation.
* Familiarity with GRC platforms such as OneTrust, Vanta, Drata, ServiceNow IRM or similar.
* Exceptional spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical requirements and findings clearly to both engineers and senior stakeholders.
* Confidence and diplomacy to challenge control owners constructively and to hold a position under pressure when the evidence supports it.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage a portfolio of concurrent assessments and deliver to deadline with minimal supervision.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.


 Desirable Skills \& Experience
   

  

* Experience in financial services, capital markets or another regulated industry is highly regarded.


**Benefits**

This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.

title: AI & Plant Operations Data Analyst
description:
About Rohan Chemicals
 
**Rohan Chemicals** 
 , built on the legacy of 
 **Rohan Dyes \& Intermediates Limited** 
 , is an Indian chemical manufacturing and export company with a legacy of more than three decades. The company manufactures and markets a diversified portfolio of 
 **sulphur\-based chemicals, specialty chemicals, dyes and dye intermediates** 
  for domestic and international markets.
 



 Our product portfolio includes 
 **Sulphuric Acid, Oleum, Chlorosulphonic Acid, Liquid Sulphur Dioxide (SO₂), Liquid Sulphur Trioxide (SO₃), Dimethyl Sulphate (DMS), dye intermediates and specialty dyestuffs** 
 , serving industries including agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, textiles, leather, paper and specialty chemicals.
 



 As we continue to expand our manufacturing capabilities, we are now focusing on building a 
 **data\-driven operating system for our manufacturing plants** 
 .
 



 We are looking for an ambitious individual who can help us use 
 **data, artificial intelligence and automation to improve plant productivity, reduce operating costs and make faster, better management decisions.** 



 About the Role
 
**Location:** 

  Corporate Office, Satellite, Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 




**Employment Type:** 

  Full\-time \| On\-site
 




**Department:** 

  Operations / Digital Transformation
 




**Reporting To:** 

  Senior Management / Plant Head
 



 We are looking for an 
 **AI \& Plant Operations Data Analyst** 
  who can convert the large amount of operational information generated every day in our plants into 
 **structured data, actionable intelligence and management decisions** 
 .
 
 A significant amount of plant information currently comes through 
 **WhatsApp messages, shift reports, production sheets, maintenance reports, laboratory reports, utility records and other Excel/data sheets** 
 .
 



 The core objective of this role is to bring all of this information together and answer:
 



**What happened?** 




**Why did it happen?** 




**What is the financial/operational impact?** 




**What action is required?** 




**Who is responsible?** 




**Has the action been completed?** 




**This is not a conventional MIS or data\-entry position** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can use 
 **AI, data analytics and technology to identify inefficiencies and improve the actual performance of a chemical manufacturing plant.** 



 Key Responsibilities1\. Convert WhatsApp \& Plant Reports into Intelligence
 * Identify and consolidate operational information currently communicated through WhatsApp and other informal channels.
* Convert unstructured messages into structured operational data.
* Categorize information relating to production, maintenance, utilities, quality, breakdowns, manpower, energy and environmental performance.
* Use AI/NLP tools to extract important information automatically.
* Develop daily and weekly 
 **Plant Intelligence Reports** 
 .
* Identify recurring problems, abnormal events and operational trends.



 The objective is to move from 
 **"collecting reports" to "generating intelligence."** 



 2\. Improve Plant Energy Efficiency
 
 Analyze plant data to identify opportunities to reduce:
 


* Electricity consumption
* Steam consumption
* Fuel consumption
* Energy consumption per MT of production
* Compressed air and utility losses
* Equipment running losses
* Abnormal energy consumption



 The candidate should be able to identify questions such as:
 



**Why has energy consumption per MT increased?** 




**Which equipment or process is responsible?** 




**Where are we losing energy?** 




**What corrective action can reduce the cost?** 



 3\. Improve Manufacturing Efficiency
 
 Analyze production data to identify:
 


* Production efficiency
* Batch\-wise performance
* Production delays
* Downtime
* Process deviations
* Recurring operational problems
* Production losses
* Raw\-material consumption
* Yield variations



 The candidate will work closely with 
 **Production, Maintenance, Utilities, ETP and Plant Management teams** 
 .
 


 4\. Maintenance \& Breakdown Intelligence
 
 Create a structured system to track:
 


* Equipment breakdowns
* Downtime
* Maintenance requests
* Preventive maintenance
* Corrective actions
* Root\-cause analysis
* Spare\-parts requirements
* Repeated equipment failures
* Pending maintenance activities



 The system should clearly show:
 



**Issue → Responsible Person → Target Date → Action → Status → Closure** 




**Management should be able to immediately identify overdue and recurring problems** 
 .
 


 5\. Pollution \& Environmental Data
 
 Analyze operational and environmental data to identify opportunities to reduce:
 


* Pollution load
* SO₂/SO₃\-related emissions
* Acid mist
* Effluent load
* Waste generation
* Chemical losses
* Abnormal operating conditions



 The objective is to use data to identify 
 **the operating conditions that contribute to higher pollution and develop preventive actions.** 



 6\. Manpower \& Labour Productivity
 
 Analyze manpower deployment against production and plant requirements.
 



 Identify:
 


* Idle manpower
* Overtime
* Shift\-wise manpower utilization
* Repetitive manual activities
* Opportunities for automation
* Labour productivity
* Manpower requirements by activity/process



 The objective is to improve 
 **manpower utilization and operational productivity** 
 .
 


 Build a Digital Plant Monitoring Application
 
 A major part of this role will be to help develop a 
 **web\-based application for plant operations and issue management** 
 .
 



 The application should eventually allow plant personnel to enter and monitor:
 


* Daily production
* Shift production
* Raw\-material consumption
* Energy consumption
* Utility consumption
* Quality parameters
* Breakdown information
* Maintenance activities
* ETP/environmental parameters
* Manpower deployment
* Corrective actions



 The candidate may build the application directly using appropriate technologies and AI\-assisted development tools, or work with external developers to implement the system.
 


 Management Dashboard \& AI Reporting
 
 The ultimate objective is to create a management dashboard that can answer, at any time:
 


 Plant Performance
 * What was produced?
* What was the target?
* What was the variance?


 Energy
 * Energy consumption/MT?
* Is it improving or deteriorating?
* Where is the abnormal consumption?


 Maintenance
 * What broke down?
* How much production was lost?
* Which problems are recurring?
* What actions are overdue?


 Environment
 * Are pollution parameters within expected levels?
* What operational factors are affecting them?


 Management Actions
 * What are today's critical issues?
* Who is responsible?
* What is overdue?
* What requires management intervention?


 Skills \& Qualifications
 
 Candidates with experience or knowledge in some or all of the following will be preferred:
 


* Advanced Excel
* SQL
* Power BI / Tableau
* Data cleaning and analysis
* Dashboard development
* Python
* Artificial Intelligence / Generative AI
* AI agents and automation
* APIs and database integration
* Web application development
* Process automation
* Data visualization
* Business intelligence



 Experience in 
 **chemical manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, process industries, manufacturing or industrial operations** 
  will be an advantage.
 



 However, we are equally interested in candidates who may not have extensive manufacturing experience but demonstrate 
 **exceptional analytical ability, technology skills and the ability to understand real\-world business problems.** 



 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are 
 **not looking for someone who simply prepares reports and dashboards** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can look at plant data and ask:
 


**Where are we losing money?** 
**Why is this happening?** 
**Can we predict it before it happens again?** 
**Can AI automate the monitoring and follow\-up?** 
**What action should management take?** 

 The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work directly with 
 **plant operations and senior management** 
  and build systems that have a measurable impact on the company's manufacturing operations.
 


 Success in this role will be measured by real business outcomes:
 * Lower energy cost per MT
* Lower production downtime
* Reduction in recurring breakdowns
* Better manpower utilization
* Reduction in pollution load
* Faster closure of plant issues
* Improved production efficiency
* Automation of manual reporting
* Better visibility and control for management



**If you are excited by the opportunity to combine AI, data and technology with real\-world chemical manufacturing, we would like to hear from you.** 




**Apply with your CV and a brief note explaining one manufacturing or business problem you would like to solve using data and AI.** 




**Rohan Chemicals** 




**Built on the legacy of Rohan Dyes \& Intermediates Limited** 




**Ahmedabad, Gujarat** 
 www.rohanchemicals.com

 This role is responsible for conducting quality testing activities on pharmaceutical products in compliance with established standards and regulatory requirements within a global pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The incumbent interprets and evaluates testing results in terms of accuracy and precision against predetermined specifications to ensure product integrity and regulatory compliance. The position identifies ongoing quality issues and takes proactive measures to prevent potential production problems, contributing to continuous quality improvement. The role audits and monitors testing processes and outputs against both internal and regulatory standards to uphold compliance. It tests random samples of finished goods to verify conformance with quality specifications and regulatory expectations. The position reports testing process deviations and defects in finished goods to the appropriate quality and production stakeholders. It supports the organization's commitment to delivering safe, effective, and compliant pharmaceutical products through rigorous quality testing.

* Audit and monitor testing processes and outputs against defined internal and regulatory quality standards.

* Report testing process deviations and defects in finished goods to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.

**TVAöD Pflege \- Lehrjahr 1 bis 2**
**Arbeiten an der Charité**
 Sie sind kommunikativ, haben hohes Empathievermögen, arbeiten gerne im Team und suchen einen abwechslungsreichen Beruf mit Zukunftsperspektive? Die Ausbildung zur Pflegefachassistenz (d/w/m) bietet Ihnen genau das und mehr. Mit dem staatlich anerkannten Abschluss Pflegefachassistentin oder Pflegefachassistent pflegen und unterstützen Sie eigenverantwortlich Menschen aller Altersstufen in stabilen Pflegesituationen.
   

  

 Sie entscheiden sich für einen Beruf mit einer hohen zwischenmenschlichen Interaktion, unterschiedlichen Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten und einer stabilen Jobgarantie. In den Pflegeeinrichtungen der Akut\-, Langzeit\- und ambulanten Patientenversorgung, erwerben Sie unter anderem die Fachkompetenz im Umgang mit der Körperpflege, Nahrungsaufnahme, Mobilisation oder die Anwendung verschiedener prophylaktischer Maßnahmen.
   

  

**Die Ausbildung im Überblick**
 Pflege ist ein eigenständiger, vielseitiger und verantwortungsvoller Beruf – immer nah am Menschen. In der Ausbildung zur Pflegefachassistenz (d/w/m) werden Ihnen fachliche und personale Kompetenzen vermittelt. Eine individuelle, bedürfnisorientierte, geschlechter\- und kultursensible Pflege steht dabei stets im Fokus. Unter Anwendung der ausgewählten modernen und innovativen Lernmethoden erwerben zusätzlich die Handlungsfähigkeit sowohl in Gefahrensituationen als auch in pflegerischen Notfallsituationen. Die Ausbildung dauert 18 Monate und erfolgt im dualen Blocksystem.
   

  

**Die Ausbildungsinhalte Verteilen Sich Auf Folgende Themenbereiche**
* Sie sichern die Durchführung der körperbezogenen Pflegemaßnahmen in stabilen Pflegesituationen
* Sie führen die Dokumentation im Pflegeprozess
* Sie wirken bei der Informationssammlung und Dokumentation der durchgeführten Maßnahmen mit
* Sie unterstützen pflegebedürftige Menschen bei der Lebensgestaltung unter Beachtung der jeweiligen Lebensgeschichte, Kultur und Religion
* Sie beobachten die Patientinnen und Patienten und erlernen durch diese gezielte Beobachtung und bewusste Wahrnehmung der Veränderung der Pflegesituation angemessen zu reagieren; auch in Notfallsituationen
* Sie arbeiten mit anderen Berufsgruppen unter Reflexion der Situation und der eigenen Rolle zusammen


**Danach suchen wir**
* Sie haben einen Berufsbildungsreife (BBR) eine gleichwertige Schulbildung oder abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung
* Sie sind mindestens 16,5 Jahre alt zum Ausbildungsbeginn
* Bei nichtdeutscher Muttersprache: Nachweis über das Sprachniveau (B2\)
* Ein mindestens 2 wöchiges Praktikum in der Pflege
* Sie verfügen über die gesundheitliche und persönliche Eignung
* Sie haben Interesse an medizinischen Zusammenhängen und Freude am Umgang mit Menschen
* Sie sind zuverlässig, arbeiten gerne im Team und besitzen Organisationsgeschick
* Sie bringen Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Engagement und Einsatzbereitschaft mit
* Sie sind vertrauenswürdig und diskret z.B. Schweigepflicht einhalten beim Umgang mit Daten von Patientinnen und Patienten


**Vorteile an der Charité**
* Sie werden von kompetenten Praxisanleiterinnen und Praxisanleitern sowie der Personalentwicklung umfassend begleitet und betreut
* Sie lernen in einem vielseitigen Tätigkeitsfeld an einer der größten Universitätskliniken Europas
* Es erwarten Sie vielfältige Angebote, die den Zusammenhalt unter den Auszubildenden fördern, wie ein Willkommenstag, Peer\-Group\-Betreuung oder regelmäßige Azubi\-Treffen
* Mit der Ausbildung sichern Sie sich hervorragende Berufsperspektiven in einer Zukunftsbranche


**Wichtige Informationen zur Ausbildung**
* Sie erhalten auf der Grundlage des Tarifvertrags für Auszubildende ein faires Ausbildungsentgelt (brutto):
+ 1\. Ausbildungsjahr: 1\.490,69 EUR
+ 2\. Ausbildungsjahr (ab dem 13\. Monat): 1\.552,07 EUR

* Mit der Ausbildung sichern Sie sich hervorragende Berufsperspektiven in einer Zukunftsbranche
* Der Ausbildungsvertrag beinhaltet 31 Tage Urlaub, eine Jahressonderzahlung im November, zusätzliche Betriebsrente im öffentlichen Dienst (VBL), Vermögenswirksame Leistungen (VWL)
* Sie bekommen eine Abschlussprämie bei erfolgreich abgeschlossener Abschlussprüfung in Höhe von 400 Euro und ggf. Heimfahrttickets
* Sie haben sehr gute Chancen auf Übernahme bei bestandener Abschlussprüfung und erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit während der Ausbildung
* Eine Bewerbung ist ganzjährig möglich
* Kennziffer: ID 8171


 Bewerbung
   

  

 An der Charité sind alle willkommen, unabhängig von Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, geschlechtlicher Identität, sexueller Orientierung, Nationalität, Behinderung, ethnischer oder sozialer Herkunft. Hier zählt jeder Mensch! Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit und Inklusion ein.
   

  

 Aus Datenschutzgründen nehmen wir Bewerbungen ausschließlich über unser Bewerbungsportal entgegen. Der unten angegebene Kontakt steht ausschließlich für Rückfragen zur Verfügung.
   

  

 Jetzt bewerben
   

  

**Bei Fragen Wenden Sie Sich An**
 ausbildung@charite.de
   

  

 Weitere Informationen
   

  

 Datenschutzhinweise
   

  

 Die Charité weist darauf hin, dass im Rahmen und zu Zwecken des Bewerbungsverfahrens an verschiedenen Stellen in der Charité (z.B. Fachbereich, Personalvertretung, Personalabteilung) personenbezogene Daten gespeichert und verarbeitet werden. Weiterhin können die Daten innerhalb des Konzerns sowie an Stellen außerhalb (z.B. Behörden) zur Wahrung berechtigter Interessen übermittelt bzw. verarbeitet werden. Mit Ihrer Bewerbung stimmen Sie unseren Datenschutz\- und Nutzungsbestimmungen für Bewerbungsverfahren, die Sie hier finden, zu.
   

  

 Zusatzinformationen
   

  

 Die Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin trifft ihre Personalentscheidungen nach Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung. Die Charité strebt eine Erhöhung des Anteils von Frauen in Führungspositionen an und fordert Frauen daher nachdrücklich auf, sich zu bewerben. Bei gleichwertiger Qualifikation werden Frauen im Rahmen der rechtlichen Möglichkeiten vorrangig berücksichtigt. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Migrationshintergrund, die die Einstellungsvoraussetzungen erfüllen, sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Schwerbehinderte Bewerber:innen werden bei gleicher Qualifikation bevorzugt. Bei der Einstellung wird ein polizeiliches Führungszeugnis, teilweise ein erweitertes Führungszeugnis verlangt. Die Bewerbungsunterlagen können leider nur dann zurückgeschickt werden, wenn ein ausreichend frankierter Rückumschlag beigefügt ist. Eventuell anfallende Reisekosten können nicht erstattet werden.

**Company Description**

The organization provides structured training, mentorship, incubation, and global market access programs to help local businesses become globally competitive brands. The role involves building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, gathering feedback on programs, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure a smooth onboarding experience. The Sales Executive will also track sales performance, prepare reports, participate in events and outreach activities, and contribute ideas to strengthen EPIC Kerala’s export ecosystem initiatives.

title: Sr. Software Engineer (UI Developer)
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 We are seeking a skilled Sr. Software Engineer to drive the high\-quality component delivery of the Ethos Design System (EDS).
   

  

 The UI Developer for EDS is a craftsman of the modern web platform. You are not building simple web pages; you are building the "Lego blocks" that the rest of the enterprise builds upon. You will specialize in Lit (Web Components) to create agnostic, future\-proof UI elements that function seamlessly in React, Angular, and Vue environments. Your code must be bulletproof, accessible, and performant, serving as the gold standard for thousands of developers across GE HealthCare.
   

  

 GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About EDS**
 EDS is the unified digital platform that powers GE HealthCare’s global software portfolio. It serves as a comprehensive library of reusable UI components, design patterns, and accessibility standards that bridge the critical gap between User Experience (UX) and Engineering. By fostering a philosophy of "reduce, reuse, and recycle," EDS enables hundreds of product teams to eliminate redundant coding and design work. We provide the foundational building blocks that ensure our clinical and operational applications are intuitive, consistent, and accessible, allowing teams to focus on patient safety.
   

  

**The Mission: Scale and Empowerment**
 We are in a phase of hyper\-growth, scaling from 15 adopting products to over 100\. This requires a leader who thinks like a founder. You must look beyond simple backlog management to think about scale, growth, and empowerment. You will build a self\-service ecosystem that allows teams to move fast without breaking the consistent standards required for patient safety and accessibility.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Component Engineering \& API Design
* Web Component Development: Develop robust, encapsulated UI components using the Lit library. You will write clean, semantic HTML and scoped CSS (SASS).
* Component API Architecture: You are responsible for writing clean, intuitive Component APIs. You define the Inputs (Props), Outputs (Events), and Slots that allow thousands of other developers to consume your code easily.
* Cross\-Framework Integration: You are responsible for the "Wrapper Layer." You will test and optimize your components to ensure they integrate seamlessly into React, Angular, and Vue applications.
* Design Fidelity \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Cross\-Functional Team: Work daily within a cross\-functional team comprising Architects, Product owners, LSD (Lead System Designers), DevOps, and QA. You ensure your components align with the broader architecture and CI/CD standards.
* Figma Proficiency: You will leverage Figma’s Dev Mode to inspect layers, extract properties, and ensure implementation matches the exact specifications of the design team.
* Accessibility Governance: You are a champion of inclusive design. You ensure every component complies with WCAG 2\.1 AA standards, including keyboard navigation, screen reader support (ARIA), and color contrast.
* Agile Execution \& Documentation
* Agile Rigor: Participate actively in Agile ceremonies. You are responsible for managing your work items in Rally, ensuring accurate status updates and story point estimation.
* Testing Rigor: You are responsible for writing comprehensive Unit Test Cases (using tools like ViTest or Jest).
* Technical Documentation: You treat documentation as part of the code. You contribute to Storybook, writing clear usage examples and technical integration guides.


**Core Competencies \& Soft Skills**
* Communicating Trade\-offs \& Alignment: Clearly explains technical options, trade\-offs, and risks for the features and components they own. Collaborates closely with peer engineers, UX, and product to align on approach and get to a shared decision.
* Technical Ownership: Acts as the go\-to owner for the design and implementation of the components/features they build within the UI and Design System platform. Takes full accountability for their work from design through delivery and maintenance and contributes actively to broader architectural discussions.
* Applied AI for Development: Uses AI\-assisted engineering for refactoring, testing, migrations, documentation, debugging, and code review as part of daily workflow. Understands model selection and context/token management and follows team\-level AI development practices (validation, security, human\-review controls) to consistently improve their own productivity.
* Evidence\-Based Direction: Raises concerns and proposes improvements to existing approaches when justified, backing suggestions with data or concrete examples rather than opinion alone.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* Experience: 5–8 years of experience in front\-end development.
+ Mandatory: Proven experience building Enterprise Software applications.

* UX Collaboration: Mandatory: 3\+ years of experience working closely with UX Designers. You must demonstrate proficiency using Figma's Dev Mode.
* Technical Stack:
+ Mandatory: Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+) and TypeScript.
+ Mandatory: Deep understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and SASS architecture.
+ Mandatory: Proficiency using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Codex, GH Copilot, Claude) as part of your daily coding workflow, from writing and reviewing code to debugging and documentation.
+ Preferred: Hands\-on experience with Lit or native Web Components.

* Agile \& Process:
+ Mandatory: Proficiency working in Agile environments and using Rally.
+ Experience writing Unit Tests (Jest, ViTest) and documentation (Storybook).


**Inclusion And Diversity**
 GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. title: Marketing Technologist, Web
description:
**About The Team**
 We are looking for an experienced Marketing Web Technologist to help build highly coordinated and efficient web integrations and infrastructure that powers Zillow's marketing organization. We serve as the technical liaison between marketing, product, engineering, and marketing vendor teams to bring all partners together toward a common goal. As part of the WebTech team, you will be responsible for building highly coordinated and efficient web integrations, infrastructure, and web platforms while playing a key role in the operations of the WebTech space; building new web components, managing configurations, integrations, and workflows to help with marketing needs. Participate in the onboarding and building of new platforms from implementation, integration, execution, data and security compliance review, and training user teams.
   

  

 This role leans heavily into hands\-on\-keyboard work, but also requires technical program management to work collaboratively across teams to deliver automation capabilities that empower our customers. The ideal candidate shines in a fast\-paced and ambiguous environment, and has a balance of technical web skills and program management. If you like solving complex problems and are passionate about enabling marketing teams and delivering the vision of Zillow 2\.0, we want to hear from you!
   

  

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Drive the marketing web technology roadmap by participating in onboarding of new web platforms including requirements definition, implementation, integration, execution, testing and validation, data and security compliance review, and training of end user teams.
* Be involved in shaping MarTech web system design and help guide technical architecture discussions and decisions to establish a flexible, scalable, and secure tech stack.
* Understand web business requirements and identify data needs to enable marketing to deliver a personalized customer experience.
* Collaborate with teams across marketing, product, and engineering to develop detailed technical web project plans and align on roadmaps.
* Coordinate with other dev dependencies to align cross\-tech team sprint schedules \& release plans.
* You will assess risks, anticipate bottlenecks, provide critical issue management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, while balancing the business needs versus technical constraints.
* Beyond being successful, you’ll thrive if you relish crafting clarity from ambiguity (at a company level) and you take pride in driving complex cross\-team web programs while aligning to company and engineering strategy.
* Define and prioritize strategic web projects and shepherd them from concept to launch.
* Own and drive large and sophisticated web programs, while creating transparency through project plans that are focused on value realization, while collaborating with engineers to align teams and manage dependencies.
* Maintain and report on program status and seek to optimize timely delivery.
* Update leadership and the business on progress, issues, risk, and course correction plans.
* Drive AI adoption across Marketing Technology by identifying high\-impact use cases, implementing AI\-powered workflows, and using automation to improve team efficiency and free up time for higher\-value strategic work.


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* Have the ability to work with other engineering team’s code and systems to deliver new features that have impact across the company.
* You love driving cross\-functional, technical and sophisticated web programs to achieve business outcomes.
* An ability to take large, complex features, and break them down in deliverables that focus on value\-realization for the end user/customer.
* Improve management decision\-making by delivering data\-driven recommendations that are aligned with organizational strategy and quarterly goals.
* You are passionate about championing great work and advocate effectively on behalf of what’s best for the customer/user.
* Outstanding oral and written communication skills, as well as the ability to think clearly, analyze quantitatively, problem\-solve, scope technical requirements, and prioritize tasks.
* Highly effective communicator that enables you to earn trust at all levels and engage effectively with senior leaders.
* Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Gravitate toward the detail but can keep the big picture in focus.
* Highly analytical approach, using data to drive step\-change results.
* Exhibit a collaborative working style with a strong focus on execution and results.
* Have the modesty to question assumptions, seek broad input, and validate iteratively.
* Dedicated to operational excellence, clear communication, and take ownership of your work.
* You actively look for ways to use AI tools in your day\-to\-day work, experiment with new workflows, and are excited to dig in, learn, and iterate to make yourself and the team more efficient.


****Qualifications:****
* Bachelor's Degree in related field or relevant experience.
* 5\+ years of proven experience working in Marketing Technologies/Front End Engineering/Full\-Stack Engineering/Web Development in a technical setting, or similar role.
* Experience developing end\-to\-end applications including frontend UI (e.g., React/Next.js), backend services (e.g., Node/JavaScript), API integrations (e.g., REST/GraphQL), and working with modern data storage technologies (e.g., SQL/NoSQL databases).
* Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments (AWS), working with containers (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and, ideally, infrastructure\-as\-code tools.
* Have experience developing/customizing WordPress themes and plugins and integrating WordPress as a headless CMS using modern frontend frameworks.
* Ability to think critically, be self\-motivated, and deal with ambiguity.
* Professional application of agile methodologies, specifically Scrum.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills and experience interacting with both business and engineering individuals at all levels including the executive level.
* JIRA, Confluence, and g suite experience preferred.


 Get to know us
   

  

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.
   

  

 As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.
   

  

 Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.
   

  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
   

  

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
   

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.*

description:
***We’re building the AI\-driven future of customer success, from retention to growth!***
 We’re building the AI\-driven future of customer success, from retention to growth! Gainsight is the AI\-powered retention engine behind the world’s most customer\-centric companies. **About This Role**
 We’re looking for a full\-time Staff Software Engineer to join our Engineering team reporting to the Director, AI Engineering. This role is a hybrid role based out of our Bengaluru, India location.
   

  

 In this role, you'll play a key role in building Atlas, Gainsight's AI Agents platform for Customer Success, by owning agentic product features end\-to\-end—designing, building, shipping, and iterating to measurably increase customer adoption. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast\-moving, high\-ownership environment with continuous deployment and enjoys working cross\-functionally with teams like Product, Design, and Forward Deployed Engineers. The ideal candidate brings strong skills in full\-stack development with Python and React, building AI agents with LLMs, and scalable system design.

* Design for scale and reliability from the outset, given the pace at which this platform is growing.
* Partner closely with product, design, and FDEs to shape plans, not just execute them.
* Bring forward better tools, patterns, or approaches where you see an opportunity to improve how the team builds.
* Keep documentation lean but sufficient, enough for clarity and continuity


*This is not a complete list of responsibilities, and the scope of the role may evolve with the needs of the team and business. This role will require occasional travel for team meetings, training, or company events.*
***What Success Looks Like***
***By 6–12 months in this role, you will have:***
* Delivered product enhancements that measurably increased customer adoption of the Atlas AI Agents Platform.
* Became a trusted resource for technical problem\-solving, unblocking teammates and improving delivery speed across the team.
* Strengthened the team's ability to deliver predictably on cutting\-edge technology, giving the business confidence to plan ahead.
* Built strong working relationships across engineering, product, and design that improve collaboration and decision\-making.
* Consistently raised the team's bar for quality and ownership, not just met the existing one.


**What We're Looking For**
* 4 \- 7 years of professional software engineering experience.
* At least 3 years building scale applications using Python and modern JavaScript frameworks (preferably ReactJs).
* 1 \- 2 years building AI Agents / working with LLMs, with a genuine engineering mindset, not just prompt\-engineering.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.
* Proven experience as a full stack engineer, owning features from initial design through deployment and ongoing maintenance.
* Strong understanding of best practices for the full software development lifecycle, system design, including coding standards, code reviews, version control, build processes, testing, and operations.
* Comfortable working with autonomy while thriving in a highly collaborative, cross\-functional team environment.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with engineers, product managers, and designers.


**Why You’ll Love It Here**
 Gainsight is a place where innovation is shaped through collaboration, curiosity, and a shared focus on solving real\-world problems. With a growing suite of products across customer success, product experience, community, education, and AI\-powered relationship intelligence, we continue to evolve with the needs of our customers. When people with diverse strengths, a strong sense of community, and true passion for our mission come together, they drive greater impact and create lasting value. What underpins it all is a culture that offers the stability, trust, and support that people need \- not just to do the job, but to show up as themselves and feel connected to the work they do. Gainsters love working here for several reasons. Here are a few:

 At Gainsight, we believe great work happens when teammates feel fully supported.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive benefits package including full health coverage (including OPD), wellness and mental health resources, flexible remote work options, and childcare assistance. You'll also enjoy dedicated Recharge Holidays \- one long weekend each quarter to relax and reset.

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Industry: Software Development
Seniority level: Mid\-Senior level  



Experience: 5\+ yrs



Location: Bengaluru



Job Type: Full\-time



We’re hiring fullstack engineers (SDE\-2 through Staff) to own this surface end\-to\-end: from rich, reactive frontends to backend services and workflows that power them.



What changes across levels is scope, ambiguity, and influence — but at every level, you’ll write code, ship product, and operate across the frontend\-backend boundary.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Frontend Development**



Design and build intuitive, high\-quality user interfaces that handle complex workflows — task tracking, state transitions, approvals, and user actions.



Senior and Staff engineers define reusable patterns and UI primitives for teams.


### **Fullstack Feature Ownership**



Own features across the stack:


* Build React frontends
* Design and implement APIs
* Ensure seamless integration between UI and backend systems


SDE\-2s execute with guidance, Seniors own end\-to\-end design, Staff engineers define system\-wide patterns.


### **Backend \& Service Layer**



Build and evolve backend services that support:


* Long\-running workflows
* State management and persistence
* Error handling and fallback strategies
* Scalable API design

### **Real\-Time \& Event\-Driven Systems**



Implement real\-time patterns using WebSockets, SSE, or async workflows:


* Live updates
* Progress tracking
* Partial results and responsiveness


Make tradeoffs around latency, consistency, and user experience.


### **User Control \& Workflow Design**



Build systems that allow users to:


* Review and approve actions
* Override system decisions
* Intervene in workflows when needed


Senior\+ engineers help define how control, automation, and usability are balanced.


### **Performance \& Reliability**



Optimize across the stack:


* UI performance and rendering
* Backend query efficiency
* Caching and throughput
* System reliability and observability


Senior and Staff engineers define SLOs and performance standards.


### **Code Quality \& Mentorship**


* Write clean, testable, maintainable code
* Participate in code reviews
* Mentor junior engineers (Senior\+)
* Establish engineering standards (Staff)

### **Cross\-Team Technical Leadership (Senior \& Staff)**



Collaborate across frontend, backend, data, and platform teams to:


* Define shared patterns and abstractions
* Resolve architectural ambiguity
* Align engineering decisions with product goals


Staff engineers drive org\-wide technical direction.



 The **SDE\-2** level typically requires **3–5 years of full\-stack experience**, with strong skills in React and TypeScript on the frontend and experience with API design and basic database concepts on the backend. Candidates should have exposure to complex workflows, be familiar with asynchronous and real\-time patterns, understand user flows, and execute well\-scoped work effectively. Communication should be clear and structured.



The **Senior** level generally requires **5–8 years of full\-stack experience**, along with deep React expertise and strong backend systems knowledge, including queues, caching, and authentication. Candidates are expected to have built production\-grade systems and demonstrate strong architectural judgment, particularly around real\-time systems. They should be capable of designing for edge cases, evaluating tradeoffs, making independent technical decisions, and clearly communicating those tradeoffs across teams.



The **Staff** level typically requires **9\+ years of full\-stack experience** and expert\-level frontend architecture skills. Candidates should have deep expertise in distributed systems and infrastructure design, with experience designing large\-scale systems and defining real\-time infrastructure patterns. They are expected to shape both product and technology direction, provide organization\-level technical leadership, and effectively bridge business, product, and engineering teams.

  


**Nice to Have**
----------------

description:

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for a DCO Frontend Developer with a strong foundation in dynamic creative (DCO) implementations to build scalable, high\-performance digital ad experiences across web, display, social, and video environments. This role focuses primarily on frontend engineering, component\-based architecture, performance optimization, and responsive creative development, while also supporting dynamic creative integrations, feed\-driven logic, and campaign activation workflows. You will collaborate closely with creative, media, and product teams to translate design concepts into robust, reusable frontend solutions that power personalized and data\-driven advertising experiences
   

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Integrate dynamic data feeds (JSON, XML, CSV, APIs) to enable personalization and content variation.
* Implement and manage basic DCO logic, including creative variations, dynamic content insertion, and conditional rendering.
* Collaborate with designers to translate Figma/Adobe designs into pixel\-perfect, interactive experiences.
* Troubleshoot and debug issues across browsers, devices, and ad platforms.
* Participate in code reviews, version control workflows, and frontend best practices implementation.
* Work with cross\-functional teams (creative, media, production) to ensure smooth delivery and deployment of campaigns.
* Support campaign launches and QA, ensuring accuracy and functionality of dynamic creatives.


**Requirements** 
**:**
* Strong experience in HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Experience building responsive and adaptive UIs across devices and screen sizes.
* Proficiency with JavaScript animation libraries such as GSAP, CreateJS, or similar.
* Familiarity with component\-based architecture and reusable design systems.
* Strong understanding of performance optimization techniques (lazy loading, asset compression, efficient DOM manipulation).
* Experience with cross\-browser compatibility and debugging tools.
* Working knowledge of Git and version control workflows.
* Experience with SASS/SCSS and modern CSS methodologies.
* Familiarity with Figma and design\-to\-development workflows.
* Understanding of web accessibility (WCAG) and W3C standards.


**Nice to Haves:**
* Experience with creative tools such as Adobe Animate, After Effects, Photoshop, or Illustrator.
* Exposure to dynamic ad platforms like Celtra, Innovid, or Smartly.
* Knowledge of video ad formats (VAST/VPAID) and rich media creatives.
* Understanding of programmatic advertising ecosystem fundamentals.
* Familiarity with basic backend/API integration concepts for data\-driven experiences.
* Interest or exposure to AI/automation in frontend or creative workflows.


**Technical Skills**
* Core: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6\+)
* Styling: SASS/SCSS, responsive design
* Animation: GSAP, CreateJS
* Data Handling: JSON, XML, CSV
* Tools: Git, Figma, Adobe Suite
* Standards: WCAG, W3C, cross\-browser compatibility.


**Why work here:**
 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

description:

 Metayb is a digital transformation company on a mission to transform seamlessly by empowering organisations to navigate the vast landscape of the digital\-first era. Within just three year of inception, we have grown into a close\-knit family of 500\+ employees, each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency \& deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging tech Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital first ecosystem of value creation. Our key areas of expertise lie in Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding, Visualization, Finance and Supply Chain services. **Key Attributes**
* Thorough knowledge of the software application development process, life cycle including conceiving, planning, documenting, and leading large, application projects.
* The ability to understand and communicate architectural principles, best practices, code patterns, Agile practices, testing automation, and mentoring/education.
* Excellent oral and written communications skills; the ability to facilitate client meetings.
* A great attention to detail, with an ability to work clearly, concisely, and quickly; the ability to multi\-task and meet tight deadlines.
* A desire to learn, and adapt to, the latest technologies.
* Creative problem\-solving skills with the ability to make things happen with limited instruction.
* Ability to drive strategy through influence with leadership qualities which engineers recognise and respect
* Ability to innovate and lead explorations into new technologies and strategies
* Ability to establish and adhere to software engineering best practices, standards and tools
* Ability to effectively collaborate with leadership and teams within technology, product management, business units, brands and across external alliance partners
* Skilled ability to foster continuous improvement and innovation; ability to accept and lead change initiatives throughout the organisation
* Must be able to build POCs across Full stack technologies across different platforms.


**Key Responsibilities**
* To analyze, understand the client's business use cases and technical requirements and be able to design, build \& integrate user interfaces to a varying suite of internal and external services
* Strong Knowledge on Application and Technical Architecture
* Experience in Micro Service Architecture, Micro Fronted, Responsive design, SPA, Composable, Serverless, Even Driven and Design Patterns.
* Knowledge on front\-end technologies such as: React Js, Angular, Vue, Redux, React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES5, ES6\), Object Oriented JavaScript, Webpack, Ajax, SCSS, Styled Component, HTML5, CSS3
* Experience with Server\-side technologies such as Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, AWS, Docker Containers, Kubernetes etc.
* Experience with React Native, Flutter or Ionic
* Experience with Swift and Objective\-C for iOS or Java and Kotlin for Android
* Experience in developing user interfaces of large\-scale websites using latest UI frameworks and libraries.
* Experience with enterprise integration tools, middleware technologies, application and data integration patterns including SOAP/REST web services, databases, ETL, ESB
* Experience in a core language like Java, XPath, and XSL/T, J2EE based web applications (JSP, Servlet, JDBC, JMS, JAXB), Design Patterns, JMS, SOAP / REST Web Services, XSLT, CXF, Spring Framework, etc. in order to deliver solutions. (Python is an acceptable alternative)
* Minimum 3 years of experience with architecting and developing solutions for highly scalable systems.
* Strong mentoring skills, proven ability to build scalable teams imbibing thought leadership.
* Experience in architecting multi\-tiered solutions based on architectural best practices.
* Strong knowledge in Dev Ops, CI/CD Integrations, Infrastructure as Code.
* Extensive experience designing \& managing a complex infrastructure implemented in one of the cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree (BE, BTech) in Computer Science, or Engineering OR equivalent experience and knowledge required.
* Excellent spoken, written communication and presentation skills.
* Excellent mentoring skills and people enablement through thought leadership.


**Disclaimer:** 
 The job title mentioned in this description is generic and intended for broad categorization purposes. The final designation will be determined based on the candidate’s performance during the interview process, relevant experience, and alignment with the organizational hierarchy.
