title: Azure developer
description:
**Job Description**
 As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the world’s top professional services firms, and in support of our global workforce strategy, we’re growing our operations in India! We create rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!
   

  

 CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices worldwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia. We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Senior Specialist – Azure Developer to join the GDC team. CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings
   

  

 YOUR TEAM.
   

  

 This position will support our GDC team and as a Senior Azure Developer, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of complex cloud\-based applications on the Microsoft Azure platform
   

  

 WHY COHNREZNICK?
   

  

 At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.
   

  

 We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning \& development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.
   

  

 YOUR ROLE.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To**
 Lead the design and development of cloud\-based applications.
   

  

 Collaborate with stakeholders to define project requirements.
   

  

 Write high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable code.
   

  

 Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance.
   

  

* Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines.


 Ensure the security and performance of applications.
   

  

 Troubleshoot and resolve advanced technical issues.
   

  

 Optimize application architecture and performance.
   

  

 Create and maintain detailed documentation.
   

  

 Stay updated with the latest Azure technologies and industry trends.
   

  

* Expert knowledge of Azure services like Azure App Service, Azure Functions, and Azure Storage.


 Leading the design and architecture of Azure\-based applications, ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
   

  

 Proficiency in RESTful APIs and web services.
   

  

 Experience with version control systems like Git.
   

  

 Strong knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.
   

  

 In\-depth understanding of DevOps practices.
   

  

 Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
   

  

 Strong understanding of networking concepts.
   

  

 Knowledge of security best practices in cloud environments.
   

  

 Ability to write clean, maintainable code.
   

  

 Experience with performance optimization.
   

  

 Hands\-on writing automated test cases in Nunit/xunit/MSTest framework
   

  

 Hands\-on with Azure containerization services
   

  

**Hands\-on With ADF Or SynapseTechnologies, Coding Languages, And Methodologies**
 Microsoft Azure (Key Vault, Service Bus Queues, Storage Queues, Topics, Blob storage, Azure Container services (kubernetes, docker), App Services \[Web Apps, Logic Apps, Function Apps], Azure functions (time triggered, durable), Azure AI services)
   

  

 Azure SQL, Cosmos DB
   

  

* NET Core (latest version)


 APIs, APIM
   

  

 Angular/ React
   

  

 JavaScript, Python
   

  

 SQL, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB
   

  

 Azure containerization services (Docker, Kubernetes)
   

  

 ADF or Synapse
   

  

 Nunit/xunit/MSTest framework
   

  

 Git
   

  

 Agile methodologies
   

  

 CI/CD pipelines
   

  

 IaC (Infrastructure as Code) \- ARM/Bicep/TerraForms
   

  

 Azure DevOps
   

  

**Your Experience.**
 The successful candidate will have:
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
   

  

 7\+ years of experience in cloud development.
   

  

* Expert understanding of Microsoft Azure services.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as C\#, JavaScript, or Python.


 Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
   

  

 Strong communication and leadership abilities.
   

  

* Experience with Agile methodologies.


 Preferred Certifications: Microsoft Certified \- Azure DevOps Engineer Expert and Microsoft Certified \- Azure Solutions Architect Expert
   

  

 In addition, please take a moment to review our Universal Job Standards.
   

  

 Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.
   

  

 "CohnReznick" is the brand name under which CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC and their respective subsidiaries provide professional services. CohnReznick LLP and
   

  

 CohnReznick Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiaries) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. CohnReznick LLP is a licensed CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC and its subsidiaries are not licensed CPA firms.
   

  

 CohnReznick is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team to drive business results and create a better future every day for our team members, clients, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

title: Salesforce Net Zero Cloud Developer
description:
Greetings from NAM Info Pvt Ltd,
 



  





*We have an opportunity for the position below. Please go through the job description.* 




  





**JOB TITLE:** 
 Salesforce Net Zero Cloud Developer
 



**WORK LOCATION:** 
 Chennai \& Hyderabad
 



**WORK PREFERENCE:** 
 Hybrid \- 3 days a week
 



**DURATION:** 
 Full\-Time Employment
 



**Notice Period –** 
 Immediate
 



**Mandatory Skills** 
 – Salesforce Net Zero Cloud
 



**Shift Type:** 
 Afternoon
 



**Shift Timing/On\-Call/Weekend Support Needed** 
 – 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM
 



**How many rounds of Interview –** 
 3 Levels
 



  





**About the Role:**




 We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Net Zero Cloud Developer to design, develop, configure, integrate, and support Salesforce solutions focused on sustainability, carbon accounting, and Net Zero initiatives.
 



 The candidate will work with sustainability and business teams to implement solutions that enable organizations to collect, manage, calculate, analyze, and report environmental data across areas.
 



 The role requires strong Salesforce development skills combined with an understanding of sustainability data, and carbon reduction programs.
 



  







**Responsibilities**



* **Salesforce Net Zero Cloud Development**
* Develop and customize solutions using Salesforce Net Zero Cloud.
* Configure and extend Net Zero Cloud functionality based on business requirements.
* Develop Apex Classes, Triggers, Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, Scheduled Apex, and Test Classes.
* Develop Lightning Web Components (LWC) where custom user interfaces are required.
* Configure Salesforce Flows, Validation Rules, Custom Metadata, Permission Sets, and other platform capabilities.
* Implement scalable solutions while adhering to Salesforce governor limits.
* Perform data modeling and configuration for sustainability\-related data.



**Integration** 



* Design and develop integrations between Salesforce Net Zero Cloud and external enterprise systems.
* Develop and consume REST/SOAP APIs.
* Integrate Salesforce with:
* Utility and energy data platforms
* ERP systems
* Work with JSON, XML, API authentication, Named Credentials, and External Credentials.
* Implement asynchronous integrations using Platform Events, Queueable Apex, and Batch Apex where appropriate.
* Troubleshoot integration failures and data synchronization issues.



**Data Management** 



* Design data ingestion processes for sustainability data.
* Develop data transformation and validation logic.
* Perform data cleansing and reconciliation.
* Build scalable solutions for large\-volume sustainability datasets.
* Develop Batch Apex and scheduled processes for recurring calculations and data processing.
* Support data migration and bulk data loading activities.



**Reporting \& Analytics** 



* Develop Salesforce dashboards and reports for sustainability KPIs.
* Support reporting of:
* Energy consumption
* Carbon intensity
* Net Zero targets
* Progress against sustainability goals
* Work with business teams to translate sustainability requirements into meaningful Salesforce reports and dashboards.








**Required Technical Skills**




**Salesforce** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with Salesforce development.
* Strong knowledge of Apex.
* Experience with:
* Apex Classes
* Triggers
* Batch Apex
* Queueable Apex
* Scheduled Apex
* Future Methods
* Test Classes
* Strong knowledge of SOQL and SOSL.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Governor Limits.
* Experience with Salesforce security and sharing model.
* Hands\-on experience with Lightning Web Components.
* Experience with Salesforce Flow and declarative automation.



**Net Zero Cloud / Sustainability** 



* Experience with Salesforce Net Zero Cloud / Sustainability Cloud is highly preferred.
* Knowledge of carbon accounting concepts.
* Experience working with sustainability KPIs and Net Zero targets.
* Understanding of sustainability reporting requirements is preferred.



**Integration \& Data** 



* Experience with REST and SOAP APIs.
* Strong knowledge of JSON and XML.
* Experience with Salesforce Named Credentials.
* Experience with Platform Events and event\-driven integrations.
* Experience handling high\-volume data.
* Knowledge of ETL/data integration concepts.
* Experience with Salesforce Data Loader or equivalent tools.



**DevOps** 



* Experience with Salesforce CLI / SFDX.
* Git experience.
* Knowledge of CI/CD practices.
* Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps, or similar tools is preferred.
* Experience with Salesforce deployment and release management.








**Soft Skills**



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand complex sustainability and business requirements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work with both technical and sustainability teams.
* Strong ownership and accountability.

 We are seeking an experienced Java Full Stack Engineer to provide L3 application support, manage security vulnerabilities, implement application enhancements, and ensure the stability, performance, and compliance of enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, modern front\-end frameworks, cloud technologies, and production support processes.
 



 The role requires ownership of critical production incidents, security remediation, root cause analysis, and collaboration with development, infrastructure, security, and business teams to maintain application reliability and availability.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**L3 Production Support** 



* Provide L3 support for business\-critical applications and resolve production incidents within agreed SLA commitments.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Troubleshoot application, API, integration, middleware, infrastructure, and database\-related issues.
* Support Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents, including war\-room participation and on\-call support when required.
* Analyze application logs, metrics, alerts, and monitoring dashboards to proactively identify issues.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, middleware, database, security, and vendor teams during incident resolution.



**Vulnerability \& Security Management** 



* Review, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities identified through application, dependency, infrastructure, and code\-security scans.
* Address security findings aligned with OWASP Top 10 and enterprise secure\-coding standards.
* Coordinate with Security and Compliance teams to ensure vulnerabilities are closed within defined remediation timelines.
* Perform impact assessment, code changes, regression testing, and deployment for third\-party library upgrades and security patches.
* Maintain evidence and technical documentation required for security reviews and audits.
* Support periodic patching, dependency upgrades, certificate renewals, and secure configuration reviews.

**Technical Skills** 



* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

description:

 We are looking for a QA2 Automation Engineer with 3–5 years of experience who will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our customer\-facing frontend platforms including Android, iOS, and Web applications.
   

  

 The primary focus of this role will be to design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites for mobile and web platforms. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to ensure that new features are delivered with high quality and minimal regressions.
   

  

 As an e\-commerce platform, our applications power critical user journeys such as product catalogue browsing, checkout flows, payments, and order lifecycle management, and this role will play a key part in ensuring these flows remain stable and reliable.
   

  

 To succeed in this role, you should have a strong understanding of automation frameworks, frontend testing strategies, test design techniques, and CI/CD integration. Experience in mobile and web test automation along with modern QA practices will be highly valuable.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks and test suites for Android, iOS, and Web applications.
   

  

 Write automated test cases for functional, regression, and end\-to\-end testing of customer\-facing features.
   

  

 Collaborate closely with frontend engineers (Android, iOS, Web) to understand application architecture and ensure proper automation coverage.
   

  

 Validate critical e\-commerce user journeys including product discovery, checkout flows, payment flows, and order lifecycle.
   

  

 Design and execute test scenarios using strong test design techniques such as boundary value testing, equivalence partitioning, and risk\-based testing.
   

  

 Manage and track test cases, test execution, and defects using Jira and related test management practices.
   

  

 Work closely with product managers and designers to validate business requirements and ensure correct feature behavior.
   

  

 Perform API testing and validation to ensure reliability of frontend\-backend integrations.
   

  

 Build and maintain automation pipelines integrated with CI/CD systems to enable continuous testing.
   

  

 Identify defects, analyze root causes, and collaborate with developers to ensure faster resolution.
   

  

 Monitor automation results and improve stability, reliability, and execution efficiency of automation suites.
   

  

 Continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and best practices to improve the overall QA automation ecosystem.
   

  

 Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and release readiness discussions.
   

  

 Ensure high standards for performance, reliability, and usability across devices and browsers.
   

  

**Skills \& Requirements**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

* Selenium / Playwright / Cypress for web automation

**Strong Understanding Of Test Design Techniques Such As**

title: Full stack Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job Full Stack Engineer Company: GreenChoice, PBC – the food intelligence company Employment Type: Full\-Time Location: Hybrid in Pune, India (preferred) or Remote Experience: 3–5 years We have multiple roles open—Please apply to only one role where you see a strong fit with your skills and experience. About GreenChoice GreenChoice, PBC is a U.S.\-based, leading provider of food health and sustainability data and personalization solutions for the grocery industry. GreenChoice gives food retailers instant access to personalized evidence\-based food health scores \& sustainability scores and verified attribute data on over 1 million food products, with award\-winning shelf\-edge and e\-commerce plugins to meet consumers' changing health needs and values in\-store and online. GreenChoice has guided over 10 million healthier purchases. Google named GreenChoice one of the three “Best Apps for Good” in the U.S. GreenChoice is backed by Katapult and BonBillo Ventures, works with Stanford University School of Medicine, is a member of Tufts Friedman School Food \& Nutrition Innovation Council, an FMI Tech Finalist, and a Progressive Grocer GenNext Honoree. For more info about GreenChoice, visit: www.greenchoice.co About the Role As a Full Stack Engineer at GreenChoice, you will design, build, and maintain end\-to\-end solutions that power both our user\-facing applications and backend systems. You’ll work across the stack—developing seamless web and mobile experiences with React.js and React Native, while also architecting APIs, services, and data pipelines with Node.js and modern databases. This role will require strong collaboration with product, design, data, and infrastructure teams to deliver features that are scalable, secure, and high\-performing. You will be a key contributor to shaping GreenChoice’s technical roadmap in a fast\-paced, agile environment. Key Responsibilities Frontend Development: Build and maintain web applications using React.js and mobile applications using React Native with Expo. Translate Figma UI/UX designs into high\-quality, pixel\-perfect interfaces. Implement responsive design principles and ensure cross\-platform compatibility. Backend Development: Design, implement, and maintain RESTful and GraphQL APIs using Node.js/Express. Work with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) to model, query, and optimize data storage. Ensure data integrity, performance, and scalability across services. Integration \& Collaboration: Collaborate with frontend and backend teams to ensure seamless data flow and API integrations. Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and architectural decision\-making. Quality \& Maintenance: Write unit and integration tests to ensure application stability. Maintain clean, well\-documented, and reusable code. Debug, optimize, and monitor performance of applications across the stack. Required Skills \& Qualifications 3–5 years of Full Stack development experience. Strong proficiency in: Frontend: React.js, React Native with Expo, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, CSS3 Backend: Node.js (Express or similar frameworks), REST/GraphQL APIs Databases: SQL (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB/Redis) Strong experience working with Figma to implement designs accurately. Proficiency with Git and collaborative tools (Asana, Slack, code versioning workflows). Understanding of responsive design, cross\-browser compatibility, and accessibility. Familiarity with state management tools (Redux, Context API). Ability to work independently in a startup environment and take ownership of features end\-to\-end. Nice to Have Experience with TypeScript. Familiarity with testing frameworks (Jest, Mocha, Cypress, React Testing Library). Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, DigitalOcean, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Experience with search/indexing systems (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch). A passion for sustainability, food systems, or health tech. What We Offer Salary: ₹13,58,594–₹18,11,400/year (based on location \& experience). Equity options in a growing early\-stage startup. Flexible working hours and remote work opportunities. Mission\-driven team with a collaborative and inclusive culture. A chance to have a real\-world impact on how people eat and live healthier, more sustainable lives.
   

  

**Required Skills**

 Additional Information

* Strong troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Front\-end or web application development using Angular, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, or similar tools

* API development and integration
* Debugging, code review, and performance optimization
* Secure coding practices and data access control

* Experience with containerization or cloud\-native development
* Experience integrating applications with external systems using REST APIs or other integration patterns
* Experience supporting healthcare, enterprise, or business\-critical applications

* Familiarity with Generative AI concepts such as LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, agents, MCP, or Azure OpenAI

* Experience with data modeling, data marts, semantic models, or OLAP concepts
* Experience with ETL development using SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or similar platforms
* Experience with Power Query, DAX, Power Pivot, or Power BI administration
* Experience with forecasting, trend analysis, anomaly detection, or predictive analytics
* Experience with Python or R for analytics, automation, or machine learning
* Experience with Azure Data Services, Azure Machine Learning, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, or similar platforms
* Experience embedding reports, dashboards, or analytics into applications
* Experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, or Power Platform governance
* Experience using LLMs to generate summaries, insights, or dynamic narratives in reports or applications

* Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications and integrations
* Build scalable, secure, and maintainable application components
* Develop and integrate APIs, services, and database\-driven functionality
* Collaborate with product, data, business, and technical teams to translate requirements into working solutions
* Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and engineering best practices
* Troubleshoot application issues and optimize performance, reliability, and maintainability
* Support CI/CD, deployment, and release management activities
* Contribute to secure development practices and data access controls
* Where applicable, support dashboard, reporting, analytics, or data integration needs as part of broader application delivery
* Explore opportunities to use AI and automation to improve development productivity and solution quality

 Minimal travel as required for position responsibilities – less than 10%, depending on candidate location.

 This candidate will work from a home office when not at client site

description:
Role: Senior Frontend Developer — React
Experience: 5\+ years
Location: Gurugram  

About: Fairdeal.Market  

Fairdeal.market is a rapidly growing B2B quick commerce platform transforming how retailers procure everyday essentials. With delivery times as fast as 60 minutes and a commitment to efficiency and sustainability, we are building the future of supply chain for the world’s shopping baskets.  

Role Overview  

We are looking for a Senior Frontend Developer with 5\+ years of experience and strong expertise in React and frontend architecture. In this role you will build a new product from the ground up — owning the architecture, tooling, and foundational engineering decisions with no legacy codebase to lean on. The ideal candidate is capable of solving complex UI, performance, security, and architecture problems, making technical decisions independently, and building scalable, maintainable production applications. Backend knowledge is expected, but the role is primarily frontend\-focused.  

Key Responsibilities* Build a production application from scratch: set up the project, tooling, CI/CD hygiene, and foundational architecture decisions from day one.
* Build scalable, maintainable, and high\-performance React applications.
* Define frontend architecture including component structure, state management, data flow, routing, API integration, and module boundaries.
* Design and build a reusable component library / design system, ensuring consistency, accessibility, and reuse across the application.
* Own authentication and authorization flows, including login, session/token handling, and role\-based access control across different user types.
* Ensure application security: input validation, XSS/CSRF protection, secure token storage, and safe handling of sensitive data on the client.
* Build responsive, adaptive UIs that work across desktop, tablet, and handheld/mobile form factors.
* Have a deep understanding of React rendering, reconciliation, memoization, virtualization, lazy loading, and code\-splitting.
* Diagnose and resolve memory leaks, UI jank, slow rendering, and performance regressions using Chrome DevTools, React Profiler, Lighthouse, and bundle analysis tools.
* Build performant data\-dense interfaces — large tables, grids, filtering, and real\-time state updates.
* Make informed state architecture decisions across local state, Context, Redux/Redux Toolkit, or other state\-management approaches.
* Own and optimize the frontend build pipeline using Vite/Webpack, including tree\-shaking, lazy loading, code\-splitting, and bundle optimization.
* Evaluate CSR vs SSR vs SSG based on performance, scalability, and SEO requirements.
* Design and maintain frontend coding standards, linting, formatting, and architecture guidelines.
* Work with REST APIs, WebSockets, authentication/authorization, and real\-time application requirements.
* Have a solid understanding of backend architecture, Node.js, databases, API design, and basic system design.
* Write maintainable, testable code and actively participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
* Mentor developers and contribute to improving overall code quality and engineering practices.
* Take an AI\-first approach to engineering: default to using AI tools across the development lifecycle — from design and coding to review, testing, and debugging — to work faster and at higher quality.
* Be hands\-on with modern AI development tools such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and similar, using them fluently as part of daily workflow.
* Build custom AI skills and agents to automate repetitive engineering tasks and accelerate team workflows.
* Critically review, validate, debug, and refine AI\-generated code, ensuring correctness, security, performance, architecture, and maintainability before production use.

  

Required Skills* 5\+ years of frontend engineering experience, with a track record of solving deep, non\-trivial UI, performance, and architecture problems — not just feature delivery.
* Proven experience building applications from scratch and making foundational architecture and tooling decisions independently.
* Strong expertise in React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Strong understanding of frontend architecture and design patterns.
* Experience building reusable component libraries or design systems.
* Strong experience with Redux/Redux Toolkit or equivalent state\-management solutions.
* Deep understanding of HTML, CSS, browser behavior, HTTP, and web performance.
* Solid grasp of web security fundamentals: authentication/authorization, RBAC, XSS/CSRF, and secure client\-side data handling.
* Strong experience with Vite/Webpack and frontend build optimization.
* Strong API integration and debugging skills.
* Working knowledge of backend architecture and system design.
* Proven experience taking complex or loosely defined frontend problems and independently defining the technical approach and solution.
* History of driving measurable improvements in load time, Core Web Vitals, rendering performance, or bundle size.
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, communication, and ownership skills.
* Strong experience with AI\-assisted software development, including the ability to critically evaluate and improve AI\-generated code.
* Demonstrated AI\-first mindset with hands\-on, daily use of AI development tools.
* Hands\-on experience building AI skills and agents to automate engineering workflows.

  

Good to Have* Next.js / SSR
* Node.js / backend development
* WebSockets / Socket.IO
* Experience with offline\-capable or unreliable\-network resilient applications
* Micro\-frontends / Module Federation

At Dezerv, we are building a platform that leverages our decades of investment expertise to help individuals invest better for their future.

 Dezerv is scaling fast, and this role is built for someone who wants to own outcomes, not just execute tickets. You'll work close to the business, close to real capital decisions, and close to a team that expects you to think, not just build what you're told.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**About Neo** 




  





 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia**
 — Co\-Founder of
 
 Zeta
 
 ,
 
 Radix
 
 , and
 
 Titan
 
 —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 



**Tasket** 
 — A radically reimagined, AI\-native work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
 



**Friday** 
 — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
 



**Studio** 
 — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
 



**Scribe** 
 — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As a Principal Engineer you will own the design and architecture of the suite and mentor engineers across teams.
 



 We are proponents of leveraging best\-in\-breed AI tools at every step of the engineering lifecycle — design, development, review, and testing. This requires a different engineering mindset: a lean team of senior, hands\-on, AI\-adept engineers, resulting in ultra\-rapid iteration cycles and fast output. You will own and oversee this approach for the systems you lead, from design through to production.
 



 This is a role for a proactive, independent decision\-maker who is at home reasoning from system internals up to cross\-team architecture, and who raises the bar for what both people and agents ship.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 Architecture \& technical direction
 


* Own the architecture of Neo's backend services and frontend components — service boundaries, data models
* Resolve cross\-cutting reliability, performance, and security concerns
* Build platforms, reusable libraries, and utilities that make the team faster and the codebase consistent.



  





 Execution \& delivery
 


* Drive delivery end to end: turn a spec into shipped software by breaking it down, running agents in parallel to implement, and steering them to a working result.
* Own verification — the real bottleneck in an agentic workflow. Decide what "correct" means for a system and make sure what ships actually meets it, before it reaches users.



  





 AI\-first SDLC harness
 


* Build and improve the harness the team builds with — specs, reusable skills, subagents, evals, and guardrails that let many agents work in parallel and give consistent results regardless of the underlying tool.
* Set the quality gates that agent\-authored changes pass before a human reviews them, and improve them as failure modes show up.



  





 Mentoring \& raising the bar
 


* Mentor engineers and run design reviews; turn what works into standards, templates, and paved roads the whole team uses.
* Spread good agent practice across the team so its leverage compounds, not just your own.



  





 Product thinking
 


* Work with product to pin down the right problem before building — scope feasibility, surface trade\-offs, and push back when the cost isn't worth the outcome.
* Own outcomes, not tickets.



  





**Skills** 



* AI\-native engineering practice — Fluent in an agentic development workflow: spec\-driven delivery, running and steering coding agents, and building the harness (specs, skills, evals, guardrails) that makes agent output reliable at the team level
* Strong language \& runtime fundamentals — Deep proficiency in one or more of the languages we work in — Java, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go — including OOP and design, concurrency, memory management, and how your runtime behaves under load. Comfortable picking the right language for the job rather than defaulting to one.
* System internals — Working knowledge of processor, memory, network, and storage internals, and how to write code that exploits hardware well and avoids bottlenecks.
* Distributed systems — Fault modelling, concurrency, isolation, and consensus; time, clocks, and ordering of events; rate control and load distribution. Strong design and problem\-solving instincts for performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
* Internals of core infrastructure — Hands\-on with the internals of Kafka, Cassandra/Scylla, and Redis — enough to troubleshoot, tune, and make sound usage decisions.
* I/O\-optimised algorithms — Asynchronous and non\-blocking I/O and DMA, for high throughput in performance\-critical paths.

**About Team**

By leveraging AI, the system anticipates and resolves associates’ queries on HR functions like Benefits, Payroll etc. before they become human contacts, ensuring proactive support for associates. Additionally, human agents are empowered with context, judgment support, and automation, allowing them to deliver faster, more accurate assistance while focusing on meaningful interactions. This approach enhances productivity, cultivates a culture of belonging, and completely transforms the HR Help Center Experience for all Walmart's associates.
   

  

 Our team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Full\-Stack) to help design and build scalable, user\-facing systems that power AI\-enabled People Support experiences. In this hands\-on role, you will work across backend services and modern web frontends, with a primary focus on backend system design, APIs, and integrations. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and ML partners to deliver reliable, performant solutions that directly impact millions of associates.

 Participate in production support and on\-call rotations, helping diagnose issues, resolve incidents, and implement long\-term fixes
   

  

 Continuously improve developer productivity and system quality by adopting appropriate tools, frameworks, and engineering practices
   

  

 What you will bring
   

  

 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong emphasis on backend development and full\-stack delivery in production environments
   

  

 Strong backend development experience in Java/Spring Boot, Node.js/TypeScript, and/or Python
   

  

 Hands\-on experience building modern web applications using React, with a solid understanding of frontend fundamentals, state management, and API\-driven UI development
   

  

 Experience building and operating distributed systems, including microservices, asynchronous processing, and data\-intensive workflows
   

  

 Exposure to real\-time systems, such as conversational interfaces, chatbots, search, or decision\-support platforms, with an understanding of latency and reliability considerations
   

  

 Solid API design skills, including RESTful APIs, service contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
   

  

 Experience integrating with AI/ML or GenAI services, focusing on backend orchestration, reliability, and performance rather than model development
   

  

 Working knowledge of data storage systems, including relational and NoSQL databases, and an understanding of trade\-offs in data modeling and access patterns
   

  

 Understanding of security fundamentals, including authentication, authorization, and secure API development
   

  

 Experience with observability tools, including logging, metrics, and basic tracing, to support debugging and production readiness
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to work across backend and frontend layers to diagnose issues
   

  

 Effective communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to learn, give feedback, and grow within a team\-oriented environment
   

  

 A sense of ownership and accountability, with a bias toward writing clean code, improving systems incrementally, and delivering customer value
   

  

**About Walmart Global Tech**
 Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. title: Member Technical Staff - Applied AI Engineer (US Timing)
description:
**Member of Technical Staff – Applied AI Engineering**

**EXPERIENCE: 2–4 years**  

**TYPE: Full\-time**  

**FOCUS: Applied AI Customer\-facing**  

**WORK HOURS: US Timings**  

**LOCATION: Bengaluru**

 **ABOUT THE COMPANY**


At Composio, we are building infrastructure that allows AI agents to communicate with the tools people use for work, including GitHub, Gmail, Notion, Salesforce, and more. We are a small team of engineers working across context, auth, execution, and reliability to build the action layer for AI agents.  

  

We raised a $25M Series A from Lightspeed, with angel investors including Guillermo Rauch (CEO of Vercel), Dharmesh Shah (CTO of HubSpot), and Gokul Rajaram. Our customers range from YC startups to companies like Brex, Glean, Zoom, and more.

 **ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

This is an applied AI engineering role, not a traditional support role. You will work directly with customers, learn the repeated work behind their problems, and build agentic systems that take that work over. When a customer needs direct engineering, you will debug and ship. When a pattern repeats, you will turn it into a workflow, eval, tool, or product capability that compounds.

* **The frontier:** support is one of the richest applied AI environments — an agent has to gather context, reason across systems, use tools, take bounded action, verify the outcome, and communicate clearly. You design that system.
* **The trust bar:** AI cannot be trusted by default with customer support. You define state, permissions, guardrails, evals, and escalation paths so the automation earns trust.
* **The feedback loop:** it's immediate. Deploy into real support work, watch where the system fails, and improve it until people can hand over more of the job.

  

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **What you'll build**

* Agentic workflows that take over support functions: intake, classification, context gathering, reproduction, diagnosis, response drafting, remediation, verification, and follow\-up.
* Tool\-using agents that safely inspect runs, logs, auth state, configuration, and provider behavior, then propose or execute bounded recovery actions.
* Eval suites for diagnostic correctness, resolution quality, safe escalation, customer communication, and end\-to\-end task completion.
* Human\-in\-the\-loop systems that make ownership, uncertainty, approvals, handoffs, and failure states explicit.
* The observability, memory, and feedback loops that let these agents improve from real support cases without repeating mistakes.
* Product improvements that remove entire classes of customer issues instead of handling the same symptoms faster.

 **How you'll work**

* Start with the customer outcome, then work backward into the model, workflow, tooling, or product change required to deliver it.
* Own the hardest issues end to end when direct engineering is needed: reproduce, isolate, mitigate, ship, communicate, and verify the resolution with the customer.
* Sit with customers and partner with Support, FDE, Product, and Engineering to find work that should become software.
* Move from a rough prototype to a reliable production workflow, with traces, evals, guardrails, and a clear human fallback.
* Use frontier models, coding agents, and internal AI tools every day to multiply your own engineering output.
* Measure success in customer outcomes improved, support work removed, and classes of failure prevented.

 **WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

* **Experience level:** 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience.

  

**Applied AI engineering*** You have built production systems with language models, tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, multi\-step workflows, or agent memory.
* You know how to use models and coding agents as leverage, and where their non\-determinism creates hidden risk.
* You use evals, traces, failure analysis, and fast iteration to make AI systems dependable.

  

**Strong systems engineering*** You are an experienced backend, platform, or integration engineer who has shipped and operated production software.
* You can debug across SDKs, HTTP, OAuth, webhooks, queues, data stores, logs, and third\-party APIs.
* You turn an ambiguous failure into a minimal reproduction, a root cause, and a durable fix.

  

**Customer\-adjacent building**  

* You are deliberately choosing to work closer to customers because you want a tighter loop between what you build and the impact it creates.
* You enjoy talking directly with technical users, turning a vague problem into a system, and watching that system change their outcome.
* You communicate clearly under uncertainty, ask the exact next question, and never bluff.

 **Workflow and product judgment**  

* You can model a support function as states, tools, permissions, handoffs, verification steps, and escalation rules.
* You know what should be automated, what should remain human, and how to increase autonomy without reducing trust.
* You fix the class of problem, not only the visible symptom.

  

**OPTIONAL*** TypeScript or Python in production.
* Experience building AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or eval infrastructure.
* Experience with a developer platform, API product, support engineering, SRE, or incident response.
* Familiarity with OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, rate limits, Postgres, queues, and cloud observability.
* Experience with support systems such as Plain, Zendesk, Intercom, or Salesforce.
* Public technical writing, open source contributions, or unusually good debugging notes.

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry\-specific survey data.

**ABOUT LEGION**



Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission\-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast\-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.



Legion Technologies delivers the industry's most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 We are the Global KYC and Onboarding squad in the Servicing department and we have a mission: to enable teams at Wise to expand and fine\-tune the business in a "config change" manner all across the globe, while remaining compliant and safe for the customers. There are three teams in the squad: Business Onboarding Verification, Personal Onboarding Verification and Wise Platform Verification (our B2B platform).
   

  

 The scale we operate at: In FY2025, 15\.6 million people and businesses used Wise, we onboarded over 5\.9 million new customers (\~500k/month), and moved £145\.2bn across borders (\~£400m/day) across 160\+ countries and 40\+ currencies. Our verification systems aren't supporting tools — they're core production infrastructure that protects customers, enables growth, and must stay reliable under constant change in regulations, policies, and evolving threat patterns.
   

  

 All of the teams are diverse, cross\-functional groups passionate about solving complex problems with elegant solutions. We bring together backend and frontend engineers, mobile developers, designers, data analysts, and product managers who collaborate closely to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our teams are responsible for the critical verification journeys that business and personal customers complete before using Wise's products. We own the entire verification lifecycle – from document collection flows and automated review systems to agent tooling and compliance monitoring. We operate with high ownership in a bottom\-up, transparent culture, make data\-driven decisions, and celebrate both technical excellence and customer impact. Right now we're focused on building KYC/FinCrime as a configuration\-driven product, refactoring and building new scalable microservice systems, and increasing automation using ML/AI where it genuinely improves decisioning, review quality, and operational efficiency — with safe fallbacks and clear observability. As a team that touches both regulatory requirements and customer experience, we have unique opportunities to innovate in a space traditionally resistant to change.
   

  

 By joining one of our teams, you'll directly impact these customers by transforming a traditionally frustrating experience into one that's fast, intuitive, and fair. Your code will help individuals and small businesses access global banking faster, enable entrepreneurs to pay international employees on time, and allow people like you and your teammates support their families across borders without friction. We're not just building verification systems – we're removing barriers that stand between our customers and their financial freedom.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own large\-sized, impactful projects within the domain. Your responsibilities span end\-to\-end:
   

  

 You will own the technical roadmap for your areas of ownership, ensuring they address important technical debt, reliability, scalability, and security concerns.
   

  

 You will be instrumental in designing and implementing robust backend systems that provide clean APIs and interfaces to hide the internal complexity.
   

  

 You will drive the integration with various risk and mitigation systems to ensure that Wise is compliant.
   

  

 You will take initiative to identify and solve impactful problems both within your team and beyond, contributing to high\-impact cross\-team initiatives.
   

  

**What We Expect From You**
 You have 6\+ years of experience working with Java 8\+, Spring framework, asynchronous message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), and have architected and built highly scalable microservices.
   

  

 A strong product mindset and a deep passion for both customer experience and regulatory compliance.
   

  

 You will prioritize work with a holistic view of the customer and business impact, making data\-driven decisions to solve complex, ambiguous problems.
   

  

 Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and architectural concepts clearly to diverse audiences, including product managers, designers, and other engineering teams.
   

  

 You demonstrate a commitment to writing clean, testable, maintainable, and highly performant code, and you are a strong advocate for best coding practices and rigorous code reviews.
   

  

 Proven ability to identify and lead the technical delivery of large\-scale, organisationally\-complex projects, adept at anticipating and escalating organizational blockers.
   

  

 Extensive experience working with relational and non\-relational databases, including advanced query optimization, schema design, and data lifecycle management for sensitive information.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Robotics Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Cosmoserve Space is dedicated to building a cleaner, more sustainable future for space exploration through active debris removal solutions. The company focuses on high\-tech, cost\-effective technologies that address the growing challenge of space debris and help safeguard the orbital environment. With a passionate team of specialists and a strong engineering culture, Cosmoserve Space is shaping the next generation of responsible space operations. Team members work on cutting\-edge projects that keep space accessible for future missions and long\-term exploration. Applicants can expect a mission\-driven environment where innovation and accountability guide everyday work.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 





 Cosmoserve Space operates a state\-of\-the\-art robotics laboratory used for proximity operations research — a controlled environment where robotic systems are used to study and replicate close\-range manoeuvring scenarios relevant to space missions. As a Robotics Software Engineer, your primary responsibility is to develop, maintain, and evolve the full software stack that powers this facility. You will write production\-quality code, build and extend ROS 2 based systems, and ensure the lab’s robotic platforms run reliably and safely. You will work closely with Controls Engineers who own controller design and MBD Engineers who own dynamic modelling, consuming their outputs and integrating them into the larger software architecture.
 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**ROS 2 Software Development** 





 •
 

 Design, develop, and maintain large\-scale ROS 2 based software systems for the robotics lab facility, including node architecture, launch configurations, topic/service/action interfaces, and lifecycle management.
 





 •
 

 Apply knowledge of robot kinematics and dynamics to implement correct coordinate transforms, Jacobian\-based velocity mapping, trajectory execution pipelines, and force/torque\-aware software interfaces — bridging the gap between mathematical models and running code.
 





 •
 

 Write clean, modular, well\-documented C\+\+ and Python code adhering to software engineering best practices — unit testing, code review, version control, and CI/CD pipelines.
 





 • 
 

 Develop and maintain custom ROS 2 packages for robot control, state management, sensor processing, and inter\-system communication across the lab’s robotic platforms.
 





 • 
 

 Design robust software architectures that can evolve as the facility expands — new robots, new sensors, new experiment configurations — without requiring rewrites.
 





  
 




**Facility Software Maintenance \& Operations** 





 • 
 

 Own the ongoing maintenance, debugging, and reliability of all software systems running in the robotics lab — ensuring maximum uptime and experiment readiness.
 





 • 
 

 Triage and resolve software faults across the stack, from low\-level hardware drivers and communication protocols to high\-level experiment orchestration logic.
 





 • 
 

 Manage software dependencies, ROS 2 workspace configurations, and system environments across multiple robot platforms in the lab.
 





 • 
 

 Write and maintain operational runbooks, software documentation, and onboarding guides so the facility can be operated and maintained by the wider team.
 





 • 
 

 Implement logging, monitoring, and diagnostics tooling to give the team real\-time visibility into system health during experiments.
 





  
 




**Hardware Integration \& Driver Development** 





 • 
 

 Integrate robotic hardware — manipulators, motion platforms, actuators, and sensors — into the ROS 2 ecosystem, developing or adapting hardware abstraction layers and drivers as needed.
 





 • 
 

 Interface with industrial robot controllers and motion systems via standard protocols (EtherCAT, CAN bus, Modbus, serial) and expose them as ROS 2 hardware interfaces using ros2\_control.
 





 • 
 

 Integrate sensor payloads (cameras, IMUs, encoders, force/torque sensors) and develop calibration pipelines and data synchronisation across the lab infrastructure.
 





 • 
 

 Work with MBD Engineers to consume dynamic model outputs and simulation interfaces, integrating them into the software stack for hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) test modes.
 





 • 
 

 Integrate trained RL/ML models produced by the MBD Engineering team into the ROS 2 stack — wrapping learned policies as ROS 2 nodes, managing inference pipelines, and ensuring real\-time performance constraints are met.
 





  
 




**Experiment Software \& Automation** 





 • 
 

 Develop software frameworks for configuring, launching, recording, and post\-processing experiments in the robotics lab — enabling the research team to run repeatable, parameterised test campaigns.
 





 • 
 

 Build data recording and playback infrastructure using ROS 2 bag files, enabling full experiment replay and post\-hoc analysis.
 





 • 
 

 Implement safety supervision software — workspace monitoring, joint limit enforcement, emergency stop logic — ensuring safe lab operations at all times.
 





 • 
 

 Collaborate with Controls Engineers to integrate controller outputs into the software stack, providing clean interfaces without owning controller design or tuning.
 





  
 




**REQUIRED SKILLS** 
**CATEGORY** 




**Programming:** 

 C\+\+ (strong proficiency), Python (strong proficiency), CMake, Bash scripting
 




**ROS 2:** 

 Node architecture, Launch system, Topics / Services / Actions, Lifecycle nodes, ros2\_control, Nav2, MoveIt 2, ROS 2 bag
 




**Software Engineering:** 

 Git, CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI), Unit \& integration testing, Code review, Documentation
 




**Hardware Integration:** 

 ros2\_control, Hardware abstraction layers, EtherCAT / CAN bus / serial protocols, Driver development
 




**Sensing \& Data:** 

 Camera / IMU / encoder / F/T sensor integration, Sensor calibration, ROS 2 bag recording \& playback
 




**System \& DevOps:** 

 Linux / Ubuntu, Docker, Systemd services, Networking (TCP/IP, DDS / FastDDS), Multi\-machine ROS 2 setups
 




**Simulation:** 

 Gazebo / Ignition, RViz 2, URDF / XACRO — for software\-in\-the\-loop testing and model validation
 




**Robotics Fundamentals:** 

 Solid understanding of robot kinematics (FK/IK, Jacobians, DH parameters) and dynamics (equations of motion, torque/force relationships) — applied to writing correct software for trajectory execution, coordinate transforms, and hardware interfacing
 





  
 




**NICE TO HAVE** 





 • 
 

 Experience with real\-time Linux (PREEMPT\-RT) or real\-time middleware (Orocos, micro\-ROS) for low\-latency control interfaces.
 





 •  
 

 Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac ROS or GPU\-accelerated perception pipelines for robot vision.
 





 • 
 

 Experience with robot operating facility or lab management software — experiment orchestration, scheduling, and remote monitoring.
 





 •  
 

 Background in software architecture for multi\-robot systems or distributed ROS 2 deployments.
 





 • 
 

 Knowledge of DDS middleware configuration (FastDDS, CycloneDDS) for reliable multi\-machine communication.
 





 •  
 

 Experience with web\-based robot monitoring dashboards (e.g., Foxglove Studio, custom WebSocket / REST interfaces).
 





 • 
 

 Familiarity with space proximity operations, relative motion dynamics, or orbital mechanics at a conceptual level.
 





 •  
 

 Prior experience maintaining a shared research facility or lab software infrastructure.
 





  
 




**QUALIFICATIONS** 





 • 
 

 B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field.
 





 • 
 

 2–3 years of hands\-on experience developing production\-quality software for robotic systems.
 





 • 
 

 Strong proficiency in C\+\+ and Python with demonstrated experience architecting and maintaining large, complex codebases — multi\-package ROS 2 workspaces, shared libraries, and long\-lived production systems rather than one\-off scripts or prototypes.
 





 • 
 

 Solid ROS 2 experience: building multi\-package workspaces, writing custom nodes, configuring launch files, and integrating hardware via ros2\_control.
 





 • 
 

 Sound understanding of robot kinematics and dynamics — forward/inverse kinematics, Jacobians, equations of motion — applied to writing software that correctly implements trajectory execution, coordinate transforms, and hardware interfaces.
 





 • E
 

 xperience integrating real robot hardware into a ROS 2 stack, including driver development or adaptation.
 





 • 
 

 Comfortable owning a complex software system end\-to\-end — development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and documentation.
 





 • 
 

 Familiarity with software engineering practices: version control workflows, CI/CD, automated testing, and code review.

title: SB-1501-Senior .NET Developer / Technical Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
----------------


We are looking for a **Senior .NET Developer / Technical Lead** with 7–10 years of strong hands\-on development experience and proven expertise in **technical architecture, application security, Azure, code quality, and team leadership**.
The role will be responsible for developing and modernizing enterprise\-grade .NET applications, designing scalable and secure technical solutions, reviewing and vetting code developed by other resources, and ensuring adherence to established architectural and security standards.
The candidate will work extensively on **authentication and credential security, cryptography, Azure Key Vault, API security, secure coding, vulnerability remediation, observability, performance, and legacy .NET application modernization**.
The role also requires the ability to lead developers technically, identify implementation risks, make architecture\-level decisions, and actively adopt **AI\-driven and specification\-driven development practices** to improve engineering productivity and delivery quality.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Development \& Technical Architecture**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using **C\#, ASP.NET MVC/Web API, .NET Framework and related Microsoft technologies**.
* Analyze existing applications and understand legacy architecture, dependencies, business flows, and technical constraints before implementing changes.
* Design scalable, maintainable, secure, and high\-performing application architectures.
* Define technical approaches, application components, integrations, APIs, data flows, and security mechanisms.
* Participate in architecture discussions and prepare technical design solutions for complex requirements.
* Ensure implementations follow established architectural patterns, coding standards, SOLID principles, and secure development practices.
* Identify technical debt, architectural risks, performance bottlenecks, and security weaknesses and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Work closely with Azure/DevOps resources to ensure application architecture aligns with infrastructure and deployment architecture.

### **Application Security \& Authentication**

* Implement and review secure authentication, authorization, password management, password reset, password history, and session\-management flows.
* Implement **bcrypt/Argon2id password hashing** and lazy re\-hashing/migration strategies for existing accounts.
* Implement secure random salt generation and eliminate static or hardcoded salts.
* Secure sensitive credentials and application secrets through appropriate key and secret management mechanisms.
* Implement and review **RSA, AES/symmetric encryption, hashing, encryption/decryption, key rotation, and secure key\-management practices**.
* Implement secure migration and re\-encryption of existing sensitive database values.
* Integrate applications with **Azure Key Vault** for RSA keys, symmetric keys, secrets, and tokenized credentials.
* Review and secure authentication cookies, including **Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite** attributes.
* Implement API security controls including authentication protection and **rate limiting for login, password\-reset, and related endpoints**.
* Ensure sensitive information is not exposed through APIs, logs, configuration files, resource files, or repositories.
* Apply **OWASP secure coding principles** and security best practices throughout development.

### **Code Review \& Technical Governance**

* Act as the primary technical reviewer for code delivered by other developers.
* Perform detailed **code reviews and architecture reviews** across backend components.
* Vet implementations for correctness, security, scalability, maintainability, performance, and architectural compliance.
* Identify security vulnerabilities, poor coding practices, technical debt, and architectural deviations.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, branching practices, and development guidelines.
* Review and validate database changes, API contracts, authentication implementations, encryption mechanisms, and third\-party integrations.
* Guide junior and mid\-level developers on technical implementation and troubleshooting.
* Ensure Critical/High findings from **SonarQube and vulnerability scans** are appropriately addressed.

### **Azure, DevSecOps \& Reliability**

* Work with **Azure Key Vault, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Azure monitoring, Application Insights, and related Azure services**.
* Ensure secure configuration and deployment practices across environments.
* Support removal of hardcoded secrets/keys from application resources and configuration.
* Implement appropriate retry, timeout, error\-handling, and dependency\-failure strategies.
* Contribute to resilience and redundancy considerations for security\-sensitive components.
* Support repository security, Git history cleanup, secret scanning, and .gitignore protection.
* Implement **correlation IDs, structured logging, security\-event logging, monitoring, and observability** across modified flows.
* Support dead\-letter/error handling for applicable asynchronous operations.
* Participate in vulnerability scanning, static code analysis, remediation, and security verification.

### **Testing \& Quality**

* Develop and maintain high\-quality, testable backend code.
* Write and review **unit and integration tests** for authentication, credential, API, and security\-sensitive flows.
* Support performance testing of login and authentication flows following credential\-storage changes.
* Work closely with QA to identify and resolve defects and improve test coverage.
* Review regression results and ensure all affected authentication and security flows are validated.
* Ensure implementation evidence, test results, scan results, and remediation details are properly documented in **Azure DevOps**.

### **Team Leadership \& Delivery**

* Provide day\-to\-day technical direction to developers working on the project.
* Break down complex technical requirements into appropriate implementation approaches.
* Mentor developers and support technical problem\-solving.
* Review estimates and technical feasibility of proposed solutions.
* Identify technical risks and dependencies early and communicate them to the Engineering/Delivery team.
* Coordinate with frontend, QA, DevOps, and project management teams to ensure smooth delivery.
* Take ownership of technical quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed architecture, security, and coding standards.
* Participate in sprint planning, technical discussions, reviews, retrospectives, and client\-facing technical discussions where required.

### **AI\-Driven Development**

* Actively use **AI\-assisted development tools** to improve development speed, code quality, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* Work with tools such as **GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot, and other AI\-powered engineering tools**.
* Apply AI\-assisted and specification\-driven development practices across requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, code review, testing, and documentation.
* Use AI tools responsibly for code generation, refactoring, test generation, documentation, debugging, and code analysis while maintaining engineering review and security controls.
* Evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, security, architectural compliance, performance, and maintainability before integration.
* Stay current with emerging AI development practices and contribute to adoption of AI\-enabled engineering workflows within the team.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

**Domain** **Skills \& Technologies** **Must / Preferred**  

Backend Development C\#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, .NET Framework 4\.x, REST APIs **Must**  


Architecture Enterprise application architecture, scalable architecture, SOLID, design patterns, clean architecture, technical design **Must**  


Database SQL Server, database design, queries, migrations, data transformation **Must**

Application Security OWASP, secure coding, vulnerability remediation, security reviews **Must**  


Secure Cookies Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, session security **Must**  


DevOps Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD, repository security **Must**  


Code Quality SonarQube, static code analysis, code review, dependency/vulnerability scanning **Must**  


Observability Application Insights, Azure Monitor, structured logging, security\-event logging, correlation IDs **Must**  


Reliability Retry policies, timeout handling, circuit breaker concepts, dependency failure handling, resilience **Must**  


Messaging Dead\-letter queues / asynchronous failure handling **Preferred**

Performance Authentication/API performance testing and optimization **Must**  


Cloud Azure services, application hosting, secure configuration **Must**  


AI Development GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, AI\-assisted coding, specification\-driven development **Must**  


AI Architecture AI agents, MCP, AI orchestration, Microsoft AI ecosystem **Preferred****Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Skills**

* Experience modernizing or securing **legacy .NET applications**.
