title: AI / Senior AI Engineer
description:
**The role**
 Most companies that say they "build AI" are wiring API calls to somebody else's model. We do that too, where it makes sense. But the interesting problems at Innovaccer are the ones a general\-purpose model cannot solve: reasoning over a patient record that spans eleven systems and thirty years, deciding whether a prior authorization meets a payer policy that changed last Tuesday, extracting a diagnosis code with an accuracy bar where being wrong has consequences.
   

  

 Those problems need models we train, evaluate, and own.
   

  

 This team builds them. You will work on post\-training and domain adaptation of language models from a few billion parameters up to the hundreds of billions, agent architectures that hold up over long horizons, evaluation systems that tell the truth, and the inference infrastructure that gets all of it running under real latency and cost budgets. You will read papers on Monday and have something running by Friday. You will also be the person who takes it to production, because we do not have a research group that throws prototypes over a wall.
   

  

 Innovaccer is committing $250M over three years to its agentic AI platform. This team is where a meaningful share of that goes.
   

  

**What You Will Work On**
 Nobody does all of this. You go deep on one or two areas and stay conversant in the rest.
   

  

**Building the model systems behind entire products**
 Our products are not one model with a prompt in front of it. Flow, our revenue cycle platform, runs document understanding, policy retrieval and reasoning, code assignment, denial prediction, and drafting, each with different accuracy, latency, and cost requirements. Somebody has to design the whole thing and make the pieces work together.
   

  

 That is a core part of this job. You will own the model portfolio behind a product surface, which means:
   

  

* Fine\-tuning across the full size range. Small language models in the 1B to 8B range for high\-volume, latency\-sensitive, cost\-constrained tasks. Medium models in the 8B to 70B range where the reasoning gets harder. Large open\-weight models from 100B into the hundreds of billions where the task genuinely demands frontier capability. Knowing which tier a task actually needs is a judgment call worth a lot of money, and getting it wrong in either direction is expensive
* Composing them into a system. Routing and cascades, small models handling the common case with escalation to larger ones, retrieval and tool layers, structured decoding, verifier models checking generator output, and the fallback paths for when a component fails
* Owning it in production. Versioning across a model fleet, shadow deployment, staged rollout, drift detection, retraining triggers, and the regression suite that runs before anything ships
* Holding a product\-level accuracy bar, not a per\-model benchmark score. A pipeline of individually good models can still produce a bad product, and finding out why is your problem


**Post\-training at scale**
 Domain adaptation of open\-weight models to clinical, claims, and payer\-policy data, across the full size range described above.
   

  

* Supervised fine\-tuning, preference optimization (DPO, GRPO, and what replaces them), and RL with verifiable rewards on tasks where correctness is machine\-checkable
* Continued pretraining and domain\-adaptive pretraining where the vocabulary and distribution shift enough to justify it
* Parameter\-efficient methods where they suffice, full fine\-tuning where they do not, and the experimental discipline to know which case you are in
* Distillation from large teachers into small models that hold the accuracy bar at a fraction of the serving cost
* Reward modeling, and the harder problem of specifying reward on tasks where clinical correctness is contested


 Running these jobs is its own discipline. You will work with multi\-node training on hundreds of GPUs: FSDP and DeepSpeed, tensor and pipeline and sequence parallelism, activation checkpointing, mixed precision and its failure modes, checkpoint and resume strategy, throughput and MFU tuning, and diagnosing the loss spike at hour 40 of a run that cost real money. Experience keeping a large distributed run healthy is a specific skill and we are hiring for it explicitly.
   

  

**Data: raw to training\-ready**
 This is where most of the actual gain comes from, and it is the part most candidates undersell.
   

  

 Healthcare data does not arrive as a dataset. It arrives as HL7 feeds, FHIR bundles, claims files, PDFs, scanned faxes, free\-text notes with inconsistent structure, and payer policy documents that change without notice. Turning that into a training corpus is a research problem in its own right.
   

  

* Building the pipelines that take raw, messy, multi\-format healthcare data to deduplicated, decontaminated, quality\-filtered, PHI\-safe training data
* Data mixture design and the experiments that justify it. Ablations on what to include, at what ratio, and at what stage of training
* Synthetic data generation, self\-instruct and teacher\-model pipelines, rejection sampling, and the quality controls that keep synthetic data from quietly poisoning a run
* Annotation strategy with clinical and coding experts on staff: what to label, how to measure inter\-annotator agreement, and when expert disagreement means your task definition is wrong rather than your labelers
* Decontamination against your own eval sets, done properly, before someone else finds the leak


**Agents and reasoning systems**
 Multi\-step agents that complete real operational work rather than producing suggestions: submitting an authorization, closing a care gap, resolving a denial. Tool use, planning, memory, and recovery from failure. Research questions here are open: how to train agentic behavior rather than prompt it, how to do credit assignment over long trajectories, how to make an agent recognize it is failing and stop. The hard part is reliability over long horizons when every intermediate step can go wrong, and the failure modes are not amusing.
   

  

**Evaluation, safety, and guardrails**
 Eval is a research function here, not a QA step.
   

  

* Designing task\-specific benchmarks where no public benchmark exists, which in clinical operations is most of the time
* LLM\-as\-judge calibration against clinical expert labels, and knowing when the judge is the thing that is broken
* Statistical rigor: confidence intervals on eval results, sample size, and resisting the pull of a number that looks good
* PHI detection and redaction, output guardrails, and the audit trails that let a health system trust an autonomous workflow. Every agent we ship keeps a human in the loop somewhere, and part of this work is deciding where


**Inference and production ML**
 Serving small and large models efficiently: quantization, speculative decoding, continuous batching, KV\-cache strategy, GPU utilization. Latency and cost budgets are real constraints, not afterthoughts. Building the training and deployment pipelines that let the team go from a notebook to a production endpoint in days.
   

  

**What We Expect From Everyone In This Role**
* You take an idea from paper to prototype to production. If you have only ever done one of those three, this role will stretch you, and we are fine with that if the rest is strong
* You can build the model layer of a real product, not just a model. That means choosing model sizes, composing several models into a working system, and holding a product\-level accuracy bar
* You write real code. Python fluently, PyTorch fluently, and enough systems sense to know why your training run is slow
* You design experiments. You state the hypothesis, run the ablation, and report the result that disagrees with you
* You measure things. You are suspicious of results that look good, and you build the eval before you build the model
* You read current research and can tell the difference between a technique that will hold up and one that will not
* You explain your work to people who are not AI engineers, including clinicians and operators who will tell you when your output is wrong


**Qualifications By Level**
**AI Engineer / AI Researcher**
* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. Exceptional BS candidates with substantial research or open\-source work will be considered
* Depth beyond coursework: first\-author publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or similar; meaningful open\-source ML contributions; a research internship at an AI lab; or models you trained and shipped that people actually used
* You have fine\-tuned an open\-weight model yourself, understand the difference between parameter\-efficient and full fine\-tuning, and can explain why you chose one
* Strong Python and PyTorch. Familiarity with the current training and serving stack (HuggingFace, FSDP or DeepSpeed, vLLM or SGLang, or equivalents)
* Some exposure to multi\-GPU training, even at lab scale. You should know what a sharding strategy is and why it matters
* Evidence you can finish things


**Senior AI Engineer / Senior AI Researcher**
 Everything above, plus:
   

  

* You have post\-trained models that ran in production and you know what broke
* You have built the model layer behind a real product feature, including fine\-tuning at more than one model size and composing multiple models into a system that met a production accuracy and latency bar
* Hands\-on multi\-node training experience, tens of GPUs at minimum, on models in the tens of billions of parameters or larger
* You have built or substantially owned a data pipeline that fed a real training run, including the unglamorous parts: dedup, filtering, decontamination, format normalization
* You can scope an ambiguous problem into a plan and tell the difference between a research question and an engineering task
* Mentoring or setting direction for other engineers is a plus and will matter more as the team grows


 Things that stand out
   

  

* Public artifacts: papers, repos, model weights, technical reports, benchmark contributions
* You have shipped a product where intelligence was the product, and can walk through every model decision you made and what you would do differently
* Reinforcement learning applied to language models, done rather than read about
* Work on evaluation methodology, which is underrated and hard to hire for
* Data\-centric research: you can point to a gain that came from the corpus rather than the architecture
* Systems background: CUDA, NCCL and collective communication tuning, distributed training frameworks, compiler or kernel work
* You have built something in a regulated or high\-stakes domain and understand why "usually right" is not a spec


**Why this team**
 Model quality is not the bottleneck in healthcare AI. Context is. Innovaccer has spent over a decade building the data foundation underneath American healthcare: clinical, claims, financial, and operational data unified across Millions of patient lives. That foundation is Gravity, our Healthcare Autonomy Platform™, and it is what our agent families run on across revenue cycle, population health, payer risk and quality, and patient access.
   

  

 What that means for you concretely:
   

  

* Training data most labs cannot get. Real longitudinal clinical and claims data at scale, under strict governance, for training and evaluation
* Compute for real runs. Budgeted for multi\-hundred\-GPU post\-training, not just inference
* Ground truth on tap. Clinical and coding experts on staff who will label your data and tell you when your model is wrong
* Products waiting for your models. Four agent families already in production at enterprise health systems and payers. What you train ships into, not into a demo environment
* A team is being built now. This group defines the in\-house modeling function. You will shape what it becomes rather than inherit it


 Innovaccer is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate candidates on the quality of their thinking and their work.

title: AI Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in shape for your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help build a better working world.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a mid\-level AI engineer to play an integral role in our machine learning projects. This position requires designing, developing, and implementing advanced AI models with minimal supervision.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field with a minimum of 5\-7 years' experience.
* Should have been involved in end\-to\-end delivery of the scalable, optimized and enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience in performing prompt engineering and fine\-tuning of the AI/ML, GenAI, LLM models \& building Agents, Multi Agent System
* Practical hands\-on fine\-tuning/transfer learning/optimization of the Transformer architecture\-based Deep Learning models.
* Experience in Agentic AI, Gen AI, LLM, NLP tools such as Word2Vec,, NLTK, SpaCy,BERT, GloVe,Autogen,Langchain, Langraph, etc
* A working understanding of cloud platforms either of AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure
* Good programming skills in Python along with experiences with Python frameworks such as Flask for lightweight applications, and FastAPI for building APIs.
* Experience in Docker for deploying the containers.
* Experience in NoSQL/SQL databases/Vector Databases.
* Strong knowledge of statistical methods and experimental design.
* Experience with MLOps practices for CI/CD in machine learning.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or related field
* Solid understanding of machine learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning
* Proficiency in Python and experience with frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit\-Learn
* Experience setting up Docker images and utilizing NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB)
* Familiarity with Retrieval Augmented Generation and AI agent platforms
* Practical experience in testing methodologies and debugging complex codebases
* Understanding of CI/CD principles and tools like GitHub Actions
* Experience with cloud services (Azure preferred) for deploying models
* Hands\-on experience developing and deploying LLM\-based AI agents


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Solid understanding of statistics, classical statistical models, and optimization techniques at a mid\-career level
* Experience applying risk management concepts within AI and ML applications


**What We Look For**
 We want people who are self\-starters, who can take initiative and get things done. If you can think critically and creatively to solve problems, you will excel. You should be comfortable working with culturally diverse outsourced on/offshore team members, which means you may need to work outside normal working hours. Some travel may be required.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Tech S and T-Network Engineer Senior-GDSN02
description:

* Strong skills in Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).

* Exposure to MLOps/AI integration using MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, KServe, or Seldon.
* Familiar with cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), configuration management (Ansible/Puppet), and GitOps tools (Argo CD/Flux).
* Strong communication, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills with ability to work cross‑functionally.


**Experience**
* 4 to 7 years


**Education**
* B.Tech. / BS in Computer Science


**Technical Skills \& Certifications**
* Terraform, Pulumi, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), Docker/Podman, Helm, Kustomize
* CI/CD tools: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps
* Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
* Python, Bash, PowerShell scripting
* DevSecOps tools: Snyk, SonarQube, Trivy, Checkmarx, GitLeaks, TruffleHog
* Policy\-as\-code (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno) and SBOM tools (Syft, CycloneDX)
* MLOps tools: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI
* Model serving frameworks: KServe, Seldon Core, BentoML, Ray Serve
* Vector DBs \& RAG stack: Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, LangChain, LlamaIndex
* Monitoring \& observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger

 Behind that impact is a global team of passionate problem\-solvers, engineers, and innovators who are redefining what’s possible in data connectivity.
   

  

 Headquartered in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, CData has over 500 team members, with offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. We take pride not just in what we build, but in how we build it: together, with curiosity, creativity, and a shared drive to push boundaries.
   

  

 This position will join our India team, operating out of our Bangalore office where we have nearly 100 team members.
   

  

**Role Description**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Principal Software Engineer to join our SaaS product development team. What makes this Principal Software Engineer role at CData unique is that it's a true technical leadership position, not a pure architecture or management role. We're looking for someone who wants to remain deeply involved in software development, enjoys solving complex technical problems, and is still passionate about writing great code.
   

  

 As a Principal Engineer, you'll help define technical direction and influence product strategy, but you'll also be hands\-on in the development process. We believe the best technical leaders stay close to the code, understand the challenges their teams face, and lead by example.
   

  

 This role offers significant influence. You'll have the opportunity to shape the product roadmap, drive architectural decisions, and help build engineering best practices across one of CData's largest engineering organizations outside of our US headquarters. You'll also play an important role in mentoring and coaching junior engineers, helping them grow into strong technical contributors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and development of robust, scalable, and cloud\-native SaaS solutions using Java and .NET technologies.
* Build highly available and fault\-tolerant systems to support a rapidly growing user base.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the development team, driving best practices and ensuring code quality.
* Optimize system performance and scalability through efficient design and implementation.
* Conduct code reviews, identify areas for improvement, and implement solutions to enhance product quality and reliability.
* Stay updated with the latest cloud technologies and industry trends and evaluate new tools and frameworks to enhance development efficiency.
* Drive innovation and continuous improvement within the SaaS product development process.


**Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in software development with expertise in Java technologies.
* Proven experience in designing and architecting cloud\-native SaaS solutions.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Experience with Spring Boot, Hibernate, Kotlin, and other Java frameworks for building scalable applications.
* Proficiency in database technologies such as SQL, NoSQL, etc.
* Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices is a plus


**Additional Skills**
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Self\-motivated and strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.

Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World\-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 You’ll lead the deployment and scaling of a next\-generation AI platform designed to connect strategy to execution through advanced analytics, machine learning, and agentic systems.
   

  

 You'll work directly with clients, embedded in their environments, navigating real\-world constraints that don't surface in controlled settings. The combination of hands\-on engineering, client\-facing delivery, and direct product influence defines your role.
   

  

 You will sit at the intersection of software engineering and infrastructure, bringing advanced AI capabilities into real\-world environments and ensuring they work at scale. You’ll be at the center of how these systems are deployed, adopted, and operated, helping organizations translate complex AI strategies into practical, high\-impact solutions.
   

  

 You'll take ownership of the platform delivery lifecycle, including the most demanding engagements, where environments are often non\-standard and requirements evolve quickly. You’ll lead large\-scale, multi\-workstream deployments across cloud and hybrid infrastructures in enterprise environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), guiding architectural decisions and setting direction for complex deployments across engagements.
   

  

 Your work frequently involves containerized and distributed systems, including Kubernetes\-based environments, where reliability, scalability, and operational stability are critical. From validating performance and resilience to ensuring structured handovers, your work ensures systems are production\-ready and built to last. Along the way, you’ll help shape how delivery is structured across teams, evolving tooling, automation, and delivery practices based on real\-world experience, and working hands\-on to resolve complex issues in production.
   

  

 The impact of your work is tangible. You’ll enable clients to run advanced AI\-driven workflows and manage intelligent systems within their existing technology ecosystems, often in regulated or multi\-region settings. Working closely with senior technical stakeholders, you’ll help define deployment strategies, navigate complex challenges, and guide adoption through practical, experience\-led best practices. Your perspective from the field will also feed directly into product development, influencing how QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, technology continues to evolve. You'll maintain a continuous feedback loop with the product team — surfacing patterns from the field, contributing to issue resolution, and helping ensure that real\-world deployment experience shapes the platform's evolution.
   

  

 Based in one of our India offices, you’ll work closely with engineers, product teams, and technical experts across the QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, global community. Beyond leading deployments, you’ll collaborate with data scientists, machine learning engineers, designers, and technologists on interdisciplinary initiatives, contributing to a broader ecosystem of AI innovation. You’ll also play a key role in developing others—mentoring engineers, reviewing approaches, and helping teams raise the bar for quality and delivery. Together, you’ll help operationalize advanced AI systems across industries, driving successful delivery, validation, and adoption in client environments.
   

  

 At QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, you’ll thrive in an unparalleled environment for growth. You’ll develop a sought\-after perspective by connecting technology and business value, work across industries, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to unlock the transformative potential of AI, while advancing as a technologist and leader.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering, artificial intelligence, or a related field

* Strong understanding of data architectures and platform design, including hands\-on experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) and familiarity with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j), alongside data pipelines and system integration patterns

description:

Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem\-solver who is energized by challenges? **You’ve come to the right place.**

---------------


You will collaborate with our Social, Healthcare and Public Entities (SHaPE) analytics teams in other technology hubs in the US, Europe, India, and Costa Rica.
SHaPE Tech combines advanced analytics, software engineering, and deep industry expertise to build innovative technology solutions for social, public, and healthcare organizations worldwide. You will lead the development of innovative technology assets and shape the engineering roadmap across a broad range of topics. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, you’ll create reusable components, provide technical vision, and align stakeholders on current and future architectures to deliver high\-value, scalable solutions.
You will drive engineering excellence through clean architecture, reusable components, coding standards, and design reviews, while ensuring applications meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, observability, reliability, and performance.
You will own technical roadmaps and translate business objectives into scalable engineering solutions. You will lead modernization initiatives involving cloud migration, platform engineering, and application transformation, while partnering with DevOps and Platform Engineering teams to deploy cloud\-native applications using container technologies. You will also build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release processes.
Your work will enable real\-world impact by accelerating product development and creating reusable core components. By contributing to McKinsey’s shift toward asset\-based consulting, you’ll help expand the firm’s entrepreneurial culture and deliver scalable, high\-quality solutions that address complex client challenges.
Your work offers a unique opportunity to grow as a technology leader. Supported by McKinsey’s global network and leadership development resources, you’ll collaborate with diverse experts, expand your skillset, and lead at the forefront of technology innovation.
**YOUR GROWTH**
---------------


Driving lasting impact and building long\-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture \- doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
* **Continuous learning:** Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* **A voice that matters:** From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* **Global community:** With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* **World\-class benefits:** On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.
**YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**
----------------------------------


* Advanced degree in a quantitative field like computer science, machine learning, applied statistics or mathematics, or equivalent experience
* 8\+ years of relevant experience
* Proven experience developing full\-stack applications by writing code that is readable, testable, maintainable, and scalable
* Demonstrated knowledge and hands\-on experience across the full application stack with a variety of languages/frameworks
* Proficient in either Cloud technologies e.g. AWS, Azure or GCP
* Ideally experience working with internal clients whose requirements are different depending on their use cases
* Experience working in Agile teams, including active participation in sprint ceremonies
* Experience pair programming collaboratively with other developers
* Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with other developers, as well as technical and non\-technical people within software teams
* While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, we often leverage the following technologies: Java, JavaScript, R, Python, SQL
* Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and local office language(s), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels
Please review the additional requirements regarding essential job functions of McKinsey colleagues.
Our unwavering commitment to integrity drives everything we do, guiding us to always act in the best interests of our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.

description:
Role Summary
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Senior .NET Developer / Technical Lead** 
 with 7–10 years of strong hands\-on development experience and proven expertise in
 **technical architecture, application security, Azure, code quality, and team leadership** 
 .
   

  

 The role will be responsible for developing and modernizing enterprise\-grade .NET applications, designing scalable and secure technical solutions, reviewing and vetting code developed by other resources, and ensuring adherence to established architectural and security standards.
   

  

 The candidate will work extensively on
 **authentication and credential security, cryptography, Azure Key Vault, API security, secure coding, vulnerability remediation, observability, performance, and legacy .NET application modernization** 
 .
   

  

 The role also requires the ability to lead developers technically, identify implementation risks, make architecture\-level decisions, and actively adopt
 **AI\-driven and specification\-driven development practices** 
 to improve engineering productivity and delivery quality.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Development \& Technical Architecture
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using C\#, ASP.NET MVC/Web API, .NET Framework and related Microsoft technologies.
* Analyze existing applications and understand legacy architecture, dependencies, business flows, and technical constraints before implementing changes.
* Design scalable, maintainable, secure, and high\-performing application architectures.
* Define technical approaches, application components, integrations, APIs, data flows, and security mechanisms.
* Participate in architecture discussions and prepare technical design solutions for complex requirements.
* Ensure implementations follow established architectural patterns, coding standards, SOLID principles, and secure development practices.
* Identify technical debt, architectural risks, performance bottlenecks, and security weaknesses and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Work closely with Azure/DevOps resources to ensure application architecture aligns with infrastructure and deployment architecture.


 Application Security \& Authentication
   

  

* Implement and review secure authentication, authorization, password management, password reset, password history, and session\-management flows.
* Implement bcrypt/Argon2id password hashing and lazy re\-hashing/migration strategies for existing accounts.
* Implement secure random salt generation and eliminate static or hardcoded salts.
* Secure sensitive credentials and application secrets through appropriate key and secret management mechanisms.
* Implement and review RSA, AES/symmetric encryption, hashing, encryption/decryption, key rotation, and secure key\-management practices.
* Implement secure migration and re\-encryption of existing sensitive database values.
* Integrate applications with Azure Key Vault for RSA keys, symmetric keys, secrets, and tokenized credentials.
* Review and secure authentication cookies, including Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite attributes.
* Implement API security controls including authentication protection and rate limiting for login, password\-reset, and related endpoints.
* Ensure sensitive information is not exposed through APIs, logs, configuration files, resource files, or repositories.
* Apply OWASP secure coding principles and security best practices throughout development.


 Code Review \& Technical Governance
   

  

* Act as the primary technical reviewer for code delivered by other developers.
* Perform detailed code reviews and architecture reviews across backend components.
* Vet implementations for correctness, security, scalability, maintainability, performance, and architectural compliance.
* Identify security vulnerabilities, poor coding practices, technical debt, and architectural deviations.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, branching practices, and development guidelines.
* Review and validate database changes, API contracts, authentication implementations, encryption mechanisms, and third\-party integrations.
* Guide junior and mid\-level developers on technical implementation and troubleshooting.
* Ensure Critical/High findings from SonarQube and vulnerability scans are appropriately addressed.


 Azure, DevSecOps \& Reliability
   

  

* Work with Azure Key Vault, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Azure monitoring, Application Insights, and related Azure services.
* Ensure secure configuration and deployment practices across environments.
* Support removal of hardcoded secrets/keys from application resources and configuration.
* Implement appropriate retry, timeout, error\-handling, and dependency\-failure strategies.
* Contribute to resilience and redundancy considerations for security\-sensitive components.
* Support repository security, Git history cleanup, secret scanning, and .gitignore protection.
* Implement correlation IDs, structured logging, security\-event logging, monitoring, and observability across modified flows.
* Support dead\-letter/error handling for applicable asynchronous operations.
* Participate in vulnerability scanning, static code analysis, remediation, and security verification.


 Testing \& Quality
   

  

* Develop and maintain high\-quality, testable backend code.
* Write and review unit and integration tests for authentication, credential, API, and security\-sensitive flows.
* Support performance testing of login and authentication flows following credential\-storage changes.
* Work closely with QA to identify and resolve defects and improve test coverage.
* Review regression results and ensure all affected authentication and security flows are validated.
* Ensure implementation evidence, test results, scan results, and remediation details are properly documented in Azure DevOps.


 Team Leadership \& Delivery
   

  

* Provide day\-to\-day technical direction to developers working on the project.
* Break down complex technical requirements into appropriate implementation approaches.
* Mentor developers and support technical problem\-solving.
* Review estimates and technical feasibility of proposed solutions.
* Identify technical risks and dependencies early and communicate them to the Engineering/Delivery team.
* Coordinate with frontend, QA, DevOps, and project management teams to ensure smooth delivery.
* Take ownership of technical quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed architecture, security, and coding standards.
* Participate in sprint planning, technical discussions, reviews, retrospectives, and client\-facing technical discussions where required.


 AI\-Driven Development
   

  

* Actively use AI\-assisted development tools to improve development speed, code quality, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* Work with tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot, and other AI\-powered engineering tools.
* Apply AI\-assisted and specification\-driven development practices across requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, code review, testing, and documentation.
* Use AI tools responsibly for code generation, refactoring, test generation, documentation, debugging, and code analysis while maintaining engineering review and security controls.
* Evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, security, architectural compliance, performance, and maintainability before integration.
* Stay current with emerging AI development practices and contribute to adoption of AI\-enabled engineering workflows within the team.

title: Lead Software Engineer (ERP Modernisation)
description:
**Company Description:** 




 Partap Singh and Sons (PSS), established in 1951, is a leading distributor of automobile spare parts across Western, Central, Northern, and Eastern India. The company partners with major manufacturers including TVS SFL, Tata Motors, Ashok Leyland, Mahindra \& Mahindra, Force Motors, Maxion Wheels, Rane group companies, Schaeffler, and ZF Wabco, serving more than 18,000 customers across heavy, medium, car segments, and industrial fasteners. PSS also exports to multiple global markets. The organization aims to be the comprehensive solution provider for all aftermarket needs and relies on proprietary software to support its nationwide operational network. This focus on technology and innovation creates a dynamic environment for engineering talent looking to impact core business systems.
 



  





**Role Description:** 




 The Lead Software Engineer (ERP Modernisation) is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The role involves leading the modernization of PSS’s proprietary ERP and related systems, including designing scalable architectures, refactoring legacy components, and implementing secure, efficient back\-end services. 
 



  





**Why this role exists:** 




 Partap Singh \& Sons has distributed automobile spare parts since 1951\. Ninety\-plus branches across twenty states. Authorised distributor for Bosch, ZF, Tata Motors, Mahindra and Ashok Leyland. Fourth\-generation, family\-run, and one of the larger independent distribution networks in the country.
 



 For two decades the business has run on a VB.NET WinForms ERP: 1\.24 million lines of code, 18 modules, 215 screens, 1,808 Crystal Reports, on a single SQL Server 2008 box.
 



  





 We have started the development on the replacement. 
 



 PSS One is Python and React, developed in\-house, with a /core rulebook of 122 money\-checks and an MCP server so AI agents can operate the system directly rather than screen\-scrape it. It has been reconciled against real production data: 630 invoices recomputed at 99\.8% accuracy, full\-year double\-entry integrity confirmed across all 94 branch sets, receivables ageing clean across 915 debtors. Offline billing has been proven in test. The PSS Go field app and our public sites already run on the new stack.
 



  





 It is not yet live. The legacy system still holds the books. PSS One is in trials, against a copy of the data, and no branch has cut over. That is the job. Finish what is still unbuilt, then move ninety branches across without a single day's billing going wrong.
 



  





**What you will own end to end:** 



* The switchover \- Two branch write\-paths (goods receipt and stock adjustment) are specified but not built, and they close a branch's full daily cycle. Then clerk trials, a five\-branch test, and fleet rollout across the network. You own the runbook, the pass conditions and the rollback.
* The report estate \- 1,808 Crystal Reports do not carry across. Establishing which ones are actually alive, and rebuilding those, is roughly forty percent of the remaining work.
* The head\-office console \- bank reconciliation, expense posting, purchase orders, item\-code approval, branch reconciliation, year\-end close. Partly specified, none of it built. This is a substantial body of work sitting outside the branch rollout entirely.
* GST and other taxation workflows: The existing ERP is used heavily for any GST and other tax\-related filings and workflows (from procurement, to expenses, to sale). This has to be further automated and streamlined. Statutory e\-invoicing still runs in the legacy system and has to move.
* Branch\-to\-head\-office data flow \- Sync, offline queue, conflict resolution, reconnect rules. Move from a single on\-prem server to branches syncing to a cloud brain.
* The AI integration \- Extending the /core rulebook and the MCP surface so agents can safely do more of the routine work.



  





**What we are looking for:** 




**Required** 



* 4–8 years building systems where money moves: ERP, billing, payments, accounting, logistics or supply chain. We care far more about this than about your industry
* Strong Python and actively working with React. You need not be a front\-end specialist, but you should be able to ship a screen end to end
* Real SQL Server depth: query plans, indexing, and the ability to explain why a report takes forty seconds
* Everyday, serious use of AI coding tools, together with a clear sense of where you stop trusting them. Candidates who have never used them and candidates who trust them completely will both struggle here
* The ability to read twenty\-year\-old VB.NET without contempt.
* Willingness to sit with a branch accountant in Indore and explain a change in language or a UI/screen interface she would use
* B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent



  





**Preferred, but not essential** 




 • A legacy migration you saw through to the end, especially with a parallel run
 



 • Nice to have: Hardware and system engineering understanding
 



 • Understanding of how businesses operate – basic commerce and taxation knowledge. As well as a solid understanding of CRM and DMS operations.
 



 • Crystal Reports, SSRS or similar reporting estates
 



 • Offline\-first or intermittently\-connected systems
 



 • GST e\-invoicing or IRP integration
 



 • Hindi or a regional language
 



  





**How you will work** 



* You will work directly with the CEO and leadership, who built PSS One and will be in the code processes with you.
* You will also work alongside two engineers who have held the legacy system together for 20 years. They know things about this business that are written down nowhere. Part of the job is getting that knowledge out of their heads and into the new system, which requires their goodwill. If your instinct on seeing old code is to call it stupid, this is not the role for you.



  





**How we'll hire you:** 




**About three weeks, five stages:** 




 1\. A thirty\-minute conversation with the CEO about motivation and your experience with legacy systems.
 



 2\. Ninety minutes of live pairing with the leadership and one of the existing engineers.
 



 3\. A paid take home assignment on a fully clean part of our actual pricing codebase. AI tools are explicitly permitted and expected, and we want to see how you verify what those tools give you, not whether you can generate code. We will pay you up to ₹10,000 for a submission that stands up to review, whether or not we take you forward.
 



 4\. Run a trial with an actual office clerk from one of the branches, discuss and close and feedback in loops to make sure that the operationalization is solid.  
 



 5\. Any references, weighted heavily towards whether you finish what you start.
 



  





**Compensation and logistics:** 




 • ₹110,000 per month fixed, plus quarterly performance bonuses. PF and gratuity as part of overall compensation
 



 • Mumbai, on\-site, with travel to branches during the rollout
 



 • Tell us your notice period. We will consider a buy out for the right teammate
 



  





**To apply:** 




 Apply through LinkedIn and/or write to
 **hr@pssao.com** 
 with two things:
 



 1\. One paragraph on the hardest bug you have found where the system did not crash, it just produced a wrong number.
 



 2\. Your
 **notice period** 
 , and whether it is negotiable
 



  





 We read every application and reply either way.
 **Good luck!**

description:
**Position: Full stack Software Engineer (TypeScript, Full\-Stack)** 




  





 Experience: 6\+ years
 



  





 Location: Pune/ Bangalore
 



  





 You will build an enterprise internal developer platform on Port.io as part of a single full\-stack engineering pool. The work spans portal configuration\-as\-code, TypeScript and Node.js integration services, and React experiences, and you will move between integration and portal work as the backlog demands. The platform is judged on developer adoption, so we look for engineers who treat platforms as products. You will be part of the Portugal engineering team, working closely with teams in the UK and India.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 You will build an enterprise internal developer platform on Port.io as part of a single full\-stack engineering pool. The work spans portal configuration\-as\-code, TypeScript and Node.js integration services, and React experiences, and you will move between integration and portal work as the backlog demands. The platform is judged on developer adoption, so we look for engineers who treat platforms as products. You will be part of the Portugal engineering team, working closely with teams in the UK and India.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Portal engineering: Build the Port.io implementation as configuration\-as\-code: blueprints, entities, scorecards, self\-service actions and RBAC.
* Integration services: Build TypeScript and Node.js services that connect the portal to ServiceNow (approvals, CMDB), identity, observability and the delivery toolchain, using APIs, webhooks and event\-driven components.
* Portal experiences: Build the React and TypeScript experiences developers use: catalogue pages, self\-service forms, scorecards, dashboards and custom widgets.
* Catalogue accuracy: Build ingestion that keeps the catalogue accurate across GitHub, cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
* Adoption: Instrument, measure and improve adoption, including self\-service success rates and developer feedback loops.
* Quality / leadership: Tested, documented, reviewable code at every level. Seniors also set standards, lead design decisions and mentor.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Applicable for Senior roles only (6\+ years): 2\+ years on internal developer platforms or DevEx tooling, with Port.io strongly preferred and Backstage accepted. You should be able to own components end to end and mentor.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Full\-stack TypeScript: Production TypeScript on both sides: Node.js services, REST APIs and webhooks, plus working React. Your depth may lean one way, but you need real ability on both, because this team flexes.
* Configuration\-as\-code: Fluency treating structured configuration (JSON/YAML) as first\-class, versioned, reviewed code.
* Testing discipline: Automated testing as a habit, with unit and integration tests written alongside the code. Strong Git and code review practice, and clear written and spoken English.
* Secure coding: Sound practices around secrets handling, authentication flows, least\-privilege access and dependency hygiene.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* IDP experience (applicable for mid\-level only): Exposure to developer portals or internal tooling.
* Python / Ocean: Python for custom integrations using the Ocean framework.
* Adoption mindset: Experience driving tooling adoption, treating the platform as a product with users rather than a request queue.
* Delivery context: GitHub Actions and Terraform awareness, Kubernetes, and API security patterns such as OAuth, OIDC and token handling.



  





 The platform environment:
 


* Developer portal: Port.io, or a Backstage background: catalogue, blueprints, self\-service actions and scorecards, with configuration\-as\-code in JSON and YAML. Custom integrations use the Ocean framework in Python, plus the Port API and Terraform provider.
* Languages: TypeScript, Node.js and React, with Python for custom integrations and JQ for data mapping.
* Orchestration: GitHub Actions, with Temporal for durable workflows.
* Delivery toolchain: GitHub and Terraform, an IaC quality and security stack (Wiz, Checkov, OPA, tflint, Infracost, Terratest), and k6 performance testing running on Kubernetes.
* Integrations: ServiceNow for approvals and CMDB, observability tooling, and enterprise identity and RBAC.

description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Lead Software Engineer (Developer)** 
 – ServiceNow IRM
   

  

**Location** 
 : Pune/ Blore, India
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Software Engineer with deep expertise in ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM) to join our team in Pune. The successful candidate will lead the design, development, enhancement, and support of enterprise\-scale IRM solutions while collaborating closely with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and engineering teams.
   

  

 This role requires strong technical expertise in ServiceNow development, solution architecture, integrations, workflow automation, and governance, risk, and compliance processes. The individual will also provide technical leadership, mentor team members, and help drive platform adoption and best practices across the organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**ServiceNow IRM Development \& Solution Delivery**
* Design, develop, configure, and implement solutions across the ServiceNow IRM platform, including Policy and Compliance Management, Risk Management, Audit Management, and related applications.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into scalable and sustainable ServiceNow solutions.
* Lead effort estimation, technical design, development planning, and implementation activities throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Configure and customize ServiceNow applications, workflows, business rules, UI policies, client scripts, script includes, and integrations.
* Design, build, and maintain complex workflows to support governance, risk, compliance, and audit processes.


**Technical Leadership**
* Own and deliver across all phases of project delivery.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to ServiceNow development standards, platform best practices, and architectural guidelines.
* Drive technical governance, solution quality, performance optimization, and platform stability.
* Own technical decision\-making, roadmap planning and platform strategy.


**Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration**
* Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, compliance teams, and risk management teams to understand requirements and deliver business value.
* Facilitate discussions on solution design, trade\-offs, implementation approaches, and best practices.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful project execution and timely delivery.


**Platform Support \& Continuous Improvement**
* Investigate and resolve production issues, defects, and performance bottlenecks related to ServiceNow IRM applications.
* Stay current with ServiceNow platform releases, emerging capabilities, and industry best practices.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes through automation, standardization, and platform optimization.
* Support platform upgrades, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.


**Team Development \& Mentoring**
* Mentor and coach engineers across varying experience levels and technical disciplines.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning, engineering excellence, and knowledge sharing.
* Support upskilling initiatives and contribute to building organizational capability in ServiceNow IRM technologies.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
* Overall 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in ServiceNow design, development, and implementation.
* 4\+ years of specialized experience working with ServiceNow IRM/GRC solutions in enterprise environments.


**Mandatory Technical Skills**
 Mandatory experience in the following areas of ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM), including:
   

  

 Develop and design
   

  

* Policy and Compliance Management
* Risk Management
* Audit Management
* Indicators and Issues Management
* Regulatory Change Management
* Entity Management
* Client Scripting
* Business Rules
* Script Includes
* UI Policies
* Flow Designer
* Workflow Configuration
* Data Policies
* ACLs and Security Configuration
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript, Glide APIs, and ServiceNow platform architecture.
* Experience designing and implementing REST and SOAP integrations with internal and external systems.
* Hands\-on experience with Integration Hub and API\-based integrations.
* Strong experience with ServiceNow Workspace, UI Builder, and Next Experience framework.
* Proven ability to develop scalable, maintainable, and secure ServiceNow solutions.


**Preferred Technical Skills**
 Strong understanding of SDLC processes, source control, code quality standards, and automated testing practices.
   

  

* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with technical and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Certifications**
 The following certifications are highly desirable:
   

  

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – IRM (CIS\-IRM)
* Additional ServiceNow certifications will be considered an advantage.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with additional ServiceNow products, including:
* IT Service Management (ITSM)
* Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM/PPM)
* Security Operations (SecOps)
* Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM)
* Vulnerability Response (VR)
* Experience implementing Virtual Agent capabilities.
* Familiarity with Performance Analytics and Reporting.
* Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and DevOps methodologies.
* Experience working in regulated financial services environments.
* Understanding risk, controls, compliance, audit, and regulatory frameworks.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will**
* Deliver high\-quality, scalable, and secure ServiceNow IRM solutions.
* Act as a trusted technical leader and subject matter expert for the IRM platform.
* Build strong partnerships across Risk, Compliance, Audit, and Technology teams.
* Drive innovation and continuous improvement while ensuring platform stability and compliance.

title: Android Developer
description:
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 3\.5\+ Years  
**Role:** Android Developer

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Android Developer** with a minimum of **3\.5 years of hands\-on experience in native Android application development**. The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of **Kotlin, Java, Android SDK, Fragments, Android lifecycle, MVVM/MVI, REST APIs, Retrofit, Coroutines, and Dagger/Hilt**.

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining, debugging, and optimizing production\-level Android applications while following clean, scalable, and maintainable coding practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain native Android applications.
* Build scalable and maintainable applications using **Kotlin and Java**.
* Work with **MVVM/MVI, Repository Pattern, Clean Architecture**, and modular application structures.
* Develop Android UI using **Activities, Fragments, XML, RecyclerView, ViewBinding/DataBinding**, and Material Design.
* Handle **Activity and Fragment lifecycle**, configuration changes, navigation, and back\-stack management.
* Integrate REST APIs using **Retrofit and OkHttp**.
* Implement proper API error handling, timeouts, retries, and network\-failure scenarios.
* Use **Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, LiveData, ViewModel, Lifecycle components, and WorkManager**.
* Implement dependency injection using **Dagger/Hilt**, including modules, scopes, and ViewModel injection.
* Work with local data storage using **Room, DataStore, SharedPreferences**, or similar technologies.
* Debug and resolve **crashes, ANRs, memory leaks, performance issues, and production defects**.
* Optimize application performance, startup time, memory usage, and responsiveness.
* Follow Android security, lifecycle, performance, and coding best practices.
* Use Git for branching, merging, pull requests, and conflict resolution.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving overall code quality.
* Understand existing production code and enhance it without impacting existing functionality.

**Required Technical Skills Android**

* Strong hands\-on experience with native Android development.
* Good understanding of **Android SDK, Android Studio, Gradle**, and Android project structure.
* Strong knowledge of **Activity and Fragment lifecycle**.
* Experience with Fragment transactions, Navigation Component, back\-stack handling, and lifecycle\-aware components.
* Understanding of Android permissions, services, broadcast receivers, notifications, and background execution limitations.

**Kotlin \& Java**

* Strong hands\-on experience with **Kotlin**.
* Good working knowledge of **Java**.
* Strong understanding of OOP, collections, null safety, extension functions, data classes, sealed classes, and Kotlin best practices.
* Ability to write clean, readable, reusable, and maintainable code.

**Architecture**

* Strong practical experience with **MVVM**.
* Understanding of **MVI and Clean Architecture** is an advantage.
* Experience with Repository Pattern, separation of concerns, use cases, and modular application design.

**Dependency Injection**

* Hands\-on experience with **Dagger or Hilt**.
* Understanding of modules, dependency injection, scopes, qualifiers, and ViewModel injection.

Jetpack Components

**Hands\-on experience with:**

* ViewModel
* LiveData
* Kotlin Flow
* Lifecycle Components
* Navigation Component
* Room Database
* WorkManager
* Paging Library, if applicable

**Networking**

* Experience integrating REST APIs.
* Strong knowledge of **Retrofit and OkHttp**.
* Experience with interceptors and authentication mechanisms.
* Knowledge of JSON parsing using **Gson, Moshi, or Kotlin Serialization**.
* Ability to handle network failures, timeouts, retries, and slow\-network conditions.

**Git \& Collaboration**

* Good working knowledge of Git.
* Experience with branching, merging, pull requests, and conflict resolution.
* Comfortable participating in code reviews and technical discussions.

Education

**Required:** Bachelor's or equivalent degree in:

* Computer Science
* Information Technology
* Software Engineering
* Computer Applications
* Any directly related Computer/IT discipline

**Preferred:** Master's degree such as **MCA, M.Sc. Computer Science, M.Tech, or equivalent**.

CDAC Candidates

CDAC candidates are eligible **only if their prior academic qualification is in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a directly related computer discipline**.

Experience Requirements

* Minimum **3\.5 years of professional, hands\-on Android application development experience**.
* Experience should primarily involve **native Android development and production applications**.
* Candidates whose experience is limited mainly to support activities, testing, or minor bug fixing may not be suitable for this role.

Good to Have

* Experience with Clean Architecture and modular Android projects.
* Firebase experience, including **Crashlytics, Analytics, FCM, or Remote Config**.
* Experience with Google Maps and location services.
* Experience with payment gateway integration.
* Knowledge of Android performance profiling and memory\-leak detection.
* Experience with Play Store release and deployment processes.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working with large\-scale or production Android applications.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should:

* Be able to independently own and deliver Android modules/features.
* Have strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Understand Android lifecycle and write lifecycle\-safe code.
* Be comfortable working with an existing production codebase.
* Follow clean coding and architecture principles.
* Focus on application performance, stability, and maintainability.
* Communicate technical issues clearly with the development team.
* Be proactive in identifying and resolving technical challenges.

Why Join Us?

* Opportunity to work on **real\-world production Android applications**.
* Work with modern Android technologies and architecture.
* Opportunity to solve challenging performance, scalability, and application lifecycle problems.
* Collaborative environment with opportunities to improve technical and architectural skills.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

title: Workflow Engineer
description:
**About the Company** 




**Join the Rocketship 🚀** 




 We’re building
 **ShopOS** 
 —
 **AI agents powering the entire ecommerce stack.** 
 Already past PMF, we’re scaling fast and shaping the future of how online brands are built with AI. Co\-founded by seasoned builders with multiple successful exits to companies like
 **Flipkart** 
 and
 **Polygon Labs** 
 — and
 **backed by Binny Bansal** 
 — this isn’t just another start\-up. It’s your
 **front\-row seat to the next big shift in ecommerce.** 




  





**Watch** 
 :
 **What is ShopOS (from the founders’ lens \- Click here)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 As a Workflow Engineer at ShopOS, you'll be responsible for building the backbone of automation that powers our AI\-native commerce stack — and then owning it. That means designing and implementing modular, node\-based workflow systems that integrate across catalog management, creative tools, personalization engines, and fulfillment systems, but it also means being the person who fixes them when they break, upgrades them as we scale, and documents them well enough that anyone on the team can pick them up.
 



 This role is for engineers who enjoy solving complex logic puzzles, who think in flows and systems rather than one\-off deliverables, and who want to make things smarter, faster, and more reliable — not just build them once and move on. You'll work closely with product, AI, and design teams to turn business rules into reusable, low\-code/no\-code automations that deliver outsized leverage to our users.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Build node\-based, rule\-driven workflows that support eCommerce operations and AI agent interactions
* Develop modular workflow components that can be composed into reusable, logic\-driven flows
* Integrate with APIs, data systems, and 3rd\-party services (Shopify, Stripe, Zapier, etc.)
* Diagnose and fix bugs in live workflows — including ones you didn't originally build
* Upgrade and refactor existing workflows for better reliability, speed, and cost
* Audit workflows on a regular cadence — flag fragile, redundant, or failure\-prone flows before they cause problems
* Maintain clear documentation for every workflow: what it does, what it depends on, what breaks it, how to fix it
* Set up admin interfaces and audit tools to monitor workflow health and performance
* Partner with product managers and designers to make workflows intuitive, testable, and transparent to end\-users
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to embed intelligence into decision points
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of key internal or external workflows (e.g. onboarding, content pipelines, personalization loops)
* Bring creative, non\-obvious solutions to recurring operational problems — not just the standard fix



**What We're Looking For** 



* CS background, with solid coding fundamentals
* Proficient in JavaScript and TypeScript
* Comfortable with Python for scripting and automation logic
* Hands\-on experience with node\-based / visual workflow builders (we currently run on Make; familiarity with n8n, Zapier, or similar counts too)
* Familiarity with Figma, Weavy, and ComfyUI
* Thinks in frameworks and systems rather than one\-off deliverables
* Strong debugging discipline — able to trace a failure across multiple connected systems, not just one node
* Comfortable with API integration (REST/GraphQL) and external services
* 2–4 years of experience — we're actively open to junior CS grads. Regardless of experience level, everyone gets trained on our systems, so raw fundamentals and problem\-solving instinct matter more than years on a resume



**Bonus Points** 



* Deep understanding of workflow engines, state machines, or rule engines
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and queueing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS)
* Working knowledge of Postgres and Redis
* Comfortable with infra\-as\-code (Docker, Terraform), monitoring, and CI/CD
* Experience with other low\-code/no\-code or visual workflow tools (Temporal, Langchain, Camunda, Retool)
* Exposure to AI/LLM systems and how workflows interface with prompt generation, chaining, etc.
* Previous experience in commerce, logistics, or creative ops automation
* Built internal ops tools or dashboards from scratch in a fast\-moving startup
* Familiarity with configuration\-driven or metadata\-driven engineering



**You'll Thrive If You Are…** 



* A builder who thinks in flows, states, and transitions
* Obsessed with making systems smarter, faster, and self\-healing
* Pragmatic about complexity — knowing when to write code and when to wire blocks
* Solution\-first — you show up with fixes, not just problem reports
* A team player who enjoys working across product, design, and AI teams
* Excited by the idea of creating leverage and automation for every human in the loop

description:

 Manage QNX\-based software development projects throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC), from requirements analysis and design to implementation, testing, and deployment.

 Identify and implement boot optimization techniques and strategies to minimize startup latency and improve overall system responsiveness.
   

  

 Utilize debugging tools and techniques for QNX, such as Uboot, Kernel, and QNX\-specific debugging utilities, to diagnose and resolve software issues and ensure robustness and stability.
   

  

 Develop and execute testing strategies and procedures for QNX\-based software components, including unit testing, integration testing, and system testing, to validate functionality, performance, and reliability.

 Manage reflash processes and procedures for QNX\-based systems, including firmware updates, patching, and system recovery mechanisms.
   

  

 Develop and maintain reflash scripts, tools, and utilities to automate and streamline the reflash process, minimizing downtime and ensuring system integrity and security.
   

  

 Integrate hypervisor technologies into QNX\-based embedded systems to support virtualization and isolation of software components and services.
   

  

 Configure and manage hypervisor environments for QNX, ensuring optimal resource utilization, performance, and security in multi\-domain embedded systems architectures.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Compilers
description:
**Who We Are**
 This role is part of the
 **Kinara Group at NXP Semiconductors** 
 , combining the agility and innovation of a startup with the scale, stability, and global reach of a leading semiconductor company.
   

  

 Kinara was founded on
 **patented technology developed during the founders’ Ph.D. research at Stanford University** 
 , with a mission to redefine AI inference at the edge through tightly integrated hardware and software. Following Kinara’s acquisition, this mission continues within NXP, with the Kinara team operating as a
 **dedicated AI accelerator and software group** 
 focused on pushing the boundaries of edge AI.
   

  

 The team has delivered
 **two generations of AI silicon shipping in volume** 
 , supported by a
 **mature and production** 
 ‑
 **ready software stack** 
 , making it one of the most proven edge AI platforms in the industry. Kinara technology is used by
 **marquee customers** 
 , including GAFA‑class companies, a leading global e‑commerce provider, and Tier‑1 PC OEMs.
   

  

 As part of NXP, the Kinara Group now benefits from
 **world** 
 ‑
 **class silicon execution, manufacturing scale, and customer access** 
 , while retaining its startup culture, deep AI expertise, and compiler‑driven engineering mindset. Joining this team offers the
 **best of both worlds** 
 : the opportunity to work on cutting‑edge AI compiler and silicon technology, with real‑world impact and long‑term stability.
   

  

**What We Do**
 We build
 **game** 
 ‑
 **changing edge AI solutions** 
 that enable faster, smarter, and more power‑efficient decision making where every millisecond matters.
   

  

 At the core of our platform are
 **Ara AI inference processors** 
 , purpose‑built to deliver
 **unrivaled deep learning performance per watt at the edge** 
 . Paired with our
 **comprehensive SDK and software toolchain** 
 , these processors enable developers to deploy and optimize complex AI models for real‑time inference under tight latency and power constraints.
   

  

 Kinara’s hardware–software co‑design approach allows high‑performance AI to be
 **seamlessly embedded into edge devices** 
 , enabling applications across vision, industrial automation, consumer electronics, and intelligent systems. Our solutions focus on
 **performance, efficiency, and scalability** 
 , helping customers bring advanced AI capabilities out of the cloud and into the real world.
   

  

 Edge AI is at an inflection point, and the Kinara Group within NXP is uniquely positioned to play a
 **leading role in its growth** 
 , delivering production‑proven silicon, a robust compiler and SDK stack, and a clear roadmap for next‑generation intelligent edge devices.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Front\-End Compiler Engineer** 
 with 10\+ years of experience to lead the design and development of our
 **AI/ML compiler front\-end** 
 . The role focuses on building scalable
 **model conversion pipelines** 
 that translate models from
 **ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch** 
 into our internal
 **Intermediate Representation (IR)** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in
 **compiler design** 
 ,
 **graph\-based optimizations** 
 ,
 **machine learning frameworks** 
 , and modern AI architectures including
 **Transformers** 
 and
 **Large Language Models (LLMs)** 
 . You will collaborate with compiler backend, runtime, performance, and hardware teams to deliver a high\-performance and production\-ready AI compiler stack.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and develop compiler front\-end architecture and model conversion frameworks.
* Build and maintain Python\-based converters for ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
* Implement graph construction, graph transformation, IR lowering, and optimization pipelines.
* Develop graph optimization passes including operator fusion, canonicalization, simplification, and decomposition.
* Design scalable pattern\-matching and graph\-rewrite frameworks.
* Enable support for modern AI architectures such as CNNs, Transformers, and LLMs.
* Drive validation, testing infrastructure, regression testing, and CI/CD integration.
* Debug and resolve issues across model conversion, optimization, and IR generation stages.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and collaborate across teams.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in compiler development, ML systems, or AI infrastructure.
* Strong Python programming and software architecture skills.
* Deep understanding of:
+ Intermediate Representations (IRs)
+ Graph\-based computation models
+ Compiler transformations and optimizations
+ Pattern matching and graph rewriting

* Hands\-on experience with ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
* Experience in graph parsing, graph transformations, and ML model optimizations.
* Strong understanding of CNNs, Transformers, and LLM architectures.
* Excellent debugging, problem\-solving, and technical leadership skills.


**Good to Have**
* Experience with MLIR, TOSA, StableHLO, or Torch\-MLIR.
* Familiarity with AI compiler stacks such as IREE, TVM, XLA, TensorRT, or ONNX Runtime.
* Experience targeting GPUs, NPUs, DSPs, or custom AI accelerators.
* Knowledge of quantization, model optimization, and deployment workflows.

title: Director of Engineering Consumer Experience - Web & Mobile
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. **YOUR MISSION:**
 As Director of Engineering \- Consumer Experience, you'll lead the technology organisation responsible for delivering exceptional digital experiences across Web and Mobile platforms. This is a horizontal, platform\-level leadership role that sets the engineering direction, standards, and quality bar across every consumer\-facing product in our Direct\-to\-Consumer (DTC) business.
   

  

 You'll own the engineering foundation that product teams build upon \- shared platform capabilities, AI\-native tooling, frontend standards, and delivery infrastructure \- and lead a lean team of senior engineers and a network of delivery partners to build fast, accessible, AI\-native experiences that delight our consumers. You'll hold platform adoption authority and co\-own the engineering quality bar across the organisation.
   

  

 As PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organization, our leaders are expected to be visible culture builders. These roles are office\-based and require regular in\-person collaboration to accelerate decision\-making, strengthen team cohesion, foster innovation, and build a world\-class engineering capability from the ground up.

* Build and own a component library and design system that enables velocity and consistency for all product teams.
* Define governance frameworks for third\-party vendor engagement including contracts, code quality reviews, delivery cadence, and SLA management.
* Introduce and maintain observability, performance monitoring, and incident management practices for consumer\-facing platforms.


**UI/UX \& Consumer Experience Leadership**

* Manage and hold accountable delivery partners for quality, timelines, and engineering standards.
* Partner with Engineering Heads, Product Owners and peer Directors to ensure horizontal services (design systems, shared APIs, performance tooling) are adopted consistently.


**YOUR TALENT:**
**Key Requirements:**
* 15\+ years of progressive engineering experience, with 5\+ years in a senior engineering leadership role.
* Strong architectural and implementation experience in modern front\-end engineering: ReactJS, TypeScript, GraphQL (GQL), REST APIs.
* Demonstrable mobile architecture \& engineering experience across React Native or iOS (Swift)/Android (Kotlin).
