title: AI Engineer
description:
Namaskaram!
 



  





 AjnaLens is looking for an AI/ML Engineer to join our Product Engineering team at Thane (Maharashtra – India). The ideal candidate should have 5\+ years of experience building, integrating, optimizing, and deploying AI systems in real\-world production environments. The role focuses on applying modern AI/ML techniques across Generative AI, LLMs, Computer Vision, multimodal AI, inference optimization, AI agents, and edge AI. Candidates should be comfortable taking AI solutions from experimentation and prototyping through production deployment, monitoring, and optimization. This role demands a strong product\-focused mindset, practical engineering skills, and the ability to translate cutting\-edge AI capabilities into reliable, scalable, and efficient products.
 



  





 We’re proud to share that Lenskart is now our strategic investor, a milestone that reflects the impact, potential, and purpose of the path we’re walking. Join us as we co\-create the future of conscious, AI\-powered technology.
 



  





 👉
 *Read more here:* 
 The smartphone era is peaking. The next computing revolution is here.
 



  





**Who are we looking for:** 




 We are looking for a highly skilled AI/ML Engineer with strong hands\-on experience in building, integrating, evaluating, and deploying AI solutions across Generative AI, LLMs, Computer Vision, multimodal AI, and AI agents. The candidate should have a solid foundation in machine learning and deep learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, neural network architectures, optimization, and transfer learning.
 



 The ideal candidate should understand the complete AI lifecycle—from data preparation and experimentation to model training/fine\-tuning, evaluation, model integration, inference optimization, API/model serving, deployment, monitoring, and production support. Experience with LLM fine\-tuning, RAG, prompt engineering, model quantization, inference optimization, and deploying AI workloads on GPUs/VMs is highly valuable. Strong Python skills and working knowledge of C\+\+ for performance\-critical applications are expected.
 



  





**Top 3 Daily Tasks:** 



* Build, integrate, fine\-tune, and optimize AI models and AI\-powered features across Generative AI, LLM, Computer Vision, multimodal, and agentic AI use cases.
* Develop and deploy production\-grade AI services, inference pipelines, and model\-serving APIs using technologies such as FastAPI, Docker, GPU runtimes, and cloud/on\-premise VMs.
* Evaluate, monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize AI systems in production, focusing on latency, throughput, resource utilization, reliability, model quality, and cost.



  





**Minimum work experience is required:** 




 Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience in AI/ML engineering, production AI systems, model integration/deployment, and the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI\-powered applications.
 



  





**Top 5 Skills you should possess:** 



* Strong proficiency in Python and solid working knowledge of C\+\+ for AI integration, performance\-critical systems, and inference optimization
* Strong understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning fundamentals, including model selection, feature engineering, supervised/unsupervised learning, neural network architectures, CNNs, transformers, transfer learning, training/validation, and model evaluation; hands\-on experience with PyTorch or similar frameworks
* Hands\-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, LLM fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI agents, and/or multimodal AI
* Practical experience with AI inference optimization, including quantization, model compression, batching, GPU utilization, latency/throughput optimization, and model serving
* Strong understanding of AI deployment, MLOps, model monitoring, API design, Docker, Linux, GPU\-based infrastructure, and deploying AI workloads on VMs/cloud environments



  





**Preferred / Good to Have:** 



* Experience with classical ML techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, feature engineering, ensemble methods, and model evaluation.
* Practical experience with deep learning architectures such as CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, transformers, vision transformers, and transfer learning.
* Experience with training and fine\-tuning models, hyperparameter optimization, experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and reproducible ML workflows.



  





**What would you be expected to do:** 



* Experience deploying and managing AI inference workloads on Linux VMs, GPU VMs, cloud infrastructure, or on\-premise servers.
* Familiarity with inference runtimes and optimization stacks such as ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, vLLM, LiteRT/LiteRT\-LM, or similar technologies.
* Experience with multimodal AI, vision\-language models, speech/audio AI, or AI systems integrated with hardware products.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes, CI/CD, Docker, observability, and production infrastructure for AI workloads.
* Experience with C\+\+, CUDA, GPU profiling, or hardware\-aware optimization is an added advantage.



  





**What would you be expected to do:** 



* Design and implement end\-to\-end AI solutions that balance model quality, latency, scalability, reliability, infrastructure cost, and user experience.
* Integrate, fine\-tune, evaluate, and deploy LLMs and Generative AI models for use cases such as conversational AI, summarization, entity extraction, classification, reasoning, text generation, and AI agents.
* Work with Computer Vision and multimodal AI systems, including image understanding, visual\-language models, embeddings, classification, detection, and other perception workloads where applicable.
* Build and maintain REST APIs and model\-serving services using FastAPI and related serving frameworks, with proper validation, documentation, logging, and observability.
* Create reproducible AI pipelines covering data preparation, experimentation, evaluation, model integration, deployment, and production validation.
* Evaluate AI systems using relevant quality and performance metrics, test edge cases, analyze failure modes, and establish reliable validation and benchmarking processes.
* Design prompt engineering strategies, RAG pipelines, guardrails, tool calling, and safety mechanisms for production Generative AI and agentic AI systems.
* Build and maintain AI observability and monitoring to track model quality, latency, resource utilization, failures, drift, anomalies, and out\-of\-distribution inputs.
* Optimize AI inference for low latency and high throughput using techniques such as quantization, batching, caching, efficient model serving, GPU optimization, and hardware\-aware deployment.
* Deploy and operate AI workloads on Linux\-based VMs and cloud/on\-premise GPU infrastructure; manage runtime dependencies, containers, model artifacts, services, logs, and production troubleshooting.

 Faurecia Clarion Electronics (FCE) is seeking an experienced

 to lead the architecture and technical governance of next\-generation
 **Cockpit, Infotainment, CDC, ADAS Visualization, Display, and Interior Monitoring Systems** 
 . The role acts as the technical authority, driving scalable, reusable, secure, and cost\-optimized solutions from

title: Engineering Team Lead
description:
**We’re looking for people to join the Access family, who share our passion for believing in better, and who will help us continue to grow.** 




  





 Love Work. Love Life. Be You. \- is central to our success and how we give our customers the freedom to do more of what's important to them.
 



  





**What does Access offer you?** 




  





 We offer a blended approach to office working, encouraging you to collaborate and connect in one of our thriving offices. We deliver on what we say, taking the development of our people seriously. We’ll work with you to progress your success plan and provide opportunities to accelerate your career.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Lead Software Engineer is a ‘50:50’ role. Half the time you are in the code — shipping production software, holding the technical bar and setting the standard the team follows. The other half you are leading the people, the process and the architecture — running a high\-performing engineering stream and developing the engineers within it.
 



  





 You’ll be joining a small, value\-aligned structure: up to two streams of four engineers each, with Product cover per stream. QA is owned by engineering — there is no handoff to a separate team, and that is by design.
 



  





 AI augmentation is a pre\-requisite for this role, not an optional extra. Access has invested in cutting\-edge AI tooling and we expect every engineer and leader to use AI pervasively to accelerate outcomes, raise quality, and shorten feedback loops. Lead Software Engineers are expected to model this behaviour, embed it into team standards and hold the bar for AI adoption across their streams. If you are not already working this way, you will need to get there fast.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities** 




  





**Technical Leadership** 



* Spend approximately half your time as a hands\-on engineer: writing, reviewing and shipping production code to the same standard you hold your team to.
* Own the technical direction of your stream — architecture decisions, technology choices, design patterns and code standards.
* Set and maintain the engineering quality bar: code review standards, test coverage expectations, CI/CD discipline, observability and security practice.
* Identify and address technical debt proactively, balancing pragmatism with the long\-term health of the codebase.
* Contribute to platform\-wide architectural decisions, feeding your stream’s experience and evidence back into broader engineering strategy.



  





**People Leadership** 



* Own the performance, development and wellbeing of up to eight engineers across your streams.
* Run regular 1:1s, set clear goals, and give direct, actionable feedback — both positive and developmental.
* Manage the full performance cycle for your engineers: goal setting, mid\-year reviews, end\-of\-year assessments and, where necessary, performance improvement plans.
* Identify growth opportunities for each engineer and actively create the conditions for them to progress.
* Hire well — contribute to recruitment, assess candidates rigorously, and take accountability for the quality of who joins your team.
* Model the behaviours and working practices you expect from the team, including AI adoption, communication standards and engineering discipline.



  





**Delivery \& Process** 



* Keep your streams delivering consistently — predictable throughput, low change failure rate, fast recovery when things go wrong.
* Own the engineering process within your streams: sprint ceremonies, planning quality, backlog health and cross\-team dependency management.
* Work closely with Product to balance feature delivery against technical investment, making the trade\-offs visible and explicit rather than absorbed silently.
* Remove blockers for your engineers — escalate where needed, resolve where you can, and protect the team’s ability to focus.
* Ensure incidents are handled well: fast triage, clear communication, thorough post\-mortems, and unique failures — the same class of incident should not recur.



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 




  





**Technical** 



* Software owned by your streams meets reliability, latency and availability targets in production.
* Lead time for change trends downwards; deployment frequency trends upwards across your streams.
* Change failure rate stays under 15%; MTTR trends downwards.
* Critical and high security vulnerabilities patched within agreed SLAs (1 day / 14 days).
* AI tooling is a demonstrable, routine part of your workflow and embedded visibly in team standards.



  





**People** 



* Engineers in your streams have clear goals, regular feedback and a development plan they understand.
* Regrettable attrition is low; engineers in your streams are growing and progressing.
* Performance issues are identified early and managed directly, without escalation becoming the default.
* New hires reach productive contribution within an agreed onboarding window.



  





**Delivery** 



* Your streams deliver predictably against commitments made to Product and stakeholders.
* Failures are unique — the same defect or incident class does not recur.
* Technical debt is visible, prioritised and moving in the right direction.



  





**Skills, Knowledge, Experience \& Qualifications** 




  





**How We Work** 




 Before the tech stack, this is what working in the F\&B engineering team looks like. As a Lead Software Engineer you are expected to model these standards, not just meet them.
 


* AI tooling is your default starting point, not a fallback — Copilot, Claude Code, Devin, Cursor or equivalent are open before you write the first line.
* You use AI pervasively across the full development lifecycle: generating and reviewing code, writing tests, producing documentation, triaging incidents and researching unfamiliar domains.
* You can prompt effectively — you know how to get useful output, iterate on it, and critically evaluate what comes back rather than accepting it at face value.
* You treat AI\-generated code with the same scrutiny as code from a colleague — it gets reviewed, tested and owned by you.
* You actively embed AI working practices into your team — through standards, playbooks, code review culture and leading by example.
* You improve your AI working practices continuously and bring the team with you; this field moves fast and standing still is falling behind.
* Expect your interview process to include assessment on how you work with AI tooling — not just what you know without it. Come prepared to demonstrate your workflow, not just talk about it.



  





**Technical Foundation** 




 The fundamentals are non\-negotiable — your technical credibility is what earns the trust of your engineers.
 


* Strong commercial software engineering background with a track record of shipping production systems end\-to\-end.
* Clean code, automated testing and CI/CD discipline — you set the standard, which means you have to embody it.
* Comfortable across the stack — backend, frontend or full\-stack — able to review and contribute across the breadth of what your streams own.
* Solid SQL and relational database skills; experience with cloud\-hosted databases in production.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and/or event\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent).
* Experience making and communicating architectural decisions, including the trade\-offs involved.



  





**Leadership \& People** 



* Proven experience leading a software engineering team — setting direction, managing performance and developing engineers.
* Direct, honest and constructive communicator — comfortable giving difficult feedback and having conversations that matter.
* Able to manage competing priorities across engineering and people responsibilities without dropping either.
* Experience running engineering process — agile delivery, planning, retrospectives, incident management.
* Comfortable working asynchronously across distributed teams (UK and India).



  





**Technologies** 




 Access F\&B runs a broad and evolving tech stack. We care far more about solid fundamentals and the ability to learn than exact technology match.
 


* Java — present across several F\&B product areas.
* TypeScript / React — frontend and web\-based ordering and management interfaces.
* Azure — our primary cloud platform; experience with Azure\-native services (App Service, Service Bus, SQL, AKS, Key Vault) is valuable.
* AWS — also present across parts of the F\&B portfolio.



  





**Security \& Compliance** 



* Working knowledge of security fundamentals: auth and authorisation patterns, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, and PII handling.
* Awareness of GDPR and UK GDPR as they apply to software systems handling guest and payment data.



  





**What are we all about?** 




  





 The Access Group is one of the largest UK\-headquartered business management software providers. It provides solutions that empower more than 160,000 small and mid\-sized organisations in commercial and non\-profit sectors across Europe, USA and APAC, giving every employee the freedom to do more of what's important. Its innovative cloud solutions and integrated AI software experience across multiple Access products transform how business technology is used.
 



  





 With
 **over 9,300 talented individuals driving innovation and customer excellence** 
 , we’re shaping the future of work. And we want you to be part of it. At Access,
 **people are at the heart of everything we do** 
 . We’re committed to creating an inclusive, high\-performing culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. If you’re excited about this role \- even if your experience doesn’t tick every box \- you might be exactly who we’re looking for.
 



  





 We believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity. So why not join our vibrant team, where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you?

title: Staff Software Engineer - CTV (Ad Server)
description:
**About The Role**
 PubMatic is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help architect and evolve our next\-generation, highly scalable, low\-latency AdServer for Connected TV (CTV) – operating at a scale of 1 trillion\+ requests per day and managing millions of requests per second. This is a technical leadership role for an engineer who wants to shape the architectural direction of the CTV AdServer platform, not just one team’s roadmap, in one of the fastest\-growing areas of programmatic advertising. If you thrive on solving distributed\-systems problems at extreme scale, enjoy influencing engineering direction across multiple teams, and want to be one of the most senior technical voices in the organization, we’d love to talk to you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Product \& Architecture Influence: Influence multiple teams across the AdServer organization by defining and reviewing product and platform architecture and implementations. Identify architectural risks early and propose alternatives and solutions that hold up at trillion\-scale.
* Architectural Oversight: Oversee the design and implementation of critical platform components by maintaining in\-depth knowledge of best practices, technologies, architectures, and emerging technologies, and by setting the technical bar for the AdServer engineering organization.
* Standards \& Decisions: Document and communicate exceptions to architectural standards by capturing significant architectural decisions (ADRs), ensuring decisions and their rationale are visible, durable, and reusable across teams.
* Own end\-to\-end technical direction for the AdServer platform – partnering with Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, Engineering Leads, and Product Leads to translate business needs into a coherent, multi\-quarter technical roadmap.
* Lead the design and evolution of highly reliable, scalable, low\-latency distributed backend platforms and services, and set the technical direction that other teams build on.
* Drive research into emerging technologies, sponsor proof\-of\-concepts, and make build/adopt decisions that materially move the platform forward.
* Act as a technical escalation point across teams – auditing designs for platform stability, reviewing major architecture changes across the AdServer Development Team, and unblocking the hardest cross\-cutting problems.
* Partner with Data Center and DevOps teams on long\-range technical planning – new technology adoption, software optimization strategy, and stability roadmaps for the overall platform.
* Mentor and raise the technical bar of Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, and other senior ICs, through design reviews, architecture forums, and hands\-on technical guidance.
* Champion engineering best practices and documentation standards across teams; ensure designs meet requirements and that platform\-wide work meets a consistently high quality bar.
* Drive the application of GenAI across the software development lifecycle – design, coding, testing, and documentation – and help set the standard for AI\-enabled engineering across the org.


**We'd Love for You to Have**
* 14\+ years of hands\-on development experience in C/C\+\+ in a Linux/UNIX environment, with a track record of shipping and evolving large\-scale distributed systems. Experience with Go is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated experience defining architecture and technical direction across multiple teams or a full platform, not just a single service or team.
* Deep proficiency in algorithms and advanced data structures, with a strong foundation in core computer science principles.
* Extensive experience in software design and architecture for complex, scalable, low\-latency, high\-throughput systems.
* A track record of identifying architectural risk ahead of time and driving alternatives that are adopted broadly.
* Ability to write and review architectural decision records, and to communicate trade\-offs clearly to both engineering and product stakeholders.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to find optimal, innovative solutions to open\-ended technical problems.
* Strong working knowledge of generative AI\-based tools and IDEs to accelerate development; comfort with prompt engineering fundamentals and an understanding of different model types at a working level.
* Deep knowledge of OS internals and systems programming – multi\-threading, multi\-processing, and memory management – and the ability to troubleshoot the hardest production issues.
* Ability to write clean, modular, loosely coupled code, and to hold others to that same bar through review.
* Strong end\-to\-end understanding of product functionality across the platform, not just an individual component.
* Working knowledge of scripting (Perl/Python/Shell) and databases (preferably MySQL).
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across teams without direct authority.


**Good To Have \- CTV Domain Experience**
* Prior hands\-on experience building or scaling ad serving, ad decisioning, or real\-time bidding systems specifically for Connected TV (CTV) / OTT.
* Working knowledge of CTV\-specific technical protocols and standards – e.g. VAST/VPAID/VMAP, SSAI (server\-side ad insertion) and CSAI, HLS/DASH manifest manipulation, and IAB CTV/OTT specifications.
* Understanding of the CTV supply chain and its unique constraints – device\- and app\-level identifiers (e.g. IFA, RIDA), frequency capping and pod/ad\-break management, content\-level targeting, and the latency/quality bar required for a living\-room viewing experience.
* Familiarity with SSAI stitching architectures and the trade\-offs between client\-side and server\-side ad insertion at scale.
* Exposure to OTT/streaming platforms, smart TV operating systems (e.g. Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS), or set\-top box environments, and the constraints they place on ad delivery.
* Understanding of CTV measurement, viewability, and completion\-rate reporting requirements, and how they differ from traditional display/video.
* Awareness of the evolving CTV privacy and identity landscape (e.g. data clean rooms, alternative identifiers, cross\-device graphs) and its implications for ad server architecture.


**AI\-Enabled Engineering Mindset**
 We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc.) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI\-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high\-scale, performance\-critical environment.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT) or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute or university; advanced degree is a plus but not required given depth of experience.


**Additional Information**
**Return to Office** 
 : PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!
   

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** 
 : PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

**About PubMatic**
 PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
   

  

 Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

**OSS \& Tools**
**Job Level/ Designation**
 M3/GM
   

  

**Function / Department**
 SNOC/OSS \& Tools
   

  

**Location**
 Pune/Hyderabad
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Seeking a visionary and technical leader for the role of
 **General Manager (GM) – Project Management** 
 . Own end\-to\-end SNOC integration planning, solution assessment and architecture for new products, network elements, applications and technology projects across RAN, Core, IP/CEN, Enterprise, OSS and Cloud domains. Evaluate OEM solutions, understand architecture and data flows, finalize SNOC scope and tool mapping, identify and close technical gaps/deviations, and ensure complete monitoring across Hardware, Storage, OS, Application, Network, Services, Fault, Performance and Logs. Drive the solution from requirement intake and project planning through design, testing, Go\-Live, stabilization and SNOC/COG HOTO while coordinating OEMs, SNOC domains, COG, OSS, Automation, Architecture, Security and Operations.
   

  

 Bridge strategic engineering with 24/7 operational excellence to scale telecom infrastructure across different SNOC Applications while ensuring strict adherence to global compliance, data privacy, and telecom quality standards.
   

  

**Key Result Areas/Accountabilities**
 Multi\-Domain Telecom Solution Architecture, SNOC Tools \& Integration Interface Expertise: Demonstrated experience in telecom solution architecture and SNOC integration across RAN, Core, OSS, TX, IP, Enterprise, Cloud and VoLTE domains. Mandatory hands\-on understanding of TEMIP, NNMi, NPM, SevOne, UHC, Infiworx, UIM and APM, with the ability to map domain solutions, monitoring requirements and end\-to\-end data flows to the appropriate SNOC tools and integration interfaces including SNMP, REST API, Kafka, Webhook and Prometheus with minimum of 2 years of experience.
   

  

 Integration Interface \& Protocol Engineering: Strong mandatory technical expertise in REST API, Kafka, Webhook and Prometheus integrations, covering API authentication, TLS/SSL, payload and response validation, error handling, timeout and retry mechanisms, Kafka topics, partitions, offsets and consumer lag, Webhook acknowledgement and idempotency, and Prometheus exporters, metrics and PromQL. Proficiency in PCAP, logs, traces, MIB/OID and protocol\-level troubleshooting is required.
   

  

 End\-to\-End Fault, Performance \& RCA Engineering: Mandatory capability to troubleshoot end\-to\-end Fault and Performance flows from Network Element or Domain through EMS, interface, middleware and SNOC platforms to ITSM, including alarm generation, severity, mapping, raise and clear, correlation, duplicate, missing and delayed events and ticket flow. Must be able to troubleshoot Bulkstat, KPI, API, Kafka and Prometheus performance flows, perform source\-to\-SNOC reconciliation and isolate failures across source, interface, processing and SNOC layers with evidence\-based technical RCA.
   

  

 Project Integration Management: Lead SNOC integration from requirement intake, solution assessment and scope finalization through testing, Go\-Live and HOTO
   

  

 SNOC Integration Strategy \& Planning Leadership: Define end\-to\-end integration strategy, scope, milestones, dependencies, prerequisites and execution plan for new projects and products.
   

  

 Solution \& Integration Architecture: Analyze OEM architecture, components, interfaces, data flows and operational model to determine the right SNOC integration approach.
   

  

 End\-to\-End Monitoring Architecture: Ensure monitoring coverage for Hardware, Storage, OS, Application, Network, Services, Processes, Faults, Performance and Logs.
   

  

 OEM Solution Assessment: Understand and technically evaluate OEM architecture, components, interfaces, data flows and operational workflows before finalizing the integration approach.
   

  

 Solution\-to\-SNOC Mapping: Map OEM solution architecture against SNOC tool capabilities and determine the right integration points, monitoring platforms and operational workflows.
   

  

 Technical Risk Management: Identify integration, architecture, security and operational risks and drive mitigation before deployment.
   

  

 Fault Management Architecture: Design alarm/event flow from network element to SNOC including normalization, severity, correlation, suppression, raise/clear and auto\-ticketing.
   

  

 Performance Management Architecture: Define KPI/counter integration through Bulkstat, APIs, Prometheus, telemetry or other performance interfaces.
   

  

 Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC): Drive standardization, reusable integration patterns, architecture governance, FTR improvement, defect prevention and continuous engineering transformation to accelerate technology onboarding and improve overall SNOC operational excellence.
   

  

 Data Privacy \& Security Enforcement: Enforce secure\-by\-design practices across SNOC integrations, including RBAC, API/SNMP/Kafka security, data protection and controlled access to sensitive network data.
   

  

 HOTO \& Operational Readiness: Ensure complete integration evidence, monitoring coverage, testing results and operational acceptance before SNOC/COG handover
   

  

 Database \& Backup Governance: Ensure database integration, data consistency, backup validation and recovery readiness across SNOC ecosystem platforms.
   

  

 Automated Observability: Drive automation for integration validation, alarm testing, reconciliation, health checks and monitoring validation to improve FTR and reduce rework.
   

  

**Core Competencies**
**Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience**
* Overall Experience: Minimum 12\+ years of progressive, post\-qualification experience in Project and Telecom management.
* Leadership Experience: Proven track record in a senior operational or engineering leadership role managing large environments and leading regulatory/compliance audits.


**Must Have Technical / Professional Qualifications**
* Applications \& Tools: OSS/NMS/EMS environment integration, HPSM(Service Manager). NNMi/Temip, NPM(Performance Management), UIM(Inventory), UHC, Prometheus, Syslog and end\-to\-end network management platforms.
* Containerisation \& Management: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP), Advanced Cluster Management (ACM), Kubernetes, and CSI frameworks.
* Integration Interfaces: End\-to\-End integration architectures using Rest APIs, SNMP, MIB/OID, CLI, API, Kafka, Syslog, CLI, Telemetry, Webhooks and event\-driven interfaces.
* Networking \& Security: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), Cloud Native Core (CNE) technologies, and Ni7 architectures.
* Monitoring \& Observability: Automated monitoring and alerting platforms for real\-time performance degradation tracking and network fault isolation.
* Automation: API Automation, Python/Shell, Validation Scripts, Auto\-Ticketing, Health Checks.
* Data Protection: Applications \& tools and disaster recovery frameworks.

description:

**Job Description**

 We are looking for an experienced Technical Manager to oversee a cloud\-based data science program, guiding a team of data engineers, data scientists, and cloud architects to deliver scalable, efficient, and high\-performance data science solutions.

* Oversee the design, development, and optimization of cloud\-based platforms for data science and machine learning.

* Manage budgets related to cloud services, data engineering tools, and infrastructure investments.
* Stakeholder Reporting \& Communication:
* Provide regular updates to senior management and stakeholders on the progress of the program, risks, and roadblocks.
* Create and deliver presentations, reports, and dashboards to communicate technical findings and achievements.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications:
   

  

* Education:
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
* Experience:
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience in a technical leadership or management role, ideally in cloud\-based data science or machine learning programs.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure(Primary), AWS or Google Cloud
* Proven track record of managing end\-to\-end data science or machine learning projects in cloud environments.
* Experience in leading teams of engineers and data scientists, with a strong understanding of cloud architecture, data pipelines, and model deployment.
* Technical Skills:
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and machine learning technologies.


 o
 **Experience in managing large platforms/applications in Kubernetes, Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS). Experience with containerization tools like Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.**
* Proficiency in microservices architecture, event driven architecture
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Mongo/NoSQL, Node,
* Familiarity with cloud services like Azure, S3, Cloud AI/ML tools, IAM services, networking concepts like private endpoints/links
* Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and tools (e.g., Terraform, YAML based deployments).
* Experience in handling and managing cloud security and vulnerability
* Leadership \& Communication Skills:
* Strong leadership abilities with experience managing diverse technical teams and driving results.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and manage stakeholder expectations.


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience with managing multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud architectures.
* Familiarity with big data technologies like Hadoop, Spark, or Kafka.
* Advanced certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
* Background in developing data governance strategies and ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations.

* Agile knowledge

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through an intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and technology into a single System of Action. Founded in 1979 and headquartered in Miami, Florida, the company serves manufacturers across more than 100 countries in industries including automotive, consumer products, food and beverage, high technology, industrial equipment, and life sciences.


The platform is built on three core pillars: **Redzone** (frontline empowerment), **Adaptive ERP** (the intelligent backbone of manufacturing operations), and **ChampionAI** (Agentic AI purpose\-built for manufacturing). Together, these enable manufacturers to achieve measurable productivity, resilience, and growth — in as little as 90 days.

 **Job Description**  

As a Senior Software AI Engineer on the ChampionAI core platform team, you will independently drive solutions, resolve complex technical challenges, and take full ownership of core platform capabilities and agent architectures. You will serve as a technical subject matter expert — delivering enterprise\-scale AI products at Champion Pace while mentoring junior engineers and helping Applied AI teams across business units build, deploy, and operate Champion agents correctly.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Independently design, build, and lead feature development across Champion platform repositories using trunk\-based development and PR\-gated merges.
* Optimize system architecture and developer experience: tooling, scaffolding, internal documentation, and onboarding paths for engineering teams.
* Architect, maintain, and evolve the MCP tool server and multi\-agent infrastructure that business unit teams depend on for production deployments.
* Proactively debug and resolve complex technical issues, performance bottlenecks, and friction points across cloud\-native and agentic platform architectures.
* Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to junior team members and Applied AI engineers across business units.
* Lead complex cross\-team code and architectural reviews for agent implementations — focusing on prompt quality, scope enforcement, security/auth configuration, and deployment setup.
* Establish engineering standards and contribute to internal architectural guides and skills documentation.
* Partner with DevOps, Cloud, and BU engineers on Kubernetes manifest creation, database registration, and feature flag/prompt rollouts.
* Drive end\-to\-end design and implementation of Champion agents for high\-impact business unit use cases.
* Engage in high\-level cross\-functional collaboration

 **Qualifications** **MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5\+ years of software development experience in enterprise SaaS environments (3\+ with a Master's), specialising in Python and cloud\-native AI\-driven systems.
* Solid understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) protocol, multi\-agent architectures, prompt engineering, and evaluation design.
* Proficiency in Python (async, FastAPI, Pydantic, pytest, pytest\-asyncio, DeepEval), Docker, PostgreSQL, and Git.
* Proven ability to independently lead feature development, architectural reviews, and cross\-team technical decisions.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers and setting engineering standards in a team environment.

**NICE\-TO\-HAVE**

* Working knowledge of AWS (ECR, EKS, Bedrock), Kubernetes, and Terraform.
* Familiarity with LaunchDarkly and AI\-native development tools (Cursor, Claude Code).
* M.S. / M.Tech in Computer Science, AI, or ML.
* Experience in manufacturing or industrial software domains.

**PROFILE**


You are a self\-sufficient senior engineer who does not need day\-to\-day direction. description:
### **Description**

  

As a **Senior Automation Test Associate Engineer**, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and stability of Davies' technology solutions through automated and manual testing. Reporting to the **Senior Manager of Development**, you will design, develop, execute, and maintain test automation solutions while working closely with Product Owners, Developers, Architects, DevOps Engineers, and business stakeholders to promote a quality\-first engineering culture.
  

The ideal candidate will have **8\-12 years of QA and Test Automation experience**, with strong expertise in test planning, test case design, automation framework development, automation coding, defect analysis, and CI/CD\-integrated testing within Agile Scrum teams.  

This is a hands\-on role focused on delivering high\-quality software through effective test automation, quality engineering best practices, risk identification, defect investigation, and continuous improvement initiatives. The position is a **permanent hybrid role based in Pune**, offering the opportunity to work in a collaborative and innovation\-driven engineering environment.### **Key Responsibilities**

 **Quality leadership and team development*** Lead, support and develop Test Analysts and other quality practitioners, setting clear expectations and providing coaching, feedback and practical guidance.
* Champion shared ownership of quality within cross\-functional teams and help squads make evidence\-based decisions about coverage, risk and release readiness.
* Define and promote proportionate quality standards, testing practices and ways of working, ensuring they are understood and applied consistently.
* Build effective working relationships with Product, Business Analysis, Engineering, Delivery, Operations and other stakeholders.

**Test strategy, planning and assurance*** Develop and maintain risk\-based test strategies and plans aligned to business outcomes, technical change, delivery approach and project constraints.
* Assess change impact, dependencies and quality risks early; define suitable test levels, types, environments, data, tooling, entry and exit criteria, and evidence requirements.
* Ensure test coverage is traceable to requirements, acceptance criteria, risks and critical business processes without creating unnecessary administration.
* Plan regression, integration, system, exploratory, non\-functional and user acceptance testing as appropriate to the change.
* Monitor testing progress, quality indicators, defects and residual risk, communicating concise and actionable information to relevant stakeholders.
* Contribute quality evidence and recommendations to collective release\-readiness decisions; escalate material gaps or risks clearly and promptly.

**Hands\-on testing and defect investigation*** Personally design, execute and maintain tests when needed, using manual and/or automated techniques appropriate to the context.
* Undertake exploratory, functional, integration, regression and other relevant testing of new and existing functionality.
* Create clear, maintainable test cases, charters, data and evidence at a level proportionate to the risk and delivery need.
* Identify, isolate, reproduce and document defects; support root\-cause analysis and verify fixes.
* Use relevant tools to inspect applications, interfaces, APIs, data and logs where required to investigate behaviour and build confidence.
* Review test assets and results produced by others, helping ensure coverage is meaningful, efficient and focused on risk.

**Automation and continuous improvement*** Evaluate where automation will provide sustainable value and where manual or exploratory testing is more appropriate.
* Contribute to the design, implementation or maintenance of automated checks where this matches the individual’s skills and the needs of the team.
* Work with engineers to improve testability and embed appropriate quality checks within the development and delivery lifecycle.
* Identify bottlenecks, duplication and gaps in the QA process and implement pragmatic improvements to quality, speed, coverage and transparency.
* Evaluate and recommend suitable testing tools and techniques, keeping current with relevant developments in software quality.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Experience*** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent applied experience.
* 10–15 years of automation and quality assurance testing experience.
* Background in web integration testing preferred.

**Skills*** Strong experience in manual and automation testing, with expertise in Selenium, Playwright, frontend UI automation, backend/API automation, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Proven experience leading QA activities for complex products and Agile delivery teams.
* Strong test strategy, test design, exploratory testing, regression planning, and defect management skills.
* Ability to apply risk\-based testing approaches and make pragmatic quality decisions.
* Experience coaching and mentoring QA engineers and driving quality best practices.
* Strong understanding of Agile, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong business awareness with the ability to evaluate customer and operational impact.
* Ability to learn new domains quickly and collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams.

**Essential (Non Negotiable)*** Experience testing APIs, integrations, data flows or databases, using tools such as Postman and SQL or equivalent.
* Experience with test\-management, defect\-management, delivery and collaboration tools.
* Experience with automation frameworks, continuous integration pipelines, performance testing, observability or application monitoring.
* Experience working in insurance, financial services or another regulated environment.
* A relevant testing qualification such as ISTQB Foundation Level, or equivalent applied experience.

  

### **About Davies**


We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  

  

We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation \& risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation \& change management.  

  

Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK \& the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20\-fold, investing heavily in research \& development, innovation \& automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: Sr Principal, DevOps & DevSecOps Engineering
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Role Overview**


We are seeking a seasoned technology leader with **18\+ years of deep technical and architectural experience** in DevOps and DevSecOps practices. This distinguished engineer will drive engineering excellence, product adoption, and innovation across a large\-scale financial organization. The role demands hands\-on expertise, strategic leadership, and the ability to influence global technology teams while ensuring operational resilience and regulatory compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Engineering Leadership**: Lead the design, development, and adoption of enterprise\-grade DevOps/DevSecOps solutions across global financial platforms.
* **Architecture \& Innovation**: Architect scalable CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks leveraging GitHub, Azure DevOps, Sonatype, and Broadcom CA Release Automation.
* **Product Ownership**: Act as global service owner for DevOps/DevSecOps platforms, ensuring reliability, security, and compliance.
* **Hands\-on Execution**: Provide technical direction and hands\-on engineering in pipeline automation, release orchestration, and secure software delivery.
* **Governance \& Compliance**: Embed security and compliance controls into DevOps workflows, aligning with financial industry standards and regulatory frameworks.
* **Collaboration \& Influence**: Partner with product engineering teams, risk governance, and infrastructure leaders to drive adoption of modern DevOps practices.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Champion innovative approaches to accelerate delivery, improve resilience, and reduce operational risk.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **15\+ years** of progressive experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, and infrastructure engineering.
* Distinguished engineer with proven **hands\-on expertise** in:
	+ GitHub Enterprise
	+ Azure DevOps
	+ CI/CD pipeline design and automation
	+ Sonatype Nexus / Lifecycle
	+ Broadcom CA Release Automation
* Strong architectural background in **enterprise\-scale automation and secure delivery pipelines**.
* Experience leading **global service ownership** and driving adoption across large financial organizations.
* Deep problem\-solving ability with a **leadership edge**—capable of influencing senior stakeholders and guiding engineering teams.
* Knowledge of **Liquibase** for database change management (preferred).
* Proven track record of delivering **resilient, compliant, and scalable solutions** in regulated industries.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience in **financial services or global banking organizations**.
* Strong understanding of **regulatory compliance frameworks** (e.g., ISO, NIST, DORA, PRA).
* Ability to balance **strategic vision with hands\-on execution**.

**Leadership Attributes**

* Visionary mindset with the ability to **drive transformation at scale**.
* Collaborative leader who fosters innovation and continuous learning.
* Strong communicator with the ability to influence across global teams and executive stakeholders.
* Recognized as a **problem solver and trusted advisor** in technology modernization.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Product Owner
description:
#### **About Tripstack**


Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019\. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining.


Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform \- giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non\-partner, low\-cost and full\-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost\-effective API.
Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily.
Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection.  

For more information, visit:  

www.tripstack.com
www.etraveligroup.com##### **The role**


As a Product Owner at Tripstack, you'll report into a Product Manager serving as an operational leader and product strategist for your portfolio within the Content Acquisition team.


You will oversee the integration and operation of flight content into our platform, ensuring we maintain world\-leading content at the highest possible quality while keeping our systems stable and performant.

##### **Job Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership \& Incident Management**

* Own end\-to\-end operational performance of your assigned content portfolio (APIs, consolidators, or scrapes), ensuring system stability, SLA adherence, and production health
* Lead incident management and structured RCA (root cause analysis) investigations for any issues; drive resolution tracking and prevention of recurring production issues
* Define, monitor, and proactively manage operational KPIs: uptime, latency, booking failures, error rates, conversion impact, and portfolio risks
* Act as primary operational escalation point for airline\-related issues, coordinating rapidly across engineering, product teams, and external airline partners

**Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Priority Management**

* Facilitate resource planning and allocation decisions with your engineering team; identify constraints and trade\-offs
* Manage the balance between competing priorities (new feature development, production support, incident response, and ad\-hoc requests)
* Define and communicate clear priorities to engineering teams \- including what gets deprioritized and why
* Coordinate all team standups, sprint planning, ROMs (Rough Order of Magnitude reviews), and alignment meetings
* Track dependencies, blockers, and risks; escalate appropriately and coordinate cross\-team resolution
* Monitor sprint velocity, deliverables, and team output; continuously optimize processes for delivery efficiency

**Stakeholder Alignment \& Communication**

* Align internal stakeholders (engineering, product leadership, data teams) and external partners (Etraveli Group, airlines, consolidators) around priorities, timelines, and expectations
* Communicate operational status, KPIs, and business decisions clearly and concisely \- orally and in writing
* Facilitate regular sync meetings with engineering leadership, other product teams, and stakeholders
* Prepare status reports, milestone updates, and analytics dashboards for leadership visibility

**Product Definition \& Requirements**

* Translate high\-level business objectives and customer needs into clear, well\-documented product requirements and user stories
* Define acceptance criteria and work with QA to establish test cases
* Establish acceptance criteria and work with QA teams to build comprehensive test cases
* Create reusable components and standardized approaches across recipe integrations to improve quality and reduce duplicative work

**Strategic Analysis \& Decision\-Making**

* Conduct data\-backed analysis to inform prioritization decisions; evaluate impact against business value
* Work with architects, engineering managers, and product leaders to assess technical feasibility and design efficient solutions
* Identify opportunities for improvement in security, CI/CD, quality, and performance practices
* Monitor KPIs tied to product decisions and iterate based on results
* Root cause analysis of systemic product issues and recommend structural improvements

**Partnership with Engineering \& Architecture**

* Collaborate with engineering leads on solution architecture, ensuring alignment between product vision and technical implementation
* Work with platform and engineering teams to identify and resolve technical blockers
* Support architecture decisions that balance speed of delivery with long\-term platform health

##### **Job Requirements**

* **3\+ years hands\-on experience in a product or program management role with significant operational responsibility**
* Strong project management and organizational skills with ability to juggle multiple competing priorities
* Excellent communication skills across technical teams, product teams, and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strategic thinker with strong experience in data\-backed decision making
* Comfort with ambiguity; ability to move fast and make decisions with incomplete information
* Leadership skills: ability to bring teams together toward a common purpose and coordinate across multiple teams

**Technical \& Industry Knowledge**

* **Knowledge of software architecture, REST, cloud platforms, platform engineering, and microservices**
* Experience working as a hands\-on QA engineer or application developer would be advantageous
* Travel industry experience \- particularly with airline APIs, NDC standards, or GDS/PSS systems
* Experience building airline or flight content integrations
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring tools, and production observability platforms

**Personal Attributes**

* Output and delivery driven; results\-oriented mindset
* Resilient with ability to thrive under pressure and competing demands
* Proficient in communication: clear, concise, and professional across contexts
* Passion for problem\-solving, root cause analysis, and operational excellence
* Highly accountable team player; takes ownership of outcomes

##### **Benefits**


We offer an opportunity to work with a young, dynamic, and a growing team composed of high\-caliber professionals. We value professionalism and promote a culture where individuals are encouraged to do more and be more. If you feel you share our passion for excellence, and growth, then look no further. We have an ambitious mission, and we need a world\-class team to make it a reality. Upgrade to a First Class team!


At Tripstack, we proudly believe in embracing diversity. This is true for our team, clients, communities and stakeholders. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating a safe, healthy and accessible environment. We encourage applications regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other grounds protected by law. Please let us know if you need any accommodations during any part of the recruitment process.


Tripstack thanks all applicants for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.  

  

Learn more about us at www.tripstack.com

Software Engineer Location – Pune (Prefferd)


What You Will Build The Belden Firewall (TBF) is our next\-generation industrial firewall platform for OT/IT environments. It is a Linux\-based embedded system built on Yocto, using nftables for packet filtering and deep packet inspection for industrial protocols such as DNP3 and Modbus. Our management UI is built on React and communicates with devices via RESTCONF. The core architecture and development is driven from our main office in Germany, and the Pune team works closely with them on implementation, testing, and feature delivery. Job Summary As the Lead Software Engineer in Pune, you are a hands\-on technical leader who writes code, debugs complex problems, and drives feature delivery for the local team. You work alongside the Embedded Firewall Architect to turn architectural direction from our Germany headquarters into working software. You lead by example – owning implementation of modules, reviewing your team’s code, and ensuring quality across the board. Key Responsibilities Hands\-On Development • Develop and maintain components of the firewall platform in C and Python, including nftables rule management, network stack modules, and system services. • Implement features and enhancements assigned to the Pune team, working within the architecture defined by the Germany engineering leadership. • Debug complex issues across the full stack – from kernel\-level networking and packet processing to application\-layer services. • Write and maintain automated tests (unit, integration, system\-level) to ensure platform stability and quality. • Perform root\-cause analysis on defects and regressions, collaborating with the Germany team on platform\-wide issues. • Review code from the team and ensure consistency, quality, and alignment with the overall architecture. • Support integration testing across the embedded Linux platform, including Yocto builds, nftables configurations, and NETCONF/RESTCONF interfaces.


Expertise needed (Mandatory): • Strong C programming, data structures, algorithms, and debugging (GCC, GDB, Make). • Strong Linux knowledge: kernel basics, IPC, multi\-threading, system programming. • Experience with embedded Linux distributions: Yocto, Debian, or Ubuntu. • Experience with nftables / netfilter for packet filtering and firewall rule management. • Working knowledge of NETCONF/YANG and RESTCONF for device management interfaces. • Solid understanding of networking: TCP/IP, L2 switching (802\.1x, STP/RSTP/MSTP, VLANs), L3 routing (OSPF, BGP). • Solid understanding of network security: Firewall concepts, VPN, IPsec, NAT, ACL, IPS/IDS, DPI (DNP3/Modbus), PKI/SSL. • Experience working on networking or security appliances (firewalls, routers, gateways). • Good debugging and root\-cause analysis skills across application and system level. • Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and unit testing frameworks. • Proficiency in Python or Bash scripting. Good to have experience: • Experience with XDP/eBPF for high\-performance packet processing. • Experience with Docker, containers, and virtualization in embedded contexts. • Familiarity with network operating systems from networking vendors. • Experience with packet generation and network test tools. • Interest in Linux kernel development.

title: Senior Software Engineer - IPv6 Networking exp is a must**
description:
**SonicWall** is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner\-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real\-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud\-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose\-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. For more information, visit **www.sonicwall.com** or follow us on **Twitter**, **LinkedIn**, **Facebook** and **Instagram**.

**About the Role**



SonicWall is seeking a **Senior Software Engineer with deep IPv6 expertise** to lead the design, implementation, and hardening of IPv6 capabilities across the Sonicwall firewall firmware stack. As a Principal Engineer, you will be the technical authority for IPv6 feature parity, protocol correctness, and interoperability across SonicWall Next\-Generation Firewall (NGFW) platforms. This role is ideal for engineers with hands\-on experience delivering IPv6 in high\-performance router, switch, or carrier\-grade networking products who are looking to apply that expertise in the embedded network security domain.


**Responsibilities**


* **Lead IPv6 Architecture \& Feature Delivery** — Own end\-to\-end design and implementation of IPv6 features across the Sonicwall frewall networking stack, including IPv6 routing, interface addressing, DHCPv6, NDP, MLDv2, and IPv6 Policy\-Based Routing (PBR).
* **Drive IPv6 Feature Parity** — Identify and close gaps between IPv4 and IPv6 feature sets across subsystems — including VPN Tunnel Interfaces, IPsec/IKEv2, SSL\-VPN, Syslog, SNMP, and NAT64 — ensuring consistent dual\-stack and IPv6\-only operation.
* **Design High\-Performance IPv6 Packet Processing Paths** — Architect and optimize the IPv6 dataplane for packet forwarding, classification, ACL matching, and session lookup within the sonicwall high\-performance packet\-processing pipeline.
* **Resolve Complex IPv6 Protocol Issues** — Diagnose and resolve deep\-rooted interoperability, conformance, and performance issues involving IPv6 neighbor discovery, prefix delegation, ICMPv6 error handling, and fragmentation edge cases.
* **Establish IPv6 Protocol Conformance Standards** — Define and drive compliance with IETF IPv6 RFCs (RFC 2460, RFC 4291, RFC 4861, RFC 4862, RFC 6724, RFC 8200, and related extensions) within the Sonicwall frewall codebase.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** — Work closely with Platform, Security, Data Platform, and QA teams to integrate IPv6 changes safely across subsystems and validate correctness at scale.
* **Prototype and Evaluate IPv6 Technologies** — Evaluate emerging IPv6 transition mechanisms (464XLAT, MAP\-T, CLAT, SRv6\) and contribute to next\-generation NGFW networking capabilities.
* **Influence Technical Direction** — Drive architectural decisions, IPv6 scalability strategies, and long\-term technical roadmap for protocol parity and government/federal compliance (USGv6, IPv6\-ready certification, DoD IPv6 mandates).
* **Mentorship \& Technical Leadership** — Serve as the IPv6 subject\-matter expert (SME) for the Sonicwall frewall engineering org; mentor senior and mid\-level engineers and lead cross\-team IPv6 technical design reviews.


**Requirements**


* **7\- 9\+ years** of hands\-on C/C\+\+ systems\-level development for networking platforms — with a strong emphasis on routers, Layer\-3 switches, carrier\-grade NAT (CGNAT) devices, or network security appliances.
* **Deep IPv6 Protocol Expertise** — Proven, production\-level implementation experience with:
* + IPv6 addressing, subnetting, and prefix delegation (DHCPv6\-PD)
	+ Neighbor Discovery Protocol (NDP), Router Advertisements (RA), and MLDv2
	+ IPv6 routing protocols (OSPFv3, BGP with IPv6 AFI/SAFI, RIPng)
	+ IPsec/IKEv2 over IPv6 transport
	+ IPv6 ACLs, PBR, and traffic classification at line rate
	+ IPv6 transition and coexistence mechanisms (Dual\-Stack, 6in4, 6rd, NAT64/DNS64, 464XLAT)
* **L2/L3/L4 Networking Depth** — Solid understanding of Ethernet, VLANs, 802\.1Q, bridging, routing (static and dynamic), NAT, firewall state tables, and VPN tunneling in the context of both IPv4 and IPv6\.
* **High\-Performance Packet Processing** — Experience with DPDK, ODP, OFP, XDP/eBPF, or comparable frameworks for low\-latency, high\-throughput packet forwarding is a strong advantage.
* **Protocol Conformance \& Testing** — Experience validating IPv6 implementations against IETF RFC requirements and government IPv6\-ready test suites (USGv6, IPv6\-Ready Logo Phase\-2\) is highly desirable.
* **Strong Debugging \& Diagnostic Skills** — Proficient with tcpdump, Wireshark (IPv6 dissectors), GDB, kernel trace tools, and network emulation environments (GNS3, EVE\-NG, or equivalent) for root\-cause analysis of IPv6 issues.
* **Communication \& Leadership** — Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the proven ability to lead cross\-functional IPv6 design discussions, write technical specifications, and represent engineering in product and architecture reviews.


**Nice to Have**


* Experience with **government / federal IPv6 compliance** requirements (DoD IPv6 mandate, NIST SP 500\-267, USGv6 Profile).
* Exposure to **SRv6** (Segment Routing over IPv6\) or **MPLS over IPv6** architectures.
* Familiarity with **Sonicwall frewall**, SonicWall NGFWs, or similar embedded network security firmware.
* Working knowledge of **WireGuard over IPv6** transport.
* Experience with **automated IPv6 test frameworks** (RFC 2544, IXIA, Spirent, or similar).

description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 We are seeking a visionary
 **PLM AI System Architect** 
 to lead the digital transformation of our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of deep engineering domain expertise and cutting\-edge Generative AI. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and scaling agentic AI capabilities that transform how we manage requirements, BOMs, CAD/CAM data, and service lifecycles. The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between our PLM platforms, engineering stakeholders, and enterprise AI architecture.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Strategic PLM Leadership: Drive AI adoption across the entire product lifecycle—from requirements and EBOM/MBOM management to digital twin enablement.
* Agentic AI Engineering: Design and orchestrate multi\-agent systems capable of reasoning over complex PLM data, automating classification, and performing automated change impact analysis.
* Advanced Data Retrieval (RAG): Architect RAG pipelines that ensure engineering\-grade accuracy, specifically tuned for structured PLM data and unstructured technical documentation.
* Architect and configure AI\-powered retrieval systems that handle both structured PLM data (attributes, relations) and unstructured content (specifications, PDFs, drawings).
* AI Integration Architecture: Lead the development of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and secure integration layers to expose PLM services to enterprise AI agents.
* Governance \& Scaling: Define the AI maturity roadmap, ensuring all deployments meet strict enterprise standards for data privacy, IP protection, and cost governance.


**What You Bring**
* Required total 7\+ years of experience along with relevant experience 3 years in Artificial Intelligence.
* PLM Domain Expertise: Basic understanding of PLM (Product Lifecycle Management).
* AI \& Intelligent Systems: Proven expertise in Agentic AI frameworks, RAG architectures, and tool\-calling patterns. Strong grasp of grounding strategies to mitigate hallucination risks in technical environments.
* Platform \& Integration: Experience building AI integration layers (e.g., MCP servers), managing APIs/microservices, and deploying AI services in cloud\-native environments.
* Communication: Ability to distill complex technical architecture into actionable business value narratives for senior leadership.
* Business Impact: Quantifiable reduction in cycle time and manual effort through AI automation.
* System Integrity: High accuracy and "trust scores" for AI\-generated engineering outputs.
* Scalability: Successful deployment of reusable AI architectural patterns across the broader enterprise.

title: Server Performance Architect - Hardware
description:
Job Requisition ID JR2016230
   

  

 Job Category Engineering
   

  

 Time Type Full time
   

  

 NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
   

  

 NVIDIA is seeking architects to drive architectural performance for its next\-generation AI server systems. This position demands a unique capability to bridge deep architectural knowledge, workload analysis, and hands\-on silicon investigations. Candidates should be adept at working directly with silicon, high\-level models, and simulators. Responsibilities include conducting performance investigations on both NVIDIA and competitive platforms, and developing targeted microbenchmarks to examine specific architectural aspects. The role does not heavily involve modeling tasks (functional or performance), though occasional focused assignments may arise.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Defining and driving server\-level performance targets across CPU, GPU, memory, interconnect, networking, and storage subsystems
* Conducting hands\-on workload characterisation and bottleneck analysis on NVIDIA and competitive server platforms using AI training, inference, and HPC benchmarks
* Leveraging profiling, tracing, and analysis tools to root\-cause performance issues and identify optimisation opportunities at the system level
* Performing trade\-off studies on system topology, thermal/power envelopes, and memory hierarchy to guide architectural decisions
* Collaborating with silicon, platform, firmware, and software teams to identify and close performance gaps from bring\-up through production
* Developing automation and tooling for performance regression tracking and reporting
* Representing the performance perspective in architecture reviews and cross\-functional design discussions
* Building and maintaining analytical performance models and simulation frameworks for next\-generation server platforms
* Publishing internal performance studies and best\-practice guides for partner and customer enablement


**What We Need To See**
* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
* 10\+ years of experience in server/system performance architecture or related disciplines
* Deep understanding of modern server architectures — CPU microarchitecture, PCIe/CXL, DDR/HBM memory subsystems, and coherency protocols
* Strong hands\-on experience with system\-level profiling and performance analysis tools on server platform(s)
* Solid knowledge of GPU\-accelerated compute, high\-performance networking, or high\-performance storage subsystems
* Proficiency in Python, C/C\+\+, or similar languages for scripting, data analysis, and tool development
* Comfortable and proficient using AI\-powered coding and productivity tools to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation workflows
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to distil complex performance data into actionable architectural recommendations


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience with AI/ML training and inference workloads at data\-centre scale
* Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (Hopper, Blackwell, Rubin) and associated software stacks (CUDA, NCCL)
* Background in chip\-to\-chip interconnect performance analysis (C2C, UCIe)
* Exposure to power/thermal\-aware performance optimisation techniques
* Track record of contributions to industry conferences or published performance studies
