title: Analytics Lead
description:
**Company Description** 




 Zenon is a boutique firm focused on financial services, healthcare, and private equity. We are deeply experienced in these industries, and provide analytics, data, and intelligent solutions to our clients.
 



 Our team includes some of the world’s most accomplished data scientists along with solutions architects, industry experts, and execution teams who know how to bring AI and machine learning into front line decision\-making and ongoing operations.
 



**About the Role** 




 Zenon Analytics is looking for an Analytics Lead / Manager (5–8 years of experience) to own end\-to\-end analytics and AI/ML engagements for our clients. This is a hands\-on leadership role: you will structure ambiguous business problems, build and productionize ML/AI solutions, and guide a small team of analysts through delivery — while staying close enough to the data and code to unblock them when needed.
 



 We’re looking for a mix of skills that leans more toward Analytics and Machine Learning, with working exposure to Data Engineering and enough Software Engineering (full\-stack, Python) to be a credible partner to engineering teams during deployment. You don’t need to be deep in all four — but you should be genuinely comfortable moving between them.
 



**What You Will Do** 




 •  Lead the design and development of statistical, ML, and AI\-driven solutions (including LLM\-based and agentic workflows) for a range of business problems.
 



 • Guide the team on exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model development, validation, and deployment — reviewing approach and code, not just output.
 



 • Partner with data engineering (or own it directly, where needed) to build and maintain the pipelines, data models, and infrastructure that feed analytics and ML solutions.
 



 • Work with software/product engineering teams to get models and analytical tools into production — comfortable enough with full\-stack and Python\-based development to prototype APIs, internal tools, or lightweight applications independently.
 



 • Mentor and upskill junior analysts and data scientists; review their work and set the technical bar for the team.
 



 • Contribute to business development — shaping proposals, scoping new engagements, and estimating effort.
 



 • Be comfortable with ambiguity, and enjoy structuring solutions for messy, large\-scale (Big Data) problems where the “right” approach isn’t obvious upfront.
 



**What We’re Looking For** 




***Must Have***




 • 5\-8 years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related field, with at least some experience leading projects or mentoring junior team members.
 



 • Strong hands\-on skills in Python and SQL; comfortable working across the analytics stack, not just in notebooks.
 



 • Proven experience with end\-to\-end ML model development — problem framing, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, validation, and deployment — with solid working knowledge of algorithms such as Random Forest, XGBoost, and SVM.
 



 • Familiarity with MLOps practices — model monitoring, versioning, and CI/CD for ML — and experience taking models from prototype to production.
 



 • Practical, hands\-on experience with AI/LLMs — working with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic or open\-source alternatives, including prompt engineering (zero\-shot, few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought) and building LLM\-powered features or workflows.
 



 • Working knowledge of data engineering fundamentals — building and maintaining data pipelines, writing efficient ETL/ELT, and working with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure) and tools such as Airflow or Spark.
 



 • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills — able to translate technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for business audiences.
 



***Good to Have***




 •     Prior experience with NLP on unstructured or semi\-structured data, and familiarity with Hugging Face / Transformers for accessing and deploying pre\-trained models.
 



 •     Exposure to modern front\-end frameworks (React or similar) for building internal analytics tools or dashboards.
 



 •     Prior experience in financial services or other regulated industries, or on similarly data\-intensive analytics engagements.
 



**Educational Qualification** 




 •     Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 institute; management degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus.

description:

Effectively developing and managing partners will require that you establish strong business and technical relationships through your knowledge of the Public Sector industry and customer requirements of AISPL. Through these relationships, you will be responsible for growing internal adoption of AWS, as well as broad organizational AWS competency in the partners in India. You will also work closely with the AWS Public Sector business development team to drive joint business engagement, as well as strategically plan for development of future opportunities and pursuits. Ideal candidates will possess both and technical business background that enables them to drive engagements and interact at multiple levels with APN partners and customers of AISPL, including the partner founders/ board. Candidates should also have strong industry experience and demonstrated the ability to think and act strategically on the government customer mission, industry directions, and partner/customer technical challenges. Roles \& Responsibilities:


* Serve as a key member of the AISPL Public Sector Team in helping to drive overall business goals.
* Manage multiple APN partners in the West states ready to develop AWS cloud competency and fulfil government transactions. Manage a set of APN partners who build vertical solutions for the Public Sector.
* Understanding of government procurement and contracting process to navigate the Public Sector contracting vehicles and RFP procedures with key strategic and advisory partners.
* Understand the legal, compliance, security, and technical considerations and certifications specific to the Public Sector that impact your APN partner ecosystem.
* Build and execute a plan to develop the competency and capabilities of the strategic and advisory APN partners in India through technical trainings/enablement, business development engagement, programs and operations that translates into a sustained and growing business portfolio for these APN partners.
* Identify specific prospects/partners/channels to approach while communicating the specific value proposition for their business and use case.
* Develop and manage the pipeline by engaging with prospects, partners, and key customers.
* Manage complex contract negotiations and liaison with the Legal group.
* Engage with APN partner teams on the new partner programs to build and scale the strategic partner engagements in the India state and local government segments.
* Develop strategic relationship with chosen public sector domain partners to ensure that they adopt AWS as their cloud platform and jointly develop GTM (Go\-To\-Market) plans with solution focused approach.

* MBA, or Master's degree in computer science, technology, design

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About Gartner IT:**

Join a world\-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting\-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome\-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.


**About the role:**

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our team, with a primary focus on database architecture, optimization, and management. The ideal candidate will have at least 4\+ years of robust, hands\-on experience in PostgreSQL (preferably AWS RDS), advanced SQL, and database development, as well as deep expertise in designing and managing ETL data pipelines. Experience with both batch and event\-driven data processing is essential. Strong Python skills for data engineering, and familiarity with AWS Glue, AWS Batch, AWS S3, CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Git), and AI\-related technologies are also required.


**What you will do:**

* Design, build, and optimize scalable RESTful APIs, incorporating authentication, authorization, caching, observability, and performance best practices.

* Drive containerization and deployment strategies using Docker, AKS, and Azure Container Apps.


* Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into scalable technical solutions and provide architectural recommendations.


* Lead design reviews, code reviews, and technical governance activities while mentoring development and data engineering teams.


* Support AI/LLM integration initiatives, enabling intelligent data products and business process automation.


* Troubleshoot complex production issues across application, API, data pipeline, cloud, and database environments.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, MCA, or a related discipline.


* Proven expertise in designing and delivering end\-to\-end Full Stack and Data Engineering solutions across frontend, backend, data, and cloud platforms.


* Strong hands\-on experience with React.js, Streamlit, Python, FastAPI, and Node.js for developing scalable enterprise applications.


* Extensive knowledge of Snowflake architecture, DBT data transformation, Airflow orchestration, and modern ETL/ELT frameworks.


* Deep understanding of Microsoft Azure services, including networking, security, identity management, Key Vault, monitoring, and cost optimization.


* Expertise in designing secure, high\-performance REST APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native architectures.


* Strong DevOps and CI/CD experience using GitHub Actions, Docker, AKS, and container\-based deployment strategies.


* Skilled in implementing observability frameworks, application monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, and production support practices.


* Experienced in establishing engineering standards, code quality processes, data governance, testing frameworks, and architectural best practices.


* Strong leadership capabilities with expertise in mentoring engineering teams, conducting design reviews, and driving technical decision\-making.


* Adept at stakeholder management, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, and integrating AI/LLM capabilities into enterprise data products.

**Position Title:**

**Function:** 
 Insurance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)
* Vendor\-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)


**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**

With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

**Job Overview**
**ROLE PURPOSE**
 Serve as the programme's Jira Cloud subject\-matter authority in support of Client's migration execution. The role advises on target\-state architecture, rationalization, app strategy, and validation approach — ensuring Client's migration engineering team executes against a clean, well\-designed cloud destination — without itself owning migration execution.

* Own the Marketplace app gap analysis: Data Center app inventory, cloud equivalence assessment, Connect\-to\-Forge implications, and recommendations to replace, retire, or rebuild — a primary driver of wave complexity classification.
* Advise on integration patterns for rebuilt or replaced integrations with enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow), in coordination with the Senior Cloud Engineer and Client integration owners.

* Define the validation and verification approach for migrated data and configuration (staging\-first migration, integrity comparison, user mapping consistency) and review verification outcomes with Client's migration engineers.
* Provide escalation\-level troubleshooting guidance during migration windows and hypercare; document architectural decisions and standards in Confluence.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of Atlassian platform expertise spanning Jira Data Center and Jira Cloud administration/architecture at enterprise scale (5,000\+ users).
* Direct experience with Data Center\-to\-Cloud migration assessment and planning, including familiarity with Atlassian's cloud migration tooling and staged (staging\-to\-production) migration approaches.
* Deep knowledge of the Atlassian Marketplace ecosystem, including cloud app parity analysis and the Connect/Forge platform transition.
* Strong grasp of enterprise identity, security, and governance in Atlassian Cloud (Atlassian Guard/Access, SSO/SCIM, data residency).
* Ability to communicate architectural trade\-offs crisply to both engineers and programme leadership.


**Preferred**

title: Technical Co-Founder And Chief Technology Officer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Guidzy is a travel technology platform focused on helping people explore India with faster, safer, and more personalized trip planning. The platform connects travelers with verified local guides, hotels, cabs, houseboats, activities, and authentic experiences through a single, trusted interface. Safety and trust are central, with features such as guide verification, ratings, reviews, location\-based matching, trip sharing, and SOS support. Starting in Kerala and expanding across India, Guidzy aims to build a nationwide local travel network that benefits both travelers and local businesses. Travelers of all types—solo, couples, families, groups, and international visitors—can use Guidzy to access reliable local support and truly “explore India like a local.”
   

**Role Description** 
 The Technical Co\-Founder and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will lead Guidzy’s technology vision, architecture, and product development from the ground up. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kerala, India, working closely with the founding team to build and scale a robust travel platform. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include defining technical strategy, overseeing system architecture, managing the development lifecycle, and ensuring platform performance, reliability, and security. The CTO will design and implement core product features, integrate third\-party services, establish development standards and processes, and build and mentor the engineering team. The role also involves collaborating with product, business, and operations teams to translate user needs into scalable solutions and iterate quickly based on market feedback.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong analytical skills to interpret user behavior, product metrics, and technical trade\-offs, and to drive data\-informed decisions.
* Excellent communication skills to collaborate with founders, engineers, partners, and non\-technical stakeholders in a clear and inclusive manner.
* Sales\-related capabilities, including supporting product demos, engaging with early customers, and representing the technology vision in partner conversations.
* Marketing awareness to align product features with market needs, support go\-to\-market initiatives, and contribute to positioning and messaging for a tech audience.
* Research skills to stay current with travel\-tech trends, security best practices, and relevant tools, and to evaluate new technologies for platform growth.
* Proven experience designing and scaling web or mobile platforms (preferably marketplace or travel\-tech) using modern architectures and cloud infrastructure.
* Hands\-on expertise in backend and frontend development, APIs, databases, and performance optimization, with willingness to code in early stages.
* Experience building and leading engineering teams, setting development processes, and implementing QA, DevOps, and security standards.
* Ability to work on\-site in Kerala, India, and engage directly with local partners and users to understand ground\-level needs.

title: Project Architect
description:
**Company Description** 
 Green Home Properties is a multidisciplinary real estate, architectural, interior design, and engineering firm focused on delivering end\-to\-end solutions for housing and development projects. The company provides engineering services, executes real estate projects, and offers advisory support to clients across the property sector. With specialist expertise in structuring real estate transactions, Green Home Properties covers the full development lifecycle from concept and design through positioning and asset disposition. The team brings together experienced real estate professionals who focus on creating, improving, and repositioning assets for optimal value. Services include site identification and acquisition, best use evaluation, concept development, planning and building approvals, pre\-construction management, strategic real estate planning, and tailored sales and off\-take models.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Project Architect role at Green Home Properties is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kochi. The Project Architect will lead architectural design and documentation for residential and mixed\-use projects, translating client requirements into functional and sustainable design solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include developing concepts and detailed drawings, coordinating Building Information Modeling (BIM) models, preparing and reviewing submittals, and ensuring designs comply with local codes and regulatory standards. The role involves close collaboration with internal teams, consultants, and contractors, overseeing design intent through all project phases from schematic design to construction administration. The Project Architect will also support LEED and other sustainability objectives, participate in client presentations, and help manage schedules and deliverables to keep projects on time and within scope.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong architectural design and technical skills, with proficiency in Architecture fundamentals and building systems.
* Experience with Building Information Modeling (BIM) tools and workflows for design coordination and documentation.
* Ability to manage project timelines, resources, and deliverables, demonstrating solid Project Management capabilities.
* Knowledge of sustainability frameworks such as Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) and interest in green building practices.
* Experience preparing, reviewing, and coordinating Submittals and construction documents with consultants and contractors.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard design software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp) and familiarity with local building codes and regulations.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture from an accredited institution; professional licensure or progress toward licensure is an advantage.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
* Experience in real estate development or interior design coordination is beneficial.

title: Civil Draughtsman
description:
**Draughtsman**

**Department:** Design / Engineering Department **Designation:** Draughtsman **Reporting To:** Architect / Design Manager / Project Engineer

**Job Summary**

The Draughtsman is responsible for preparing accurate 2D and 3D technical drawings, detailed plans, sections, elevations, and execution drawings based on project requirements and design standards. The role involves coordinating with architects, engineers, and site teams to ensure drawing accuracy, proper documentation, timely revisions, and smooth project execution.

**Key Duties \& Responsibilities1\. Technical Drawing Preparation**

* Prepare accurate 2D and 3D technical drawings using AutoCAD and related drafting software.
* Develop plans, sections, elevations, and detailed drawings as per project requirements.
* Ensure drawings comply with company standards and technical specifications.
* Cross\-check dimensions, scales, and annotations before final submission.
* Update and revise drawings based on design changes and site feedback.

**2\. Coordination \& Communication**

* Coordinate with architects, engineers, and site teams for drawing requirements.
* Attend site visits and meetings to collect technical information when required.
* Clarify technical drawing details with execution teams.
* Alert the team regarding design clashes or drafting issues.
* Support project teams in day\-to\-day drawing and documentation activities.

**3\. Drawing Verification \& Documentation**

* Review drawings for accuracy before issue and execution.
* Maintain systematic backups and digital archives of all drawings.
* Provide printed drawing sets for site and consultant teams when required.
* Maintain records of drawing revisions and daily work updates.
* Ensure proper document filing and project drawing organization.

**4\. Project Support \& Timeline Management**

* Support execution teams with drawing\-related clarifications.
* Ensure project drawing submissions are completed within deadlines.
* Coordinate with supervisors for design and project coordination.
* Monitor drawing status and maintain workflow efficiency.
* Help ensure project timelines related to drawings are achieved.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Diploma / Certification in Drafting, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related field.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and other drafting software.
* Knowledge of architectural and interior detailed drawings.
* Understanding of construction drawings, dimensions, and technical standards.
* Good coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple drawing tasks and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation management.

**KPI Indicators \& Expected Performance Standards**

**KPI Indicator**

**Expected Performance Standard**

Drawing Accuracy

98% error\-free technical drawings

Timely Submission

100% drawings issued within deadlines

Revision Efficiency

Drawing revisions completed within 24 hrs

Coordination Efficiency

Smooth coordination with project teams

Documentation Management

Proper filing and backup of all drawings

Technical Compliance

Drawings aligned with company standards

**Expected Performance Standards**

* Deliver accurate and detailed technical drawings consistently.
* Ensure all drawings are completed within approved timelines.
* Maintain proper drawing documentation and revision control.
* Coordinate effectively with architects, engineers, and site teams.
* Minimize drafting errors and technical discrepancies.
* Follow company drafting standards and project procedures.

**Growth Opportunity**

The Draughtsman role provides opportunities for career growth in technical drafting, architectural detailing, design coordination, and project management. Employees demonstrating strong technical knowledge, drafting accuracy, and project coordination skills can progress into Senior Draughtsman, Design Coordinator, CAD Manager, or Project Design roles within the organization.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: From ₹20,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* Drafting: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Interior Designer & 3D Visualizer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONINTERIOR DESIGNER CUM 3D VISUALISER

**Company:** Pipe Dreamers Collab  
**Position:** Interior Designer Cum 3D Visualiser  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Experience : 1 \+ years**  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala

ABOUT PIPE DREAMERS COLLAB

**Pipe Dreamers Collab** is an architecture, interior design and construction practice focused on creating thoughtful, sustainable and context\-responsive spaces.

Our approach combines **architecture, interiors, landscape and materiality** to create spaces that are functional, aesthetically refined and connected to their environment.

We are looking for a talented **Interior Designer Cum 3D Visualiser** who can contribute both creatively and technically to our design process.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Interior Designer Cum 3D Visualiser will be responsible for developing interior design concepts and transforming architectural and interior ideas into **high\-quality 3D models, realistic renders and compelling visual presentations**.

This is not purely a rendering role.

We are looking for someone who can **understand design, develop spaces, work with materials and translate concepts into strong visual outcomes**.

The role will involve visualisation across multiple scales, from:

**Interior Spaces → Buildings → Exteriors → Landscapes → Master Plans**

The ideal candidate should have strong practical proficiency in **SketchUp and professional rendering software such as D5 Render, Lumion, V\-Ray, Enscape or equivalent**.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. INTERIOR DESIGN \& SPACE PLANNING

* Understand client requirements, lifestyle and functional needs.
* Develop interior concepts and design directions.
* Prepare furniture layouts and space\-planning proposals.
* Develop interior schemes for living, dining, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms and other spaces.
* Assist in selecting appropriate furniture, finishes, materials, colours, textures and lighting.
* Develop design solutions balancing **function, aesthetics, comfort and practicality**.
* Explore different design options and alternatives.
* Assist the design team in taking projects from initial concept to final design.

2\. 3D MODELLING \& VISUALISATION

The candidate will be responsible for developing high\-quality 3D visualisations across **interior, architectural exterior, landscape and master\-planning projects**.

INTERIOR VISUALISATION

* Create accurate and detailed 3D interior models.
* Produce high\-quality, realistic interior renders.
* Develop realistic furniture, materials, textures, lighting and decorative elements.
* Prepare different material and design options for client presentations.
* Create detailed views that communicate the overall design intent.

EXTERIOR ARCHITECTURAL VISUALISATION

Produce high\-quality exterior renders for:

* Residential buildings
* Villas
* Commercial buildings
* Apartment projects
* Building facades
* Architectural massing and forms
* Entrance areas
* Courtyards
* Terraces
* Outdoor spaces
* Day and night views
* Landscape\-integrated architectural views

MASTER PLAN \& SITE VISUALISATION

Develop **master plan and site\-level 3D visualisations**, including:

* Overall site/master plan views
* Villa/community developments
* Building layouts
* Roads and pathways
* Landscape and open spaces
* Water bodies
* Parking areas
* Common amenities
* Recreational spaces
* Outdoor gathering areas
* Site features and structures
* Aerial and bird's\-eye views

LANDSCAPE VISUALISATION

* Integrate architecture and landscape realistically.
* Develop vegetation, trees, planting, terrain and outdoor elements.
* Create visually convincing landscape environments.
* Represent the relationship between buildings, open spaces and the surrounding context.

OTHER VISUALISATION

* Architectural walkthroughs
* Fly\-throughs
* Animations
* Design presentation videos
* Conceptual visualisations
* Material and lighting studies

3\. DESIGN DEVELOPMENT

* Translate concepts into detailed and presentable interior proposals.
* Explore materials, colours, textures, furniture styles and lighting schemes.
* Develop mood boards and material palettes.
* Assist in preparing client presentations.
* Participate in design discussions with the architects and design team.
* Make revisions based on feedback from the Chief Architect, designers and clients.
* Ensure that the final 3D visualisation accurately represents the approved design.

4\. MATERIAL \& PRODUCT SELECTION

The candidate should have an interest in and understanding of:

* Natural materials
* Wood and wood finishes
* Natural and engineered stone
* Tiles
* Glass
* Metal
* Paint and wall finishes
* Fabrics and upholstery
* Lighting fixtures
* Furniture
* Hardware
* Modular cabinetry
* Kitchen finishes
* Sanitaryware and bathroom materials

The ability to **research materials, products and finishes and incorporate them accurately into the visualisation** will be an advantage.

5\. WORKING DRAWINGS \& INTERIOR DETAILING

A basic understanding of interior detailing and construction is expected.

The candidate should be able to understand and assist with:

* Furniture layouts
* Ceiling layouts
* Flooring layouts
* Electrical and lighting layouts
* Wall elevations
* Joinery and cabinetry
* Kitchen layouts
* Bathroom layouts
* Material specifications
* Interior detailing

Experience in preparing or understanding **working drawings** will be an added advantage.

6\. SOFTWARE REQUIREMENTSMANDATORY

**Strong practical proficiency in 3D modelling and rendering software is mandatory.**

The candidate must have strong working knowledge of:

* **SketchUp – Mandatory**
* **D5 Render / Lumion / equivalent professional rendering software – Mandatory**

PREFERRED

* V\-Ray
* Enscape
* Twinmotion
* AutoCAD
* Photoshop
* Illustrator

The candidate should be capable of independently handling the workflow:

**2D DRAWINGS → 3D MODELLING → MATERIALS → LIGHTING → LANDSCAPE → CAMERA COMPOSITION → RENDERING → POST\-PRODUCTION**

**Candidates without strong practical 3D modelling and rendering skills will not be considered.**

7\. MANDATORY SKILLS

The candidate must have:

* Strong **3D modelling skills**
* Strong **3D rendering skills**
* Proficiency in **SketchUp**
* Proficiency in **D5 Render, Lumion or equivalent**
* Good understanding of interior design principles
* Good spatial understanding
* Ability to read and understand architectural drawings
* Strong understanding of materials, textures and lighting
* Ability to create realistic architectural environments
* Strong visualisation and presentation skills
* Good sense of scale, proportion, composition and perspective
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to work within deadlines

8\. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who combines:

**DESIGN THINKING \+ TECHNICAL SKILLS \+ VISUAL STORYTELLING**

You should be able to look at an empty room, building or site and understand:

**How should the space function?**  
**How should it feel?**  
**What materials should be used?**  
**How should the light interact with the space?**  
**How should the landscape complement the architecture?**  
**How can the entire idea be communicated through a compelling visual?**

We value candidates with a strong eye for:

* Composition
* Lighting
* Material realism
* Architectural proportions
* Furniture styling
* Landscape integration
* Atmosphere
* Photography and camera angles

An understanding of **minimal, contemporary, tropical and natural\-material\-based architecture and interiors** will be an added advantage.

9\. QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCEPreferred Qualification

* Degree / Diploma in Interior Design
* B.Arch / Architecture
* Diploma / Degree in Interior Architecture
* 3D Visualisation or related design fields

Experience

**1–3 years of relevant experience preferred.**

Freshers with an exceptionally strong portfolio demonstrating genuine interior design and 3D visualisation skills may also be considered.

PORTFOLIO IS MANDATORY

Candidates must submit a portfolio demonstrating their **own work**.

The portfolio should preferably include:

* Interior renders
* Exterior architectural renders
* Master plan / site visualisations
* Landscape visualisations
* SketchUp models
* D5 / Lumion / V\-Ray / Enscape renders
* Material and lighting studies
* Before/after or design development work, if available

10\. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

We are looking for someone who is:

* Creative and design\-oriented
* Technically strong
* Detail\-oriented
* Curious and willing to experiment
* Good at visual communication
* Fast and efficient
* Open to feedback
* Responsible with deadlines
* Comfortable working collaboratively
* Interested in architecture, interiors, materials and design
* Willing to continuously improve their visualisation skills

11\. ROLE \& REPORTING

The selected candidate will work closely with the **Chief Architect and Design Team**.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Engineer \& SR Engineer –Avionics SW**
 Thales India Engineering Competency Center is seeking a Engineer/Sr Engineer to be part of its Avionics Flight Display Systems. The Engineer/Sr Engineer is in charge of the software development activities (Requirement Capturing, Design, Code and V\&V), in order to deliver software that meet requirements coming from a Business Lines (B/L), with the adequate quality and maturity level, within schedule and budget.
   

  

**Qualifications:** 
 Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science \& Engineering, Electronics \& Communication or equivalent discipline with 3 to 7 years of relevant experience.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Thales India Private Limited, Richmond Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025\.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
 As a Engineer/Sr Engineer, you will be a major actor in the software development phase using approach with C /Embedded C. In more details:
   

  

* Development of Application Software with a good understanding of architectures, multi thread program development, requirements, algorithms, interfaces and designs for avionics systems (Flight Display System) as per DO178B/C standards
* Debugging, bug fixing \& enhancements on existing Software.
* To perform Development free hands testing \& regression on existing features.
* Ensure quality deliveries before hand\-off to Quality Assurance teams for further testing and verification.
* Participate in an AGILE team involved in the development phases by respecting deadlines and contractual milestones.


**Minimum Skills/Experience:**
* EXPERT in Embedded C Programming Language.
* EXPERT in Memory usage \& execution time allocation.
* Good understanding of Integrated Modular Avionics (IMA)
* Candidate should be Strong in RTRT
* Knowledge in Data Structures.
* Good experience on Cockpit Display and Graphics, Primary Flight Display, Multi\-Functional Display, Flight Management System functionality
* Knowledge in DO178B/C is required and Knowledge of Coding standards e.g. MISRA.
* Candidate should be strong in writing System Specification, High Level Requirements \& Low Level Requirements. Also Strong in High Level Test \& Low level Test definition procedure \& hands on experience in verification.
* Should have overall engineering experiences in software development of Avionics embedded system and experience in software Development Life Cycles
* Knowledge in configuration management tool git is required
* Knowledge about avionics protocols (A429, A664 – AFDX, RS232, Arinc653\)
* Good organizational abilities. Good interpersonal skills, writing \& verbal skills


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Senior Software Engineer ( AI/ML)
description:
Senior Software Engineer – AI/ML
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer – AI/ML with strong hands\-on experience in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, particularly in designing and developing complex, production\-level AI/ML solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have practical experience taking AI/ML solutions from concept or prototype through to production deployment, with a strong understanding of model integration, AI/ML workflows, scalability, performance, and reliability.
   

  

 Experience in API development and software engineering is also required, but this will be a secondary focus compared to hands\-on AI/ML expertise.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, deploy, and maintain production\-grade AI/ML solutions for complex business and technical use cases.
* Develop and implement AI/ML solutions using appropriate models, frameworks, tools, and technologies.
* Work with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI/ML applications where applicable.
* Develop solutions involving RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model integration, and AI workflows.
* Build and integrate AI/ML capabilities into enterprise applications and existing technology ecosystems.
* Evaluate and optimize AI/ML solutions for accuracy, performance, scalability, reliability, and cost.
* Work with large and complex datasets and apply appropriate machine learning techniques to solve real\-world problems.
* Develop and maintain REST APIs and services to expose and integrate AI/ML capabilities with enterprise applications.
* Integrate AI/ML solutions with databases, external services, enterprise applications, and other data sources.
* Write clean, maintainable, testable, and production\-ready code.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, deployment, and production support.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to AI/ML models, applications, integrations, and production environments.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, architecture, and business teams to deliver scalable AI/ML solutions.
* Contribute to technical standards, best practices, and continuous improvement of AI/ML engineering processes.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.
* Strong professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with proven hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-level AI/ML solutions.
* Experience working on complex, real\-world AI/ML use cases rather than only prototypes, POCs, or academic projects.
* Strong programming skills in Python. Experience with Java, C\#, or TypeScript is an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of machine learning concepts, algorithms, model development, evaluation, and deployment.
* Hands\-on experience with relevant AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit\-learn, Hugging Face, or similar.
* Experience with Generative AI and LLM\-based applications is preferred.
* Experience with concepts such as RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, LLM integration, and model evaluation is an advantage.
* Experience developing and integrating REST APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Spring Boot, .NET, or similar.
* Understanding of software engineering principles, application architecture, scalability, and performance.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or other relational/NoSQL databases.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automated testing, and production deployment practices is preferred.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building and deploying enterprise\-scale AI/ML applications.
* Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar.
* Experience with AI agents, tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and multi\-step AI workflows.
* Familiarity with MCP, AI guardrails, LLM evaluation, AI observability, and Responsible AI.
* Experience integrating AI/ML solutions with enterprise APIs, databases, and business applications.
* Experience with AI/ML model optimization, monitoring, and production support.
* Cloud or AI/ML certifications are a plus.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 We are primarily looking for a strong hands\-on AI/ML engineer who has experience solving complex, production\-level AI/ML problems and delivering reliable solutions in an enterprise environment.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across the AI/ML lifecycle — from understanding the business problem and developing the solution to deployment, optimization, monitoring, and production support.
   

  

 Experience in API development and broader software engineering is important, but it is considered a secondary requirement. The primary differentiator for this role will be the candidate's depth of practical AI/ML experience and their ability to build and productionize complex AI/ML solutions.
   

  

 Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
   

  

 We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: Data Engineer(Python/AWS/SQL)
description:
\#\# ROLE SUMMARY
   

  

 Are you a software developer who loves building software that actually gets used?
   

  

 Join us at FTSE Russell! We're building a team of engineers who care about software craftsmanship, clean code, and shipping things that matter. As a Software Engineer, you'll build the services, libraries, and applications that power the indices trusted by financial institutions worldwide.
   

  

 We work primarily in Python, so that's our preference — but we care far more about whether you can genuinely build software than about which language you built it in. If your track record is in Java, C\#, C, C\+\+, Scala, Go, or Rust and you're keen to work in Python, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers pick up a new language quickly; strong engineering judgement takes years.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on software development role. You'll spend your days designing, coding, testing, and shipping — in a modern AWS environment, alongside engineers who review each other's code, pair when it helps, and take real ownership of what they build. The systems you work on handle serious volumes of financial data, so there's a rich data dimension to the problems — but the craft we're hiring for is software engineering.
   

  

 If you've built real software and want to keep building, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

 \#\# WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
   

  

 We're building the next\-generation index data platform at FTSE Russell — and we want you to help build it:
   

  

* Writing production code, primarily in Python — services, APIs, libraries, and command\-line tools that are modular, well\-tested, and built to be maintained by others
* Designing and building software components end to end, from breaking down a problem through to deployment and support in production
* Applying modern software engineering practices every day: version control, trunk\-based development, CI/CD, code review, refactoring, and automated testing (unit, integration, contract)
* Taking ownership of features and systems — you debug your own problems, fix them properly, and take responsibility for the quality of what you deliver
* Designing data models and integrations across relational databases (Aurora PostgreSQL) and object storage, thinking carefully about schema design, evolution, and backwards compatibility
* Building software that processes data at scale on AWS — Lambda, S3, containerised services, and where appropriate the AWS data stack (Glue, EMR Serverless)
* Building observability in from the start — structured logging, metrics, tracing, and meaningful alerting, so that we know how our software behaves in production
* Contributing to design and architecture discussions, and to our shared engineering standards
* Working directly with product and business teams to turn requirements into working software
* Learning the financial indices domain and sharing what you learn with the team


 \#\# WHAT YOU'LL BRING
   

  

 Essential — this is the bar:
   

  

* You have built and shipped real software. Not scripts and notebooks — applications, services, or libraries that other people depended on, that you maintained and evolved over time
* Python is our preference, but not a hard gate. Either you already write strong production Python, or you have that depth in another serious general\-purpose language — Java, C\#, C, C\+\+, Scala, Go, or Rust — and are genuinely motivated to work in Python here. We'll give you the time and support to get fluent
* You write clean, maintainable, testable, extensible code. In Python that means type hints, linters and formatters (ruff, mypy, black), and a genuine testing habit with pytest; we'd expect the equivalent discipline in whatever language you've come from
* Strong software engineering fundamentals — modular design, sensible abstractions, dependency management, packaging, error handling, and knowing when \*not\* to add a layer
* You are hands\-on and want to stay hands\-on. You enjoy being in the code
* Practical experience with Git\-based workflows, code review, and CI/CD
* Strong experience with relational databases (e.g. Aurora PostgreSQL) — schema design, query writing, and understanding what happens under the hood
* Working knowledge of a cloud platform, ideally AWS (S3, Lambda, containers, IAM basics)
* You're comfortable with data\-shaped problems — batch processing, ETL, schema evolution — or you're keen to learn them
* You enjoy the business context and working closely with stakeholders rather than at arm's length
* You work well in Agile teams and value collaboration over solo heroics


 \#\# NICE TO HAVES
   

  

 Great if you bring these, but we'll happily teach you:
   

  

* Apache Spark / PySpark or other large\-scale distributed processing
* Big data experience — working with datasets and workloads that don't fit on one machine
* Additional languages used in data\-intensive software — Scala, Java, C\+\+, Go, or Rust — particularly where you've used them for performance\-sensitive or high\-throughput work
* Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or similar open table formats, and lakehouse architecture
* Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable data platforms
* CI/CD tooling such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK)
* Data quality frameworks like Great Expectations or Deequ
* Curiosity about financial markets, index data, or investment analytics
* Experience in finance domain (investment banking, asset/portfolio management) or in any product company


 Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to build software that matters, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Career Stage:**
 Manager
   

  

**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
 Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
   

  

 Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
 **Integrity, Partnership** 
 ,
 **Excellence** 
 and
 **Change** 
 underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
   

  

 Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
   

  

 We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
   

  

 LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
   

  

 Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject.
   

  

 If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

title: Senior Staff R&D Engineer – C/C++, Python, Unix/Linux, scripting
description:

 At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
   

  

 You Are:
   

  

 You are a driven and passionate engineer who thrives on solving complex system\-level challenges. You possess deep technical expertise in C/C\+\+ and Unix/Linux internals, and you bring a security\-first mindset to every line of code you write. You enjoy architecting scalable, robust, and high\-performance software that serves as the backbone for mission\-critical products. Your curiosity keeps you up\-to\-date with the latest advancements in licensing systems, application security, and cryptography. You take pride in delivering reliable solutions that protect intellectual property and enable business growth.
   

  

 You are a natural collaborator who communicates effectively across functions and geographies, ensuring alignment and clarity in development goals. You are comfortable taking ownership and initiative, proactively identifying potential risks and proposing innovative solutions. Your attention to detail and commitment to engineering excellence set you apart as a technical leader. You thrive in a fast\-paced environment where your analytical thinking and problem\-solving abilities are constantly challenged. You value continuous learning, embrace new technologies, and are motivated by the impact your work has on both product quality and customer trust.
   

  

 What You’ll Be Doing:

* Design, develop, enhance, and deploy Synopsys Common Licensing solutions from concept through production.
* Ensure licensing and security solutions operate reliably across heterogeneous Unix environments.
* Identify complex technical problems and deliver robust, scalable, and high‑quality system\-level solutions.
* Support product excellence through a strong focus on performance, reliability, accuracy, and robustness.
* Stay current with advancements in licensing systems, application security, and cryptography.
* Collaborate effectively across teams to meet aggressive development timelines.


 The Impact You Will Have:
   

  

* Protect Synopsys’ intellectual property with secure and reliable licensing infrastructure, safeguarding our innovations.
* Directly contribute to customer trust and revenue protection through robust licensing and security mechanisms.
* Drive Synopsys’ leadership in the industry by delivering high\-quality, scalable, and secure system software.
* Empower product teams worldwide by providing a strong, reliable foundation for feature\-rich solutions.
* Enhance the overall security posture of Synopsys products, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices.
* Support ongoing innovation by enabling rapid yet secure development and deployment cycles.


 What You’ll Need:

* Deep understanding of Unix signals, multi\-threading and synchronization mechanisms, socket programming, networking concepts, Unix system calls, and OS internals.

 Who You Are:
   

  

* Highly self\-driven and motivated, with the ability to operate effectively in dynamic, fast\-paced environments.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills.
* Capable of making sound technical decisions with good judgment and clear rationale.
* Demonstrates strong ownership, accountability, and meticulous attention to detail.
* Willingness and ability to continuously learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies.
* Collaborative team player with a passion for engineering excellence and shared success.


 The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:
   

  

 You will join a highly skilled team responsible for building and maintaining the core licensing and security infrastructure that underpins Synopsys products. The team’s focus is on driving innovation, security, and performance in system\-level software that operates across a wide variety of platforms. As a foundational group, you will enable product teams worldwide to deliver feature\-rich solutions without compromising on security or reliability. Collaboration, technical excellence, and a commitment to continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits:
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Senior Principal Engineer - SambaRack
description:
The era of pervasive AI has arrived. In this era, organizations will use generative AI to unlock hidden value in their data, accelerate processes, reduce costs, drive efficiency and innovation to fundamentally transform their businesses and operations at scale.
   

  

 SambaNova Suite™ is the first full\-stack, generative AI platform, from chip to model, optimized for enterprise and government organizations. Powered by the intelligent SN40L chip, the SambaNova Suite is a fully integrated platform, delivered on\-premises or in the cloud, combined with state\-of\-the\-art open\-source models that can be easily and securely fine\-tuned using customer data for greater accuracy. Once adapted with customer data, customers retain model ownership in perpetuity, so they can turn generative AI into one of their most valuable assets.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Join the company that's building the future of AI infrastructure. SambaNova is developing advanced AI systems powered by our RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) architecture, combining hardware and software into an integrated platform for large\-scale AI deployments.
   

  

 Our products include SambaRack, a rack\-scale AI infrastructure system, and SambaStack, our inference serving platform. Together, they enable customers to deploy and operate production AI environments with performance, reliability, and control.
   

  

 We are a team of engineers and innovators building next\-generation AI infrastructure systems designed for enterprise\-scale deployments.
   

  

**About The Role**
 SambaNova is hiring a Senior Principal Engineer for the SambaRack platform.
   

  

 You will help design and build the software that enables customers to monitor, control, update, and diagnose SambaRack systems safely and reliably.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Senior Full\-Stack Engineer – Scalable AI Applications**

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Full\-Stack Engineer** to join our engineering team and take ownership of building and scaling complex features for a **live, production\-grade AI\-powered platform**.

This is not a conventional full\-stack role focused primarily on standard web development. The platform is already in production and growing, and the engineering challenges involve **scalability, real\-time processing, AI integration, application performance, reliability, and evolving product architecture**.

We are looking for an engineer who enjoys solving problems where the implementation path may not be immediately obvious. You should be comfortable investigating complex technical challenges, evaluating alternative approaches, understanding trade\-offs, and taking solutions from architecture through production.

You will work hands\-on across **React, Python, Django, databases, APIs, caching, asynchronous processing, real\-time communication, cloud infrastructure, and AI integrations**, while collaborating closely with AI engineers and senior technology leaders.

Key ResponsibilitiesFull\-Stack Product Engineering

* Design, develop, and own complex product features across both **frontend and backend systems**.
* Build scalable, responsive, and maintainable frontend applications using **React**.
* Design and develop high\-performance backend services and APIs using **Python and Django**.
* Take complete ownership of technical problems from **investigation and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production troubleshooting**.
* Build reusable and maintainable components that support continuous product evolution.

Scalability \& Performance Engineering

* Design applications capable of scaling to **100,000\+ registered users, 10,000\+ daily active users, and 100\+ concurrent users**.
* Build and optimize systems supporting **real\-time user interactions and high levels of concurrent application traffic**.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, databases, AI services, and infrastructure.
* Apply appropriate scalability patterns including:
* Caching
* Asynchronous processing
* Background jobs
* Message queues
* Database optimization
* Load balancing
* Horizontal scaling
* WebSockets and real\-time communication
* API optimization
* Rate limiting
* Conduct performance analysis and help improve application response times, throughput, and resource utilization.

AI \& LLM Integration

* Collaborate closely with AI engineers to integrate **LLMs, AI APIs, machine\-learning services, and AI models** into production applications.
* Build application workflows around **RAG pipelines, vector search, AI\-powered search, streaming LLM responses, and real\-time AI interactions**.
* Design robust application interfaces between AI services and the core product.
* Handle challenges such as AI service latency, streaming responses, failures, retries, timeouts, and concurrent AI requests.
* Help translate AI capabilities into scalable, reliable, user\-facing product features.

Architecture \& Engineering

* Participate actively in application and platform architecture discussions.
* Work with senior engineering and technology leaders to design architecture for new product capabilities.
* Evaluate different implementation approaches based on **scalability, performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and development effort**.
* Break down complex technical requirements into clear and practical implementation approaches.
* Continuously improve existing architecture as product usage and technical requirements evolve.
* Identify technical debt and recommend practical approaches for addressing it.

Production Reliability \& Troubleshooting

* Diagnose complex production issues and identify **root causes rather than relying on temporary fixes**.
* Improve the reliability, maintainability, observability, and performance of production systems.
* Implement appropriate logging, monitoring, error handling, alerting, and application health mechanisms.
* Proactively identify scalability and reliability risks before they become production issues.
* Support production deployments and troubleshoot issues across application and infrastructure layers.

Engineering Leadership \& Mentorship

* Maintain high standards for code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering practices.
* Conduct code reviews and review technical approaches proposed by other engineers.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
* Help team members improve their engineering quality, architecture thinking, debugging, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Share technical knowledge, engineering practices, and lessons learned across the team.
* Contribute to building a strong engineering culture focused on **ownership, quality, experimentation, and continuous improvement**.

What We Are Looking ForCore Technical Skills

* **5\+ years of professional software engineering experience**, preferably building and operating production applications.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **React and modern frontend development**.
* Strong backend development experience with **Python and Django**.
* Strong understanding of **REST APIs, application architecture, authentication, databases, and backend system design**.
* Experience designing, building, or operating applications supporting significant user traffic and concurrency.
* Strong understanding of relational databases and practical experience with database design, indexing, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Experience working with caching, asynchronous processing, background jobs, and queues.
* Understanding of **WebSockets, Server\-Sent Events, or similar real\-time communication approaches**.
* Experience diagnosing production performance, scalability, and reliability issues.
* Good understanding of cloud\-native application architecture and deployment practices.

Problem\-Solving \& Ownership

We are particularly interested in engineers who are motivated by difficult technical problems.

You should be someone who can:

* Independently investigate unfamiliar technical problems.
* Understand the root cause before deciding on a solution.
* Research and evaluate alternative technical approaches.
* Work effectively when requirements or implementation paths are ambiguous.
* Make informed engineering trade\-offs between **speed, scalability, maintainability, and quality**.
* Challenge existing approaches constructively when a better solution is available.
* Take ownership rather than waiting for detailed technical instructions.
* Stay persistent when the first implementation approach does not work.
* Think beyond the immediate feature and consider its long\-term impact on the platform.

Technology Landscape

You should have strong experience with several of the following technologies or equivalent platforms:

**Frontend:**  
React, JavaScript/TypeScript, modern frontend frameworks and libraries

**Backend:**  
Python, Django, Django REST Framework, REST APIs

**Data \& Caching:**  
PostgreSQL/MySQL, Redis, database indexing and optimization

**Async \& Real\-Time:**  
Celery, message queues, background workers, WebSockets, Server\-Sent Events

**AI:**  
LLM APIs, AI/ML services, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, streaming AI responses

**Cloud:**  
AWS, EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Load Balancers, Lambda, Redis/ElastiCache or equivalent services

**DevOps \& Operations:**  
Docker, CI/CD, application monitoring, centralized logging, observability, performance monitoring

Nice to Have

* Experience building **high\-concurrency or real\-time applications**.
* Experience architecting applications on **AWS or another major cloud platform**.
* Experience with **Redis, Celery, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, or similar messaging technologies**.
* Experience integrating **LLMs or AI APIs into production applications**.
* Experience implementing **RAG and AI\-powered search solutions**.
* Experience with vector databases or semantic search technologies.
* Experience building applications with streaming AI responses.
* Experience with Docker and containerized production environments.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, tracing, and production observability.
* Experience conducting application performance testing and optimization.
* Experience working in a **startup, product company, or rapidly scaling technology environment**.

Mindset We Value

We value engineers who:

* **Enjoy difficult problems** rather than avoiding them.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of what they build.
* Are comfortable operating with ambiguity.
* Investigate problems deeply instead of applying temporary fixes.
* Learn unfamiliar technologies when required.
* Think about scalability before scalability becomes a problem.
* Consider production reliability as part of development.
* Proactively identify technical risks.
* Communicate technical trade\-offs clearly.
* Challenge assumptions when better approaches are possible.
* Balance engineering excellence with the execution speed required in a growing organization.
* Help other engineers become better problem solvers.

Why Join This Role

This is an opportunity to work on a **live, rapidly evolving AI platform** where engineering decisions directly influence product performance, scalability, reliability, and user experience.

You will not simply receive predefined development tasks. You will be expected to **understand the underlying problem, participate in solution architecture, evaluate technical approaches, build the solution, and take ownership of its performance in production**.

You will work at the intersection of **full\-stack engineering, scalable application architecture, cloud infrastructure, real\-time systems, and Generative AI**.

If you enjoy building sophisticated applications, solving problems without obvious answers, and taking meaningful ownership of how a technology platform evolves, this role provides the opportunity to do exactly that.

description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **Company Description**



Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre\-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.


### **Position Description**



We are seeking an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to play a key role in building and scaling the **Okta Recovery Vault (ORV)**. This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise\-grade soft\-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.



As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real\-time, high\-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.


### **Job Duties and Responsibilities**


* **Feature Execution:** Drive the technical design and end\-to\-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers.
* **Component Design:** Design and build reliable core components for real\-time recovery systems that capture deletion events and support scalable data restoration.
* **Relationship \& State Management:** Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency.
* **Security \& Compliance:** Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft\-delete, restore, permanent\-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.
* **Product \& Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones.
* **Operational Excellence:** Participate in on\-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.
* **Code Quality \& Technical Standards:** Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* **Team Growth:** Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality.

### **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**


* **Experience:** 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production\-grade applications.
* **Java Expertise:** Strong proficiency in object\-oriented programming, with extensive experience in **Java** and the **Spring Boot** framework.
* **Distributed Systems:** Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event\-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).
* **Data Management:** Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., **MySQL**) and caching strategies (e.g., **Redis**) to manage state and high\-throughput data snapshots.
* **API Design:** Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust **RESTful APIs** for enterprise integration.
* **Problem Solving \& Ownership:** Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs.

### **Nice to Haves**


* Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
* Experience with resilient systems design (e.g., retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting).
* Hands\-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies.
* Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e.g., Kafka).

### **Education and Training**


* **B.S. or M.S.** in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
