description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)** 
 is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100\+ countries make better decisions. Join our world\-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Customer Engineer is our entry point into technical customer success — a hands\-on executor who learns by doing, builds foundational platform knowledge, and contributes to reliable, well\-documented customer solutions. This role works in structured environments under clear guidance, following patterns set by more senior roles. Success here is about learning deeply, executing reliably, and building the habits of quality and repeatability that define great Customer Engineers at every level.
   

  

**What You'll Contribute**
* Analyze recurring and complex customer\-impacting engineering issues and identify opportunities for AI\-driven automation.
* Build AI\-powered tools and workflows that help engineers diagnose, troubleshoot, remediate, and prevent customer issues.
* Develop prompt harnesses and evaluation frameworks to systematically test LLM solutions against real\-world engineering scenarios.
* Work with code, logs, configurations, documentation, tickets, incidents, and other engineering context to build grounded AI solutions.
* Design agentic workflows where LLMs can reason over context, use tools, perform actions, validate results, and iterate.
* Understand and optimize the complete LLM loop: Context → Prompt → Model → Tool → Observation → Validation → Iteration
* Investigate AI failures methodically and improve prompts, context, tools, model selection, and workflows.
* Build prototypes quickly and turn successful experiments into reliable, reusable engineering capabilities.
* Develop automation that can identify patterns across customer issues and surface potential root causes or recommended actions.
* Measure solutions using meaningful engineering metrics such as accuracy, resolution time, automation rate, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Partner with internal engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing tools and workflows.
* Help establish reusable patterns for applying AI to customer engineering problems at scale.


**What We're Seeking**
* Early\-career experience in a technical implementation or customer\-facing role, with a demonstrated ability to translate well\-defined requirements into concrete technical tasks across configuration, integration, and deployment scenarios.
* 4\+ years of experience. Experience in LLM Application Development: Hands\-on experience building production applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and function/tool calling.
* Experience in AI Agents \& Orchestration: Experience building agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent, including MCP/tool integrations.
* Experience in Production AI Engineering: Strong Python/software engineering skills with experience deploying, monitoring, evaluating, and optimizing AI workloads for reliability, latency, cost, and security.
* Basic working knowledge of enterprise software platforms, APIs, and integrations, with a willingness to develop fluency in FICO Platform, decision management, and related analytics and fraud capabilities.
* Ability to document solutions, runbooks, and support procedures to ensure long\-term maintainability, and to flag early\-stage risks such as data gaps and environment constraints to senior team members.
* Comfortable working within structured team environments under guidance, with clear communication of technical progress and issues to both customer and internal teams.
* A proactive approach to continuous skill development with demonstrated curiosity, reliability, and professionalism in customer\-facing situations — even under ambiguity.


**Our Offer to You**
* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people\-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.


**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
 At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest\-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
   

  

 FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
   

  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.


 Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
   

  

 Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
   

  

 FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy\-policy

title: TechOps-DE-AI-Staff-Assistant-GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Service line \- Position Title: TechOps \- Staff – Digital Engineering Operations – AI Engineer**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Staff in the EY GDS Tech Ops practice, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and supporting AI\-powered solutions that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), AI services, and enterprise integrations. You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to build intelligent automation solutions, AI agents, and digital workflows that improve operational efficiency and business outcomes. This role requires strong software development skills, a passion for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams to deliver scalable, secure, and responsible AI solutions.
   

  

 You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
   

  

 You will anticipate and identify risks within engagement and share any issues with senior members of the team.
   

  

 In line with EY commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test, and deploy Agentic AI solutions leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems, AI agents, and orchestration frameworks to automate business and operational processes.
* Integrate LLMs, NLP, Computer Vision, and other AI/ML services with enterprise applications and platforms through APIs, SDKs, and cloud\-native technologies.
* Develop custom applications, services, and automation workflows using Python and modern AI frameworks to enable intelligent process automation and system integration.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, maintain, and optimize AI agents and automated workflows to ensure reliability, scalability, performance, and security.
* Collaborate with AI Platform, Engineering, Operations, and Business teams to identify use cases, implement AI solutions, and operationalize enterprise AI capabilities.
* Create technical documentation, contribute to reusable AI accelerators and best practices, and ensure solutions comply with security, governance, risk management, and Responsible AI standards.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, NLP, machine learning concepts, and experience integrating AI services into enterprise applications and business workflows.
* Proficiency in Python and experience integrating enterprise systems through APIs, SDKs, and cloud\-native services to develop AI\-powered automation solutions.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including AI/ML services, vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search technologies.
* Understanding of AI governance, Responsible AI principles, security, privacy, and operational practices such as DevOps, MLOps, and LLMOps is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across AI, engineering, operations, platform, and business teams to deliver impactful AI solutions.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
* 2\-4 years of experience in software development, automation, AI/ML, or related technology roles, with exposure to Generative AI or AI\-powered solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, or AI\-powered workflow automation.
* Proficiency in Python and experience developing APIs, integrations, automation scripts, or enterprise applications. Knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks, NLP technologies, vector databases, semantic search, and cloud\-based AI services such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of software development best practices, AI governance, model evaluation, monitoring, security, and Responsible AI principles.


**What we look for:**
* Passionate and curious technologists with a strong interest in Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and emerging AI technologies, coupled with hands\-on experience in Python development and enterprise integrations.
* Continuous learners who stay current with advancements in LLMs, AI agents, RAG architecture, agent orchestration frameworks, and cloud\-based AI services.
* Strong problem solvers with the ability to analyze complex business challenges, identify automation opportunities, and design innovative AI\-driven solutions.
* Self\-motivated professionals who take ownership of outcomes and proactively troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance AI\-enabled workflows and systems.
* Collaborative team players who can effectively partner with AI, engineering, platform, operations, and business stakeholders in distributed, hybrid, and global work environments.
* Engineers with a strong customer and business\-value mindset, capable of translating requirements into scalable, secure, and impactful AI solutions.
* Detail\-oriented professionals who maintain high standards for code quality, testing, documentation, governance, and operational excellence.
* Individuals with strong communication and presentation skills, able to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Professionals who embrace innovation while balancing Responsible AI principles, security, compliance, and enterprise governance requirements.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Quantitative Analyst -Systematic Trading & Alpha Research
description:
About the Role
 
 We are a start\-up proprietary trading firm building a high\-performance quantitative research capability in Bangalore. We are looking for a rigorous, intellectually curious Quantitative Analyst to join our systematic trading research team.
 



 In this role, you will develop, backtest, and refine quantitative trading models across digital asset and alternative markets. You will work with large\-scale market datasets (on\-chain, order book, derivatives), apply statistical and machine learning methods to identify alpha signals, and collaborate closely with discretionary traders and engineers to bring strategies from research to production.
 



 This is not a support role — you will own the full lifecycle from hypothesis generation through model validation to live performance monitoring.
 



*If you think in distributions, not predictions, and want to build systematic strategies in a market where inefficiencies are abundant but fleeting, this is the role.* 



 Key Responsibilities
 * Design, develop, and backtest systematic trading strategies using statistical, econometric, and machine learning techniques across digital asset spot, derivatives, and DeFi markets.
* Identify and extract alpha signals from diverse data sources: order book dynamics, on\-chain metrics, funding rates, liquidation cascades, sentiment data, and macro indicators.
* Build and maintain robust backtesting frameworks with proper handling of transaction costs, slippage, market impact, and survivorship/look\-ahead bias.
* Develop market regime classification models to dynamically adjust strategy parameters and risk exposure.
* Conduct research on market microstructure, cross\-exchange arbitrage opportunities, basis trading, and volatility surface dynamics in Digital assets derivatives.
* Collaborate with engineers to productionise validated models — define signal generation pipelines, feature engineering specifications, and real\-time inference requirements.
* Monitor live strategy performance, investigate P\&L attribution and drawdown drivers, and iterate on models based on production feedback.
* Prepare research memos, strategy documentation, and performance reports for senior leadership and risk oversight.
* Stay current on academic and industry developments in quantitative finance, market microstructure, and applied ML for trading.
* Contribute to the firm’s quantitative research codebase, ensuring code quality, reproducibility, and documentation standards.


 Requirements \- Must Have
 * 2–5 years of experience in quantitative research, systematic trading, or quantitative risk management at a prop trading firm, hedge fund, or asset manager.
* Strong foundation in probability, statistics, time series analysis, and stochastic processes; comfort with hypothesis testing, regression, and dimensionality reduction.
* Proficiency in Python for research (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, statsmodels, scikit\-learn); experience with at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow) is expected.
* Demonstrated experience building backtesting systems or strategy simulation frameworks with realistic cost and execution modelling.
* Familiarity with financial derivatives pricing, Greeks, and risk factor models; understanding of digital assets\-specific instruments (perpetual futures, funding rates, basis).
* Strong programming discipline — version control (Git), testing, modular code architecture, and documentation.
* Ability to communicate complex quantitative concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Willingness to work flexible hours aligned to 24/7 digital assets market cycles when strategies are in deployment or under observation.


 Requirements Good to Have
 * Experience with Hidden Markov Models, regime\-switching models, or state\-space models for financial applications.
* Exposure to gradient\-boosted tree methods (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) for feature importance and signal generation.
* Familiarity with on\-chain data analytics (Nansen, Dune, Santiment, Glassnode) and DeFi protocol mechanics.
* Experience with alternative data sources — social sentiment, news NLP, satellite data, or blockchain\-native metrics.
* Knowledge of optimal execution algorithms (TWAP, VWAP, implementation shortfall) and market impact modelling.
* Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in a quantitative discipline: Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or Econometrics.
* Professional certifications: CFA, FRM, CQF, or equivalent.


 International Relocation Path
 
 This role offers a structured path to relocation to Singapore or Dubai after a minimum of 12 months, subject to performance, research output, and business requirements. Our quantitative research function will scale internationally as the firm expands.
 


 Why Join Us
 * Build systematic trading strategies in digital assets markets where alpha opportunities are structurally richer and less competed than traditional asset classes.
* Full\-cycle ownership from research to production — no handing off models to a separate implementation team.
* Access to institutional\-grade data infrastructure, analytics platforms, and exchange connectivity from day one.
* Collaborative culture that values rigour, intellectual honesty, and evidence\-based decision\-making over hierarchy.
* Competitive compensation with performance\-linked profit sharing directly tied to strategy P\&L.

description:

 Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage and creativity, where you can be on the team shaping the future of global commerce? Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re interested in joining a purpose\-driven community that is dedicated to crafting an ambitious and inclusive work environment, join eBay — a company you can be proud to be with.
   

  

 eBay’s Ads teams build the production systems that help buyers discover relevant inventory and help sellers grow their businesses. These systems span multiple applied ML domains, including sponsored search, item recommendations, seller guidance experiences, ranking, retrieval, personalization, and GenAI\-powered capabilities.
   

  

 As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will help build the platforms, services, APIs, data pipelines, and MLOps capabilities that bring cutting edge AI models into production at eBay scale. You will engineer the data pipelines that feed our models, build the infrastructure to train and serve them, and develop the APIs that deliver personalized experiences to millions of users. You will work at the intersection of machine learning and software engineering, solving complex challenges in system design and the operationalization of the latest Generative AI technologies. You will partner closely with Applied Researchers, Product Managers, and cross\-org Engineering teams to turn prototypes into robust, scalable, low\-latency systems for millions of customers.
   

  

 This is a shared hiring role across Ads teams. Final team placement will be determined after offers based on each candidate’s experience, strengths, and fit with the needs of Ads Recommendations, Ads Search, and Ads Guidance.
   

  

**What You Will Accomplish**
* Design, build, and operate scalable backend and ML systems supporting sponsored experiences, ranking, retrieval, and personalization.
* Develop and own the MLOps pipelines for continuous integration, continuous delivery (CI/CD), training, validation, and monitoring of all production\-grade models.
* Engineer robust data pipelines using big data technologies to process vast datasets for model training and feature engineering.
* Implement and optimize both traditional ML models and state\-of\-the\-art Generative AI models (including LLMs) for low\-latency serving and high\-throughput environments.
* Collaborate closely with Applied Researchers to translate novel algorithms and research prototypes into hardened, production\-ready code.
* Champion software engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and documentation, within the machine learning team.
* Monitor system performance, identify and resolve production issues, and continuously improve the reliability and efficiency of our ML services.
* Mentor other team members through code reviews, technical guidance, architecture design, and pair programming.


**What You Will Bring**
* MS in Computer Science or related area with 7\+ years of relevant work experience (or BS/BA with 9\+ years) in in ML / AI / Data Engineering.
* Expert in production engineering practices and software development in an OO language (Scala, Java, Python, etc.).
* Extensive experience in big data distributed processing frameworks, e.g. Apache Hadoop, Spark, Flink.
* Experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch from a production perspective. Experience with serving frameworks (TensorFlow Serving, TorchServe, NVIDIA Triton) and libraries for LLM operations (LangChain, Hugging Face Transformers) preferred.
* Proven ability to build and manage CI/CD pipelines for ML models, including proficiency with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with using cloud services, big data pipelines and databases, e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure.
* Proven ability to design and build scalable, distributed systems and expose their functionality through well\-designed RESTful or gRPC APIs.
* A masterful understanding of the challenges and requirements of running machine learning in a live, 24/7 production environment, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response.

title: Junior Associate/Associate - AI Prompt & Market Rollout Specialist
description:
Job Title: Junior Associate/Associate \- AI Prompt \& Market Rollout Specialist
   

  

 Career Level: C1/C2
   

  

**Introduction To Role**
 Are you ready to turn cutting\-edge generative AI into better customer conversations that ultimately improve patient outcomes? Join the team scaling an AI Coach that uses Meta\-Skills Avatars to elevate field engagement across multiple brands and markets. You will help translate global benchmark avatars into market\-ready experiences, shaping a strategic capability that connects technology, commercial excellence, and measurable impact in the field.
   

  

 You will orchestrate complex, parallel rollouts across 40–50 markets while getting hands\-on with prompt and context engineering for six brands, with potential expansion into additional therapy areas. Working closely with Commercial, Medical Excellence, GBS, and Commercial IT stakeholders, you will drive quality, speed, and adoption from pilot to launch. Can you balance precision in prompts with the pace needed to deliver hundreds of avatars in year one?
   

  

 Based in India and aligned to European time zones, you will operate in English and collaborate globally, coordinating market stakeholders and enabling rapid adaptation within our governance and compliance frameworks.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Market coordination: Build and maintain market\-specific rollout plans to achieve on\-time pilots and launches across 40–50 markets; manage dependencies, sequencing, and cross\-market timelines to keep the program moving at pace.
* Prompt and context engineering: Customize 3–4 scenarios per brand and approximately nine prompts per scenario, adapting persona, language, and local context while preserving core feedback logic to improve realism and learning outcomes.
* Avatar adaptation: Guide markets to complete fast\-turn adaptations (1–6 hours per avatar), including persona and face changes, language localization, and scenario tweaks; validate first\-time translations to reduce rework and maintain precision.
* Testing and QA orchestration: Run market testing cycles, capture structured feedback, iterate prompts quickly, and ensure regulatory, medical, and brand alignment across commercial use cases.
* Governance and change management: Partner with change leads to socialize the AI Coach, manage approval gates, and sustain adoption metrics; keep leadership informed with clear, cadence\-based reporting.
* Capacity planning: Model throughput to hit an annual target of 200–250 avatars; forecast resource needs and recommend resourcing plans and support model enhancements to meet business priorities.
* Stakeholder integration: Collaborate across GBS, Commercial IT, and business teams to evolve enterprise\-wide prompt and context engineering capability, connecting technical work to commercial value.
* Enablement and training: Leverage Meta\-Skills onboarding, support SME training for Avatar Studio, and produce templates and playbooks that standardize market adaptations to reduce variance.
* Risk and compliance: Apply brand, medical, and regulatory guardrails consistently; surface risks early and drive mitigation across markets and brands to protect quality and speed.


**Essential Skills/Experience**
* Experience: 4\-6 years in commercial learning technologies, conversational AI, or digital rollout across multiple markets; experience coordinating vendors and internal teams.
* Technical skills: Hands\-on with generative AI prompting, context curation, and scenario design; familiarity with avatar\-based simulations and feedback frameworks.
* Domain knowledge: Understanding of pharma commercial practices (PCS/customer engagement), brand localization, and approval workflows; knowledge of medical/market access contexts is a plus.
* Language and localization: Experience guiding multilingual deployments; comfortable validating translations for accuracy and tone, even when core logic remains unchanged.
* Project delivery: Strong program coordination, QA, and governance execution; adept at tracking milestones across parallel rollouts. Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Communication: Clear, structured communication with market stakeholders and executives; ability to produce concise status, risks, and adoption insights.
* Tools: Exposure to Avatar Studio or similar; prompt repositories, QA frameworks, and basic analytics; SSO\-aware user flows and compliance processes.


**Desirable Skills/Experience**
* Experience with RAG\-enhanced prompting.
* Prior work in BBU brands or similar therapeutic areas; understanding of iCVA, adoption ladders, and objection handling.


 Background in GBS/Commercial IT or Commercial Excellence teams, bridging business and technology.
   

  

**When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the** 
 power to inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
   

  

**Why AstraZeneca**
 Here, your expertise powers meaningful change. You will join a global, fast\-moving community that pairs scientific ambition with real\-world impact, using data, predictive analytics and smart automation to reimagine how we work for the benefit of patients with unmet needs. We bring unexpected teams together to spark bold ideas, move decisively, and support one another with kindness as well as ambition. With significant investment in digital capabilities and a culture that encourages thoughtful risk\-taking and continuous learning, you will have the scope to shape enterprise\-scale solutions and see your work contribute directly to better outcomes for patients and society.
   

  

**Call To Action**
 If you are ready to build a strategic AI capability and see your work elevate field engagement across markets, submit your application and help us deliver smarter coaching at scale today!

title: Geospatial Analyst
description:
**About AiDASH**  

  

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.



The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\.



Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

### **The Role**



As a Geospatial Analyst at AiDASH, you will produce high\-quality annotated datasets from diverse imagery sources — satellite, LiDAR, aerial, and ground\-based panoramic images and videos. Your work will directly feed AI/ML pipelines and client deliverables that protect critical infrastructure. This role demands a sharp eye for detail, comfort working with visual and geospatial data at scale, and fluency with modern AI tools. You won't just annotate images; you'll build AI\-accelerated workflows that make the entire team faster.


### **How** **You'll** **Make an Impact**


* Annotate and label imagery (satellite, LiDAR, aerial, drone, ground\-based panoramic photos and videos) to identify, classify, and delineate features such as vegetation, assets, terrain, and infrastructure components
* Prepare, extract, and organize spatial and non\-spatial data based on AI model and customer delivery requirements
* Review annotated data for patterns, trends, and quality issues using annotation platforms and in\-house tools
* Use AI tools and assistants to accelerate annotation and workflows, auto\-generate documentation, and draft reports
* Perform annotation tasks including object classification, digitization, geo\-referencing, and feature creation across multi\-source imagery
* Leverage generative AI tools to build automations or semi\-automated annotation pipelines that boost team productivity
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to define annotation guidelines, refine labelling schemas, and ensure datasets meet model training and delivery standards
* Ensure productivity targets are met with utmost focus on annotation quality, consistency, and adherence to project specifications

### **What** **We're** **Looking For**


* 1 to 4 years of work experience in imagery annotation, image analysis, remote sensing, or a related domain
* Hands\-on experience with annotation and labelling platforms; familiarity with GIS software is an added advantage
* Demonstrated use of generative AI tools(e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to enhance day\-to\-day work — whether for analysis, drafting reports, automating repetitive tasks, improving annotation speed, or any other productivity gains
* Comfortable using Gen AI tools to draft reports, generate annotation guidelines, and summarize analysis outputs with sound judgment
* Working knowledge of Python or scripting for data processing and automation is preferred; geospatial libraries are a bonus
* Experience working with satellite imagery, aerial photography, LiDAR point clouds, or video annotation for AI/ML pipelines
* Ability to learn quickly and develop deep functional knowledge of project specifications, annotation schemas, and quality procedures
* Strong focus on data quality, annotation accuracy, and consistency across large\-scale datasets


We are proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.



We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.

**Industry:** Real Estate / Construction / ConTech

About Bandhoo

Bandhoo is a construction technology company building technology\-led solutions to improve **quality, transparency, and productivity** across the construction industry.

We are looking for a **Construction Quality Expert** with strong hands\-on experience in **construction QA/QC, quality inspections, snagging, defect identification, and site quality audits**.

This role is ideal for someone who has worked extensively on construction sites as a **QA/QC Engineer, Quality Engineer, QC Engineer, Quality Inspector, or QA/QC Manager** and can independently inspect construction work, identify defects, understand their root causes, and determine whether work meets the required quality standards.

**This is a hands\-on Quality role, not a Project Management role.** Candidates whose experience is primarily in project execution, project planning, project management, cost management, or client coordination without strong hands\-on QA/QC experience will not be suitable.

Key Responsibilities1\. Construction Quality Inspection

* Conduct detailed **site quality inspections and construction quality audits**.
* Inspect work across different stages of construction, including:
* RCC \& Structural Works
* Masonry / Blockwork
* Plastering
* Waterproofing
* Flooring \& Tiling
* Painting \& Finishing
* Doors \& Windows
* False Ceiling
* Plumbing
* Electrical \& MEP works
* Identify **defects, workmanship issues, deviations, incomplete works, and quality deficiencies**.
* Verify construction work against approved **drawings, specifications, BOQ, ITPs, method statements, and applicable quality standards**.
* Determine the severity and impact of identified defects.

2\. Snagging \& Defect Assessment

* Conduct **snagging, pre\-handover and quality inspections**.
* Prepare detailed snag/punch lists with:
* Defect description
* Location
* Photographs
* Severity
* Recommended corrective action
* Conduct **re\-inspections** after rectification and verify closure of defects.
* Identify recurring quality issues and their possible root causes.

3\. QA/QC Documentation

* Review and work with **ITPs, Method Statements, NCRs, IRs, inspection checklists, and quality reports**.
* Maintain quality inspection records and documentation.
* Evaluate contractor workmanship and adherence to approved quality standards.
* Support development of **quality checklists, defect categories and quality benchmarks**.

4\. Construction Quality \& CONSTRA

Bandhoo is building **CONSTRA**, an AI\-powered construction quality management platform.

The Quality Expert will:

* Use practical construction knowledge to help define **real\-world construction defects and quality issues**.
* Review and validate defects identified through site photographs/videos.
* Help create standardized **defect taxonomies, inspection checklists and quality benchmarks**.
* Provide expert feedback to the product and engineering teams to improve CONSTRA's quality assessment capabilities.
* Participate in pilot projects and testing of digital inspection workflows.

**No prior AI or technology experience is required. Strong construction quality expertise is what matters.**

5\. Site \& Client Assessments

* Conduct quality assessments at construction and real estate projects.
* Visit project sites across Bangalore and other locations when required.
* Interact with site engineers, contractors and client representatives to explain quality observations.
* Provide clear and practical recommendations for defect rectification.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate should have:

* **5–8 years of hands\-on construction QA/QC experience**.
* Strong experience in **construction quality inspection and defect identification**.
* Experience with **snagging, pre\-handover inspection, quality audits, and defect closure**.
* Strong knowledge of **civil construction and finishing quality**.
* Practical understanding of **ITPs, Method Statements, NCRs, IRs and material testing**.
* Ability to identify defects by physically inspecting construction work.
* Good understanding of **IS Codes and construction quality standards**.
* Experience evaluating contractor workmanship and quality compliance.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent.

Preferred Background

Candidates from the following backgrounds are preferred:

* QA/QC Engineer
* Senior QA/QC Engineer
* Quality Engineer
* Construction Quality Engineer
* QC Engineer
* Quality Inspector
* Construction Quality Auditor
* Snagging / Property Inspection Professional
* QA/QC Manager **with strong hands\-on site inspection experience**

Experience with **real estate developers, builders, PMC companies, construction companies, property inspection firms, or quality consultancies** will be an advantage.

Not Suitable For This Role

**Please do not apply if your experience is primarily in:**

* Project Management
* Project Planning
* Project Coordination
* Cost Management
* Contracts / Commercial
* Business Development
* General Site Management without strong QA/QC responsibility

**We are specifically looking for a Quality professional who can personally inspect construction work and identify what is wrong, why it is wrong, and how it should be rectified.**

Why Join Bandhoo?

* Work at the intersection of **Construction \+ Quality \+ AI \+ Technology**.
* Use your construction quality expertise to shape an AI\-powered quality platform.
* Work across multiple real estate and construction projects.
* Opportunity to build standardized construction\-quality practices using technology.
* Be part of a growing ConTech company transforming construction quality assessment.

This role will collaborate closely with data scientists, machine learning engineers, product teams, and domain experts to translate business problems into machine learning solutions. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, sound judgment within their area of expertise, and the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and findings across teams.

  

We are a fast\-paced, energetic team driven by continuous process improvement. We’re looking for motivated, organized, and independent team members who are passionate about solving challenging problems using data, machine learning, and computer vision. This position requires strong analytical and programming skills, curiosity to explore new technologies, and the ability to quickly learn and apply evolving AI techniques.


Responsibilities:
* Develop, train, evaluate, and improve machine learning and deep learning models using aerial imagery and geospatial datasets.
* Design and conduct experiments to evaluate model architectures, training strategies, datasets, and other approaches to improve model performance.
* Perform data exploration, preprocessing, and error analysis to identify data quality issues, model limitations, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop computer vision solutions for tasks such as segmentation, depth estimation, object detection, and image classification.
* Apply established machine learning practices and technical judgment to solve defined problems with minimal guidance.
* Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, product teams, and domain experts to develop effective machine learning solutions.
* Contribute to reproducible training, evaluation, benchmarking, and model development workflows.
* Communicate findings and technical decisions, contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing, and participate in technical reviews and design discussions.


Qualifications:
**Required Experience:*** 2–4 years of hands\-on experience in data science, machine learning, computer vision, or a related field.
* Strong programming experience in Python, with experience using common data science and machine learning libraries.
* Hands\-on experience developing and training deep learning models using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar.
* Understanding of fundamental machine learning concepts, including supervised learning, self\-supervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering and optimization.
* Familiarity with computer vision concepts and techniques, such as instance and semantic segmentation, depth estimation, object detection, image classification, or related tasks.
* Experience working with large datasets, including data preprocessing, dataset preparation, and exploratory data analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex model and data\-related issues **and develop appropriate solutions within a defined problem space**.
* Ability to design and execute experiments, **interpret results, and clearly communicate findings and recommendations.**
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS and GPU\-based model training environments.
* Effective **written and verbal communication skills** and the ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git, and collaborative software development practices.

**Preferred Experience:*** Experience working with aerial, satellite, geospatial, or other large\-scale imagery datasets.
* Experience with modern deep learning architectures such as Vision Transformers, Foundation Models and CNNs.
* Exposure to MLOps practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, reproducible training pipelines, and model lifecycle management.
* Experience with distributed or large\-scale model training.
* Familiarity with geospatial data formats, GIS concepts, or remote sensing applications.

**Core Competencies:**
The successful candidate will demonstrate strength in the following competencies as well as which can be found here:* **Drive \& Follow Through** – Takes initiative and turns ideas into action.
* **Adaptability in Uncertainty** – Adjusts quickly and performs through change.

title: Manager, Account Analytics Development
description:
**Overview**  

**About Business Unit:**  

Powerful predictors of the future \- our Analytics team seamlessly blends data science and business intelligence to provide unparalleled foresight for our platform offerings. They turn insights into actionable results for our clients by collaborating with senior team members and staying ahead of market trends, powered by our data assets. By using new\-age analytic tools and emerging technologies, the team cultivates a dynamic learning environment for curious minds to thrive.
  

  

**How You'll Make an Impact:**  

The
  

**Manager, Account Analytics Development** is a hands\-on technical leader. You will personally design and build the most technically demanding parts of our AI capability, and you will hire and develop the engineer who works alongside you. This is a small, senior team \- today a VP and a Lead. You will be the third member, and the first person you hire will report to you.
  

  

We already run AI agents in production that generate analyst\-grade SQL against our analytics environment. That foundation works. What comes next is harder, and it is the reason this role exists.
  

  

**What You'll Build:**  

**Interpretation.** Systems that take the output of an analysis and produce business\-relevant interpretation \- what the numbers mean for this client, in this category, given what we know about their objectives. This is the distance between a query result and an insight, and closing it requires reasoning, not summarization.
  

  

**Client knowledge.** A knowledge system that accumulates and organizes what the organization understands about each client: their business, their category, their measurement history, and Epsilon's relationship with them. It has to serve both people and agents, and it has to compound with use rather than decay into a stale wiki.
  

  

**Media investment planning.** Analytical tooling that supports budget allocation and media investment planning \- putting scenario and optimization capability directly in the hands of client teams.
  

  

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  

  

**Responsibilities**  

**Architecture and Systems Design**
  

* Own the architecture of our AI capability: how agents are scoped, how they compose, and where the boundaries sit between tools, context, and model reasoning.
* Design evaluation before you design the solution. Define how we will know an agent is correct, how we detect regression in a non\-deterministic system, and where human review belongs in the loop.
* Establish the engineering standards \- source control, testing, documentation, deployment \- that let a three\-person team ship reliably today and a larger team ship reliably later.

  

**Hands\-On Delivery**
  

* Write production code.
* Prototype quickly to resolve technical uncertainty, then make the explicit call about what graduates into a supported system and what gets discarded.
* Take personal ownership of the components carrying the highest technical risk rather than delegating them.

  

**Team Leadership**
  

* Hire, onboard, and develop your first direct report at senior engineer level.
* Set technical direction and raise the quality bar through design review and code review.
* Absorb technical scope currently carried by the VP and become a person the wider analytics organization brings its hardest problems to.
* Promote engineering discipline, documentation, code quality, and knowledge sharing across the team.

  

**Business Partnership**
  

* Work directly with analytics leads and client teams, most of whom are US\-based, to find where automation and AI create real leverage \- and where they do not.
* Translate loosely specified business problems into system designs, and explain those designs credibly to non\-technical partners.
* Balance experimentation against the reality that these tools enter client\-facing workflows and have to keep working.
* Your work will be evaluated by the level of usage and adoption by the rest of the Analytics team and the ability of the tools you and the team develop to drive greater efficiency and insights

  

**Qualifications**  

* 8\+ years building software or data products, including leading technical design on complex, ambiguous projects.
* Strong Python and advanced SQL. You are comfortable both in a substantial codebase and in an analytical data warehouse.
* Demonstrated experience designing and shipping LLM\-based systems in production \- agents, tool use, orchestration, structured outputs \- not prototypes or prompt experimentation alone.
* Systems thinking. You can take an ambiguous capability such as "interpret this analysis" and decompose it into components, interfaces, and failure modes, then explain why you drew the boundaries where you did.
* A considered point of view on evaluating non\-deterministic systems, and practical experience applying it.
* Working familiarity with marketing measurement \- attribution, incrementality, media mix modeling, campaign performance \- sufficient to judge whether an automated interpretation is analytically sound. You will not be building measurement models; you will be building systems that reason about their output.
* Experience mentoring or leading engineers, whether or not you have held a formal management title.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

  

**Additional Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**  

**Preferred Technical Experience**
  

* Agentic development environments \- Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar \- used as a daily working tool rather than tried once.
* Databricks, Greenplum or PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, or comparable analytical platforms.
* Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and disciplined code review practice.
* Building knowledge management or retrieval systems that stay accurate as they grow.
* Integrating applications with APIs, databases, and enterprise platforms.
* Marketing analytics, media, or adtech background.
* Working with data under client confidentiality and governance constraints.

  

**How You Work**
  

* You are opinionated about design and you change your mind when the evidence says to.
* You are comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room and equally comfortable being wrong in it.
* You would rather ship something useful and imperfect than design something elegant that never lands.

  

**Additional Information**  

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.  

  

Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400\+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real\-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry\-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.  

  

Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day.  

* **People centricity:** We focus on employee well\-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other.
* **Collaboration:** We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals.
* **Growth:** There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement.
* **Innovation:** We drive progress through cutting\-edge solutions and forward\-thinking approaches.
* **Flexibility:** We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively.

  

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.  

* Act with integrity
* Work together to win together
* Innovate with purpose
* Respect all voices
* Empower with accountability

  

These pillars and values are our foundation\-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.  

  

**Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
  

Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

title: IT Applications Engineer - Technology IT
description:
About Signant Health
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  

About the Role
  
The IT Applications Engineer is a generalist engineering and support role responsible for the day\-to\-day administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Signant Health's core business applications. The role carries particular depth in NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Box, and Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence), while also supporting the broader enterprise application portfolio as needed.
  
This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role that blends technical engineering — configuration, scripting, integrations, automations, and upgrades — with day\-to\-day operational support — tickets, incidents, and user requests. The IT Applications Engineer is a trusted first\- and second\-line point of contact for application issues, and is equally comfortable delivering enhancements and automations that improve reliability and reduce manual effort across the application landscape. Where the IT Application Operations Manager sets direction and leads the team, this role does the technical and support work directly, partnering closely with the Service Operations, Infrastructure Operations, and Security Operations teams.
  
  

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function
  
1\. Application Administration \& Configuration — Own day\-to\-day administration and configuration of NetSuite, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID), Box, and Atlassian (Jira, JSM, Confluence), plus other assigned enterprise applications, including user provisioning, permissions, and platform settings.
  
2\. Technical Support \& Incident Resolution — Act as a key point of escalation for tier 2/3 application support tickets, diagnosing and resolving issues across the supported application stack and coordinating with vendors and other IT teams as needed.
  
3\. Engineering \& Customization — Build and maintain customizations to meet business requirements — including SuiteScript/SuiteFlow (NetSuite), Power Automate/Graph API automations (Microsoft 365\), workflow and scripting configuration (Atlassian), and equivalent customizations for other supported applications.
  
4\. Integrations \& Automation — Develop and support integrations between applications using APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tooling, building automations that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  
5\. Change, Release \& Patch Management — Plan, test, and execute upgrades, patches, and configuration changes across supported applications, minimizing disruption to the business.
  
6\. Security \& Compliance — Apply access control, licensing, and data\-handling practices aligned with company security policy and relevant regulatory and quality requirements.
  
7\. Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement — Monitor application health, usage, and performance; proactively identify issues and recommend and implement improvements.
  
8\. Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination — Liaise with software vendors and business stakeholders on support cases, licensing, and roadmap requests for supported platforms.
  
9\. Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing — Maintain runbooks, configuration standards, and knowledge base articles; participate in knowledge transfer and cross\-training to build coverage across the application portfolio.
  
10\. AI \& Automation Adoption — Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI\-assisted tooling, agents, and low\-code automation to improve support efficiency and business workflows.
  
11\. Roadmap Support — Contribute to application\-specific roadmaps for releases, improvements, and vendor\-provided enhancements, in partnership with the IT Application Operations Manager.
  
  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES
  
  

**Essential:**  

1\. NetSuite — Administration and configuration; SuiteScript 2\.x and SuiteFlow; saved searches/SuiteAnalytics; SuiteTalk and REST API integrations.
  
2\. Microsoft 365 — Administration of Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, and Entra ID (Azure AD); familiarity with Intune and the Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
  
3\. Box — Content management administration, permissions and governance, and API\-based integrations.
  
4\. Atlassian — Administration and configuration of Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including workflow design and scripting (e.g., ScriptRunner).
  
5\. APIs \& Integrations — Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tools (e.g., Power Automate, N8N, Boomi) for connecting applications.
  
6\. Scripting \& Automation — Proficiency in at least one scripting language (JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python) for customization, troubleshooting, and automation.
  
7\. Application Lifecycle Management — Experience with patching, upgrades, testing, and change management for SaaS/cloud and on\-premise applications.
  
8\. Security \& Compliance Awareness — Understanding of access management, data protection, and relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GxP where applicable).
  
9\. ITSM \& Monitoring Tools — Familiarity with ticketing/ITSM tooling (e.g., Jira Service Management) and application monitoring/observability tools.
  
  

**Desirable:**  

1\. Clear and effective communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  
2\. Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
  
3\. Good organizational and time\-management skills across competing priorities.
  
4\. Ability to document clearly and concisely for varied audiences.
  
5\. Adaptability and resilience amid changing priorities and technologies.
  
6\. Effective cross\-team collaboration with Infrastructure, Security, Automation, and Business Analyst teams.
  
  

Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  

If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
  

\#LI\-AB1
  
  

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
  
Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

The Senior Data Scientist designs and deploys statistical, forecasting, and machine learning solutions to solve complex business problems. This role works with cross\-functional teams to build production\-ready models, generate actionable insights, and improve planning and decision\-making at scale.



The role requires strong expertise in statistics, time series analysis, probabilistic forecasting, machine learning, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Statistical Modeling \& Forecasting

Machine Learning \& Predictive Modeling

title: Sr Staff Applications Engineer, Simulation & Debug
description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India


**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18510 **Date posted** 09/06/2026
### **Alternate Job Titles**

* Senior Staff Verification Engineer
* Sr Staff Applications Engineer, Simulation \& Debug
* Principal Application Engineer, VCS/Verdi
* Senior Staff FAE, Verification Solutions
* Sr Staff Technical Solutions Engineer, EDA

### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years in verification, the kind where a missed edge case costs six months and millions of dollars, and you have learned to think like both the designer who built it and the engineer trying to break it. You know that simulation is not just about running tests, it is about understanding why a testbench stalls at 3am, why coverage is stuck at 87%, and what it takes to get a customer from "this doesn't work" to "this is faster than anything we've run before."


You are comfortable sitting with a customer's verification team, digging into their UVM environment or gate\-level timing flow, and walking out with a deployment plan that actually works in their environment, not just in a demo. You do not wait for perfect documentation. You read waveforms, trace through SystemVerilog, script your way around problems, and know when to pull in R\&D versus solve it yourself.


Competitive benchmarks do not intimidate you. You have run them, you know where VCS wins, and you can explain it in terms that matter to the person signing the contract. You care about the craft. At Synopsys, you will work on verification technology that powers tape\-outs across the industry, and the customers you support will remember your name.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Drive customer deployments of VCS and Verdi simulation and debug platforms, working directly with design and verification teams to integrate tools into their existing flows
* Diagnose complex technical issues across UVM testbenches, gate\-level simulations, low power flows, and timing\-aware verification environments
* Lead competitive engagements and benchmarking efforts, demonstrating VCS/Verdi performance, capacity, and debug advantages against rival tools
* Collaborate with R\&D and product teams to gather customer requirements, reproduce field issues, and influence the product roadmap based on real deployment feedback
* Develop and optimize automation scripts in Perl, Python, TCL, Shell, and Make to improve customer productivity and streamline verification workflows
* Interface across global teams including product validation, field applications, and customer engineering to propose solutions and drive product improvements
* Support customers through technical escalations, providing expertise in SystemVerilog, SVA, UVM, low power (UPF), and gate\-level simulation methodologies

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable customers to close verification faster and reach first\-pass silicon success by deploying simulation technology that scales to their toughest designs
* Influence the VCS and Verdi product roadmap by surfacing real\-world customer challenges and competitive gaps that R\&D can act on
* Win competitive deals by proving performance, capacity, and debug superiority in head\-to\-head benchmarks that matter to customer schedules
* Accelerate adoption of advanced features like AI\-driven productivity tools, formal integration, and next\-gen debug capabilities across your customer base
* Reduce time\-to\-resolution for critical customer issues, turning escalations into deployments and deployments into long\-term partnerships
* Strengthen Synopsys' position as the verification platform of choice by making customers successful in ways they can measure and defend internally
* Build institutional knowledge across the global applications team by documenting solutions, sharing best practices, and mentoring peers on complex verification challenges

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering or equivalent, with 5\-12 years of hands\-on experience in verification or application engineering
* Deep expertise in simulation technologies, UVM, SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA), and verification methodologies applied to real designs
* Strong command of HDL languages including Verilog, VHDL, and SystemVerilog, with solid understanding of digital design fundamentals
* Proven experience with gate\-level simulation, timing\-aware verification, and low power flows using UPF
* Advanced scripting ability in Perl, Python, TCL, Shell, and Make, with comfort working in UNIX/Linux environments
* Experience with Synopsys Verdi or similar waveform debug tools is a strong plus, as is knowledge of DPI, C/C\+\+, SystemC, or functional safety standards
* Exposure to generative AI technologies or AI\-driven EDA workflows is a plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a verification problem described in half\-formed sentences, and walk out with a clear technical plan and next steps
* You are the person your team pulls in when a customer issue is stuck, not because you know everything, but because you know how to find the answer and who to ask
* You manage multiple customer engagements at once without dropping threads, and you do not need reminders to follow up or close the loop
* You push back when a proposed solution does not fit the customer's actual environment, and you are comfortable saying "that won't work, here's what will"
* Travel does not faze you, whether it is onsite customer visits, regional workshops, or working across time zones with global R\&D and field teams
* You stay current, not because it is required, but because you are genuinely curious about what is next in verification, AI tooling, and EDA technology

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

### **Job Description**


**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


### **Role Definition**



The Senior Design Engineer is responsible for the design, development, validation, and continuous improvement of Motor Grader Ground Engaging Tools, including cutting edges, end bits, ripper points, and associated wear components. The role applies advanced engineering principles, virtual product development tools, performance simulation, wear modeling, and validation methodologies to deliver solutions that improve customer productivity, wear life, durability, manufacturability, and total owning and operating costs.


### **Key Technical Responsibilities**


* Lead design and development of Motor Grader Ground Engaging Tool (GET) components including cutting edges, end bits, ripper points, shank protection systems and wear packages.
* Develop solutions that improve machine productivity, penetration performance, wear life, serviceability and customer value.
* Perform structural, fatigue, performance, and wear simulations to support design decisions and reduce physical validation cycles.
* Utilize Virtual Product Development (VPD) tools to predict stress, durability, material behavior, and wear characteristics under various customer applications.
* Develop and validate wear\-performance models using field data, laboratory testing, and simulation results.
* Analyze system interactions between blade, cutting edge, moldboard and ripper systems to optimize performance and life\-cycle cost.
* Evaluate alternative materials, heat treatments, casting, forging and wear technologies to improve product performance.
* Support prototype builds, laboratory testing, field validation and production implementation.
* Lead root\-cause investigations for field issues using analytical, simulation and test data.


**Skill Descriptors**:


**Analytical Thinking \& AI Uses:**



Knowledge of analytical techniques, engineering tools, simulation methods, and AI\-assisted technologies that promote effective problem solving; ability to identify root causes of design and performance issues and develop multiple solutions that optimize customer value, durability, manufacturability, and cost.


**Effective Communications:**



Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.


**Managing Multiple Priorities:**



Knowledge of effective self\-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.


**Technical Excellence \& Innovation**:



Knowledge of mining applications, Ground Engaging Tool (GET) systems, wear technologies, and engineering methodologies; ability to develop innovative solutions to complex technical challenges while improving customer value, product performance, durability, and cost competitiveness.


**Computer\-Aided Design \& Engineering:**



Knowledge of engineering tools (Creo, Teamcenter, ANSYS, DEM, Wear Simulation) and techniques of parametric design, simulation, and knowledge\-based engineering; ability to design, analyze, simulate, validate, and optimize Ground Engaging Tool (GET) systems throughout the product development lifecycle.


**Product Design and Development:**



Knowledge of product features; ability to design, build, and develop a new product, technology, or service from concept through to production.

Relocation is available for this position.



Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
