**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Leadership**: Define and lead the enterprise\-wide Terraform adoption strategy, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* **Infrastructure as Code Excellence**: Architect and implement standardized IaC frameworks across multi\-cloud and hybrid environments (Azure, AWS, private cloud).
* **Terraform Enterprise Adoption**: Drive rollout, governance, and operationalization of Terraform Enterprise at scale across global teams.
* **DevOps Expertise**: SME in driving DevOps CICD in IaC implementation.
* **Resiliency \& Observability**: Embed resiliency, monitoring, and observability into IaC practices to ensure robust and compliant infrastructure delivery.
* **Standardization \& Governance**: Establish enterprise\-wide standards, guardrails, and reusable modules to accelerate adoption and reduce risk.
* **Hands\-on Engineering**: Provide technical leadership and hands\-on expertise in Terraform, cloud automation, and infrastructure modernization.
* **Collaboration \& Influence**: Partner with product engineering, risk governance, and infrastructure teams to drive adoption and innovation.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Champion automation, efficiency, and secure delivery practices across the organization.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **15\+ years** of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, automation, and cloud technologies.
* Deep hands\-on expertise in **Terraform (Open Source \& Enterprise)**, with proven ability to design and scale IaC solutions.
* Strong architectural background in **multi\-cloud (Azure, AWS) and private cloud platforms**.
* Experience driving **enterprise\-wide adoption of IaC frameworks** in regulated industries.
* Proven ability to embed **resiliency, observability, and compliance** into infrastructure delivery pipelines.
* Strong leadership edge with experience as a **global service owner** or platform lead.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to influence senior stakeholders.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience in **financial services or global banking organizations**.
* Familiarity with **regulatory compliance frameworks** (ISO, NIST, DORA, PRA, CSA CCM).
* Expertise in **cloud modernization, automation frameworks, and operational resilience**.

**Leadership Attributes**

* Visionary leader with the ability to **transform infrastructure delivery at scale**.
* Collaborative and influential communicator across global teams and executive stakeholders.
* Recognized as a **trusted advisor and problem solver** in infrastructure modernization.
* Passionate about driving **innovation, standardization, and resilience** in technology delivery.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

title: 2067990-Senior Manager
description:
About The Role: The Senior Risk Manager, Loss Forecasting will be an organized and motivated team player with a strong sense of ownership. As a key member of the credit risk management team, you will be responsible for creating and tracking appropriate KPIs, developing and maintaining forecasting frameworks and processes, and serve as an active team player in credit reviews. You will develop and maintain forecasting, CECL and Stress Testing models for fintech products and will be expected to find opportunities to enhance and automate existing processes. What You'll Do
   

  

* Collect and analyze data to identify credit risk (delinquency, roll rate, charge\-off and prepayment) trends and drive insights to further strengthen loss forecasting analytics.
* Craft dashboards to track KPIs around portfolio performance, including deep diving into credit strategies and their impact on it.

* Support planning and budgeting exercises within the company by leveraging forecasting assumptions and outputs.
* Work closely with key partners to ensure forecast and allowance assumptions are accurate. About You
* 5\+ years of experience in credit, analytics, risk management, data science, or information management.
* Bachelor's or master’s degree with a quantitative background (e.g. Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economics).
* Strong technical skills such as SQL, SAS, Python.
* Experience with BI/data visualization tools (like Tableau or Excel to create dashboards).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate project scope in documentation and presentation format.
* Experience in the Financial / FinTech industry is a plus.
* Previous experience with loss forecasting and collections analytics, allowance and stress testing is a plus.
* Location Preference: Gurugram / Bengaluru

The Specialist – Spend Analytics will be responsible for transforming procurement spend data into actionable cost intelligence to drive insights and strategic decision\-making related to procurement and cost optimization, generating actionable intelligence for the Global and Regional supply chain teams to achieve financial goals and improve overall operational efficiency. The role combines rigorous spend analytics with deep should\-cost expertise — leveraging tools such as aPriori to build fact\-based cost models that challenge supplier pricing, identify savings opportunities, and support high\-stakes negotiations. A working knowledge of AI and machine learning techniques for spend analytics, anomaly detection, and pattern recognition will be a strong advantage, enabling the specialist to continuously elevate the analytical maturity of the COE and deliver commercially impactful outcomes at scale.


### **Key Responsibilities**


**A. Spend Data Analysis \& Interpretation**


* Conduct in\-depth analysis of spend data to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies across categories and suppliers.
* Utilize statistical techniques and data visualization tools to transform complex datasets into clear, meaningful insights for stakeholders.
* Leverage tools such as Python, R, VBA, and advanced Excel to build scalable analytical workflows and automate repetitive data processing tasks.
* Apply machine learning techniques to enhance spend classification, outlier detection, and predictive analytics capabilities.
* Increase automation across key steps of the spend analysis lifecycle to improve speed, accuracy, and consistency of outputs.
* Deliver robust, audit\-ready spend analysis that supports strategic sourcing decisions at both global and regional levels.


**B. Should Costing \& Cost Intelligence**


* Build and validate detailed should\-cost models for Build to Print categories including plastics, Sheet Metal, pressure die cast (PDC) components, machining, leveraging knowledge of raw materials, manufacturing processes, and cost drivers.
* Maintain and continuously refine cost models using aPriori or equivalent tools to reflect current market dynamics and input cost movements.
* Drive cost reduction initiatives through value engineering, design\-to\-cost analysis, and supplier negotiations.
* Partner with engineering and commodity teams to apply should\-cost outputs to RFQ benchmarking and fact\-based negotiation preparation.


**C. Market Intelligence \& Sourcing Strategy**


* Monitor global market trends, raw material indices, supplier landscapes, and technological developments in the HVAC and related industries.
* Leverage market intelligence to inform sourcing strategies, risk mitigation plans, and cost management decisions.
* Identify alternative suppliers, emerging markets, and innovative manufacturing processes to enhance competitiveness.


**D. Negotiation Preparation**


* Prepare structured negotiation packs for category managers, including should\-cost breakdowns, market benchmarks, supplier scorecards, and price\-volume analyses.
* Conduct supplier cost walk\-throughs and price justification reviews to equip sourcing teams with robust challenge frameworks.
* Model negotiation scenarios and sensitivity analyses, including the impact of raw material price movements on target pricing.
* Track negotiation outcomes and feed results back into cost models and spend databases to improve future analytical cycles.


**E. Implementation \& Value Capture**


* Drive or support the execution of initiatives generated from spend analytics, converting insights into real, measurable savings.
* Ensure consistent tracking and reporting of value capture against identified savings pipeline.


**F. Stakeholder Collaboration**


* Collaborate with stakeholders across the organisation — supply chain, engineering, operations, and quality — to understand spend analysis requirements and translate them into actionable insights.
* Present findings, opportunity assessments, and recommendations in a clear and compelling manner to senior leadership.
* Provide guidance and support in interpreting spend analytics findings and implementing recommendations across functions.
* Facilitate cross\-functional workshops to align on category strategies, savings priorities, and data quality improvement plans.


**G. Continuous Improvement \& Governance**


* Drive process improvements in sourcing, RFQ management, cost analysis, and spend reporting cycles.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies, contracts, and ethical sourcing standards.
* Support digitalization and analytics initiatives, including deployment of BI platforms and AI\-driven spend intelligence tools, to enhance sourcing effectiveness.

### **Requirements**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited institution in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 8\&\#43; years of experience in spend analytics, strategic sourcing, or cost engineering within a manufacturing or industrial procurement environment.
* Strong understanding of part cost structures, manufacturing processes, and tooling across key direct spend categories.
* Hands\-on experience with aPriori or similar should\-cost software is mandatory.
* Experience with BI and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with AI/ML techniques applied to procurement analytics is a strong plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for analytics and presentations is mandatory.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with strong interpersonal abilities for stakeholder management.
* High learning agility, accountability, and effective collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global environment with stakeholders located in different regions.
* Strong attention to detail with sharp observational skills to identify issues accurately and articulate findings effectively.

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.


* Have peace of mind and body with our health insurance

description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking an experienced **Google Cloud Technology Consultant** to join our team and drive enterprise cloud transformation initiatives.


In this role, you will partner with clients to design future\-state GCP architectures, guide application modernization efforts, and serve as a trusted technical advisor across complex cloud programs. You will collaborate closely with pre\-sales, engineering, and delivery teams to shape scalable, secure, and innovative solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with enterprise clients to assess existing application and infrastructure landscapes and define future\-state GCP architecture and transformation strategies
* Advise clients across cloud platform engineering, cloud\-native adoption, application modernization, and migration
* Architect enterprise GCP environments covering organization structure, landing zones, networking, IAM, security, governance, observability, and platform services
* Define modernization approaches for legacy and enterprise applications, including re\-platforming, refactoring, containerization, microservices adoption, and cloud\-native re\-architecture
* Guide architecture using services such as GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Pub/Sub, Apigee, and other GCP managed services
* Lead large\-scale workload assessments and define migration and modernization strategies, including rehost, re\-platform, refactor, and re\-architect
* Advise engineering teams on scalable application architectures, APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, integration patterns, and distributed systems
* Shape technical solutions for RFPs, proposals, architecture workshops, and client discussions in collaboration with pre\-sales, engineering, and delivery teams
* Evaluate opportunities to leverage GenAI and Vertex AI capabilities within cloud transformation and application modernization programs
* Act as a trusted technical advisor, bringing clarity and architectural direction to complex enterprise cloud transformation initiatives

**Requirements**

* 16\-22 years of overall IT experience with strong background in enterprise architecture, cloud consulting, systems/platform architecture, or application architecture
* Hands\-on architectural expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including compute, networking, IAM, security, storage, governance, observability, and managed services
* Proficiency in designing enterprise cloud foundations, including GCP Landing Zones, Organization/Folder/Project structures, Shared VPC, IAM, and Organization Policies
* Skills in GKE/Kubernetes, containers, and Cloud Run for cloud\-native application platforms
* Proven capability in application modernization, including migration from monolithic or legacy applications toward microservices, containerized, API\-driven, or event\-driven architectures
* Familiarity with application architecture and development technologies such as Java, .NET, or Python
* Background in enterprise\-scale cloud migration and modernization programs
* Understanding of APIs, integration patterns, and messaging/event streaming, along with databases, caching, and distributed application architectures
* Ability to engage with senior business and technology stakeholders and translate business transformation objectives into practical cloud architecture
* Experience contributing to pre\-sales, solutioning, RFPs, architecture assessments, and client workshops
* Capability to operate as a senior individual contributor and influence enterprise architecture decisions across cloud platform and application modernization initiatives

**Nice to have**

* Google Cloud certifications such as Professional Cloud Architect or other relevant GCP certifications
* Exposure to AWS or Azure
* Experience with multi\-cloud transformation programs

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Senior Application Transition Manager
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


This is a high\-impact leadership role for a Transition Managerwho is ready to shape the future of application transitions — combining deep delivery expertise with AI\-powered innovation to redefine how complex global IT services are handed over, stabilized, and scaled.


We are looking for a seasoned **Application Transition Manager** to lead end\-to\-end planning, solutioning, and execution of complex, multi\-service managed services, application development, and support/maintenance transitions. This role sits at the intersection of delivery leadership, AI\-powered modernization, and enterprise\-scale program governance.


The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on experience in transitioning large application development/support portfolios — including custom\-built, packaged, and cloud\-native applications — and is fluent in harnessing AI tools, automation, and intelligent accelerators to compress timelines, reduce risk, and elevate transition quality.


You will operate as the single accountable owner across pre\-sales solutioning and live execution, partnering closely with the client, delivery towers, and incumbent vendors to deliver a seamless transition to steady\-state operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Independently design and own transition solutions for complex outsourcing pursuits across multi\-vendor, multi\-geo, multi\-stack, multi\-service (Apps, Infra, Security, Automation, Cloud) environments
* Define transition strategy, milestone frameworks, resource models, and success KPIs for RFP/RFI/SOW responses and contract negotiations
* Defend the proposed transition solutions and execution approaches to senior Client stakeholders / C\-suite audiences (Orals)
* Design AI\-powered transition solutions using GenAI\-based knowledge extraction, automated documentation generation, and intelligent codebase discovery to accelerate solutioning timelines
* Leverage AI estimating models and effort prediction tools to build data\-driven transition business cases and risk\-adjusted transition plans during pre\-sales
* Lead transitions of 100\+ applications spanning custom development, microservices, APIs, data platforms, ERP/CRM systems, and cloud\-native workloads

Manage all transition phases: Knowledge Acquisition Shadow Reverse Shadow Parallel Run Stabilization (Hypercare)* BAU Handover
* Oversee structured code and architecture discovery activities — codebase walkthroughs, dependency mapping, tech\-debt assessment, and environment cataloging
* Ensure delivery of all transition artifacts: SOPs, Runbooks, Application Passports, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), RACI matrices, and operational documentation
* Manage Knowledge Acquisition sessions across development teams (onshore/offshore), ensuring structured capture of tribal knowledge, design rationale, and undocumented dependencies
* Deploy AI\-based code analysis tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeScene, SonarQube AI) to accelerate codebase understanding, surface tech debt, and auto\-generate inline documentation during Knowledge Acquisition
* Use GenAI\-powered documentation tools to auto\-draft SOPs, Runbooks, and Application Passports from discovery sessions, reducing documentation effort by up to 40%
* Apply AI\-driven dependency mapping tools to visualize application interdependencies, integration touchpoints, and data flows across complex portfolios
* Establish and chair Transition Governance Forums — weekly/bi\-weekly SteerCos, RAID reviews, milestone checkpoint meetings, and executive reporting cadences
* Maintain a real\-time Transition Dashboard tracking milestones, knowledge transfer completion, risk status, team readiness scores, and go\-live criteria
* Drive RAID log management (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and proactively resolve blockers impacting transition timelines
* Manage 50\+ active stakeholders — client executives, product owners, architects, vendor leads, and delivery managers — across multiple geographies
* Use AI\-powered project analytics tools and NLP\-based status reporting to auto\-generate executive dashboards and transition health summaries
* Define and execute Go\-Live Readiness Criteria encompassing access provisioning, monitoring setup, SLA framework validation, on\-call rota, and escalation paths
* Lead structured Hypercare operations post\-go\-live: stabilization sprints, defect triage, performance baselining, and SLA attainment tracking
* Ensure tooling readiness: ITSM (ServiceNow), observability stack (Dynatrace, Splunk, Datadog), CMDB accuracy, and alerting configuration
* Integrate AIOps capabilities (anomaly detection, predictive alerting) during Hypercare to proactively surface risks before they escalate to incidents
* Use ML\-based SLA prediction models to benchmark incoming team performance trajectories and forecast BAU stabilization timelines

**Requirements**

* 12–18 years of IT industry experience with significant tenure leading enterprise Application Transition programs
* Minimum 8 years of hands\-on experience transitioning Application Development portfolios within Managed Services or IT Outsourcing environments
* Proven track record managing transitions of 200\+ FTEs and 100\+ applications across multi\-geo delivery models
* Hands\-on exposure to AI tools and automation platforms used across the transition lifecycle (code analysis, documentation generation, test automation, AIOps)
* Experience managing transitions in Agile, SAFe, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models; able to adapt governance to match client maturity
* Demonstrated ability to manage 50\+ active stakeholders, including CXOs, Product Owners, Architects, and Vendor Leads
* Strong pre\-sales experience: RFP/RFI responses, SOW development, contract reviews, and client oral presentations
* Exposure to multi\-domain transitions covering Application Development, Application Support, Data \& Analytics, and Integration platforms

**Nice to have**

* Skills in DevOps and CI/CD Migration/Management
* Proficiency in AIOps and Observability
* Background in GenAI Tooling for Development, Prompt Engineering, and AI\-driven Code Analysis Tools
* Experience in Cloud Transition (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Certifications such as Anthropic Claude Certified Architect, PMP/PRINCE2 Practitioner, ITIL Foundation/Managing Professional, SAFe Agilist (SA) or SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), AWS/Azure/GCP Cloud Practitioner or Associate, or GitHub Copilot / relevant AI/ML practitioner certifications

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development

	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off

title: Data Analyst - Senior
description:
As a Senior Data Analyst, measurement, you will be the analytical engine behind our commercial performance tracking. Serving within the Global Verticals Marketing team, you will act as the primary point of contact for querying, analysing, and synthesizing FedEx internal transactional and customer data. Your mission is to convert complex datasets into clear, actionable vertical performance narratives that guide business planning.  

In this role, you will build executive\-ready reports, conduct ad\-hoc analyses, and provide data\-driven insights that directly support marketing, commercial strategy, and forecasting functions. Your work will directly influence how senior leadership understands vertical health, product performance, and regional business dynamics.

 **Grade :****T5**

**"Please note that the Job will close at 12am on Posting Close date, so please submit your application prior to the Close Date"**

**Key Responsibilities**  

**Vertical Performance**  

* **Write, optimize, and execute complex SQL queries against FedEx enterprise data warehouses to extract performance metrics across priority industry verticals (e.g., E\-commerce, Healthcare, Aerospace, Technology).**
* **Monitor and analyse key commercial indicators, including volume, revenue, and yield, with a specific focus on identifying regional / lane / product level insights.**
* **Investigate regional and product\-level performance variations, isolating root causes of growth or decline and translating findings into structured data briefs.**
* **Build, maintain, and automate interactive performance dashboards and scorecards to track commercial performance, vertical health, and pipeline health.**
 **Executive \& Leadership Reporting**  

* **Synthesize complex performance datasets into high\-impact, visual, and narrative\-driven reports for leadership and executive\-level business updates (e.g., CEO updates and strategic reviews).**
* **Translate analytical findings into concise executive takeaways, ensuring executive communications clearly explain the past performance, present status, and future outlook.**
* **Deliver regular monthly and quarterly performance updates, highlighting competitive risks, commercial opportunities, and customer journey trends.**

**Strategic \& Forecasting Support**  

* **Partner with forecasting, strategy, finance, and marketing functions to model commercial funnels, market demand shifts, and historical volume trends.**
* **Apply statistical techniques and behavioural segmentation models to track, isolate, and forecast changes in specific customer cohorts and industry verticals.**
* **Conduct rapid\-response, ad\-hoc deep dives to answer critical, time\-sensitive business questions posed by leadership.**
* **Provide data backing and baseline historical trends to support annual commercial strategic planning and commercial goal setting.**

**What We’re Looking For**  

**Experience \& Background**  

* **6\-10 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, sales analytics, or financial/commercial measurement roles.**
* **Proven experience querying large\-scale, complex relational databases to extract commercial, transactional, and customer\-level insights.**
* **Demonstrated track record of preparing executive\-calibre presentations, briefs, and reports based on complex data analysis.**
* **Experience collaborating with cross\-functional, global stakeholders across various time zones.**
 **Core Competencies**  

* **Executive Storytelling \& Visualization: The ability to translate numbers into a cohesive, executive\-ready story that leaders can grasp and act on instantly.**
* **Statistical Thinking \& Pattern Discovery: Strong capability to utilize business statistics (e.g., correlation, significance testing, regression, trend analysis) to**

* **Analytical Rigor \& Structured Problem Solving: High attention to data accuracy, methodological soundness, and the ability to formulate logical business hypotheses.**

 **Professional Expertise \& Technical Skills**

title: GM/AVP - Artificial Intelligence and Analytics
description:
**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for a highly entrepreneurial Analytics \& AI leader to build and lead the Analytics \& AI charter for our Growth \& Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM) function.
 



 This role is for a go\-getter and builder — someone who has demonstrated the ability to start with an ambiguous business problem, build solutions from scratch, and turn data, analytics, AI, and technology into measurable business outcomes.
 



  





 The ideal candidate would have spent a significant part of their career being hands\-on and building things themselves — analytics frameworks, models, dashboards, automation, AI/GenAI solutions, or even teams and capabilities from the ground up. As the role evolves, they will be responsible for leading a team, setting the analytics roadmap, and scaling these capabilities across Growth and CLM.
 



  





 You should be equally comfortable discussing business problems with senior stakeholders, writing Python/SQL, experimenting with LLMs and AI tools, and coaching a team to build scalable solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Build and lead the Analytics \& AI charter for Growth and CLM, defining the roadmap, priorities, and areas of impact.
* Identify high\-impact business problems and independently take them from problem definition → solution design → build → implementation → measurement → optimization.
* Build analytical and AI capabilities from the ground up across customer segmentation, propensity, targeting, retention, campaign optimization, and growth analytics.
* Drive the Data → Insights → Action → Measurement → Optimization lifecycle for key business initiatives.
* Build scalable dashboards, tracking frameworks, automated reporting systems, and analytical products that enable faster decision\-making.
* Leverage Python, SQL, LLMs, APIs, GenAI, Agentic AI, and automation to solve business problems and eliminate manual processes.
* Build AI\-powered workflows and agents to automate MIS, reporting, analysis, operational processes, and recurring decision\-making.
* Experiment rapidly with emerging AI capabilities and identify where they can create meaningful business impact.
* Partner closely with Product, Business, Marketing, Risk, and Operations teams to embed analytics and AI into business decisions.
* Establish analytical frameworks and reusable solutions that can be scaled across multiple use cases and teams.
* Define success metrics, design experiments, measure incremental impact, and continuously optimize outcomes.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing analytics team, creating a culture of ownership, experimentation, speed, and strong execution.
* Raise the team's technical and problem\-solving bar while remaining sufficiently hands\-on to guide complex analytical and AI problems.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 




 We are looking for someone who has a builder's mindset — not someone who is comfortable only managing an existing analytics setup.
 


* 8–12 years of experience across Analytics, Data Science, Product Analytics, Business Intelligence, or related areas.
* A track record of building capabilities, products, frameworks, or teams from scratch.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML, GenAI, LLMs, Agentic AI, APIs, and workflow automation.
* Demonstrated experience taking AI/analytics ideas from experimentation to production or business adoption.
* Strong experience in customer, growth, product, campaign, segmentation, propensity, retention, or CLM analytics.
* Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Superset, etc.
* B.Tech/M.Tech from a Tier 1 institute preferred.
* Experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, or consumer internet preferred.
* Strong ability to work with large and complex datasets and convert them into actionable business decisions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.



  





**What Will Set You Apart:** 



* You are a 0→1 builder who enjoys creating something where there is no established playbook.
* You have moved from doing the work yourself to building and leading teams, without losing your technical depth.
* You naturally ask,
 *“Can we automate this?”* 
 ,
 *“Can we build this better?”* 
 or
 *“What is the actual business impact?”*
* You actively experiment with new AI/LLM capabilities and are able to separate interesting technology from genuinely useful business applications.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity and can create structure where none exists.
* You have a strong bias for action and are willing to roll up your sleeves when required.
* You can challenge business teams with data, while also understanding the realities of execution.
* You know how to build scalable systems and teams, rather than solving every problem as a one\-off analysis.
* You have demonstrated the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive adoption of analytics\-led decisions.



  





**Key Outcomes:** 



* Build and scale a high\-impact Analytics \& AI function for Growth \& CLM.
* Establish scalable analytics, AI, automation, and experimentation capabilities from the ground up.
* Significantly reduce dependency on manual MIS, reporting, and repetitive analysis.
* Improve customer acquisition, targeting, engagement, retention, and campaign effectiveness.
* Identify and quantify new growth opportunities through data and AI.
* Enable faster and better decision\-making across business teams.
* Build and develop a strong analytics team with high ownership and technical depth.
* Deliver measurable business impact, rather than analytics output alone.



  





**The Opportunity:** 



* This is an opportunity for someone who has built before and is now ready to build at scale — taking ownership of a critical business charter, building the team and capabilities around it, and using Analytics, AI, and automation to fundamentally change how Growth and CLM operates.

title: Geospatial Summer Intern
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
   

  

 If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
   

  

**Skills And Competencies**
* Strong foundation in machine learning, computer vision, and numerical methods
* Experience with CNN\-based architectures and modern vision models
* Solid understanding of remote sensing techniques, including:
* Image classification and segmentation
* Change detection and decorrelation
* Processing of hyperspectral and multispectral imagery
* Proficiency in Python, with hands\-on experience in: Machine Learning frameworks (Scikit\-Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, GluonCV, Image processing \& geospatial libraries: OpenCV, GDAL, GeoPandas, Rasterio)
* Familiarity with GIS tools: ESRI suite, QGIS, GRASS
* Exposure to Google Earth Engine is a plus


**Education**
 Pursuing post\-graduation (Masters/PhD) in Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Earth Sciences, Computer Science or Graduate in Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Environmental Science from an institute of good repute
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Geospatial team at Moody’s is developing advanced AI/ML capabilities, including Large Vision Models (LVMs) and Generative/Agentic AI, to extract insights from large\-scale satellite and aerial imagery. These capabilities enable scalable analysis of remote sensing data, supporting accurate detection of objects, patterns, and temporal changes, Key initiatives include:
   

  

* Global Property Project: building high\-resolution global datasets of building stock
* Global Renewable Energy Project: mapping solar and wind assets worldwide


 As an AI/ML Intern, you will contribute to these high\-impact programmes by:
   

  

* Developing and applying vision models to geospatial challenges
* Working on tasks such as: Image enhancement (denoising, super\-resolution), building footprint extraction, renewable asset detection, multi\-temporal change detection
* Supporting the integration of LVMs and generative AI into production workflows


 This role offers hands\-on experience with scalable, production\-grade AI systems while contributing to global geospatial intelligence solutions.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Geospatial Team (Model Development Group) is responsible for developing critical geospatial datasets, exposure intelligence, and modeling components that underpin Moody’s industry\-leading catastrophe risk solutions used by more than 400 clients worldwide. By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work in developing geospatial datasets for catastrophe models, advancing AI\-powered geospatial analytics, and delivering innovative solutions in renewable energy intelligence, event response, and damage assessment to support global risk insights and decision\-making.
   

  

 Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.
   

  

 For more information on the Securities Trading Program, please refer to the Securities Trading Policy on Moody’s Compliance Expo page
   

  

 Please note: STP categories are assigned by the hiring teams and are subject to change over the course of an employee’s tenure with Moody’s.

title: Tech S and T-Network Engineer Senior-GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**DevSecOps \& AI Engineer**
**Job Description**
* Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and CircleCI for application, data, and AI workloads.
* Integrate DevSecOps practices into pipelines using Snyk, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Trivy, Anchore, and OWASP tools for continuous security scanning.
* Implement shift\-left security with secret scanning (GitLeaks, TruffleHog), SBOM automation (Syft, CycloneDX), and dependency management (Dependabot, Renovate).
* Work with containerization (Docker/Podman) and Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) including Helm/Kustomize for deployments and secure image pipelines.
* Develop and automate MLOps workflows using MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML, SageMaker, or Vertex AI for model training, packaging, and deployment.
* Build and maintain RAG/AI integration pipelines using LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS.
* Implement AI inference systems using Seldon Core, KServe, BentoML, Ray Serve, or Triton Inference Server for scalable model serving.
* Automate ETL/ELT and data feature pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt, or Kafka/Kinesis for AI model data feeds.
* Work with IaC tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Azure Bicep to provision cloud and AI infrastructure.
* Implement event\-driven architectures using serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Cloud Functions) and messaging systems like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Maintain monitoring and logging using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Datadog, or New Relic for both app and ML workloads.
* Handle model \& data observability using tools like Evidently AI, Arize AI, WhyLabs, or Fiddler for drift, bias, and performance tracking.
* Secure cloud environments using IAM best practices (AWS IAM, Azure AD/Entra ID, GCP IAM), workload identities, and least\-privilege controls.
* Support configuration management using Ansible, Chef, or SaltStack for environment consistency and automation.
* Develop scripts in Python, Bash, or SQL for automation, data processing, validation, and orchestration of ML workflows.
* Implement API integrations for AI systems using REST, gRPC, or GraphQL for model consumption and downstream applications.
* Use GitOps tools like Argo CD or Flux for automated, secure Kubernetes deployments and progressive delivery.
* Apply AI security practices including guardrails, prompt protection, model validation, and safe inference techniques using industry tools.
* Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and security standards including GDPR, CCPA, and cloud security best practices.
* Collaborate with data engineers, ML engineers, DevOps teams, and security teams, contributing to documentation, reviews, and mentoring juniors.


**Desired Profile**
* Looking for a DevSecOps \& AI Engineer with 4–7 years of hands‑on experience in cloud, DevOps, and AI/ML workflows.
* Strong skills in Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
* Proficient in Python and scripting (Bash/PowerShell) with good automation mindset.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices—SAST/DAST, container scanning, secrets scanning, SBOM, and policy\-as\-code.
* Exposure to MLOps/AI integration using MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, KServe, or Seldon.
* Familiar with cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), configuration management (Ansible/Puppet), and GitOps tools (Argo CD/Flux).
* Strong communication, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills with ability to work cross‑functionally.


**Experience**
* 4 to 7 years


**Education**
* B.Tech. / BS in Computer Science


**Technical Skills \& Certifications**
* Terraform, Pulumi, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), Docker/Podman, Helm, Kustomize
* CI/CD tools: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps
* Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
* Python, Bash, PowerShell scripting
* DevSecOps tools: Snyk, SonarQube, Trivy, Checkmarx, GitLeaks, TruffleHog
* Policy\-as\-code (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno) and SBOM tools (Syft, CycloneDX)
* MLOps tools: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI
* Model serving frameworks: KServe, Seldon Core, BentoML, Ray Serve
* Vector DBs \& RAG stack: Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, LangChain, LlamaIndex
* Monitoring \& observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger
* Configuration management: Ansible, Puppet
* GitOps: Argo CD, Flux
* Serverless: AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Google Cloud Functions.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

 We bring an engineering mindset to complex marketing situations to deliver scalable performance that generates an exponential return on investment.

* Always deliver in the best interest of our clients
* Invest in the success of every team member
* Build long\-term relationships with our partners.
* Delivering these foundational codes will fund our continued growth.

 As a Data Engineer, you will help clients make data\-driven decisions by collecting, processing, analysing, and visualising data. You’ll work on medium to large\-scale projects across multiple industries, helping clients unlock the full potential of their data.

* Continuously improve internal workflows by automating repetitive tasks.
* Support account expansion efforts by identifying opportunities to provide additional value to clients.

* Data pipeline quality
* Delivery timeliness
* Client impact
* Reporting quality
* Automation improvement

* At least 6 years of experience as a Data Engineer.
* Strong knowledge of statistical analysis and data modelling.
* Have prior experience handling marketing data.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL (and other relevant languages/tools).
* Experience building ETL pipelines and transforming data from multiple sources.
* Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau / Looker / Google Data Studio.

title: Security Control Assessment Specialist
description:
* Permanent \- Full Time
* Ahmedabad/GiftCity

We are seeking an experienced Security Control Assessment Specialist to independently test the design and operating effectiveness of Trading Technologies’ enterprise cybersecurity controls. This role plans and executes control assessments end to end, documents findings with clear supporting evidence, and partners with control owners and the TT Security team to design practical remediations. The role also contributes to the continuous improvement of the control environment itself, strengthening how controls are defined, evidenced and monitored, and automating control testing where possible.  

##### **Key Responsibilities**


* Plan and execute independent tests of enterprise cybersecurity controls across TT’s technology estate, with a high degree of autonomy over scoping, methodology, sampling and scheduling.
* Assess both the design and the operating effectiveness of controls, combining evidence review and control owner walkthroughs with hands\-on technical validation of configurations, logs, identity and access data, and cloud environments.
* Document findings clearly and defensibly, setting out the condition, criteria, cause, risk and impact, and rating them consistently against TT’s risk criteria.
* Partner with control owners and TT Security to design workable remediations, then validate closure through retesting rather than accepting assertion alone.
* Track findings and remediation plans through to closure, escalating overdue or inadequately addressed items where necessary.
* Build and maintain automated and continuous control monitoring so that control health is visible between formal assessment cycles.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the control framework itself, refining control definitions, testing procedures, evidence requirements and the annual assessment plan.
* Map the control environment to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks, identifying gaps, duplication and opportunities to test once and satisfy multiple obligations.
* Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and control owners, setting expectations, communicating requirements clearly, and holding a firm, evidence\-based position when findings are challenged.
* Support external audits and customer assessments by providing tested, reliable control evidence.
  

##### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**


Essential Skills \& Experience
* 8 to 10 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years focused on information security.
* Professional certification required: CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC or equivalent.
* Demonstrable experience designing and executing security control tests and producing findings and workpapers that withstand audit scrutiny.
* Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity controls and frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST SP 800\-53\.
* Technical depth across identity and access management, cloud infrastructure (AWS certification is a plus), endpoint and network security, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management and secure development practices.
* Experience automating control testing or building continuous control monitoring, using scripting, queries, APIs or GRC platform automation.
* Familiarity with GRC platforms such as OneTrust, Vanta, Drata, ServiceNow IRM or similar.
* Exceptional spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical requirements and findings clearly to both engineers and senior stakeholders.
* Confidence and diplomacy to challenge control owners constructively and to hold a position under pressure when the evidence supports it.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage a portfolio of concurrent assessments and deliver to deadline with minimal supervision.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.

description:
**Associate – Business Finance \& Accounts**

Job Description

Company: Abhinaya Cinemas

Department: Business Finance \& Accounts

Location: Head Office, Changanacherry, Kerala

Reports to: Finance Manager

Employment Type: Full\-time, on\-site

Compensation: ₹20,000 – ₹28,000 per month, based on qualification, skills and assessment

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Abhinaya Cinemas is looking for an Associate – Business Finance \& Accounts to join our head office finance team.

This is an entry\-level role built for someone at the start of their career who wants to learn how money actually

moves through a business — daily box office collections, food \& beverage sales, vendor payments, distributor

settlements, payroll and statutory filings — across a multi\-location cinema operation with a multi\-decade legacy.

The role is deliberately designed for a candidate who is as comfortable with software as with a ledger. A large part

of our finance work is being rebuilt around automation: dashboards instead of manual MIS, system\-to\-system data

flows instead of re\-keying, and validated templates instead of ad\-hoc spreadsheets. We want an Associate who will

not simply run the process as it exists, but will look at a recurring task and ask whether it needs to be done by hand at all.

You will be trained on the accounting fundamentals. What you bring is accuracy, curiosity, and an instinct for using technology to do the job better.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Daily Accounting \& Bookkeeping

* Record day\-to\-day transactions in the accounting system — sales, purchases, expenses, journal entries and bank transactions.
* Maintain accurate ledgers, vouchers and supporting documentation, filed and retrievable.
* Process vendor bills and payments, track advances, and maintain the payables schedule.
* Handle petty cash accounting and expense claims across cinema locations.

Revenue \& Reconciliation

* Reconcile daily box office collections against the ticketing system, online aggregator reports and bank credits.
* Reconcile food \& beverage / Cafe Abhinaya POS sales, stock movement and cash–card–UPI settlements.
* Perform bank reconciliations and follow up on unmatched or delayed settlements.
* Support distributor and film\-hire settlement workings and share calculations.

Statutory \& Compliance Support

* Prepare working files for GST returns, TDS and other statutory filings; assist with timely submission.
* Support monthly payroll inputs in coordination with HR — attendance, deductions, PF and ESI schedules.
* Assist with audits by preparing schedules, ledger extracts and supporting documents.
* Maintain compliance calendars and flag due dates before they arrive.

Automation \& Systems Improvement

* Build and maintain Excel / Google Sheets models with formulas, validation and pivot\-based reporting that replace manual re\-keying.
* **Identify repetitive finance tasks and propose ways to automate or simplify them.**
* Help migrate and clean data as we move processes onto better tools; test new workflows and document them.
* **Write and maintain simple SOPs so that every recurring process is repeatable by anyone in the team.**
* Reporting \& Analysis
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS — collections, occupancy\-linked revenue, F\&B performance, expense
* summaries.
* **Assist with budget versus actual tracking and highlight variances with a plain\-English explanation.**
* Support the Finance Manager with ad\-hoc analysis for management decisions.
* QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE
* **B.Com, M.Com, or MBA (Finance) — freshers are welcome and encouraged to apply.**
* 0–2 years of experience; internships, articleship exposure or academic projects in accounting count.
* **Sound understanding of accounting fundamentals — double entry, ledgers, trial balance, and basic financial**
* statements.
* Awareness of GST and TDS basics; willingness to learn statutory compliance on the job.
* **Strong command of Excel or Google Sheets (formulas, lookups, pivot tables); comfort with Tally or any**
* accounting software is an advantage.

**SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES**

* Technically fluent. Picks up new software quickly and prefers a system to a sticky note. Familiarity with
* automation tools — advanced spreadsheet functions, Google Apps Script, Power Query, Zoho / Tally
* integrations, or AI tools — is a strong plus.
* **Accurate. Treats a mismatched rupee as a problem to be solved, not rounded away.**
* Forward thinking. Asks “why is this done this way?” and comes back with a better way.
* **Organised. Manages deadlines, filings and month\-end without needing to be chased.**
* Discreet. Handles financial and payroll information with confidentiality.
* **Communicative. Explains numbers clearly to people who are not accountants; working proficiency in English**
* and Malayalam.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Ground\-floor exposure to the complete finance cycle of a running business — not a single narrow task repeated
* for a year.
* **Direct mentoring from the Finance Manager, with real ownership from early on.**
* A genuine mandate to modernise how our accounting is done, and the freedom to propose and build those
* improvements.
* A stable, established Kerala cinema brand with an active growth pipeline.
* Clear progression to Senior Associate for candidates who deliver.

To apply, please share your updated CV with the HR team. Abhinaya Cinemas is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹28,000\.00 per month

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Sr.Data Scientist I
description:
**Who We Are**
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
   

  

 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
   

  

**About the role:**
 Samsara Technologies India Private Limited is seeking a Data Scientist to advance our data\-driven efforts in sales, marketing, and customer success. As part of the Data Science and AI team in Revenue Operations, this role focuses on designing and delivering predictive models, refining AI\-based scripts to validate, augment, and test the accuracy of business critical data, and establishing the quality measurement, lineage, and input pipelines of that data. You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders in BizTech, Marketing, Sales, and Operations to unlock insights, automate processes, and enhance the operational efficiency of the sales organization.
   

  

**This hybrid position requires 2 days per week in our Bangalore office and 3 days working remotely. This position requires working hours in IST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.**
**Who We Are**
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, a platform that enables organizations in physical operations to harness IoT and AI to improve efficiency, safety, and sustainability. Our customers span essential industries like transportation, manufacturing, field services, agriculture, and construction.
   

  

 As part of Samsara’s Revenue Operations AI \& Data Science team, you’ll be helping to define how AI transforms our sales, marketing, and customer success functions. Your work will power intelligent decisions at scale, enhancing operational efficiency and unlocking actionable insights from complex data.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Estimate revenue opportunity models and conduct impact analysis as part of the annual strategic planning cycle to guide GTM and investment decisions.
* Leverage LLMs and other AI tools to systematically validate account\-level data, enabling dynamic quality measurement scores and continuous trust in business\-critical data.
* Generate predictive models and triangulate from multiple inputs—CRMs, web data, third\-party signals—to drive data accuracy and establish reliable sources of truth.
* Establish scalable data pipelines from internal systems to generate and sustain baseline data programs supporting cross\-functional initiatives.
* Contribute to the development of predictive analytics tools, such as sales performance dashboards, pipeline forecasting models, and KPI frameworks, to enhance operational efficiency.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing Ops, BizTech, and Enablement teams to automate insights, enrich GTM execution, and accelerate business outcomes.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles—Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team—as we scale globally and across new offices.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field.
* 4 \- 7 years of experience in data science, AI engineering, or advanced analytics roles.
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and tools such as Tableau for building analytics and dashboards.
* Experience developing and deploying ML models to support sales/revenue strategies.
* Hands\-on experience with CRMs and sales/marketing data pipelines.
* Exposure to LLM\-based tools and GenAI for data enrichment or automation tasks.
* Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with MLOps tools (Docker, Kubernetes), model versioning, and deployment workflows.
* Experience with AI observability, monitoring, and guardrail implementation for responsible AI.
* Exposure to ETL/data engineering processes and modern cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
* Strong business acumen and curiosity to understand operational processes in physical industries, strong attention to detail.
* Experience analyzing B2B marketing channels, account\-level data accuracy, and lifecycle optimization.
* Entrepreneurial mindset, able to work from 0 → 1 and iterate rapidly in ambiguous environments.


**Total Rewards**
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
   

  

 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
   

  

**Flexible Working**
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
   

  

**Belonging at Samsara**
 At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
   

  

**Accommodations**
 Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**
 We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
   

  

**Fraudulent Employment Offers**

Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Gen AI Researcher
description:
**Role:** 
 Gen AI Researcher – Reasoning \& Benchmarks
 



**Function:** 
 AI Research
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Information Technology \& Services
 



  





**About Company** 




 A research\-first AI company incubated at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc). The company builds advanced AI for the planning and operations of critical networks.
 



 Its core technology is a World Model that augments LLMs to reason about network state and dependencies, even with limited or noisy data. The founding team has raised over $100M in prior ventures and published at leading AI research venues.
 



 Having just closed its seed round, the company is assembling a team of ambitious, frontier\-focused researchers.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 This role sits at the core of the company's research agenda — designing and building reasoning benchmarks across science and engineering domains to rigorously evaluate AI systems at the frontier of reasoning and planning. You will build evaluation infrastructure, develop agents, and iterate on them against real\-world science and engineering tasks. You'll work directly with the founders and IISc faculty in a lean, research\-driven environment where your output shapes the company's technical direction.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, and validate reasoning benchmarks spanning science and engineering domains, ensuring rigor and reproducibility
* Develop evaluation pipelines using eval harnesses and benchmark suites (e.g., SWE\-bench) to systematically assess AI system performance
* Build and iterate on agents capable of tackling complex reasoning and planning tasks, guided by benchmark results
* Contribute to the company's core research agenda — document methodologies, findings, and experimental results to publication\-ready standards
* Collaborate closely with IISc faculty, and internal research, agent, and data teams to align benchmark design with real\-world network planning problems
* Engage with the open\-source research community to stay current with and contribute to frontier developments in reasoning and evaluation



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* BTech from a top\-tier institute (IITs/IISc/BITS or equivalent) with 2\+ years of relevant AI/ML research experience, OR MTech/PhD from a top\-tier institute
* Solid foundations in probability, statistics, and machine learning — demonstrable through coursework, research, or published work
* Hands\-on experience with evaluation harnesses and benchmark suites (e.g., SWE\-bench or comparable frameworks)
* Strong coding and software engineering skills sufficient to build and maintain reproducible research pipelines
* Demonstrated ability to build and iterate on AI agents for reasoning or planning tasks



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior publications at leading AI research venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, or equivalent)
* Prior experience designing or contributing to benchmark datasets or evaluation frameworks
* Familiarity with network planning, operations research, or science/engineering simulation domains
* Experience working in early\-stage or research\-lab environments with high autonomy



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct collaboration with IISc faculty and a founding team with a track record of $100M\+ raised and frontier AI publications
* Ownership over a core research function at a seed\-stage company building at the frontier of reasoning AI
* Opportunity to publish and contribute to the broader AI research community as part of your role
* Lean, research\-first culture with high autonomy and cross\-disciplinary exposure across agents, data, and network AI

title: Manager
description:
As the Manager, Market \& Competitive Intelligence (MI/CI), you will lead the strategy, transformation, and execution of global intelligence and insights capabilities that enable data\-driven business decisions across commercial and therapeutic areas. This role will be responsible for driving the evolution of traditional MI/CI functions through the adoption of advanced analytics, AI, and Generative AI (GenAI) technologies, creating scalable intelligence solutions that accelerate insight generation and decision\-making.
 



 You will serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior business leaders, leveraging market research, competitive intelligence, social listening, secondary and primary research, and AI\-powered intelligence platforms to identify market opportunities, competitive threats, emerging trends, and strategic implications. The role will also oversee the modernization of MI/CI operating models, processes, and technology ecosystems to deliver faster, more actionable, and predictive insights.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Leadership \& Capability Transformation** 



* Define and lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Market Intelligence and Competitive Intelligence capabilities across key therapeutic, commercial, and strategic business priorities.
* Drive the modernization of MI/CI functions through the adoption of advanced analytics, automation, AI, and Generative AI technologies.
* Establish scalable intelligence frameworks, operating models, and best practices that improve speed, consistency, and business impact of insight generation.
* Build and execute a digital transformation roadmap for MI/CI, incorporating emerging technologies, external data assets, and knowledge management capabilities.



**AI \& GenAI Innovation** 



* Lead the design and implementation of GenAI\-powered MI/CI solutions including intelligence copilots, automated literature monitoring, competitive signal detection, insight generation, and executive briefing tools.
* Leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, and advanced search technologies to improve intelligence gathering and synthesis.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual research processes and enhance analyst productivity through AI\-enabled workflows.
* Partner with Data Science, AI, Product, and Technology teams to develop next\-generation intelligence solutions and drive enterprise adoption.



**Stakeholder Engagement \& Strategic Advisory** 



* Act as a strategic thought partner to senior leadership, collaborating across Commercial, Marketing, Medical, Market Access, Business Development, and Strategy functions.
* Deliver forward\-looking market, competitor, and industry insights that influence key business decisions, product strategy, portfolio planning, and investment priorities.
* Facilitate executive\-level discussions by translating complex information into concise strategic recommendations.



**Research \& Intelligence Leadership** 



* Oversee a portfolio of secondary research, primary research, competitive intelligence, social listening, market monitoring, and strategic intelligence programs.
* Guide the development of competitive landscapes, market trend assessments, KOL insights, conference intelligence, pipeline tracking, and strategic scenario analysis.
* Ensure methodological rigor, quality assurance, and alignment to business priorities across all intelligence initiatives.



**Insight Generation \& Storytelling** 



* Synthesize diverse data sources, market signals, and competitive developments into clear, actionable insights and strategic implications.
* Deliver high\-impact executive presentations, dashboards, and intelligence products tailored for senior leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Drive adoption of advanced visualization, storytelling, and insight communication best practices.



**Vendor \& Ecosystem Management** 



* Lead relationships with external research agencies, intelligence providers, data partners, and technology vendors.
* Evaluate emerging MI/CI platforms, AI solutions, and data sources to continuously enhance organizational intelligence capabilities.
* Ensure cost\-effective execution, vendor performance, and data quality standards.



**Governance \& Excellence** 



* Establish governance frameworks for intelligence generation, AI adoption, research quality, knowledge management, and insight dissemination.
* Define KPIs and success measures to evaluate the impact of intelligence activities on business outcomes.
* Promote innovation, continuous improvement, and best practices across the MI/CI organization.



**Team Leadership \& Talent Development** 



* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team of MI/CI professionals, fostering a culture of strategic thinking, innovation, and analytical excellence.
* Develop future\-ready capabilities across market research, competitive intelligence, analytics, and AI\-driven intelligence methodologies.
* Champion continuous learning and upskilling in emerging AI and GenAI technologies.



  





**Qualifications** 



* **10\-12\+ years of experience** 
 in Market Intelligence, Competitive Intelligence, Strategic Insights, Commercial Analytics, or Market Research within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences industry.
* Should have worked on GenAI projects.
* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale MI/CI programs and influencing senior executives through strategic insights and intelligence.
* Proven experience modernizing intelligence capabilities through digital transformation, advanced analytics, AI, and Generative AI solutions.
* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercialization, competitive landscape analysis, market dynamics, pipeline intelligence, and strategic planning.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/GenAI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, enterprise search, and intelligent knowledge management platforms.
* Experience leveraging AI\-enabled tools for research automation, insight generation, competitive monitoring, and market sensing.
* Deep expertise in both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, competitive intelligence frameworks, and insight generation approaches.
* Demonstrated success managing global stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, and third\-party vendors in a matrixed environment.
* Strong executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills with the ability to distill complex information into strategic recommendations.
* Experience leading globally distributed teams and driving organizational capability\-building initiatives.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience developing or implementing GenAI\-powered MI/CI products, intelligence portals, insight copilots, or market sensing platforms.
* Familiarity with commercial pharma domains including Forecasting, Omnichannel Analytics, Customer Engagement, Patient Analytics, and Strategic Planning.
* Experience with visualization and analytics tools (Power BI, Tableau), AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, Databricks, AWS AI Services), and commercial intelligence solutions.

By using new\-age analytic tools and emerging technologies, the team cultivates a dynamic learning environment for curious minds to thrive.
  

  

**Role Summary:**  

The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for the accurate and timely execution of analytic and statistical work supporting Epsilon clients, products, and revenue\-generating initiatives. This role applies established statistical methods, develops analytic code, and delivers high\-quality, well\-documented outputs for assigned analytic workstreams.
  

  

Senior Data Analysts operate as experienced individual contributors who independently implement analytic projects, support client and internal requests, and collaborate with multi\-functional partners. This position may have assigned clients for which the Senior Analyst is accountable for statistical deliverables. The role follows established processes and standards, exercises sound analytic judgment within defined scope, and contributes hands\-on expertise to incremental improvements in analytic workflows, systems, and tools.
  

  

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  

  

**Responsibilities**  

* Accountable for the accurate, on\-time delivery of statistical deliverables for assigned projects, including proactively managing workload and standard request queues within the Data Analytics team.
* Implement analytic and research projects by confirming objectives, translating client or business needs into defined analytic approaches, applying appropriate methodologies, and delivering final analytic outputs.
* Independently build, validate, and present statistically sound models using standard tools, programs, and methodologies, making informed decisions under ambiguity, and exercising judgment to identify when creative or non\-standard approaches are required and when escalation is appropriate.
* Perform original research and contribute to research requests; maintain clear and comprehensive analytic documentation across the project lifecycle; and develop client\-ready materials that clearly communicate findings, implications, and data\-driven recommendations, exercising judgment and standing behind analytic conclusions while considering business, client, and operational tradeoffs.
* Consult with Sales personnel and external clients by supporting client meetings and conference calls, explaining statistical concepts, and serving as a trusted analytic advisor.
* Work cross functionally with internal teams, including Client Services, Data Acquisition \& Performance, Modeling/Stats, T\&D, Production, and Product partners, to troubleshoot data, modeling, and process issues, build effective peer level relationships, clearly explain root causes and recommended solutions, and proactively surface risks or issues before they impact delivery.
* Support the development of peers through informal mentoring, knowledge sharing, and collaboration, contributing to team learning and continuous improvement.
* Write new Python (and PySpark, where applicable) code, enhance and maintain existing codebases, apply relevant industry techniques and trends, and provide input on improvements to modeling methodologies and analytic workflows.
* Ensure compliance with applicable privacy, data governance, and AI guidelines across all assigned analytic work, including the responsible use of AI\-enabled tools to improve efficiency and accuracy where appropriate.

  

**Qualifications**  

* 5\+ years os experience.
* Bachelors in statistical, quantitative, or related field. Advanced degree preferred; minimum 3 years experience in a statistical field, including experience performing data analysis or modeling with large transactional databases, conducting original research, and working directly with external clients in a business environment.
* Experience working with external clients in a business environment and familiarity with Epsilon data products, processes, and direct marketing concepts preferred.
* Advanced knowledge of statistical methods and principles, including regression, clustering, factor analysis, ANOVA, sampling, inference, transformations, validation, and model evaluation techniques.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct analytic projects and research through all stages, including problem formulation, metric definition, methodology selection, execution, evaluation, and final reporting.
* Proficiency in analytic programming and tools, including Python (and PySpark where applicable) and SQL, with the ability to independently perform analyses, understand, improve, and maintain existing codebases, review peer analytic work for quality and correctness, and contribute to informal knowledge sharing and skill development; proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint to support analysis, reporting, and presentations.
