* Lead workshops with finance stakeholders to agree consistent definitions, business rules and reporting requirements.
* Produce clear finance mapping specifications, decision logs and acceptance criteria for technical and data teams.
* Define validation, reconciliation and audit controls to ensure accuracy, traceability and trust in reporting outputs.
* Drive standardisation and help eliminate inconsistent interpretations of financial data across the business.
* Contribute to governed semantic models and self\-service datasets, ensuring calculations and business logic are applied consistently.
* Build and maintain a select suite of standard finance reports aligned to business reporting requirements.
* Work collaboratively with Finance, Business Intelligence and Data teams to deliver effective reporting and analytics solutions.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





**Essential:** 



* Fully qualified accountant (ACCA, CIMA or equivalent recognised accountancy qualification).
* Strong understanding of financial statements and core finance processes.
* Experience defining financial KPIs, reporting structures and business rules.
* Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills.
* Strong documentation and specification\-writing skills.
* Experience working with finance reporting, data governance or business intelligence environments.
* Working knowledge of SQL.
* Experience with Power BI, semantic modelling and DAX.
* Strong focus on data quality, governance and auditability.
* At least 7–8 years' experience in a similar role, engaging with stakeholders at all levels.



  





**Desirable:** 



* Experience with Python, Spark or data profiling.
* Microsoft Power BI certification (PL\-300 or equivalent).

title: Senior Scientist: Data Analytics and Pharmacometric Modeling
description:
Senior Scientist, Data Analytics and Pharmacometric Modeling
   

  

 Join Amgen’s Clinical Pharmacology, Modeling and Simulation (CPMS) team as a Senior Scientist and help shape the future of drug development through data science, predictive analytics, pharmacometrics, and quantitative systems pharmacology. In this role, you will apply innovative modeling and simulation approaches to support critical decisions across clinical development programs and therapeutic areas.
   

  

 You will work in a collaborative, science\-driven environment alongside CPMS colleagues, therapeutic area teams, external partners, and cross\-functional R\&D stakeholders. This is an opportunity to contribute to model\-informed drug development, influence study design and dose selection, and help bring meaningful therapies to patients.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a quantitative scientist who enjoys working with complex biological and clinical datasets, translating analyses into actionable insights, and communicating results clearly to multidisciplinary teams. You will have the opportunity to use established pharmacometric methods as well as emerging machine learning and AI\-enabled tools to solve high\-impact development questions. The typical job responsibilities may include :
   

  

* Develop and implement modeling, simulation, and analytics strategies that support clinical drug development programs across Amgen’s portfolio.
* Use pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, patient\-level, and disease data to inform dose selection, dosing regimens, study designs, and development decisions.
* Analyze in vitro and preclinical PK/PD data to support first\-in\-human dose selection and contribute to IND submissions and supporting documentation.
* Build and apply pharmacometric, PK/PD, quantitative systems pharmacology, and predictive analytics models to address key program questions.
* Partner with clinical pharmacologists, statisticians, translational scientists, clinical teams, and other stakeholders to integrate quantitative insights into program strategy.
* Explore and recommend innovative data science, machine learning, and AI\-enabled approaches that can improve decision\-making and increase development efficiency.
* Communicate modeling results and recommendations clearly through study reports, regulatory documents, presentations, publications, and cross\-functional discussions.
* Contribute to the external scientific community through publications, presentations, and professional engagement.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Doctorate degree and 4 years of relevant experience; or
* Master’s degree and 8 years of relevant experience; or
* Bachelor’s degree and 10 years of relevant experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced training in statistical or data sciences, computer science, pharmaceutical sciences, engineering, clinical pharmacology, pharmacometrics, or a related quantitative discipline; PhD, MD, PharmD, or equivalent experience preferred.
* Experience in life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical development, consulting, or postdoctoral research, with a strong interest in applying quantitative methods to drug development.
* Hands\-on experience developing, scripting, and executing data analytics algorithms, statistical models, or pharmacometric models.
* Experience with tools such as Python, R, MATLAB, NONMEM, SAS, S\-Plus, or related modeling and analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with machine learning, AI\-enabled methods, or advanced analytics applied to life science datasets is a plus.
* Experience with PK/PD modeling, population\-based analyses, clinical trial simulations, or model\-informed drug development is highly valued.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain quantitative analyses and recommendations to scientific, clinical, and cross\-functional audiences.
* A collaborative mindset, scientific curiosity, and the ability to influence and contribute within multidisciplinary teams.
* A record of scientific contribution through publications, presentations, regulatory support, or external engagement is desirable.

description:
**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design and validate the disproportionality and statistical signal\-detection methods powering /signal \- PRR, ROR, EBGM (MGPS), Bayesian Confidence Propagation / IC and IC025, observed\-vs\- expected and time\-to\-onset analyses.
* Own therapeutic\-class\-driven assessment logic: comparator selection, indication and channeling confounding control, subgroup and class\-effect stratification, and the metrics/calculations that differentiate each certified therapeutic add\-on pack (Oncology, Anti\-Infective/AMR, Cardiometabolic, CNS, Immunology, Respiratory, Vaccines, Rare Disease).

title: Business Solutions Specialist
description:
The Business Solutions Specialist plays a key role within Fleet IT's IT Operations \& Supply Chain function, helping the business make better decisions through clear reporting and smarter automation. Working primarily on the Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps and Power Automate), the role turns business needs into practical, low\-code solutions \- with growing exposure to RPA and AI/GenAI capabilities as Anglo\-Eastern's automation landscape evolves. The focus throughout is on improving data visibility, decision\-making, efficiency, accuracy, compliance and scalability across the organization.
   

  

**Requirements**
**ROLES ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
* Create clear, reliable reporting and dashboards \- primarily using Power BI, including data models (star schema) \- that give business stakeholders visibility into operational and financial performance
* Shape the data behind those reports using Power Query (M) and DAX, so numbers stay accurate, fast to load and consistent across the business
* Look after reports once they go live \- refresh schedules, workspace access and row\-level security (RLS) in Power BI Service \- so business users always see the right data, safely
* Turn manual, repetitive processes into simple, easy\-to\-use apps and forms \- using Power Apps (Canvas and Model\-driven), including the underlying logic and connectors that make them work
* Build and support automated workflows using Power Automate (Cloud and Desktop), with room to extend into RPA, AI Builder and Copilot as the platform \- and your skills \- grow
* Set up and maintain the data foundations behind these solutions \- Dataverse tables, relationships, business rules and security \- so everything stays reliable as it scales
* Follow good governance and change\-management practice \- moving solutions cleanly from development to testing to live, with the right approvals and data\-protection policies in place \- so everything stays safe, supportable and audit\-ready
* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand what they need, and turn that into simple designs and documentation everyone can follow
* Be the go\-to person when something isn't working \- troubleshooting reporting, apps and automation issues, and escalating platform\-level problems when needed
* Keep learning as the automation and AI landscape evolves \- including RPA, GenAI and Agentic AI \- and bring ideas back to improve how the team works


**KEY SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES:**
**Technical Skills**
* Certifications: PL\-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) is the primary certification for this role, with PL\-200 (Power Platform Functional Consultant) and PL\-400 (Power Platform Developer) as valuable additions
* Power BI (primary specialism): confident with data modelling (star schema), Power Query (M), DAX, row\-level security (RLS), performance tuning, and publishing through the Power BI Service with scheduled refresh
* Low\-code/no\-code: comfortable building end\-to\-end solutions with Power Apps (Canvas and Model\-driven) on SharePoint and Power Automate (Cloud and Desktop), including AI Builder and Copilot. General exposure to RPA concepts and tools is a plus
* Dataverse: a working understanding of table/relationship design, business rules, security roles and business process flows; exposure to plug\-ins/custom APIs is a bonus
* Automation governance: aware of good ALM practice \- solution\-based deployment, Dev/UAT/Prod environments, and environment variables/connection references
* Programming \& scripting: basic SQL; familiarity with Python or VBA for data handling is a bonus


**Professional Skills**
* Comfortable working independently across a project's full lifecycle, with a working knowledge of SDLC / Agile ways of working
* Good at documentation and business analysis \- able to translate what stakeholders need into clear, simple technical designs
* Curious about GenAI and Agentic AI \- a bonus, not a requirement
* Proactive, data\-led mindset with a focus on process improvement, data governance and solution scalability


**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:**
* 3\-4 years of hands\-on experience building reporting, apps and automation solutions \- primarily on the Microsoft Power Platform \- with strong depth in Power BI
* Confident, hands\-on experience with Power Apps and Power Automate \- this is a core part of the role, not a nice\-to\-have
* Bachelor's degree (Any Graduate); a background in Computer Science, IT or a related field is an advantage
* PL\-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) certification preferred; PL\-200 and PL\-400 certifications an advantage


**Benefits**
 About Anglo\-Eastern
   

  

 Anglo\-Eastern is a global leader in independent ship management services. The Group manages over 700 vessels under full technical management, supports around 500 additional ships under crew management, and has overseen more than 1,000 newbuildings and conversions through its newbuilding supervision and project management divisions.
   

  

 Headquartered in Hong Kong, Anglo\-Eastern operates through a network of 30 offices across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, including wholly owned maritime training facilities. Our strength lies in our people: over 39,000 seafarers and 2,350 shore\-based employees who work together to support clients across ship types while building trust, driving performance, and shaping a better maritime future.
   

  

 Why join Anglo\-Eastern?
   

  

* Join a globally respected company with a strong maritime heritage of over 50 years
* Work in an environment anchored in integrity, trust, and long\-term relationships
* Access continuous learning and structured career development across a truly global network
* Be part of a team committed to delivering excellence and shaping a better maritime future


 Join us today!

title: Senior Manager — Industry Domain (Credit Decisioning)
description:
Vymo transforms how financial institutions manage their distribution networks and collections operations. Our AI\-powered DMS and CMS platform serves 350,000\+ users across 70\+ global financial enterprises, enabling banks and insurers to optimize performance across their distribution channels, and empowering banks to drive operational excellence in collections.
 



  





**Why Global Leaders Choose Vymo** 




  





 Vymo partners with financial institutions through a comprehensive solution that combines deep domain expertise with cutting\-edge technology. Our platform's human\-centric design, coupled with enterprise\-grade scalability and AI\-powered intelligence, delivers measurable business outcomes while ensuring high user adoption and engagement.
 



  





**Recognition \& Trust** 




  





 ● Backed by $45M\+ funding from Peak XV partners (formerly Sequoia), Emergence Capital, and Bertelsmann Investments.
 



 ● Trusted by leading global financial institutions including Berkshire Hathaway, AIA, AXA, SBI Life, HDFC Bank, Aditya Birla Capital, Tata AIA, ABSLI and many more!
 



 ● Recognized by Celent in their 2024 Distribution Management Solutions report, with an Advanced Functionality ranking.
 



 ● Featured in Gartner's Market Guide for Sales Engagement Applications and recognized as a
 



 "Strong Performer" in Forrester's Sales Engagement Wave Report.
 



 ● Microsoft 'AI for All' award winner for innovation in artificial intelligence
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 Credit decisions at scale — whether a loan gets approved, at what rate, under what conditions — are governed by business rule engines and decision frameworks that have been refined over decades inside banks, NBFCs, and risk analytics firms. Vymo's agentic AI systems interact with, augment, and in some cases replace components of these decisioning frameworks.
 



  





 Building the right system requires someone who understands how business rule engines actually work: how rules are authored, versioned, tested, and deployed; how credit policy translates into decision logic; where the standard engines fall short and where manual override is still the norm. That is this role.
 



  





 You are the person who sits between a client's risk team and Vymo's product team — making sure that what is being built reflects how credit decisioning actually works in a regulated Indian financial institution, not how a software team imagines it works. You will carry domain knowledge from the BRE layer through to the underwriting policy and credit risk framework that sits above it.
 



  





***The crux of this role: you know enough about credit decisioning and BRE architecture to know which questions, asked in which sequence, reveal how a client's decision engine actually works — and what Vymo needs to build to sit alongside it or replace it.***




  





**What You Will Do** 




  





**1\. Client Discovery — Decode the Decision Engine** 



* Diagnose architectural realities and data flows by asking targeted questions that reveal system dependencies, latencies, and integration requirements.
* Translate discovered logic gaps into actionable visual maps and precise engineering specifications for the product team.



**2\. Product Requirements — Translate Decisioning Logic Into What to Build** 



* Translate credit decisioning and Business Rule Engine (BRE) logic into precise product specifications for Vymo's agentic layer, defining routing, rule execution, and human\-in\-the\-loop interventions.
* Validate technical assumptions against BFSI deployment cycles while mapping major BRE platforms (e.g., SAS, Experian, FICO) to ensure architectural accuracy.



**3\. GTM Support — Lend Credibility to the Technical Sales Conversation** 



* Partner with sales teams in high\-stakes sessions to provide deep architectural credibility and handle advanced technical inquiries regarding BRE and decisioning systems.
* Act as a trusted advisor to client architects and risk heads, auditing technical proposals and developing GTM assets that address platform constraints and regulatory governance.



**4\. Industry Intelligence — Track How Decisioning Is Evolving** 



* Track RBI regulatory changes—including the Model Risk Management Framework (MRMF) and AI explainability rules—alongside Indian BRE market trends to anticipate compliance demands.
* Build a strong network of industry experts to validate core architecture choices and feed real\-world market insights directly into the product roadmap.



  





**What You will Bring** 




  





**Experience \& Fluency** 




  




* **Domain Background:** 
 Operational depth in credit decisioning across key sectors—whether coming from BRE vendors (SAS, FICO, Experian), bank/NBFC credit risk teams, underwriting operations, risk consulting, or credit bureaus.
* **BRE \& Risk Architecture:** 
 Deep understanding of Business Rule Engine (BRE) architectures, rule authoring, champion\-challenger frameworks, scorecard calibration, and baseline risk concepts ($PD/LGD/EAD$).
* **Origination \& Integration Landscape: Practical knowledge of Loan Origination System (LOS) integration patterns, core platform configurations (e.g., PowerCurve, Blaze Advisor), and performance metrics like Straight Through Processing (STP) rates.**
* **Regulatory \& Compliance Context:** 
 Familiarity with RBI guidelines regarding algorithmic credit decisions, model risk management, explainability requirements, and cloud data localisation constraints.



  





**Mindset \& Core Traits** 




  




* **Architectural Inquiry:** 
 Driven by deep curiosity about how entire systems fit together, possessing the precise sequence of targeted questions that uncover how a client’s engine
 *actually* 
 operates beneath the documentation.
* **Skeptical Practitioner:** 
 Operates with a healthy skepticism of stated architectures; validates system realities by analyzing deployment logs, rule histories, and exception reports rather than relying solely on official diagrams.
* **Policy\-to\-Logic Translation:** 
 Seamlessly bridges the gap between high\-level credit policy language and structured, actionable rule engine engineering specifications.
* **Grounded Intellectual Humility:** 
 Explicitly understands the boundaries of personal technical knowledge, prioritizing accurate discovery and domain\-expert networking over making unverified assumptions.

title: Senior Manager Global Pricing
description:
**About Us** 




  





 Headquartered in Singapore, SATS Ltd. is one of the world’s largest providers of air cargo handling services and Asia’s leading airline caterer. SATS Gateway Services provides airfreight and ground handling services including passenger services, ramp and baggage handling, aviation security services, aircraft cleaning and aviation laundry. SATS Food Solutions serves airlines and institutions and operates central kitchens with large\-scale food production and distribution capabilities for a wide range of cuisines.
 



 SATS is present in the Asia\-Pacific, the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, powering an interconnected world of trade, travel and taste. Following the acquisition of Worldwide Flight Services (WFS) in 2023, the combined SATS and WFS network operates over 215 stations in 27 countries. These cover trade routes responsible for more than 50% of global air cargo volume. SATS has been listed on the Singapore Exchange since May 2000\. For more information, please visit www.sats.com.sg
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a Senior Manager, Pricing to lead bid pricing, commercial modelling, and pricing intelligence across complex, multi\-location deals. This role plays a critical part in shaping competitive, data\-driven pricing strategies and ensuring consistency, accuracy, and profitability across regions.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong commercial acumen, advanced analytical modelling, and stakeholder influence, with the ability to operate at pace during live bids and negotiations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Bid Pricing \& Consolidation:
 


* Establish baseline station pricing at the start of each RFP cycle
* Own pricing data collection from regional/station teams using a standardised global template
* Validate and challenge pricing inputs against benchmarks and pricing libraries
* Consolidate multi\-location inputs into a single, coherent global bid model
* Identify variances and escalate for resolution where required



  





 Business Case Development \& Trade\-offs:
 


* Build and challenge end\-to\-end pro\-forma financial models across the contract lifecycle
* Conduct scenario and sensitivity analysis (volume, mix, FX, cost drivers)
* Model commercial levers such as:



 • Rebates
 



 • Discounts
 



 • Sign\-on incentives
 



 • Bundled pricing structures
 


* Support live deal negotiations with rapid scenario re\-runs and analysis



  





 Pricing Intelligence \& Analytics:
 


* Build and maintain a central pricing library / rate repository across customers and regions
* Drive pricing consistency and knowledge reuse across bids
* Leverage automation and advanced analytics (incl. Gen\-AI where applicable) to:



 • Improve pricing accuracy
 



 • Scale pricing intelligence
 



 • Enable faster turnaround of bid models
 


* Partner with Finance to co\-own pricing frameworks and margin guardrails



  





 Process Improvement \& Governance:
 


* Establish and enforce standard pricing methodologies and governance practices
* Improve turnaround time and accuracy of bid pricing deliverables
* Ensure alignment between regional pricing inputs and global pricing strategy
* Continuously enhance tools, templates, and modelling approaches



  





 Stakeholder Management:
 


* Partner closely with:



 • Regional commercial and station teams
 



 • Finance (business case validation and margins)
 



 • Deal / solution architects
 


* Act as a constructive challenger, bringing data\-driven insights to decision\-making
* Support leadership with clear, quantitative storytelling for pricing decisions



  





 Key Success Metrics
 


* Accuracy and timeliness of pro\-forma pricing models
* Consistency and coverage of station pricing baselines
* Effective identification and resolution of pricing variances
* Adherence to agreed SLAs during live bid and negotiation cycles
* Growth and utilisation of pricing library / rate database



  





**Candidate Profile** 




  





**Experience** 



* •\~10–14 years of experience in pricing, commercial finance, or bid modelling roles
* Background in aviation, logistics, technology or complex multi\-element pricing environments preferred
* Experience working across multi\-regions or global pricing structures



  





**Technical \& Analytical Skills** 



* Advanced proficiency in financial modelling and scenario analysis (Excel or equivalent tools)
* Ability to work with large, complex datasets across multiple systems
* Strong understanding of:



 • Cost structures
 



 • Pricing strategies
 



 • Margin optimisation
 


* Exposure to automation, advanced analytics, or AI\-driven pricing tools is a plus



  





**Leadership \& Functional Skills** 



* Strong commercial acumen with a data\-driven decision mindset
* Ability to manage complexity and operate under tight timelines (RFP cycles)
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
* High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and consistency
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate data into clear insights

title: Senior Program Associate - IRP
description:
**Note: This opportunity is available across Mumbai, and New Delhi**
**About Us**
 WRI India, an independent knowledge organization registered as India Resources Trust, provides objective information and practical proposals to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development.
   

  

 Through research, analysis, and recommendations, WRI India puts ideas into action to build transformative solutions to protect the earth, promote livelihoods, and enhance human well\-being. Know more: wri\-india.org
   

  

**Program Overview For Energy**
 The objective of the WRI India energy program is to inform and guide India’s transition to cleaner energy through strong research, ground\-level implementation experience, partnerships with key stakeholders and communicating our work. The 5 pillars of the energy program focus on increasing clean energy demand, increasing clean energy supply, supporting sub\-national energy transitions, raising the issues of materials and circularity for the energy transition and ensuring equitable development through energy transitions.
   

  

**About IRP**
 Under this initiative we work with states on Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) and to support the translation of state energy\-transition priorities into implementable plans, infrastructure requirements and investment pathways. By helping states identify the system interventions needed to meet changing demand and integrate clean energy, the work strengthens their capacity to implement reliable and modern electricity infrastructure and supports the long\-term transition towards cleaner energy supply for communities.
   

  

**Job Highlight**
 We are looking for a Senior Program Associate \- IRP to support and co\-lead WRI India’s state\-level Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) work. The role will focus on modelling and simulation, scenario development, and translating analytical findings into insights that can inform electricity sector policy and regulatory decision\-making.
   

  

 The position will also drive project execution and stakeholder engagement, working closely with state electricity utilities, regulators, renewable energy agencies, partners, and other stakeholders. In addition, the role will contribute to capacity\-building initiatives on resource adequacy and IRP, develop knowledge products and research outputs, and facilitate training sessions for relevant institutions and stakeholders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring strong analytical and research capabilities, an understanding of power sector policy and regulatory processes, and the ability to translate complex analysis into actionable insights and effective stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Support and co\-lead the state\-specific IRP work of WRI India, including overseeing the modelling and simulation, designing of scenarios and interpretation of results to draw insights that can help inform regulatory and policy decision\-making at the state level, etc.
* Manage the IRP work in terms of timely project execution and ensuring completion of all deliverables.
* Communicate with various stakeholders, especially with the state electricity utilities, regulators, RE nodal agencies, donors, partners, and other state\-level agencies, for effective collaboration to ensure a comprehensive IRP process.
* Support and co\-lead the effort of developing course content for capacity building on resource adequacy and IRP\-related processes in collaboration with partner organisations.

* Good understanding of the basic institutional framework of the Indian electricity sector with an ability to analyse, interpret and summarise relevant policy, legal and regulatory documents.
* Exposure to or familiarity with power sector modelling tools and software (e.g., PLEXOS, GridPath, PSS®E) is desirable, and a willingness to learn new tools and modelling techniques relevant to the work is crucial.
* Excellent communication skills in presenting/sharing WRI’s research findings – both orally and through op\-eds, blogs, and research publications – with a wide set of stakeholders.
* Strong ability to brainstorm and think creatively about all elements of the project in diverse group settings, especially when collaborating with partners and external agencies.
* A willingness to travel and an ability to work flexibly and cooperatively with all team members to achieve the project goals are essential.


**Qualifications And Requirements We Seek**

title: Historical Market Data (HMD)
description:
**Why Mizuho** 




  





 At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone
 



  





 It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who have the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest and growing banks in the world.
 



  





 Role Overview:
 



  





 The Historical Market Data (HMD) team is a specialist function within Enterprise Risk responsible for the quality, completeness, and controlled implementation of market risk time series used in Value at Risk (VaR), Stressed VaR (SVaR), stress testing, and related risk and capital calculations.
 



 Reporting to the Head of Risk Appetite and Capital Analysis, the candidate will own front\-to\-back onboarding and maintenance of historical risk\-factor data across spot, curves, spreads, and volatility surfaces. The role requires strong understanding of market risk time\-series construction, returns and shock generation, proxy and backfill methodologies, data\-quality controls, and the downstream impact of data changes on risk measures. The successful candidate will work closely with Market Risk, Risk Analytics, Quantitative Analytics, and Technology teams.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  




* Lead front\-to\-back onboarding of historical market data and risk\-factor time series, including spot, curve, spread, and volatility surface data.
* Manage time\-series implementations end to end, covering requirements analysis, data sourcing, mapping, transformation, validation, testing, and production delivery.
* Assess the suitability and completeness of market data used in VaR, SVaR, stress testing, FRTB, and related capital calculations.
* Perform data\-quality analysis across completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, outliers, stale observations, and risk\-factor coverage.
* Develop, document, and enhance proxy and backfilling methodologies for illiquid, sparse, or unavailable historical time series.
* Conduct quantitative impact assessments for data\-source changes, history extensions, methodology updates, and proxy enhancements.
* Investigate material data exceptions and production issues, identify root causes, and drive remediation with Risk Analytics and Technology teams.
* Partner with Quantitative Analytics and Market Risk stakeholders on risk\-factor modelling, methodology changes, and model\-data requirements.
* Define test scenarios, execute UAT and regression testing, validate results, and coordinate issue resolution for HMD platform changes.
* Contribute to automation, monitoring, and tooling enhancements that improve the scalability, transparency, and control of time\-series management.
* Prepare management information on data quality, proxy usage, backfilling activity, risk\-factor coverage, exceptions, and remediation progress.
* Maintain clear documentation of data lineage, source selection, transformations, proxy logic, controls, approvals, and implementation outcomes.
* Support governance, audit, model\-risk, and regulatory reviews relating to historical market data and market risk measurement.



  





  





 Qualifications and Experience:
 



  




* Master's degree from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 university in Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 5\-12 years of relevant experience within Market Risk Time series, Quantitative Risk, Risk Analytics, Market Data, Product Control, or a closely related function in a bank or financial institution.
* Hands\-on experience with historical time\-series data, market\-data validation, proxy construction, backfilling, risk\-factor mapping, or data\-quality controls.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data flows and communicate quantitative issues clearly.
* Effective stakeholder\-management skills and the ability to work across Risk, Quantitative Analytics, Technology, and control functions.
* Strong Python and SQL skills for data analysis, validation, automation, and investigation; advanced Excel proficiency required.
* Experience working with large\-scale historical time\-series datasets and applying statistical techniques to identify gaps, outliers, and structural data issues.
* Familiarity with market\-data vendors, risk engines, or platforms such as Bloomberg, LSEG/Refinitiv, Murex, MSCI RiskMetrics, or equivalent systems is advantageous.
* CFA, FRM, CQF, or an equivalent professional qualification is advantageous.



  





**Organization Overview:** 




  





 Mizuho Global Services (MGS), Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, MGS Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high\-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.
 



  





 MGS Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.
 



  





 MGS Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices. MGS Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

title: Senior Specialist, Provider Data Operations (US Healthcare Insurance)
description:
**Our Mission**
 Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.
   

  

 Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in\-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across 200\+ specialties and \+12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power. In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.
   

  

 We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.
   

  

 As an Insurance Senior Specialist, you will serve as the subject matter expert for Zocdoc's insurance taxonomy and related systems. You will own the policies, processes, and quality standards that ensure our insurance data is accurate, scalable, and aligned with product strategy. This role combines deep expertise in the U.S. health insurance landscape with strong analytical thinking to improve the patient search experience and strengthen the integrity of our insurance database.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to define insurance policies, monitor database health, and drive continuous improvements. Your work will directly influence how patients find in\-network care by ensuring that our insurance taxonomies, carrier and plan coverage, and provider matching systems remain accurate, scalable, and responsive to changes in the healthcare market.
   

  

**A Day in the Life of a Product Operations Specialist:**
* Define Insurance Policies \& Standards: Own the policies governing insurance carriers and plans across the Zocdoc marketplace. Define and maintain rules for adding, modifying, and removing insurance carriers and plans, as well as thresholds for performance\-based retention or removal.
* Monitor Insurance Market Trends: Stay informed about developments in the U.S. health insurance landscape, including new carrier launches, plan introductions, mergers, and regulatory changes. Evaluate their impact on Zocdoc's insurance database and recommend proactive updates.
* Drive Cross\-functional Strategy: Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data \& Analytics teams to ensure insurance taxonomies support product strategy and accurate patient search experiences. Translate complex insurance policies into clear product requirements, data models, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Advise senior Product and Engineering leaders on recommendations and tradeoffs, influence roadmap priorities, and shape taxonomy architecture, validation logic, tooling, and system controls. Define reporting and monitor performance, while leading incident reviews and escalations involving inaccurate insurance availability or provider matching to identify root causes and mitigate future risk.
* Own Insurance Database Health: Define, monitor, and report on key insurance database health metrics. Conduct regular reviews with Product, Operations, and Data partners to identify trends, prioritize improvements, and maintain high data quality.
* Improve Processes \& Quality: Identify systemic issues affecting insurance data quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives. Refine policies and operational processes to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase accuracy across workflows.
* Perform Quality Assurance \& Expert Reviews: Act as the organization's expert on U.S. health insurance, review and validate outputs from operational teams for new insurance plan additions and complex taxonomy decisions. Serve as the final escalation point for policy interpretation and insurance\-related quality questions.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* 5\+ years of experience in the U.S. healthcare industry, with deep expertise in Insurance Payor Management, Payor Analytics, Database
* Management or related functions at payor or plan level.
* Strong understanding of U.S. commercial insurance plans, carriers, provider networks.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience using metrics and data to drive strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience partnering cross\-functionally with Product, Operations, Analytics, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to balance strategic thinking and operational execution.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to influence stakeholders across functions.
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Looker or other analytical tools is a must.
* Familiarity and proven usage of AI\-driven tools and workflow automation is a must.


**Benefits**
* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check\-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025\-2026


**About Us**
 Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in\-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in\-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last\-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
   

  

 Zocdoc is a mission\-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values \-
 *Together, Not Alone* 
 , we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

title: Growth Manager-Ecommerce
description:
We’re looking for a
 **Growth Manager\-Ecommerce** 
 to own and scale our online business across D2C, marketplaces and quick\-commerce platforms with a primary focus on Amazon and Blinkit as key revenue\-driving channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate understands that e\-commerce is not just about managing listings \- it’s about driving sales, improving visibility, increasing conversion, ensuring product availability and building profitable \& sustainable growth. You should be comfortable working with data, managing multiple platforms and identifying opportunities to grow the business.
 



  





 If you enjoy taking ownership, working fast and directly impacting online revenue and business growth, we’d love to hear from you.
 



  





**About Ayuvya** 




 Ayuvya is a modern Ayurveda and wellness brand built around trust, authenticity and innovation, combining traditional Ayurvedic wisdom with modern science and technology.
 



  





 We are building modern Indian wellness brands across D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce, with a strong focus on building scalable and profitable digital businesses.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Own and scale Amazon \& Blinkit as key revenue\-driving channels, while managing the broader D2C, marketplace and quick\-commerce business.
* Drive sales targets for the overall brand, hero products and key categories, while owning channel P\&L, margins, CAC and contribution.
* Own forecasting, budgeting, revenue planning and profitability across e\-commerce channels.
* Manage product listings, catalogue, assortment, pricing and promotions across platforms.
* Optimize product pages for SEO, visibility, conversion and platform merchandising.
* Plan and execute media, promotional and marketplace campaigns with the marketing team.
* Monitor competitors, pricing, keywords, rankings, reviews and category trends to identify growth opportunities.
* Track inventory, stock availability, orders, cancellations, returns and fulfilment in coordination with supply chain and operations.
* Analyze sales and platform data to track revenue, conversion, AOV, ROAS, margins and overall channel performance.
* Manage new product launches, SKU additions and platform onboarding.
* Manage marketplace, agency and vendor relationships and drive commercial negotiations.
* Coordinate with marketing, supply chain, operations, finance, CRM and distribution teams.
* Define long\-term channel strategy and growth roadmap and drive continuous experimentation and improvement.
* Prepare regular performance reports and share key insights and action plans with leadership.



  





**Requirements** 



* B.Tech or MBA in Sales \& Marketing / Business or a relevant field.
* 3–5 years of experience in e\-commerce, growth, marketplace management or key account management. Hands\-on experience with major marketplace or quick\-commerce platforms.
* Experience as a Category Manager with an online retailer, KAM for an E\-commerce channel with a leading brand or KAM in Modern Trade is a strong fit.
* Strong understanding of catalogue management, e\-commerce operations and platform dashboards.
* Good understanding of SEO, product pages and conversion optimization.
* Strong understanding of pricing, promotions, margins and marketplace profitability.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify the root cause of problems and make decisions with imperfect information.
* Strong negotiation and commercial skills with the ability to create win\-win outcomes.
* Strong solutioning ability with a creative and problem\-solving mindset.
* Strong customer orientation and interest in consumer internet and digital commerce.
* Detail\-oriented, organized and execution\-focused.
* Experience in D2C, FMCG, Wellness, Ayurveda, Beauty or Lifestyle is a plus.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Someone who understands what drives online sales and can turn data into action.
* A self\-driven professional who takes ownership and continuously looks for ways to improve sales, visibility, conversion, availability and profitability.
* Someone who can balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Someone who is commercially sharp, data\-driven and comfortable solving ambiguous problems.
* Someone who enjoys working across platforms, teams and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**You’ll Be a Great Fit If** 



* You enjoy working with data, platforms and products.
* You can manage multiple platforms, stakeholders and priorities.
* You enjoy working in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment.
* You’re excited about D2C, marketplaces, quick commerce and the consumer internet space.
* You enjoy experimentation and see ambiguity as an opportunity rather than friction.



  





**This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If** 



* You see e\-commerce only as a listing/uploading job.
* You prefer following instructions rather than taking ownership.
* You’re uncomfortable with numbers, P\&L and performance metrics.
* You don’t enjoy working across multiple teams, platforms and external partners.
* You’re not comfortable working in an early\-stage startup environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
 As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno\-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data\-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP\&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As\-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross\-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in\-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5\-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.


**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.


**What We Look For**
* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Competitive Data Eng & Analyst
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
   

  

 Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
   

  

 Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
   

  

**About EBay**
 eBay Inc. is a global commerce leader that connects millions of buyers and sellers around the world. We exist to enable economic opportunity for individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and organizations of all sizes. eBay Marketplaces operates in 190 markets worldwide.
   

  

 Are you looking for a company that inspires passion, courage, and imagination—where you can help shape the future of global commerce? Join eBay and help influence how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Global Competitive Strategy \& Insights team delivers high\-impact insights that help eBay navigate a dynamic commerce landscape. We connect market data, trends, and competitive intelligence into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions.
   

  

 As the team evolves, we are investing in scalable data infrastructure, automation, and self\-serve analytics to improve how competitive insights are generated, operationalized, and delivered.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Competitive Data Engineering \& Analytics Specialist is a hands\-on role that combines data engineering, analytics, automation, and reporting. This role will help build and maintain data pipelines, integrate third\-party and vendor data into eBay’s data ecosystem, and support reliable, automated, and self\-serve analytics for competitive intelligence.
   

  

 The role will work closely with analytics, strategy, product, and data engineering partners to improve data quality, automate recurring workflows, build dashboards, and support AI\-enabled analytics use cases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong SQL skills, working knowledge of Python, experience with data pipelines or analytical data workflows, and a strong interest in building scalable, automated solutions.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Build and Maintain Data Pipelines
* Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines to ingest, transform, and integrate third\-party/vendor datasets into the data warehouse.
* Develop and support ETL/ELT workflows to improve data quality, reliability, and timeliness.
* Partner with Data Engineering teams to implement data models, optimize queries, and improve data processing efficiency.
* Create and maintain data schemas, validation checks, and monitoring mechanisms to improve data integrity.
* Automate recurring ingestion, transformation, and reporting workflows to reduce manual effort.
* Support Data Integration and Vendor Data Operations
* Support onboarding of external and vendor data sources, including requirements gathering, data validation, and pipeline implementation.
* Work with internal stakeholders and vendors to investigate data issues and improve data consistency.
* Help standardize disparate data sources into reusable and scalable datasets.
* Document data sources, business logic, transformation rules, and known limitations to improve transparency and reusability.
* Build Reporting and Visualization Solutions
* Develop dashboards and reporting layers using Tableau or similar BI tools.
* Create reusable datasets, data marts, and semantic layers to support self\-serve analytics.
* Improve dashboard performance, usability, and maintainability through optimization and standardization.
* Translate business questions into structured analyses, dashboards, and scalable reporting solutions.
* Apply AI and Automation
* Use AI\-enabled tools, LLMs, and automation frameworks to improve data processing, analysis, and reporting workflows.
* Build automated workflows to support competitive intelligence generation, recurring analysis, and insight delivery.
* Identify practical opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve speed, consistency, and scalability.
* Support use cases involving AI\-assisted analytics, summarization, classification, and workflow automation.
* Partner with Stakeholders
* Collaborate with cross\-functional partners across strategy, analytics, product, data engineering, and business teams.
* Communicate technical approaches, data limitations, timelines, and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Support long\-term roadmap initiatives as well as fast\-turn analytical and operational requests.
* Work effectively with global teams across time zones.
* Contribute to Operational Excellence
* Identify data quality, scalability, and process bottlenecks and help implement practical solutions.
* Contribute to best practices for data governance, pipeline reliability, documentation, and analytics workflows.
* Support continuous improvement of competitive intelligence data infrastructure and reporting processes.
* Provide input on feasibility, timelines, and implementation approaches.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or hybrid data roles.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python.
* Experience building, maintaining, or supporting data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, or automated analytical data processes.
* Experience working with data warehouses and large datasets.
* Experience ingesting, cleaning, transforming, and integrating structured datasets, including third\-party or vendor data.
* Hands\-on experience with BI tools such as Tableau or similar visualization platforms.
* Good understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT concepts, and data quality management.
* Experience automating recurring workflows, reports, or analytical processes.
* Familiarity with AI/ML or LLM\-based tools in analytics workflows.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to execute independently on well\-defined problems while seeking guidance on complex or ambiguous topics.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to learn new tools and technologies.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in eCommerce, marketplaces, retail, pricing, or competitive intelligence domains.
* Experience building reusable datasets, reporting layers, or analytics frameworks.
* Exposure to AI agents, prompt engineering, or workflow automation frameworks.
* Exposure to Kubernetes or containerized deployment environments is a plus.
* Experience with cloud\-based data platforms, orchestration tools, or modern data stack technologies.
* Strong documentation habits and ability to make data assets easy to understand and reuse.


**Additional Details**
 eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. title: Data Engineer
description:

 We're looking for a
 **Data Engineer**

title: Data Engineer III - Databricks
description:

 We’re an all\-in\-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high\-yield savings, credit cards, point\-of\-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. * Ready to run

**The Role**

title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
description:
**Company Overview:** 




 Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. 
 



 BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma\-to\-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world\-class support on this first\-of\-its\-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock. 
 



 We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!
 



 As a Senior Data \& Analytics Engineer, you will be a key technical contributor who designs and builds both data infrastructure and analytics\-ready data models. You will develop and maintain data pipelines and transformation layers that enable self\-service analytics across the organization. You will partner closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and data scientists to understand requirements and translate them into scalable, well\-modeled data products. You will design for data integrity, reliability, and performance while ensuring data is accessible, documented, and trustworthy for downstream consumers. You will contribute to code quality through adherence to standards and participation in peer code and architecture reviews.
 



 What You'll Need:
 


* 5\+ years hands\-on experience with a combination of:
+ SQL mastery including writing complex, highly\-optimized queries and designing dimensional data models
- Expert\-level analytical SQL (window functions, CTEs, pivots, advanced joins).
- Building reusable, parameterized logic for transformations.
- Writing testable, modular SQL models (dbt or equivalent).

+ Translating ambiguous business questions into
 **structured data models** 
 and
 **metrics** 
 .
+ Designing semantic layers, metrics, and business logic for analytics consumption
+ Python software development for data pipelines and automation
+ Building and maintaining data transformation pipelines using tools like dbt, SQL, and Python
+ Integration with Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Looker, QuickSight, Tableau)
+ Building and maintaining data integration (ETL/ELT) pipelines using SQL, EMR, Python and Spark
+ Good to have knowledge on ETL/ELT with batch (AWS Data Pipeline, Airflow) and streaming (Kinesis, Kafka)
+ Creating scalable, well\-documented data models following dimensional modeling best practices

* Experience with modern analytics engineering tools and practices (e.g., dbt, data modeling, testing frameworks, version control for analytics code)
* Experience using tools like Cursor/ChatGPT to speed up coding and testing, improve documentation, and raise code quality (maintainability, readability, security, performance) is strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of data modeling concepts (star schema, dimensional modeling, slowly changing dimensions)
* Experience working with data lakes and contributing to automation and simplification improvements across the data ecosystem
* Experience owning features from design through delivery along with ongoing support
* Strong ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, translating business requirements into technical solutions
* Experience partnering with analysts, data scientists, and business teams to define metrics, KPIs, and reporting requirements
* Experience mentoring junior engineers and analysts, and promoting best practices for data management, quality, and governance
* Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
* Experience with the following will be added advantage:
+ Working with columnar databases (e.g., Redshift, Snowflake) and optimizing for query performance
+ Distributed data processing (Hadoop, Spark, Hive)
+ Extra consideration will be given to those with Healthcare\-relevant company experience, with demonstrated industry knowledge of handling sensitive information



**Why Join Us:** 




 It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

title: QA Engineer with API Testing, Data Flow Validation
description:
Project overview: The scope includes API, integration, database, and data quality testing for pre trip and invoice related flows.
  
Position overview: We are looking for a QA Engineer to provide technical quality assurance for data moving through APIs, orchestration services, and databases. You will focus on validating payloads, tracing transactions across distributed services, querying databases, isolating defects, and building automated regression coverage.
  
Technology stack: Postman, cURL, Swagger, OpenAPI, JSON, SQL, relational databases, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, cloud based services, CI/CD
  
* Responsibilities: Develop and execute test strategies, test plans, scenarios, and evidence for API, integration, database, and data quality testing.
* Construct and execute API requests using Postman, cURL, Swagger, OpenAPI tooling, or equivalent tools.
* Inspect request and response payloads and validate schemas, required fields, transformations, business rules, status codes, and error responses.
* Write SQL and database queries to compare source, processed, persisted, and consumed data.
* Trace individual transactions across intake, processing, orchestration, persistence, and consumption layers to identify the point of failure.
* Test positive, negative, boundary, retry, idempotency, duplicate, incomplete data, and failure recovery scenarios.
* Validate invoice completeness and accuracy, including field level reconciliation across source and downstream outputs.
* Log defects with reproducible steps, payloads, query evidence, observed versus expected results, severity, and likely failure point.
* Collaborate with developers, product, architecture, and downstream teams to clarify acceptance criteria and resolve defects.
* Create and maintain automated API, integration, data validation, and regression tests, prioritizing critical paths and repeatable scenarios.
* Support component, integration, and end to end test cycles.
* Report test execution, defect trends, coverage gaps, risks, and readiness using concise, evidence based status updates.


  
* Requirements: Demonstrated experience in a QA Engineer, SDET, Test Automation Engineer, or comparable technical testing role.
* Strong hands on API testing experience, including creating calls and analyzing JSON request and response payloads.
* Ability to work effectively with Swagger and OpenAPI specifications and API documentation.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating data directly within relational databases.
* Experience testing integrations or distributed services where a transaction passes through multiple components.
* Ability to independently isolate whether a defect originates in source data, API processing, orchestration, persistence, or consumption.
* Experience designing or extending automated tests for APIs, integrations, or data pipelines.
* Clear written communication and disciplined defect documentation.


  
* Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft SQL Server or Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, and cloud based services.
* Experience testing event driven workflows, orchestration engines, microservices, or ETL and data processing pipelines.
* Experience with contract testing, schema validation, CI/CD integrated test execution, and test reporting.
* Exposure to invoice, itinerary, travel, booking, or other transaction heavy data domains.
* Experience working with globally distributed engineering and product teams in an Agile delivery model.

description:

At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.


Vantive: A New Company Built on Our Legacy


Since last year, Baxter has been on a journey to separate our Kidney Care segment into a standalone company. Vantive\* will build on our nearly 70\-year legacy in acute therapies and home and in\-center dialysis to provide best\-in\-class care to the people we serve. We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us.

  

 At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us are driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us as we revolutionize kidney care and other vital organ support.

 **JOB TITLE: Principal Engineer, Systems (Model based development)**

**Your role :**


As a MDB leader for the Peritoneal dialysis systems the candidate will lead the development of embedded control software for complex electromechanical medical devices using a Model‑Based Design (MBD) approach. In this role, you will lead the design, simulation, and implementation of control algorithms using MATLAB/Simulink, ensuring robust system behavior and seamless integration with hardware components.


You will be responsible for generating high‑quality embedded code through automated workflows, ensuring compliance with relevant software and medical device standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 60601, and internal quality processes. Working within the Systems Engineering team and collaborating closely with Software, Hardware, V\&V, Quality, Regulatory, and Manufacturing groups, you will help translate system‑level requirements into validated models and embedded implementations.


The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, deep experience in MBD workflows, and a solid understanding of real‑time embedded systems. You demonstrate leadership in guiding technical decisions, ensuring design traceability, performing system analysis, managing interfaces, and delivering solutions that support safe, reliable, and innovative medical devices.

 **Job description :**


As a MDB leader for the Peritoneal dialysis systems the candidate will lead all the MBD activities collaborating with the cross functional teams to deliver the embedded code while meeting all the medical device regulations and standards with Aqueduct as the leading project.

* Define and own the MBD framework, methodology, and governance for MATLAB/Simulink, State flow, and Embedded Coder.
* Create system‑level models (plant \+ controller) for electro‑mechanical behaviors—motors/actuators, power stages, sensors, safety interlocks, calibration, and diagnostics.
* Define modeling guidelines, libraries, and reference architectures to maximize reuse, traceability, and testability.

Translate system requirements into executable models; maintain end‑to‑end traceability (DOORS Simulink Requirements tests* code).
* Decompose control strategies and safety requirements into model components, interfaces, and state machines.
* Lead FMEA /Risk analysis (ISO 14971\) and ensure design mitigations are implemented and verified in models.
* Set standards for auto‑code generation (Embedded Coder, coder profiles, build settings, data types, fixed‑point).
* Ensure generated C/C\+\+ integrates cleanly with target RTOS/MCU/SoC, HAL/BSP, drivers (SPI, I2C, UART, PWM, ADC, timers), and communication stacks (CAN, Ethernet if applicable).
* Enforce coding standards (e.g., MISRA‑C/C\+\+), static analysis, and defensively designed runtime checks.
* Establish model‑in‑the‑loop (MIL), software‑in‑the‑loop (SIL), processor‑in‑the‑loop (PIL), and hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) strategies, including plant models for electromechanical dynamics.
* Own model coverage, requirement coverage, and code coverage targets; define acceptance criteria and entry/exit gates.
* Implement CI/CD for models and generated code, including automated builds, checks, and regression tests.
* Ensure compliance with IEC 62304 (software lifecycle), IEC 60601 (applicable electrical safety), ISO 14971 (risk), ISO 13485 (QMS), and FDA design controls.
* Lead and author deliverables: software plans, architectures, risk controls, verification protocols/reports, trace matrices, and problem reports/CAPA inputs.
* Partner with Cybersecurity (FDA guidance, SBOM, vulnerability handling) and Usability Engineering (IEC 62366\) where SW behavior impacts user risk.
* Work with Electrical/Mechanical to co‑simulate and co‑design plant models (motors, gear trains, loads, sensors, thermal, power).
* Support manufacturing test strategies (boundary tests, calibration models, digital twins) and service diagnostics.
* Guide suppliers/CMs on MBD integration and compliance expectations; review artifacts from external modeling partners.
* Mentor systems, software, and test engineers in MBD, control theory, and verification strategies.
* Drive continuous improvement—templates, scripts, libraries, checkers, and dashboards; conduct design and model reviews.
* Serve as the technical authority for trade‑offs (performance vs. safety vs. cost vs. schedule).

 **Qualifications \& Experience**

**Education**

* Master’s in Electronics and communication, Electrical and Electronics, Automation or Computers engineering or a similar field.

 **Experience \& Expertise**

* 15 years of relevant industrial experience in model based development.
* Exposure to coding standards and SW development life cycle
* Expertise in design control documentation, including Design History Files.
* Proven experience in technical risk assessment, mitigation, and execution.
* Strong analytical skills, and trouble shooting experience in electro\-mechanical devices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business decisions at all organizational levels.
