title: Data Engineer, VP
description:
Join us as a Data Engineer
   

  

* You’ll be the voice of our customers, using data to tell their stories and put them at the heart of all decision\-making
* We’ll look to you to drive the build of effortless, digital first customer experiences
* If you’re ready for a new challenge and want to make a far\-reaching impact through your work, this could be the opportunity you’re looking for
* We're offering this role at vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 As a Data Engineer, you’ll be looking to simplify our organisation by developing innovative data driven solutions through data pipelines, modelling and ETL design, inspiring to be commercially successful while keeping our customers, and the bank’s data, safe and secure.
   

  

 You’ll drive customer value by understanding complex business problems and requirements to correctly apply the most appropriate and reusable tool to gather and build data solutions. You’ll support our strategic direction by engaging with the data engineering community to deliver opportunities, along with carrying out complex data engineering tasks to build a scalable data architecture.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Also Include**
* Building advanced automation of data engineering pipelines through removal of manual stages
* Embedding new data techniques into our business through role modelling, training, and experiment design oversight
* Delivering a clear understanding of data platform costs to meet your departments cost saving and income targets
* Sourcing new data using the most appropriate tooling for the situation
* Developing solutions for streaming data ingestion and transformations in line with our streaming strategy


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 To thrive in this role, you’ll need a strong understanding of data usage and dependencies and experience of extracting value and features from large scale data.You’ll also bring practical experience of programming languagesalongside knowledge of data and software engineering fundamentals.
   

  

**Additionally, You’ll Need**
* To lead a configuration\-first data platform, using reusable frameworks, metadata\-driven pipelines and low\-code/no\-code engineering principles
* Strong expertise in PySpark, SQL, Airflow, MongoDB, Apache Iceberg and AWS, with experience in CDC, lakehouse architecture and production resilience
* To lead engineers and own code quality, Git\-based CI/CD, automation, governance and risk\-controlled delivery within a regulated environment
* A good understanding of modern code development practices
* Experience of working in a governed, and regulatory environment
* Strong communication skills with the ability to proactively engage and manage a wide range of stakeholders

title: Data & Analytics Senior Developer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Data \& Analytics Senior Developer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai, India /Hybrid
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Department** 
 : Data and Analytics Team, Center of Excellence
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Surendra Kalayti
   

  

**Company:** 
 Assa Abloy Global Solutions
   

  

**About Assa Abloy Global Solutions:**
**Assa Abloy Global Solutions is a leading provider of smart access solutions** 
 and
 **digital identity services that ensure the secure flow of people, assets, and information. As part of the Assa Abloy Group** 
**,** 
 the global leader in access solutions, we empower organizations to create smarter
 **,** 
**safer, and** 
**more sustainable environments through innovative technologies. Our diverse range of solutions includes physical security products and** 
**advanced cloud\-based services** 
**,** 
 serving customers across multiple industries worldwide. Assa Abloy has been recognized by Fortune Magazine multiple times as one of the world's most innovative companies.
   

  

 At our Center of Excellence in Chennai, we focus on fostering innovation, building expertise, and developing best\-in\-class solutions for our global Data and Analytics needs.
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Data \& Analytics Developer with 7\+ years of experience in designing, developing, and supporting enterprise data and business intelligence solutions. The role is predominantly focused on Azure Data Factory (ADF), Snowflake, and Power BI, covering the end\-to\-end analytics lifecycle from source\-system integration and cloud data engineering through semantic modelling, dashboard development, and production support.
   

  

 This role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, data architects, developers, and IT leadership to deliver reliable and efficient data solutions that support strategic decision\-making. You will play a key role in defining best practices for data engineering, implementing security and performance standards, and ensuring that data systems meet both technical and business requirements in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
   

  

**What we are looking for:**
* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Senior Cloud Data Platform Developer, working with large\-scale data integration and warehousing solutions.
* Strong expertise in Azure Data Factory (ADF) for orchestrating and automating data workflows.
* Proficient in Snowflake Data Warehouse, including data modelling, performance tuning, and advanced SQL.
* Experience designing data models for Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, and Modern Data Platforms.
* Hands\-on Power BI expertise, including Power Query, DAX, star\-schema modelling, semantic models, interactive reports, dashboards, drill\-through, bookmarks, and performance optimization.
* Experience integrating data from multiple sources, including:
+ CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce/SFDC)
+ SAP
+ FTP servers
+ APIs (REST/SOAP)

* Solid understanding of data quality, data governance, and best practices in ETL/ELT processes.
* Ability to integrate AI\-driven solutions securely, ensuring data governance and compliance.
* Demonstrates strong analytical skills and flexibility in handling evolving technologies and complex challenges.
* Clear communicator with collaborative leadership style, fostering teamwork and mentoring peers.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.


**What you will be doing:**
* Design, develop, and optimize data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Azure Data Factory.
* Build and maintain scalable data models and data marts in Snowflake.
* Integrate data from CRM (SFDC), SAP, FTP, and API sources into the enterprise data warehouse.
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and security across all data pipelines.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to deliver high\-quality datasets for analytics and reporting.
* Create and maintain technical documentation for data workflows, integrations, and architecture.
* Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance, ensuring reliability and scalability.
* Optimize ADF pipeline execution, Snowflake compute and query performance, and Power BI model size, refresh time, and report responsiveness.
* Collaborate with Data Architects to understand business requirements and implement solutions.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and business leaders to align Data strategy with organizational objectives.
* Lead the Data Platform setup, including multi\-environment configuration (Dev/Test/Prod), security, backups, and performance tuning.
* Provide architectural guidance and mentoring to development teams and consultants.


**Nice to Have:**
* Knowledge of SAP business data domains and integration patterns.
* Knowledge of SAP business domains and common integration patterns.
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and cloud monitoring services.
* Experience applying AI\-assisted analytics or natural\-language BI capabilities within enterprise security and governance standards.


**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
 Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
   

  

 As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.
   

  

 As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Specialist - Calculation Tools
description:
Company:
   

  

 KONE is a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, making people’s journeys safe, convenient, and reliable with smart and sustainable People Flow®. In a world where cities are constantly evolving and more and more people choose to live in them, we at KONE stand with one clear aim: to shape the future of cities. We make urban life more vibrant and livable. And we do it by enabling safe, sustainable, and effortless people flow for all. We help cities leave a positive mark on the planet \- for the next century and beyond. We shape the future of cities.
   

  

 KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI) is where the magic happens at KONE. It's where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies.
   

  

 KONE R\&D brings together top talent from different disciplines into an industry\-leading product and technology organization. We thrive in solving complex customer challenges, connecting legacy with the latest technologies across hardware and software engineering. In fact, roughly half of our R\&D roles are in software. Agile ways of working mean that we are better able to meet our customers’ rapidly evolving needs for speed and innovation, in a global environment.
   

  

 R\&D unit in KTI is responsible for developing digital services at KONE. It’s the development engine for our Digital Services such as KONE 24/7 Connected Services, Office Flow and Partnership Ecosystem. Our common goal at KONE is to keep the end users safe and people flow uninterrupted. KONE moves 2 billion people every day and that means our services can really make cities better places to live.
   

  

 What will you be doing?
   

  

* Support and manage engineering and calculation\-related applications used within Shared R\&D, such as E\-Site Survey, Mathcad, and similar tools.
* Coordinate with application owners, business stakeholders, IT teams, and vendors to ensure application availability, performance, and user satisfaction.
* Manage application configurations, access controls, service accounts, and operational support activities.
* Troubleshoot application issues and coordinate resolution across technical teams.
* Participate in the modernization of legacy applications to cloud\-native platforms and services.
* Support API\-based integrations and secure connectivity between applications and enterprise systems.
* Contribute to solution design, implementation, testing, and deployment of new integrations and enhancements.
* Utilize REST APIs, scripting, and automation to improve operational efficiency, reporting, and system interoperability.
* Coordinate vulnerability remediation efforts with application teams, IT operations, infrastructure teams, and security stakeholders.
* Track remediation progress, ensure timely closure, and maintain compliance with organizational security requirements.
* Support secure authentication, authorization, and integration practices.
* Support and administer licensing tools used across R\&D departments.
* Monitor license utilization, availability, optimization opportunities, and compliance requirements.
* Provide stakeholder support and reporting related to software license usage.
* Manage and support ITSM processes including: Incident Management, Problem Management, Service Request Fulfillment, Knowledge Management
* Ensure timely resolution of operational issues and continuous service improvement.
* Coordinate testing, deployment, release, and operational readiness activities.
* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and team objectives.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, knowledge articles, support procedures, and technical guidelines.
* Promote knowledge sharing and best practices across teams.


 Required Skills:
   

  

* Good understanding of both cloud\-hosted and on\-premises application environments.
* Experience in application support, IT operations, enterprise application administration, system integrations, or related technical operations roles.
* Basic understanding of vulnerability management and security remediation processes.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, system integrations, authentication mechanisms, and secure application connectivity.
* Experience with scripting or automation using one or more of the following:


 Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, C\#, SQL, Similar technologies
   

  

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.

title: Lead Fabric Data engineer
description:
**Job Summary**  

  



We are looking for an experienced Lead Fabric Data Engineer to design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric for our Industrial Gas project.


The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on expertise in Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Factory, Data Warehouse, Spark/PySpark, SQL, and Power BI. You will be responsible for building robust data pipelines, implementing Medallion Architecture, optimizing data processing workloads, and ensuring high\-quality, secure, and reliable data solutions.


You will work closely with architects, business stakeholders, data engineers, and analytics teams to deliver enterprise\-grade data platforms and analytics solutions.


**Roles \& Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric and OneLake.
* Build and maintain end\-to\-end data pipelines using Fabric Data Factory, Pipelines, and Dataflows Gen2\.
* Develop data ingestion and transformation processes across structured and semi\-structured data sources.
* Implement Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold) using Fabric Lakehouse.
* Develop and optimize PySpark/Spark notebooks for large\-scale data processing and transformation.
* Design and implement data models and curated datasets for analytics and reporting.
* Develop solutions using Fabric Data Warehouse and T\-SQL for analytical workloads.
* Work with Delta Lake and optimize storage, partitioning, and data processing strategies.
* Implement incremental data loads, slowly changing dimensions, data quality checks, and error\-handling frameworks.
* Integrate data from multiple sources including Azure, SQL Server, APIs, files, and legacy data platforms.
* Optimize pipeline performance, Spark workloads, SQL queries, and Fabric capacity utilization.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, Git integration, and deployment processes for Fabric artifacts.
* Work with Azure DevOps/GitHub to manage source code, releases, and development workflows.
* Implement appropriate data security, access controls, and workspace\-level governance.
* Collaborate with Power BI developers and analytics teams to provide optimized datasets and Semantic Models.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and ensure timely resolution.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical design sessions, and solution walkthroughs.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level data engineers and promote data engineering best practices.
* Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, reliability, security, and data quality standards.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**


* 6–8 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Development, or related data technology roles.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or strong experience in Azure data platforms with practical Fabric implementation experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and OneLake.
* Expertise in Fabric Data Factory, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse, and Data Warehouse.
* Strong experience with PySpark/Spark and Python for large\-scale data processing.
* Strong proficiency in SQL/T\-SQL and experience developing complex queries and transformations.
* Good understanding of Delta Lake and Medallion Architecture.
* Experience implementing Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers.
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT development and data integration patterns.
* Experience working with structured and semi\-structured data sources.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure Data Factory and/or Azure Synapse Analytics is preferred.
* Experience with Power BI and Semantic Models is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of Direct Lake and Fabric performance optimization is preferred.
* Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, and Fabric deployment pipelines.
* Good understanding of data security, access controls, data governance, and workspace management.
* Experience with data quality, monitoring, logging, and production support.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as lead and mentor technical team members.

What You Will Do


As a Lead Fabric Data Engineer, you will play a key role in building and modernizing enterprise data platforms using Microsoft Fabric. You will work on challenging data engineering problems, develop scalable cloud data solutions, and contribute to the successful delivery of modern analytics capabilities for our clients.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

description:

We are looking for an accomplished Lead Data Strategy Architect – Microsoft Fabric Specialist to lead enterprise\-wide data transformation initiatives for our Industrial Gas project.


In this role, you will bridge business strategy and technology execution by designing scalable, secure, and governed data platforms using Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Real\-Time Intelligence, and Power BI.


You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, data engineers, and analytics teams to define data strategies, modernize legacy platforms, establish governance standards, and deliver high\-impact analytics solutions.


**Roles \& Responsibilities**


* Lead the data strategy, enterprise architecture, and roadmap for Microsoft Fabric implementations.
* Design scalable data platforms using Microsoft Fabric and OneLake.
* Define and implement Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and enterprise data modeling standards.
* Establish domain\-driven data ownership and governance aligned with Data Mesh principles.
* Assess legacy data platforms such as Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, and SQL Server and define migration strategies to Microsoft Fabric.
* Lead the implementation of Fabric workloads including Data Factory, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Spark/PySpark, Real\-Time Intelligence, KQL, and Power BI.
* Define performance optimization strategies for Direct Lake Semantic Models, DAX, Spark workloads, and Fabric capacity.
* Establish CI/CD, Git integration, Azure DevOps, and deployment pipelines for Fabric solutions.
* Define and implement enterprise data governance and security frameworks using Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Fabric.
* Drive implementation of RLS, CLS, access controls, data lineage, DLP, encryption, and workspace governance.
* Monitor and optimize Fabric capacity, compute consumption, and platform costs.
* Act as a strategic advisor to senior business and client stakeholders, translating business requirements into scalable data and analytics solutions.
* Lead and mentor cross\-functional teams comprising Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, BI Developers, and Architects.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the data engineering lifecycle.
* Ensure successful delivery of multi\-phase enterprise data transformation initiatives within agreed timelines and quality standards.

**Required Skills :**


* 10–14 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Solution Architecture, or Enterprise Data Strategy.
* 1\.5–2\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and implementing Microsoft Fabric solutions.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Fabric and OneLake.
* Hands\-on experience with Fabric Data Factory, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Synapse Data Engineering, Spark/PySpark, Real\-Time Intelligence, KQL, and Power BI.
* Strong knowledge of Lakehouse, Medallion Architecture, Kimball dimensional modeling, and Data Mesh concepts.
* Expertise in Python/PySpark, SQL/T\-SQL, DAX, Power Query/M, and PowerShell/CLI.
* Strong experience with Power BI, Semantic Models, Direct Lake, and DAX optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git/GitHub, CI/CD, Fabric deployment pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Experience with Microsoft Purview, data governance, security, lineage, RLS/CLS, and DLP.
* Proven experience leading technical teams and enterprise\-scale data transformation programs.
* Strong client\-facing, stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in Industrial Gas, Manufacturing, Energy, Utilities, or related industrial domains will be an added advantage.
* Relevant Microsoft Fabric, Azure, or Power BI certifications will be preferred.

You will play a key role in shaping and delivering modern enterprise data solutions, helping organizations unlock the value of their data through Microsoft Fabric, cloud modernization, data governance, and advanced analytics.

**Description**


Do you want to build a career that is truly worthwhile? Working at the World Bank Group provides a unique opportunity for you to help our clients solve their greatest development challenges. The World Bank Group is one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries; a unique global partnership of five institutions dedicated to ending extreme poverty, increasing shared prosperity and promoting sustainable development. With 189 member countries and more than 130 offices worldwide, we work with public and private sector partners, investing in groundbreaking projects and using data, research, and technology to develop solutions to the most urgent global challenges. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org **ITS Vice Presidency Context**  

The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150\+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload\=9\&v\=VTFGffa1Y7w


**Unit Context**  

The ITS Financial Technology (ITSFT) unit enables critical Finance and Accounting functions through enterprise platforms supporting financial management, accounting, budgeting, reporting, analytics, external reporting, trust fund management, lending operations, and institutional performance management.
The unit manages and modernizes enterprise data and analytics platforms including SAP BW, SAP Business Objects, Azure\-based data platforms, and reporting solutions while supporting strategic initiatives related to data modernization, cloud adoption, operational reporting, compliance, and financial transparency. **Duties and Accountabilities** **Role Purpose**  

The Platform Engineer (SAP BW \& Data Platform) is responsible for the engineering, administration, modernization, and operational excellence of the World Bank Group's enterprise analytics and data platforms.  

The role supports SAP BW on HANA, Business Objects, SAP data integration technologies, Azure\-based data platforms, and enterprise reporting solutions. The Platform Engineer collaborates with product owners, architects, data engineers, business stakeholders, and infrastructure teams to ensure platform reliability, performance, scalability, security, governance, and continuous improvement.  

The position contributes to the evolution of enterprise analytics capabilities through automation, modernization initiatives, cloud adoption, DevOps practices, observability, and platform engineering principles, enabling trusted and timely business insights across financial and operational domains. **Key Responsibilities** **SAP BW Platform Engineering*** Administer, maintain, and optimize SAP BW on HANA environments.
* Manage platform upgrades, patches, transport, performance tuning, and capacity planning.
* Support business\-critical financial and operational reporting processes.
* Ensure platform availability, resiliency, scalability, and operational stability.
* Support BW upgrade, modernization and migration initiatives, including cloud and next\-generation analytics platforms.


 • Perform professional\-level analysis and platform engineering activities across data and analytics platforms.

* Solve moderately complex platforms, integration, performance, and operational challenges.
* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to define solutions and drive continuous improvement.
* Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing within the platform engineering and analytics delivery teams.
* Apply practical expertise across data platforms, analytics architecture, cloud technologies, integration, security, and operational support.

**Integration \& Data Operations*** Manage SAP BW, SAP ECC, SAP BODS, and related enterprise data integrations.
* Support incident response, root cause analysis, and issue remediation activities.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream application teams to ensure reliable data movement and processing.
* Monitor platform health, data loads, and integration performance.

**Analytics \& Reporting Platforms*** Support Business Objects, Power BI, Bex, Analysis for Office and enterprise reporting solutions.
* Ensure reporting platform performance, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Partner with business stakeholders to enable trusted, timely, and scalable reporting capabilities.

 **Security, Risk \& Compliance*** Ensure compliance with World Bank security, audit, data governance, and operational risk requirements.
* Support security reviews, vulnerability remediation, and platform hardening activities.
* Participate in audit response and compliance remediation efforts.
* Maintain appropriate controls for access management, data protection, and system integrity.

**Agile Delivery \& Collaboration*** Participate in SAFe Agile ceremonies including PI Planning, Iteration Planning, Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Scrum Masters, and Engineering teams to prioritize platform improvements.
* Contribute to backlog refinement and technical roadmap planning.
* Support continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.

**Selection Criteria**

**Education \& Experience*** Master's degree with 5 years of relevant experience or Bachelor's degree with at least 8 years of relevant experience in enterprise data platforms, SAP BW, data engineering, analytics platforms, or related disciplines.
* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale analytics, reporting, and data platforms.
* Experience with SAP BW on HANA administration, development support, and platform operations.
* Experience with enterprise data integration, analytics modernization, and cloud data platform technologies.

**Core Skills and Capabilities**

title: Development Manager
description:
About Kanerika
 




**Who we are:**




 Kanerika Inc. is a premier global software products and services firm specializing in providing innovative solutions and services for data\-driven enterprises. We help businesses achieve digital transformation and maximize impact through data and AI, leveraging advanced technologies in analytics, governance, AI/ML, and GenAI/LLM to optimize operations, enhance customer experience, and drive growth.
 



  






 Awards and Recognitions:
 




 Kanerika has won several awards over the years, including:
 


1. Best Place to Work 2023 by Great Place to Work®
2. Top10 Most Recommended RPA Start\-Ups in 2022 by RPA Today
3. CMMI Level 3 Appraised in 2024
4. Frost \& Sullivan India 2021 Technology Innovation Award for its Kompass composable solution architecture
5. Kanerika has also been recognized for its commitment to customer privacy and data security, having achieved ISO 27701, ISO 9001, SOC2, and GDPR compliances.



  





**Locations:**




 We are located in Austin (USA), Singapore, Hyderabad, Indore and Ahmedabad (India).
 



**Job Location:
 
 Hyderabad, Indore and Ahmedabad.** 




**Department:
 
 Product Development** 




**Employment Type:
 
 Full\-Time** 




**Experience Required:
 
 6 – 8 Years** 




**Reporting To:
 
 Product Leader** 




  





**Role
 
 :** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on and technically sharp Development Manager to lead the engineering of FLIP's BI Migration Plugins within the Product Development team. You will be joining a team of highly competent, high\-energy engineers who take strong ownership of what they build — we are looking for someone who matches that drive and raises the bar further.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of product engineering and delivery— you will own the end\-to\-end development lifecycle of BI migration plugins, working closely with the Product Leader to drive the roadmap from conception to production. You will both build new migration capabilities from scratch on the FLIP platform and enhance the existing suite of plugins that power migrations from tools like Cognos, SSRS, Crystal Reports, and Tableau to Power BI.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  





**Plugin Development \& Engineering** 



* Architect, design, and build new BI migration plugins on the FLIP platform from the ground up, covering source analysis, metadata extraction, logic conversion, and target generation.
* Enhance and extend existing FLIP plugins for migrations including Cognos → Power BI, SSRS → Power BI, Crystal Reports → Power BI, Tableau → Power BI, and other BI migration paths.
* Own end\-to\-end development: from requirement analysis and design through coding, testing, deployment, and post\-release maintenance.
* Ensure plugins handle complex scenarios such as VB.NET/DAX expression conversion, visual mapping, parameterized reports, paginated report generation, and data model transformation.



  





**Technical Leadership** 



* Work alongside a team of highly competent, high\-energy engineers on FLIP plugin modules — conduct code reviews, set engineering standards, and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.
* Collaborate closely with the Product Leader to translate product roadmap requirements into detailed technical specifications and delivery plans.
* Drive architectural decisions around plugin framework design, scalability, extensibility, and quality.
* Define and enforce engineering best practices, coding standards, and automated testing strategies for the plugin development lifecycle.



  





**Delivery \& Collaboration** 



* Manage sprint planning, task estimation, and delivery milestones for plugin development cycles.
* Working close coordination with migration consultants and QA engineers to ensure plugin output achieves functional equivalence and data integrity between source and target platforms.
* Proactively identify and resolve technical blockers, bottlenecks, and risks across the development pipeline.
* Contribute to documentation of plugin architecture, migration logic, and technical runbooks.



  





**Continuous Improvement** 



* Analyze client migration feedback and production issues to drive iterative improvement of existing plugins.
* Evaluate emerging BI tools and platform APIs to identify new migration accelerator opportunities.
* Contribute ideas and POCs to expand FLIP's migration coverage and automation depth.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**




**Experience** 



* 6–8 years of total experience in software/product development, with at least 2 years in a technical lead or engineering management role.
* Proven experience in building or working on BI/data migration tools, platforms, or accelerators.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more source BI platforms: IBM Cognos, SSRS, Crystal Reports, Tableau, MicroStrategy, or similar.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Power BI — familiarity with Power BI data models, DAX, Power BI Service, paginated reports, and Power BI Report Builder is an advantage.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Strong proficiency in Python and/or Java for backend plugin development; good working knowledge of the Spring Boot framework and Angular is required.
* Experience with XML/JSON parsing, metadata extraction, AST processing, or code\-to\-code transformation techniques.
* Familiarity with low\-code/no\-code platform development or plugin/extension framework design.
* Exposure to REST API integration and cloud platforms (Azure preferred); good understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices including version control, automated testing, containerisation, and release management.
* Comfortable working with SQL, data modeling concepts, and schema conversion techniques.



  





**Leadership \& Interpersonal Skills** 



* Ability to coordinate and work effectively with a team of engineers — comfortable guiding peers and facilitating technical discussions.
* Excellent communication skills — able to interface clearly with the Product Leader and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with the ability to break down complex technical challenges into actionable development tasks.
* Detail\-oriented and quality\-driven, with a strong sense of ownership over product outcomes.



  





**Good to Have:**



* Prior experience building SaaS products or platform plugins in a product company.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric — including Fabric workloads, pipelines, and data platform capabilities — is a plus.
* Knowledge of RPA platforms such as UiPath or Microsoft Power Automate.
* Experience with Informatica, Alteryx, SSIS, or other ETL tools.
* Exposure to LLM/AI\-assisted code conversion or metadata intelligence use cases.



  





**What You Will Work On at Kanerika:**




 Your core focus will be building and improving FLIP's BI Migration Plugin suite. You will work across multiple migration paths — such as Cognos, SSRS, Crystal Reports, and Tableau to Power BI — developing the plugin logic that handles metadata extraction, expression conversion, visual mapping, and report generation. You will also take on new migration paths as the product roadmap evolves, contributing directly to the platform's growing coverage and automation depth.
 



  





**Why Join Kanerika:**



* Work on a high\-impact, proprietary product platform (FLIP) that is transforming enterprise data modernization.
* Be part of a fast\-growing, Microsoft Solutions Partner firm with a strong focus on innovation and delivery excellence.
* Opportunity to build and lead an engineering team in a domain\-critical vertical — BI migration is at the heart of Kanerika's growth trajectory.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge AI, automation, and cloud\-native data platform technologies.



  





**Employee Benefits:**




 1\. Culture:
 



 i. Open Door Policy: Encourages open communication and accessibility to management.
 



 ii. Open Office Floor Plan: Fosters a collaborative and interactive work environment.
 



 iii. Flexible Working Hours: Allows employees to have flexibility in their work schedules.
 



 iv. Employee Referral Bonus: Rewards employees for referring qualified candidates.

Serving within the Global Verticals Marketing team, you will act as the primary point of contact for querying, analysing, and synthesizing FedEx internal transactional and customer data. Your mission is to convert complex datasets into clear, actionable vertical performance narratives that guide business planning.
   

  

 In this role, you will build executive\-ready reports, conduct ad\-hoc analyses, and provide data\-driven insights that directly support marketing, commercial strategy, and forecasting functions. Your work will directly influence how senior leadership understands vertical health, product performance, and regional business dynamics.
   

  

**Grade : T5**
**"Please note that the Job will close at 12am on Posting Close date, so please submit your application prior to the Close Date"**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Vertical Performance
   

  

* Write, optimize, and execute complex SQL queries against FedEx enterprise data warehouses to extract performance metrics across priority industry verticals (e.g., E\-commerce, Healthcare, Aerospace, Technology).
* Monitor and analyse key commercial indicators, including volume, revenue, and yield, with a specific focus on identifying regional / lane / product level insights.
* Investigate regional and product\-level performance variations, isolating root causes of growth or decline and translating findings into structured data briefs.
* Build, maintain, and automate interactive performance dashboards and scorecards to track commercial performance, vertical health, and pipeline health.


 Executive \& Leadership Reporting
   

  

* Synthesize complex performance datasets into high\-impact, visual, and narrative\-driven reports for leadership and executive\-level business updates (e.g., CEO updates and strategic reviews).
* Translate analytical findings into concise executive takeaways, ensuring executive communications clearly explain the past performance, present status, and future outlook.
* Deliver regular monthly and quarterly performance updates, highlighting competitive risks, commercial opportunities, and customer journey trends.


 Strategic \& Forecasting Support
   

  

* Partner with forecasting, strategy, finance, and marketing functions to model commercial funnels, market demand shifts, and historical volume trends.
* Apply statistical techniques and behavioural segmentation models to track, isolate, and forecast changes in specific customer cohorts and industry verticals.
* Conduct rapid\-response, ad\-hoc deep dives to answer critical, time\-sensitive business questions posed by leadership.
* Provide data backing and baseline historical trends to support annual commercial strategic planning and commercial goal setting.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

 Experience \& Background
   

  

* 6\-10 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, sales analytics, or financial/commercial measurement roles.
* Proven experience querying large\-scale, complex relational databases to extract commercial, transactional, and customer\-level insights.
* Demonstrated track record of preparing executive\-calibre presentations, briefs, and reports based on complex data analysis.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional, global stakeholders across various time zones.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Executive Storytelling \& Visualization: The ability to translate numbers into a cohesive, executive\-ready story that leaders can grasp and act on instantly.

 robustly identify patterns, validate data anomalies, and extract high\-integrity insights from raw corporate data.
   

  

* Analytical Rigor \& Structured Problem Solving: High attention to data accuracy, methodological soundness, and the ability to formulate logical business hypotheses.
* Agility \& Proactiveness: Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, managing competing priorities, and delivering quick\-turnaround ad\-hoc analyses.


**Professional Expertise \& Technical Skills**
* Analytics \& BI: High proficiency in SQL (required) and experience working with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Teradata, or BigQuery).
* Applied Business Statistics: Practical knowledge of statistical methods to perform cohort analysis, customer segmentation, and behavioural pattern recognition to discover performance anomalies.
* Business AI \& Machine Learning Application: Understanding of how to leverage predictive models, clustering algorithms (e.g., for cohort refinement), and NLP/text mining to automate industry vertical tracking, spot micro\-trends, and optimize customer group definitions.
* Data Visualization: Proficiency in building dashboards in Power BI or similar BI tools

 Sector Familiarity: Prior experience analysing commercial performance within B2B verticals (e.g., Retail/E\-commerce, Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Industrial, Technology) is highly valued.
   

  

* Exposure to CRM/sales enablement tools (e.g., Salesforce)

 Our Culture

title: Storefront and eCommerce
description:
* About the role  

  

As our Storefront and CRO Manager, you will be the centre of expertise for everything that happens on our storefronts. You will own and drive the storefront experience for Crazy Domains, Vodien and BigRock, and support the wider Digipac group of brands.  

  

Our brands sit across a mix of platforms including WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager and our own in\-house stack, with control panels managed separately. A significant part of this role is bringing a coherent roadmap, one standard of experience and one testing discipline across all of them, while respecting where each brand needs to be different.  

  

You will be accountable for the storefront roadmap and for the commercial outcomes that come with it, with a focus on conversion rate, cross sell, and the overall quality of the customer experience. You will work with marketing, design, engineering, analytics and brand teams to make sure everything that ships is consistent with our wider eCommerce and marketing strategy.  

  

This role offers a largely remote working experience with flexible working hours and the opportunity to work with teams across the globe.
* Job Description**What you will own**


Targets are agreed by brand at the start of each financial year with the eCommerce and brand leads. Baselines are set in your first quarter.

**Revenue and conversion**


	+ **Storefront conversion rate.** Improve visit to cart and cart to purchase across priority funnels for each brand.
	+ **Cross sell and attach rate.** Grow attach of adjacent products at cart, checkout and in the control panel, measured by attach rate and revenue per visit.
	+ **Average order value and revenue per session.** Own the onsite levers that move both, including merchandising, pricing presentation, bundling and upgrade paths.**Experience and performance**


	+ **Site performance.** Page load and Core Web Vitals on key templates, with particular attention to mobile.
	+ **Experience quality.** Reduction in onsite defects reaching production, faster time to resolution on storefront bugs, improved task success and friction scores from behavioral and qualitative research.
	+ **Consistency across brands.** A shared component and experience standard applied across the portfolio, so that a fix or a win on one brand can be reused rather than rebuilt.**Delivery and process**


	+ **Experimentation velocity.** An agreed number of tests live per quarter, each with a documented hypothesis, a clean readout and a decision logged, whether the test wins or loses.
	+ **Roadmap delivery.** Percentage of committed roadmap delivered in the quarter, and cycle time from PRD to live.
	+ **Delivery against Strategi Project.** Own and deliver platform support where applicable for strategic global projects such as brand migrations and consolidations **A day in the life of our Storefront and Conversion Manager**

**Core deliverables**


	+ Build, maintain and track the storefront and control panel roadmap across Crazy Domains, Vodien, BigRock and the Digipac brands, keeping it continuously aligned with business strategy and with the commercial priorities of each brand.
	+ Manage the execution of storefront and customer panel driven marketing, UX and product initiatives from idea through to live.
	+ Run a continuous onsite testing program, using tools like Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and other forms of customer insight, and turn what you learn into a prioritized backlog rather than a folder of results.
	+ Create PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and build wireframes and high level mockups in Figma alongside our Design team to define desired outcomes.
	+ Make and manage day to day content, layout and campaign updates on our WordPress properties, and scope and brief larger changes to engineering for our AEM and in\-house stacks.
	+ Lead storefront redesign and rebranding work as it comes up, covering page templates, navigation, product and pricing pages, cart and checkout.
	+ Worl closely with storefront QA and pre release teams, so that what goes live matches what was specified and does not quietly break something else.
	+ Actively participate in and represent marketing in weekly project grooming, sprint planning and release readiness in Jira.
	+ Continuously measure and report key storefront metrics including conversion rate, click and engagement metrics, funnel drop off and load time.**Stakeholder management**


	+ Proactively manage all relevant stakeholders including senior management, building consensus and commitment to project outcomes.
	+ Work with brand and marketing leads across the portfolio to sequence competing requests into a single roadmap, and be comfortable explaining why something is not being built this quarter.
	+ Work collaboratively with cross functional stakeholders and in close conjunction with design and engineering teams to align on roadmaps and deliverables across all three stacks.
	+ Engage and cultivate relationships with partners across the business, gain insight and adopt best practices.
	+ Partner closely with Analytics and BI teams to evolve our understanding of performance across eCommerce.
	+ Collaborate with marketing, sales and support teams on go to market planning for products and campaigns.
	+ Close the loop with customer support and care teams, using what they hear every day as a source of onsite improvements.**Data and analysis**


	+ Monitor, report and find ways to improve platform performance across brands and funnel steps.
	+ Work with the BI team to build visibility for key platform metrics, including dashboards that let brand teams self serve.
	+ Investigate anomalies and conversion drops quickly, and separate a tracking problem from a real experience problem.
	+ Analyze data from internal and external sources to develop strategies and define platform objectives.
	+ Leverage data and insight to continually optimize and maximize the value of our platform and processes.
	+ Benchmark our storefronts against competitors and against good practice outside our category.
* Additional Job Description**What you will need to succeed**


	+ Five or more years in eCommerce, conversion rate optimization, digital product or web experience roles, ideally across multiple brands or markets.
	+ A demonstrable track record of moving conversion rate, attach rate or average order value, with the ability to talk through how you did it and what you learned when it did not work.
	+ A keen eye for good design and a strong understanding of user experience.
	+ A customer first mindset and the ability to apply design thinking principles.
	+ Data driven, but able to make a judgement call when the data is thin or the sample is small.
	+ Strong working knowledge of tracking customer journeys, event and tag setup, and the ability to analyze and act on what you see.
	+ Hands on experience with Figma and Jira. Both are everyday tools in this role, not occasional ones.
	+ Comfortable working directly in AEM/WordPress (or have the willingness to learn this). You should be able to make and QA basic content, layout and template updates yourself without waiting in a development queue. Experience with Adobe Experience Manager or a similar enterprise CMS is a strong advantage.
	+ A working understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Enough to read a page, spot what is wrong, estimate effort and hold a credible conversation with engineers. You will not be asked to ship production code.
	+ Experience with analytics and experimentation tooling such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and similar.
	+ Strong communication, organizational and analytical skills.
	+ Attention to detail, comfort with multitasking, and a customer service focus.
	+ Independent thinking, and not being afraid to suggest new ideas.
	+ Experience working in an agile organization or with cross functional teams.
	+ Ability to build collaborative relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders.
	+ Driven by delivery, delivering on time and to a high standard.**Nice to have**


	+ Experience in domains, hosting, SaaS or subscription businesses.
	+ Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and how onsite changes affect organic performance.
	+ Exposure to Adobe Analytics or Adobe Target.
	+ Working knowledge of accessibility standards and page speed optimization.
	+ Experience working across multiple time zones and distributed teams. **What success looks like**

**First 90 days.** You know our stacks, our funnels and our numbers. You have audited the storefronts across brands, established a clean baseline for conversion, attach and performance, and shipped a first set of quick wins.

**First six months.** A prioritized storefront roadmap is agreed with brand and engineering leads, a regular testing cadence is running, and reporting is in place that everyone trusts and uses.

**First twelve months.** Measurable improvement against your conversion, attach and performance targets, a shared experience standard applied across brands, and a healthy backlog of tested, evidenced ideas ready for the following year.

**Why you'll love us.**


	+ **We've evolved**; we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work\-from\- home, hybrid, or work\-from\-the\-office environment.
	+ **Work\-life balance**. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
	+ **We celebrate one another’s differences**. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 \+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
	+ **We care about you**. At Newfold, taking care of our employees is our top priority. we make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place to for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi\-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
	+ **Where can we take you?** We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with \#teamnewfold

title: Associate, Workflow Modelling and Orchestration - Parametric
description:
ABOUT MORGAN STANLEY
  

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.
  

  

ABOUT PARAMETRIC
  

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what is important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi\-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
  

  

This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
  

  

ABOUT THE TEAM
  

The Automation, Reinvention and Collaboration (ARC) team is part of Parametric Operations. The Workflow Modelling and Orchestration team designs, builds, tests, and delivers enterprise operational workflows through Workflow Center, Parametric's Camunda\-based workflow platform.
  

  

ABOUT THE ROLE
  

Parametric is seeking an Associate to join the Workflow Modelling and Orchestration team to support the design, build, testing, and delivery of enterprise operational workflows through Workflow Center, Parametric's Camunda\-based workflow platform.
  

  

The role is a hands\-on workflow practitioner who translates complex operational processes into clear requirements and executable workflows. Working with Operations, Product, Technology, Risk and platform teams, the role supports the full workflow lifecycle from discovery and BPMN/DMN modelling through testing, deployment readiness and production support. The role requires practical process analysis, attention to controls and exceptions, and a willingness to develop deeper Camunda expertise.
  

  

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES


* Discover and define workflows: Lead or support discovery sessions; document business objectives, triggers, actors, systems, data, controls, handoffs, SLAs, decisions and exception scenarios; translate incomplete processes into structured, testable requirements.
* Model executable processes: Design end\-to\-end BPMN 2\.0 workflows and DMN decision logic, including user and service tasks, events, gateways, subprocesses, approvals, escalations, retries, rework and manual\-intervention paths.
* Configure Workflow Center solutions: Configure models, forms, variables, business rules, task assignments and approved platform components; partner with engineers to define service interactions, APIs, data mappings and integration dependencies.
* Support end\-to\-end delivery: Contribute from intake and design through functional testing, UAT, deployment readiness, hypercare and production analysis; prepare test scenarios, investigate defects and maintain delivery and operating documentation.
* Embed controls and operational resilience: Model maker\-checker controls, evidence requirements, rejection and resubmission, attestations, auditability and exception handling; escalate unclear requirements, conflicting rules and unresolved risks.
* Collaborate and communicate: Facilitate workshops and model walkthroughs; explain workflow behaviour in business language; provide concise updates on progress, decisions, dependencies, risks and defects.
* Apply standards and promote reuse: Follow BPMN, DMN, documentation, testing, naming and review standards; use and improve reusable patterns, templates, checklists and playbooks.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related area of study.
* 4\+ years of professional experience in workflow modelling, business process management, process automation, business analysis, operations transformation or a related discipline.
* Hands\-on experience creating executable BPMN 2\.0 models, with a sound understanding of events, tasks, gateways, subprocesses, messages, timers, boundary events and exception paths.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate complex or incomplete operational processes into structured models, decision logic and clear documentation.
* Understanding operational controls, approvals, handoffs, task assignment, SLAs, auditability and exception management.
* Experience preparing test scenarios, documenting defects and supporting functional testing or UAT.
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills; ability to manage assigned work, raise risks early and collaborate with business and technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications


* Hands\-on experience with Camunda 8, Camunda Modeler or another executable workflow platform, including BPMN, DMN, forms, variables or connectors.
* Familiarity with FEEL, REST APIs, JSON, events, messaging, SQL or enterprise\-system integrations.
* Experience with Jira and Confluence and with reviewing workflow instances, variables, incidents, logs or execution paths.
* Financial\-services or other regulated\-industry experience; exposure to onboarding, oversight, reconciliation, approvals, investment operations or exception management.
* BPMN, Camunda, business analysis or process\-management training or certification

Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our business.


**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.


To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.


Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.


Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.


For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo .

* Build the quality layer that catches silent failure: contracts at every handoff, freshness and completeness monitoring, and pipelines that quarantine bad data rather than publish it.
* Improve entity matching and attribution — and make match decisions explainable to the customers who depend on them.
* Make our release cycle boring. Recurring deliveries should not depend on people watching them.
* Treat compute cost as a first\-class engineering metric across Spark, orchestration, and the serving tier.



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 15\+ years building production grade data engineering systems, with a minimum of 5 years in a staff or principal scope.
* Deep Spark and Databricks expertise at multi\-terabyte scale, including the operational side of lakehouse table formats — merges, compaction, small files, schema evolution.
* Strong SQL and dimensional modelling, and the judgment to know when to break the rules.
* Experience with performant and scalable OLTP setups (MySQL/Postgres).
* Airflow orchestration (DAGs, operators, sensors) and integration with Spark/Databricks
 *.*
* Proven experience in AWS ecosystems (EC2, S3, EMR).
* Hands\-on entity resolution, fuzzy matching, or record linkage at scale. This is central to what we do.
* Python/Scala/Java, with real software discipline: testing, CI/CD, code review, infrastructure as code is a plus.
* Experience in Docker \- Kubernetes, Terraform is a plus.
* Experience in integrating AI first implementations in traditional data engineering setups will greatly help in shaping our future designs.
* Experience with machine learning pipelines (Spark MLlib, Databricks ML) for predictive analytics.
* Knowledge of data governance frameworks and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA).



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 Helpful, not required: B2B firmographic, technographic or intent data; streaming and CDC; warehouse\-to\-lakehouse migration experience.

The role ensures the platform is scalable, secure, and cost\-effective, while supporting critical capabilities such as asset and telemetry processing, data quality, lineage, and integration with machine learning services.
   

  

 This position is accountable for improving platform reliability, performance and transparency through strong engineering practices, automation, and observability, and for enforcing governance through clear data standards, access controls, and lifecycle management.  Translate platform strategy into quarterly technical objectives, capacity plans, and measurable engineering outcomes.

 Design and operate the enterprise data storage using Amazon S3 and Apache Iceberg.
   

  

 Implement and mature Bronze–Silver–Gold (Medallion) architecture for structured, governed data processing.

 Implement data quality, validation, lineage, and observability controls across pipelines.
   

  

 Design for resilience through robust error handling, reprocessing, and backfill mechanisms.
   

  

 Establish and maintain automated unit testing for data transformations, schemas, and business logic.
   

  

 Support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

 Monitor and continuously improve platform throughput, latency, and unit economics (e.g., cost per GB, cost per pipeline).

description:
### **Description**

  

The Senior Associate \- Front End Engineering is a hands\-on front\-end engineering role, equivalent in scope and expectations to a UK Intermediate Engineer. The role is responsible for building high\-quality user\-facing software solutions across the Consulting \& Technology estate.
  

The role provides strong squad\-level technical contribution across the React ecosystem, including TypeScript, component architecture, state management, automated front\-end testing, accessibility, performance, and integration with modern API\-driven services.
Working closely with architects, lead engineers, and senior engineers, the role helps translate technical direction into maintainable implementation, follows agreed engineering standards, and contributes to delivery quality through sound engineering practice.
This role is ideal for an experienced front\-end engineer who can operate independently on well\-defined work, contribute to technical discussions, support good engineering discipline, and deliver robust web applications in Agile engineering squads.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

***Front End Design \& Development**** Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality React and TypeScript applications aligned to agreed architecture and squad delivery priorities.
* Build reusable components, shared UI patterns, and design\-system\-aligned experiences that support consistency and maintainability.
* Contribute to client\-side implementation decisions including routing, state management, data fetching, forms, validation, error handling, and API integration.
* Write clean, maintainable, secure front\-end code following modern React patterns and agreed engineering standards.
* Work with UX/UI colleagues and Product Owners to deliver responsive, accessible, intuitive user experiences.

***Engineering Quality, Testing \& DevOps**** Create and maintain automated tests across unit, component, integration, and end\-to\-end layers using tools such as Jest / Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for front\-end applications, including build quality gates, test automation, static analysis, and deployment readiness.
* Support front\-end performance optimisation, observability, resilience, and maintainability across browser\-based applications.
* Apply secure coding practices across authentication flows, authorisation boundaries, API consumption, data handling, and dependency management.

***Technical Contribution \& Collaboration**** Operate as an experienced engineer within the squad, demonstrating good engineering discipline, ownership, and pragmatic problem\-solving.
* Participate in code reviews, pairing, design discussions, and constructive technical feedback with peers and junior developers.
* Contribute to shared front\-end standards, templates, component patterns, and engineering practices.
* Support onboarding activities where front\-end engineering input is required.

***Problem Solving \& Support**** Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve front\-end issues affecting delivery, quality, performance, or production stability.
* Work with Architects, Lead Engineers, Backend Engineers, QA, and Platform Engineers to resolve cross\-cutting technical problems.
* Contribute to improvements in shared front\-end libraries, frameworks, and platform components where required.

***Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement**** Work closely with Architects, Product Owners, Platform Engineers, Backend Engineers, and QA teams to ensure technical solutions meet business and user needs.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, contributing to planning, refinement, retrospectives, technical discovery, and continuous improvement.

***Continuous Improvement \& Innovation**** Identify practical opportunities to improve developer experience, front\-end quality, accessibility, performance, and delivery effectiveness.
* Keep up to date with relevant React, TypeScript, testing, and web platform developments.
* Contribute to continuous learning and engineering improvement across the squad and wider engineering community.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 ***Mandatory:**** 4\-5 SW experience and 3\-4 years AI/ML experience years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent capability demonstrated through delivery experience.
* Strong relevant experience delivering modern React and TypeScript applications in commercial or enterprise environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

***Knowledge, Skill and Ability:**** React ecosystem including hooks, component composition, routing, forms, and modern application architecture.
* TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and front\-end build tooling such as Vite or Webpack.
* State management and data\-fetching patterns such as Redux, Zustand, TanStack Query, or equivalent approaches.
* REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, authentication and authorisation flows, and secure client\-side integration patterns.
* Automated test tooling such as Jest / Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or equivalent.
* Accessibility standards such as WCAG, semantic HTML, browser compatibility, and front\-end performance optimisation.
* CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling, dependency management, and quality gates.

***Esential requirement (Non\- Negotiable)**** Strong hands\-on proficiency in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Experience implementing maintainable front\-end application structures, reusable components, and consistent UI patterns.
* Experience integrating front\-end applications with REST APIs and secure authentication/authorisation patterns.
* Good automated testing capability across unit, component, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, code quality tooling, and modern DevOps practices.
* Good understanding of accessibility, browser performance, responsive design, and user\-centred engineering.
* Secure coding practices and familiarity with OWASP principles.

***Nice to Have**** C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs
* SQL Server

description:

 This role is the
 **primary commercial support to the Area Business Manager (ABM)** 
 and acts as the

 . It
 **enables** 
 the ABM by ensuring the
 **Area has high‑quality, consolidated, and decision‑ready commercial intelligence** 
 .
   

  

 It works closely with Zonal Business Managers to

 and

 which are then
 **synthesized into area\-level insights**

* Area‑Level Sales Planning \& Consolidation (Primary Responsibility)

* Track GTN utilization at Zonal and Area level.
* Provide ABM with decision\-ready GTN insights, including value leakage, utilization efficiency, and execution risks.

* Present area\-wide drivers of performance, gaps, and recommended interventions to ABM.

+ Zonal productivity and coverage patterns
+ Portfolio mix shifts at area level
+ GTN effectiveness and return

* Influences through clarity, structure, and data, not through authority.
* Brings calm, disciplined execution to complex, multi\-zone challenges.
* Maintains strong working relationships with ZBMs while ensuring the Area’s needs are met.
* Bias for closure, action, and follow\-through.

* Strong experience in aggregation, consolidation, and area‑level reporting or planning.
* Hands\-on experience in sales planning, forecasting, GTN, and commercial governance.
* High analytical capability; ability to turn complex zonal data into simplified, decision\-ready area narratives.
* Prior experience in Agri\-inputs, Crop Protection, Seeds, FMCG, or similar complex GTM environments preferred.

**In India** 
 \- Mumbai
   

  

**What Makes Us Special**
 At Simon\-Kucher, you’ll be part of a unique entrepreneurial team where you’re encouraged to think independently, bring your ideas to the table, and take ownership from day one.
   

  

* Work on what matters. Take on challenging, high\-impact projects that address our clients’ most important growth questions and deliver meaningful, tangible results.
* Grow with us. Build your career in a thriving company with an entrepreneurial spirit, supported by extensive training, continuous feedback, and development opportunities at every stage.
* Have a voice. Bring your perspective and ideas to a culture built on openness, integrity, and entrepreneurship, where you’re encouraged to speak up and help shape how we work. Be part of a global team. Work alongside smart, supportive, and enthusiastic colleagues across our international network who value collaboration and shared success.
* Broaden your horizons. With 45 offices around the world, build an international network, collaborate across borders, and gain exposure to exciting projects and perspectives.


 And, of course, enjoy the flexibility and support of benefits such as hybrid working, wellbeing programs, and corporate discounts.
   

  

**How You Will Create An Impact**
 This is a unique opportunity to help build and shape Simon\-Kucher’s growing Life Sciences presence in India, while working on high\-impact projects for leading Life Sciences clients globally. You will combine hands\-on client work with the opportunity to contribute to the growth of our local team, capabilities, and expertise.
   

  

* Building our India Life Sciences \- Play an active role in growing our Li fe Sciences practice in India, contributing to knowledge and capability building, team development, and shaping how we collaborate with our global Life Sciences organization.
* Strategy and Data Analysis \- Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to solve commercial challenges across pricing and market access, go\-to\-market strategy, sales, and broader growth topics, translating insights into actionable recommendations.
* Project Delivery \- Take ownership of project workstreams and collaborate with teams to develop analyses, financial models, presentations, and client workshops.
* Client Interaction \- Work directly with clients through meetings, workshops, and presentations, helping translate complex analyses into clear and impactful recommendations.
* Global Collaboration \- Work closely with Simon\-Kucher colleagues and clients across markets, bringing global expertise to India while building a strong international network.
* Problem Solving and Innovation \- Bring fresh perspectives and creative solutions to complex business challenges and emerging opportunities within Life Sciences.
* Learning and Development \- Continue building your consulting, commercial, and Life Sciences expertise through hands\-on experience, mentorship, and Simon\-Kucher’s extensive training programs.


**Job Requirements**
* 3\-4 years of consulting experience in top tiers is good to have (Fresh graduates would be considered with strong academic record)
* Strong interest OR prior experience in working with global Healthcare \& Life Sciences clients, with an understanding of commercial topics such as marketing, pricing, sales, and growth strategy if prior experience
* Demonstrated ability to analyze and solve complex business problems, using quantitative, conceptual, and analytical skills to develop clear and actionable recommendations
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and comfortable taking ownership while working both independently and collaboratively
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English and a strong client\-service mindset
* Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, with an inclusive and empathetic approach to working across cultures, geographies, and globally distributed teams.
* Strong quantitative capabilities, with proficiency in Excel and experience with analytical and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Flexibility to work across global time zones, including regular overlap with clients and colleagues in Europe and North America and, when needed, meetings outside standard India business hours
* Ability to work from the office or client site 3\- 4 days per week, in line with our hybrid working model

title: Associate Specialist-FP&A
description:
3M has a long\-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Title: Associate Specialist\-FP\&A**
**Collaborate With Innovative 3Mers Around The World**
 Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.
   

  

**The Impact You’ll Make In This Role**
 We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Finance Analyst to join our Finance team, Bangalore. In this role, you will work cross functionally to deliver insightful, actionable analytics and influential reporting packages to drive change and improved financial performance.
   

  

  

* Lead FP\&A reporting and analysis for Orders, Sales, Gross Margin, OPEX, forecasts, and budgets.
* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reports with insights on drivers, risks, opportunities, FX, and macro trends.
* Track key metrics such as Organic Sales Growth, EBITDA, backlog, takt time, Gross\-to\-Net Sales, AR, DSO, DIO, cash flow, and inventory.
* Perform variance analysis for R\&D and SG\&A, and develop dashboards and reports for sales, orders, and inventory performance.

- 

**Your Skills And Expertise**
**To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:**
* MBA in Finance or a professional qualification such as CMA or CA.
* Minimum of 4–6 years of relevant FP\&A work experience.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Proficient in Power BI, Microsoft Excel, and PowerPoint, with knowledge of financial modeling and data analysis tools.
* Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Collaborative team player with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Self\-motivated and proactive, with a strong willingness to learn and contribute.


-

 Hebbal, Bangalore (Karnataka), Hybrid Mode
