title: Assistant Manager CRM and Loyalty
description:
**Position: Assistant Manager\-CRM \& Loyalty** 




  





**Location: Bangalore** 




  





**Total Experience: 4\-6 years** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 This role is about owning the full customer journey—from acquiring users to retaining and reactivating them—using data and marketing automation.
 



 You’ll use tools like Salesforce to create personalized, cross\-channel campaigns (email, SMS, push, WhatsApp) that drive revenue and engagement.
 



 It involves analysing customer behaviour (cohorts, segmentation) and continuously improving campaigns through testing and insights.
 



 You’ll also align marketing efforts with product launches and business goals through structured campaign planning (GTM).
 



 A key part of the role is building loyalty programs and partnerships to increase repeat usage and customer lifetime value.
 



 You’ll track performance metrics like retention, ROI, and LTV, and optimize strategies based on data.
 



 Overall, it’s a mix of growth marketing, CRM strategy, analytics, and execution across teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**CRM \& Lifecycle** 



* Own end\-to\-end lifecycle strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and reactivation.
* Drive segmentation, cohort analysis, personalization, and automated journeys aligned to revenue KPIs.
* Build and manage
 **GTM campaign calendars** 
 aligned with product launches and business priorities.
* Develop cohort\-led engagement strategies to improve retention and customer lifetime value.



  





**Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Hands\-on with campaign execution)** 



* Manage implementation and daily operations on Salesforce Marketing Cloud and understanding of Salesforces data cloud pertaining to business needs.
* Work on building cohorts specific to business goals
* Plan and execute automated cross\-channel campaigns (Email, SMS, Push, WhatsApp).
* Establish campaign measurement, attribution models, and performance tracking dashboards.
* Ensure seamless integration across CRM, product, sales, and analytics systems.



  





**Brand Strategy \& Campaign Execution** 



* Translate brand strategy into lifecycle and CRM\-led campaign execution.
* Lead integrated campaign planning aligned with GTM priorities.
* Ensure consistent messaging and customer experience across owned channels.



  





**Loyalty \& Partnerships** 



* Design and launch experiential loyalty programs, rewards, and brand collaborations.
* Own rewards strategy, fulfilment, and performance monitoring.
* Manage strategic brand, agency, and vendor partnerships.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with marketing, sales, product, and service teams.



  





**Performance \& Optimization (Hands on with Tableau )** 



* Track retention, LTV, repeat rate, referral contribution, and campaign ROI.
* Build and analyze performance dashboards using
 **Tableau** 
 .
* Generate insights through cohort analysis and experimentation.
* Continuously optimize lifecycle journeys through A/B testing and data\-driven decision\-making.



  





**Who We’re Looking For** 



* 4–6 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, growth marketing, or loyalty programs.
* Strong hands\-on experience with
 **Salesforce Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud** 
 (mandatory).
* Proven expertise in campaign automation and cross\-channel execution.
* Experience building
 **GTM calendars, cohort strategies, and brand\-led campaigns** 
 .
* Experience scaling loyalty and referral programs.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience translating data into growth actions.
* Ability to manage cross\-functional stakeholders and external partners.

title: ML Modeling
description:
**Modeler – Marketing Models** 




 Modeler \|Marketing Models \| 3–6 Years of Experience
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking a skilled Modeler to contribute to the development and optimization of marketing analytics models. You will work within a cross\-functional team to build propensity models, next\-best\-action (NBA) engines, customer segmentation frameworks, and campaign response models that power data\-driven marketing strategies. You will apply best practices in model explainability, fairness testing, and lifecycle governance to ensure high\-quality, compliant model outputs.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and optimize propensity models, segmentation frameworks, and campaign response models using supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques.
* Conduct bias testing and implement model explainability methods (e.g., SHAP, LIME) to support model approval and governance workflows.
* Perform exploratory data analysis and feature engineering to identify meaningful predictors of customer behavior.
* Support the full model lifecycle including development, documentation, validation support, performance monitoring, and periodic re\-validation.
* Collaborate with marketing and data teams to understand business objectives and translate them into modeling requirements.
* Prepare clear, concise model documentation including methodology overviews, performance summaries, and limitation disclosures.
* Monitor deployed models for data drift, performance degradation, and champion\-challenger evaluation.
* Contribute to A/B test design and campaign measurement analyses to evaluate marketing effectiveness.
* Stay current on advances in marketing data science, uplift modeling, and customer analytics.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 3–6 years of experience in data science, analytics, or quantitative modeling with a focus on customer or marketing analytics.
* Hands\-on experience building and evaluating classification and regression models for propensity scoring or segmentation.
* Proficiency in Python with working knowledge of libraries such as scikit\-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, pandas, and numpy.
* Familiarity with model explainability tools (SHAP, LIME) and basic concepts of model fairness and bias testing.
* Experience with SQL and large\-scale data platforms for data extraction and feature preparation.
* Understanding of model validation principles and documentation standards.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills for presenting model results to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree (master's preferred) in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.



**Model Lifecycle \& Governance** 




 This role supports end\-to\-end model lifecycle management. Responsibilities encompass model development, independent validation and assessment, performance optimization, monitoring, documentation, and governance — ensuring all models adhere to applicable standards and remain fit\-for\-purpose throughout their operational life.

title: International AIS Finance Analyst
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


Reporting to the International AIS CFO, the International Segment Finance Analyst plays a key role in supporting financial planning, reporting, analytics, and finance transformation initiatives across the Segment.  

This role combines operational finance excellence with advanced analytics and process improvement. The analyst will support forecasting, closing, performance reporting, dashboard development, automation initiatives, and business insights generation while partnering with Segment, Zone, and Global Finance stakeholders. The position offers significant exposure to senior leadership and strategic business decision\-making.**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Financial Planning, Reporting \& Performance Management**

* Support closing and reporting activities, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting.
* Assist in the preparation of forecasts, budgets, and long\-range plans.
* Produce recurring financial reports, dashboards, and performance reviews for Segment leadership.
* Analyze orders, sales, margin, productivity, inflation, and other key performance indicators.
* Identify financial trends, performance drivers, opportunities, and risks.

### **Analytics \& Decision Support**

* Develop financial analyses supporting commercial, operational, and strategic decisions.
* Perform variance analysis and provide actionable recommendations.
* Support profitability and contribution margin analysis.
* Build and maintain reporting tools that improve visibility into business performance.
* Deliver clear and concise financial insights to finance and operating leaders.

### **Process Excellence \& Transformation**

* Drive finance process simplification, standardization, and documentation.
* Support automation initiatives leveraging Power BI, AI, data analytics, and digital tools.
* Improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and forecasting accuracy.
* Create and maintain standard operating procedures and knowledge repositories.
* Participate in global and regional finance transformation projects.

### **Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Collaborate with Segment, Zone, Commercial, Operations, Pricing, Marketing, and FP\&A teams.
* Support strategic initiatives and special projects.
* Promote best practices and continuous improvement across the finance organization.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related quantitative discipline.
* Proven professional experience in finance, FP\&A, commercial finance, accounting, business analytics, or related domain.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Advanced Excel skills.
* Experience with Power BI or similar visualization tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to work effectively in a matrixed and multicultural environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of enterprise financial systems and reporting tools.
* Experience with automation, AI, data modeling, or process transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of forecasting, budgeting, and financial planning processes.
* Ability to translate complex data into simple business insights.
* Demonstrated curiosity, ownership mindset, and continuous improvement attitude.

**Success Profile**
-------------------


The ideal candidate combines strong financial fundamentals, business curiosity, analytical rigor, and a passion for automation and process improvement. The individual is comfortable operating in a fast\-paced international environment and enjoys turning data into actionable business insights.


This role is open in all locations where GE HealthCare has a presence, even if not included in the role posting location. No relocation required.

**Inclusion and Diversity**
---------------------------


GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.


We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.


Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world\-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

**IN FRENCH:**
--------------

**Resumé du poste**
-------------------


L’Analyste Finance Segment AIS International joue un rôle essentiel dans le soutien des activités de planification financière, de reporting, d’analyse et de transformation de la fonction Finance au sein du Segment.


Rattaché(e) directement au CFO AIS International, vous combinerez excellence en finance opérationnelle, analyses avancées et amélioration continue des processus. À ce titre, vous contribuerez aux activités de prévision financière, de clôture comptable, de reporting de performance, de développement de tableaux de bord, d’automatisation et de génération d’analyses à valeur ajoutée, tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes Finance du Segment, des Zones et les parties prenantes Finance globales.


Vous participerez à la production d’informations financières fiables et pertinentes afin de soutenir la prise de décision stratégique et opérationnelle. Grâce à vos analyses et recommandations, vous contribuerez à identifier des opportunités de croissance, à améliorer la performance financière et à soutenir les initiatives de transformation au sein du Segment.


Ce poste offre une forte visibilité auprès des équipes dirigeantes et une exposition directe aux décisions stratégiques de l’entreprise, constituant une excellente opportunité de développement dans un environnement international dynamique.

**Responsabilités principales**
-------------------------------

### **Planification financière, reporting et gestion de la performance**

* Contribuer aux activités de clôture financière et de reporting, en garantissant la production d’informations financières fiables et dans les délais.
* Participer à la préparation des prévisions financières, des budgets et des plans stratégiques à long terme.
* Produire les rapports financiers récurrents, tableaux de bord et revues de performance destinés à l’équipe de direction du Segment.
* Analyser les commandes, le chiffre d’affaires, les marges, la productivité, l’inflation ainsi que les autres indicateurs clés de performance.
* Identifier les tendances financières, les principaux leviers de performance, les opportunités et les risques.

### **Analyse financière et soutien à la prise de décision**

* Réaliser des analyses financières afin de soutenir les décisions commerciales, opérationnelles et stratégiques.
* Effectuer des analyses d’écarts et formuler des recommandations concrètes et exploitables.
* Contribuer aux analyses de rentabilité et de marge contributive.
* Développer et maintenir des outils de reporting permettant d’améliorer la visibilité sur la performance de l’activité.
* Fournir des analyses financières claires, synthétiques et pertinentes aux responsables Finance et aux équipes opérationnelles.

### **Excellence opérationnelle et transformation**

* Contribuer à la simplification, à la standardisation et à la documentation des processus financiers.
* Soutenir les initiatives d’automatisation en s’appuyant sur Power BI, l’intelligence artificielle, l’analytique des données et d’autres outils digitaux.
* Améliorer la qualité des données, l’efficacité du reporting et la précision des prévisions.
* Créer et maintenir les procédures opérationnelles standardisées ainsi que les référentiels de connaissances.
* Participer aux projets de transformation Finance aux niveaux régional et mondial.

### **Collaboration transverse**

* Collaborer avec les équipes du Segment, des Zones, ainsi qu’avec les équipes Commerciales, Opérations, Pricing, Marketing et FP\&A.
* Soutenir les initiatives stratégiques et les projets spécifiques de l’organisation.
* Promouvoir les meilleures pratiques et l’amélioration continue au sein de la fonction Finance.

**Qualifications requises**
---------------------------

* Diplôme universitaire (Licence/Bachelor) en Finance, Comptabilité, Économie, Administration des affaires ou dans une discipline quantitative connexe.
* Expérience professionnelle confirmée en Finance, FP\&A, Finance Commerciale, Comptabilité, Business Analytics ou dans un domaine similaire.
* Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
* Maîtrise avancée d’Excel.
* Expérience avec Power BI ou un outil équivalent de visualisation de données.
* Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale en anglais.
* Capacité à évoluer efficacement dans un environnement matriciel et multiculturel.

**Qualifications souhaitées**
-----------------------------

* Connaissance des systèmes financiers d’entreprise et des outils de reporting.
* Expérience dans des initiatives d’automatisation, d’intelligence artificielle, de modélisation des données ou de transformation des processus.
* Bonne compréhension des processus de prévision, de budgétisation et de planification financière.
* Capacité à transformer des données complexes en analyses simples et pertinentes pour les métiers.
* Curiosité intellectuelle démontrée, sens des responsabilités et forte orientation vers l’amélioration continue.

**Profil recherché**
--------------------


Le candidat idéal combine de solides fondamentaux en finance, une réelle curiosité pour les enjeux business, une forte rigueur analytique et une véritable passion pour l’automatisation et l’amélioration des processus. Vous êtes à l’aise dans un environnement international dynamique et savez transformer des données complexes en analyses et recommandations concrètes permettant d’éclairer les décisions de l’entreprise et de créer de la valeur.


Ce poste est ouvert dans tous les pays où GE HealthCare est présent, même si certains ne figurent pas parmi les localisations mentionnées dans l’annonce. Aucune relocalisation n’est requise.

**Inclusion et diversité**
--------------------------


GE HealthCare est un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances où l'inclusion compte. Les décisions relatives à l'emploi sont prises sans tenir compte de l’origine nationale ou ethnique, de la religion, du sexe, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'identité ou de l'expression de genre, de l'âge, du handicap, du statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou d'autres caractéristiques protégées par la loi.


Nos rémunérations totales sont conçues pour libérer votre ambition en vous donnant la motivation et la flexibilité dont vous avez besoin pour transformer vos idées en réalités qui changent le monde. Nos salaires et nos avantages sociaux correspondent à tout ce que vous attendez d’une organisation ayant une dimension internationale, avec des possibilités de développement de carrière, dans une culture qui favorise la collaboration et le soutien.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

title: Risk & Controls Analyst, Corporate Engineering
description:
Reporting to the Risk \& Controls Officer, Corporate Engineering, the Risk \& Controls Analyst, Corporate Engineering is responsible for building and renewing annual business continuity plans, and supporting the coordination of risk management activities across Corporate Engineering, including issue management, risk and control assessments, external audit and risk governance.


This role will also collaborate closely with the BISO and Security architects to understand security programmes and initiatives, coordinating the response of Corporate Engineering teams.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of building and managing Corporate Engineering business continuity plans, and conducting annual reviews in partnership with capability pillars to renew as required.
* Build Corporate Engineering business continuity assessments in\-line with the Enterprise Risk Management Framework and in partnership with key stakeholders in the business continuity function.
* Support in the reporting of KRIs (Key Risk Indicators) and KCIs (Key Control Indicators) timely to support various reporting Committees.
* Assist in control testing including obtaining evidence and challenging information provided to support the control design and operating effectiveness.
* Analyse and interpret data to provide regular reports and recommendations to stakeholders, identifying technology, cyber and resilience risks.
* Conduct risk reviews and assessments of existing and proposed methodologies, policies, standards and best practices. providing recommendations for improvement and supporting their implementation.
* Support all core risk activities, including but not limited to, risk control assessments, issue management, external assurance, risk governance, risk reporting.
* Draw on technical knowledge to engage with internal stakeholders on risk remediation.
* Prepare reports for relevant internal committees, senior management and stakeholders.
* Partner with capability teams to produce reports and analysis, offering guidance where necessary and ensuring adherence and understanding of technology, cyber and resilience risk policies and frameworks.
* Build knowledge of the organisation, processes and stakeholders to assist with risk oversight.

**Leadership and Line Management**

* This role is an individual contributor with no line management responsibilities but will partner with other members of the Business Management team as required.
* Establish and maintain strong and supportive relationships across all capabilities and business units to enable the swift and effective management of issues, risks and dependencies when escalated.
* Contribute to the overall development of Corporate Engineering and take ownership of shared deliverables where identified.
* Continuously adopt a pragmatic, flexible, and responsive approach.
* Working with teams in multiple locations simultaneously.
* Apply judgement to assess the relative importance of assigned tasks and prioritises effectively.

**You’ll bring (Candidate Profile / Key Skills)**
=================================================

* 3\+ years of combined Technology and Cyber risk management experience.
* 2\+ years of experience supporting and building risk processes.
* 2\+ years of experience supporting and building business continuity plans.
* 2\+ years of experience driving risk remediation.
* Previous IT Audit, 2nd line Technology Risk or 1st line technology risk assurance expertise in financial services.
* Knowledge to provide guidance to support Divisional Technology teams in controls over SDLC, agile, tooling, architecture, disaster recovery, operational resilience, IT asset management, incident and problem management, IT third party risk management, program/project management, infrastructure practices would be beneficial.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills \- ability to communicate findings in a compelling manner to internal audiences.
* Good understanding of risk management frameworks and their practical application.
* Capable of working independently and collaboratively as needed to deliver against Corporate Engineering objectives.
* Experience of working with multiple ‘Corporate technologies’, to enable recognition of interdependencies in end\-to\-end processes that bisect functional boundaries (JML etc).
* Highly motivated / Strong work ethic – Proven commitment to adapt and champion time sensitive/mission critical processes operating in a global and matrix\-type organization.
* Professional presentation skills with impact, competent in presenting ideas clearly, convincingly to influence stakeholders and possessing personal presence, with the ability to earn trust and respect.
* Strong process Management skills \- able to understand and coordinate complex organizational processes and consolidate input from multiple stakeholders.
* Fast learner and able to link diverse sources of information to our business including ability to handle confidential information and materials with appropriate discretion.

title: Power BI & Power Apps Developer
description:
**Position: Power BI \& Power Apps Developer**

**Payroll Company: Pro Team Solutions Private Limited**   
**Work\& Client Location: Sahakar Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka**   
**Experience:** 5–6 Years  
**Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Function:** Business Intelligence / Data Analytics / Microsoft Power Platform

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced **Power BI \& Power Apps Developer** with approximately **5\+ years of hands\-on experience** in designing, developing, implementing, and supporting business intelligence solutions and low\-code business applications using the **Microsoft Power Platform**.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, DAX, Power Query, Dataverse, and SharePoint Online**, along with a good understanding of data modelling, ETL, system integration, security, and governance.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, and technical teams to understand business requirements and translate them into **interactive dashboards, automated workflows, scalable applications, and data\-driven solutions** that improve operational efficiency and support informed decision\-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Power BI Development**

* Design, develop, deploy, and maintain interactive **Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions**.
* Develop complex **DAX measures, calculated columns, KPIs, and business calculations** based on functional requirements.
* Build and optimize robust data models using **Star Schema and Snowflake Schema** methodologies.
* Perform data transformation, cleansing, and preparation using **Power Query / M Language**.
* Implement and manage **Row\-Level Security (RLS)** to ensure secure and controlled access to business data.
* Connect Power BI with multiple data sources, including:
* SQL Server
* SAP
* SharePoint Online
* Microsoft Excel
* Azure services
* Dataverse
* REST APIs and other external data sources
* Develop optimized data models and reports for improved performance and scalability.
* Configure and monitor **Power BI Service workspaces, datasets, dataflows, gateways, and scheduled refreshes**.
* Troubleshoot data, refresh, visualization, and performance\-related issues.
* Monitor report performance and implement optimization techniques to improve report loading and query execution times.
* Ensure dashboards and reports follow appropriate data governance, security, and reporting standards.

**2\. Power Apps Development**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain business applications using **Microsoft Power Apps**.
* Develop both **Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps** based on business requirements.
* Create responsive and user\-friendly applications for business process automation and operational requirements.
* Develop custom forms, screens, controls, user interfaces, and business logic.
* Use **Microsoft Dataverse** for data storage, application development, security, and integration.
* Integrate Power Apps with:
* SharePoint Online
* SQL Server
* Microsoft Teams
* Azure Services
* Dataverse
* Microsoft 365
* External APIs and third\-party systems
* Develop applications that improve manual processes and enhance business productivity.
* Configure application security, permissions, roles, environments, and access controls.
* Troubleshoot and enhance existing Power Apps solutions based on business and user feedback.

**3\. Power Automate \& Business Process Automation**

* Design and develop automated workflows using **Microsoft Power Automate**.
* Build automated business processes for:
* Approval workflows
* Notifications and alerts
* Document management
* Data synchronization
* Task assignments
* Business process automation
* Integrate Power Automate with Microsoft 365 applications, Power Apps, SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL Server, Teams, and external systems.
* Develop cloud flows and automate repetitive and manual business processes.
* Troubleshoot failed flows, connectivity issues, integration errors, and performance problems.
* Optimize existing workflows to improve reliability, efficiency, and maintainability.
* Implement appropriate error handling, exception management, and monitoring mechanisms.

**4\. Data Integration \& Technical Development**

* Integrate data from multiple internal and external sources into Power Platform and Power BI solutions.
* Work with **SQL Server, SAP, SharePoint, Excel, Azure, Dataverse, APIs, and other enterprise data sources**.
* Understand and apply data warehousing and **ETL concepts**.
* Develop efficient data extraction, transformation, and loading processes.

Key responsibilities

Process oriented and able to utilize technology platforms to work effectively

Teamwork

Experience

Current knowledge of Work Dynamics business models, clients and geos will be highly valuable.
  
Facilities Management or Property Management experience is advantageous
  
Demonstrated successes in data analysis, drawing conclusions, and improvement.

description:
**Ref\#:** W181713  

  

**Department:** Finance  

  

**City:** Bangalore  

  

**State/Province:** Karnataka  

  

**Location:** India  

  

**Company Description**Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.
  

  

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education \& Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.  

  

  

**Position Overview**The Senior Analyst Inventory will support EMEA Inventory Accounting within the Finance / Record\-to\-Report function, with a strong focus on SAP migration activities connected to inventory accounting, cost of sales, inventory valuation, reconciliations and reporting. The role will combine business\-as\-usual month\-end responsibilities with project\-based SAP migration support, including data validation, testing, reconciliation of migrated balances and support for cutover and stabilization activities.  

The candidate will be responsible for performing accounting functions and analytical reviews for selected inventory areas, while partnering closely with Sales Audit, Costing, Tax, Internal Audit, IT and SAP project teams. Key responsibilities include validating inventory\-related data flows, reviewing SAP postings and interfaces, supporting UAT and regression testing, investigating variances between legacy and SAP outputs, preparing journals and reconciliations, and ensuring that documentation supports SOX, internal audit and external audit requirements.  

The role requires strong inventory accounting knowledge, hands\-on SAP experience, advanced analytical skills and the ability to work with large data sets during migration, testing and close activities. The candidate will also contribute to process improvement, automation and standardization initiatives to support a stable post\-migration operating model.  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**Timely and accurate completion of monthly, weekly and migration\-related reconciliations with clear variance explanations.  

Successful support of SAP migration activities, including test execution, defect follow\-up, data validation and cutover readiness for inventory accounting areas.  

Accurate, efficient and timely month\-end close for inventory, cost of sales, valuation and related reporting areas.  

Compliance with company policies, SOX controls, audit requirements and documented procedures.  

Effective communication with inventory accounting, SAP project teams and business stakeholders, with proactive escalation of risks, defects and reconciliation breaks.  

Inventory Accounting and Month\-End Close  

Perform detailed reconciliations between source systems, SAP and reporting outputs for inventory, sales, COGS and related balance sheet accounts.  

Prepare, review and post journal entries, accruals and reclassifications related to inventory accounting month\-end close activities.  

Analyze inventory movements, EOH balances, GR/IR, sales, VAT, purchase price variance, freight, costing and margin\-related variances.  

Prepare monthly account analysis, balance sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules with clear explanations for open items and aged balances.  

Support internal and external audits by providing reconciliations, evidence, walkthrough support and responses to audit queries.  

SAP Migration and Project Support  

Support SAP migration activities for inventory accounting, including master data review, mapping validation, opening balance checks and reconciliation of migrated inventory values.  

Participate in UAT, regression testing and business validation for inventory accounting processes, interfaces, reports and SAP posting logic.  

Validate SAP outputs for costing runs, inventory valuation, COGS, margin reporting, GR/IR, purchase price variance and period\-end close activities.  

Document test results, defects, reconciliation breaks and business sign\-off evidence; follow up with SAP, IT and functional teams until closure.  

Support cutover preparation, mock close, parallel run, post\-go\-live stabilization and knowledge transfer for migrated inventory accounting processes.  

Reporting, Controls and Process Improvement  

Prepare inventory reports, variance analysis, product margin reports, e\-commerce reconciliations and management summaries as required.  

Maintain and update SOPs, control documentation and process maps for both BAU and SAP migration\-related activities.  

Identify opportunities to improve reconciliation quality, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls and automate recurring reports using Excel, Power BI, Power Automate or similar tools.  

Assist with ad\-hoc analysis, special projects and business initiatives including new channels, new store openings, sourcing initiatives, inventory liquidation and process transitions  

**Experience, Skills, and Knowledge**Minimum 3 years of experience in inventory accounting, RTR, finance operations, audit or accounting, preferably in retail, apparel, fashion, FMCG or a data\-intensive industry.  

Strong understanding of inventory accounting concepts including inventory valuation, COGS, GR/IR, EOH, purchase price variance, costing, margin and balance sheet reconciliations.  

Hands\-on SAP experience is mandatory; exposure to SAP migration, SAP testing, UAT, data validation, cutover or post\-go\-live stabilization is highly preferred.  

Ability to validate large data sets, compare legacy and SAP outputs, investigate exceptions and clearly document reconciliation results.  

Strong accounting background with good RTR knowledge and the ability to understand end\-to\-end process impact from source system to financial reporting.  

Advanced Excel skills are preferred; experience with Power BI, Power Automate or other reporting / automation tools is an advantage.  

Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, variance analysis capability and a structured approach to problem solving.  

Ability to manage multiple deliverables, meet tight deadlines and work independently in a complex, matrixed and project\-driven environment.  

Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with finance, IT, SAP project teams and business stakeholders.  

University degree in accounting, finance, business, economics or a related field.

title: Performance Marketing Freelancer
description:
**Company Description:** 




 1\-2\-Taste is transforming the B2B food ingredients industry through a digital, AI\-managed marketplace that optimizes how ingredients are sourced, sold, and innovated. Business customers can easily find and order a broad range of food ingredients from trusted suppliers. The platform is built on transparency in pricing, reliable delivery, and efficient supply chain management. This combination of technology and service quality makes 1\-2\-Taste a distinctive player in the global food ingredients market and an engaging environment for performance\-driven marketing professionals.
 



  





  





**Role Description** 




 Drive qualified lead generation and conversion growth through performance marketing campaigns, while ensuring accurate, reliable and actionable tracking and analytics across all digital channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be equally strong in Performance Marketing and Marketing Analytics, with hands\-on expertise in Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), conversion tracking, event tracking, debugging and data validation.
 



  





**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**



* Increasing qualified leads
* Campaign ROI \- Efficient advertising spend
* Conversion Optimisation \- Improving conversion rates
* Tracking \& Measurement \- Accurate and reliable marketing data
* Analytics \& Reporting \- Clear performance visibility and actionable insights
* Data Quality\- Ensuring consistency between website activity, GTM and GA4



  





**1\. Performance Marketing** 



* Manage and optimise Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns.
* Plan and execute campaigns based on lead generation and business objectives.
* Optimise targeting, audiences, budgets, bidding and campaign structures.
* Monitor CPL, conversion rates, ROAS and overall campaign performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs.
* Conduct A/B testing of campaigns, audiences, landing pages and creatives.



  





**2\. Google Tag Manager (GTM) – Advanced Expertise** 



* Take complete ownership of Google Tag Manager containers and tracking implementation.
* Create, configure and manage Tags, Triggers and Variables based on business and marketing requirements.
* Implement tracking for key website interactions such as:
* Form submissions
* CTA/button clicks
* Product/category page visits
* Sample requests
* Contact/lead forms
* Downloads
* Outbound clicks
* Scroll depth and engagement events
* Other important user journeys and conversion actions
* Maintain a clear and structured GTM container with proper naming conventions and documentation.
* Manage GTM versions, workspaces and publishing processes.
* Identify and troubleshoot duplicate, missing or incorrectly configured tags.
* Ensure that tracking implementations do not negatively impact website performance.



  





**3\. Google Analytics 4 (GA4\) – Advanced Expertise** 



* Take ownership of GA4 configuration, events, parameters, conversions and reporting.
* Configure and manage GA4 events and relevant event parameters.
* Define and maintain a clear measurement framework for the website and marketing campaigns.
* Configure relevant conversions/key events in GA4\.
* Ensure important user actions and business outcomes are properly captured.
* Analyze user journeys, acquisition sources, engagement and conversion behaviour.
* Create and maintain relevant GA4 explorations, reports and audiences.
* Ensure campaign data such as source, medium, campaign and other relevant parameters are captured correctly.



  





**4\. Tracking Validation, Testing \& Debugging** 




*This is a critical responsibility of the role.*



* Test every major tracking implementation before and after deployment.
* Use GTM Preview/Debug mode, GA4 DebugView and browser developer tools to validate tracking.
* Verify that the correct event is triggered when a user performs the intended action.
* Verify that the correct parameters and values are being passed with each event.
* Cross\-check that the data fired through Google Tag Manager is correctly received and recorded in GA4\.
* Identify discrepancies between:
* Website → GTM → GA4 → Advertising Platforms
* Test whether conversions are being recorded correctly and only once.
* Identify and resolve duplicate events, missing events, incorrect parameters and incorrectly firing tags.
* Perform regression testing whenever changes are made to the website, GTM or GA4 configuration.
* Regularly audit the tracking setup to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
* Maintain a tracking QA checklist and document any issues, fixes and changes made.



  





 5\. Conversion \& Campaign Tracking
 


* Implement and validate conversion tracking for Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn.
* Ensure UTM parameters and campaign tracking are correctly implemented.
* Verify that campaign source/medium/campaign information is correctly attributed in GA4\.
* Ensure leads generated through different channels can be accurately identified and attributed.
* Troubleshoot discrepancies between advertising\-platform conversions and GA4 conversions.
* Continuously improve the accuracy of attribution and conversion measurement.



 6\. Analytics \& Reporting
 


* Maintain marketing dashboards and performance reports.
* Track key metrics including MQLs, leads, CPL, conversion rate, ROAS and campaign performance.
* Provide insights rather than simply reporting numbers.
* Identify trends, anomalies and tracking issues proactively.
* Highlight actionable recommendations for improving campaign and website performance.
* Ensure reporting data is based on properly validated tracking.



  





**Technical Skills Required**




*Must\-Have*



* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM).
* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4\).
* Advanced understanding of GTM containers, Tags, Triggers and Variables.
* Strong understanding of GA4 Events and Event Parameters.
* Experience implementing and testing conversion tracking.
* Experience debugging GTM and GA4 tracking issues.
* Ability to validate data flow from website → GTM → GA4 → advertising platforms.
* Strong understanding of UTM parameters and campaign attribution.
* Experience with Google Ads conversion tracking.
* Experience with Meta Pixel and LinkedIn Insight Tag.
* Ability to independently identify and fix tracking discrepancies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.



*Good to Have*



* Understanding of Google Search Console.
* Basic understanding of JavaScript/dataLayer.
* Experience with CRM and marketing automation integrations.
* Experience with server\-side tracking/conversion APIs.
* Experience working with B2B lead\-generation websites.



  





**Ideal Candidate**




 We are looking for someone who is not just a campaign manager, but a hands\-on performance marketer who understands how data is generated, captured, validated and used to make marketing decisions.
 



  





 The candidate should be comfortable asking:
 



  





 “Did the user action actually fire?” → “Did GTM capture it correctly?” → “Did GA4 receive it correctly?” → “Was the correct parameter passed?” → “Was the conversion recorded correctly?” → “Can we trust the number in the report?”
 



  





 The candidate should be capable of independently setting up, testing, debugging and validating the complete tracking ecosystem without relying solely on developers or external analytics teams.
 


* KPI Owned
* KPI Target / Expectation
* MQL Generation Increasing
* Cost per Lead Optimized
* ROAS High
* Conversion Rate Improving
* Tracking Accuracy High
* Conversion Data Integrity 100% validated
* Reporting Accurate and actionable
* Reporting / Supervision



  





 Reports to: Head of Digital Marketing

title: Junior Analyst – Financial Data & Reporting
description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW** 





 The Junior Analyst will play a critical support role within Graystone Capital’s financial analyst team, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timely availability of financial data. This entry level role is ideal for candidates who are detail\-oriented, numerically proficient, and eager to build a career in corporate finance and investment analysis.
 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Data Entry \& Accuracy** 



* Accurately enter financial data from source documents into spreadsheets and internal systems
* Prepare, review, and complete internal documentation, including one\-pager checklists and supporting forms, to facilitate due diligence, compliance verification, and internal approval processes.
* Verify and cross check entered data for completeness, consistency, and correctness before submission
* Maintain data integrity across all files and flag discrepancies to the reporting manager immediately
* Ensure zero error data standards through structured double\-checking routines



**Financial Spreading** 



* Spread financial statements (Profit \& Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) from client documents into standardized excel templates
* Perform working capital and ratio calculations including liquidity ratios, leverage ratios, and profitability metrics as directed
* Assist in maintaining and updating financial models and analytical templates used by the senior team



**Data Collation \& Reporting** 



* Collect and consolidate financial data from multiple sources including client submissions, third\-party databases, and internal files
* Organize collated data into structured formats ready for analysis by senior analysts
* Draft bank\-specific credit proposal templates by analysing financial, operational, and business information to support comprehensive credit assessment, risk evaluation, and lending recommendations.
* Prepare \& populate summary sheets, trackers, and dashboards for ongoing deals and client portfolios
* Support preparation of transaction teasers, information memoranda, internal MIS and credit notes on a regular basis



**Documentation Management** 



* Maintain well organized and up to date documentation system for all client financial data and deal documents
* Assist in compiling document checklists and ensuring all required financial information is on track
* Coordinate with senior team members to track and follow up on data requirements from clients
* Coordinate and correspond with lenders on documentation support



**Quality Control \& Compliance** 



* Adhere to internal data quality standards and review protocols at all times
* Maintain confidentiality of all client’s financial information in line with company policies
* Ensure all work is completed within agreed timelines and flagged proactively if delays are anticipated



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 



* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (M. Com / MBA Finance or equivalent)
* 1–2 years of experience in financial data handling, accounting, credit or a related role
* Working knowledge of MS Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, basic formulas), MS Word
* Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail
* Financial data entry and spreading
* Basic understanding of accounting concepts
* Basic knowledge of credit and trade finance products

 We are looking for a Collections Strategy Analyst (2\-6 years of experience) to support collections strategy, performance tracking, reporting, and day\-to\-day operational execution. title: Data Analyst - Senior
description:
As a Senior Data Analyst, measurement, you will be the analytical engine behind our commercial performance tracking. Serving within the Global Verticals Marketing team, you will act as the primary point of contact for querying, analysing, and synthesizing FedEx internal transactional and customer data. Your mission is to convert complex datasets into clear, actionable vertical performance narratives that guide business planning.
   

  

 In this role, you will build executive\-ready reports, conduct ad\-hoc analyses, and provide data\-driven insights that directly support marketing, commercial strategy, and forecasting functions. Your work will directly influence how senior leadership understands vertical health, product performance, and regional business dynamics.
   

  

**Grade : T5**
**"Please note that the Job will close at 12am on Posting Close date, so please submit your application prior to the Close Date"**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Vertical Performance
   

  

* Write, optimize, and execute complex SQL queries against FedEx enterprise data warehouses to extract performance metrics across priority industry verticals (e.g., E\-commerce, Healthcare, Aerospace, Technology).
* Monitor and analyse key commercial indicators, including volume, revenue, and yield, with a specific focus on identifying regional / lane / product level insights.
* Investigate regional and product\-level performance variations, isolating root causes of growth or decline and translating findings into structured data briefs.
* Build, maintain, and automate interactive performance dashboards and scorecards to track commercial performance, vertical health, and pipeline health.


 Executive \& Leadership Reporting
   

  

* Synthesize complex performance datasets into high\-impact, visual, and narrative\-driven reports for leadership and executive\-level business updates (e.g., CEO updates and strategic reviews).
* Translate analytical findings into concise executive takeaways, ensuring executive communications clearly explain the past performance, present status, and future outlook.
* Deliver regular monthly and quarterly performance updates, highlighting competitive risks, commercial opportunities, and customer journey trends.


 Strategic \& Forecasting Support
   

  

* Partner with forecasting, strategy, finance, and marketing functions to model commercial funnels, market demand shifts, and historical volume trends.
* Apply statistical techniques and behavioural segmentation models to track, isolate, and forecast changes in specific customer cohorts and industry verticals.
* Conduct rapid\-response, ad\-hoc deep dives to answer critical, time\-sensitive business questions posed by leadership.
* Provide data backing and baseline historical trends to support annual commercial strategic planning and commercial goal setting.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

 Experience \& Background
   

  

* 6\-10 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, sales analytics, or financial/commercial measurement roles.
* Proven experience querying large\-scale, complex relational databases to extract commercial, transactional, and customer\-level insights.
* Demonstrated track record of preparing executive\-calibre presentations, briefs, and reports based on complex data analysis.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional, global stakeholders across various time zones.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Executive Storytelling \& Visualization: The ability to translate numbers into a cohesive, executive\-ready story that leaders can grasp and act on instantly.
* Statistical Thinking \& Pattern Discovery: Strong capability to utilize business statistics (e.g., correlation, significance testing, regression, trend analysis) to


 robustly identify patterns, validate data anomalies, and extract high\-integrity insights from raw corporate data.
   

  

* Analytical Rigor \& Structured Problem Solving: High attention to data accuracy, methodological soundness, and the ability to formulate logical business hypotheses.
* Agility \& Proactiveness: Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, managing competing priorities, and delivering quick\-turnaround ad\-hoc analyses.


**Professional Expertise \& Technical Skills**
* Analytics \& BI: High proficiency in SQL (required) and experience working with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Teradata, or BigQuery).
* Applied Business Statistics: Practical knowledge of statistical methods to perform cohort analysis, customer segmentation, and behavioural pattern recognition to discover performance anomalies.
* Business AI \& Machine Learning Application: Understanding of how to leverage predictive models, clustering algorithms (e.g., for cohort refinement), and NLP/text mining to automate industry vertical tracking, spot micro\-trends, and optimize customer group definitions.
* Data Visualization: Proficiency in building dashboards in Power BI or similar BI tools
* Programming \& Automation: Comfortable using Python or R for statistical modelling, data manipulation, and analytical process automation is a must.
* Productivity \& Reporting: Expert\-level skills in MS Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables) and PowerPoint (to draft polished, executive\-ready presentations).


 Sector Familiarity: Prior experience analysing commercial performance within B2B verticals (e.g., Retail/E\-commerce, Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Industrial, Technology) is highly valued.
   

  

* Exposure to CRM/sales enablement tools (e.g., Salesforce)


 Certifications (nice to have)
   

  

* CFA, FRM, PMP, Six Sigma (or equivalent).


 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

description:

**Senior – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
 As part of our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients leverage finance data intelligence and data lake solutions to drive performance improvement initiatives.  We are seeking a Consultant / Senior Consultant with expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process – PTP, OTC, RTR \& FP\&A. Candidates with working knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics are preferred. * Possess technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Experience in Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture.

* Manage priorities effectively in a dynamic, high\-pressure environment.

* Experience in consulting or finance data intelligence roles is preferred.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage confidently with diverse audiences.
* Proficiency in English
* Adaptable and able to work in ambiguous and evolving environments.
* Collaborative team player with the ability to influence and drive consensus.
* Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 1\-2 years (Staff level) or 3\-6 years (Senior level) of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Strong skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL .


**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**
* Exposure to ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience with finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance.
* Project management and stakeholder management capabilities.


**What We Look For**
* A team player with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and eagerness to learn in a fast\-paced environment.

 At EY, you will work on inspiring and meaningful projects with some of the world’s top companies. Additionally, we offer:

**EY \| Building a better working world**

title: Marketplace Account Manager (Ecommerce)
description:
ABOUT INVISEL
 
 Invisel is India's first nanotechnology\-based home surface protection brand. Our nano\-coatings create an invisible protective shield on home surfaces like glass, fabric, marble, leather, and tiles — protecting them from stains and damage for months. We are a fast\-growing D2C brand, and online marketplaces like Amazon and Flipkart are among our most important channels for reaching customers, driving revenue, and scaling the brand beyond our own website.
 



  




 THE ROLE
 
 We are looking for an E\-Commerce Marketplace Manager who owns Invisel's presence and performance across Amazon, Flipkart, and other relevant online marketplaces — end to end. This is not a listings\-and\-reporting role. This is an ownership role: you are responsible for how Invisel shows up, sells, and grows on every marketplace we operate on.
 



 You will work closely with the content team, performance marketing team, and operations/inventory teams — ensuring every listing is optimised, every campaign is executed on time, and every marketplace account stays healthy and growing.
 



 This role is for you if you have independently managed a brand's presence on Amazon, Flipkart, or another online marketplace before, understand how catalog, pricing, inventory, and advertising work together to drive marketplace sales, and can take full ownership of the numbers — not just the activity.
 



  




 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 
**▸ 1\. Marketplace Account Management** 




 ●      Manage the complete day\-to\-day operations of Invisel's Amazon and Flipkart accounts
 



 ●      Take end\-to\-end ownership of marketplace performance across all listed platforms
 



 ●      Monitor marketplace dashboards, notifications, account health, and performance metrics daily
 



 ●      Resolve listing errors, suppressed products, inventory issues, and other account\-related concerns quickly
 



 ●      Coordinate with marketplace support teams whenever required
 



 ●      Ensure full compliance with each marketplace's policies and guidelines
 



**▸ 2\. Sales \& Business Growth** 




 ●      Develop and execute strategies to grow marketplace sales month on month
 



 ●      Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance against targets
 



 ●      Analyse SKU\-level performance — identify what's working and what isn't, and act on it
 



 ●      Identify opportunities to improve visibility, traffic, and conversion across marketplaces
 



 ●      Own monthly and quarterly marketplace sales targets
 



**▸ 3\. Catalog, Listing \& Pricing** 




 ●      Manage and maintain accurate product listings — titles, descriptions, bullet points, images, and specifications
 



 ●      Coordinate with the content and creative teams for listing optimisation and marketplace\-specific creatives
 



 ●      Monitor competitor pricing and marketplace movements; maintain competitive, profitable pricing
 



 ●      Plan and execute marketplace promotions, deals, and coupon campaigns
 



 ●      Fix listing suppression, catalog errors, or incorrect categorisation as soon as they arise
 



**▸ 4\. Inventory \& Order Coordination** 




 ●      Coordinate with inventory and operations teams to maintain healthy, campaign\-ready stock levels across all marketplaces
 



 ●      Monitor SKU\-wise inventory and flag stock\-out or overstock risks early
 



 ●      Track order processing, cancellations, and returns, and resolve fulfilment issues with the relevant teams
 



  





**▸ 5\. Marketplace Advertising \& Campaigns** 




 ●      Coordinate with the performance marketing team on Amazon and Flipkart advertising
 



 ●      Provide SKU\-level insights to guide ad spend and campaign planning
 



 ●      Plan and coordinate participation in major marketplace sale events (e.g. Amazon Great Indian Festival, Flipkart Big Billion Days)
 



 ●      Ensure pricing, inventory, and listings are campaign\-ready ahead of every major sale event
 



  





**▸ 6\. Analytics \& Reporting** 




 ●      Prepare and share weekly and monthly marketplace performance reports — sales, orders, conversion, traffic, returns, and profitability
 



 ●      Maintain SKU\-level performance tracking across all marketplaces
 



 ●      Turn data into clear, actionable recommendations for the wider team
 



  




 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 
**▸ Background — Non\-Negotiable** 




 ●      2–4 years of hands\-on experience in e\-commerce marketplace management
 



 ●      Has independently managed Amazon and Flipkart seller/vendor accounts for a brand
 



 ●      Has previously owned marketplace performance for one or more brands independently — not just supported a larger team
 



 ●      Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills — comfortable working with SKU\-level data daily
 



  





**▸ Skills — Non\-Negotiable** 




 ●      Deep working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub operations
 



 ●      Understands how catalog, pricing, inventory, and advertising work together to drive marketplace sales — not siloed thinking
 



 ●      Strong analytical ability — reads marketplace data and draws clear, actionable conclusions
 



 ●      Clear communicator — coordinates confidently with content, creative, performance marketing, and operations teams
 



 ●      Organised — manages multiple SKUs, listings, and marketplace dashboards without dropping anything

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Senior Associate \- Risk Management Services**
 This is a technical senior role that requires the incumbent to independently support, design, build, maintain, and enhance global Assurance Quality Review processes with a strong focus on creating Power BI dashboards, preparing AQR data models, performing data analysis, automating recurring reporting activities, validating questionnaire and findings data, and enabling technology\-driven process improvements for Global and Regional Assurance Quality stakeholders. The candidate should be comfortable working in an unstructured and complex environment requiring out\-of\-the\-box thinking, logical reasoning, hands\-on digital capability, sound verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to make prompt yet well\-informed decisions.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Service Line Quality enablement teams play a crucial role in facilitating the Annual Quality Reviews. Our primary responsibilities include generating reports and aiding the analysis conducted by the Global Service Line Quality Leadership.
   

  

 This is a great opportunity to be part of a leading firm while contributing to strengthening the quality framework of the firm.
   

  

 The Senior Associate will be expected to develop subject matter expertise in Assurance Quality Review processes and independently manage technical AQR deliverables, including dashboard development, automated reporting, data modelling, data validation, analysis of inspection/questionnaire outputs, troubleshooting reporting issues, and AI\-enabled productivity solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence:**
* Develop subject matter expertise in Assurance Quality Review processes, AQR reporting requirements, questionnaires, findings analysis, inspection data, and related EY tools.
* Design, build, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, reports, and data models to support AQR monitoring, trend analysis, leadership reporting, and stakeholder decision\-making.
* Use advanced Excel, Power Query, Power Automate, SQL concepts, Microsoft Copilot, and AI\-enabled tools to automate recurring reporting, data preparation, quality checks, and workflow activities.
* Perform data validation and reconciliation checks on AQR inspection, questionnaire, engagement, and findings data to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Analyze AQR data to identify trends, exceptions, reporting gaps, process issues, and improvement opportunities.
* Complete assigned AQR technical projects in line with standard operating procedures, quality expectations, and stipulated timelines.


**Client Management:**
* Manage conversations with Global and Regional Assurance Quality stakeholders to understand dashboard, reporting, analytics, and automation requirements.
* Translate stakeholder requirements into practical Power BI dashboards, automated reports, data checks, and workflow solutions.
* Address AQR reporting, dashboard, data quality, or automation\-related issues and escalations by identifying root causes, recommending fixes, and implementing preventive checks in a timely and professional manner.
* Drive quality control mechanisms for technical outputs and manage stakeholder requirements within defined timelines and required quality standards.


**People Management:**
* Provide feedback, coaching, and guidance to team members and help them move up the learning curve.
* Support team capability\-building by reviewing deliverables, sharing timely feedback, guiding junior team members, and reinforcing quality expectations.
* Ensure adherence to workflow protocols, quality checks, documentation standards, and technology\-enabled ways of working.
* Coordinate training and learning opportunities for new and existing team members.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong self\-review mindset for dashboards, reports, data models, reconciliations, and other technical outputs.
* Well\-developed analytical, problem\-solving, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage dashboard/reporting requirements, stakeholder expectations, technical priorities, and project critical success factors.
* Attention to detail, accountability, curiosity for digital tools, and a solution\-oriented approach.


**Qualification Requirements**
* MBA or postgraduate degree in Engineering, Technology, Data/Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline from a reputed institute.
* 4–5 years of professional experience, preferably in Assurance Quality Reviews, audit quality, reporting, analytics, automation, quality review, risk management, or compliance monitoring environment.
* Exposure to handling Global or Regional Assurance Quality stakeholders or client interactions.
* Experience in managing or guiding team members.
* Attention to detail, flexibility to support AQR business season requirements if needed, and a solution\-oriented approach.


**Soft And Technical Skills**
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in Power BI dashboard design and build, Power Query, data modelling, DAX concepts, dashboard visualization, report publishing, and ongoing dashboard enhancement will be preferred.
* Proficiency in advanced Excel, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot, AI\-powered productivity tools, and basic SQL concepts to support data preparation, automation, validation, and reporting activities.
* Ability to design reporting workflows, automate recurring reports, perform data checks, and convert raw AQR data into clear business insights.
* Knowledge of artificial intelligence or automation tools to improve reporting efficiency and reduce manual effort will be an added advantage.


**Added Advantage**
* Working knowledge of SQL, Python, XML, R, SAS, database integrations, data security, and Microsoft Fabric capabilities including Data Factory, Power BI with Copilot, Data Activator, and OneLake.
* Ability to leverage emerging technologies, AI\-enabled tools, and automation solutions to improve reporting efficiency, data quality, and process outcomes.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite, with exposure to process mining, creative visualization, digitization, and automation.


**What We Offer:**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We serve Service Line Quality teams globally and support Assurance Quality Review processes through reporting, analysis, dashboarding, automation, and process enablement. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on quality\-focused initiatives and work with stakeholders from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous Learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next
* Success As Defined By You: We’ll provide tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact
* Transformative Leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs
* Diverse and Inclusive Culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Requisition Number:

**Senior Service Desk Data Analyst**
**Location:** 
 This is a hybrid opportunity in Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram area.
   

  

**Insight at a Glance**
* 14,000\+ engaged teammates globally with operations in 25 countries across the globe.
* Received 35\+ industry and partner awards in the past year
* $9\.2 billion in revenue
* \#20 on Fortune’s World's Best Workplaces™ list
* \#14 on Forbes World's Best Employers in IT – 2023
* \#23 on Forbes Best Employers for Women in IT\- 2023
* $1\.4M\+ total charitable contributions in 2023 by Insight globally


 Now is the time to bring your expertise to Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people\-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a
 **Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator** 
 with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organisations through complex digital decisions.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior Service Desk Data Analyst / Program Operations Coordinator is responsible for delivering high\-impact analytics, KPI reporting, and operational insights across global Service Desk operations, supporting both Incidents and Service Requests.
   

  

 This is a highly analytics\-driven role, focused on measuring and improving key service desk performance metrics including MTTR, ASA, FLR, FCR, CSAT, and SLA compliance. In addition, the role supports program operations coordination, ensuring smooth execution of deliverables, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong ServiceNow data expertise, Power BI dashboarding, ITSM knowledge, and analytical problem\-solving skills, with the ability to communicate insights effectively to US\-based stakeholders and clients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilitiies**
* Service Desk Analytics \& KPI Ownership (Primary Focus)
+ Analyze ServiceNow ticket data (Incidents and Requests) to identify trends, anomalies, and improvement opportunities
+ Own and report on key service desk KPIs:
+ MTTR (Mean Time to Resolve)
+ ASA (Average Speed of Answer)
+ FLR (First Level Resolution)
+ FCR (First Contact Resolution)
+ CSAT (Customer Satisfaction)
+ SLA compliance and breach trends
+ Perform detailed analysis across:
+ Ticket volume drivers and demand patterns
+ Category/subcategory trends
+ Assignment group performance
+ Escalation and reassignment (boomerang) patterns
+ Identify and drive shift\-left opportunities through data insights
+ Deliver actionable recommendations to improve efficiency, SLA attainment, and customer experience
+ Prepare and present weekly, monthly, and executive (QBR) reports

* Dashboarding, Reporting \& Automation
+ Design and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards with drill\-down capabilities
+ Automate recurring reports using Power BI, Power Query, and Excel
+ Build scalable and standardized data models and reporting frameworks
+ Continuously improve reporting processes to reduce manual effort and enhance accuracy

* Data Quality \& Governance
+ Ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of ServiceNow data
+ Define and maintain standard KPI definitions and reporting logic
+ Perform data validation, reconciliation, and audit checks
+ Align reporting outputs with real\-world service desk operations (ticket lifecycle, reassignment logic, SLA rules)

* Program Operations Coordination (Secondary Focus)
+ Support execution of service improvement programs and operational initiatives
+ Track deliverables, timelines, risks, and dependencies
+ Maintain program documentation and reporting trackers
+ Support budget tracking and variance analysis
+ Coordinate across global teams (US, India, other regions)

* Stakeholder Communication \& Client Interaction
+ Translate data insights into clear, business\-focused narratives
+ Present findings to US\-based stakeholders, leadership, and clients
+ Provide recommendations backed by data and track execution outcomes
+ Support client\-facing reporting and discussions

* Advanced Analytics \& GenAI Enablement
+ Utilize Generative AI tools to enhance:
+ Data analysis and insight generation
+ Reporting and executive summaries
+ Documentation and process automation
+ Explore predictive analytics and proactive reporting opportunitie

* Be AmbITious: This opportunity is not just about what you do today but also about where you can go tomorrow. When you bring your hunger, heart, and harmony to Insight, your potential will be met with continuous opportunities to upskill, earn promotions, and elevate your career.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or related field
* 4\+ years of experience in data analysis within IT Service Desk or IT Operations
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* ServiceNow reporting and data analysis
* Power BI (dashboard development, data modeling)
* Advanced Excel (Power Query, PivotTables, formulas)
* Strong understanding of KPIs:
* MTTR, ASA, FLR, FCR, CSAT, SLA management
* Proven ability to deliver insight\-driven reporting (not just data extraction)
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills (verbal and written English)
* Experience working with global stakeholders (especially US clients)
* Ability to work in US time zone alignment (shift flexibility required)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with SQL and/or Python for analytics
* Experience in Managed Service Provider (MSP) environments
* Familiarity with ITIL framework and service management best practices
* Exposure to forecasting, capacity planning, or predictive analytics
* Experience supporting multi\-region/global service desk operations


**What You Can Expect**
 We’re legendary for taking care of you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. We want you to enjoy a full, meaningful life and own your career at Insight. Some of our benefits include:
   

  

* Freedom to work from another location—even an international destination—for up to 30 consecutive calendar days per year.
* Medical Insurance
* Health Benefits
* Professional Development: Learning Platform and Certificate Reimbursement
* Shift Allowance


 But what really sets us apart are our core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony, which guide everything we do, from building relationships with teammates, partners, and clients to making a positive impact in our communities.
   

  

**Join us today, your ambITious journey starts here.**
 When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
   

  

 At Insight, we celebrate diversity of skills and experience so even if you don’t feel like your skills are a perfect match \- we still want to hear from you!

Unsolicited resumes will be treated as direct applications from the candidate, and recruiters or agencies who submit candidates for this position without a prior, written vendor agreement will not be eligible for any form of compensation, even if the candidate is hired.***
