title: Consultant - Digital Strategy, Customer Experience & Analytics
description:
**What makes Gartner Consulting a GREAT fit for you?**
 A career at Gartner Consulting will be unlike any other you have experienced. Not only are we passionate about technology and its applications, but we are also committed to attracting the most creative, talented, and self\-driven people to take our well\-regarded Consulting function to a whole new level. When you join Gartner, you will be a part of some of the most innovative business and technology efforts in the marketplace today. We are technology thought leaders for the 21st century. You can expect to connect technology innovations, data\-driven insights and automation to the strategic requirements of an organization and to the commercial needs of a business, all within the context of a rapidly evolving digital economy. Consulting associates enjoy a collaborative work environment, exceptional training, and career development opportunities. If you thrive on solving complex business challenges with technology, Gartner Consulting is the place for you.
   

  

**About Role:**
 Gartner Consulting is looking for a Consultant who will work with some of the world’s largest enterprises to shape digital roadmaps, assess and improve customer experience, design data\-driven performance insights, and implement technology\-enabled transformation priorities. The role will combine digital and technology consulting with hands\-on dashboarding, analytics and automation, leveraging Gartner’s market\-leading research and benchmarks.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Work on consulting engagements for some of the world’s largest enterprises on their mission\-critical priorities, including dashboarding and analytics, digital transformation, customer experience improvement and technology\-enabled change that help clients improve business outcomes and accelerate value realization.
* Develop and demonstrate deep expertise in areas such as Digital Transformation, Enterprise Technology Strategy, Customer Experience Assessment, Digital Benchmarking, Dashboarding and Analytics, Automation, and Transformation Program Assurance.
* Understand client industry issues, exhibit structured problem\-solving ability, and develop insights and recommendations based on in\-depth research, Gartner benchmarks, client interviews, customer and operational data, and relevant market trends.
* Design executive dashboards, scorecards and reporting frameworks that translate business, customer and operational data into actionable insights for senior stakeholders.
* Develop and automate analytical and reporting solutions using Power BI, Power Platform, Excel and other relevant tools, improving the quality, consistency and timeliness of management information.
* Define key performance indicators, measurement frameworks and data requirements aligned to strategic priorities, customer outcomes and transformation objectives.
* Analyze business, customer and operational data to identify trends, root causes, performance gaps and opportunities for improvement, using independent judgment to shape recommendations.
* Conduct customer experience assessments, customer journey analyses, stakeholder interviews and workshops to identify pain points, service gaps, process inefficiencies and digital improvement opportunities.
* Support the development of digital and technology strategies, maturity assessments, operating models, business cases, transformation roadmaps and program assurance reviews.
* Use AI\-enabled tools and techniques to accelerate research, synthesis, benchmarking, analysis, ideation and executive\-ready deliverables, while applying appropriate quality control, source validation, confidentiality and human judgment.
* Prepare high\-quality outputs in the form of executive presentations, dashboards, transformation roadmaps, business cases and written recommendations, communicating results using hypothesis testing, storyboarding and data visualization techniques.
* Work with globally distributed teams of consultants on client engagements and intellectual property development across multiple industry and technology domains, and support junior colleagues with research, analysis, dashboard development, story lining and deliverable quality.


**What you’ll need:**
* 3\-5 years of total experience in strategy consulting, digital transformation, technology advisory, customer experience, business analytics, performance management, enterprise architecture, product strategy, IT strategy or related roles, preferably with exposure to large enterprise clients.
* 2\+ years of experience delivering digital or technology transformation, analytics and dashboarding, customer experience improvement, operating model, program assurance or related consulting engagements.
* Experience delivering consulting engagements and recommending valuable insights using customer journey mapping, customer experience or digital maturity assessments, business capability assessment, benchmarking, prioritization and roadmap development.
* Demonstrated hands\-on ability to design dashboards, scorecards, analytical models and automated reporting solutions using Power BI, Power Platform, Excel, SQL or similar analytics and visualization tools.
* Experience translating business and stakeholder requirements into meaningful KPIs, measurement frameworks, data requirements and executive performance views, with the ability to interpret data and communicate practical implications.
* Demonstrated understanding of digital transformation, customer experience, automation, cloud, data platforms, digital products and enterprise technology platforms, with the ability to translate technology opportunities into practical business and transformation actions.
* Experience using AI\-enabled productivity tools to improve research, synthesis, analysis, ideation, deliverable creation and speed\-to\-insight, with strong attention to accuracy, source validation, client confidentiality and responsible use.
* Passionate about technology; tracks latest trends and their potential use to solve complex business problems, improve customer outcomes, automate processes and strengthen digital capabilities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills in a global environment, with the ability to collaborate continuously with cross\-border teams and engage business, technology and data stakeholders.
* A curious and inquisitive mind, with openness to new experiences and learning, strong problem\-solving ability, client focus and the versatility to work effectively across strategy, analytics, customer experience and transformation topics.
* Ability to create executive\-ready dashboards and deliverables with clear storyline, data\-backed recommendations, structured logic and practical next steps; Bachelor’s degree required, with an MBA or advanced degree in business, technology, engineering, analytics, computer science or a related field preferred.


**Who you are:**
* Self\-starter and quick learner who demonstrates ownership, intellectual curiosity and a strong commitment to client impact.
* Strong consultative skills and problem\-solving ability, with the confidence to structure ambiguous problems, analyze data and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
* Passionate about technology and helping clients improve customer and business outcomes through digital transformation, analytics, automation and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Comfortable combining hands\-on dashboard and analytical delivery with broader digital and technology consulting, and using AI\-enabled methods responsibly to improve productivity, quality and speed of delivery.
* Able to work effectively with senior stakeholders, engagement managers and globally distributed consulting teams across business, technology, customer experience and data topics.
* High\-performing and versatile team player with strong intercultural communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* Willing to coach and support junior team members, helping them improve consulting craft, analytical rigor, dashboard development, AI\-enabled productivity and deliverable quality.


**What Gartner Consulting will offer you?**
* A world\-class consulting environment.
* The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge dashboarding, analytics, customer experience, digital transformation and IT strategy engagements with a tier one client portfolio.
* A competitive salary.
* Structured bonus based on individual and corporate performance.
* Opportunities for promotion with a clearly defined career development structure.
* Opportunity to participate actively in the development and future of Gartner Consulting.
* A dynamic but relaxed and supportive working environment that encourages personal development.


**About Gartner:**
 Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT) is the world’s leading information technology research and advisory company. We deliver the technology\-related insight necessary for our clients to make the right decisions, every day. We work with every client to research, analyze and interpret the business of IT within the context of their individual role. Founded in 1979, Gartner is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, U.S.A. – Visit gartner.com to discover more.

 Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
   

  

 We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

 We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
   

  

**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
 At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

title: Anaplan Integration Analyst
description:
**The Role:**




 The Integration Data Analyst plays a key role in maintaining and optimising Anaplan data integrations that support FP\&A processes. Responsible for monitoring data flows, resolving integration issues, supporting testing and ongoing maintenance, the role ensures reliable data for forecasting, budgeting, and decision\-making. Working closely with technology, data, and FP\&A teams, the position supports solution releases, drives continuous improvement, enhances integration processes, and ensures Anaplan data pipelines remain robust, accurate, and aligned with evolving business needs.
 



  





**Accountabilities:**




**Monitor and remediate integration of inbound and outbound data** 



* Oversee Anaplan interfaces, data refreshes, system integrations, and EPM Fast Track configurations, ensuring reliable data flows, timely issue resolution, and seamless connectivity across SAP, Salesforce, Tempus, MDM, Datahub, Azure, and Synapse platforms.



  





**Provide Anaplan application support** 



* Deliver application support, troubleshoot system issues, manage and test data integrations, resolve errors, ensure stable and accurate data flows between Anaplan and source systems, and provide user training and guidance on platform functionality and integration best practices.



  





**Support project management and agile execution** 



* Contribute to Agile project delivery through sprint planning and execution, facilitate alignment between technical and business teams, proactively manage integration risks, and support product management in shaping the future direction of Anaplan data integration capabilities.



  





**Knowledge management – documentation and training** 



* Develop integration methodologies, best practices, training, and enablement programmes; advise stakeholders on optimal integration approaches; support adoption of new processes; establish KPIs to measure effectiveness; and promote a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance Anaplan data integration performance and business value.



  





**Technical Expertise** 



* Manage Anaplan integrations across SAP and Azure data platforms, understand multidimensional data structures, apply FP\&A knowledge in planning and forecasting, and leverage advanced Excel, Power BI, and reporting skills to support effective financial analysis and decision\-making.



  





**Role specific knowledge and experience:** 




**Essential:** 



* Extensive knowledge and experience of data management and governance.
* Experience in advising technology teams on integration best practices
* Operational knowledge of large\-scale ERP system
* Understanding and some knowledge of accounting standards
* Experience of working with diverse stakeholders in a global organisation.
* Experience of reporting metrics and to monitor compliance and outcomes.
* Deep understanding on Anaplan or similar planning tools architecture



  





**Desirable:** 



* Anaplan Model Builder qualification (any level).
* Finance qualifications – ACCA / CIMA etc
* Experience working with SAP products, especially SAP ECC
* Experience of the transactional and bulk Anaplan APIs
* Strong programming skills



  





**Role specific skills:** 



* Data integration skills, including data mapping and process design skills.
* Building relationships at all levels of the organisation
* Excellent analytical and data skills along with strong planning and organisational skills are required.
* Flexibility, independence, and initiative to perform successfully in a global and rapidly changing environment.

description: Business Intelligence Analyst (Minimum Five years of total experience): We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Business Intelligence Analyst who is passionate about transforming innovative ideas into effective, data\-driven solutions. title: BI and Data Analyst
description:
### **Description**

  

We are looking for an FP\&A BI Analyst to join our finance team at an exciting moment in our growth as a business, to build and own the reporting and analytics that power financial decision making across the Group.  

The FP\&A BI Analyst will sit at the intersection of finance and data, turning information held in Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and Dynamics 365 into clear, reliable and commercially relevant insight. The role is responsible for designing and maintaining our financial reporting suite, automating manual processes, and ensuring a single trusted version of the numbers. The successful candidate will combine strong technical data skills with genuine financial understanding and the ability to translate complexity into something non\-finance stakeholders can act on.### **Key Responsibilities**

 **Data \& Platform*** Build, maintain and optimise financial data models and pipelines within Microsoft Fabric, ensuring accuracy, performance and scalability
* Own the flow of financial and operational data from Dynamics 365 into the reporting environment, resolving issues at source wherever possible
* Partner with IT and Data teams to align on architecture, governance, security and data quality standards

  

**Reporting \& Visualisation*** Design, build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that are clear, intuitive and support business decision making
* Automate recurring management reporting, replacing manual Excel processes with sustainable, well controlled solutions
* Develop robust DAX measures and a well\-documented semantic model that acts as a single source of truth for financial data
* Understand the business model and value driving levers to ensure reporting reflects what genuinely matters to the business

  

**Analysis \& Decision Support*** Support delivery of the monthly reporting pack, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and clarity
* Develop and track KPIs to measure business performance, including revenue, cost and headcount analysis (A vs. B)
* Support preparation of presentations for senior leadership and board reviews
* Provide ad hoc analysis, scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis as required

  

**Stakeholder Engagement*** Work closely with FP\&A, Financial Control and the wider business to understand reporting needs and translate them into practical, scalable solutions
* Act as a trusted point of contact for reporting queries, building confidence in the numbers across the organisation

  

**Governance \& Compliance*** Ensure data controls, reporting policies and change management processes are adhered to
* Maintain clear documentation of data sources, definitions and report logic to support auditability and continuity

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Required attributes:*** Demonstrable hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Warehouse or equivalent)
* Strong Power BI and wider Power Platform skills, including advanced DAX, Power Query and dimensional data modelling
* Practical experience working with Dynamics 365 finance data, including its structure and reporting implications
* Experience gained working directly within a Finance function, or in close partnership with one, is strongly preferred
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate data into meaningful insight
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong Excel skills and a solid grounding in core financial concepts including P\&L, balance sheet, budgeting and forecasting

Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with multiple competing priorities  
* 

**Desirable attributes:*** Experience in a PE\-backed or fast\-growth environment advantageous
* Part\-qualified or qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent), or a finance or data related degree
* Familiarity with SQL, Power Automate, Python or version control / deployment pipelines

  

### **What we offer**

  

Some of the benefits we include are:* Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.

To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.  

  

Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.### **About Aurora Energy Research**


From its academic roots, Aurora Energy Research is a thriving, rapidly growing company, currently serving over 1000 of the world’s most influential energy sector participants, including utilities, investors, and governments.  

  

While we constantly strive to reach new markets and diversify our product portfolio, we are already active across the globe in Asia\-Pacific, Latin America, Europe, South Africa and North America, working with leading organisations to provide comprehensive market intelligence, bespoke analytic and advisory services, and cutting\-edge software.  

  

We are a diverse team of experts with vast energy, financial, and consulting backgrounds, covering power, hydrogen, carbon, and fossil commodities. With this, we provide data\-driven intelligence to fuel strategic decisions in the global energy transformation.

title: Senior Associate, Digital Assets
description:
Tower Research Capital is a leading quantitative trading firm founded in 1998\. Tower has built its business on a high\-performance platform and independent trading teams. We have a 25\+ year track record of innovation and a reputation for discovering unique market opportunities.
   

  

 Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.
   

  

 Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low\-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.
   

  

 At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best.
   

  

 At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results\-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.
   

  

**Responsibilities :**
* Supporting day\-to\-day trading operations across multiple markets, venues, and counterparties, including account onboarding, KYC, account maintenance, and operational setup with external counterparties.
* Analyzing daily trade, position, cash, and transaction reconciliations, investigating breaks and driving timely resolution while maintaining accurate books and records.
* Coordinating cash, collateral, and asset movements across venues and banking partners, and ensuring trading accounts are appropriately configured for collateral, leverage, margin, and settlement requirements.
* Monitoring transaction and settlement activity, investigating and resolving failed or delayed movements, maintaining accurate books and records and reviewing and signing off daily P\&L while escalating discrepancies and key items to management.
* Collaborating with Trading, Finance, Compliance, Technology, and external counterparties to resolve operational issues and continuously improve workflows.
* Optimizing operational processes by automating manual activities, strengthening controls, and enhancing operational reporting.


**Qualifications:**
* A bachelor’s degree in economics, finance, or a related field; CFA certification or progress toward the CFA designation is a plus.
* At least 3–5 years of experience in capital markets or cryptocurrency operations.
* Expertise in Microsoft Excel, including lookups, PivotTables, and conditional statements.
* The ability to manage multiple priorities and transition seamlessly across diverse responsibilities while maintaining a high standard of quality and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and communication skills, with sound judgment and the ability to perform effectively under pressure.
* The ability to work in a fast\-paced, 24/7 market environment with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.


**Benefits:**
 Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.
   

  

 At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well\-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win.
   

  

 Our benefits include:
   

  

* Generous paid time off policies
* Savings plans and other financial wellness tools available in each region
* Hybrid working opportunities
* Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily
* In\-office wellness experiences and reimbursement for select wellness expenses (e.g., gym, personal training and more)
* Company\-sponsored sports teams and fitness events (JPM Corporate Challenge, Cycle for Survival, Wall Street Rides FAR and more)
* Volunteer opportunities and charitable giving
* Social events, happy hours, treats, and celebrations throughout the year
* Workshops and continuous learning opportunities


 At Tower, you’ll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together.
   

  

 Tower Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
Performance Marketer
 
  





**Company:** 
 IZGGI Mercado Private Limited
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time \| In\-House
 



**Location:** 
 New Delhi
 



**Experience:** 
 2–4 Years
 



**Department:** 
 Growth \& Marketing
 



  




 About IZGGI
 
 IZGGI is a growing fashion and lifestyle brand focused on building a strong digital\-first presence and delivering products that customers love.
 



 We are looking for a
 **Performance Marketer** 
 to join our in\-house team and take ownership of our paid marketing efforts across platforms. This role is ideal for someone who is highly data\-driven, commercially minded, and comfortable taking complete ownership of campaign performance.
 



  




 The Role
 
 As a Performance Marketer, you will be responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and scaling paid acquisition campaigns with a strong focus on
 **profitable growth and revenue generation** 
 .
 



 You will work closely with the Creative, Growth, E\-commerce, and Management teams to turn data and insights into campaigns that acquire customers efficiently and scale revenue.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Paid Advertising
 * Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across
 **Meta Ads and Google Ads** 
 .
* Manage campaign budgets and allocate spending based on performance.
* Build and manage prospecting, retargeting, and customer acquisition campaigns.
* Continuously test audiences, creatives, offers, placements, and campaign structures.
* Identify opportunities to scale high\-performing campaigns while maintaining profitability.
* Monitor campaign performance and take corrective action when performance declines.



  




 2\. Performance \& Growth
 * Own key performance metrics including
 **ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR, AOV, and revenue** 
 .
* Track and improve overall customer acquisition efficiency.
* Understand the difference between platform\-level ROAS and actual business profitability.
* Analyse new vs. returning customer performance.
* Work towards improving the overall
 **Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER)** 
 .
* Identify growth opportunities across products, audiences, campaigns, and channels.



  




 3\. Creative Testing
 * Work closely with the Creative Team to develop performance\-driven ad concepts.
* Identify winning creative angles, hooks, formats, products, and messaging.
* Establish a structured creative testing process.
* Analyse creative\-level performance and provide actionable feedback to the creative team.
* Continuously refresh creatives to prevent ad fatigue.



  




 4\. Analytics \& Reporting
 * Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly campaign performance.
* Prepare regular performance reports with clear insights and action points.
* Analyse campaign, product, audience, and customer\-level data.
* Use
 **GA4, Shopify Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and spreadsheets** 
 to analyse performance.
* Maintain accurate UTM and campaign tracking.
* Identify tracking or attribution issues and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them.



  




 5\. Conversion Optimization
 * Analyse the complete customer journey from
 **ad → landing page → product page → checkout → purchase** 
 .
* Identify conversion drop\-offs and recommend improvements.
* Work with the E\-commerce/Technology team on landing\-page and website optimization.
* Test offers, product positioning, landing pages, and other conversion opportunities.



  




 6\. D2C \& Commercial Understanding
 
 The candidate should understand the commercial side of performance marketing, including:
 


* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Contribution Margin
* Break\-even ROAS
* Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
* Repeat Purchase Rate
* COD vs. prepaid performance
* RTO impact
* New vs. returning customers
* Overall profitability



 The objective is
 **not simply to generate sales, but to generate profitable and sustainable growth.** 




  




 Required Skills
 * 2–4 years of hands\-on experience in Performance Marketing.
* Strong experience with
 **Meta Ads Manager** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **Google Ads** 
 .
* Experience working with
 **D2C / e\-commerce brands** 
 is highly preferred.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Good understanding of GA4 and Shopify Analytics.
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, events, and attribution.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Ability to interpret data and turn insights into actions.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing funnels.
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills.


- 

 Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience managing a significant monthly advertising budget.
* Experience scaling a D2C/fashion/e\-commerce brand.
* Experience with Performance Max and Google Shopping.
* Understanding of Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and server\-side tracking.
* Experience with A/B testing and CRO.
* Experience working closely with creative teams.
* Experience with marketing dashboards and reporting tools.



  




 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Thinks in
 **numbers and outcomes** 
 , not just activities.
* Takes ownership of campaign performance.
* Can explain
 *why* 
 a campaign is working or failing.
* Is comfortable experimenting and testing new ideas.
* Understands that high ROAS does not always mean high profitability.
* Can work independently and make data\-backed decisions.
* Moves quickly and adapts to changing performance.
* Wants to build and scale something rather than simply manage an existing account.



  




 Key Performance Indicators
 
 Your performance will primarily be evaluated on:
 


* Revenue generated through paid channels
* CAC / CPA
* ROAS
* Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER)
* Conversion Rate
* AOV
* New Customer Acquisition
* Contribution to overall profitable growth
* Quality and speed of campaign optimization
* Creative testing velocity and learnings



  




 Why Join IZGGI?
 * Work directly with the core growth and management team.
* Own a meaningful part of the brand's growth journey.
* Build and execute strategies rather than simply follow an agency's plan.
* Work closely with creative, e\-commerce, and technology teams.
* Opportunity to take significant ownership as the brand scales.



  




 Application
 
 Candidates should share their
 **CV along with details of the brands/accounts they have managed, approximate monthly ad spend handled, and key performance results achieved.** 




 Candidates who can demonstrate
 **actual revenue growth, efficient customer acquisition, and successful scaling of campaigns** 
 will be strongly preferred.

* Exposure to ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.

**What We Look For**
* A team player with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and eagerness to learn in a fast\-paced environment.
* Opportunities to collaborate with EY Advisory teams globally and work with leading businesses across industries.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, you will work on inspiring and meaningful projects with some of the world’s top companies. title: Senior Associate
description:
**Senior Associate, Accounting Transformation** 




**Role Summary** 




 The Accounting Transformation team partners with clients to improve, remediate, and modernize their accounting operations. As a Senior Associate, you will assess accounting processes, financial data, and reporting practices to identify risks, compliance gaps, and operational inefficiencies. You will lead accounting remediation initiatives, including financial statement clean\-up, account reconciliations, GAAP adjustments, close process documentation, and implementation of scalable accounting practices.
 



 This is a project\-based individual contributor role focused on transforming accounting functions and delivering sustainable outcomes. Success is measured by the quality, accuracy, and completeness of the accounting records, reconciliations, and close processes you leave behind.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Accounting Assessment \& Analysis** 



* Evaluate accounting policies, procedures, controls, and reporting practices for compliance with US GAAP.
* Review transaction cycles, including revenue, procure\-to\-pay, payroll, and month\-end close processes.
* Identify accounting risks, reporting issues, control gaps, and operational inefficiencies.
* Assess the quality of the general ledger, chart of accounts, and underlying financial data.
* Document findings and develop remediation plans to address identified issues.



**Accounting Remediation \& Transformation** 



* Perform accounting clean\-up initiatives, including historical corrections, opening balance sheet reconstruction, and cash\-to\-accrual conversions.
* Prepare and post adjusting journal entries supported by appropriate calculations and documentation.
* Apply US GAAP guidance across key accounting areas, including revenue recognition, deferred revenue, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, leases, and equity.
* Rebuild or optimize chart of accounts structures and support financial data remediation efforts.
* Research accounting issues and prepare supporting analysis and documentation.



**Reconciliations \& Close Process Development** 



* Perform balance sheet reconciliations and resolve outstanding reconciling items.
* Develop and document month\-end close procedures, workflows, and control activities.
* Create workpapers, reconciliation templates, supporting schedules, and audit\-ready documentation.
* Establish repeatable and scalable close processes that can be maintained by ongoing accounting teams.
* Transition completed engagements to Exbo's Controllership team through comprehensive documentation and knowledge transfer.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* CPA, CA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* 3 \+ years of accounting experience in public accounting, controllership, accounting operations, or financial reporting.
* Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting research methodologies.
* Experience managing full\-cycle month\-end close activities and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Hands\-on experience preparing and posting adjusting journal entries.
* Advanced Excel skills, including large data analysis, pivot tables, lookup functions, and Power Query.
* Strong written communication skills with the ability to create clear process documentation.
* High attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to producing accurate, audit\-ready work.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects with limited supervision.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience assessing and redesigning accounting processes and controls.
* Hands\-on experience with QuickBooks Online.
* Experience with accounting clean\-ups, first\-audit readiness projects, or finance transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting US\-based clients and working within US GAAP reporting environments.
* Experience with venture\-backed, private equity\-backed, or high\-growth companies.



**Success in This Role** 



* Deliver accurate, reconciled, and GAAP\-compliant financial records.
* Create sustainable accounting processes and audit\-ready documentation.
* Independently manage engagements from assessment through transition.
* Enable ongoing accounting teams to execute a repeatable and well\-documented close process with confidence.

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
 We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.
   

  

**What To Know**

* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.


 If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
   

  

**About Commvault**
 Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI\-powered platform combines best\-in\-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning\-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.
   

  

**Senior Engineer\- DevOps**
**The Opportunity**
 We have an outstanding career opportunity for Senior Engineer\- DevOps at Bangalore, Hyderabad and Pune locations to join the Hyperscale (HSX) Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have strong software development, automation, infrastructure, and system\-level troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work across complex distributed environments spanning compute, storage, networking, virtualization, containers, and cloud platforms.
   

  

 In this role, you will design and develop automation frameworks, enhance provisioning and deployment capabilities, troubleshoot complex product and customer issues, and contribute to improving the reliability, scalability, serviceability, and overall quality of the Hyperscale platform. You will collaborate closely with development, QA, support, field engineering, and other cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality solutions and resolve complex customer issues.
   

  

**What You’ll Do…**
* Design, develop, and maintain automation using Python, Shell scripting, and Ansible for server provisioning, configuration, deployment, upgrades, and patching of Hyperscale environments.
* Develop reusable Ansible roles, modules, and playbooks to standardize and simplify product deployment and infrastructure configuration.
* Build and enhance automation frameworks for deploying and configuring distributed system components.
* Automate deployment and configuration of technologies such as HAProxy, Corosync, and other clustering, high\-availability, and monitoring components.
* Develop and maintain automation for S3 deployment, configuration, and validation/testing.
* Deploy and validate software across multiple operating systems and hardware configurations to ensure compatibility and reliability.
* Work with modern bare\-metal provisioning frameworks such as RackN and extend existing frameworks when required.
* Develop tools and scripts that improve engineering productivity, diagnostics, deployment, testing, and operational efficiency.
* Navigate and maintain existing C\+\+ and XML\-based codebases, making targeted enhancements and fixes when required.
* Effectively use AI\-assisted software development tools, including GitHub Copilot and similar technologies, to accelerate development, code understanding, debugging, test creation, and modernization of legacy components.
* Design and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions for provisioning and managing development and test environments.
* Automate creation, modification, and deletion of virtual machines and infrastructure resources on VMware and Hyper\-V.
* Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot containerized workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
* Develop infrastructure automation using Python libraries and frameworks such as Boto3, Paramiko, Fabric, and PyYAML.
* Configure and troubleshoot compute, storage, and networking resources across cloud, virtualized, and on\-premises environments.
* Automate bare\-metal operating system and HSX ISO installation using PXE/network boot technologies, including RackN and Cobbler.
* Use Git\-based development workflows for source control, collaboration, code reviews, and release management
* Product Engineering, Troubleshooting \& Customer Issue Resolution. Analyze system logs, application logs, crash information, error reports, network behavior, storage behavior, and performance metrics to identify root causes.
* Build and maintain engineering environments for functional, integration, regression, upgrade, and compatibility testing across major and minor product releases.
* Validate product functionality across supported hardware platforms, operating systems, hypervisors, cloud environments, and infrastructure configurations.


**Who You Are…**
* Bachelor's degree required.
* 4 or more Years of experience.
* Strong software development experience with Python and Shell scripting.
* Hands\-on experience with configuration management and automation technologies, particularly Ansible.
* Strong understanding of Linux operating systems, system administration, networking, storage, and distributed system concepts.
* Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware and/or Hyper\-V.
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and/or OpenShift.
* Experience developing infrastructure and system automation using Python libraries such as Boto3, Paramiko, Fabric, or PyYAML.
* Familiarity with bare\-metal provisioning and network boot technologies such as PXE, RackN, or Cobbler.
* Working knowledge of Git and modern software development workflows.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex issues across application and infrastructure layers.
* Ability to read and understand existing C\+\+ and XML code and make targeted changes when required.
* Experience troubleshooting production or customer environments and performing detailed root\-cause analysis (RCA).
* Enterprise storage, backup, recovery, or data\-management platforms preferred.
* Security and SaaS experience strongly preferred.


**You’ll Love Working Here Because**
* Employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
* Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
* Annual health check\-ups, Car lease Program, and Tuition Reimbursement
* An inclusive company culture, an opportunity to join our Community Guilds

title: Senior Software Engineer - Kubernetes & ServiceMesh
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.
 
  
 


**Roku is changing how the world watches TV** 

 Roku is the \#1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
 



 From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable \- and valued \- contribution. We're a fast\-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
 



  
 



**About the Role**

  
 





 Join us in building Roku’s next\-generation
 
**cloud\-agnostic platform**

 that powers Kubernetes and service mesh at scale. If you’re passionate about designing resilient infrastructure, automating deployments, and enabling hundreds of workloads across multiple regions, this role is for you. You’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies like Kubernetes, Istio, Envoy, Terraform, modern observability stacks and collaborate with teams worldwide to deliver a unified hosting experience.
 

  
 





 If you’re passionate about deep platform and infrastructure engineering, solving complex scaling challenges, and enabling teams through elegant, automated solutions—this role is for you.
 

  
 




**About the Team**

  
 





 Our Cloud Compute Platform
 


 Engineering team is at the heart of Roku’s transformation toward a single, unified platform. We design and scale Kubernetes clusters, service mesh architecture, and supporting systems to ensure all engineering teams speak the same infrastructure language. We partner with internal teams to migrate workloads, enhance CI/CD pipelines, and integrate observability and security into every layer of the stack. Collaboration and impact are core to what we do.
 

  
 




**What You’ll Be Doing**

  
 



* Architect, design, and deploy Roku’s next\-generation cloud platform and service mesh.
* Build and own solutions to Roku's compute problems using Docker, Kubernetes, Istio/Envoy, Terraform and scripting to evolve our tech stack and deployments.
* Proactively drive the research and implementation of new technologies to enhance scalability, reliability, and developer experience.
* Integrate security best practices into infrastructure design and automation.
* Build tooling to visualize inefficiencies and optimize costs across shared\-tenancy clusters, including network traffic insights, cross\-cluster communication efficiency, and cost attribution.
* Collaborate with internal teams to migrate workloads to Kubernetes \+ Istio, leveraging open\-source observability tools.
* Work closely with the Observability team to scale monitoring and logging solutions for a holistic view of the platform.
* Leverage SRE principles to maintain high availability and streamline onboarding workflows.
* Mentor team members and help define best practices for infrastructure and automation.



**We’re Excited If You Have**

  
 



* Strong hands\-on experience with cloud technologies (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure is a plus), specifically in architecting and managing performant, large\-scale systems handling significant traffic/data.
* Deep knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS, or similar) and service mesh technologies.
* Proficiency in Go or another programming language, Python or another scripting language.
* Experience designing infrastructure and building automation tools, while collaborating with internal team members and external stakeholders.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines and following modern deployment practices.
* Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, etc.).
* Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Passion for learning and solving complex infrastructure challenges.
* Experience integrating AI tools to improve processes and reduce operational toil (a plus).
* Master’s degree or equivalent experience (8\+ years preferred).



  
 



  
 


**Our Hybrid Work Approach** 

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy.
 



  
 


**Benefits** 

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 



  
 


**Accommodations** 

 Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
 



  
 


**The Roku Culture** 

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.
 



 We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem\-solvers, which itself is a two\-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002\.
 



 To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.
 



 By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

title: Sr. Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Cybersecurity is at the beating heart of our culture. Our diligence and expertise are what make us the undisputed leader in electronic payments. We've made it our priority to create a top\-tier Cyber Engineering \& Operations team, poised to defend us against any potential cyber threats. We're looking for those of you who are inherently driven and fascinated by the art and science of Cybersecurity. We'll arm you with the very best tools and tech so that you can deliver top notch results.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Analyst with a strong development background to join our cybersecurity team. In this role, you will lead the identification, prioritization, and remediation of vulnerabilities across our cloud\-native infrastructure, containerized workloads, and application environments. You will combine deep engineering expertise with security leadership to architect scalable automation, expand scanning coverage, mentor junior team members, and partner with engineering teams and senior stakeholders to drive risk reduction at scale.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Be a vulnerability management champion by leading the discovery, assessment, prioritization, and remediation of vulnerabilities across cloud, container, and host infrastructure at Visa.
* Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle management of security scanning, including deployment, configuration, coverage expansion, policy tuning, upgrades, and ongoing optimization to ensure accurate and complete scanning across all environments.
* Lead and facilitate vulnerability assessments, scan result analysis, and finding validation throughout the development and deployment lifecycle; eliminate false positives and provide clear, actionable remediation guidance to development and platform teams.
* Architect the integration of vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines in conjunction with engineering teams to enable shift\-left security, establishing security gates, image policies, and automated checks that prevent vulnerable images from reaching production.
* You'll be working on securing and assessing various platforms and technologies which protect Visa's environments from vulnerabilities and attacks like:
+ Cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, GCP, including cloud\-native services, IAM, and CSPM practices
+ Container and orchestration technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, container registries, admission controllers, and runtime security
+ Vulnerability management tools like Qualys, Prisma Cloud, Tenable, Rapid7, Wiz, Trivy, Grype
+ CI/CD and DevOps tooling like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Artifactory
+ Programming and automation languages like Python, Bash, Go, and REST API integrations
+ AI/ML and LLM\-based tools like AI coding assistants, automated triage engines, and security copilots
+ Threat and exploitability intelligence sources like EPSS, CISA KEV, CVE/CVSS, vendor advisories

* Automate security tools and processes ensuring innovation and advancement strategies that keep pace in the areas of vulnerability triage, enrichment, ticketing, remediation orchestration, and metrics/reporting.
* Apply risk\-based prioritization leveraging threat intelligence, exploitability data, and asset criticality to provide recommended countermeasures or mitigating controls that reduce risk to an acceptable and manageable level.
* Track and report on vulnerability metrics, SLAs, and remediation trends for engineering leadership, security management, and compliance stakeholders.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior security engineers and analysts across the team.
* Help business and product teams achieve and maintain various compliance certifications like PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* 5\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD OR 8\+ years of relevant work experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 years of relevant work experience with a PhD.
* Have significant hands\-on experience in vulnerability management, application security, or a related security engineering role, with a strong development background.
* Have strong proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and API integrations to streamline and scale security workflows.
* Have deep experience with containers (Docker or similar), including image scanning, hardening, and registry security.
* Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes, including architecture, workloads, security configurations, RBAC, and common misconfigurations.
* Extensive experience securing and assessing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including cloud\-native services and Identity and Access Management concepts.
* A proven record of accomplishment operating and managing vulnerability scanning and management tools such as Prisma Cloud, Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Wiz, Trivy, Grype, etc., including tool lifecycle ownership.
* Strong understanding of CVE/CVSS scoring, exploitability analysis, and risk\-based prioritization.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g. Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating security scanning into pipelines to drive shift\-left practices across engineering teams.
* Have experience applying AI/ML or LLM\-based tools to security workflows, such as automated vulnerability triage, false\-positive reduction, or remediation recommendations, and familiarity with securing AI/ML systems (e.g. OWASP Top 10 for LLMs).
* Relevant certifications such as CKS, CKA, AWS/Azure/GCP security certifications, OSCP, GCSA, or CISSP.
* Experience working in the payments industry or other regulated environments such as financial services, healthcare, or government.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical risk to engineers, leadership, and non\-technical audiences, and experience mentoring or guiding junior team members.


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:

 For this role JiBe requires a hands\-on engineer operating at the intersection of IT operations, Site Reliability Engineering, and security engineering. The environment is Azure\-first and automation\-first, with AWS as a secondary cloud. You will build and run reliable, secure, automated infrastructure for a multi\-client organization — owning the systems day to day rather than directing others to. Priorities, in order: Azure depth, an automation\-first instinct, hands\-on security engineering, and reliability ownership. AWS, formal compliance ownership, and team leadership are not the focus of this role.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities** 




**Site Reliability Engineering** 



* Define and track SLOs/SLIs and error budgets for core services (Microsoft 365, internal applications, and client\-facing platforms).
* Build observability — metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics).
* Lead reliability\-focused incident response: detection, mitigation, blameless postmortems, and the follow\-up automation that prevents recurrence.
* Systematically reduce operational toil through automation; own platform capacity and performance.



**Automation \& Infrastructure as Code** 



* Author and maintain infrastructure as code (Pulumi, Terraform, or ARM) for Azure and for AWS where used.
* Build automation in PowerShell, Bash, and Python \- integrate with Microsoft Graph and cloud provider APIs.

* Implement and operate cloud security controls: Microsoft Defender (for Cloud and Endpoint), Microsoft Sentinel, Entra ID Conditional Access, Intune compliance, Key Vault, encryption, and network segmentation.
* Run vulnerability management and remediation; prioritize by business impact and coordinate patching with reliability work.

* Build detections, harden configurations, and automate response with SOAR\-style runbooks.



**Cloud Platform — Azure/AWS** 



* Azure \- Entra ID, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, Key Vault, networking, and Intune, landing\-zone hygiene and cloud security posture management.
* AWS \- IAM, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, Security Hub, and KMS for secondary workloads; maintain consistent posture and monitoring across both clouds.

**IT \& Endpoint / Identity Operations** 



* Hands\-on Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, Intune, Entra ID).

**Compliance Support** 



* Implement and evidence the technical controls that support the organization’s security compliance and audit requirements across frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR.
* Produce technical evidence for audits and automate evidence collection where possible.
* Support the compliance program with engineering; this role does not own governance or certification.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Technical Skills** 




**Cloud Platforms:** 



* Strong, hands\-on Azure across identity, security, networking, and governance — must\-have.
* Knowledge of AWS security \- IAM, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, Security Hub, and KMS.



**Automation \& Infrastructure as Code:** 



* PowerShell and/or Python, Pulumi or Terraform, Azure DevOps CI/CD, Microsoft Graph.
* An automation\-first mindset — codifying and scripting by default rather than working manually.



**Security Engineering:** 



* Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, and Entra ID with Conditional Access and PIM.
* Least\-privilege and zero\-trust patterns; vulnerability management and remediation.



**Site Reliability \& Observability:** 



* SLOs/SLIs, alerting, and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics).
* Incident response and blameless postmortems.



**Frameworks, Standards \& Supporting Tools:** 



* Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR.
* Microsoft 365 and Intune administration; FortiGate / FortiClient EMS.
* Exposure to Databricks, Power BI Embedded, or Microsoft Foundry is an advantage.

title: Azure Network Specialist
description:
ViaPlus is seeking a Senior Network SRE to own and drive the end\-to\-end architecture, reliability, security, and performance of enterprise\-scale network platforms across Microsoft Azure cloud and on\-premises data center environments. This role plays a critical part in ensuring that ViaPlus’ high\-volume, real\-time transaction systems remain highly available, resilient, and secure.
 



  





 This position will work closely with Infrastructure, DevOps, Security, Application, and Data teams to align network architecture with application performance, security requirements, and business objectives. The Senior Network SRE will also be responsible for driving automation, observability, and governance standards, contributing to capacity planning, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous reliability improvements.
 



  





**About Viaplus**

 :
 




 ViaPlus is a global mobility company in the Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) market, specializing in revenue and services management solutions for the transportation industry. Our customer operations, data analytics, and full\-featured single\-account back\-office technology facilitate the high\-volume transactions, required for seamless multimodal mobility. As a VINCI Concessions subsidiary, we are committed to technical innovation and to promoting a positive mobility experience for all. We are pioneers in the transportation transaction and mobility industry, with a decade of proven global experience in providing solutions focused on the tolling and transit industries.
 



  





 ViaPlus is headquartered near Dallas, Texas and maintains offices across the United States and in France, India, and Ireland. We are part of the global network of VINCI Concessions, an international player in transport infrastructure with projects in 23 countries. Our vision has evolved to provide a fully automated, end\-to\-end transportation solution that significantly improves revenue collection and efficiency while effectively lowering costs for our agency clients.
 



  





 We serve enterprises that require high\-volume, real\-time transactions processing with the highest levels of accuracy, especially where revenue reconciliation and customer account management are key deliverables to the customer experience. Our flagship back\-office system (BOS) enables Mobility\-as\-a\-Service (MaaS) with a “one account” feature that supports multimodal transportation solutions. In a rapidly\-changing environment, ViaPlus maintains a strong focus on technology and continuous R\&D to improve agency efficiencies, reduce operating expenses, and maximize revenue – all while providing exceptional customer service.
 



  





**About Indian Operations:**




 Plan, Design and Develop New Features for our Products \| Customize our product on request from our premium Clients \| Provide end\-to\-end IT Infrastructure set\-up and Maintenance for global Clients \| 24/7 Support and provide services to our ASP Clients
 



  





**Job Profile: Senior Network SRE**




**Experience: 6 \-10yrs**









**Job Responsibilities:**



* Design and implement scalable Azure network architectures (Hub\-Spoke, Landing Zones, vWAN).
* Build and manage hybrid connectivity solutions: ExpressRoute, VPN, VNet Peering, Private Link.
* Define North–South/East–West traffic flows, segmentation, and micro\-segmentation strategies.
* Create and maintain HLD/LLD designs, network diagrams, and architecture standards.
* Configure and optimize Azure Application Gateway, Azure Load Balancer (L4/L7\), and traffic routing.
* Implement SSL termination, path\-based routing, session affinity, and health probes.
* Deploy and tune Azure WAF (OWASP rules, custom rules, bot protection).
* Architect global solutions using Azure Front Door (CDN, edge security, global load balancing, multi\-region failover).
* Implement Zero Trust–aligned network security controls across cloud and on\-prem.
* Manage NSGs, ASGs, Azure Firewall, DDoS Protection, and threat detection workflows.
* Integrate network telemetry with SIEM/SOC tools (Azure Sentinel preferred).
* Lead capacity planning, performance tuning, and traffic engineering.
* Define and maintain SOPs, runbooks, best practices, and network governance.
* Troubleshoot advanced latency, routing, packet loss, and connectivity issues.
* Support DR/BCP planning and ensure network resiliency.
* Implement IaC using Terraform, Bicep, and ARM templates.
* Collaborate with DevOps to integrate network deployments into CI/CD pipelines.
* Automate network provisioning for repeatable and consistent builds.
* Work closely with Cloud, Security, DevOps, Application, and Data teams.
* Present architecture decisions to leadership (CIO/CTO) and guide technology choices.
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across projects.



  





**Skill Set:**



* Deep knowledge of Azure Virtual Network, App Gateway, front door, Load Balancer, AFD, Azure Firewall.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, DNS, DHCP, VPN, SD\-WAN.
* Experience with enterprise firewalls (Fortinet, Palo Alto, CheckPoint, Cisco ASA).
* Hands\-on with monitoring tools: Azure Monitor, Network Watcher, Traffic Analytics.
* Strong troubleshooting skills (Wireshark, packet captures, routing diagnostics).
* Tools \& Automation
* Terraform / Bicep / ARM
* Azure DevOps, GitHub, CI/CD
* PowerShell, Python (optional but preferred)



  





**Qualifications:**




 Any Graduate with B. E / B. Tech, MCA or equivalent degree with more than 6\+ years relevant work experience.
 



 4 years of experience in Network Engineering/Architecture.
 



 Minimum 4 years of Azure cloud networking experience.
 



  





**Certifications Preferred:**



* AZ\-700: Azure Network Engineer Associate
* AZ\-305: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* CCNP / CCIE (for on\-prem routing/switching)
* Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto PCNSE

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Description: Cloud Security Engineer
 



**Reports to:** 
 Security Lead
 



**Level:** 
 Mid (IC)
 



 Mission
 



 Own the identity, access, and network security control plane — CyberArk, Zscaler and Cloudflare — for a fast\-scaling, AI\-driven insurance infrastructure org. You'll take these tools from initial deployment handoff to steady, auditable, day\-2 operations, and be the technical backbone the Security Lead relies on for privileged access and network security posture.
 



 What you'll own
 



 • CyberArk (PAM) — safe/policy design, privileged account lifecycle, credential rotation monitoring, access recertification
 



 • Zscaler (SSE) — policy tuning, app onboarding, exception handling
 



 • Cloudflare (WAF/CDN, and Zero Trust/Access if applicable) — rule tuning, DNS, edge security posture
 



 Key responsibilities
 



 • Take over day\-2 administration of CyberArk from the implementation partner; ensure clean runbooks/SOPs exist and are maintained
 



 • Run privileged access onboarding/offboarding and periodic access recertification, feeding evidence to the GRC Analyst for audit cycles
 



 • Own Zscaler and Cloudflare policy baselines; manage exceptions without degrading security posture
 



 • Partner with engineering teams as headcount scales to keep IAM and network controls usable, not just secure
 



 • Support technical deep\-dives requested by auditors or pen testers on identity/network architecture
 



 • Identify opportunities to automate policy\-drift detection and routine PAM/SSE administration, in line with the team's AI\-driven, lean operating model
 



 • Escalate control\-design questions or audit findings on these tools to the Security Lead
 



 What we're looking for
 



 • 3–6\+ years in security engineering, with hands\-on ownership of at least one PAM platform (CyberArk strongly preferred) in production
 



 • Working experience with a cloud SSE/ZTNA platform (Zscaler, Cloudflare Access, or similar) and a CDN/WAF
 



 • Comfortable being the sole owner of high\-scrutiny controls in an audited environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar)
 



 • Strong scripting/automation ability (Python, Terraform, or similar) to keep a lean team's operational load sustainable
 



 • Clear written communication — you'll produce evidence and explanations auditors and pen testers can follow
 



 Nice to have
 



 • Insurance, financial services, or other regulated\-industry background
 



 • Experience standing up or maturing a PAM program from a fresh implementation
 



 • Exposure to NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law or similar state insurance regulatory frameworks
 



 How we'll know you're succeeding
 



 • CyberArk, Zscaler, and Cloudflare pass audit control tests with minimal findings
 



 • Privileged access recertification completed on schedule every cycle
 



 • No unplanned production impact from policy changes across owned tools
 



 • Routine administration increasingly automated rather than manual quarter over quarter

title: Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer

This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. * Monitor and support the network health of on\-premises and cloud infrastructures.

description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
 We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

 If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
   

  

**About Commvault**
 Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI\-powered platform combines best\-in\-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning\-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.
   

  

**Senior Engineer\- DevOps**
**The Opportunity**
 We have an outstanding career opportunity for Senior Engineer\- DevOps at Bangalore, Hyderabad and Pune locations to join the Hyperscale (HSX) Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have strong software development, automation, infrastructure, and system\-level troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work across complex distributed environments spanning compute, storage, networking, virtualization, containers, and cloud platforms.
   

  

 In this role, you will design and develop automation frameworks, enhance provisioning and deployment capabilities, troubleshoot complex product and customer issues, and contribute to improving the reliability, scalability, serviceability, and overall quality of the Hyperscale platform. You will collaborate closely with development, QA, support, field engineering, and other cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality solutions and resolve complex customer issues.
   

  

**What You’ll Do…**
* Design, develop, and maintain automation using Python, Shell scripting, and Ansible for server provisioning, configuration, deployment, upgrades, and patching of Hyperscale environments.
* Develop reusable Ansible roles, modules, and playbooks to standardize and simplify product deployment and infrastructure configuration.
* Build and enhance automation frameworks for deploying and configuring distributed system components.
* Automate deployment and configuration of technologies such as HAProxy, Corosync, and other clustering, high\-availability, and monitoring components.
* Develop and maintain automation for S3 deployment, configuration, and validation/testing.
* Deploy and validate software across multiple operating systems and hardware configurations to ensure compatibility and reliability.
* Work with modern bare\-metal provisioning frameworks such as RackN and extend existing frameworks when required.
* Develop tools and scripts that improve engineering productivity, diagnostics, deployment, testing, and operational efficiency.
* Navigate and maintain existing C\+\+ and XML\-based codebases, making targeted enhancements and fixes when required.
* Effectively use AI\-assisted software development tools, including GitHub Copilot and similar technologies, to accelerate development, code understanding, debugging, test creation, and modernization of legacy components.
* Design and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions for provisioning and managing development and test environments.
* Automate creation, modification, and deletion of virtual machines and infrastructure resources on VMware and Hyper\-V.
* Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot containerized workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
* Develop infrastructure automation using Python libraries and frameworks such as Boto3, Paramiko, Fabric, and PyYAML.
* Configure and troubleshoot compute, storage, and networking resources across cloud, virtualized, and on\-premises environments.
* Automate bare\-metal operating system and HSX ISO installation using PXE/network boot technologies, including RackN and Cobbler.
* Use Git\-based development workflows for source control, collaboration, code reviews, and release management
* Product Engineering, Troubleshooting \& Customer Issue Resolution. Analyze system logs, application logs, crash information, error reports, network behavior, storage behavior, and performance metrics to identify root causes.
* Build and maintain engineering environments for functional, integration, regression, upgrade, and compatibility testing across major and minor product releases.
* Validate product functionality across supported hardware platforms, operating systems, hypervisors, cloud environments, and infrastructure configurations.


**Who You Are…**
* Bachelor's degree required.
* 4 or more Years of experience.
* Strong software development experience with Python and Shell scripting.
* Hands\-on experience with configuration management and automation technologies, particularly Ansible.
* Strong understanding of Linux operating systems, system administration, networking, storage, and distributed system concepts.
* Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware and/or Hyper\-V.
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and/or OpenShift.
* Experience developing infrastructure and system automation using Python libraries such as Boto3, Paramiko, Fabric, or PyYAML.
* Familiarity with bare\-metal provisioning and network boot technologies such as PXE, RackN, or Cobbler.
* Working knowledge of Git and modern software development workflows.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex issues across application and infrastructure layers.
* Ability to read and understand existing C\+\+ and XML code and make targeted changes when required.
* Experience troubleshooting production or customer environments and performing detailed root\-cause analysis (RCA).
* Enterprise storage, backup, recovery, or data\-management platforms preferred.
* Security and SaaS experience strongly preferred.


**You’ll Love Working Here Because**
* Employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
* Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
* Annual health check\-ups, Car lease Program, and Tuition Reimbursement
* An inclusive company culture, an opportunity to join our Community Guilds
