title: Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring \& resolution in large\-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi\-vendor infrastructures.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
* Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
* Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
* Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
* Monitor and support the network health of on\-premises and cloud infrastructures.
* Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.


**What We Need To See**
* Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS\-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
* Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
* Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
* Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
* Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
* Hands\-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
* Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
* Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
* Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
* Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.


 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hard\-working people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Engineering Manager - Regression Testing
description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

**About the Role**
 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced QA Manager to lead the regression testing effort. You will manage, mentor, and grow a team of SDETs, set test and automation strategy for regression, own quality standards and metrics, and partner closely with other QA managers to deliver reliable, secure releases. You'll work across web, browser extension, mobile, desktop, CLI, and server components, supporting a great team and an amazing open\-source community. This role is primarily for someone strong in people leadership, QA strategy and process, and quality ownership, with the technical credibility to coach engineers and make sound testing and tooling decisions.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of QA’s: hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.
* Set and own QA regression strategy: test strategy, quality standards, processes, and tooling direction across the team
* Define, track, and report quality metrics and KPIs, surfacing the QA health of projects to engineering leadership.
* Partner with other QA managers to define testing requirements and ensure comprehensive coverage across manual and automated efforts.
* Guide the team's balance of manual and automated testing investment, and oversee defect tracking and timely resolution.
* Partner with DevOps to integrate QA into CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive adoption of modern tooling and AI\-assisted testing practices across the team.
* Stay technically credible: enough hands\-on depth to coach engineers, review approaches, and make sound automation and coverage decisions.


**What You'll Bring**
* People leadership and team development: managing, mentoring, and growing SDETs. This includes coaching, performance, and hiring (6\+ years in QA, including 3\+ years managing or leading QA teams).
* QA strategy and process ownership: defining test and automation strategy as it pertains to regression testing. Quality standards, and process across the team.
* Technical credibility across manual and automated testing: enough depth to set direction, coach engineers, and make sound tooling, coverage, and automation decisions
* Metrics and stakeholder management: quality KPIs, reporting QA health to leadership, and cross\-functional partnership.
* Personal fluency with AI tooling for testing/QA workflows and openness to driving its adoption (Anthropic Claude preferred).
* Should have hands\-on automation background (C\#/Selenium/Appium) and willingness to dive into tests or code when needed.
* Should have demonstrated experience leading AI adoption or an automation transformation across a QA team.
* Should have experience building or scaling QA processes and frameworks from a lower\-maturity starting point.CI/CD ownership and integrating QA into pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).SaaS, security, identity, privacy, or developer\-facing product experience.


 Good to have
   

  

* Bitwarden product/domain knowledge.
* Specific automation language or stack (C\# specifically) given strong leadership and a transferable automation background.
* Specific CI/CD platform (Jenkins vs. GitLab CI vs. GitHub Actions).
* Specific test management tooling.Claude Code or similar AI coding/test\-generation tools.
* Bitwarden internal architecture and the open\-source contribution process.


**Why Join Us**
 This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
   

  

 Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization \& contribute to products used by customers around the world.
   

  

 If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast\-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

description:
Job Description – SRE (Monitoring \& Observability)
   

  

 Experience: 1 Year
   

 Role: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Monitoring \& Observability
   

  

 Job Summary
   

  

 We are looking for an SRE with around 1 year of experience in Monitoring and Observability to help ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of applications and infrastructure. The candidate should have hands\-on knowledge of ELK Stack, Linux, and Grafana, along with basic incident management and troubleshooting skills.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- 1 year of experience in SRE, Production Support, Monitoring, or Observability.
   

 \- Good knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems and basic troubleshooting commands.
   

 \- Hands\-on experience with ELK Stack – Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana.
   

 \- Experience creating and monitoring Grafana dashboards.
   

 \- Understanding of monitoring concepts such as metrics, logs, alerts, SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs.

 Good to Have
   

  

 \- Knowledge of Prometheus and alerting.

 Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of production systems through proactive monitoring, effective observability, timely incident response, and continuous improvement of monitoring and alerting.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**The Opportunity** 




 RediMinds is looking for an experienced
 **Technical Operations Manager** 
 to help build an exceptional engineering organization in India.
 



 Our engineering team is sharp, ambitious and highly capable. Many joined RediMinds early in their careers and have grown rapidly with the company. We are now looking for an experienced engineering leader who can work closely alongside them, bringing the practices, judgment and standards that come from having built and operated multiple complex engineering systems before.
 



 You will partner closely with our Director of Engineering to strengthen engineering quality, reliability and operating discipline across all of our engineering teams and be the go\-to resource for our engineers. You will mentor engineers, help solve difficult technical problems, improve development and production practices, and help the team understand what world\-class engineering looks like in practice.
 



 The goal is not to create more process. It is to build trust and help an already talented team become an exceptional one.
 



 This role is based in Gurugram, India and we expect the Technical Operations Manager to work from our Gurugram office at least three days per week, providing engineers with accessible, day\-to\-day technical leadership, mentorship and support.
 



**Raise the engineering bar** 



* Bring proven engineering practices from high\-quality SaaS and technology environments to strengthen architecture, code quality, testing, deployment, reliability, observability, and maintainability.
* Review technical approaches and guide engineers toward sound design and implementation decisions.
* Identify recurring engineering gaps, address root causes, and establish practical standards that improve quality without slowing delivery.



**Mentor and develop engineers** 



* Provide hands\-on technical mentorship and help engineers strengthen judgment, problem\-solving, and engineering discipline.
* Use code reviews, architecture discussions, incident reviews, and day\-to\-day problem\-solving as learning opportunities.
* Help engineers understand both
 **what** 
 to do and
 **why** 
 , while building ownership and confidence rather than dependency.
* Identify individual development opportunities and support engineers in progressing to the next level of their careers.



  





**Strengthen technical operations** 



* Improve the reliability and operational maturity of RediMinds’ production systems by strengthening deployments, monitoring, observability, incident response, root\-cause analysis, change management, disaster recovery, and production support practices.
* Establish meaningful service\-level indicators, reliability metrics, and operational health measures, while ensuring incidents drive learning and systemic improvement. Increase automation and reduce avoidable manual operational work.
* Strengthen CI/CD, automated testing, release practices, and engineering discipline across development, testing, staging, and production environments. Promote smaller, safer, and more frequent releases while identifying opportunities to increase development velocity without compromising quality.



  





**Support difficult technical problems** 



* Serve as a senior technical resource for engineers, helping teams systematically diagnose complex systems, architecture, and production challenges and arrive at sound, practical solutions.
* Facilitate technical decision\-making across competing approaches and trade\-offs, stepping into critical situations when needed while enabling teams to build the skills and confidence to solve similar problems independently in the future.



  





**Build an engineering culture of excellence** 



* Foster a culture where engineers take pride in the quality, reliability, and elegance of what they build, while promoting strong ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Encourage thoughtful experimentation and adoption of modern engineering tools and practices, including AI\-assisted software development, while helping teams learn from incidents, projects, and one another.
* Make engineering excellence a visible, everyday part of how teams work—not simply a set of documented standards—by embedding quality, learning, and continuous improvement into engineering practices.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 During your first 12–18 months, we would expect you to:
 


* Establish strong working relationships and credibility with the India engineering team while helping engineers demonstrate stronger technical judgment, ownership, and independence.
* Establish and consistently apply higher standards for engineering quality, production readiness, development, testing, deployment, CI/CD, release management, and operational practices.
* Improve system reliability, observability, and production health by reducing recurring incidents and establishing effective incident review, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement practices.
* Create scalable, repeatable engineering practices and develop technical leaders within the team, resulting in a visible improvement in the quality, consistency, and overall maturity of engineering output beyond your direct involvement.



  





**The Person We Are Looking For** 



* You are an experienced engineer and technical leader who has seen what excellent software engineering looks like and knows how to help teams achieve it. You have worked in mature SaaS or technology environments where reliability, code quality, testing, observability, automation, and disciplined production operations were core expectations—and you have personally built and operated systems where these practices mattered.
* You are still deeply technical and enjoy reviewing architecture, debugging difficult problems, examining incidents and deployment processes, and working directly with engineers to find better solutions. At the same time, you are a teacher who develops others rather than simply solving problems for them.
* You lead with a high bar and low ego. You ask thoughtful questions, explain your reasoning, challenge constructively, and help engineers develop the judgment, ownership, and confidence to solve increasingly difficult problems independently—creating an environment where people are motivated to reach that high standard.



  





**Required Experience** 



* 9\+ years of software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or related technical experience, ideally in SaaS or product technology environments, with several years of technical leadership or mentorship experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience building and operating scalable cloud\-based SaaS platforms, with deep knowledge of at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, along with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, monitoring, observability, reliability, incident response, and root\-cause analysis.
* Proven ability to improve engineering practices across testing, deployments, code review, release management, and production operations; review technical designs, identify risks and weaknesses, and drive simpler, more reliable solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and elevate team capabilities, with strong written and verbal communication skills and a practical, low\-ego leadership style that remains hands\-on when needed.



  





**Especially Valuable** 




 Experience with any of the following would be particularly valuable:
 



 · Healthcare technology or other highly regulated technology environments.
 



 · High\-volume SaaS platforms where reliability and data integrity are critical.
 



 · Security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HITRUST, ISO 27001, NIST or FedRAMP.
 



 · Kubernetes, containers and infrastructure as code.
 



 · Modern observability and SRE practices.
 



 · Automated QA and testing frameworks.
 



 · AI\-assisted software development and agentic engineering tools.
 



 · Supporting distributed engineering teams across India and the United States.
 



 · Building or significantly improving engineering practices in a fast\-growing company.
 



 · Developing talented early\-career engineers into strong senior engineers and technical leaders.
 



 Leadership Style
 



**We are looking for someone who:** 




 · Leads through technical credibility rather than title.
 



 · Sets a high bar and helps people understand how to reach it.
 



 · Coaches rather than simply fixes.
 



 · Is comfortable getting into the details.
 



 · Creates clarity and structure without unnecessary bureaucracy.
 



 · Looks for root causes rather than patches.
 



 · Believes automation is better than repeated manual work.
 



 · Treats incidents and mistakes as opportunities to improve systems and capability.
 



 · Gives clear, constructive feedback.
 



 · Takes pride in building excellent engineers as well as excellent technology.
 



**About Rediminds** 




 At RediMinds, we build AI\-enabled systems that help complex industries operate better, faster, and more intelligently. Our work spans healthcare, legal, finance, government, and other high\-impact domains where software quality, trust, and speed truly matter.
 



 We are a growing, entrepreneurial team that values ownership, clarity, compassion, and technical excellence. We're looking for builders who want to grow with us, contribute meaningfully, and be part of a team creating real products with real\-world impact.
 



  





 RediMinds, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

****Position:****

* Establish standards for traffic flow, network segmentation, connectivity, and security.

* Support TLS/SSL, Certificates, Encryption, Secure Communication, and Zero Trust initiatives.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer / Quality Engineering Lead who will own the transformation of QA engineering at RunLoyal.
 



 This role is suited for someone who goes beyond executing test cases and is comfortable designing automation frameworks, testing APIs and databases, debugging issues, performing root\-cause analysis, and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
 



 The ideal candidate should be technically strong, curious, and capable of understanding a system end\-to\-end from requirements and user stories through development, testing, release, and production monitoring.
 



  





**QA Transformation \& Engineering Leadership** 



* Assess the current QA organization, automation maturity, testing processes, tools, and technical capabilities.
* Define and execute a roadmap to transform QA into an automation\-first Quality Engineering function.
* Establish standards for automation architecture, coding practices, test design, test data, environments, and reporting.
* Identify high\-risk manual testing areas and systematically convert them into reliable automated coverage.
* Establish a scalable automation strategy across UI, API, integration, mobile, and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Define quality gates and integrate automated testing into CI/CD.
* Establish engineering metrics to measure automation coverage, test reliability, escaped defects, regression execution time, and release quality.
* Mentor and upskill existing QA engineers in programming, automation, API testing, SQL, debugging, and system\-level testing.
* Identify technical capability gaps within the QA team and recommend training, tooling, process improvements, or additional hiring.
* Establish a culture of quality ownership rather than test execution.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Automation Testing** 



* Design, develop, maintain, and enhance automated test suites for web applications and APIs.
* Build scalable and maintainable automation using tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Playwright MCP, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, Cucumber, or equivalent.
* Develop reusable automation components and frameworks rather than relying only on record\-and\-playback approaches.
* Maintain and optimize automated regression suites across product releases.
* Identify manual testing activities that can be automated and continuously improve test coverage.
* Analyze automation failures and distinguish between application defects, test defects, environment issues, and data issues.



**2\. Functional \& System Testing** 



* Understand product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
* Design comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, and test strategies for complex features.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Validate complete business workflows across multiple services and components.
* Identify edge cases and potential failure scenarios before they reach production.
* Participate actively in sprint planning, refinement, retrospectives, and release activities.



**3\. API Testing** 



* Design and execute API test scenarios covering:
* Positive and negative cases
* Authentication and authorization
* Request/response validation
* Error handling
* Data integrity
* Integration scenarios
* Work with tools such as Postman, REST Assured, Swagger, or equivalent.
* Build automated API test suites where appropriate.
* Validate API behavior against database records and application behavior.



**4\. Database Testing** 



* Write and execute SQL queries to validate application data.
* Perform backend validation using databases such as MySQL/PostgreSQL or equivalent.
* Verify data consistency between UI, APIs, and backend systems.
* Identify data\-related defects and assist developers in troubleshooting them.



**5\. Debugging, Logs \& Root Cause Analysis** 



* Investigate defects beyond simply reproducing them.
* Analyze application logs, network logs, and monitoring information to identify the root cause of issues.
* Collaborate with developers to provide meaningful technical information for defect resolution.
* Perform RCA for production and pre\-production issues.
* Work with monitoring/logging tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana, New Relic, Splunk, or equivalent.



**6\. CI/CD \& Release Quality** 



* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Work with tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, Maven, Gradle, Docker, or equivalent.
* Ensure automated regression suites run reliably as part of the development/release process.
* Analyze failed pipelines and automation failures.
* Support release validation and production deployment activities.



**7\. Defect Management** 



* Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using tools such as JIRA or equivalent.
* Provide clear reproduction steps, expected vs. actual results, logs, screenshots, and supporting evidence.
* Work closely with developers and product teams to drive defects to resolution.
* Perform regression testing after fixes.
* Identify recurring defects and contribute to preventive quality improvements.



**8\. Quality Engineering \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Identify gaps in the existing QA process and recommend improvements.
* Improve automation coverage, reliability, execution time, and maintainability.
* Contribute to QA standards, test strategies, automation frameworks, and documentation.
* Continuously evaluate new testing approaches and tools that can improve engineering efficiency.
* Use AI\-assisted testing and automation tools such as Claude and other AI coding/testing assistants where appropriate to improve productivity.
* Explore and leverage Playwright MCP and AI\-enabled testing workflows to improve test creation, execution, debugging, and maintenance.



  





**Required Skills** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 5\-8 years of experience in software QA/testing, with a focus on Quality Engineering leadership and automation strategy (exceptional candidates with 4\-5 years of experience may be considered).
* Strong hands\-on experience in automation testing.
* Strong programming knowledge in Java, JavaScript, Python, or a similar language.
* Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to design scalable, maintainable automation architectures over expertise in specific tools.
* Playwright
* Selenium
* Cypress
* Appium
* Strong understanding of API testing.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs and tools such as Postman or REST Assured.
* Good knowledge of SQL and database testing.
* Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience creating and maintaining automation frameworks/test suites.
* Experience working with Git and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to analyze logs and perform debugging and root\-cause analysis.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and QA processes.
* Ability to test a system end\-to\-end rather than focusing only on individual UI screens.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with TestNG, Cucumber, Page Object Model (POM).
* Experience with Playwright MCP or similar MCP\-based testing/automation workflows.
* Experience with mobile testing using Appium.
* Experience with performance/load testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
* Experience with Docker/Kubernetes.
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with monitoring/logging tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or New Relic.
* Experience testing complex SaaS, enterprise, fintech, payments, or transactional systems.
* Exposure to security testing.
* Exposure to AI/LLM\-based applications and AI\-assisted testing.
* Hands\-on experience using Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar AI tools for test automation, debugging, code generation, test\-case creation, or productivity enhancement.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 The ideal candidate is someone who:
 


* Thinks like an engineer, not just a test executor.
* Can understand a complex system and identify how different components interact.
* Can independently build or extend an automation framework.
* Is comfortable going from UI → API → Database → Logs when investigating an issue.
* Can write code and debug automation failures independently.
* Can determine what should be automated and what should remain manual.
* Has strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Is comfortable challenging requirements and identifying gaps before development is completed.
* Takes ownership of quality rather than considering QA to be only the final stage before release.
* Can work effectively with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders.
* Is comfortable working on unfamiliar and technically complex systems.
* Is open to adopting AI\-assisted QA and modern automation approaches, including tools such as Claude and Playwright MCP.



  





**Technical Depth We Expect** 




 For this role,
 **automation is a core requirement, not an additional skill** 
 .
 



 A candidate should ideally be able to demonstrate that they can take a feature and independently:
 



 Understand requirement → identify test scenarios → design test strategy → create automation → test APIs → validate database → execute regression → investigate failures → analyze logs → raise defects → validate fixes → integrate testing into CI/CD.
 



 That is the level of ownership we expect from this role.
 



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent practical experience may be considered.



  





**Certifications (Good to Have)** 




 Certifications in Selenium, Playwright, API testing, cloud, or QA are good to have but not mandatory.
 



 Hands\-on technical ability and demonstrated automation experience will be given significantly more importance than certifications.

title: Solution Architect- Infrastructure, cloud & security
description:
Role Overview:
 



  





 We are looking for a Solution Architect with strong Infrastructure and Azure expertise who can design secure, resilient and supportable solutions in a large, complex organisation.
 



  





 The essential focus of this role is infrastructure, cloud and networking architecture across on\-premises, Azure and hybrid environments. The successful candidate will be technically credible in Azure and infrastructure design, with sufficient networking depth to shape connectivity decisions and work effectively with network engineering and security specialists. They will also be able to think beyond a single technology silo and understand the wider impact of their decisions across security, identity, integration, operations and business outcomes.
 



  





 Our technology estate includes SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Genesys and Azure\-based platforms. Direct experience across all of these platforms is not required, but the successful candidate should be comfortable working with architects and specialists across these domains.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong cloud and infrastructure knowledge with practical networking architecture experience, company\-wide solution thinking, sound judgement and curiosity about how different technology domains interact.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Lead infrastructure and cloud architecture activities across a diverse technology landscape.
* Design secure, resilient and supportable solutions aligned to enterprise standards.
* Contribute to Azure strategy, cloud adoption and platform evolution.
* Define and assure networking and connectivity architectures across on\-premises, Azure and hybrid environments, working with network engineering and security specialists where detailed engineering expertise is required.
* Work closely with architects across SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Data and Integration domains.
* Support enterprise identity, authentication and access management strategies.
* Contribute to security architecture discussions and ensure security is embedded into solution designs.
* Support architecture governance, roadmap development and domain stewardship activities where relevant.
* Help define infrastructure standards, patterns and architectural guardrails.
* Support enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives and cloud migration programmes.
* Consider operational supportability, resilience, disaster recovery and lifecycle management in solution designs.



  





**Essential Skills \& Experience:** 




  




* Strong Infrastructure Architecture experience.
* Strong Azure architecture experience.
* Experience designing solutions for large, complex organisations.
* Strong practical knowledge of on\-premises, cloud and hybrid networking architecture, including network segmentation, routing, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, private connectivity, resilience and secure cloud access patterns. Deep specialist expertise across every networking technology is not expected, but candidates must be able to make sound architectural decisions and work effectively with network engineering and security specialists.
* Experience working with identity and access management concepts.
* Ability to engage effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience balancing technical, security, operational and business requirements.
* Strong communication and influencing skills.



  





**Highly Desirable** 




  





 The following areas are highly desirable rather than mandatory. We would not expect candidates to demonstrate deep expertise across all of them, but experience in some areas, combined with the curiosity and judgement to work effectively with specialists in the others, would be a strong advantage.
 


* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID.
* Understanding of Zero Trust principles.
* Experience with Conditional Access, Privileged Access and identity governance.
* Experience supporting enterprise platforms such as SAP, ServiceNow or Salesforce.
* Experience with security architecture and risk\-based design decisions.
* Understanding of integration and data architecture principles.
* Experience with cloud landing zones and enterprise governance models.
* Experience contributing to technology roadmaps and standards.



  





 The Type of Architect We Are Looking For
 



  





 We are seeking a strong Infrastructure and Azure architect who can think beyond a single technology silo.
 



  





 The successful candidate will understand that infrastructure decisions can impact applications, data, security, integration, operations and business outcomes. They will be comfortable working across architectural boundaries, collaborating with other domain specialists and helping shape solutions that are coherent across multiple technologies.
 



  





 Whilst Azure and Infrastructure will be their primary area of expertise, they will have a genuine interest in broader company\-wide technology considerations and an appreciation of how cloud, identity, security, integration and business platforms work together.
 



  





 Why This Role Is Different
 



  





 Many infrastructure architecture roles focus primarily on hosting, networking and cloud technologies.
 



 In this role, we are looking for someone who can combine deep Azure and infrastructure expertise with broader company\-wide solution thinking. The successful candidate will work alongside architects responsible for SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Data and Integration and will play a key role in shaping secure, resilient and supportable end\-to\-end solutions.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**About Us:** 




  





 Mobileum is a leading provider of Telecom analytics solutions for roaming, core network, security, risk management, domestic and international connectivity testing, and customer intelligence. More than 1,000 customers rely on its Active Intelligence platform, which provides advanced analytics solutions, allowing customers to connect deep network and operational intelligence with real\-time actions that increase revenue, improve customer experience, and reduce costs. Know our story: https://www.mobileum.com/
 



  





 Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Mobileum has global offices in Australia, Dubai, Germany, Greece, India, Portugal, Singapore and UK with global HC of over 1800\+.
 



  





**About NTR:** 




  





 NTR (Network Traffic Redirector) is Mobileum's flagship in\-path roaming traffic steering solution, deployed across 600\+ operator networks worldwide and engineered for five\-nines availability. Built on Core Java, RAID (our no\-code/low\-code UI and ETL platform), Couchbase, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and Kubernetes/OpenShift, NTR steers roaming traffic in real time at carrier scale. We're now building agentic, GenAI\-powered copilot capabilities on top of NTR, enabling autonomous configuration, natural\-language operator assistance, and intelligent, self\-healing traffic\-steering decisions.
 



  





**Overview:** 









 We are hiring a Principal Engineer to architect Mobileum's agentic, GenAI\-powered copilot capabilities for NTR — our carrier\-grade, in\-path roaming traffic steering platform used across 600\+ operator networks. You will design how multi\-agent orchestration, tool integration, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) let NTR autonomously configure and operate itself, while staying hands\-on with core NTR engineering and mentoring the wider team. This is a deep technical architecture role: you set the target\-state design and technical standards for agentic AI on NTR, and you're still writing code and prototyping alongside the team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Agentic Architecture \& Strategy** 



* Define the target\-state architecture for NTR's agentic copilot platform: multi\-agent orchestration, tool/function\-calling integration, and RAG pipelines over NTR configuration, telemetry, and documentation
* Select and evaluate agent frameworks, LLM providers, and orchestration patterns (e.g., LangGraph\-style stateful workflows)
* Define the model\-hosting strategy (self\-hosted/on\-prem vs. API\-based LLMs), accounting for the data\-residency and security constraints typical of Tier\-1 telco on\-premise deployments
* Establish safety, guardrail, and evaluation standards for autonomous or semi\-autonomous NTR actions (approval workflows, audit trails, hallucination/regression checks)



  





**Platform \& Integration Engineering** 



* Architect the integration layer between agentic services and NTR's Core Java backend (with a RAID\-based no\-code/low\-code UI), ensuring safe, auditable access to live configuration and telemetry
* Design context management, memory, and retrieval strategy across NTR's data stores (Couchbase, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL)
* Set standards for agent observability, tracing, and production monitoring



**Core NTR Engineering** 



* Remain hands\-on with core NTR features and architecture: roaming traffic steering, signaling/session handling, and high\-availability service design
* Ensure the copilot platform meets NTR's carrier\-grade, five\-nines reliability bar



  





**Technical Leadership \& Enablement** 



* Provide architectural guidance and mentorship to the Technical Lead and engineers building on the platform
* Partner with product, telecom domain experts, and customers to prioritize agentic use cases with the highest operator impact
* Represent the agentic AI roadmap in architecture reviews and executive updates



  





**Required Technical Skills** 




  





**Core Engineering** 



* Deep expertise in Core Java, distributed systems, and backend architecture at carrier scale; familiarity with RAID (Mobileum's no\-code/low\-code UI and ETL platform) a plus
* Strong system design across distributed data stores (Couchbase, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, or similar), Kafka, and Kubernetes/OpenShift



  





**Agentic AI \& GenAI** 



* Proven experience architecting production LLM/agentic systems: multi\-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, RAG
* Deep familiarity with agent frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) and Python
* Strong grasp of vector databases, context/memory management, and agent evaluation, safety, and observability practices



  





**Telecom Domain** 



* Familiarity with telecom/roaming systems, protocols, and roaming analytics; NTR or similar in\-path traffic\-steering experience a strong plus



  





**Leadership** 



* Strong technical influence and mentorship without relying on direct management authority



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 12–16 years of software engineering experience with deep distributed systems/backend architecture expertise (Core Java)
* 3\+ years hands\-on designing and shipping production LLM\-based or agentic AI systems
* Proven ability to set technical direction and influence across teams without direct authority



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Telecom/roaming domain experience, ideally including NTR or in\-path traffic\-steering products
* Deep experience with agent orchestration frameworks and multi\-agent architecture patterns
* Familiarity with MCP/A2A or similar agent communication protocols
* Experience with model evaluation, safety/guardrails, and production LLM observability
* Exposure to fine\-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) or model serving infrastructure



  





**Work Experience: 12\-16 Years** 




  





**Educational Qualification:** 
 BE. / B.Tech., M.E./M.Tech. or M. Sc. in Computer Science / Electronics Engineering / MCA

description:

 Roku is the \#1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
 



 From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable \- and valued \- contribution. We're a fast\-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
 



  
 


 About the role
 
 Roku pioneered TV streaming and continues to innovate and lead the industry. The Roku Channel has us well\-positioned to help shape the future of streaming. Continued success relies on investing in the Roku Cloud TV Platform so we deliver high quality streaming TV experience at a global scale.
 



 You will be part of the Roku Video Platform Engineering team that is building the next generation video services for the Roku Cloud TV Platform. In this role you will work on key video services projects around video ingestion, encoding, VoD/live\-linear, Ads Insertion services, DRM and Video QoS, with the goal of delivering best\-in\-class streaming TV experience across all of Roku devices. The projects that you will work on will impact millions of Roku users around the world. All along, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with key product engineering stakeholders across Roku engineering teams, and lead the design of our video services platform.
 



 The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical leadership, bring endless curiosity and can pair a global mindset with locally relevant execution. You should be a gritty problem solver and self\-starter who can drive programs with the product and commercial teams within Roku and across external strategic partner organizations. The successful candidate will display a balance of hard and soft skills, including the ability to respond quickly to changing business needs.
   

  




 How will I use AI at Roku?
 
 At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 
 



 We value
 
 your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.
 



  
 


 What you’ll be doing
 * You will lead a team of engineers towards building high availability cloud hosted video platform that powers key elements of the Roku streaming platform.
* Spearhead efforts towards building scalable and robust video processing pipelines, improve video workflows including transcoding, packaging, publishing and ads insertion
* Provide technical and organizational leadership in executing our video services initiatives including to deliver high quality, low latency, delightful streaming experiences, fine tune quality of experience, investigate and remediate potential streaming quality of service problems
* Key technical contributor to the design and implementation of core software backend components of video services platform
* Evaluate architectural tradeoffs for performance and security for high performance, and high concurrency video infrastructure applications
* Drive relentless focus on innovation, increasing user delight and improving the quality of user experience, reliability, stability, security and quality of the apps. Contribute towards enhancing a culture of engineering and operational excellence.
* Collaborate across teams – Work with product, UX, and engineering teams to define scope and make product decisions, Influence cross\-team alignment and provide thought leadership across the organization
* Attract top engineers in the industry, mentor and guide overall professional development of the team


 We’re excited if you have
 * 5\+ years proven track record in hiring, building and leading high\-caliber product engineering teams
* 8\+ years of software development experience with deep technical knowledge and expertise in building high availability, large\-scale distributed systems and services
* Experience with modern cloud\-based video processing platforms, e.g. AWS Elemental or Azure Media Services
* Video Streaming domain knowledge, experience with media formats, e.g. DASH, HLS, CMAF, MPEG\-4, etc., and DRM technologies such as Widevine and Fairplay
* Experience with Ad insertion technologies and frameworks is a big plus!
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders, teams, and senior leaders across the organization. Ability to operate at both hands\-on technical depth and strategic leadership level
* Strong leadership, collaboration and communication skills in working with cross\-functional teams across the organization, and delivering on big and ambitious goals
* Experience in Connected TV environments – with understanding of the unique technical constraints and requirements of this space is a big plus.
* Demonstrable GenAI fluency and in actively using Agentic AI engineering tools to accelerate product development
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, plus 10\+ years of experience or equivalent; Master's degree preferred.



  
 


  
 **What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.
 



  
 


**What are some of the benefits?** 

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 



  
 


**Accommodations** 

 Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
 



  
 


**What should I know about Roku's culture?** 

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.
 



 We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem\-solvers, which itself is a two\-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002\.
 



 To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.
 



 By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

* Analyze complex ATP and order confirmation issues and recommend appropriate solutions.

* Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA AATP and SAP APO gATP.

* Strong knowledge of SAP SD / Order\-to\-Cash processes.
* Experience with Product Allocation, ABC, BOP, Advanced Scheduling, and availability checking.
* Good understanding of supply chain planning and advanced intercompany processes.
* Experience designing SAP solutions and translating business requirements into functional concepts.
* Understanding of SAP enhancement technologies, including BAdIs and ABAP\-based enhancements.

=============================================================================================================================================================================

**The Team**


Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate \& Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy \& Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.


Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.

* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends within the Financial Services industry, with interest and knowledge about the current trends in Banking and Payments
* Demonstrate ability to understand and analyze business issues and leverage technology to solve them
* Preferred experience of engaging in strategic issues with senior\-level clients including C\-Suite executives
* Exposure to working in non\-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders
* Exposure around building dynamic Excel models and macros for market sizing, forecasting, and automation of repetitive analysis and reporting tasks
* Ability to craft structured generative research prompts and use tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude or MS Copilot in Excel/PowerPoint) to streamline research, create slides, synthesize interviews, or simulate models
* Experience in developing and deploying LLM tools to accelerate research, generate summaries, and support slide creation

**Core Consulting Skills**

* Clear and concise communication \- Conduct client interviews, participate in workshops / trainings and present recommendations; strong verbal and written skills are critical
* Good client presence – Interact and build relationships with clients and other team members
* Analytical thinking – Comfortable with managing large data sets, ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary), synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data through configurable dashboards; familiarity with Python, and Excel Macro scripting is nice to have
* Logical structuring \- Structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused – Support team in development of deliverables, manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on experience in transitioning large application development/support portfolios — including custom\-built, packaged, and cloud\-native applications — and is fluent in harnessing AI tools, automation, and intelligent accelerators to compress timelines, reduce risk, and elevate transition quality.

* Define transition strategy, milestone frameworks, resource models, and success KPIs for RFP/RFI/SOW responses and contract negotiations

* Lead transitions of 100\+ applications spanning custom development, microservices, APIs, data platforms, ERP/CRM systems, and cloud\-native workloads

Manage all transition phases: Knowledge Acquisition Shadow Reverse Shadow Parallel Run Stabilization (Hypercare)* BAU Handover

title: Cybersecurity Architect
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  


Could you be the full\-time Cybersecurity Architect in our dynamic team located in Bangalore we’re looking for?

  


**Your future role**


Take on a new challenge and apply your comprehensive cybersecurity expertise in a new cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside innovative, dedicated, and forward\-thinking teammates.


You'll lead and shape the cybersecurity landscape within our projects. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (IT, Engineering, Operations), validate security aspects of IT projects, and much more.


You’ll specifically take care of developing use cases, creating business cases with a thorough TCO analysis, and producing or validating architectural documentation. Additionally, you will engage in stakeholder presentations, conduct security studies, and lead design and build phases with subcontractors.


We’ll look to you for:


* Identifying project needs and gathering functional and technical requirements
* Defining use cases and creating an enablement roadmap
* Developing a business case with TCO analysis
* Validating or producing Architecture Design Documents (ADD)
* Presenting solutions and enhancing the service catalog
* Conducting security studies and implementing infrastructure hardening
* Providing troubleshooting expertise and operational support

  

**All about you**


We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:


* A Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology
* CISSP or CISM certification
* Experience in the Transport Industry is a plus
* At least 7 years of work experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on architecture and design
* A strong grasp of security architecture and infrastructure
* Proficiency in risk analysis and network security patterns
* Strong knowledge of cloud solutions and security mechanisms
* Fluency in English

  

**Things you’ll enjoy**


Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:


* Enjoy stability, challenges and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our flexible working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning
* Progress towards senior cybersecurity roles
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  


**Important to note**


As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
  
  

At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting\-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
  
  

We are looking forward to hire Digital Business Transformation Professionals in the following areas :
  
  

Digital Transformation and Technology Strategy
  
  

**Location:** Hyderabad / Hybrid
  
**Experience:** 8\+ years
  
**Function:** Business Consulting / Digital Transformation / Enterprise Architecture
  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

We are looking for a business\-oriented Enterprise Architect to lead technology strategy and architecture workstreams across complex digital transformation engagements.The Enterprise Architect will work with senior business and technology stakeholders to translate enterprise strategy, business capabilities, value streams and future\-state processes into integrated application, data, integration, infrastructure and security architectures. The role will typically operate during Phase 0, discovery, assessment and transformation\-planning engagements, helping customers establish the case for change, evaluate strategic platform options and define an actionable transformation roadmap.The successful candidate will combine architecture depth with strong consulting, facilitation and commercial skills. The role requires the ability to move from current\-state diagnosis to target architecture, prioritized initiatives, business\-case inputs and implementation mobilization.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Lead enterprise architecture and technology strategy workstreams across digital and business transformation engagements.
  
Establish pragmatic architecture methods, principles, standards, viewpoints and decision criteria.
  
Assess current business capabilities, processes, applications, data, integrations, infrastructure, cloud services, security controls and technology risks.
  
Develop business capability maps, value\-stream architectures and traceability between business requirements, processes, applications and data.
  
Define integrated target architectures covering business, application, data, integration, infrastructure, cloud and cybersecurity domains.
  
Translate future\-state processes and operating\-model requirements into technology capabilities, solution options and architecture decisions.
  
Lead digital\-core, ERP, CRM, supply chain, manufacturing, asset\-management, data\-platform and enterprise\-application strategy assessments.
  
Evaluate strategic platforms and vendors based on business fit, architecture fit, scalability, integration, data, security, cost, implementation risk and organizational readiness.
  
Conduct application technical\-health, strategic\-fit and portfolio\-rationalization assessments using frameworks such as TIME or equivalent.
  
Convert architecture gaps and recommendations into prioritized transformation initiatives and implementation work packages.
  
Develop high\-level project charters covering scope, outcomes, capabilities, architecture, dependencies, risks, effort and success measures.
  
Create phased technology roadmaps aligned with business value, process transformation, data foundations, change readiness and investment capacity.
  
Provide technology cost, benefit, dependency and risk inputs to business cases and value\-realization plans.
  
Define enterprise architecture, application, integration and data\-governance models, including decision rights and architecture\-assurance processes.
  
Facilitate workshops and present architecture options, trade\-offs and recommendations to executive and senior\-management stakeholders.
  
Provide technical direction and quality assurance to domain architects, solution architects, business analysts and platform specialists.
  
Support proposals, solution shaping, estimation, presales and development of architecture methods and reusable consulting assets.
  
  

Required Experience and Skills
  
  

8\+ or more years of experience across enterprise architecture, technology strategy, solution architecture or digital transformation.
  
Proven experience leading Phase 0, discovery, assessment, technology strategy, roadmap or pre\-implementation advisory engagements.
  
Strong understanding of business capabilities, value streams, end\-to\-end processes and Target Operating Model design.
  
Experience developing current\-state, target\-state and transition architectures.
  
Ability to integrate business, application, data, integration, infrastructure, cloud and security perspectives.
  
Experience with ERP, digital\-core or enterprise\-platform strategy involving solutions such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion or comparable platforms.
  
Experience assessing and rationalizing complex application portfolios.
  
Experience defining strategic initiatives, project charters, transition architectures and multi\-year transformation roadmaps.
  
Understanding of API, integration\-platform, event\-driven, data\-platform, analytics, master\-data and cloud\-architecture concepts.
  
Experience in one or more complex domains, such as process manufacturing, industrial products, chemicals, energy, utilities, life sciences, consumer products, logistics or asset\-intensive industries.
  
Strong executive communication, consulting, workshop\-facilitation and stakeholder\-management skills.
  
Ability to explain complex architecture decisions as clear business choices, implications and recommendations.
  
Commercial awareness and experience supporting proposals, estimates, business cases or vendor evaluations.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or a related discipline.
  
Postgraduate qualification in business, strategy, technology or management is advantageous.
  
TOGAF, ArchiMate, cloud, data, Microsoft, SAP, Oracle or comparable architecture certification is desirable.
  
Familiarity with enterprise architecture tools such as LeanIX, Ardoq, Bizzdesign, Orbus, MEGA or Sparx Enterprise Architect.
  
Experience with process\-manufacturing concepts such as batch genealogy, quality management, asset traceability and supply\-chain planning is advantageous.
  
Experience working across multiple countries, business units or acquisition\-led technology landscapes is preferred.
  
  

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career\-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.
  
  

Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles
  
  

Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
  
Agile self\-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
  
All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
  
Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Site Reliability, Staff
description:
### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years keeping large\-scale compute environments running, not just available but actually performant, under the kind of load that makes most infrastructure buckle. You understand that when an engineer's simulation job sits in queue for six hours instead of six minutes, that is not a scheduler problem, it is a planning problem, a tuning problem, or a resource allocation problem, and you are the person who figures out which one and fixes it before it becomes a pattern.


You think in systems, not tickets. When LSF or Slurm throws an error, you do not just restart the service, you trace it back to the workload spike, the misconfigured policy, or the storage bottleneck that triggered it. You have built enough automation to know that the script is the easy part, the hard part is designing it so it does not create three new problems when the environment shifts next quarter.


You are comfortable in a room with R\&D engineers who need 10,000 cores by Tuesday and cloud architects who want to move half the farm to Azure, and you can translate between those conversations without losing the thread of what actually has to work. At Synopsys, you will work on HPC infrastructure that powers the chip design tools the world depends on, and the decisions you make will directly affect how fast our engineers can build the next generation of silicon.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Design, build, and optimize large\-scale HPC compute farm platforms that support thousands of engineering workloads across global sites
* Administer and tune IBM Spectrum LSF, Slurm, or equivalent workload schedulers to maximize resource utilization and minimize job queue times
* Lead capacity planning and workload optimization efforts, translating engineering demand into infrastructure requirements and deployment timelines
* Drive automation using Python and Shell scripting to eliminate manual toil, improve reliability, and accelerate incident response
* Lead complex troubleshooting and root cause analysis for platform issues, working across storage, networking, LDAP, NFS, and scheduler layers
* Collaborate with R\&D, Cloud, Infrastructure, and Security teams on strategic initiatives including cloud\-integrated HPC and AI/ML workload enablement
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across global teams, setting standards for operational excellence and engineering rigor
* Participate in 24x5 support operations and lead major infrastructure projects from design through deployment

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable faster product development cycles by ensuring high availability and performance of the compute infrastructure that powers Synopsys EDA tools
* Maximize infrastructure utilization and license efficiency, directly reducing costs and improving engineering productivity across the company
* Reduce incident response time and platform downtime through automation, monitoring, and proactive capacity management
* Accelerate cloud adoption and modernization efforts, helping Synopsys scale compute resources dynamically to meet global engineering demand
* Improve workload throughput and job completion times, giving engineers more iterations per day and faster feedback loops
* Build operational resilience into the platform, ensuring that infrastructure scales reliably as the business grows
* Mentor and elevate the technical capabilities of the global infrastructure engineering team, raising the bar for how we operate and support critical systems

### **What You'll Need**

* 8\+ years of Linux/UNIX systems administration experience with deep expertise in performance tuning, troubleshooting, and large\-scale operations
* 5\+ years of hands\-on HPC or compute farm administration, including workload scheduling, resource management, and capacity planning
* Strong expertise in IBM Spectrum LSF, Slurm, or equivalent schedulers, including policy configuration, job prioritization, and performance optimization
* Advanced knowledge of LDAP, NFS, DNS, enterprise storage systems, and networking in the context of distributed compute environments
* Proven experience with Python and Shell scripting for automation, monitoring, and infrastructure orchestration
* Solid understanding of monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Elastic, or Splunk for proactive incident detection and analysis
* Experience with EDA environments is a strong plus, as is familiarity with cloud\-integrated HPC platforms on Azure or AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, or Terraform

### **Who You Are**

* You take ownership of problems end to end, from the first alert to the post\-incident review, and you do not consider something fixed until you understand why it broke
* You are self\-driven and proactive, the kind of engineer who sees a pattern in the logs and writes the script to prevent it before anyone files a ticket
* You can explain a complex infrastructure tradeoff to a VP in two sentences without losing the technical nuance, and you can turn that same conversation into a design doc for your team
* You are collaborative and team\-oriented, comfortable working across time zones and disciplines to align on solutions that work for everyone
* You have strong analytical and problem\-solving instincts, you do not guess, you instrument, measure, and validate before you change production
* You are focused on service excellence and customer impact, you measure success by whether engineering teams can do their jobs faster and more reliably because of the infrastructure you built

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


The Compute Farm Infrastructure Engineering team operates and enhances Synopsys' global HPC and compute farm platforms. You will work with a distributed team responsible for providing reliable, scalable engineering compute services that support mission\-critical EDA workloads. The team drives automation, modernization, and cloud adoption while maintaining high availability and operational excellence across all global sites.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
